chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ىتح كاوسلبا ينيصوي ليئربج لاز ام :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .دردأ وأ يفحأ نأ تفخ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gabriel kept recommending the use of the siwak to me until I feared that I might wear down my teeth or lose them. Translator: Siwak or miswak refers to a tooth-cleaning twig traditionally used in the Middle East and other parts of the world. It comes from the Salvadora persica tree, also known as the arak tree in Arabic regions, although twigs from other trees can also be used. The siwak is esteemed for its natural antibacterial properties and its effectiveness in oral hygiene. It is used by fraying one end of the twig into a brush-like texture which is then used to clean the teeth.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .كاوسلا نيلسرملا نننس نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Using the siwak is one of the traditions of the messengers.

englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Using the siwak is among the characteristics of the prophets. Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendati...

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .كاوسلاو ،جاوزلأاو ،رطعلا :ءايبنلأا نهيطعأ ثلاث :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Three things were given to the Prophets: perfume, wives, and the siwak.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices

englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The use of the siwak is from the traditions (sunan) of the Messengers.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: للاخلاو ،كاوسلبا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لىع ليئربج لزن :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .ةماجحلاو
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Gabriel descended upon the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's blessings and peace be upon him and his family) with the siwak, toothpick, and cupping (hijamah).

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: هيلع) ليئربج لاز ام :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .يفحأو دردأ نأ تيشخ ىتح كاوسلبا ينيصوي (ملاسلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gabriel (peace be upon him) kept recommending the use of the siwak to me until I feared that I would wear down my teeth and gums.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ىتح كولمملبا ينيصوي لاز امو ،هثرويس هنأ تننظ ىتح راجلبا ينيصوي لاز امو :دازو ،لاسرم قودصلا هاورو .هيف قتعي لاجأ هل برضيس هنأ تننظ
englishText: Al-Saduq narrated it in mursal form, and added: He kept advising me about the neighbor until I thought he would make him an heir, and he kept advising me about the slave until I thought he would set a time for his freedom.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .اهقلاط يغبني لا هنأ تننظ ىتح ةأرملبا ينيصوي لاز امو :رخآ ربخ يفو :لقا مث
englishText: Then he said: And in another narration: And he kept advising me about women until I thought that it was not appropriate to divorce her.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .برلل ةاضرم مفلل ةرهطم كاوسلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا دانسلاا اذهبو
englishText: With this chain of narration, he said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Using the siwak is a purification for the mouth and pleasing to the Lord.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ةحرفمو ،برلل ةاضرمو ،مفلل ةرهطم :لاصخ رشع كاوسلا يف :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .رفحلبا بهذيو ،مغلبلبا بهذيو ،رصبلا ولجيو ،ةثللا دشيو ،ةنسلا نم وهو ،ةكئلاملل
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) say: There are ten qualities in using the siwak: It purifies the mouth, pleases the Lord, brings joy to the angels, it is from the Sunnah, strengthens the gums, sharpens the eyesight, removes phlegm, and eliminates tooth decay.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ةلاجمو ،مفلل ةرهطمو ،ةنسلا نم وه ،ةلصخ ةرشع اتنثا كاوسلا يف لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،رفحلبا بهذيو ،تانسحلا فعاضيو ،نانسلأا ضيبيو ،ظفحلا يف ديزيو ،مغلبا بهذيو ،برلا يضريو ،رصبلل .ةكئلاملا هب حرفتو ،ماعطلا يهشيو ،ةثللا دشيو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said regarding the siwak: It has twelve qualities: it is from the Sunnah, it purifies the mouth, it brightens the eyesight, it pleases the Lord, it removes anxiety, it increases memory, it whitens the teeth, it multiplies good deeds, it removes tooth decay, it strengthens the gums, it stimulates appetite, and the angels rejoice with it.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: الله حىوفأ ،نيكرشملا سافنأ نم ىقلت ام لجو زع الله ىلإ ةبعكلا تكش :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع هيلع الله لىص) ادمحم الله ثعب املف ،رجشلا نابضقب نوفظنتي اموق مهب كلدبم ينفإ ،ةبعك يرق :اهيلإ .للاخلاو كاوسلبا ليئربج عم هيلإ حىوأ (هلآو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: The Ka'bah complained to Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, about what it endures from the breaths of the polytheists. So Allah revealed to it: "Be content, O Ka'bah, for I will replace them for you with a people who clean themselves with tree twigs." When Allah sent Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), He revealed to him through Gabriel about the use of the siwak and toothpick. Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendati...

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .رصبلا ولجيو ،ةعمدلبا بهذي كاوسلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): The siwak removes tears and brightens the eyesight.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .ينانسأ لىع تفخ ىتح كاوسلبا ليئربج يناصوأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gabriel advised me to use the miswak (toothstick) so much that I feared for my teeth.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ام :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا - يهانملا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،قداصلا نع .ةضيرف هلعجيس هنأ تننظ ىتح كاوسلبا ينيصوي ليئربج لاز
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the hadith of prohibitions- he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gabriel kept advising me about using the siwak until I thought he would make it obligatory.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ،(ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع نم كاوسلا ،ليع يا ،نآرقلا ةءارقو ،كاوسلاو ،نابللا :مغلبلا نبهذيو ،ظفحلا يف ندزي ةثلاث ،ليع يا :لقا يهشيو ،ةثللا دشيو ،رفحلبا بهذيو ،نانسلأا ضيبيو ،نامحرلا يضريو ،رصبلا ولجيو ،مفلل ةرهطمو ،ةنسلا .ةكئلاملا هب حرفتو ،تانسحلا فعاضيو ،ظفحلا يف ديزيو ،مغلبلبا بهذيو ،ماعطلا
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him), he said: O Ali, three things increase memory and remove phlegm: frankincense, using the miswak (toothstick), and reciting the Quran. O Ali, using the miswak is from the Sunnah, it purifies the mouth, brightens the eyesight, pleases the Most Merciful, whitens the teeth, removes decay, strengthens the gums, increases appetite for food, removes phlegm, increases memory, multiplies good deeds, and delights the angels.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .ءانحلاو ،ءانسلاو كاوسلاو ،رطعتلا :نيلسرملا ننس نم عبرأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Four practices are from the traditions of the Messengers: perfume, using the siwak, senna (*), and henna. Translator: * A shrub which is used for its medicinal properties.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: يا :ليقف ،اهاوفأ اهبذعأو ،باولق اهقرأ دزلأا مهتتأ اجاوفأ نيدلا يف سانلا لخد امل :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو .ةيلهاجلا يف كاتست تناك اهنلأ :لقا ؟اهاوفأ اهبذعأ تراص ملف ،هانفرع باولق اهقرأ اذه ،الله لوسر
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: When people entered the religion in multitudes, the Azd came to them with the most tender hearts and the sweetest mouths. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, we understand why they have the most tender hearts, but why do they have the sweetest mouths? He said: Because they used to use the siwak in the pre-Islamic period.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .كاوسلا مفلا روهطو ،روهط ئش لكل :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقاو
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: "For everything there is purification, and the purification of the mouth is the siwak."

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .فاحل يف مهعم هوتبالأ كاوسلا يف ام سانلا ملع ول :يورو :لقا
englishText: It was said: And it was narrated: If people knew what was in the siwak, they would keep it with them under their blanket.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: لاف ،بجاوب سيلو كاوسلا رثكي ناك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقاو .ميالأا طرف يف هكرت كرضي
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would frequently use the siwak but it is not obligatory, so it does not harm you to leave it for several days.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: سأرلا يف يتلا امفأ ،دسجلا يف سمخو ،سأرلا يف ننسلا نم سمخ :(ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا وبأ لقا قلحو ،ناتخلفا ،دسجلا يف يتلا امأو ،قاشنتسلااو ،ةضمضملاو ،رعشلا قرفو ،براشلا ذخأو ،كاوسلفا .ءاجنتسلااو ،رافظلأا ميلقتو ،نيطبلإا فتنو ،ةناعلا
englishText: Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) said: Five practices are from the Sunnah for the head, and five for the body. As for those for the head, they are: using the siwak, trimming the mustache, parting the hair, rinsing the mouth, and inhaling water into the nose. As for those for the body, they are: circumcision, shaving the pubic hair, plucking the armpit hair, trimming the nails, and cleaning oneself after relieving nature. chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: رظنلاو ،ءاملا يف سامترلااو ،بوكرلاو ،يشملا :ءايشأ ةرشع يف ةرشنلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لاجرلا ةثداحمو ،كاوسلاو ،عامجلاو ،ءانسحلا ةأرملا ىلإ رظنلاو ،برشلاو ،لكلااو ،ةرضخلا ىلإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Refreshment is in ten things: walking, riding, immersing in water, looking at greenery, eating, drinking, looking at a beautiful woman, sexual intercourse, using miswak, and conversing with men.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ةرهطم :لاصخ رشع هيف كاوسلا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىلإ هعفري دانسإب عيمج نب ورمع نع ،نانسلأا ضيبيو ،رفحلبا بهذيو ،ةنسلا نم وهو ،افعض نيعبس تانسحلا فعاضي ،برلل ةاضرم ،مفلل .ماعطلا يهشيو ،رصبلا ةواشغب بهذيو ،مغلبلا عطقيو ،ةثللا دشيو
englishText: From Amr ibn Jami', with a chain of narration raising it to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), who said: The siwak has ten qualities: It purifies the mouth, pleases the Lord, multiplies good deeds seventy times, is from the Sunnah, removes tooth decay, whitens the teeth, strengthens the gums, cuts phlegm, removes the covering from the eyes, and stimulates appetite.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ةنسو ،لجو زع الله ةاضرم كاوسلاو :لقا - ةئامعبرلأا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع هدانسإبو قلح زاوج مدع ثيداحأ يف ةروكذملا ننسلا لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ .مفلل ةبيطم ،(ملاسلا هيلع) يبنلا .ةيحللا
englishText: By his chain of narrators from Ali (peace be upon him)- in the hadith of the four hundred- he said: And the toothbrush (siwak) is pleasing to Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, and a Sunnah of the Prophet (peace be upon him), purifying for the mouth. I (Hurr Amili) say: And there will come what indicates the mentioned Sunnahs in the hadiths about the impermissibility of shaving the beard.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .لقعلا يف ديزيو مغلبلبا بهذي كاوسلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: The siwak removes phlegm and increases intelligence (aql).

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: هوتبالأ كاوسلا يف ام سانلا ملعي ول :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .فاحل يف مهعم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: If people knew what benefits are in the siwak, they would keep it with them under their blanket.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: - لقا نأ ىلإ - قلاخلأا مراكمب مكيلع :لقا هنأ - ثيدح يف (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج قداصلا نع .ةنسح ةنسو ،ةرهطم اهنفإ كاوسلبا مكيلعو
englishText: From Al-Sadiq Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) in a hadith- he said: You must adhere to noble character traits- until he said- and you must use the siwak, for it is purifying and a good practice.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: يبأ نع ،رامع نب قاحسإ نع ،ةورع نب مساقلا نع ،هيبأ نع :(نساحملا) يف يقربلا دلاخ نب دمحم نب دمحأ .كاوسلا ءايبنلأا قلاخأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع
englishText: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi in (Al-Mahasin): From his father, from Al-Qasim ibn Urwah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Among the characteristics of the prophets is the use of the siwak.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: كاوسلبا ينيصوي ليئربج لاز ام :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ينس لىع تفخ ىتح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gabriel kept recommending the use of the siwak to me until I feared for my teeth.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ىتح كاوسلبا ليئربج يناصوأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ينانسأ لىع تفخ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gabriel advised me to use the miswak (toothstick) so much that I feared for my teeth.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: ةنسو الله ةاضرم كاوسلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع .مفلل ةرهطمو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), he said: Amir al Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Using the siwak is pleasing to Allah, a practice of Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendati... the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and a purifier for the mouth.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .مغلبلل ةافنم وهو رصبلا ولجي كاوسلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: Using the miswak (toothstick) sharpens the eyesight and removes phlegm.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .كاوسلا اهنم دعو ءايشأ ةرشع يف ةرشنلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Invigoration is in ten things, and he counted among them the use of the siwak.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .مغلبلل ةعطقم نآرقلا ةءارقو كاوسلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Using the miswak (toothstick) and reciting the Quran cut phlegm.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .رصبلا ولجي كاوسلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Using the siwak brightens the eyesight.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .رصبلا ولجي هنفإ كاوسلبا مكيلع :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: You should use the siwak, for it brightens the eyesight.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: .مغلبلل ةافنم نابللاو كاوسلاو نآرقلا ةءارق (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Ali (peace be upon him) said: Reciting the Quran, using the siwak, and [chewing] frankincense dispel phlegm.

chapter: Emphasis Of Its Recommendation But Not Obligation, The Recommendation Of Its Constant Use, And Mention Of Various Recommended Practices
arabicText: نفإ كاوسلبا كيلع ليع يا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع (لوقعلا فحت) يف ةبعش نب ليع نب نسحلا حيرب ىذأتت ةكئلاملا نفإ ،ةكئلاملا لىع كببحي للاخلاو ،نيعلل ةلاجمو ،برلل ةاضرمو ،مفلل ةرهطم كاوسلا .ماعطلا دعب للختي لا نم
englishText: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Shu'bah in (Tuhaf al-Uqul) narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said: O Ali, you must use the siwak, for the siwak purifies the mouth, pleases the Lord, and brightens the eyes. And using a toothpick endears you to the angels, for the angels are harmed by the odor of one who does not use a toothpick after eating.

chapter: Dislike Of Abandoning Miswak And The Emphasis On Its Recommendation After Three Days
arabicText: .ةرم هرمت نأ ولو ثلاث لك يف هعدت لا :لقا كاوسلا يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), regarding the siwak he said: Do not abandon it every three days, even if you use it just once.

chapter: Dislike Of Abandoning Miswak And The Emphasis On Its Recommendation After Three Days
arabicText: ؟نوكاتست لا مكلام ؟احلق مكارأ يلام :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: What is wrong that I see you with yellow teeth? Why do you not use the toothstick?

chapter: Dislike Of Abandoning Miswak And The Emphasis On Its Recommendation After Three Days
arabicText: ؟سانلا نم مهلك قلخلا اذه ىرتأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ ليق هنأ ،هيبأ نع ،يطساولا ىيحي يبأ نعو .كاوسلل كراتلا مهنم قلأ :لاقف
englishText: From Abu Yahya al-Wasiti, from his father, that it was said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Do you consider all these creatures to be from among the people? He said: Exclude from them those who abandon the siwak.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak During Ablution
arabicText: نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) لىعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف ناك :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس - لقا نأ ىلإ لاصخلا نم ةلمج دعو - هنعأ مهللا :لقا مث ينع اهظفحفا لاصخب كسفن يف كيصوأ ليع يا لقا .ءوضو لك دنع كاوسلبا كيلعو
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) say: It was in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him) that he said: O Ali, I advise you regarding yourself with qualities, so remember them from me. Then he said: O Allah, help him- and he enumerated a number of qualities until he said- and you must use the siwak with every ablution.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak During Ablution
arabicText: .ةلاص لك ءوضو دنع كاوسلبا كيلع ليع يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him): O Ali, you should use the siwak during ablution for every prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak During Ablution
arabicText: .ءوضولا رطش كاوسلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: Using the siwak is half of ablution.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak During Ablution
arabicText: .ةلاص لك ءوضو دنع كاوسلبا مهترملا يتمأ لىع قشأ نأ لاول :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقاو
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Were it not that I would be overburdening my nation, I would have ordered them to use the siwak for every ablution before prayer. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It is noted here that the command mentioned refers to an obligation, as the recommendation has been established. Recommendation Of Siwak During Ablution

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak During Ablution
arabicText: هيلع) نينمؤملا ريملأ هتيصو يف - (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (عنقملا) باتك يفو .ةلاص لك ءوضو دنع كاوسلبا كيلع :- (ملاسلا
englishText: In the book (Al-Muqni'), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said- in his advice to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him)-: You should use the siwak for ablution before every prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak During Ablution
arabicText: يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ هعفر ،ليعامسإ نب دمحم نع :(نساحملا) يف يقربلا دمحم نب دمحأ .ءوضو لكل كاوسلبا كيلع :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو
englishText: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi in (Al-Mahasin): From Muhammad ibn Isma'il, raising it to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: You should use the siwak for every ablution.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak During Ablution
arabicText: لقاو ،ءوضو لك دنع كاوسلبا كيلع :هتيصو يف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .ةلاص لك دنع :مهضعب
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him) in his advice: You must use the siwak with every ablution. And some of them said: before every prayer.

chapter: If Someone Forgets To Use The Siwak Before Ablution, It Is Recommended For Them To Do So After, And It Is Recommended To Rinse The Mouth Three Times After Using The Siwak
arabicText: نإ تيأرأ :تلق .أضوتي نأ لبق كايتسلاا :لاقف ؟ءوضولا دعب كاوسلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .تارم ثلاث ضمضمتي مث كاتسي :لقا ؟أضوتي ىتح يسن
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about using the siwak after performing ablution? He said: Use the siwak before performing ablution. I said: What if one forgets until after performing ablution? He said: Use the siwak then rinse the mouth three times.

chapter: If Someone Forgets To Use The Siwak Before Ablution, It Is Recommended For Them To Do So After, And It Is Recommended To Rinse The Mouth Three Times After Using The Siwak
arabicText: .ضمضمتيلف كاتسا نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هاور نم ضعب نعو
englishText: And from some who narrated it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever uses a siwak should rinse his mouth.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak Before Every Salat
arabicText: كيلع :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةلاص لكل كاوسلبا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: You should use the siwak for every prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak Before Every Salat
arabicText: .كاوس ريغب ةعكر نيعبس نم لضفأ كاوسلبا ناتعكر :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Two units of prayer (rak'ahs) with the use of the siwak are better than seventy units of prayer without the siwak.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak Before Every Salat
arabicText: .ةلاص لك عم كاوسلبا مهترملا يتمأ لىع قشأ نأ لاول :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقاو
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Were it not that I would be overburdening my nation, I would have ordered them to use the siwak before every prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak Before Every Salat
arabicText: ظفلي ملف هيف لىع هفا كلملا عضو لىصف مقا مث كوسو لجرلا أضوت اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا .همقتلا لاإ ائيش
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: When a man performs ablution and uses the siwak, then stands to pray, the angel places its mouth upon his mouth, and nothing comes forth from it except that the angel catches it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak Before Every Salat
arabicText: .هتءارق ىلإ عمسي ابناج كلملا مقا كتسي مل نفإ :مهضعب هيف دازو :لقا
englishText: He said: And some of them added: If he does not use the siwak, the angel stands aside to listen to his recitation.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak Before Every Salat
arabicText: .كاوس ريغب تاعكر عبرأ نم لضفأ كاوسب نيتعكر ةلاص :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Praying two rak'ahs (units of prayer) with siwak is better than praying four rak'ahs without siwak.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak Before Every Salat
arabicText: ،مفلل ةرهطم :ةلصخ ةرشع اتنثا كاوسلا يف :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىلإ هعفري عيمج نب ورمع نع هب باصتو ،تانسحلا فعاضيو ،ماعطلا يهشيو ،مغلبلا لقيو ،رفحلبا بهذيو ،نانسلأا ضيبيو ،برلل ةاضرمو نم لجو زع الله ىلإ بحأ كاوسلبا نيتعكرو ،نآرقلا قيرطب رمي وهو ،ةثللا دشيو ،ةكئلاملا هرضحتو ،ةنسلا .كاوس ريغب ةعكر نيعبس
englishText: Narrated by Amr bin Jami', raising it to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), who said: There are twelve qualities in using the siwak: It purifies the mouth, pleases the Lord, whitens the teeth, eliminates tooth decay, reduces phlegm, stimulates appetite, multiplies good deeds, achieves the Sunnah, angels attend to it, strengthens the gums, it passes through the path of the Quran, and two rak'ahs (units of prayer) with siwak are more beloved to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, than seventy rak'ahs without siwak.

chapter: Recommendation Of Siwak Before Every Salat
arabicText: .ةلاص لكل كاتسي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ناك :لقا (عنقملا) يفو
englishText: In (Al-Muqni'), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) would use the siwak before every prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using The Siwak In The Morning And After Waking Up From Sleep In General
arabicText: رمأ ةرخلآا ءاشعلا لىص اذإ ناك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع مث ،تاعكر عبرأ ليصيو أضوتيو كاتسيف موقي مث الله ءاش ام دقريف ارمخم هسأر دنع عضوي هكاوسو هئوضوب رخآ يف لقاو ةنسح ةوسأ الله لوسر يف مكل ناك دقل :لقا مث ،(١) ليصيو أضوتيو كاتسيف موقي مث دقري .همون نم مقا ةرم لك يف كاتسي ناك هنإ :ثيدحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would pray the late night prayer, he would order that his ablution water and siwak be placed covered near his head. He would then sleep for as long as Allah willed, then get up, use the siwak, perform ablution and pray four rak'ah. Then he would sleep again, then get up, use the siwak, perform ablution and pray. Then he said: Indeed in the Messenger of Allah you have an excellent example [Quran, 33:21]. And he said at the end of the hadith: He would use the siwak every time he got up from his sleep.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using The Siwak In The Morning And After Waking Up From Sleep In General
arabicText: كتسا مث - لقا نأ ىلإ - لله دمحلا :لقف كمانم نم ليللبا تمق اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .أضوتو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When you get up at night from your sleep, say: Alhamdulillah - until he said - then use the siwak and perform ablution.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using The Siwak In The Morning And After Waking Up From Sleep In General
arabicText: فرح نم سيلف كيف لىع هفا عضيف كيتيأ كلملا نفإ كتسفا ليللبا تمق اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .حيرلا بيط كوف نكيلف ءامسلا ىلإ هب دعص لاإ هب قطنتو هولتت
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When you rise at night, use the siwak because an angel comes to you and places his mouth over your mouth, so not a single letter you recite and utter but it ascends with him to heaven, so let your mouth be of pleasant smell.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using The Siwak In The Morning And After Waking Up From Sleep In General
arabicText: .رحسلا تقو يف كاوسلا يف ةنسلا نأ يورو :ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: It is narrated that it is recommended to use the siwak at the time of suhoor (pre-dawn).

chapter: Recommendation Of Using The Siwak In The Morning And After Waking Up From Sleep In General
arabicText: - لقا نأ ىلإ - لله دمحلا :لقو ءامسلا قفأ يف رظنفا كشارف نم تمق اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .أضوت مث ةنسلا نم ءوضولا لبق رحسلا يف كاوسلا نفإ كاوسلبا كيلعو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: When you get up from your bed, look at the horizon of the sky and say: Alhamdulillah- until he said- and you must use the siwak, for using the siwak before dawn before performing ablution is from the Sunnah, then perform ablution.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using The Siwak In The Morning And After Waking Up From Sleep In General
arabicText: يتيأ كلملا نفإ بيطلا مشي نأو ،كاتسي نأ ليللبا مقا اذإ لجرلل بحلأ ينإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .كلملا كلذ فوج يف لخد ئش نم نآرقلا نم جرخ امف هيف لىع هفا عضي ىتح ليللبا مقا اذإ لجرلا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: I indeed love for a man when he stands at night to use the siwak and to apply perfume, for when a man stands at night, the angel comes to him until it places its mouth upon his mouth, and whatever comes out from the Quran enters into the interior of that angel.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using The Siwak Before Reciting The Quran
arabicText: مكهاوفأ :لقا ؟نآرقلا قيرط امو الله لوسر يا ليق ،نآرقلا قيرط اوفظن :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .كاوسلبا :لقا ؟اذامب :ليق
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Clean the path of the Quran. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, what is the path of the Quran? He said: Your mouths. It was said: With what? He said: With siwak.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using The Siwak Before Reciting The Quran
arabicText: متردق امب اهوبيطف ،احير اهبيطأ الله يلإ اهبحفأ ،مكبر قرط نم مكهاوفأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .هيلع
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Your mouths are among the paths to your Lord, and the most beloved of them to Allah are those with the most pleasant smell, so perfume them with whatever you can.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using The Siwak Before Reciting The Quran
arabicText: .كاوسلبا اهورهطف نآرقلا قرط مكهاوفأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا
englishText: From Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him): Indeed your mouths are pathways for the Quran, so purify them with the siwak.

chapter: Recommendation Of Brushing Teeth Horizontally And Using Tree Branches
arabicText: .اضرع اوكاتساو ارتو اولحتكا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Apply kohl in odd numbers and brush teeth horizontally.

chapter: Recommendation Of Brushing Teeth Horizontally And Using Tree Branches
arabicText: كلدبم ينفإ ةبعك يا يرق اهيلإ الله حىوفأ ،نيكرشملا سافنأ نم ىقلت ام الله ىلإ تكش ةبعكلا نأ يورو :لقا نيملأا حورلا هيلع لزن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) ادمحم هيبن الله ثعب املف رجشلا نابضقب نوفظنتي اموق مهب .كاوسلبا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليئربج
englishText: It was narrated that the Ka'bah complained to Allah about what it endures from the breaths of the polytheists. So Allah revealed to it: Be content O Ka'bah, for I will replace them for you with people who clean themselves with tree twigs. When Allah sent His Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), the trustworthy spirit Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended upon him with the siwak.

chapter: Recommendation Of Brushing Teeth Horizontally And Using Tree Branches
arabicText: عم هيلإ حىوأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) ادمحم الله ثعب املف :لقا هنأ لاإ هوحن (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .للاخلاو كاوسلبا ليئربج
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) similar to it except that he said: When Allah sent Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), He revealed to him through Gabriel about the siwak and toothpick.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Using Siwak Once Even With Fingers
arabicText: ةلاص ىلإ مقا اذإ هديب ةرم كاتسي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هاخأ لأس هنأ رفعج نب ليع نع .هب سبأ لاف حبصلا فاخ اذإ :لقا ؟كاوسلا لىع ردقي وهو ليللا
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far that he asked his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who uses his hand as siwak once when he stands for the night prayer while he has access to a siwak? He said: If he fears (the arrival of) morning, then there is no problem with it.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Using Siwak Once Even With Fingers
arabicText: .ةرم هرمت نأ ولو ثلاث لك يف هعدت لا :لقا كاوسلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding siwak, he said: Do not abandon it every three (days), even if you pass it once.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Using Siwak Once Even With Fingers
arabicText: .كعبصإب هكلدت نأ كاوسلا ىندأ :لقا هدانسإب ليع نعو
englishText: And from Ali through his chain of narration, he said: The minimum siwak is that you rub it with your finger.

chapter: Sufficiency Of Using Siwak Once Even With Fingers
arabicText: ماهبلابا كوستلا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .كاوس ءوضولا دنع ةحبسملاو
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Rubbing the teeth with the thumb and index finger during ablution counts as using a miswak.

chapter: Exemption From The Recommended Practice Of Using The Miswak Due To Weak Teeth From Old Age
arabicText: .هلثم ركذو ،كاوسلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ كرت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ ىلوم ملسم نع
englishText: From Muslim, the freed slave of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) left using the siwak, and he mentioned something similar.

chapter: Dislike Of Using Siwak In The Bathhouse And In Privacy
arabicText: يف كاوسلا نع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىهنو :لقا - يهانملا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع .مامحلا
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in a hadith of prohibitions- he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade using siwak in the bathhouse.

chapter: Dislike Of Using Siwak In The Bathhouse And In Privacy
arabicText: .نانسلأا ءباو ثروي مامحلا يف كاوسلا نأ يورو ،لقا
englishText: He said, and it is narrated that using siwak in the bathhouse causes dental disease.

chapter: Dislike Of Using Siwak In The Bathhouse And In Privacy
arabicText: .نانسلأا ءباو ثروي هنفإ مامحلا يف كاوسلاو كياإو :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: Beware of using siwak in the bathhouse for it causes dental disease. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It has been previously indicated that using the siwak in the privy is disliked due to causing bad breath.

chapter: Permissibility Of Using The Miswak For The Fasting Person, Even With A Moist Miswak, Although There Is A Particular Dislike For Using A Moist Miswak.
arabicText: .ءاش راهنلا يأ كاتسي معن :لاقف ؟مئاصلل كاوسلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about using the siwak for the fasting person. He said: Yes, he may use the siwak at any time of the day he wishes.

chapter: Permissibility Of Using The Miswak For The Fasting Person, Even With A Moist Miswak, Although There Is A Particular Dislike For Using A Moist Miswak.
arabicText: ءاملبا هكاوس لبي نأ رضي لا :لقاو .بطر كاوسب كاتسي نأ مئاصلل هرك هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ئش هيف ىقبي لا ىتح هضفني مث
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he disliked for the fasting person to use a moist siwak. And he said: It is not harmful to moisten one's siwak with water and then shake it until nothing remains in it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Multiple Miswaks
arabicText: نأ ىلإ هلاصم يف سلج رجفلا لىص اذإ - ناسارخب وهو - ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع مث) هغضميف ردنكب ىتؤي مث دحاو دعب ادحاو اهب كاتسيف كيواسم اهيف ةطيرخب ىتؤي مث ،سمشلا علطت .هيف أرقيف فحصملبا (ىتؤي
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: When he was in Khurasan, after praying Fajr he would sit in his prayer place until sunrise, then he would be brought a bag containing siwaks and he would use them one after another, then he would be brought frankincense which he would chew, then he would be brought the mus'haf (Quran) and he would recite from it. Section 2 Etiquettes Of The Bathroom, Cleaning, And Adornment. And They Are An Introduction To The Washings

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse, Remembering The Fire, And The Merit Of Building And Owning One
arabicText: بهذيو ،رانلا ركذي ،مامحلا تيبلا معن :ملاسلا هيلع نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا ريمأ لوق سانلا بسنف :لقا .رتسلا كتهيو ،ةروعلا يدبي مامحلا تيبلا سئب :رمع لقاو .نردلبا .(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ىلإ رمع لوقو ،رمع ىلإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: What an excellent house is the public bath, it reminds of the Fire and removes dirt. And Umar said: What an evil house is the public bath, it exposes private parts and violates privacy. He said: Then people attributed the saying of Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) to Umar, and the saying of Umar to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him).

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse, Remembering The Fire, And The Merit Of Building And Owning One
arabicText: اذه نمل خيش يا :تلقف مامحلا ميق وهو ريبك خيش اذفإ ةنيدملبا امامح تلخد :لقا يقبادلا الله ديبع نع .معن :لاقف ؟هلخدي ناك :تلقف ،نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم رفعج يبلأ :لقا ؟مامحلا
englishText: From Ubaydullah Al-Dabiqi who said: I entered a public bath in Medina and found an elderly man who was the caretaker of the bath. I said: O Shaykh, who owns this bath? He said: It belongs to Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn. I asked: Did he use to enter it? He said: Yes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse, Remembering The Fire, And The Merit Of Building And Owning One
arabicText: مدلا ءاودف ،مغلبلاو ةرملاو مدلفا :ءادلا امفأ ،ةثلاث ءاودلاو ،ةثلاث ءادلا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .يشملا ةرملا ءاودو مامحلا مغلبلا ءاودو ،ةماجحلا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There are three ailments and three cures. As for the ailments: they are blood, bile, and phlegm. The cure for blood is cupping (hijamah), the cure for phlegm is the bath, and the cure for Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse, Remembering The Fire, And... bile is walking.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse, Remembering The Fire, And The Merit Of Building And Owning One
arabicText: .نردلبا بهذيو رانلا هيف ركذت مامحلا تيبلا معن :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقاو
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: What an excellent house the bathhouse is; it reminds one of the Fire and removes dirt.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse, Remembering The Fire, And The Merit Of Building And Owning One
arabicText: .ءايحلبا بهذيو رتسلا كتهي مامحلا تيبلا سئب :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: How evil is the public bath, it violates privacy and removes modesty.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse, Remembering The Fire, And The Merit Of Building And Owning One
arabicText: رح ركذي مامحلا تيبلا معنو ةروعلا يدبيو ،رتسلا كتهي ،مامحلا تيبلا سئب :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو .رانلا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: How evil is the bathhouse as a place, it violates privacy and exposes private parts, and how good is the bathhouse as a place that reminds one of the heat of hellfire.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse, Remembering The Fire, And The Merit Of Building And Owning One
arabicText: هيف لقيو انعلا هيف رثكي مامحلا تيبلا سئب :رمع لاقف مامحلا رمعو ليع لخد :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع .رانلبا ركذيو ىذلأا بهذي مامحلا تيبلا معن :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لاقف ،ايحلا
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: Umar and I entered the public bath, and Umar said: What an evil place is the public bath where hardship increases and modesty decreases. So Ali (peace be upon him) said: What an excellent place is the public bath where it removes impurity and reminds of the Fire.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse, Remembering The Fire, And The Merit Of Building And Owning One
arabicText: .مامحلا عضوم معن :لاقف عضابملبا ناكمب ،هلآو (هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر رم :لقا هنعو يف طارفلاا لىع وأ ،رم امل ةيقتلا لىع امإ لومحم مامحلا مذ نم مدقت امو ،كلذ لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ .ملعأ اللهو ،كانه ليلعتلا نم مهفي امل ةروعلا رتس مدع لىع وأ ،يتيأ امل هلوخد
englishText: From him, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and his family passed by a place at Al-Mabadi' and said: An excellent place for a bathhouse. I (Hurr Amili) say: And there will come what indicates that, and what has preceded regarding the censure of bathhouses is interpreted either as taqiyyah for what has passed, or as referring to excessive use of bathhouses as will be mentioned, or as referring to not covering the private parts as can be understood from the reasoning there, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathroom Every Other Day, And The Dislike Of Entering It Every Day Except For Someone Who Is Fleshy And Wants To Reduce It (Flesh)
arabicText: .نيتيلكلا محش بيذي موي لك هنامدإو ،محللا رثكي لا مويو موي مامحلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: The bath every other day does not increase the flesh, and doing it daily melts the fat of the kidneys.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathroom Every Other Day, And The Dislike Of Entering It Every Day Except For Someone Who Is Fleshy And Wants To Reduce It (Flesh)
arabicText: دوعي نأ كرسيأ :لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا لىع تلخدف يمحل بهذ ىتح تضرم :لقا يرفعجلا ناميلس ثروي هنامدإ نفإ ،هنمدت نأ كياإو ،كمحل كيلإ دوعي هنفإ ،ابغ مامحلا مزلا :لقا ،لىب :تلقف ؟كمحل كيلإ .لسلا
englishText: Sulayman al-Ja'fari said: I became ill until my flesh wasted away, so I went to Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) and he said: Would it please you for your flesh to return? I said: Yes. He said: Regularly attend the bathhouse every other day, for your flesh will return, but beware of frequenting it daily, for daily use causes consumption.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathroom Every Other Day, And The Dislike Of Entering It Every Day Except For Someone Who Is Fleshy And Wants To Reduce It (Flesh)
arabicText: لخديلف امحل لمحي نأ دارأ نم :لقا يرفعجلا ناميلس نع ،ميشأ نب دمحأ نب ليع نع ،دمحم نب دمحأ نع .موي لك لخديلف محللا ريثك ناكو رمضي نأ دارأ نمو ،اموي بغيو اموي مامحلا
englishText: From Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashim, from Sulayman Al Ja'fari who said: Whoever wants to gain weight should enter the bathhouse every other day, and whoever wants to lose weight and is overweight should enter it every day.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathroom Every Other Day, And The Dislike Of Entering It Every Day Except For Someone Who Is Fleshy And Wants To Reduce It (Flesh)
arabicText: ةحئارلا مشو ،مامحلا نامدفإ نمسي يتلا امفأ نلزهي ةثلاثو نمسي ةثلاث :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نامدإ :قودصلا لقا .علطلاو ،كمسلاو ،ضيبلا لكأ نامدفإ نلزهي يتلا امأو ،ةنيللا بايثلا سبلو ،ةبيطلا .همحل نم صقن موي لك هلخد نإ هنفإ لا امويو اموي هلخدي نأ مامحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Three things make one fat and three things make one thin. As for those that make one fat, they are: frequent use of the bath, smelling pleasant fragrances, and wearing soft clothes. And as for those that make one thin, they are: frequent eating of eggs, fish, and palm spadix. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Al-Saduq said: Frequent use of bath means entering it every other day, for if one enters it every day, it reduces one's flesh.

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Private Parts In The Bathhouse And Elsewhere From Any Respected Observer And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Private Parts Of A Muslim Unlawfully
arabicText: .هيخأ ةروع ىلإ لجرلا رظني لا :لق (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: A man should not look at the private parts of his brother.

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Private Parts In The Bathhouse And Elsewhere From Any Respected Observer And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Private Parts Of A Muslim Unlawfully
arabicText: ضغو ،رزئمب هلخدأ :لقا مامحلا نع يريغ هلأس وأ هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع .كرصب
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him, or someone else asked him, about the public bath? He said: Enter it with a waist wrap, and lower your gaze.

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Private Parts In The Bathhouse And Elsewhere From Any Respected Observer And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Private Parts Of A Muslim Unlawfully
arabicText: وه ىري وأ ؟ءاملا هيلع بصي وأ هتروع ىرت ءاملا بص دنع لجرلا درجتيأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .دحأ لك نم كلذ هركي يبأ ناك :لقا ؟سانلا ةروع
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Should a man undress when pouring water so that his private parts are visible, or should water be poured on him? Or should he see the private parts of others? He said: My father used to dislike that from anyone.

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Private Parts In The Bathhouse And Elsewhere From Any Respected Observer And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Private Parts Of A Muslim Unlawfully
arabicText: نم الله هنمآ هيخأ ةروع ىلإ رظنلا نع هفرط ضغف مامحلا لخد نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةمايقلا موي ميمحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever enters the bathhouse and lowers his gaze from looking at his brother's private parts, Allah will protect him from the scalding water on the Day of Resurrection.

chapter: Obligation Of Covering The Private Parts In The Bathhouse And Elsewhere From Any Respected Observer And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Private Parts Of A Muslim Unlawfully
arabicText: رظانلا (نوعلم) نوعلم ،رزئم ريغب مامحلا لوخدو كياإ ليع يا :لقا هنأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع .هيلإ روظنملاو
englishText: From the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) that he said: O Ali, beware of entering the bath without a waist covering. Cursed, cursed is the one who looks and the one who is looked at. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It is mentioned before regarding the regulations of seclusion, and there will be more on this in discussions on entering the bathhouse with a waist-wrap and others, in the book of marriage, and explanations will be provided for seemingly contradictory narrations, God willing.

chapter: Limit Of The Private Parts That Must Be Covered
arabicText: .ةروعلا نم تسيل ذخفلا نإ :لاقف ،بوث هتروع لىعو ادرجتم هآر نم وأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تيأر
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) or from one who saw him uncovered with a cloth over his private parts, he said: The thigh is not part of the awrah (private parts that must be covered).

chapter: Limit Of The Private Parts That Must Be Covered
arabicText: ترتس اذفإ نيتيللأبا روتسم ربدلاو ،ربدلاو لبقلا :نتاروع ةروعلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) يضاملا نسحلا يبأ نع .ةروعلا ترتس دقف نيتضيبلاو بيضقلا
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi (peace be upon him) who said: The awrah consists of two parts: the front private part and the rear private part. The rear is covered by the buttocks, so when you cover the penis and testicles, you have covered the awrah.

chapter: Limit Of The Private Parts That Must Be Covered
arabicText: .كديب هرتسفا لبقلا امأو ،ناتيللأا هترتس دقف ربدلا امفأ ىرخأ ةياور يف :لقاو :ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And he said in another narration: As for the posterior, the buttocks have covered it, and as for the front, cover it with your hand.

chapter: Limit Of The Private Parts That Must Be Covered
arabicText: .ةروعلا نم سيل ذخفلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The thigh is not part of the awrah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Covering The Knee, Navel And What Is Between Them
arabicText: رزتفأ لخد مث ءاملا ناخسإب رمفأ ،معن :تلق ؟مامحلا ديرت :لاقف مامحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس .لعففا اذكه :لقا مث - :لقا نأ ىلإ - هترسو هيتبكر ىطغف رازإب
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the public bath, so he said: You want to go to the public bath? I said: Yes. He ordered for the water to be heated, then he entered and wrapped himself with a cloth covering his knees and navel- until he said- then he said: Do like this.

chapter: Permissibility Of Looking At The Private Parts Of Animals And Non-muslims Without Lust
arabicText: .رامحلا ةروع ىلإ رظنلا لثم ملسمب سيل نم ةروع ىلإ رظنلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Looking at the private parts of a non-Muslim is like looking at the private parts of a donkey.

chapter: Permissibility Of Looking At The Private Parts Of Animals And Non-muslims Without Lust
arabicText: سيل نم ةروع ىلإ رظنلا امفأ ،ملسملا ةروع ىلإ رظنلا هرك امنإ :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع ىور .رامحلا ةروع ىلإ رظنلا لثم ملسمب
englishText: It is narrated from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he said: Looking at the private parts of a Muslim is disliked, but looking at the private parts of a non-Muslim is like looking at the private parts of a donkey.

chapter: Ruling Of Bathing Nude In The Presence Of One's Slave Woman, Parent, Spouse, Or Relative
arabicText: سبأ لا :لقا ؟اهمداخ يدي نيب لسغلاو يرعتلا اهجوزل لحي له ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس .هدعتي مل ام كلذ نم هل تلحأ ام
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about whether it is permissible for a woman's husband to be nude and bathe in front of her servant (meaning slave girl)? He said: There is no harm in what she has permitted him of that as long as he does not exceed it.

chapter: Ruling Of Bathing Nude In The Presence Of One's Slave Woman, Parent, Spouse, Or Relative
arabicText: مأ اهيدي نيب درجتي نأ هل لحي له هلهلأ وأ ،هدلاول وأ ،لجرلا دلول نوكت مداخلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تلأس .اسبأ هب ىرأ لاف دلولا امأ :لقا ؟لا .الله ءاش نإ حاكنلا يف يتيأ امل ،هسفن لىع هتيراج هوبأ موق اذإ ريغصلا دلولبا اذه صخي نأ يغبني :لوقأ
englishText: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about the female servant (meaning slave girl) who belongs to a man's son, or his father, or his family- is it permissible for him to undress in front of her or not? He said: As for the son's servant, I see no problem with it. I (Hurr Amili) say: This should be specific to young children when their father has assigned the slave girl to himself, as will be discussed in the chapter on marriage, insha'Allah.

chapter: Prohibition Of Pursuing The Slips And Faults Of A Believer
arabicText: ثيح سيل :لاقف ،مارح نمؤملا لىع نمؤملا ةروع :سانلا هلوقي ئش :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .ام اموي هب هريعيل هيلع ظفحيف هيلع باعي ئشب ملكتي وأ ةلز لزي نأ نمؤملا ةروع ىنع امنإ ،نوبهذي
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): There is something people say: The awrah of a believer is forbidden upon another believer. He said: It is not as they think. What is meant by the awrah of a believer is when he makes a mistake or says something for which he can be criticized, and someone preserves (remembers) it to shame him with it someday.

chapter: Prohibition Of Pursuing The Slips And Faults Of A Believer
arabicText: ينعأ :تلق ،معن :لاقف ؟مارح نمؤملا لىع نمؤملا ةروع نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هرس ةعاذإ وه امنإ بهذت ثيح سيل :لاقف ،هيلفس
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I asked him about "the awrah of a believer is forbidden upon another believer?" He said: Yes. I said: I mean his private parts. He said: It is not as you think, rather it means spreading his secrets.

chapter: Prohibition Of Pursuing The Slips And Faults Of A Believer
arabicText: ،ائيش هنم ىريف فشكني نأ سيل :لقا مارح نمؤملا لىع نمؤملا ةروع يف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هبيعي وأ هيلع يرزي نأ وه امنإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding the sacredness of a believer's awrah to another believer, he said: It is not about uncovering and seeing something of him, rather it is about disparaging or finding fault with (criticizing) him. Shaykh Hurr Amili: There is no contradiction between this and the previously mentioned prohibition of looking at a Muslim's private parts because 'private matters' have two meanings. These narrations clarify one meaning, and the previous ones clarified the other. However, other evidence exists for both meanings. This may also include the interpretation of a specific narration, so it doesn't affect the previous ruling. But many other evidences exist, and both meanings might be intended, as will be explained in the narration of Hanan. Further evidence supporting the contents of this chapter will be presented in the chapters on Brotherhood from the Book of Hajj, God willing.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: .رازإب هلخدأ :لاقف ؟مامحلا ءام نع هتلأس لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them both), he said: I asked him about the water of the public bath? He replied: Enter it with a waist wrap (* izaar). Translator: * Izaar refers to a traditional waist-wrap or a piece of cloth that is wrapped around the lower part of the body, covering from the waist to the knees or sometimes the ankles.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: هيلإ رظن مكدحأ ىرعت اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع ،هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع .اورتتسفا هيف عمطف ناطيشلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his father, from his forefathers, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon them), he said: When one of you undresses, Satan looks at him and covets him, so cover yourselves.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: .ةرونلا قوف رازإ هيلعو ةرونلا هيلعو (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا وبأ لىع لخدف طسولأا تيبلا يف مامحلا يف تنك
englishText: I was in the bathroom in the middle house when Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) entered. He had depilatory (hair removing) paste on him and was wearing a waist wrapper over the depilatory paste.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: ؟موقلا نمم :انل لاقف خلسملا تيبلا يف لجر اذفإ ةنيدملبا امامح يمعو يدجو يبأو ناأ تلخد :لقا هيبأ نع نمؤملا لىع نمؤملا ةروع :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نفإ !؟رزلأا نم مكعنمي ام - :لقا نأ ىلإ - :لقا نأ ىلإ - اهيف انلخد مث ادحاو انم دحاو لك ذخأ مث ،ةعبربأ اهقشف ةسبارك ىلإ يبأ ثعبف :لقا ،مارح .(ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع وه اذفإ ؟لجرلا نع انلأس
englishText: From his father who said: I, my father, my grandfather, and my uncle entered a public bath in Medina. There was a man in the changing room who said to us: Where are you from?- then he said- What prevents you from wearing waist wraps?! For indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The private parts of a believer are forbidden for another believer. He said: So my father sent for some cotton Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The ... cloth and tore it into four pieces, then each one of us took one piece and we entered wearing them- then he said- We asked about the man? And it turned out to be Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him).

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: لاف رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رزئمب لاإ مامحلا لخدي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not enter the bathhouse except with a waist-wrapper.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: مامحلا لخدي لاف رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم :لوقي ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ نأ هثدح نم ضعب نع .رزئمب لاإ
englishText: From some who narrated to him that Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) used to say: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not enter the public bath except with a waist wrapper.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: .كرصب ضغو رزئمب لاإ مامحلا لخدت لا :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: Do not enter the public bath except with a waist covering and lower your gaze.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: هرك الله نإ :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع .رزئمب لاإ مامحلا لوخد هركو - :لقا نأ ىلإ لااصخ دعو - يتملا
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: Indeed Allah dislikes for my nation- and he counted characteristics until he said:- and He dislikes entering the bath without a waist wrapper.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: نلخدي لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقاو :لقا - يهانملا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع .رزئمب لاإ مامحلا مكدحأ
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in hadith of prohibitions- he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: None of you should enter the bathhouse except with a waist wrap.

chapter: Recommendation Of Entering The Bathhouse With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Leaving It Off
arabicText: .هرتسب الله هرتس رزئمب مامحلا لخد نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever enters the bath with a waist wrap, Allah will cover him with His cover. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Previous narrations indicate this and not the obligation, and more evidence on both rulings will come, God willing.

chapter: Disapproval Of Entering Water Without A Waist Wrap
arabicText: .رزئمب لاإ ءاملا لجرلا لخدي نأ ىهن هنأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع
englishText: From Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him): He prohibited a man from entering water except with a waist wrap.

chapter: Disapproval Of Entering Water Without A Waist Wrap
arabicText: نع ىهنو ،رزئمب لاإ ءامسلا تحت لسغلا نع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) ىهن :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .نااكسو لاهأ ءاملل نإ :لقاو ،رزئمب لاإ راهنلأا لوخد
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: He (peace be upon him and his family) prohibited bathing under the sky except with a waist wrap, and he prohibited entering rivers except with a waist wrap, and he said: Indeed, water has inhabitants and dwellers.

chapter: Disapproval Of Entering Water Without A Waist Wrap
arabicText: يتملا الله هركو :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) لىعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .ةكئلاملا نم نااكس اهيف نفإ رزئمب لاإ راهنلأا لوخد هركو ،رزئمب لاإ ءامسلا تحت لسغلا
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: And Allah dislikes for my nation bathing under the sky except with a waist wrap, and He dislikes entering rivers except with a waist wrap, for in them are dwellers from among the angels.

chapter: Disapproval Of Entering Water Without A Waist Wrap
arabicText: ةلصخ نيرشعو اعبرأ ةملأا اهتيأ مكل هرك الله نإ :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع ،قداصلا نع راهنلأا يف :لقاو ،رزئمب لاإ راهنلأا لوخد هركو ،رزئم ريغب ءامسلا تحت لسغلا هركو لقا نأ ىلإ - اهنع مكاهنو .رزئم ريغب تامامحلا لوخد هركو ،ةكئلاملا نم ناكسو رامع
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) who said: Indeed Allah has disliked for you, O nation, twenty-four characteristics and has forbidden you from them- until he said: And He disliked bathing under the sky without a waist wrap, and disliked entering rivers except with a waist wrap, and he said: In the rivers are dwellers and inhabitants from among the angels, and He disliked entering bathhouses without a waist wrap.

chapter: Permissibility Of Bathing Without A Waist Wrap When Not Observed, With Dislike, Especially Under The Sky
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لقا ؟دحأ هاري لا ثيح رازإ ريغب لستغي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who performs ghusl without a waist wrap where no one can see him? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Permissibility Of Bathing Without A Waist Wrap When Not Observed, With Dislike, Especially Under The Sky
arabicText: .سبأ لاف دحأ هري مل اذإ :لاقف ؟ازربا لجرلا لستغي :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Can a man perform ghusl while exposed? He said: If no one sees him, then there is no problem.

chapter: Permissibility For A Man To Enter The Bath With His Female Servants With A Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Them Being Nude, And The Permissibility For Women To Enter The Bath
arabicText: هيراوج عم لخدي كلملا دبع نب ديعس نإ :هل ليق :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .ضعب ةأوس ىلإ مهضعب رظني رمحلاك ةارع نونوكي لا ،رازلإا نهيلعو هيلع ناك اذإ سبأ امو :لقا ،مامحلا
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon them), he said: It was said to him: Sa'id bin Abdul-Malik enters the bathhouse with his slave girls. He said: What's wrong with that if he and they are wearing a waist-wrapper? They should not be naked like donkeys, looking at each other's private parts. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Also, there will be mention of the permissibility for women to enter the bath in the narrations about marriage in the bath and others.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating With The Transmitted Prayers In The Bath And A Collection Of Its Rulings And Etiquettes
arabicText: عزنأ مهللا هيف كبايث عزنت يذلا تقولا يف لقف مامحلا تلخد اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج قداصلا لقا ذيعتسأو يسفن رش نم كب ذوعأ ينإ مهللا :لقف لولأا تيبلا تلخد اذإو ،ناميلاا لىع ينتبثو قافنلا ةقبر ينع ،هاذأ نم كب راحلا ءاملا نم ذخو ،يبلقو يدسج رهطو ،سجنلا سجرلا ينع بهذا مهللا :لقف ،يناثلا تيبلا تلخد اذإو يف ثبلاو ،ةناثملا يقني هنفإ لعففا ةعرج هنم علبت نأ نكمأ نإو ،كيلجر لىع هنم بصو ،كتماه لىع هعضو ،ةعاس يناثلا تيبلا ،راحلا تيبلا نم كجورخ تقو ىلإ اهددرت ،ةنجلا هلأسنو رانلا نم للهبا ذوعن :لقف ثلاثلا تيبلا تلخد اذإو ،ةدعملا دسفي هنفإ مامحلا يف عاقفلاو درابلا ءاملا برشو كياإو نم ءادلا ليسي هنفإ تجرخ اذإ كيمدق لىع درابلا ءاملا بصو ،ندبلا فعضي هنفإ درابلا ءاملا كيلع نبصت لاو .ءاد لك نم تنما كلذ تلعف اذفإ ،يدرلا ينبنجو ىوقتلا ينسبلأ مهللا :لقف كبايث تسبل اذفإ ،كدسج
englishText: Al-Sadiq, Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) said: When you enter the bathhouse and start to undress, say: "O Allah, remove from me the bonds of hypocrisy and establish me in faith." When you enter the first room, say: "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil within myself and from the harm it may cause." Upon entering the second room, say: "O Allah, remove impurity from me, cleanse my body and heart." Take warm water, pour it over your head and onto your feet. If possible, swallow a gulp of it to cleanse the bladder. Stay in the second room for a while. When entering the third room, say: "We seek refuge in Allah from the Fire and ask for Paradise," repeating it until you leave the hot room. Avoid drinking cold water or consuming fuqqa'a (* fizzy drinks) in the bath as it corrupts the stomach. Do not pour cold water on yourself as it weakens the body. Pour cold water on your feet upon exiting to wash away diseases from your body. When you dress, say: "O Allah, clothe me in piety and keep me away from disgrace." Doing so, you will be protected from every disease. Translator: * Literally anything that bubbles or foams. Historically, it referred to a fermented beverage made from barley or dates, which had a slightly effervescent quality due to the fermentation process Recommendation Of Supplicating With The Transmitted Prayers In The ...

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating With The Transmitted Prayers In The Bath And A Collection Of Its Rulings And Etiquettes
arabicText: ،نيتيلكلا محش بيذي هنفإ مامحلا يف عاجطضلاا كياإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،رعشلا ءباو ثروي هنفإ مامحلا يف طشمتلاو كياإو ،ةليبدلا ءاد ثروي هنفإ مامحلا يف افقلا لىع ءاقلتسلااو كياإو كياإو ،هجولا جمسي هنفإ نيطلبا كسأر لستغت نأ كياإو ،نانسلأا ءباو ثروي هنفإ مامحلا يف كاوسلاو كياإو ،صربلا ثروي هنفإ فزخلبا كمدق تحت كلدت نأ كياإو ،هجولا ءامب بهذي هنفإ رزئمب كهجوو كسأر كلدت نأ .مامحلا ةلاسغب لستغت نأ كياإو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: Beware of lying down in the bathhouse for it melts the fat of the kidneys, and beware of lying on your back in the bathhouse for it causes the disease of abscesses, and beware of combing in the bathhouse for it causes hair disease, and beware of using the siwak in the bathhouse for it causes tooth disease, and beware of washing your head with clay for it disfigures the face, and beware of rubbing your head and face with a waist-wrapper for it removes the radiance of the face, and beware of rubbing under your foot with khuzfah (* pumice stone) for it causes leprosy, and beware of bathing with the used water of the bathhouse. Translator: * In the olden days, pumice stone was widely used as a natural exfoliating tool during bathing to remove dead skin cells and soften the skin.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating With The Transmitted Prayers In The Bath And A Collection Of Its Rulings And Etiquettes
arabicText: ققري هنفإ مامحلا يف حرست لاو ،نيتيلكلا محش بيذي هنفإ مامحلا يف كتت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا كهجو حسمت لاو ،صربلا ثروي هنفإ فزخلبا كلدتت لاو ،ةريغلبا بهذي هنفإ نيطلبا كسأر لسغت لاو ،رعشلا .هجولا جمسي هنفإ نيطلبا كسأر لسغت لاو :لقا هنأ لاإ لاسرم قودصلا هاورو .هجولا ءامب بهذي هنفإ رازلإبا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Do not lie down in the bathhouse for it dissolves the fat of the kidneys, do not comb your hair in the bathhouse for it thins the hair, do not wash your head with clay for it removes ghayrah (possessive or protective jealousy), do not scrub with khuzfah (pumice stone used for exfoliation) for it causes vitiligo, and do not wipe your face with the waist wrapper for it removes the glow of the face. And Al-Saduq narrated it as mursal except he said: do not wash your head with clay for it makes the face unsightly. Translator: * In the sense of a positive or protective attribute not in its negative connotation of envy, implying that a certain level of jealousy, especially in matters of honor and protecting rights or relationships, is considered a good trait.

chapter: Recommendation Of Supplicating With The Transmitted Prayers In The Bath And A Collection Of Its Rulings And Etiquettes
arabicText: .ثيدحلا ةيقب ركذو ...ةريغلبا بهذي :رخآ ثيدح يفو :لقا
englishText: He said: And in another narration: "It removes jealousy (*) ..." and the rest of the narration was mentioned. Translator: * See comment on Hadith 1431.

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting In The Bath For Those Wearing An Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Greeting For Those Not Wearing An Waist Wrap
arabicText: هيلعو (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا وبأ لىع لخدف طسولأا تيبلا يف مامحلا يف تنك :لقا ملسم نب نادعس نع هيف يذلا تيبلا ىلإ تلخدف تردباو ،ملاسلا هيلع تددرف مكيلع ملاسلا :لاقف ،ةرونلا قوف رازإ هيلعو ،ةرونلا .تجرخو تلستغفا ضوحلا
englishText: From Sa'dan bin Muslim who said: I was in the bathhouse in the middle room when Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) entered while having depilatory paste on him, and he was wearing a waist wrap over the depilatory paste. He said: Peace be upon you, so I returned his greeting, and I hastened to enter the room with the pool where I bathed and left. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And al-Saduq, narrated it with his own chain of transmission in a similar manner. Al-Saduq then said: This indicates that it is permissible to greet someone in the bathhouse if they are wearing a izar, while there is a prohibition against greeting someone in the bathhouse if they are not wearing a izar.

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting In The Bath For Those Wearing An Waist Wrap And The Dislike Of Greeting For Those Not Wearing An Waist Wrap
arabicText: تيب يفو ،ةعمجلا ىلإ يشاملاو ،ةزانجلا عم يشاملا :نوملسي لا ةثلاث :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع .مامح
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Three do not give salam: one walking with a funeral procession, one walking to Friday prayer, and one in a bathhouse.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reciting The Entire Qur'an In The Bathhouse For One Who Wears A Waist Wrap, The Dislike Of Recitation By The Naked, And The Permissibility Of Sexual Intercourse In The Bathhouse And In Water
arabicText: لا :لاقف ؟مامحلا يف نآرقلا ةءارق نع ىهني (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس .سبأ لاف رازإ هيلع ناك اذإ امفأ ،نيارع وهو لجرلا أرقي نأ ىهن امنإ
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Did Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) forbid reciting the Quran in the bath? He said: No, he only forbade a man to recite while he is naked, but if he is wearing a waist wrap then there is no problem.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reciting The Entire Qur'an In The Bathhouse For One Who Wears A Waist Wrap, The Dislike Of Recitation By The Naked, And The Permissibility Of Sexual Intercourse In The Bathhouse And In Water
arabicText: ديري لاو الله هجو هب ديري ناك اذإ مامحلا يف نآرقلا أرقي نأ لجرلل سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هتوص فيك رظني
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no harm for a man to recite the Quran in the bath if he intends it for the sake of Allah and does not intend to listen to how his voice sounds.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reciting The Entire Qur'an In The Bathhouse For One Who Wears A Waist Wrap, The Dislike Of Recitation By The Naked, And The Permissibility Of Sexual Intercourse In The Bathhouse And In Water
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لقا ؟هيف حكنأو مامحلا يف نآرقلا ءرقأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبلأ تلق
englishText: I said to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): Can I recite the Quran in the bathroom and engage in sexual intercourse there? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reciting The Entire Qur'an In The Bathhouse For One Who Wears A Waist Wrap, The Dislike Of Recitation By The Naked, And The Permissibility Of Sexual Intercourse In The Bathhouse And In Water
arabicText: .هب سبأ لا :لقا ؟هيف حكنيو مامحلا يف أرقي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: I asked him about a man reciting and having sexual intercourse in the bathhouse? He said: There is no problem in it. Permissibility Of Reciting The Entire Qur'an In The Bathhouse For O...

chapter: Permissibility Of Reciting The Entire Qur'an In The Bathhouse For One Who Wears A Waist Wrap, The Dislike Of Recitation By The Naked, And The Permissibility Of Sexual Intercourse In The Bathhouse And In Water
arabicText: .هب سبأ لا :لقا ؟هيف حكنيو مامحلا يف أرقي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: I asked him about a man reciting and having sexual intercourse in the bathhouse? He said: There is no problem in it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reciting The Entire Qur'an In The Bathhouse For One Who Wears A Waist Wrap, The Dislike Of Recitation By The Naked, And The Permissibility Of Sexual Intercourse In The Bathhouse And In Water
arabicText: سيل :لقا ؟ءاملا يف هتيراج يتيأ لجرلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ليجعلا ةيواعم نب ديرب نع .سبأ هب
englishText: Burayd ibn Mu'awiyah al-Ijli said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): [What about] a man who approaches his slave girl in water? He said: There is no harm in it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reciting The Entire Qur'an In The Bathhouse For One Who Wears A Waist Wrap, The Dislike Of Recitation By The Naked, And The Permissibility Of Sexual Intercourse In The Bathhouse And In Water
arabicText: .هلك تئش نإ نآرقلا أرقفا رازإ كيلع ناك اذإ :لاقف ؟مامحلا يف ةءارقلا نع هتلأس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع
englishText: Abu Basir said: I asked him about reciting [the Quran] in the bathhouse. He replied: If you are wearing a waist wrap, then you may recite the Quran, all of it if you wish.

chapter: Permissibility Of Reciting The Entire Qur'an In The Bathhouse For One Who Wears A Waist Wrap, The Dislike Of Recitation By The Naked, And The Permissibility Of Sexual Intercourse In The Bathhouse And In Water
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لقا ؟هيف حكنأو مامحلا يف أرقأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسومل لقا
englishText: It was said to Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him): Shall I recite (Quran) in the bathhouse and have intercourse in it? He said: There is no harm in it.

chapter: Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Funeral, Or Wear Thin Clothes Without Necessity, And The Prohibition Of That With Suspicion, Accusation, And Corruption.
arabicText: .مامحلا هتليلح لخدي لاف رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not let his wife enter the public bath.

chapter: Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Funeral, Or Wear Thin Clothes Without Necessity, And The Prohibition Of That With Suspicion, Accusation, And Corruption.
arabicText: .مامحلا ىلإ هتليلح لسري لاف ،رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not send his wife to the public bath.

chapter: Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Funeral, Or Wear Thin Clothes Without Necessity, And The Prohibition Of That With Suspicion, Accusation, And Corruption.
arabicText: .مامحلا ىلإ هتليلح ثعبي لاف رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not send his wife to the public bath.

chapter: Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Funeral, Or Wear Thin Clothes Without Necessity, And The Prohibition Of That With Suspicion, Accusation, And Corruption.
arabicText: هوعدت لقا ؟ةعاطلا كلت امو :ليق ،رانلا يف هيرخنم لىع الله هبكأ هتأرما عاطأ نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو :لقا .اهبيجيف ،ققارلا بايثلا سبلو تامامحلاو تاسرعلاو تاحاينلا ىلإ
englishText: And he (peace be upon him) said: Whoever obeys his wife, Allah will throw him on his face into the Fire. It was asked: And what is that obedience? He said: When she calls him to attend wailing ceremonies (*), weddings, public baths, and to wear thin clothes, and he responds to her. Translator: * An-niyahaat refers to a group of women who engage in excessive lamentation or professional mourning. They were hired to wail, scream, and display extreme forms of grief during mourning ceremonies. This practice was prevalent in pre-Islamic Arabia and was discouraged or prohibited in Islam. Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Fun...

chapter: Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Funeral, Or Wear Thin Clothes Without Necessity, And The Prohibition Of That With Suspicion, Accusation, And Corruption.
arabicText: نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىهن :لقا - يهانملا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،قداصلا نع .مامحلا هتليلح لجرلا لخدي
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the hadith of prohibitions- he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade a man from taking his wife to the public bath.

chapter: Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Funeral, Or Wear Thin Clothes Without Necessity, And The Prohibition Of That With Suspicion, Accusation, And Corruption.
