arabicText: هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع امو :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لقا ،رانلا يف ههجو لىع لجو زع الله هبكأ هتأرما عاطأ نم ،ليع يا :لقا - (ملاسلا .ققارلا بايثلا سبلو تاحئانلاو تاسرعلاو تامامحلا ىلإ باهذلا يف اهل نذيأ :لقا ؟ةعاطلا كلت
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: O Ali, whoever obeys his wife, Allah the Mighty and Majestic will throw him face-first into the Fire. Ali (peace be upon him) asked: What kind of obedience is that? He replied: Allowing her to go to public baths, wedding celebrations, wailing ceremonies (*), and wearing thin clothes. Translator: * See comment on Hadith 1446.

chapter: Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Funeral, Or Wear Thin Clothes Without Necessity, And The Prohibition Of That With Suspicion, Accusation, And Corruption.
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع ،ينوكسلا نع ىلإ بهذت نأ هيلإ بلطت لقا ؟ةعاطلا كلت امو :ليق ،رانلا يف ههجو لىع الله هبكأ هتأرما عاطأ نم :(هلآو .اهبيجيف ،ققارلا بايثلاو تاحاينلاو سرعلاو تامامحلا
englishText: From al-Sakuni, from Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever obeys his wife, Allah will throw him on his face into the Fire. It was asked: And what is that obedience? He said: When she asks him to go to public baths, weddings, wailing ceremonies (*), and to wear thin clothes, and he complies with her. Translator: * See comment on Hadith 1446.

chapter: Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Funeral, Or Wear Thin Clothes Without Necessity, And The Prohibition Of That With Suspicion, Accusation, And Corruption.
arabicText: اهيلع برشي ةدئام لىع سلجي لاف رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا عدي لاف رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم و ،رزئمب لاإ مامحلا لخدي لاف رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم ،رمخلا .مامحلا ىلإ جرخت هتليلح
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not sit at a table where wine is being drunk. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not enter a bathhouse except with a waist wrapper. And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not allow his wife to go to the bathhouse.

chapter: Dislike Of Permitting The Wife To Go To The Bathhouse, Wedding, Funeral, Or Wear Thin Clothes Without Necessity, And The Prohibition Of That With Suspicion, Accusation, And Corruption.
arabicText: لىع الله هبكأ ءايشأ ةعبرأ يف هتأرما عاطأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع هئباآ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .تاحاينلاو ،تاسرعلاو تامامحلاو ،ققارلا بايثلا يف :لقا ؟يه امو :ليق ،رانلا يف هيرخنم متأملا يف ءاسنلا جورخ زاوج لىع لدي ام ىلاعت الله ءاش نإ ةراجتلاو حاكنلاو زئانجلا ثيداحأ يف يتيأ :لوقأ ةمئلأا ءاسن نم اهريغو (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا جورخ لىعو ،ةزانجلا عييشتو ةحاينلاو سانلا قوقح ءاضقو هانلق ام لىع ةنيرق وهو ،مامحلا يف حاكنلا زاوج لىعو ،مامحلا يراوجلا لوخد زاوج لىع لدي ام مدقتو .كلذل .ملعأ اللهو ناونعلا يف
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) who said: Whoever obeys his wife in four things, Allah will throw him on his face into the Fire. It was asked: And what are they? He said: In wearing thin clothes, going to public baths, attending weddings, and attending wailing ceremonies. I (Hurr Amili) say: In the hadiths of funerals, marriage, and trade, if Allah Almighty wills, there will come evidence indicating the permissibility of women going out for funerals, fulfilling people's rights, lamentation, and accompanying funeral processions. It also indicates the permissibility of Fatima (peace be upon her) and other wives of the Imams going out for such purposes. Previously, there was evidence indicating the permissibility of female slaves entering the bathhouse, and the permissibility of conducting marriage in the bathhouse, which supports what we have stated in the title. And Allah knows best.

chapter: Dislike Of Entering The Bathhouse On An Empty Stomach, With Hunger, And After Eating Heavily
arabicText: ىوقأ وهو ةدعملا جهو كنع ئفطي ئش كفوج يفو لاإ مامحلا لخدت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ماعطلا نم ليتمم تنأو هلخدت لاو ،ندبلل
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Do not enter the bathhouse except with something in your stomach that extinguishes the heat of the stomach, for it is more strengthening for the body, and do not enter it when you are full of food.

chapter: Dislike Of Entering The Bathhouse On An Empty Stomach, With Hunger, And After Eating Heavily
arabicText: نادنع سانلا نإ :هل تلق :لقا ،هلكفأ ائيش لوانت مامحلا لوخد دارأ اذإ ناك هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .فوجلا ةرارح نكسيو رارملا يفطي هلبق ئش لكؤي لبلا :لقا ،نوكي ام دوجأ قيرلا لىع هنإ :نولوقي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), when he intended to enter the bathhouse, he would take something and eat it. I said to him, "The people where we are say that it is best on an empty stomach." He replied, "No, rather something should be eaten before it to extinguish the bile and calm the heat of the stomach."

chapter: Dislike Of Entering The Bathhouse On An Empty Stomach, With Hunger, And After Eating Heavily
arabicText: .ائيش اومعطت ىتح هولخدت لاو ،قيرلا لىع مامحلا اولخدت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا وبأ لقا
englishText: Al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Do not enter the bathhouse on an empty stomach, and do not enter it until you have eaten something.

chapter: Dislike Of Entering The Bathhouse On An Empty Stomach, With Hunger, And After Eating Heavily
arabicText: ،ةنطبلا لىع مامحلا لوخدو ،باغلا ديدقلا لكأ :نلتق امبرو ندبلا نمهي ةثلاث :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو .زوجعلا حاكنو
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Three things weaken the body and may even kill: eating old dried meat, entering the bathhouse on a full stomach, and having sexual intercourse with an elderly woman.

chapter: Dislike Of Entering The Bathhouse On An Empty Stomach, With Hunger, And After Eating Heavily
arabicText: مامحلا لخد نم :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع يور :لاقا (ةمئلأا بط) يف هوخأو ماطسب نب نيسحلا لىع مامحلا لخدفا كمحل يف ديزت نأ تدرأ نإو ،ةرملا ىقنأ لكلاا دعب هتلخد نإو ،مغلبلا ىقنأ قيرلا لىع .قيرلا لىع مامحلا لخدفا كمحل نم صقنت نأ تدرأ نإو ،كعبش
englishText: Al-Husayn ibn Bastam and his brother reported in "Tibb al Aimmah" (Medicine of the Imams) that they said: It was narrated from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he said: Whoever enters the bathhouse on an empty stomach, it clears out phlegm. If you enter it after eating, it clears out bile. If you want to increase your flesh, enter the bathhouse when you are full. And if you want to decrease your flesh, enter the bathhouse on an empty stomach.

chapter: Permissibility Of Using Depilatory Paste To Cover The Awrah And The Recommendation Of Combining It With Other Actions
arabicText: أدبيف هلخدي ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ نأ مامحلا بحاص هربخفأ ةنيدملبا امامح لخد هنأ - ثيدح يف نإ :ميالأا نم اموي هل تلقف ،هندب رئاس ليطفأ ينوعديو هليلحإ فارطأ لىع هرازإ فلي مث ،اهيلي امو هتناع ليطيف .ةرتس ةرونلا نإ لاك :لقا ،هتيأر دق هارأ نأ هركت يذلا
englishText: From him- He entered a public bath in Medina, and the bath owner informed him that Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) would enter it and begin by applying depilatory cream to his pubic area and its surroundings, then wrap his waist cloth over the tip of his private part and call me to apply the cream to the rest of his body. One day I said to him: What you dislike me to see, I have already seen. He said: Not at all, the depilatory cream acts as a cover.

chapter: Permissibility Of Using Depilatory Paste To Cover The Awrah And The Recommendation Of Combining It With Other Actions
arabicText: مامحلا لخدي لاف رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم :لوقي ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ نأ هثدح نم ضعب نع يببأ :هل ىلوم هل لاقف ،رزئملا ىقلأ هندب لىع ةرونلا تقبطأ املف رونتف مامحلا موي تاذ لخدف :لقا ،رزئمب لاإ .ةروعلا تقبطأ دق ةرونلا نأ تملع امأ :لاقف ،كسفن نع هتيقلأ دقلو هموزلو رزئملبا انيصوتل كنإ يمأو تنأ
englishText: From some who narrated to him that Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) used to say: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not enter the public bath except with a waist cover. He said: One day he entered the bath and applied depilatory paste. When the paste covered his body, he removed the waist cover. His servant said to him: May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, you advise us about wearing the waist cover and keeping it on, yet you have removed it from yourself. He said: Don't you know that the depilatory paste has covered the private parts.

chapter: Permissibility Of Using Depilatory Paste To Cover The Awrah And The Recommendation Of Combining It With Other Actions
arabicText: .ةرونلا قوف رازإ هيلعو مامحلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ ىأر هنأ نادعس ثيدح يف مدقت دقو
englishText: It has been previously mentioned in the hadith of Sa'dan that he saw Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) in the bathhouse wearing a waist wrap over the depilatory paste.

chapter: Recommendation Of Wearing A Turban When Exiting The Bathhouse In Winter And Summer
arabicText: امف :لقا ،ممعتف مامحلا نم تجرخ اذإ :يل لاقف ممعتو سبلتف مامحلا نم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ جرخ .فيص لاو ءاتش يف مامحلا نم جيورخ دنع ةمامعلا تكرت
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) came out of the bath, put on his clothes and wore a turban. He said to me: When you come out of the bath, wear a turban. He said: After that, I never left wearing the turban when coming out of the bath, neither in winter nor in summer.

chapter: Dislike Of Lying On One's Back, Reclining, Leaning, And Rubbing With Khuzfa (Pumice Stone) In The Bathhouse, And The Permissibility Of Doing So With Cloth
arabicText: يف مكدحأ نيقلتسي لا لاأ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ماذجلا ثروي هنفإ فزخلبا هيلجر نكلدي لاو ،نيتيلكلا محش بيذي هنفإ مامحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) used to say: Beware, none of you should lie on his back in the bath, for it melts the fat of the kidneys, and none of you should rub his feet with khuzfah (* pumice stone used for exfoliation), for it causes leprosy. Translator: * In the olden days, pumice stone was widely used as a natural exfoliating tool during bathing to remove dead skin cells and soften the skin.

chapter: Dislike Of Lying On One's Back, Reclining, Leaning, And Rubbing With Khuzfa (Pumice Stone) In The Bathhouse, And The Permissibility Of Doing So With Cloth
arabicText: .نيتيلكلا محش بيذي هنفإ مامحلا يف عجطضت لا :لقاو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Do not lie down in the bath/ hammam, for it melts the fat of the kidneys.

chapter: Dislike Of Lying On One's Back, Reclining, Leaning, And Rubbing With Khuzfa (Pumice Stone) In The Bathhouse, And The Permissibility Of Doing So With Cloth
arabicText: نمولي لاف صربلا هباصفأ هدسج اهب كحف ةفزخ مامحلا نم ذخأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع .هسفن لاإ
englishText: Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: Whoever takes a piece of khuzfah (pumice stone used for exfoliation) in the bathhouse and rubs it on his body, and then is afflicted with leprosy, should blame none but himself.

chapter: Dislike Of Lying On One's Back, Reclining, Leaning, And Rubbing With Khuzfa (Pumice Stone) In The Bathhouse, And The Permissibility Of Doing So With Cloth
arabicText: كلدتلاو - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا وبأ لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .دسجلا ليبي فزخلبا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Abu al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a narrative- stated: Rubbing with khuzfah (pumice stone used for exfoliation) wears out the body.

chapter: Dislike Of Lying On One's Back, Reclining, Leaning, And Rubbing With Khuzfa (Pumice Stone) In The Bathhouse, And The Permissibility Of Doing So With Cloth
arabicText: :لوقأ .قرخلبا مكيلع دسجلا أكنت اهنفإ فزخلاو مكياإ :لاقف مامحلا ركذو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .همومع لىع هؤاقب نكميو فزخلا صيصخت لىع لدي ام يتيأو كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) mentioning the bathhouse and said: Beware of khuzfah (pumice stone used for exfoliation), for it scars the body; use cloth instead. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And what has come before indicates that, and what will come after indicates the special type or class of pottery, and it (the prohibition) can remain general (i.e. general pottery).

chapter: Dislike Of A Child Entering The Bath With His Father And Vice Versa, And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Private Parts Of Parents And Children
arabicText: مامحلا هنبا عم لجرلا لخدي لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع :لقاو ،دلاولا ةروع ىلإ رظني نأ دلولل سيلو ،دلولا ةروع ىلإ ارظني نأ نيدلاولل سيل :لقاو ،هتروع ىلإ رظنيف .رزئم لاب مامحلا يف هيلإ روظنملاو رظانلا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نعل
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: A man should not enter the bath with his son and look at his private parts, and he said: Parents should not look at the private parts of the child, and the child should not look at the private parts of the parent, and he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) cursed both the one who looks and the one being looked at in the bath without a covering.

chapter: Dislike Of A Child Entering The Bath With His Father And Vice Versa, And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Private Parts Of Parents And Children
arabicText: .هتروع ىلإ رظنيف مامحلا هنبا عم لجرلا لخدي لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: A man should not enter the bath with his son and look at his private parts.

chapter: Dislike Of A Child Entering The Bath With His Father And Vice Versa, And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Private Parts Of Parents And Children
arabicText: .(ملاسلا امهيلع) ليع نب دمحم هنبا هعمو نيسحلا نب ليع هيف اذفإ مامحلا لخد هنأ - ثيدح يف - هيبأ نع ،مامحلا هعم هدلو لخدي نأ ماملال قلاطإ ربخلا اذه يف :لقا مث ،ريدس نب نانح نع ،هدانسإب قودصلا هاورو .هريغو مامح يف ةروع ىلإ رظنلا هنم عقي لا هربكو هرغص يف موصعم ماملاا نلا مامإب سيل نم نود
englishText: From his father- in a hadith- that he entered the bath and found Ali bin Al-Husayn and his son Muhammad bin Ali (peace be upon them both) there. Al-Saduq narrated it with his chain, from Hanan bin Sudayr, then said: In this report there is permission for the Imam to enter the bath with his child, unlike those who are not Imams because the Imam is infallible in his childhood and adulthood and does not look at private parts in baths or elsewhere.

chapter: Dislike Of A Child Entering The Bath With His Father And Vice Versa, And The Prohibition Of Looking At The Private Parts Of Parents And Children
arabicText: - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل هتيصو يف - (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،قداصلا نع هعم لخدي لاو ،همامأ سلجي لاو ،هيدي نيب يشمي لاو ،همسبا هيمسي لا نأ هدلو لىع دلاولا قح :لقا .مامحلا
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)- in his testament to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: The right of a father over his child is that he should not call him by his name, nor walk in front of him, nor sit before him, nor enter the bath with him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Vacating The Bathhouse For One Person, Although It Is Disliked
arabicText: ،هيلإ راصف (ملاسلا هيلع) يناثلا رفعج وبأ هلخدي يذلا مامحلا نع لأس هنأ - ثيدح يف - نيرز نب الله دبع :لقا ؟ملو :تلق ،ةعاس كلذ دعب كل أيهتي لا هنفإ لخدفا مقف مامحلا لوخد تدرأ نإ :مامحلا بحاص هل لاقف ليخن :لقا ؟هريغ مامحلا هعم لخدي نأ زوجي لاو :هل تلق ،مامحلا لوخد ديري (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نبا نلا .ءاج اذإ مامحلا هل
englishText: Abdullah bin Zareen- in a hadith- that he asked about the public bath which Abu Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him) would enter, so he went to it. The owner of the bathhouse said to him: If you want to enter the bathhouse then go ahead and enter now, for you will not have the opportunity after this hour. I said: And why? He said: Because Ibn Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) wants to enter the bathhouse. I said to him: Is it not permissible for others to enter the bathhouse with him? He said: We empty the bathhouse for him when he comes.

chapter: Permissibility Of Vacating The Bathhouse For One Person, Although It Is Disliked
arabicText: ،كلذ يف يل ةجاح لا :لاقف ؟كل هيلخا :مامحلا بحاص هل لاقف مامحلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لخد .كلذ نم فخأ نمؤملا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) entered the public bath, and the bath owner said to him: Shall I empty it for you? He said: I have no need for that, the believer is more modest than that.

chapter: Permissibility Of Vacating The Bathhouse For One Person, Although It Is Disliked
arabicText: ؟كل هيلخن :مامحلا بحاص هل لاقف ،مامحلا (ملاسلا هيلع قداصلا) لخد :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .ةنؤملا فيفخ نمؤملا نإ ،لا :لاقف
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) entered the bathhouse, and the owner of the bathhouse said to him: Shall we empty it for you? He said: No, indeed the believer is light in burden.

chapter: Dislike Of Washing The Head With Egyptian Clay And Massaging With Syrian Pottery
arabicText: .ةثيادلا ثرويو ،ةريغلبا بهذي هنفإ رصم نيطب مكسوؤر اولسغت لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Do not wash your heads with the clay of Egypt, for it removes ghayrah (possessive or protective jealousy) and brings about cuckoldry (*). Translator: * When a man shows indifference towards the honor and chastity of his wife or female relatives, allowing them to engage in illicit activities.

chapter: Dislike Of Washing The Head With Egyptian Clay And Massaging With Syrian Pottery
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا دقلو :لاقف - رصم مذ يف اثيدح ركذو - لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تعمس كلذ لقا دق :هل انلق ،ةريغلبا بهذيو ،ةلذلا ثروي هنفإ اهراخف يف اولكتأ لاو ،اهنيطب مكسوؤر اولسغت لا :(هلآو .معن :لقا ؟(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر
englishText: I heard Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) say- and he mentioned a hadith criticizing Egypt- he said: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Do not wash your heads with its clay, and do not eat from its pottery, for it causes humiliation and removes jealousy. We said to him: Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) really say that? He said: Yes.

chapter: Dislike Of Washing The Head With Egyptian Clay And Massaging With Syrian Pottery
arabicText: .هجولا جمسي هنفإ نيطلبا كسأر لسغت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Do not wash your head with clay, for it disfigures the face.

chapter: Dislike Of Washing The Head With Egyptian Clay And Massaging With Syrian Pottery
arabicText: فزخو رصم نيط كلذ نأ يورو :لقا ،صربلا ثروي هنفإ فزخلبا كلدت لاو ةريغلبا بهذي :رخآ ثيدح يفو .ماشلا .ملعأ اللهو ديق ريغ نم ةهاركلا لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ
englishText: In another hadith: It removes ghayrah (possessive or protective jealousy), and do not scrub with khuzfah (pumice stone) for it causes vitiligo. He said: And it was narrated that this refers to the clay of Egypt and khuzfah of Syria. Dislike Of Washing The Head With Egyptian Clay And Massaging With S... I (Hurr Amili) say: And what preceded indicates dislike without restriction, and Allah knows best. Translator: * A natural exfoliating material used to remove dead skin cells and soften the skin.

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting When Leaving The Bath, Responding To It, And Its Manner
arabicText: ؟متلبقأ نيأ نم :انل لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ انيقل انجرخ املف مامحلا انلخد انباحصأ نم ةعامج انك مامحلا لخد ىتح هعم انئج ناإو ،كادف انلعج :هل انلقف ،مكلسغ الله ىقنأ :لاقف ،مامحلا نم :هل انلقف .الله مكرهط :لاقف ،كلسغ الله ىقنأ :هل انلقف جرخ ىتح هل انسلجف
englishText: A group of our companions entered the bath. When we came out, we met Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who asked us: Where are you coming from? We said: From the bathhouse. He said: May Allah purify your washing. We said: May we be sacrificed for you. We then went with him until he entered the bathhouse, and we sat waiting for him until he came out. We said to him: May Allah purify your washing. He replied: May Allah purify you.

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting When Leaving The Bath, Responding To It, And Its Manner
arabicText: امو عكل يا :لاقف ،كمامحتسا باط :هل لاقف ناسنإ هيقلف مامحلا نم جرخ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نسحلا نإ اذإو :لقا ،كمامح باط :لقا ،قرعلا ميمحلا نأ ملعت امأ :لاقف ،كميمح باط :لاقف !؟انهه تسلابا عنصت .كنم رهط ام باطو كنم باط ام رهط :لق نكلو !؟يل ئش يفأ يمامح باط
englishText: Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon him) came out of the bath and someone met him and said: May your bathing be pleasant. He said: O foolish one, what are you doing mentioning the posterior here?! The man then said: May your hot water be pleasant. He replied: Don't you know that 'hameem' means sweat? The man said: May your bath be pleasant. He replied: And if my bath is pleasant, what is that to me?! Rather say: May what is good of you be pure and may what is pure of you be good.

chapter: Recommendation Of Greeting When Leaving The Bath, Responding To It, And Its Manner
arabicText: .كلبا الله معنأ :هل لقف ،كمامح باط :مامحلا نم تجرخ دقو كوخأ كل لقا اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: When your brother says to you after you have come out of the bath: "May your bath be pleasant," say to him: "May Allah make your mind at ease."

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Marsh Mallow (Khatmi)
arabicText: ،رقفلا يفني يمطخلبا سأرلا لسغو ،براشلا نم ذخلااو ،رافظلأا ميلقت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .قزرلا يف ديزيو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Trimming the nails, trimming the mustache, and washing the head with marsh mallow plant (* khatmi) removes poverty and increases sustenance. Translator: * A flowering plant from the mallow family and particularly noted for its gelatinous properties, which come from the sap-like substance produced by its roots and leaves.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Marsh Mallow (Khatmi)
arabicText: . ءاذقلاا يفنيو نردلبا بهذي يمطخلبا سأرلا لسغ :)ملاسلا هيلع( نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Washing the head with marsh mallow plant removes dirt and eliminates impurities.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Marsh Mallow (Khatmi)
arabicText: .ةرشن يمطخلبا سأرلا لسغ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Washing the head with marsh mallow plant is a remedy.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Marsh Mallow (Khatmi)
arabicText: سأرلل روهطو ،رقفلا نم ةءاربو ،عادصلا نم نامأ يمطخلبا سأرلا لسغ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .زازحلا نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Washing the head with marsh mallow plant is a protection from headache, freedom from poverty, and purification of the head from dandruff.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Marsh Mallow (Khatmi)
arabicText: .ةرشن وه :لقاو ،قزرلا يف ديزيو ،رقفلا يفني يمطخلبا سأرلا لسغ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Washing the head with marsh mallow plant removes poverty and increases sustenance, and he said: it is a remedy.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Marsh Mallow (Khatmi)
arabicText: .ابلج قزرلا بلجي يمطخلبا سأرلا لسغ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تعمس
englishText: I heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying: Washing the head with marsh mallow plant strongly attracts sustenance.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Marsh Mallow (Khatmi)
arabicText: .يمطخلبا سأرلا لسغ اهنم دعو ،ءايشأ ةرشع يف ةرشنلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The remedy is in ten things, and he counted washing the head with marsh mallow plant among them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Sidr (Lote Tree) Leaves
arabicText: .ابلج قزرلا بلجي ردسلبا سأرلا لسغ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تعمس
englishText: I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) say: Washing the head with sidr (* lote tree leaves) attracts sustenance greatly. Translator: * The lote tree is native to parts of Africa and the Middle East and is valued for its medicinal properties. The leaves, known as sidr leaves, are commonly used for cleansing purposes due to their antibacterial properties. They are also used in traditional rituals, such as in washing and cleansing the dead before burial, and are also used for personal hygiene and hair care due to their beneficial properties for skin and hair health.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Sidr (Lote Tree) Leaves
arabicText: نم ةرثكو نيملسملا نم ةلق ىأر حيولا رهظو ملاسلاا راهظإب هلوسر الله رمأ امل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع نم ردسب ليئربج هيلإ لجو زع الله ثعبف اديدش امه (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر متهفا نيكرشملا .همه هب لاجف هسأر هب لسغف ىهتنملا ةردس
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: When Allah commanded His Messenger to proclaim Islam openly and the revelation became apparent, he saw how few the Muslims were and how numerous the polytheists were, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) became intensely worried. Then Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, sent Gabriel to him with sidr (lote tree leaves) from Sidrat al-Muntaha (The Lote Tree Of the Ultimate Boundary), and he washed his head with it, which removed his worry.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Sidr (Lote Tree) Leaves
arabicText: .ابلج قزرلا بلجي ردسلبا سأرلا لسغ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Washing the head with sidr attracts sustenance abundantly.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Sidr (Lote Tree) Leaves
arabicText: كلذ ناكو ردسلبا هسأر لسغف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليئربج هرمفأ متغا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإو :لقا .ىهتنملا ةردس نم اردس
englishText: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was distressed, so Gabriel (peace be upon him) instructed him to wash his head with sidr, and that sidr was from Sidrat al-Muntaha (The Lote Tree of the Ultimate Boundary).

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Sidr (Lote Tree) Leaves
arabicText: يبن لكو ،برقم كلم لك هسدق هنفإ ردسلا قروب مكسوؤر اولسغا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو لقا هنع الله فرص نمو ،اموي نيعبس ناطيشلا ةسوسو هنع الله فرص ردسلا قروب هسأر لسغ نمو ،لسرم .ةنجلا لخد اموي نيعبس الله صعي مل نمو ،الله صعي مل اموي نيعبس ناطيشلا ةسوسو
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Wash your heads with sidr leaves, for it is sanctified by every close angel and every sent prophet. Whoever washes his head with sidr (lote tree leaves), Allah will avert the whispering of Satan from him for seventy days. Whoever from whom Allah averts the whispering of Satan for seventy days will not disobey Allah, and whoever does not disobey Allah for seventy days will enter Paradise.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Sidr (Lote Tree) Leaves
arabicText: :لوقيو ردسلبا هسأر لسغي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .هلثم ركذ مث .ردسلا قروب مكسوؤر اولسغا
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to wash his head with sidr (lote tree leaves) and would say: Wash your heads with sidr. He mentioned similarly.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing The Head With Sidr (Lote Tree) Leaves
arabicText: .ردسلبا هسأر لسغي نأ ليئربج هرمفأ متغا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ هدج نع ،هيبأ نع
englishText: From his father, from his grandfather that when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was distressed, Gabriel commanded him to wash his head with sidr (lote tree leaves).

chapter: Permissibility Of Entering Excessively Hot Baths And Throwing Felt Cloth In Them
arabicText: هنكمي لا ناكف ثالاث هيلع هل دقوي نأ رمأ مامحلا لوخد دارأ اذإ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم يبأ ناك .مئقا ةرمو دعقا ةرمف هلخد اذفإ دوبللا هل نوقليف نادوسلا هلخدي ىتح هلوخد
englishText: My father Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), whenever he wanted to enter the bathhouse, would order it to be heated for him three times. He would not enter it until the servants would go in and lay down rugs for him. When he entered, he would sometimes sit and sometimes stand.

chapter: Permissibility Of Entering Excessively Hot Baths And Throwing Felt Cloth In Them
arabicText: مث مامحلا ناخسإب رمفأ :لقا ،معن :تلق ؟مامحلا ديرت :لاقف مامحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس .لخد
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the bathhouse, so he said: Do you want the bathhouse? I said: Yes. He said: So he ordered for the bathhouse to be heated, then he entered.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah)
arabicText: .روهط ةرونلا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Depilatory paste is purifying.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah)
arabicText: وبأ لاقف - لقا نأ ىلإ - ةرونلبا لىطا دق الله دبع وبأو ءاجف ةجاح يف هيخأ نبا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ثعب .روهط ةرونلا نإ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) sent his nephew on an errand, and he returned while Abu Abdullah had applied depilatory paste- until he said- then Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Indeed the depilatory paste is purifying.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah)
arabicText: .دسجلل روهطو ةرشن ةرونلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Depilatory paste is a refreshment and purification for the body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah)
arabicText: خىرأو ،بلصلا ءام عطق لاط اذإ دسجلا رعشو :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع ،نيتيلكلا محش يف ديزتو ،ندبلا ىوقتو ،بلصلا ءام يف ديزت ةرونلا نإو ،لسلاو فعضلا ثروو ،لصافملا .ندبلا نمستو
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When the body hair grows long, it reduces the spinal fluid, loosens the joints, and causes weakness and consumption. Indeed, the depilatory paste increases the spinal fluid, strengthens the body, increases the fat of the kidneys, and fattens the body. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What leads to this has been previously mentioned in the context of the miswak and others, and more evidence will follow.

chapter: Recommendation Of Taking From The Depilatory Paste During Application, Smelling It, Placing It On The Tip Of The Nose, And Praying For Solomon Son Of David
arabicText: هفنأ فرط لىع لعجو همشف هعبصبأ ةرونلا نم ذخفأ ةرونلبا ءلاطلاا دارأ نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .ةرونلا هقرحت مل ،ةرونلبا نارمأ امك دواد نب ناميلس لىع الله لىص :لقاو
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever wants to apply the depilatory paste, and takes some of it with his finger, then smells it and puts it on the tip of his nose, and says: May Allah's blessings be upon Sulayman son of Dawud as he instructed us about the depilatory paste, the paste will not burn him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Taking From The Depilatory Paste During Application, Smelling It, Placing It On The Tip Of The Nose, And Praying For Solomon Son Of David
arabicText: .ةرونلبا نارمأ امك دواد نب ناميلس محرا مهللا :لقا هنأ لاإ هوحن ركذو (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said, and he mentioned something similar except that he said: O Allah, have mercy on Solomon, son of David, as You have commanded us to use depilatory paste.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying With Transmitted Supplications When Applying Depilatory Paste (Nurah)
arabicText: :ةرونلبا لىطأ اذإ لقا نم :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع عمس هنأ ريدس نع ةنس ءاغتبا ترهطت ينإ مهللا ،كيصعي لا ارهاط ارعش ينلدبأو ،ينم باط ام رهطو ،ينم رهط ام بيط مهللا" نمم ينلعجاو ليمع كزو يقلخ رهطو ،رانلا لىع يرشبو يرعش مرحف ،كترفغمو كناوضر ءاغتباو ،نيلسرملا لاماع كلوسرو كبيبح (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم نيدو كليلخ ميهاربإ ةلم ةحمسلا ةيفينحلا لىع كاقلي كئايلوأ بيدتأو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) كلوسر بيدتأو كبيدتأ نسحب بادأتم هب اذخآ كيبن ةنسل اعبتا كعئارشب "مهيلع كتاولص كملعل نداعم مهتلعجو ،مهرودص يف ةمكحلا تعرزو ،كبدبأ مهتوذغ نيذلا نم ةرعش لكب الله قلخو ،ىصعي لا ارعش هلدبو ،بونذلا نمو ايندلا يف سنادلأا نم الله هرهط كلذ لقا نم لهأ حيبست نم ةحيبست فلبأ لدعت مهحيبست نم ةحيبست نأو ،ةعاسلا موقت نأ ىلإ هل حبسي اكلم هدسج .ضرلأا
englishText: Sudair reported hearing Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) say: Whoever says when applying bath clay (nurah): OAllah, purify what is pure in me, and purify what is good in me, and replace my hair with pure hair that does not disobey You. O Allah, I have purified myself seeking the tradition of the messengers, and seeking Your pleasure and forgiveness. So forbid my hair and skin from the Fire, purify my character, bless my deeds, and make me among those who meet You upon the upright and tolerant religion, the faith of Ibrahim, Your close friend, and the religion of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), Your beloved and Your messenger. Make me act according to Your laws, following the tradition of Your prophet, adhering to it, being disciplined with Your excellent teachings and the teachings of Your messenger (peace be upon him and his family), and the teachings of Your close friends whom You have nourished with Your discipline, and planted wisdom in their hearts, and made them repositories of Your knowledge. Your blessings be upon them. Whoever says that, Allah will purify him from impurities in this world and from sins, and will replace his hair with hair that does not disobey. Allah will create an angel for every hair on his body that will glorify Him until the Hour is established, and one glorification from their glorifications equals a thousand glorifications from the glorification of the people of the earth.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste To Private Parts, Allowing Others To Apply Depilatory Paste To The Body, And The Choice Of Order In Doing So
arabicText: ناك ام لىطف مامحلا بحاص رمأ مث ،هترسو هيتبكر ىطغو رازإب رزتفا مامحلا لخد (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ نأ .لعففا اذكه :لقا مث ،هديب هتحت ام وه لىط مث ينع جرخا :لقا مث ،رازلإا نم اجراخ
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) entered the bathhouse, wrapped himself with a waist cloth, and covered his knees and navel. Then he instructed the bathhouse attendant to apply depilatory paste to the areas outside the waist cloth. Then he said, "Leave me," and he applied the paste to the areas underneath by himself. Then he said, "This is how you should do it."

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste To Private Parts, Allowing Others To Apply Depilatory Paste To The Body, And The Choice Of Order In Doing So
arabicText: نأ مامحلا بحاص هربخفأ ةنيدملبا امامح لخد هنأ يقفارملا الله ديبع نع هدانسإب نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم ينوعديو هليلحإ فارطأ لىع هرازإ فلي مث ،اهيلي امو هتناع ليطيف أدبيف لخدي ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ .هندب رياس لىطفا
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn, through his chain from Ubaydullah Al-Murafaqi, that he entered a bathhouse in Medina, and the owner of the bathhouse informed him that Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) used to enter, and he would begin by applying depilatory paste to his pubic area and its surroundings, then he would wrap his waist cloth around his private parts, and then call me to apply the paste to the rest of his body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste To Private Parts, Allowing Others To Apply Depilatory Paste To The Body, And The Choice Of Order In Doing So
arabicText: وه ليطي مث ،حنت :ليطي يذلل :لقا ةروعلا عضوم غلب اذفإ مامحلا يف ليطي (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا ناكو :لقا .عضوملا كلذ
englishText: He said: As-Sadiq (peace be upon him) would apply depilatory paste in the bathhouse, and when he reached the area of the private parts, he would say to the one applying it: "Step aside," then he would apply it to that area himself.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Even If Recently Applied, Even After Two Days
arabicText: نامحرلا دبع يا :يل لاقف مامحلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ عم تلخد :لقا الله دبع يبأ نب نامحرلا دبع نع .روهط اهنفإ لطأ :لاقف مياأ ذنم تيلطأ امنإ :تلقف ،لطأ
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Abdullah who said: I entered the bathhouse with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), and he said to me: "O Abd al-Rahman, remove your body hair (*)." I said: "I only removed it a few days ago." He said: "Remove it, for it is purification." Translator: * Refers to the application of specific substances primarily composed of natural clay or earth materials and also offered exfoliating properties due to its texture and the method of using it involved applying a layer of the moistened clay to the skin, letting it sit, and then scrubbing or washing it off.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Even If Recently Applied, Even After Two Days
arabicText: هب يدهع :تلقف ؟ليطت لاأ دمحم يا :لاقف ،هنم جرخأ نأ ديرأ ناأو مامحلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لخد .روهط اهنأ تملع امأ :لاقف ،مياأ ذنم
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) entered the bathhouse as I was about to leave, and said, "O Muhammad, won't you apply the depilatory paste?" I said, "I just did a few days ago." He said, "Don't you know that it is purification?"

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Even If Recently Applied, Even After Two Days
arabicText: ىلإ - لىطأ دق (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ ترظنف مامحلا ريصب يبأ عم تلخد :لقا ةزمح يبأ نب ليع نع .روهط هنفإ لطأ :لاقف مياأ ذنم تيلطأ دق :لاقف ،دمحم باأ يا لطأ :ريصب يبلأ :لاقف - :لقا نأ
englishText: Ali bin Abi Hamza narrated: I entered the bathhouse with Abu Basir and saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) applying depilatory paste- until he said:- Then he said to Abu Basir: Apply depilatory paste, O Abu Muhammad. Abu Basir replied: I have applied it a few days ago. He said: Apply it, for it is purification. Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Even If Recently Applie...

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Even If Recently Applied, Even After Two Days
arabicText: وبأ هنم نادف رونتي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تيأرف مامحلا هتلخدفأ هدوقأ هعم تنك :لقا ،ريصب يبأ نع اهنأ تملع امأ :لاقف ،ثلاثلا مويلاو سمأ نم لوأ ترونت امنإ :لاقف ،رونت ريصب باأ يا :لاقف ،هيلع ملسف ريصب .رونتف روهط
englishText: From Abu Basir, who said: I was with him guiding him and I took him to the bathhouse where I saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) using depilatory paste. Abu Basir approached him and greeted him. He said: O Abu Basir, use depilatory paste. He replied: I only used depilatory paste the day before yesterday and this is the third day. He said: Don't you know that it is purification, so use depilatory paste.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Even If Recently Applied, Even After Two Days
arabicText: :لاقف ثلاث ذنم كلذ انلعف :لااقف ايلطأ :ريصب يبلأو هل لقا هنأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .روهط ءلاطلاا نفإ (١) ادعأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that he said to him and to Abu Basir: Apply depilatory paste. They said: We have done that three days ago. He said: Do it again, for applying depilatory paste is purification.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Even If Recently Applied, Even After Two Days
arabicText: لاقف ،ةرونلبا لىطأ دق (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأو ءاجف ةجاح يف هيخأ نبا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ثعب نإ (،ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ :لاقف ثلاث ذنم ةرونلبا يدهع امنإ :لاقف لطأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ .روهط ةرونلا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) sent his nephew on an errand. When he returned, Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) had just applied depilatory paste. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said, "Apply it." The nephew replied, "I just used depilatory paste three days ago." Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said, "Indeed, depilatory paste is a purifier."

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Even If Recently Applied, Even After Two Days
arabicText: ليطي مامحلا يف هتبصفأ ةجاح يف هتيتأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لاخ طقرلأا ميكح نب نوراه نع .روهط ةرونلا نفإ لطأ :لاقف ،سمأ نم لوأ هب يدهع امنإ :تلقف ؟ليطت لاأ :لاقف يتجاح هل تركذف
englishText: Harun bin Hakim al-Arqat, the maternal uncle of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), said: I came to him for a need and found him in the bath applying depilatory paste. I mentioned my need to him, and he said: "Won't you apply depilatory paste?" I said: "I just did it the day before yesterday." He said: "Apply it, for the depilatory paste is purifying."

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Every Fifteen Days, Emphasizing It Even If Just Scratched, After Twenty Days, And Even More So After Forty Days, As Well As Shaving The Pubic Hair
arabicText: سيلو اموي نورشع كيلع تتأ نفإ رشع ةسمخ يف ةرونلا يف ةنسلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .الله لىع ضرقتسفا كدنع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The sunnah regarding depilatory paste (*) is in fifteen days, and if twenty days pass and you do not have it, then borrow on account of Allah. Translator: * Primarily composed of natural clay or earth materials and also offered exfoliating properties due to its texture and the method of using it involved applying a layer of the moistened clay to the skin, letting it sit, and then scrubbing or washing it off.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Every Fifteen Days, Emphasizing It Even If Just Scratched, After Twenty Days, And Even More So After Forty Days, As Well As Shaving The Pubic Hair
arabicText: اموي نورشع كيلع تتأ نفإ اموي رشع ةسمخ لك يف ةرونلا يف ةنسلا :لقا )ملاسلا هيلع( الله دبع يبأ نع .الله لىع ضرقتسفا كدنع سيلو
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The Sunnah regarding depilatory paste is to use it every fifteen days. If twenty days pass and you don't have any, then borrow on the account (for the sake) of Allah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Every Fifteen Days, Emphasizing It Even If Just Scratched, After Twenty Days, And Even More So After Forty Days, As Well As Shaving The Pubic Hair
arabicText: لك يف ليطي نأ نمؤملل بحأ :)ملاسلا هيلع( نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا )ملاسلا هيلع( الله دبع يبأ نع .اموي رشع ةسمخ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: I love for the believer to apply depilatory paste every fifteen days.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Every Fifteen Days, Emphasizing It Even If Just Scratched, After Twenty Days, And Even More So After Forty Days, As Well As Shaving The Pubic Hair
arabicText: دحأ هيلع تتأ نمف اموي رشع ةسمخ لك يف ةرونلا يف ةنسلا :لقا )ملاسلا هيلع( الله دبع يبأ نع سيلف رونتي ملو اموي نوعبرأ هيلع تتأ نمو ،رونتيلو لجو زع الله لىع ندتسيلف رونتي ملو اموي نورشعو .ةمارك لاو ملسم لاو نمؤمب
englishText: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Every Fifteen Days, Emp... From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The Sunnah regarding depilatory paste is every fifteen days. Whoever passes twenty-one days without using it, let him borrow against Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, and use depilatory cream. And whoever passes forty days without using it is neither a believer nor a Muslim, and has no dignity.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Every Fifteen Days, Emphasizing It Even If Just Scratched, After Twenty Days, And Even More So After Forty Days, As Well As Shaving The Pubic Hair
arabicText: مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم :لقا )هلآو هيلع الله لىص( يبنلا نع )ملاسلا مهيلع( هئباآ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .رخؤي لاو نيعبرلأا دعب ضرقتسيلف دجي مل نفإ نيعبرلأا قوف هتناع قلح كرتي لاف رخلآا
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not leave the hair of his pubic area for more than forty days. If he cannot find the means to remove it, then he should borrow after forty days and not delay it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Depilatory Paste Every Fifteen Days, Emphasizing It Even If Just Scratched, After Twenty Days, And Even More So After Forty Days, As Well As Shaving The Pubic Hair
arabicText: نم اموي رشع ةسمخ لك يف ليطي نأ نمؤملل بحأ :لقا - ةئامعبرلأا ثيدح يف - )ملاسلا هيلع( ليع نع .ةرونلا
englishText: Ali (peace be upon him) said- in the hadith of the four hundred: I prefer for the believer to apply depilatory paste every fifteen days.

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Use Of Depilatory Paste (Nurah) In The Summer
arabicText: .ءاتشلا يف رشع نم ريخ فيصلا يف ةيلط :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: One coat (application) of depilatory paste in the summer is better than ten in the winter.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Entire Body With Henna After Using The Depilatory Paste (Nourah)
arabicText: ناك همدق ىلإ هنرق نم ءانحلبا هعبتأ مث لىطفأ مامحلا لخد نم :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع .ةرونلا نم هلثم ىلإ ةلكلااو صربلاو ماذجلاو نونجلا نم هل ناامأ
englishText: From the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever enters the bathhouse and applies depilatory paste, then follows it with henna from his head to his foot, it will be a protection for him against madness, leprosy, vitiligo, and ulcers until the next application of depilatory paste.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Entire Body With Henna After Using The Depilatory Paste (Nourah)
arabicText: .رقفلا هنع يفن همدق ىلإ هنرق نم ءانحلبا كلدتف لىطأ نم :لقا هعفر ،الله دبع يبأ نب دمحأ نع
englishText: From Ahmad ibn Abu Abdullah, raising it (to the Imam), he said: Whoever applies henna and rubs it from his head to his foot, poverty will be removed from him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Entire Body With Henna After Using The Depilatory Paste (Nourah)
arabicText: ىلإ هنرق نم وهو مامحلا نم جرخ دقو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر :لقا ميهاربإ نب سودبع نب دمحأ نع .ءانحلا رثأ نم ةدرولا لثم همدق
englishText: From Ahmad ibn Abdus ibn Ibrahim, who said: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) coming out of the bath, and he was from his head to his foot like a rose due to the effect of henna.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Entire Body With Henna After Using The Depilatory Paste (Nourah)
arabicText: ماذجلا :لاصخ ثلاث نم لجو زع الله هنمآ ءانحلبا بضتخاو لىطأ نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .اهلثم ةيلط ىلإ ةلكلااو صربلاو
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever applies (depilatory paste )and dyes with henna, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will protect him from three characteristics: leprosy, vitiligo, and ulceration until the next application.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Entire Body With Henna After Using The Depilatory Paste (Nourah)
arabicText: .صربلاو ماذجلا نم نامأ ةرونلا رثأ لىع ءانحلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Applying henna after depilation provides protection against leprosy and vitiligo.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Entire Body With Henna After Using The Depilatory Paste (Nourah)
arabicText: .رقفلا هنع الله ىفن همدق ىلإ هنرق نم ءانحلبا كلدتو لىطأ نم نأ يورو
englishText: It has been reported that whoever applies depilatory paste and rubs henna from the top of his head to his feet, Allah will remove poverty from him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Entire Body With Henna After Using The Depilatory Paste (Nourah)
arabicText: ءانحلبا بضتخاو لىطأ نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تعمس .اهلثم ةيلط ىلإ ةلكلااو ،صربلاو ،ماذجلا :لاصخ ثلاث نم الله هنمآ
englishText: I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever applies depilatory paste and dyes with henna, Allah will protect him from three qualities: leprosy, vitiligo, and mouth ulcers until the next application.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Entire Body With Henna After Using The Depilatory Paste (Nourah)
arabicText: نامأ ةرونلا دعب ءانحلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع "رابخلأا نويع" يف .صربلاو ماذجلا نم
englishText: In "Uyun al-Akhbar" from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), who said: Amir al Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Applying henna after depilatory paste is a protection against leprosy and vitiligo.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Entire Body With Henna After Using The Depilatory Paste (Nourah)
arabicText: نسحيو ،ةهكنلا بيطيو ،هجولا ءام يف ديزيو ،كهسلبا بهذي ءانحلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع رفعج باأ تيأر :لقاو .رقفلا هنع يفن همدق ىلإ هنرق نم ءانحلبا كلدتف مامحلا لىطأ نم :لقاو دلولا .ءانحلا رثأ نم ةرونلا لثم همدق ىلإ هنرق وهو مامحلا نم جرخ دق (ملاسلا هيلع) يناثلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Henna removes body odor, increases the radiance of the face, freshens the breath, and improves the appearance of children. He also said: Whoever enters the bathhouse and rubs henna from head to toe will have poverty removed from him. And he said: I saw Abu Ja'far al-Thani (peace be upon him) coming out of the bathhouse, and from his head to his toe he was like depilatory paste due to the effect of henna.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Hands With Henna And Applying Henna On Nails After Depilatory Paste (Nurah), And Praying Two Units Of Thanksgiving Upon Exiting The Bath
arabicText: ءانحلا ذخأ دقو هيلإ رظنف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ربق دنع لجر عم (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا وبأ ناك هيف :لاقف هيلإ تفتلفا !؟هيدي نم ءانحلا ذخأ فيك اذه ىلإ نورت امأ :ةنيدملا لهأ ضعب لاقف :لقا ،هيدي نم همدق ىلإ هنرق نم ةرونلا ءلاطإ نم هغارف دعب ءانحلا ذخأ نم هنإ :لاقف ،يلإ تفتلا مث هربخت لا امو هربخت ام .صربلاو ،ماذجلاو ،نونجلا :ةثلاثلا ءاودلأا نم نمأ
englishText: Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) was with a man at the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) when he looked at him and saw that the henna had been removed from his hands. One of the people of Medina said, "Don't you see how the henna has been removed from his hands?!" He turned to him and said, "There is what you know about it and what you don't know about it." Then he turned to me and said, "Whoever applies henna after finishing applying depilatory paste from his head to his feet will be protected from three diseases: madness, leprosy, and vitiligo."

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Hands With Henna And Applying Henna On Nails After Depilatory Paste (Nurah), And Praying Two Units Of Thanksgiving Upon Exiting The Bath
arabicText: ام :تلقف ؟اذه يف لوقت ام مكح يا :لاقف هريفاظأ لىع هلعجو ءانحلا ذخأ دقو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر اهتريغ ةرونلا اهتباصأ اذإ ريفاظلأا نإ مكح يا :لاقف ،نابشلا هلعفي نادنع نأو هلعفت تنأو هيف لوقأ نأ تيسع .ءانحلبا اهريغف ىتوملا ريفاظأ هبشت ىتح
englishText: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and he had taken henna and applied it to his nails. He said: O Hakam, what do you say about this? I said: What can I say about it when you do it, though among us only young men do it. He said: O Hakam, when depilatory paste affects the nails, it changes them until they resemble the nails of the dead, so change them with henna.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Hands With Henna And Applying Henna On Nails After Depilatory Paste (Nurah), And Praying Two Units Of Thanksgiving Upon Exiting The Bath
arabicText: لاف ىتوملا ريفاظأ هبشت اهنأ ىتح اهتريغ ةرونلا اهتباصأ اذإ ريفاظلأا نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رقابلا رفعج وبأ لقا .اهرييغتب سبأ
englishText: Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said: When depilatory paste affects the nails, it changes them until they resemble the nails of the deceased, so there is no harm in changing them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Hands With Henna And Applying Henna On Nails After Depilatory Paste (Nurah), And Praying Two Units Of Thanksgiving Upon Exiting The Bath
arabicText: هيلع) الله دبع وبأ هل لاقف نيديلا بوضخم مامحلا نم جرخ دقو لجر ىلإ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ رظن لخد نم هنأ مكنع ينغلب هنلأ كلذ تلعف امنإو ،اللهو لا :لقا ؟اذكه كيدي قلخ الله نوكي نأ كرسيأ :(ملاسلا مامحلا نم مكدحأ جرخ اذإ كلذ ىنعم امنإ ،تبهذ ثيح كلذ سيل :لاقف ،ءانحلا ينعي هرثأ هيلع ريلف مامحلا .اركش نيتعكر لصيلف ملس دقو
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) looked at a man who had come out of the bathhouse with his hands dyed. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to him: "Would it please you if Allah had created your hands like this?" The man replied: "No, by Allah. I only did this because I was informed that you said that when one enters the bathhouse, the effect should be seen on him, meaning henna." Abu Abdullah said: "That's not what was meant. The meaning of that is when one of you leaves the bathhouse safely, he should pray two rak'ahs in gratitude." Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is not explicit in denunciation and might be a question from him to expose the narrator's mistake in understanding the narration, and the meaning mentioned does not contradict desirability, and the previous denunciation is from the common people like Hakam and the people of Medina, then the latter may tolerate caution and can be interpreted as excessive and habitual for the man, indeed it seems so by the phrase 'created your hands,' because if the color was natural, it would be permanent, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Hands With Henna And Applying Henna On Nails After Depilatory Paste (Nurah), And Praying Two Units Of Thanksgiving Upon Exiting The Bath
arabicText: نم لجر هلبقتسفا مامحلا نم اموي جرخ هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيبأ نع ،ىسوم نب نيسحلا نع دينك يا كليو :لاقف ،ءانح رثأ :لاقف ؟كديب رثلأا اذه ام :لاقف ءانحلا رثأ هديبو (دينك) :هل لاقي ريبزلا لآ لخد نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا ،هدج نع ،هيبأ نع ،هنامز لهأ ملعأ ناكو يبأ ينثدح هلثم ىلإ ةلكلااو ،صربلاو ،ماذجلاو نونجلا نم هل ناامأ ناك همدق ىلإ هنرق نم ءانحلبا هعبتأ مث لىطفا مامحلا .ةرونلا نم
englishText: From Al-Husayn ibn Musa, from his father Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him): One day he came out of the bathhouse and was met by a man from the family of Al-Zubayr called Kunayd. There were traces of henna on his hand. He asked, "What is this trace on your hand?" The man replied, "It's a trace of henna." He said, "Woe to you, O Kunayd! My father, who was the most knowledgeable person of his time, narrated to me from his father, from his grandfather, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever enters the bathhouse and applies depilatory paste, then follows it with henna from his head to his feet, it will be a protection for him from madness, leprosy, vitiligo, and ulcers until the next application of depilatory paste.'" Recommendation Of Dyeing Hands With Henna And Applying Henna On Nai... Shaykh Hurr Amili: This can be argued by generality since the desirability of the whole implies the desirability of the part, and the denunciation here is also from the common people.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Hands With Henna And Applying Henna On Nails After Depilatory Paste (Nurah), And Praying Two Units Of Thanksgiving Upon Exiting The Bath
arabicText: هيلع) رفعج يبأ دي يف ءانحلا رثأ تيأر :لقا حابصلا يبأ نع ،(قلاخلأا مراكم) يف ،يسربطلا لضفلا نب نسحلا (.ملاسلا
englishText: Al-Hasan bin Al-Fadhl Al-Tabarsi, in (Makarim Al-Akhlaq), from Abu Al-Sabah who said: I saw the trace of henna on the hand of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him).

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Hands With Henna And Applying Henna On Nails After Depilatory Paste (Nurah), And Praying Two Units Of Thanksgiving Upon Exiting The Bath
arabicText: .هلك باضخلبا سبأ لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) stated: There is no harm in all kinds of dyeing. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is indicated by the general narrations about dyeing and henna as will be mentioned.

chapter: Permissibility Of Urinating While Standing For One Who Applied Depilatory Paste And The Dislike Of Sitting
arabicText: .هب سبأ لا :لقا ؟مئقا وهو لوبيف ليطي لجرلا نع هتلأس
englishText: I asked him about a man who applies depilatory paste and urinates while standing? He said: There is no harm in it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Urinating While Standing For One Who Applied Depilatory Paste And The Dislike Of Sitting
arabicText: .قتفلا هيلع فيخ رونتم وهو سلج نم نأ يور
englishText: It is narrated that whoever sits while having applied depilatory paste, there is fear of hernia for him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Massaging With Bran, Flour, And Oil After Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) Without Dislike And Without Being Considered Extravagance
arabicText: دعب هب حسميف هب تلي تيزلبا قيقدلا لعجيف ةرونلبا ليطي لجرلا نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .سبأ لا :لقا ،هنع اهحير عطقيل ةرونلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who uses depilatory paste, then mixes flour with oil to make a paste and applies it after the depilatory paste to remove its smell from him. He said: There is no problem with that.

chapter: Permissibility Of Massaging With Bran, Flour, And Oil After Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) Without Dislike And Without Being Considered Extravagance
arabicText: لا :لقا ،كلذ نوهركي سانلا نإ :هل تلقف ،تيزلبا توتلم قيقدب كلدت دقو (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تيأر .هب سبأ
englishText: I saw Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) rubbing himself with flour mixed with oil. So I said to him: "People dislike that." He replied: "There is no harm in it."

chapter: Permissibility Of Massaging With Bran, Flour, And Oil After Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) Without Dislike And Without Being Considered Extravagance
arabicText: .هب سبأ لا :لقا ،قيقدلاو تيزلبا كلدتيو ليطي لجرلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), regarding a man who applies depilatory paste and rubs himself with oil and flour, he said: There is no harm in it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Massaging With Bran, Flour, And Oil After Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) Without Dislike And Without Being Considered Extravagance
arabicText: :فارسإ هنأ نومعزي :تلق ،سبأ لا :لاقف ةرونلا دعب قيقدلبا كلدتلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس اميف فارسلاا امنإ ،هب كلدتفأ تيزلبا يل تليف يقنلبا ترمأ امبر ينإو فارسإ ندبلا حلصأ اميف سيل :لاقف .ندبلبا رضأو لاملا فلتأ
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about rubbing with flour after using depilatory paste. He said: There is no harm in it. I said: They claim it is extravagance. He replied: There is no extravagance in what benefits the body. I sometimes order pure flour to be mixed with oil for me to rub with. Extravagance is only in what wastes wealth and harms the body.

chapter: Permissibility Of Massaging With Bran, Flour, And Oil After Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) Without Dislike And Without Being Considered Extravagance
arabicText: امنإ سبأ لا :لاقف ؟قيقدلبا كلدتنف ةلاخن انعم نوكي لاو رفاسنل ناإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق يل تلف يملاغ ترمأ امبر ينإ ،داسفب سيل هنفإ ندبلا حلصأ ام امفأ لاملا فلتأو ،ندبلبا رضأ اميف داسفلا .هب كلدتفأ تيزلبا يقنلا
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): We travel and we don't have bran with us, so can we rub ourselves with flour? He said: There is no harm. Corruption is only in what harms the body and wastes wealth. As for what benefits the body, it is not corruption. I sometimes order my servant to mix pure flour with oil for me to rub with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Massaging With Bran, Flour, And Oil After Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) Without Dislike And Without Being Considered Extravagance
arabicText: دعب هب حسمتب هب هتلي تيزلبا قيقدلا لعجيف ةرونلبا ليطي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .سبأ لا :لقا ،اهحير عطقيل ةرونلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who applies depilatory paste and then mixes flour with oil to rub it on after the depilatory paste to remove its smell. He said: There is no problem with that.

chapter: Permissibility Of Massaging With Bran, Flour, And Oil After Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) Without Dislike And Without Being Considered Extravagance
arabicText: نوكي لاو مارحلاا ديرن ةكم قيرط يف نوكن ناإ :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هركذ لجر نع ؟فارسلاا ةفاخم :لقا ميلع هب الله ام كلذ نم ينلخديف قيقدلبا كلدتنف ةرونلا نم اهب كلدتن ةلاخن انعم فارسلاا امنإو ،هب كلدتفأ تيزلبا تلي يقنلبا ترمأ امبر ناأ ،فارسإ ندبلا حلصأ اميف سيل :لاقف ،معن :تلقف .ندبلبا رضأو ،لاملا فلتأ اميف
englishText: From a man whomentioned it from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I said to him: We are on the road to Makkah, intending to enter ihram, and we don't have bran to rub ourselves with after using depilatory paste, so we rub ourselves with flour, and this causes me concern that only Allah knows the extent of. He said: Are you afraid of wastefulness? I said: Yes. He said: There is no wastefulness in what improves the body. I sometimes order pure flour to be mixed with oil and rub myself with it. Wastefulness is only in what wastes money and harms the body.

chapter: No Dislike For Wearing A Waist Wrap Over Depilatory Paste (Nurah)
arabicText: .ةرونلا قوف رازإ هيلعو ةرونلا هيلعو (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا وبأ لىع لخدف طسولأا تيبلا يف مامحلا يف تنك
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): I was in the bathroom in the middle room when Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) entered while he had depilatory paste on him and was wearing a waist wrap over the depilatory paste.

chapter: Dislike Of Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) On Wednesday For Entering The Bathhouse, And No Dislike On Friday And The Rest Of The Days
arabicText: هنفإ ءاعبرلأا موي ةرونلا ىقوتي نأ لجرلل يغبني :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا .ميالأا رئاس يف ةرونلا زوجتو رمتسم سحن موي
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: A man should avoid using depilatory paste on Wednesday, for it is a day of continuous misfortune, but using depilatory cream is permissible on all other days.

chapter: Dislike Of Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) On Wednesday For Entering The Bathhouse, And No Dislike On Friday And The Rest Of The Days
arabicText: .ءاعبرلأا موي اومحتساو ءثالاثلا موي مكرافظأ اوملق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: Trim your nails on Tuesday and bathe on Wednesday.

chapter: Dislike Of Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) On Wednesday For Entering The Bathhouse, And No Dislike On Friday And The Rest Of The Days
arabicText: موي ةرونلا ىقوتي نأ لجرلل يغبني :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رمتسم سحن موي هنفإ ءاعبرلأا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: A man should avoid using depilatory paste on Wednesday, for it is a day of continuous misfortune.

chapter: Dislike Of Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) On Wednesday For Entering The Bathhouse, And No Dislike On Friday And The Rest Of The Days
arabicText: موي ةرونلا :صربلا ثروت لاصخ سمخ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا يف يسرافلا ليع نب دمحم ةأرملا نايشغو ةبانجلا لىع لكلااو ،سمشلا هنخست يذلا ءاملبا لاستغلااو يضوتلاو ،ءاعبرلأا مويو ةعمجلا ثيداحأ يف ةعمجلا موي ةرونلا ةهارك مدع لىعو كلذ لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ .عبشلا لىع لكلااو ،اهضيح يف .ةيقتلا وأ خسنلا لىع امإ لومحم ةهاركلا نمضت ام نأو ،ةعمجلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali Al-Farisi reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Five traits lead to leprosy: Using depilatory paste on Friday and Wednesday, performing ablution and bathing with water heated by the sun, eating while in a state of janabah (sexual impurity), having intercourse with a woman Dislike Of Using Depilatory Paste (Nurah) On Wednesday For Entering... during her menstruation, and eating when already full. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Evidence for non-dislikeability of using depilatory paste on Friday, will come in the hadiths about Friday. What implies dislikeability is interpreted as either abrogated or as taqiyya.

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: لوسر لوق لاإ ايلع عنمي ملو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا بضخ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .(ملاسلا امهيلع) رفعج وبأو نيسحلا بضخ دقو ،هذه نم هذه بضخت :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) dyed [his hair], and nothing prevented Ali except the saying of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): "This will be dyed by this," and Al-Husayn and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon them both) had dyed [their hair].

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: !هولأسف داوسلبا ابضتخم هوأرف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ لىع موق لخد :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .نهل عنصتأ نافأ ءاسنلا بحأ لجر ينإ :لاقف
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said: A group of people visited Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and saw him dyeing his hair black, so they asked him about it. He replied: I am a man who loves women, so I beautify myself for them.

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: ديزيو ،ءاسنلا ىلإ ةبحمو ،برحلا يف ةبيهم :لاصخ ةثلاث باضخلا يف :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .هابلا يف
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: In hair-dyeing there are three benefits: it creates awe during war, makes one more appealing to women, and increases sexual potency.

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: :لقا نأ يلإ - ؟موقلا نمم :انل لاقف خلسملا تيب يف لجر اذفإ ةنيدملبا امامح يمع و يدجو يبأو ناأ تلخد ؟باضخلا نم كعنمي ام لهك يا :لاقف ،يدجل دمص راحلا تيبلا يف ناك املف ، مامحلا يف هبضغ انفرع ىتح كلذل بضغف :لقا ،بضتخي لا كنمو ينم ريخ وه نم تكردأ :يدج هل لاقف ،بضتخي لا وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) بلاط يبأ نب ليع تكردأ :لاقف ؟ينم ريخ وه يذلا كاذ نمو :لقا هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نفإ بضتخت نإ لهك يا :لقا مث ترربو تقدص :لاقف ،قارع باصتو هسأر سكنف ،ةنس ليعب كلف كرتت نإو ،ليع نم ريخ وه بضخ دق (هلآو .(ملاسلا امهيلع) ليع نب دمحم هنبا هعمو نيسحلا نب ليع وه اذفإ لجرلا نع انلأس مامحلا نم انجرخ املف
englishText: I, my father, my grandfather, and my uncle entered a public bath in Medina, and there was a man in the changing room who said to us: "Where are you from?"- until he said Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non-obligatorines...- When we were in the hot room, he approached my grandfather and said: "O elderly one, what prevents you from dyeing [your hair]?" My grandfather said to him: "I met someone who is better than you and me who did not dye [his hair]." He [the other person] became so angry that we noticed his anger in the bathhouse. He said: "And who is that who is better than me?" He replied: "I met Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), and he did not dye [his hair]." He hung his head and began to sweat, then said: "You have spoken the truth and been righteous." Then he said: "O elderly one, if you dye [your hair] then indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) has dyed, and he is better than Ali. And if you leave it [undyed] then you have Ali's example to follow." When wecame out of the bathhouse, we asked about the man, and it turned out to be Ali ibn Al-Husayn and with him was his son Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon them both).

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: .ةنسلا نم وهو (هلأو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم (١) ىلإ يده باضخلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Hair dyeing was divinely guided to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and it is from the Sunnah.

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: .هلك باضخلبا سبأ لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: There is no harm in all types of hair dye.

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لاقف ،باضخلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ لأس هنأ ملسم نب دمحم نع هدانسباو .نادنع هرعش اذهو بضتخي (هلآو هيلع الله
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim that he asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about dyeing (hair), so he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to dye, and here is his hair with us.

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: .ىراصنلاو دوهيلبا اوهبشت لاو بيشلا اوريغ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Change the gray hair and do not imitate the Jews and Christians.

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: تدروأ امنإ :قودصلا لقا .ىراصنلاو دوهيلبا اوهبشت لاو ،بيشلا اوريغ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا لامعتسا ةعيشلا لىع نوركني بصنلا لهأ نلا ةريره يبأ نع رخلآاو ،ريبزلا نع امهدحأ :نيربخلا نيذه .مهيلع انل ةجح امهيفو ،امهنع حصي ام عفد لىع نوردقي لاو باضخلا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Change your gray hair and do not resemble the Jews and Christians. Al-Saduq said: I have only mentioned these two reports- one from Al-Zubair and the other from Abu Hurayrah- because the Nasibis (those who show enmity to Ahl al-Bayt) deny the Shia's use of hair dye while they cannot reject what is authentically narrated from these two, and in these reports is our proof against them.

chapter: Recommendability Of Dyeing For Men And Women, Its Non obligatoriness, The Permissibility Of Different Types Of Dyes, And The Recommendability Of Women Dyeing After Menstruation Ends
arabicText: ؟(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر بضتخا دقو باضخلا نم كعنم ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريملأ تلق هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر يبيبح هب ينربخأ دوهعم دهعب يسأر مد نم يتيحل بضخي نأ اهاقشأ رظتنا :لقا .(هلآو
englishText: I said to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him): "What prevents you from dyeing (your hair) when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to dye?" He replied: "I am waiting for its most wretched one to dye my beard with blood from my head, according to a covenant that my beloved, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), informed me about."

chapter: Recommendability Of Spending On Dyeing
arabicText: عبرأ هيف نإ ،الله ليبس يف مهرد ةقفن نم لضفأ باضخلا يف مهرد ةقفن :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا دشيو ،ةهكنلا بيطيو ،ميشايخلا نيليو ،رصبلا نع اشغلا ولجيو ،نينذلاا نم حيرلا درطي :ةلصخ ةرشع هب ظيغيو ،نمؤملا هب رشبتسيو ةكئلاملا هب حرفتو ،ناطيشلا ةسوسو لقيو ،نايشغلبا بهذيو ،ةثللا .ريكنو ركنم هنم ييحتسيو ،هربق يف ةءاربو ،بيط وهو ،ةنيز وهو ،رفاكلا
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Spending a dirham on dyeing (hair) is better than spending a dirham in the path of Allah, for it has fourteen qualities: It expels wind from the ears (*), clears cloudiness from vision, softens the nostrils, freshens the breath, strengthens the gums, eliminates fainting, reduces satanic whispers, delights the angels, brings joy to the believer, angers the disbeliever, it is an adornment, it is fragrant, provides immunity in one's grave, and makes Munkar and Nakir (the questioning angels) shy away from him. Translator: * This could imply a preventative or curative effect against conditions as caused by "wind" or air, which could relate to various ailments such as earaches, headaches, or imbalances believed to be caused by air entering the body.

chapter: Recommendability Of Spending On Dyeing
arabicText: يف مهرد ليع يا :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ولجيو :لقا هنأ لاإ هوحن ركذ مث ،ةلصخ ةرشع عبرأ هيفو الله ليبس يف قفني مهرد فلأ نم لضفأ باضخلا .نايشغلبا بهذيو :هلوق لدب ىنضلبا بهذيو :لقاو ،رصبلا
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: O Ali, one dirham spent on hair dye is better than a thousand dirhams spent in the way of Allah, and in it are fourteen qualities. Then he mentioned similar to it except that he said: it brightens the eyesight, and he said: it removes exhaustion instead of saying: it removes unconsciousness.

chapter: Dislike Of Neglecting Dyeing And The Recommendation Of Reapplying It
arabicText: .سؤب كلذ نفإ باضخلا لوصنو كياإ :الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah said: Beware of the washing out of hair dye for that is misery.

chapter: Dislike Of Neglecting Dyeing And The Recommendation Of Reapplying It
arabicText: نم باضخلا لصن دقو (ملاسلا هيلع) لتقو متكلاو ءانحلبا بضتخي ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نإ .هيضراع
englishText: Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) used to dye his hair with henna and katam (a plant used for black dye), and when he was martyred (peace be upon him), the dye had faded from his sideburns. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This can be taken to mean it is permissible, or necessary, and he was unable to reapply it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Grey Hair, Its Non-obligation, And Its Non-recommendation For Those In Mourning
arabicText: ،هتيحل يف بيشلا ىلإ رظنف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىلإ لجر ءاج :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع :لقا ،ةمايقلا موي ارون هل تناك ملاسلاا يف ةبيش باش نم :لقا مث ،رون :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لاقف بضخف ،ملاسإو رون :لقا باضخلا ىأر املف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىلإ ءاج مث ءانحلبا لجرلا بضخف بولق يف ةبهرو ،مكئاسن ىلإ ةبحمو ،ناميإو ملاسإو رون :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لاقف ،داوسلبا لجرلا .مكودع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and he noticed grey hair in his beard. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Light." Then he said: "Whoever grows grey hair while in Islam, it will be light for him on the Day of Resurrection." The man then dyed his beard with henna and came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). When he saw the dye, he said: "Light and Islam." Then the man dyed his beard black, so the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Light and Islam and faith, and love from your women, and fear in the hearts of your enemy."

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Grey Hair, Its Non-obligation, And Its Non-recommendation For Those In Mourning
arabicText: لوق نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع ،(ةغلابلا جهن) يف يوسوملا يضرلا نيسحلا نب دمحم هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا امنإ :لاقف ،دوهيلبا اوهبشت لاو بيشلا اوريغ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .راتخا ام ؤرمفا هنارجب برضو هقاطن عستا دقو نلآا امأو ،لق نيدلاو كلذ (هلآو
englishText: Muhammad bin Al-Husayn Al-Radhi Al-Musawi narrated in (Nahj Al-Balagha), from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) that he was asked about the saying of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): "Change gray hair and do not resemble the Jews." He said: "The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said this when the religion was still limited in scope, but now that its scope has expanded and it has become well-established, a person may choose as he wishes."

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing Grey Hair, Its Non-obligation, And Its Non-recommendation For Those In Mourning
arabicText: لوسرب ديري ،ةبيصم يف موق نحنو ةنيز باضخلا :لاقف ،نينمؤملا ريمأ يا كبيش تريغ ول :هل ليقو :لقا .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: It was said to him: If only you would dye your grey hair, Amir al-Mu'minin. He said: Dyeing is adornment and we are a people in mourning- referring to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing The Hair And Beard
arabicText: ريمأ نإ :تلق ،معن :لاقف ؟ةنسلا نمأ ةيحللاو سأرلا باضخ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس هذه نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لوق هعنم امنإ :لقا ،بضتخي مل (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا .هذه نم بضختس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about dyeing the hair of the head and beard, is it from the sunnah? He said: Yes. I said: But Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) did not dye his hair. He said: He only refrained from it because of the saying of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): This will be dyed from this.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Black
arabicText: تبضتخا كارأ :تلقف داوسلبا بضتخا دقو (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ لىع تلخد :لقا مهجلا نب نسحلا نع ءاسن كرت دقلو ،ءاسنلا ةفع يف لجو زع الله ديزي امم ةئيهتلاو باضخلاو ارجأ باضخلا يف نإ :لاقف ،داوسلبا ،بيشلا يف ديزي ئش يأ :لقا ،بيشلا يف ديزي ءانحلا نأ انغلب :تلق :لقا ،ةئيهتلا نهل نهجاوزأ كرتب ةفعلا .موي لك يف ديزي بيشلا
englishText: From Al-Hasan bin Al-Jahm who said: I entered upon Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) and he had dyed his hair black, so I said: I see you have dyed your hair black. He said: Indeed there is reward in dyeing, and dyeing and grooming are among the things through which Allah the Mighty and Majestic increases the chastity of women. Women have abandoned chastity due to their husbands abandoning grooming for them. I said: We have been informed that henna increases gray hair. He said: What thing increases gray hair? Gray hair increases every day.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Black
arabicText: داوسلبا ابضتخم هوأرف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا لىع موق لخد :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع نأ اهازغ ةازغ يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر رمأ :لقا مث ،هتيحل ىلإ هدي دمف ،كلذ نع هولأسف .نيكرشملا لىع هب اووقيل داوسلبا اوبضتخي
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A group of people came to Al-Husayn bin Ali (peace be upon him) and saw him dyeing with black. They asked him about that, so he extended his hand to his beard and said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered during one of his military expeditions that they dye with black to appear stronger against the polytheists.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Black
arabicText: .ودعلل ةباهمو ،ءاسنلل سنا داوسلبا باضخلا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) say: Dyeing hair black provides comfort to women and inspires awe in the enemy. Recommendation Of Dyeing With Black

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Black
arabicText: .داوسلبا باضخلا هنم :لقا (ةوق نم متعطتسا ام مهل اودعأو) " لجو زع الله لوق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو
