englishText: He (peace be upon him) said regarding the words of Allah the Mighty and Majestic And prepare against them whatever you are able of power [Quran, 8:60], he said: Among it is dyeing with black.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Black
arabicText: .كلاحلا الله ىلإ مكباضخ بحأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The most beloved dye to Allah is the darkest one.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Black
arabicText: .ودعلل ةتبكمو ءاسنلل ةنيز داوسلبا باضخلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: Dyeing with black is an adornment for women and a cause of distress for the enemy.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Yellow And Red, Preferring Red Over Yellow, And Preferring Black Over Both
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر هل لاقف ،هتيحل رفص دقو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لىع لخد لاجر نإ هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر مسبتف ءانحلبا ىنقأ دقو اذه دعب هيلع لخد مث ؟اذه نسحأ ام :(هلآو نسحأ اذه لقاو هيلإ كحضف داوسلبا بضخ دقو كلذ دعب هيلع لخد مث ،كاذ نم نسحأ اذه :لقاو (هلآو .كاذو كاذم
englishText: A man entered upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) with his beard dyed yellow. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: How beautiful is this? Then he entered again after this with his beard dyed red with henna, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) smiled and said: This is more beautiful than that. Then he entered after that with his beard dyed black, and he smiled at him and said: This is more beautiful than that and that.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Yellow And Red, Preferring Red Over Yellow, And Preferring Black Over Both
arabicText: باضخ نم اذه سيل كادف تلعج :تلقف ،ةرمحلبا بضخي ناكو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب يسوم تيقل لوسر دهع لىع ملسأ اذإ ناك لجرلا نإ ،ينانسأ لىع تكرحتف ةمسولبا بضتخأ تنك لجأ :لاقف ،كلهأ ،كلذ لعف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله يف) لاقف ،كلذ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا غلبف ةرفصلبا (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ بضخ دقلو هبضخف ،ناميإو ملاسإ :لاقف كلذ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا غلبف ،ةرمحلبا هبضخف ملاسإ ،(باضخلا .رونو ناميإو ملاسإ :لاقف كلذ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا غلبف داوسلبا
englishText: I met Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) and he used to dye with red, so I said: May I be sacrificed for you, this is not the dye of your family. He said: Yes, I used to dye with wasma (indigo leaves) but it affected my teeth. Indeed when a man would embrace Islam during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) he would do that. And indeed Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) dyed with yellow and this reached the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), so he said regarding the dye: Islam. Then he dyed it red and this reached the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), so he said: Islam and faith. Then he dyed it black and this reached the Prophet Recommendation Of Dyeing With Yellow And Red, Preferring Red Over Y... (peace be upon him and his family), so he said: (This is) Islam, faith and light.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Yellow And Red, Preferring Red Over Yellow, And Preferring Black Over Both
arabicText: بحلأ ينإ ،ملاسلاا باضخ اذه :لاقف مهاحل اورفص هباحصأ نم اموق نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر غلب :لقا ،ملاسلاا باضخ اذه :لقا مهآر املف هوتفأ مهتربخفأ مهيلع تررمف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لقا ،مهارأ نأ ينإ ناميلاا باضخ اذه :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر كلذ غلب املف اونقفأ اوبغر هنم كلذ اوعمس املف ناميلاا باضخ اذه :لقا مهآر املف هوتفأ مهتربخفأ مهيلع تررمف :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لقا .مهارأ نأ بحلأ .اوتام ىتح هيلع اوقب هنم كلذ اوعمس املف
englishText: It reached the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that some of his companions had dyed their beards yellow, so he said: This is the dye of Islam, I would love to see them. Ali (peace be upon him) said: I passed by them and informed them, so they came to him. When he saw them, he said: This is the dye of Islam. When they heard this from him, they desired more and used henna. When this reached the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), he said: This is the dye of faith, I would love to see them. Ali (peace be upon him) said: I passed by them and informed them, so they came to him. When he saw them, he said: This is the dye of faith. When they heard this from him, they maintained it until they died. Shaykh Hurr Amili: There will come what proves the dye with red, God willing, and what has been mentioned partially before, and there will come what proves it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Katam
arabicText: نيسحلاو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا بضخ دق :لاقف رعشلا باضخ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .متكلبا ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) رفعج وبأو ،ليع نب
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about dyeing hair, and he said: Indeed the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), Al-Husayn bin Ali, and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon them) used to dye with katam (a plant based black dye).

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Katam
arabicText: متكلبا نوبضتخي (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب دمحم رفعج وبأو ،ليع نب نيسحلاو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ناك .متكلاو ءانحلبا بضتخي (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع ناكو
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), Al-Husayn bin Ali, and Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali (peace be upon him) used to dye with katam (a plant based black dye), and Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) used to dye with henna and katam.

chapter: Chapter On The Recommendation Of Dyeing With Wasma
arabicText: لا ناسح وبأو ،ةمسولبا ثراحلاو ،ءانحلبا بضتخم ةمقلعو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ دنع ناسح يبأو هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لاقف ،هتيحل ىلإ راشأو ؟الله كمحر اذه يف ىرت ام :مهنم لجر لك لاقف ،بضتخي جوزت نيح كلذ معن :لقا ؟ةمسولبا ابضتخم (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ ناك :اولقا ؟هنسحأ ام :(ملاسلا .هنبضخف اهيراوج هتذخأ ةيفقثلا
englishText: Abu Hasan, Alqama, and Al-Harith were with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him). Alqama had dyed with henna, Al-Harith with wasma (indigo plant dye), and Abu Hasan had not dyed. Each man said: What do you think of this, may Allah have mercy on you? pointing to his beard. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: How beautiful it is! They asked: Did Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) dye with wasma? He said: Yes, that was when he married the Thaqafiyyah woman, her slave girls took him and dyed him.

chapter: Chapter On The Recommendation Of Dyeing With Wasma
arabicText: .ريبكلا خيشلل اهب سبأ لا :لاقف ؟ةمسولا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ،نانس نب الله دبع نع
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about wasma (indigo plant dye). He said: There is no harm in it for the elderly man.

chapter: Chapter On The Recommendation Of Dyeing With Wasma
arabicText: يسارضأ ةمسولا تضقن دمحم يا :لاقف ،اكلع غضمي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر ،ميلس نب دمحم نع .بهذلبا اهدشف تخرتسا تناكو :لقا ،اهدشلا كلعلا اذه تغضمف
englishText: From Muhammad ibn Sulaym: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) chewing mastic gum, and he said: O Muhammad, the wasma (hair dye) has loosened my molars, so I chewed this gum to strengthen them. He said: And they had become loose, so he fastened them with gold.

chapter: Chapter On The Recommendation Of Dyeing With Wasma
arabicText: .ةمسولا يسارضأ تضقن :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The wasma (indigo plant dye) loosened my teeth. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This indicates his regular use of it, implying recommendation, and it is not explicit in criticism, nor is the one before it.

chapter: Chapter On The Recommendation Of Dyeing With Wasma
arabicText: .ةمسولبا بضتخم وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا لتق :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Husayn (peace be upon him) was killed while he had dyed his hair with wasma (indigo plant dye).

chapter: Chapter On The Recommendation Of Dyeing With Wasma
arabicText: وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا لتق دق سبأ لا :لاقف ،ةمسولبا باضخلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ةمسولبا بضتخم
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about dyeing with wasma (indigo), and he said: There is no problem with it, as Husayn (peace be upon him) was killed while he was dyed with wasma.

chapter: Chapter On The Recommendation Of Dyeing With Wasma
arabicText: .ةمسولبا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ةمئلأا بضخ دقو :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: And the Imams (peace be upon them) used to dye with wasma (indigo plant dye).

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna
arabicText: .اينقا بااضخ ءانحلبا بضتخي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر
englishText: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) dyeing his hair with henna in a deep red color.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna
arabicText: .بيشلا رثكيو هجولا ءام يف ديزي ءانحلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Henna increases facial radiance and causes grey hair to grow abundantly.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna
arabicText: .ءانحلبا باوضخم (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر
englishText: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) having hair dyed with henna.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna
arabicText: .بيشلا لعشي ءانحلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Henna ignites gray hair.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna
arabicText: هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليعل ىلوم نع ،زيرح نع ،بويأ نب ةلاضف نع ،هيبأ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نب دمحأ نع اوبضخا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع تعمس :لقا (ملاسلا .ةجوزلا نكسيو ،حيرلا بيطيو ،رعشلا تبنيو ،رصبلا ولجي هنفإ ءانحلبا
englishText: From Ahmad ibn Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Hareez, from a freedman of Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) who said: I heard Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Dye with henna for it sharpens eyesight, promotes hair growth, perfumes the breath, and calms the wife.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna
arabicText: ،كهسلبا بهذي ءانحلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ هعفر ،ميهاربإ نب سودبع نع ،دمحأ نع ،مهنعو .دلولا نسحيو ،ةهكنلا بيطيو ،هجولا ام يف ديزيو
englishText: From them, from Ahmad, from Abdus ibn Ibrahim, raising it to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Henna removes body odor, enhances facial complexion, improves breath fragrance, and beautifies offspring.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna
arabicText: - :لقا نأ ىلإ - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم ميهاربإ وبأ ىفوت امل :لقا يربنعلا ةقدص نب دمحم نع ةحارج رثأ هب سيلو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم ىلإ اورظنف هتعيش نم لاجر نوعبس هيلع لخدف .ءانحلا رثأ هلجر يف ناكو ،قنخ لاو مسلاو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Sadaqah Al-Anbari who said: When Abu Ibrahim Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) passed away- until he said:- seventy men from his followers entered upon him and they looked at Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) and there was no trace of injury, poison, or strangulation on him, and there was a trace of henna on his foot.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna And Katam
arabicText: امهيلع) رفعج وبأو نيسحلا بضخ :لاقف ،رعشلا باضخ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .متكلاو ءانحلبا (ملاسلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about hair dyeing, and he said: Al-Husayn and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon them both) used to dye their hair with henna and katam (a plant based black dye).

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna And Katam
arabicText: .متكلاو ءانحلبا يبأو نيسحلا بضتخا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him), he said: Al-Husayn and my father used to dye [their hair] with henna and katam [a black dye plant].

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna And Katam
arabicText: .هيضراع نم باضخلا لصن دقو (ملاسلا هيلع) لتقو ،متكلاو ءانحلبا بضتخي (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا ناك
englishText: Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) used to dye [his hair] with henna and katam [a plant based dye], and when he was killed (peace be upon him), the dye had started fading from his sideburns.

chapter: Recommendation Of Dyeing With Henna And Katam
arabicText: امنإ ،نورت امك سيل هنأ امأ :لاقف ،هباضخ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا لأس هنأ رحلا نب الله ديبع نع ،متكو ءانح وه
englishText: Ubaydullah bin Al-Hur narrated that he asked Al-Husayn bin Ali (peace be upon him) about his hair dye, so he said: It is not as you see it, it is merely henna and katam.

chapter: Dislike Of A Woman Neglecting Jewelry And Hand Dyeing, Even If She Is Old And Not Married
arabicText: نأ اهل يغبني لاو ،ةدلاق اهقنع يف قلعت نأ ولو اهسفن لطعت نأ ةأرملل يغبني لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا .ةنسم تناك نإو ،احسم ءانحلبا اهحسمت نأ ولو باضخلا نم اهدي عدت
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: A woman should not leave herself unadorned, even if it means just wearing a necklace around her neck, and she should not leave her hands without dye, even if it means just wiping them with henna lightly, even if she is elderly.

chapter: Dislike Of A Woman Neglecting Jewelry And Hand Dyeing, Even If She Is Old And Not Married
arabicText: لوسر صخر :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع :(قلاخلأا مراكم) يف يسربطلا لضفلا نب نسحلا ءاسنلا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر رمأو :لقا داوسلبا اهسأر بضخت نأ ةأرملل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله دي اهدي هبشت لاف لعبلا تاذ ريغ امأو ،اهجوزل نيزتف لعبلا تاذ امأ ،لعبلا تاذ ريغو لعبلا تاذ باضخلبا .لاجرلا
englishText: Al-Hasan ibn Al-Fadhl Al-Tabarsi in (Makarim Al-Akhlaq) narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) permitted women to dye their hair black. He said: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered women to use dye, both married and unmarried. As for the married woman, it is to adorn herself for her husband, and as for the unmarried woman, it is so that her hand does not resemble the hand of men. Shaykh Hurr Amili: There will come evidence supporting this in the dress of the prayer, in the rulings on clothing, in marriage, and other matters.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Dye When Meeting Enemies And When Meeting Women
arabicText: ةباهم نأ لىع لدي ام اهضعب يفو ةقباسلا باوبلأا يف ةقرفتم ثيداحأ ةدع يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقت دق :لوقأ .ملعأ اللهو .ملاسلاا لوأ يف هب رملاا وأ ،باضخلا بابحتسا يف ةلعلا وه ءادعلأا
englishText: I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates this has already been mentioned in several separate hadiths in the previous chapters, and some of them indicate that intimidating the enemies was the reason for recommending or ordering hair dyeing in early Islam. And Allah knows best. Translator: No hadith are mentioned in this chapter. Just a comment by Shaykh Hurr Amili.

chapter: Recommendation of Using Kohl for Both Men and Women
arabicText: .مفلا بذعي لحكلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: Narrated from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Kohl (eyeliner) sweetens the mouth.

chapter: Recommendation of Using Kohl for Both Men and Women
arabicText: .دوجسلا لوط لىع نيعيو ،رصبلا دحيو .رعشلا تبني لحكلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Kohl grows hair, sharpens vision, and helps in prolonging prostration.

chapter: Recommendation of Using Kohl for Both Men and Women
arabicText: .ةعضابملا يف ديزي لحكلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Applying kohl increases sexual desire.

chapter: Recommendation of Using Kohl for Both Men and Women
arabicText: .رصبلا ولجيو ،قيرلا بذعيو ،ةعمدلا ففجيو ،رعشلا تبني لحكلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Kohl grows hair, dries tears, sweetens saliva, and brightens vision.

chapter: Recommendation of Using Kohl for Both Men and Women
arabicText: .لحتكيلف رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي ناك نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should apply kohl.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Kohl, Especially Antimony, And Specifically Not Mixed With Musk
arabicText: هشارف ىلإ ىوآ اذإ دمثلإبا لحتكي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ارتو ارتو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would apply antimony kohl to his eyes in odd numbers (of times) when he retired to his bed.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Kohl, Especially Antimony, And Specifically Not Mixed With Musk
arabicText: .نيعلا رافشأ دشيو ،ةهكنلا بيطي دمثلإبا لاحتكلاا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Applying kohl made of antimony improves the breath and strengthens the eyelashes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Kohl, Especially Antimony, And Specifically Not Mixed With Musk
arabicText: .ةعمدلبا بهذيو ،(نفجلا يف) رعشلا تبنيو ،رصبلا ولجي دمثلإا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Antimony (kohl) clears the vision, grows hair (in the eyelid), and eliminates tears.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Kohl, Especially Antimony, And Specifically Not Mixed With Musk
arabicText: .هيلع ماني ماد ام ادبأ دوسلأا ءاملا نم نمأ كسمم ريغ دمثإ لىع منا نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever sleeps while having applied kohl (antimony) without wiping it off will be forever protected from glaucoma as long as he continues to sleep with it on.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Kohl, Especially Antimony, And Specifically Not Mixed With Musk
arabicText: .رعشلا تبنيو ،ةعمدلا عطقيو ،رصبلا ولجي دمثلإا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Antimony (kohl) brightens the vision, stops excessive tearing, and promotes hair growth.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Kohl Every Other Night And Its Non-obligatory Nature
arabicText: دقف لعف نمو ،رتويلف لحتكا نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .سبأ لاف لعفي مل نمو ،نسحأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever applies kohl should do it in odd numbers, and whoever does so has done well, and whoever does not do so, there is no harm.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Kohl Every Other Night And Its Non-obligatory Nature
arabicText: .اضرع اوكاتساو ،ارتو اولحتكا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Apply kohl in odd numbers, and brush your teeth (with siwak) horizontally.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Kohl At Night And Before Sleep, Four Times In The Right Eye And Three Times In The Left Eye
arabicText: يف اعبرأ ماني نأ لبق لحتكي ناك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ىرسيلا يف ثالاثو ،ىنميلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his progeny) used to apply kohl before going to sleep, four times in the right eye and three times in the left.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Kohl At Night And Before Sleep, Four Times In The Right Eye And Three Times In The Left Eye
arabicText: .ةنيز راهنلبا وهو ندبلا عفني ليللبا لحكلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Applying kohl at night benefits the body and it serves as an adornment during the day.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Kohl At Night And Before Sleep, Four Times In The Right Eye And Three Times In The Left Eye
arabicText: .ءاملا نم نامأ مونلا دنع لحكلا :لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع)الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Applying kohl before sleep is a protection against eye ailments.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Kohl At Night And Before Sleep, Four Times In The Right Eye And Three Times In The Left Eye
arabicText: .دمثلإا نم همانم دنع دوارم ةعبس لحتكيلف هرصب يف فعض هباصأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع
englishText: From al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever suffers from weak eyesight should apply kohl seven times at bedtime with ithmid (antimony).

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Kohl At Night And Before Sleep, Four Times In The Right Eye And Three Times In The Left Eye
arabicText: .مفلا بيطي ليللبا لحكلا :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نعو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Applying kohl at night sweetens the breath.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Kohl At Night And Before Sleep, Four Times In The Right Eye And Three Times In The Left Eye
arabicText: دوارم ثلاث ةليل لك يف اهنم لحتكي ةلحكم (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلل ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع .همانم دنع نيع لك يف
englishText: From al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his progeny) had a kohl container from which he would apply kohl every night, three strokes in each eye at bedtime.

chapter: Recommendation Of Applying Kohl At Night And Before Sleep, Four Times In The Right Eye And Three Times In The Left Eye
arabicText: ثالاث لحتكا ءاش نم :لقاو نيتنث ىرسيلا يفو ،ثالاث ىنميلا هنيع يف لحتكي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ناك يف اهب لحتكي ةلحكم هل ناكو ،مئاص وهو لحتكا امبرو ،جرح لاف هقوف وأ كلذ نود لعف نمو ،نيع لك يف .دمثلإا هلحك ناكو ليللا
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) would apply kohl three times in his right eye and twice in his left eye, and he said: Whoever wishes may apply kohl three times in each eye, and whoever does less or more than that, there is no harm, and he would sometimes apply kohl while fasting, and he had a kohl container that he would use at night, and his kohl was antimony (ithmid).

chapter: Recommendation Of Having A Kohl Applicator Made Of Iron And A Kohl Container Made Of Bone
arabicText: هيلع) نسحلا يبلأ ناك اذه :لاقف ماظع نم ةلحكمو ديدح نم لايم (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا وبأ ينارأ .تلحتكفا هب لحتكفا (ملاسلا
englishText: Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) showed me an iron stick and a kohl container made of bones and said: This belonged to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), so apply kohl with it, and I did.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming Hair And Removing It Completely
arabicText: ةرثكو ،رعشلا ذخأو ،رطعلا :نيلسرملا ننس نم ثلاث :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا ىسوم نب ليع تعمس .ةقورطلا
englishText: I heard Ali ibn Musa Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) say: Three practices are from the traditions of the Messengers: wearing perfume, removing hair, and frequent marital relations.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming Hair And Removing It Completely
arabicText: ،رعشلا زج :نهعدي مل نهفرع نم ثلاث :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع ،دلاخ نب رمعم نع ،دانسلاباو .ءاملإا حاكنو بايثلا ريمشتو
englishText: In the chain, from Ma'mar bin Khallad, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said: Three things, whoever knows them will not abandon them: cutting the hair, rolling up the clothes, and marrying slave women.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming Hair And Removing It Completely
arabicText: ،كتبقر ظلغتو ،هخسوو هباودو هنرد لقي كرعش لصأتسا :يل لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كندب حيرتسيو :ىرخأ ةياور يفو .كرصب ولجيو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He said to me: Remove your hair completely, it will reduce its dirt, its insects, and its filth, and will thicken your neck, and will brighten your vision. And in another narration: and your body will find rest.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming Hair And Removing It Completely
arabicText: .نسحي هنفإ رعشلا مكنع اوقلأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Remove hair from yourselves for it is better.

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: ضقني له هسأرو هتيحل رعش نم ذخيأو ،هبراش زجيو هرافظأ ملقي لجرلا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق كلذ نإو ،ةضيرفلا ضقني ةنسلا نم ئش سيلو ةضيرف ءوضولاو ،ةنس اذه لك ةرارز يا :لاقف ؟هءوضو كلذ .اريهطت هديزيل
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who clips his nails, trims his mustache, and takes from the hair of his beard and head- does this invalidate his ablution? He said: O Zurarah, all of this is sunnah, while ablution is obligatory, and nothing from the sunnah invalidates what is obligatory. In fact, it increases him in purification.

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: ةلثم ةرمع لاو جح ريغ يف سأرلا قلح نأ نووري انباحصأ نإ :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .قلحف ةياس :اهل لاقي ةيرق ىلإ لدع هكسن ىضق اذإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا وبأ ناك :لاقف
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): I said to him: Our companions narrate that shaving the head outside of Hajj or Umrah is mutilation. He said: Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) would, after completing his rituals, go to a village called Saya and shave his head.

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: ةلثمو ،انل ةرمع :(ملاسلا هيلع) لاقف ،ةلثم سأرلا قلح :نولوقي سانلا نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .انئادعلأ
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): People say shaving the head is mutilation. He said: For us it is umrah, and for our enemies it is mutilation.

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) دمحم باحصأ ناك :لاقف ؟رعشلا ةلاطإ يف لوقت ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق ةيحوجرم مدع لىع لديف ،زجلا مطلا نم دارملا نأ رهاظلا :ىقتنملا بحاص لقا .مطلا ينعي نيرعشم (هلآو .زجلا عم ةلاطلإا
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What do you say about letting the hair grow long? He said: The companions of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) had abundant hair, meaning al-tamm. The author of Al-Muntaqa said: It appears that what is meant by al-tamm is trimming, which indicates that letting hair grow with trimming is not discouraged.

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: .كلامج يف ديزي هنفإ قلحا :لجرل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to a man: Shave your head for it will increase your beauty.

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: .مكل لامجو مكئادعلأ ةلثم ةرمع لاو جح ريغ يف سأرلا قلح نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Shaving the head when not in hajj or umrah is a disfigurement for your enemies and beauty for you.

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: .ةيلطلا ىلإ ةيلطلا نيب اميف ةعمج لك يف قلحلأ ينإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Indeed I shave every Friday between hairline to hairline.

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: ،ةرونلبا دسجلا قلحو ىسوملبا فيظنتلاو ،بيطتلا :ءايبنلأا قلاخأ نم عبرأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا .ةقورطلا ةرثكو
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Four traits are from the manners of the prophets: wearing perfume, cleaning with the razor, removing body hair with depilatory, and frequent marital relations.

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: بهذو ،رصبلا فعض لاط اذإ سأرلا لىع رعشلا نإ :لوقي هتعمس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع .هرون ءوض يف ديزيو ،رصبلا ولجي رعشلا مطو ،هرون ءوضب
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Awwal (peace be upon him), he said: I heard him saying: When the hair on the head grows long, it weakens eyesight and diminishes its light, and trimming the hair improves eyesight and increases its light. Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair

chapter: Recommendation Of Head Shaving For Men And Dislike Of Long Hair
arabicText: .خيشلبا رقاوو ،باشلبا ةلثم سأرلا قلح نأ يور لقا يناوفصلل (ملاعلا سنا) باتك نمو
englishText: And from the book (Uns Al-Alim) by Al-Safwani, he said it is narrated that shaving the head is a disfigurement for the young man but dignity for the elderly.

chapter: Dislike Of A Man Shaving Only The Back Of The Head While Leaving The Rest, And The Recommendation Of Shaving The Nape
arabicText: هيلع) نسحلا وبأ ينآرف ةرقنلا عضوم نم قلحف ماجحلا ينمجح :لقا ملسأ نب رمع نب نامحرلا دبع نع .يسأر تقلحف تبهذف :لقا ،كسأر قلحفا بهذا ؟اذه ئش يأ :لاقف (ملاسلا
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Umar bin Aslam who said: The cupper performed cupping (hijamah) on me and shaved the area of the back of the head. Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saw me and said: What is this? Go and shave your head. He said: So I went and shaved my head.

chapter: Dislike Of A Man Shaving Only The Back Of The Head While Leaving The Rest, And The Recommendation Of Shaving The Nape
arabicText: :لقا ،اديدش امغ ينمغيف يافق يف رعشلا رثك امبر كادف تلعج تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مغلبا بهذي افقلا قلح نأ تملع امأ قاحسإ يا يل لاقف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I said: May I be sacrificed for you, sometimes the hair on my nape becomes abundant and causes me severe distress. He said to me: O Ishaq, don't you know that shaving the nape removes distress.

chapter: Recommendation Of Parting The Hair Of The Head When It Grows Long
arabicText: لوسر رعش ناكو :لقا .رنا نم راشنمب الله هقرف هقرفي ملو ارعش ذختا نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا .قرفلا غلبي مل ةرفو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Whoever grows hair and does not part it, Allah will part it with a saw of fire. He said: And the hair of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was abundant but did not reach the point of needing parting.

chapter: Recommendation Of Parting The Hair Of The Head When It Grows Long
arabicText: :لقا ؟اهعدي وأ اهقرفيأ ةرفو هل نوكي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا قابقبلا سابعلا يبأ نع .اهقرفي
englishText: From Abi Al-Abbas Al-Baqbaq who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the man who has thick hair (wafrah), should he part it or leave it? He said: He should part it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Parting The Hair Of The Head When It Grows Long
arabicText: الله لىص) يبنلا نأ نومعزي :تلقو ،ةنسلا نم قرفلا نأ نووري مهنإ تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رعشلا كسمت ءايبنلأا تناك لاو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا قرف ام :لقا ،قرف (هلآو هيلع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I said, They narrate that parting the hair is from the Sunnah, and they claim that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) used to part his hair. He replied: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) did not part his hair, nor did the prophets maintain [long] hair.

chapter: Recommendation Of Parting The Hair Of The Head When It Grows Long
arabicText: نإ لا :لقا ؟هرعش قرفي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناكأ :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هنذا ةمحش ىلإ ناك هرعش لاط اذإ ناك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him: Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) part his hair? He said: No, when the hair of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) grew long, it would reach his earlobes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Parting The Hair Of The Head When It Grows Long
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر قرف لهف :تلق ،لا :لقا ؟ةنسلا نم قرفلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق ؟ةنسلا نم سيلو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر قرف فيك تلق ،معن :لقا ؟(هلآو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر قرف امك قرفي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر باصأ ام هباصأ نم :لقا ؟كلذ فيك :هل تلق ،لاف لاإو يتلا ياؤرلا الله هارأ مرحأو ىدهلا قاس ناك دقو تيبلا نع دص امل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لقا الله ءاش نإ مارحلا دجسملا نلخدتل قحلبا ياؤرلا هلوسر الله قدص دقل) :لوقي ذإ هباتك يف اهب الله كربخأ (نوفاخت لا نيرصقمو مكسؤر نيقلحم نينمآ هسأر لىع ناك يذلا رعشلا كلذ رفو مث نمف ،هارأ امب هل يفيس الله نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ملعف كلذ ناك لاو رعشلا ريفوت يف دعي مل هقلح املف ،لجو زع الله هدعو ثيح ،مرحلا يف هقلحل اراظتنا مرحأ نيح .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) هلبق نم نمضت امو ،هيلإ جاتحي ثيحب رعشلا لوط مدع ةلاح لىع قرفلا ىفن نمضت ام لمح انه عمجلا هجو :لوقأ ،كاوسلا يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو ،ةقباسلا ثيداحلأا نم مهفي امك دحلا كلذ ىلإ هلوط لىع قرفلا بابحتسا ةرم هلعف امنإو ،ابلاغ لاو امئاد كلذ لعفي ناك ام هنأ هانعم قرفي ناك ام (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) هنأ نمضت امو .هل ةرمتسم ةنس نوكي لاف ةدحاو
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Is parting the hair from the Sunnah? He said: No. I said: Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) part his hair? He said: Yes. I said: How did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) part his hair while it is not from the Sunnah? He said: Whoever is afflicted with what afflicted the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) may part his hair as the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) parted his, otherwise no. I said to him: How is that? He said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was prevented from reaching the House (Ka'bah) while he had brought the sacrificial animals and entered ihram, Allah showed him the vision which Allah informed you about in His Book when He says: "Indeed Allah has shown to His Messenger the vision in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Haram, if Allah wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and shortened (hair), not fearing [anyone]." [Quran, 48:27] The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) knew that Allah would fulfill what He had shown him. Therefore, he kept growing the hair that was on his head when he entered into Ihram, waiting to shave it in the Haram (Sacred Sanctuary), as Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, had promised him. After he shaved it, he did not return to growing his hair, nor was this his practice before (peace be upon him and his family). Recommendation Of Parting The Hair Of The Head When It Grows Long I (Hurr Amili) say: The way to reconcile here is to interpret what implies the absence of parting on the condition when the hair is not long enough to require it, and what implies the recommendation of parting when the hair reaches that length, as understood from the previous hadiths. This was previously indicated in the discussion about the tooth-stick (siwak). As for what implies that he (peace be upon him and his family) did not part his hair, it means that he did not do it constantly or frequently, rather he did it only once, so it was not his continuous practice.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard And Rounding It, And Taking From The Cheeks, And Lining The Beard
arabicText: .اهرود :لاقف ،هتيحل نم ذخيأ ماجحلاو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر
englishText: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) while the barber was trimming his beard, and he said: Make it round.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard And Rounding It, And Taking From The Cheeks, And Lining The Beard
arabicText: .هتيحل ففخ دق (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر :لقا تيازلا نسحلا نع ،ناكسم نب الله دبع نع
englishText: From Abdullah bin Muskan, from Al-Hasan Al-Zayyat who said: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and he had shortened his beard.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard And Rounding It, And Taking From The Cheeks, And Lining The Beard
arabicText: ليوط لجر (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلبا رم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع تسرد نع ،ناقهدلا نع لىع لخد مث ،نيتيحللا نيب هتيحلب أيهف لجرلا كلذ غلبف ،هتيحل نم أيه ول اذه لىع ناك ام :لاقف ةيحللا .اولعففا اذكه :لقا هآر املف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا
englishText: From Al-Dihqan, from Durust, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A man with a very long beard passed by the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), so he said: What harm would it be for this man if he were to groom his beard. This reached the man, so he groomed his beard to a length between two extremes, then he came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). When he saw him, he said: Do like this.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard And Rounding It, And Taking From The Cheeks, And Lining The Beard
arabicText: .هتيحل نطبيو هيضراع ذخيأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تيأر
englishText: I saw Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) trimming the sides of his beard and thinning its inner part. Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard And Rounding It, And Taking Fr...

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard And Rounding It, And Taking From The Cheeks, And Lining The Beard
arabicText: بحاص يطنزبلا رصن يبأ نبا دمحم نب دمحلأ (عماجلا) باتك نم لاقن (رئارسلا) رخآ يف سيردإ نب دمحم لاف هيضراع نم امأ :لقا ؟هتيحل نم ذخيأ نأ هل حلصي له لجرلا نع هتلأسو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا .لاف اهمدقم نم امأو ،سبأ
englishText: Al-Hasan bin Idris narrated in the end of Al-Sara'ir, quoting from the book Al-Jami' by Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti, companion of Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), who said: I asked him whether it is permissible for a man to trim his beard? He said: As for trimming from its sides, there is no harm in that, but as for trimming from its front, then no. Shaykh Hurr Amili: This is to be understood as not exceeding a handful, as will be explained later, insha Allah, and it has been previously indicated in the hadiths about shaving hair.

chapter: Dislike Of Frequently Placing The Hand In The Beard
arabicText: .هجولا نيشي كلذ نفا كتيحل يف كدي عضو رثكت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Do not excessively run your hand through your beard, for that disfigures the face.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard Beyond A Handful
arabicText: .ةيحللا ينعي رانلا يفف ضبقلا لىع داز ام :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whatever exceeds the handful [in length] is in the Fire - meaning of the beard.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard Beyond A Handful
arabicText: .رانلا يف وهف ةضبقلا نع ةيحللا نم داز ام :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whatever exceeds from the beard beyond a fistful is in the Fire.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard Beyond A Handful
arabicText: .لضف ام زجتو ةيحللا لىع كديب ضبقت :لقا ةيحللا ردق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding the length of the beard, he said: Grasp your beard with your hand and trim what exceeds that.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Beard Beyond A Handful
arabicText: يفو ،همتاخ شقن يفو ،هتيحل لوط يف :ثلاث يف لجرلا لقع ربتعي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هتينك
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A man's intellect is judged by three things: by the length of his beard, by the inscription on his ring, and by his teknonym (kunyah). Shaykh Hurr Amili: It appears that it means intelligence is inferred from the beard being moderate in length.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Mustache And Defining Its Edge, Disliking Its Lengthening, And Similarly For The Pubic And Armpit Hair
arabicText: .معن :لقا ؟ةنسلا نمأ براشلا صق نع هتلأس
englishText: I asked him about trimming the moustache, is it from the Sunnah? He said: Yes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Mustache And Defining Its Edge, Disliking Its Lengthening, And Similarly For The Pubic And Armpit Hair
arabicText: براشلا نم ذختأ نأ ةنسلا نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .راطلإا غلبي ىتح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: It is from the Sunnah to trim the mustache until it reaches the border [of the lip].

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Mustache And Defining Its Edge, Disliking Its Lengthening, And Similarly For The Pubic And Armpit Hair
arabicText: .هب رتتسي ائبخم هذختي ناطيشلا نفإ هبراش مكدحأ نلوطي لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: None of you should let his moustache grow long, for Satan uses it as a hiding place to conceal himself.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Mustache And Defining Its Edge, Disliking Its Lengthening, And Similarly For The Pubic And Armpit Hair
arabicText: .ةنسلا نم وهو ةرشن لاقف ،براشلا نم ذخلاا ناركذ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When we mentioned trimming the mustache, he said: It revives freshness, and it is from the Sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Mustache And Defining Its Edge, Disliking Its Lengthening, And Similarly For The Pubic And Armpit Hair
arabicText: .بيسعلبا هقصلأ ىتح هبراش ىفحأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ ىأر هنأ نامثع نب الله دبع نع
englishText: Ibn Abdullah bin Othman reported that he saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) trim his mustache very close until it was nearly touching the upper lip. Recommendation Of Trimming The Mustache And Defining Its Edge, Disl...

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Mustache And Defining Its Edge, Disliking Its Lengthening, And Similarly For The Pubic And Armpit Hair
arabicText: ،هيطبإ رعش لاو هبراش مكدحأ نلوطي لا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع .اهب رتتسي ائبخم اهذختي ناطيشلا نفإ ،هتناعلاو
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said: None of you should let his mustache, armpit hair, or pubic hair grow long, for Satan uses them as hiding places to conceal himself.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Mustache And Defining Its Edge, Disliking Its Lengthening, And Similarly For The Pubic And Armpit Hair
arabicText: هيلع) ميهاربإ ةعيرش ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع (قلاخلأا مراكم) يف يسربطلا نسحلا ميلقتو ،طبلإا فتنو ،براشلا صقو ،ناتخلا ةيفينحلا يف هدازو (:لقا نأ ىلإ) صلاخلااو ديحوتلا (ملاسلا .هتعيرش اهلك هذهف ،كسانملاو ،جحلاو ،تيبلا ءانبب هرمأو ،ةناعلا قلحو ،رافظلأا
englishText: Al-Hasan Al-Tabarsi reported in (Makarim Al-Akhlaq) from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: The law of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) was monotheism and sincerity (then he said:) and to his original pure faith were added circumcision, trimming the mustache, plucking armpit hair, clipping nails, shaving pubic hair, and he was commanded to build the House [Ka'bah], perform Hajj, and the rituals- so all these were his law.

chapter: Recommendation Of Trimming The Mustache And Defining Its Edge, Disliking Its Lengthening, And Similarly For The Pubic And Armpit Hair
arabicText: ،هيطبإ نم فتنف " رهطت " لقا مث ،هبراش ذخفأ " رهطت " :ميهاربلإ لجو زع الله لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) هنعو .نتتخفا " رهطت " :لقا مث ،هتناع قلحف " رهطت " لقا مث ،هرافظأ ملقف " رهطت " لقا مث
englishText: From him (peace be upon him), he said: Allah the Mighty and Majestic said to Ibrahim: Purify yourself, so he trimmed his mustache, then He said: Purify yourself, so he plucked his armpits, then He said: Purify yourself, so he clipped his nails, then He said: Purify yourself, so he shaved his pubic hair, then He said: Purify yourself, so he was circumcised.

chapter: Prohibition Of Shaving The Beard And The Recommendation Of Growing It To A Handful Or Similar Length
arabicText: .دوهيلبا اوهبشت لاو حىللا اوفعاو براوشلا اوفح :هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Trim the mustaches and let the beards grow, and do not resemble the Jews.

chapter: Prohibition Of Shaving The Beard And The Recommendation Of Growing It To A Handful Or Similar Length
arabicText: ،براوشلا زجن نحن ناإو مهبراوش اورفوو ،مهاحل اوزج سوجملا نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .ةرطفلا يهو ،حىللا يفعنو
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed, the Magians (Zoroastrians) used to trim their beards and let their mustaches grow long, while we trim the mustaches and let the beards grow, and this is the natural way.

chapter: Prohibition Of Shaving The Beard And The Recommendation Of Growing It To A Handful Or Similar Length
arabicText: .سوجملبا اوهبشت لاو ،حىللا اوفعاو ،براوشلا اوفح :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Trim the mustaches, let the beards grow, and do not imitate the Magians.

chapter: Prohibition Of Shaving The Beard And The Recommendation Of Growing It To A Handful Or Similar Length
arabicText: يرجلا يعايب اهب برضي ناتبابس اهل ةرد هعمو سيمخلا ةطرش يف (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ تيأر فنخأ نب تارف هيلإ ماقف ،ناورم ينب دنجو ،ليئارسإ ينب خوسم يعايب يا :مهل لوقيو ،رامزلاو ،يهامراملاو .اوخسمف براوشلا اولتفو حىللا اوقلح ماوقأ :هل لاقف :لقا ؟ناورم ينب دنج امو نينمؤملا ريمأ يا :لاقف :لقا هنأ لاإ هلثم بوقعي نب دمحم نع ،ققادلا دمحأ نب ليع نع (نيدلا لامكإ) باتك يف قودصلا هاورو .يفاطلاو ،ريمزلاو
englishText: I saw Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) in the Thursday police patrol, and he had a whip with two strands, striking the sellers of eel and murmaahi (a snake-like) f ish, and the flute player, saying to them: O sellers of the transformed ones of Bani Israel and soldiers of Bani Marwan. Then Furat ibn Akhnaf stood up and said: O Amir al-Mu'minin, who are the soldiers of Bani Marwan? He replied: People who shaved their beards and twisted their mustaches, so they were transformed. Prohibition Of Shaving The Beard And The Recommendation Of Growing ... Al-Saduq narrated it in the book (Ikmal al-Din) from Ali ibn Ahmad al-Daqqaq, from Muhammad ibn Yaqub similarly except that he said: and the zameer, and the floating f ish. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The hadith is narrated by al-Saduq in the book "Ikmal al-Din" from Ali bin Ahmad al-Daqqaq, from Muhammad bin Ya'qub, similarly, except that he said: "and the flute player, and the drummer."

chapter: Prohibition Of Shaving The Beard And The Recommendation Of Growing It To A Handful Or Similar Length
arabicText: هب الله هلاتبا ام هنإ :لقا " نهمتفأ تاملكب هبر ميهاربإ لىتبا ذإو " :ىلاعت هلوق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع هل بااوث هل ىلاعت الله لقا مزع املف الله رملأ ملسو اهيلع مزعو ميهاربإ اهمتفأ ليعامسإ هدلو حبذ نم همون يف " امامإ سانلل كلعاج ينإ " :لقا نأ ىلإ يف يتلا امفأ ،ندبلا يف اهنم ةسمخو ،سأرلا يف اهنم ةسمخ :ءايشأ ةرشع يهو ةيفينحلا هيلع لزنأ مث نم رعشلا قلحف ندبلا يف يتلا امأو ،للاخلاو ،كاوسلاو ،رعشلا مطو ،حىللا ءافعإو ،براشلا ذخفأ سأرلا ،ءاملبا روهطلاو ،ةبانجلا نم لسغلاو ،رافظلأا ميلقتو ،ناتخلاو ،ندبلا :هلوق وهو ،ةمايقلا موي ىلإ خسنت لاو خسنت ملف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ اهب ءاج يتلا ةرهاظلا ةيفينحلا هذهف .افينح ميهاربإ ةلم عبتاو
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) regarding Allah's words: And when Ibrahim was tried by his Lord with certain words which he fulfilled [Quran, 2:124], he said: It was what Allah tested him with in his sleep regarding slaughtering his son Isma'il, so Ibrahim fulfilled it and resolved to do it and submitted to Allah's command. When he resolved to do it, Allah the Most High said to him as a reward, until He said: I will make you an Imam for mankind [Quran, 2:124]. Then the 'Hanifiyyah' (pure natural way) was revealed to him, which consists of ten things: five of them in the head and five in the body. As for those in the head, they are trimming the mustache, letting the beard grow, parting the hair, using the siwak, and using toothpicks. As for those in the body, they are removing body hair, circumcision, clipping the nails, performing ghusl after janabah, and purification with water. This is the manifest 'Hanifiyyah' practices that Ibrahim (peace be upon him) brought, which was not abrogated and will not be abrogated until the Day of Resurrection, and it is His saying: And follow the religion of Ibrahim inclining towards truth [Quran,

chapter: Recommendation Of Removing Hair From The Nose
arabicText: .هجولا نسحي فنلاا نم رعشلا ذخأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Trimming the nose hair beautifies the face.

chapter: Recommendation Of Removing Hair From The Nose
arabicText: كلذ نفإ ،هسفن دهاعتيلو هفنأ نم يذلا رعشلاو هبراش نم مكدحأ ذخأيل :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ .ابيط ءاملبا ىفكو :لقاو ،هلامج يف ديزي
englishText: That the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Let one of you trim his mustache and the hair from his nose, and let him take care of himself, for that increases his beauty. And he said: Water alone suffices as a perfume.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing The Hair Of The Head When It Grows Long
arabicText: :لقا ؟ءباولا امو :تلق :لقا ،ءباولبا بهذي سأرلل طشملا :(ثيدح) يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ يل لقا .سارضلأا دشي ةيحلل طشملاو ،ىمحلا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) told me in a hadith: Combing the head eliminates the plague. I asked: What is the plague? He said: The fever. And combing the beard strengthens the teeth.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing The Hair Of The Head When It Grows Long
arabicText: ،باولبا بهذي سأرلا حيرست ةرثك :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىلإ ثيدحلا عفر ديعس نب ةسبنع نع .عامجلا يف ديزيو ،قزرلا بلجيو
englishText: Anbasa bin Sa'eed raised the hadith to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said: Frequently combing the hair eliminates plague, brings sustenance, and increases sexual ability.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing The Hair Of The Head When It Grows Long
arabicText: .باولبا بهذي سأرلا طشم :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn narrated that Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Combing the hair removes the plague.

chapter: The Recommendation Of Combing
arabicText: .باولبا بهذي طشملا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تعمس
englishText: I heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) say: Combing (the hair) eliminates the plague.

chapter: The Recommendation Of Combing
arabicText: .مغلبلا للقي طشملا ةرثك :لقا :هيبأ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نب دمحأ نع ،انباحصأ نم ةدع نعو
englishText: Several of our companions narrated from Ahmad ibn Abu Abdullah, from his father who said: Frequent combing of hair reduces phlegm.

chapter: The Recommendation Of Combing
arabicText: :يقربلا الله دبع يبأ نب دمحأ ةياور يفو :لقا .ىمحلا وهو ،ءباولبا بهذي طشملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا .فعضلا وهو ءباولبا بهذي
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Combing [the hair] removes the plague, which is fever. He said: And in the narration of Ahmad ibn Abu Abdullah Al-Barqi: It removes the plague, which is weakness.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing At The Time Of Obligatory And Supererogatory Prayers
arabicText: دنع طشمتلا كلذ نم :لقا .(١) دجسم لك دنع مكتنيز اوذخ " :الله لوق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .ةلاص لك
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) regarding Allah's saying: Take your adornment at every mosque [Quran, 7:31]. He said: Among that is combing your hair before every prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing At The Time Of Obligatory And Supererogatory Prayers
arabicText: يف طشم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ ناكو ءباولبا بهذي طشملا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تعمس .هتلاص نم غرف اذإ هب طشمتي دجسملا
englishText: I heard Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) say: Combing dispels the plague, and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) had a comb in the mosque which he would use to comb his hair after completing his prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing At The Time Of Obligatory And Supererogatory Prayers
arabicText: مكتنيز اوذخ لجو زع الله لوق نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا وبأ لئس :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .ةلاص لك دنع طشمتلا كلذ نم :لقا ،دجسم لك دنع
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) was asked about the saying of Allah the Almighty "Take your adornment at every mosque" [Quran, 7:31], he said: Among that is combing the hair before every prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing At The Time Of Obligatory And Supererogatory Prayers
arabicText: نفإ طشملا :لقا " دجسم لك دنع مكتنيز اوذخ " :لجو زع الله لوق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لوسر ناكو ،مغلبلا عطقيو ،بلصلا ءام يف ديزيو ،ةجاحلا زجنيو ،رعشلا نسحيو قزرلا بلجي طشملا ،نهذلا يف ديزي هنإ :لوقيو ،تارم عبس اهقوف نمو ،ةرم نيعبرأ هتيحل تحت حرسي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله .مغلبلا عطقيو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding the words of Allah the Mighty and Majestic: Take your adornment at every mosque [Quran, 7:31], he said: The comb, for combing brings sustenance, beautifies the hair, fulfills needs, increases spinal fluid, and eliminates phlegm. And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would comb under his beard forty times and above it seven times, and he would say: It increases intelligence and eliminates phlegm.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing At The Time Of Obligatory And Supererogatory Prayers
arabicText: دنع طشمتلا وه :لقا " دجسم لك دنع مكتنيز اوذخ " :ىلاعت هلوق نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ةلفناو ةضيرف ةلاص لك
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about His, the Most High's saying: Take your adornment at every mosque [Quran, 7:31]. He said: It is combing (the hair) before every obligatory and supererogatory prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing At The Time Of Obligatory And Supererogatory Prayers
arabicText: مكتنيز اوذخ " :ىلاعت هلوق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع (نايبلا عمجم) يف يسربطلا نسحلا نب لضفلا .ةلاص لك دنع طشمتلا وه ةنيزلا ذخأ نإ :لقا " دجسم لك دنع
englishText: Al-Fadhl ibn al-Hasan al-Tabarsi in (Majma' al-Bayan) from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) regarding the words of the Almighty: "Take your adornment at every mosque" [Quran, 7:31], he said: Taking adornment means combing the hair before every prayer.

chapter: Recommendation Of Combing At The Time Of Obligatory And Supererogatory Prayers
arabicText: اوذخ " :ىلاعت هلوق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا (قلاخلأا مراكم) يف يسربطلا لضفلا نب نسحلا .رعشلا نسحيو قزرلا بلجي طشملا نفإ طشملا :لقا ،" دجسم لك دنع مكتنيز
englishText: Al-Hasan ibn Al-Fadhl Al-Tabarsi in (Makarim Al-Akhlaq) said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) regarding His saying: "Take your adornment at every mosque" [Quran, 7:31], said: The comb, for combing brings provision and beautifies the hair.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using An Ivory Comb
arabicText: نادنع نإ كادف تلعج :هل تلقف ،هب طشمتي جاع طشم هدي يفو (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ يبأ لىع تلخد :لقا مث ،ناطشم وأ طشم اهنم يبلأ ناك دقف ؟ملو :لاقف ،جاعلبا طشمتلا لحي لا هنأ معزي نم قارعلبا .باولبا بهذي جاعلا نفإ جاعلبا اوطشمت
englishText: I went to Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and in his hand was an ivory comb with which he was combing. I said to him: May I be sacrificed for you, we have people in Iraq who claim that combing with ivory is not permissible. He said: And why? My father had one or two ivory combs. Then he said: Comb with ivory for it eliminates plague.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using An Ivory Comb
arabicText: .هل هتيرتشاو جاع طشمب طشمتي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تيأر
englishText: I saw Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) combing his hair with an ivory comb, and I had bought it for him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using An Ivory Comb
arabicText: .هب سبأ لا :لقا اهطاشمأو اهنهادم ليفلا ماظع نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the elephant bones, using them for oil containers and combs. He said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using An Ivory Comb
arabicText: .اطشمل هنم يل نإو هب سبأ لا :لاقف ؟جاعلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about ivory? He replied: There is no problem with it, and I indeed have a comb made of it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using An Ivory Comb
arabicText: .باولبا بهذي هنفإ ،جاعلبا اوطشمت :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Comb with ivory, for it eliminates plague.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using An Ivory Comb
arabicText: نم دودلا درطيو ،سأرلا يف رعشلا تبني جاعلا طشمب حيرستلا :لقا ملاسلا هيلع ركسعلا نسحلا يبأ نع .رومعلاو ةثللا يقنيو ،رارملا ئفطيو ،غامدلا
englishText: It was narrated from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Askari, peace be upon him, who said: Combing with an ivory comb promotes hair growth on the head, expels worms from the brain, extinguishes bile, and cleanses the gums and gingiva.

chapter: Recommendation Of Grooming The Beard, Cheeks, Locks, Eyebrows, And Head
arabicText: .سارضلأا دشي ةيحللا طشمو ءباولبا بهذي سأرلا طشم :ملاسلا هيلع قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said: Combing the head removes the epidemic, and combing the beard strengthens the molars.

chapter: Recommendation Of Grooming The Beard, Cheeks, Locks, Eyebrows, And Head
arabicText: .سارضلأا دشي ةيحللا طشملا :ملاسلا هيلع الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا طمسلا نب نايفس ثيدح يف مدقت دقو
englishText: It was previously mentioned in the hadith of Sufyan bin al-Simt who said: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, said: Combing the beard strengthens the molars.

chapter: Recommendation Of Grooming The Beard, Cheeks, Locks, Eyebrows, And Head
arabicText: حيرستو ،ءباولبا بهذي ةيحللا حيرستو ،سارضلأا دشي نيضراعلا حيرست :ملاسلا هيلع الله دبع وبأ لقا .مغلبلا عطقي سأرلا حيرستو ،ماذجلا نم نامأ نيبجاحلا حيرستو ،ردصلا لبلابب بهذي نيتباؤذلا
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, said: Combing the sideburns strengthens the molars, combing the beard eliminates al-wab'a (widespread illness), combing the two braids [of hair] removes anxieties of the chest, combing the eyebrows protects from leprosy, and combing the head cuts phlegm.

chapter: Dislike Of Combing While Standing
arabicText: .رقفلا ثروي مايق نم طشمتلاو :- ثيدح يف - لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said- in a hadith: Combing hair while standing leads to poverty.

chapter: Dislike Of Combing While Standing
arabicText: .نيدلا هبكر امئقا طشتما نم :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع
englishText: From the Prophet (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever combs their hair while standing will be burdened with debt.

chapter: Dislike Of Combing While Standing
arabicText: تنأو طشتماو ،بلقلا يف فعضلا ثروي هنفإ مايق نم طشتمت لا :لقا ملاسلا هيلع ىسوم نسحلا يبأ نعو .دلجلا خخميو بلقلا يوقي هنفإ سلاج
englishText: Abu Al-Hasan Musa, peace be upon him, said: Do not comb your hair while standing as it causes weakness in the heart, and comb your hair while sitting as it strengthens the heart and nourishes the skin.

chapter: Recommendation Of Running The Comb Over The Chest After Grooming The Head And Beard
arabicText: .باولاو مهلبا بهذي هنفإ كردص لىع طشملا رمفأ كتيحلو كسأر تحرس اذإ :لقا ملاسلا هيلع نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abil-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said: When you comb your head and beard, pass the comb over your chest, for it removes anxiety and plague.

chapter: Recommendation of Combing the Beard Seventy Times Counting One by One, or Forty-Seven Times, and Its Method
arabicText: نيعبرأ ناطيشلا هبرقي مل ةرم ةرم اهدعو ةرم نيعبس هتيحل حرس نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع اموي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever combs his beard seventy times, counting them one by one, Satan will not come near him for forty days.

chapter: Recommendation of Combing the Beard Seventy Times Counting One by One, or Forty-Seven Times, and Its Method
arabicText: طشملا نفإ طشملا :لقا ،" دجسم لك دنع مكتنيز اوذخ " :ىلاعت هلوق يف :ملاسلا هيلع الله دبع وبأ لقا. .مغلبلا عطقيو بلصلا يف ديزيو ،ةجاحلا زجنيو ،رعشلا نسحيو ،قزرلا بلجي
englishText: Abu Abdullah, peace be upon him, regarding the words of the Almighty: "Take your adornment at every mosque" [Quran, 7:31], he said: It refers to the comb, for the comb brings sustenance, beautifies the hair, fulfills needs, strengthens the spine, and removes phlegm.

chapter: Recommendation of Combing the Beard Seventy Times Counting One by One, or Forty-Seven Times, and Its Method
arabicText: :لوقيو ،تارم عبس اهقوف نمو ،ةرم نيعبرأ هتيحل تحت حرسي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناكو :لقا .مغلبلا عطقيو نهذلا يف ديزي هنإ
englishText: He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would comb under his beard forty times and above it seven times, and he would say: It increases intelligence and cuts phlegm.

chapter: Recommendation of Combing the Beard Seventy Times Counting One by One, or Forty-Seven Times, and Its Method
arabicText: .(ردقلا ةليل يف هانلزنأ ناإ) أرقيو ،تحت نم أدبي هنأ يور :لقا (راطخلاا نامأ) يف سواط نب ىسوم نب ليع
englishText: Ali bin Musa bin Tawus in (Aman al-Akhtar) said: It is narrated that one starts from below, and recites [Indeed, We sent the Quran down during the Night of Decree] [Quran, 97:1]. Recommendation of Combing the Beard Seventy Times Counting One by O...

chapter: Recommendation of Combing the Beard Seventy Times Counting One by One, or Forty-Seven Times, and Its Method
arabicText: عبس تحت ىلإ قوف نمو (هانلزنأ ناإ) أرقيو ،ةرم نيعبرأ قوف ىلإ تحت نم هتيحل حرسي هنأ ةياور يفو :لقا .رودصلا ةشحوو مومغلاو مومهلا ينع حرس مهللا :لوقيو (تياداعلاو) أرقيو تارم
englishText: He said: And in a narration that he combs his beard from bottom to top forty times while reciting (Indeed, We have sent it down) [Quran, 97:1], and from top to bottom seven times while reciting (By the galloping horses) [Quran, 100:1], and says: O Allah, remove from me worries, sorrows, and heaviness of the heart.

chapter: Recommendation of Combing the Beard Seventy Times Counting One by One, or Forty-Seven Times, and Its Method
arabicText: اهقوف نمو ،ةرم نيعبرأ هتيحل تحت حرسي (ملاسلا هيلع) ناك :لقا :(قلاخلأا مراكم) يف يسربطلا نسحلا .مغلبلا عطقيو نهذلا يف ديزي هنإ :لوقيو ،تارم عبس
englishText: From Al-Hasan Al-Tabarsi in (Makarim Al-Akhlaq): He said: He (peace be upon him) would comb under his beard forty times and above it seven times, and he would say: It increases intelligence and removes phlegm.

chapter: Recommendation of Burying Hair, Nails, Teeth, Blood, and Placenta
arabicText: نفد :لقا " تااومأو ءايحأ تاافك ضرلأا لعجن ملأ " :لجو زع الله لوق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رفظلاو رعشلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding the words of Allah the Mighty and Majestic: "Have We not made the earth a container of both the living and the dead?" [Quran, 77:25], he said: It means burying the hair and nails.

chapter: Recommendation of Burying Hair, Nails, Teeth, Blood, and Placenta
arabicText: يا :لقا مث ،لله دمحلا :لقا مث ،هفك يف هعضوف هسارضأ نم سرض علقنا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ نإ دمحلا :لقا مث ،هفك لىع هعضوف رخآ اضيأ علقنا مث نيح دعب ثكم مث ،يعم هنفدفا (ينتنفد تنأ اذإ) ،رفعج .يعم هنفدفا تم اذإ رفعج يا لله
englishText: From Ja'far: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) had a molar tooth come out which he placed in his palm, then said: Praise be to Allah. Then he said: O Ja'far, when you bury me, bury it with me. Then after some time another tooth came out and he placed it in his palm, then said: Praise be to Allah. O Ja'far, when I die, bury it with me.

chapter: Recommendation of Burying Hair, Nails, Teeth, Blood, and Placenta
arabicText: يهو اهنم ذخأ اذإ هرعشو هرافظأ لجرلا نفدي :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .ةنس
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: A man should bury his nails and hair when he cuts them, and this is a sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation of Burying Hair, Nails, Teeth, Blood, and Placenta
arabicText: .مدلاو رفظلاو رعشلا نفد ةنسلا نم نأ يورو لقا
englishText: He said it was narrated that it is from the sunnah to bury hair, nails, and blood. Recommendation of Burying Hair, Nails, Teeth, Blood, and Placenta

chapter: Recommendation of Burying Hair, Nails, Teeth, Blood, and Placenta
arabicText: نب الله دبع نع مشاه نب ميهاربإ نع ،دمحأ نب دمحم نع ،ىيحي نب دمحم نع ،هيبأ نع (لاصخلا) يفو ،نسلاو ،رعشلا :ةعبرأ نفدب نارمأ :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع ،ليع نع ،هئباآ نع ،ديز نب نيسحلا .مدلاو ،رفظلاو
englishText: In (Al-Khisal) from his father, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Muhammad bin Ahmad, from Ibrahim bin Hashim, from Abdullah bin Al-Husayn bin Zayd, from his forefathers, from Ali, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said: We were commanded to bury four things: hair, teeth, nails, and blood.

chapter: Recommendation of Burying Hair, Nails, Teeth, Blood, and Placenta
arabicText: ،مدلاو ،رفظلاو ،رعشلا :ناسنلاا نم ءايشأ ةعبس نفدب رميأ ناك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ .ةقلعلاو ،نسلاو ،ةميشملاو ،ضيحلاو
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to command the burial of seven things from humans: hair, nails, blood, menstrual blood, placenta, teeth, and blood clots. Shaykh Hurr Amili: It is previously mentioned in the hadiths about dying that it is not obligatory to bury the hair, and some of the hair of the Prophet (peace be upon him) remains preserved with the Imams (peace be upon them).

chapter: Recommendation of Honoring Hair
arabicText: وأ هتيلاو نسحيلف ارعش ذختا نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هزجيل
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever keeps hair should take good care of it or cut it off.

chapter: Recommendation of Honoring Hair
arabicText: .هومركفأ الله ةوسك نم نسحلا رعشلا :ملاسلا هيلع لقاو
englishText: And he (peace be upon him) said: Beautiful hair is from Allah's clothing, so honor it.

chapter: Permissibility of Cutting Grey Hair, the Dislike of Plucking it, and its Non-prohibition
arabicText: .هفتن نم ىلإ بحأ هزجو ،هفتنو طمشلا زجب سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no harm in cutting or plucking grey hair, though cutting it is more beloved to me than plucking it. Translator: See Hadith 1710 and Shaykh Hurr Amili's comment.

chapter: Permissibility of Cutting Grey Hair, the Dislike of Plucking it, and its Non-prohibition
arabicText: .ةيحللا نم هفتنو طمشلا زجب سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no harm in cutting or plucking grey hair from the beard. Translator: See Hadith 1710 and Shaykh Hurr Amili's comment.

chapter: Permissibility of Cutting Grey Hair, the Dislike of Plucking it, and its Non-prohibition
arabicText: .هفتن هركيو اسبأ بيشلا زجب ىري لا ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) saw no harm in cutting grey hair but disliked plucking it.

chapter: Permissibility of Cutting Grey Hair, the Dislike of Plucking it, and its Non-prohibition
arabicText: .هوفتنت لاف رون بيشلا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Grey hair is light, so do not pluck it.

chapter: Permissibility of Cutting Grey Hair, the Dislike of Plucking it, and its Non-prohibition
arabicText: :ميلأ باذع مهلو مهيلإ رظني لاو ةمايقلا موي الله مهملكي لا ةثلاث :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .هربد يف حوكنملاو ،هسفن حكانلاو ،هبيش فتانلا
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: There are three whom Allah will not speak to on the Day of Resurrection, nor look at them, and they will have a painful punishment: one who plucks his grey hair, one who commits self gratification, and one who is penetrated from behind.

chapter: Permissibility of Cutting Grey Hair, the Dislike of Plucking it, and its Non-prohibition
arabicText: باش نمو ،ملسملل رون هنفإ بيشلا فتني لا :لقا - ةئامعبرلأا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع هدانسإبو .ةمايقلا موي ارون هل تناك ملاسلاا يف هبيش لد ام نإ مث ،روكذملا مكحلا يف اهتحارص مدعل اهدروأ ملو رقاوو رون بيشلا نأ يف ثيداحأ ةدع يورو :لوقأ لىع لومحم ديعولاو ديدهتلا لىع لد امو ةهاركلا توبث يفاني لاف ميرحتلا يفن لىع لومحم فتنلا زاوج لىع .اهرثكأ وأ ةيحللا كلذ باعيتساو بيشلا عيمج فتن
englishText: And by his chain from Ali (peace be upon him)- in the hadith of the four hundred he said: Do not pluck grey hair for it is light for the Muslim, and whoever grows grey in Islam, it will be light for him on the Day of Resurrection. I (Hurr Amili) say: Several hadiths have been narrated stating that grey hair is light and dignity, but I have not included them as they do not explicitly state the mentioned ruling. Then, what indicates the permissibility of plucking is interpreted as negating prohibition, so it does not contradict the establishment of dislike, and what indicates threat and warning is interpreted as referring to plucking all grey hair and encompassing the whole beard or most of it.

chapter: Recommendation of Trimming Nails and the Dislike of Leaving Them
arabicText: مظعلأا ءادلا عنمي رافظلأا ميلقت :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .قزرلا رديو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Trimming nails prevents the greatest disease and increases sustenance.

chapter: Recommendation of Trimming Nails and the Dislike of Leaving Them
arabicText: .نايسنلا نوكي هنمو ،ناطيشلا ليقم اهنلأ رافظلأا اوصق امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Nails are to be cut because they are the resting place of Satan, and from it comes forgetfulness.

chapter: Recommendation of Trimming Nails and the Dislike of Leaving Them
arabicText: تحت نكسي راص نأ مدآ نبا نم ناطيشلا طلسي ام يفخأو رتسأ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ريفاظلأا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, the most concealed and hidden way that Satan gains control over the son of Adam is that he comes to dwell under the nails.

chapter: Recommendation of Trimming Nails and the Dislike of Leaving Them
arabicText: .رافظلأا ميلقت ةنسلا نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Trimming nails is from the Sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation of Trimming Nails and the Dislike of Leaving Them
arabicText: حيولا سبتحا :هل ليقف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لىع حيولا سبتحا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .!؟مكبجاور نوقنت لاو ،مكرافظأ نوملقت لا متنأو سبتحي لا فيكو :لاقف !؟كنع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Revelation was withheld from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and it was said to him: "Has revelation been withheld from you?!" He said: "How could it not be withheld when you neither trim your nails nor clean your finger joints?!"

chapter: Recommendation of Trimming Nails and the Dislike of Leaving Them
arabicText: ناحبس :لاقف ،ةعمجلا موي رافظلأاو براشلا ذخا امنإ :نولوقي انباحصأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلل لقا هنأ .ميالأا رئاس يف تئش نإو ،ةعمجلا موي يف تئش نإ اهذخ ،الله
englishText: He said to Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him): Our companions say that mustaches and nails should only be trimmed on Friday. He said: Glory be to Allah! Trim them on Friday if you wish, or on any other day if you wish.

chapter: Recommendation of Trimming Nails and the Dislike of Leaving Them
arabicText: .تلاط اذإ اهصق :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو :قودصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Saduq said: And he (peace be upon him) said: Cut them when they grow long.

chapter: Recommendation of Trimming Nails and the Dislike of Leaving Them
arabicText: فتنو ،براشلا صقو ،رافظلأا ميلقت :ةرطفلا نم سمخ :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع ،ةريره يبأ نع .ناتتخلااو ،ةناعلا قلحو ،طبلإا
englishText: From Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said: Five things are from natural disposition: trimming nails, trimming mustaches, plucking armpit hair, shaving pubic hair, and circumcision.

chapter: Recommendation of Trimming Nails and the Dislike of Leaving Them
arabicText: .قزرلا رديو ،مظعلأا ءادلا عنمي رافظلأا ميلقتو :لقا - ةأمعبرلأا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع هدانسإبو
englishText: And by his chain from Ali (peace be upon him)- in the hadith of the four hundred he said: And trimming nails prevents the greatest disease and increases sustenance.

chapter: Recommendation For Men To Trim Their Nails And For Women To Leave A Bit Of Theirs
arabicText: :ءاسنللو ،مكريفاظأ اوصق :لاجرلل :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نكل نيزأ هنفإ ،نكرافظأ نم نكرتا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: For men: Cut your nails, and for women: Keep some of your nails (longer), for it is more beautifying for you.

chapter: Dislike of Trimming Nails with Teeth, Pulling the Beard, and Cupping on Wednesday and Friday
arabicText: رافظلأا ميلقت نع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىهن :لقا - يهانملا ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع .ةعمجلاو ءاعبرلأا موي ةماجحلا نع ىهنو ،نانسلأبا
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the hadith of prohibitions- he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade trimming nails with teeth, and he forbade cupping (hijamah) on Wednesday and Friday.

chapter: Dislike of Trimming Nails with Teeth, Pulling the Beard, and Cupping on Wednesday and Friday
arabicText: نم ةثلاث ليع يا :لقا - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع يف ةماجحلا مكح لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ .ةيحللا لكأو ،نانسلأبا رافظلأا ميلقتو ،نيطلا لكأ :ساوسولا .ةراجتلا باتك نم ةماجحلا ثيداحأ يفو جحلا باتك نم ءاعبرلأا موي رفسلا ثيداحأ
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: O Ali, three things are from obsessive-compulsive disorder: eating clay, trimming nails with teeth, and eating (pulling) the beard. Shaykh Hurr Amili: There will be what indicates the ruling on cupping in the hadiths about traveling on Wednesday from the Book of Hajj, and in the hadiths on cupping from the Book of Commerce.

chapter: Recommendation Of Starting With Trimming The Little Finger Of The Left Hand And Ending With The Little Finger Of The Right Hand
englishText: Start with your left little finger and end with the right.

chapter: Recommendation Of Starting With Trimming The Little Finger Of The Left Hand And Ending With The Little Finger Of The Right Hand
arabicText: .نيميلبا متخت مث رسيلأا كرصنخب أدبت متخيو ،ىرسيلا ديلا نم هرصنخب أدبي ةعمجلا موي هرافظأ ملقي نم هنأ يورو :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .ىنميلا ديلا نم هرصنخب
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: And it is narrated that whoever clips their nails on Friday should start with the little finger of the left hand and end with the little f inger of the right hand.

chapter: Recommendation of Removing Armpit Hair for Men and Women Even by Plucking, and the Dislike of Letting it Grow Long
arabicText: .مامحلا يف ةرونلبا هيطبإ ليطي ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ نأ
englishText: It was reported that Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) would remove his armpit hair with depilatory paste in the bath.

chapter: Recommendation of Removing Armpit Hair for Men and Women Even by Plucking, and the Dislike of Letting it Grow Long
arabicText: نفإ ،هيطبإ رعش مكدحأ نلوطي لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هب رتتسي ائبخم هذختي ناطيشلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: None of you should let his armpit hair grow long, for Satan uses it as a hiding place to conceal himself.

chapter: Recommendation of Removing Armpit Hair for Men and Women Even by Plucking, and the Dislike of Letting it Grow Long
arabicText: .نطبلا رعش ةخسن يفو .ىثنلأاو ركذلل طبلإا رعش اوقلحا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقاو :لقا
englishText: He said: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Shave the armpit hair for males and females. And in another version: the belly hair.

chapter: Recommendation of Removing Armpit Hair for Men and Women Even by Plucking, and the Dislike of Letting it Grow Long
arabicText: .(ملاسلا هيلع) بيطلا هب رمأ امم ةنسو روهط وهو ،ةهوركملا ةحئارلا يفني طبلإا فتن (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لقا
englishText: Ali (peace be upon him) said: Plucking the armpit hair eliminates unpleasant odor, and it is purification and a Sunnah from what the Pure One (peace be upon him) commanded.

chapter: Recommendation of Preferring Depilatory Paste for Underarms Over Shaving, and Shaving Over Plucking, and the Dislike of Plucking
arabicText: تربخف :لقا ،ةرونلبا هيطبإ لىطو لىطأ دق (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ ترظنف مامحلا ريصب يبأ عم تلخد :لقا هيلإ يندشرأ هرأ مل ناأو هتيأر دق تنأ :لاقف :ناأ هتيأر دق ،تلقف ،هنع هلأسلأ هيلإ يندشرأ :لاقف ريصب باأ نإ دمحم با يا معن :لاقف ،؟ةرونلبا كيطبإ تيلطو تيلطأ كنأ يدئقا ينربخأ ،كادف تلعج :هل لاقف ،هتدشرفأ .دمحم باأ يا لطأ ،رصبلا فعضي نيطبلإا فتن
englishText: I entered the bathhouse with Abu Basir and saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) applying depilatory paste and applying it to his armpits. He said: So I informed Abu Basir, and he said: Guide me to him so I can ask him about it. I said: I have seen it myself. He said: You have seen it and I have not seen it, guide me to him. He said: So I guided him, and he said to him: May I be sacrificed for you, my guide informed me that you applied depilatory paste and applied it to your armpits? He said: Yes, O Abu Muhammad, indeed plucking the armpits weakens eyesight. Apply depilatory paste, O Abu Muhammad.

chapter: Recommendation of Preferring Depilatory Paste for Underarms Over Shaving, and Shaving Over Plucking, and the Dislike of Plucking
arabicText: .هطبإ ليطي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ناكو ،نيبكنملا فعضي طبلإا فتن :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Plucking armpit hair weakens the shoulders, and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) used to apply depilatory paste to his armpits.

chapter: Recommendation of Preferring Depilatory Paste for Underarms Over Shaving, and Shaving Over Plucking, and the Dislike of Plucking
arabicText: باأ كلذب تربخفأ هطبإ ليطي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تيأرف مامحلا يف ريصب يبأ عم تنك لقا نادعس نع وأ - يهوي طبلإا فتن نإ دمحم با يا :لاقف ؟هقلح وأ ،طبلإا فتن لضفأ اميأ كادف تلعج :هل لاقف ،ريصب .هقلحا ،- فعضي
englishText: From Sa'dan who said: I was with Abu Basir in the bathhouse when I saw Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) applying depilatory paste to his armpit, so I informed Abu Basir about it. He said to him: May I be sacrificed for you, which is better plucking the armpit hair or shaving it? He said: O Abu Muhammad, plucking the armpit hair weakens - or debilitates -, so shave it.

chapter: Recommendation of Preferring Depilatory Paste for Underarms Over Shaving, and Shaving Over Plucking, and the Dislike of Plucking
arabicText: لقاو ،لضفأ هقلح :تلقف ،هقلحو طبلإا فتن يف ةرارز يناحلاف ةنيدملبا انك :لقا ،روفعي يبأ نب الله دبع نع ،هيطبإ لىطأ دق ليطي مامحلا يف وهو انل نذفأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لىع ناذأتسفا لضفأ هفتن :ةرارز ؟هلعفأ نأ يل زوجي لا امل ،اذه لعف هلعل لا :لاقف ؟كيفكي :ةرارزل تلقف :لاقف ،لضفأ هفتن :لقاو ،لضفأ هقلح :تلقف ،هقلحو طبلإا فتن يف ةرارز يناح لا :تلقف ؟متنأ ميف :لاقف .هقلح نم لضفأ هيلطو ،هفتن نم لضفأ هقلح ،ةرارز اهأطخأو ةنسلا تبصأ
englishText: From Abdullah bin Abi Ya'fur who said: We were in Medina when Zurarah disputed with me about plucking versus shaving the armpit. I said shaving is better while Zurarah said plucking is better. We sought permission to see Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) and he permitted us while he was in the bathroom applying depilatory paste, having already applied it to his armpits. I said to Zurarah: Is this sufficient for you? He said: No, perhaps he did this for a reason that I am not allowed to do it? He (Abu Abdullah) asked: What are you discussing? I said: Zurarah disputed with me about plucking versus shaving the armpit. I said shaving is better while he said plucking is better.
