arabicText: نولوقت ام :لاقف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا باحصأ باطخلا نب رمع عمج :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ننااتخلا ىقتلا اذإ :نورجاهملا لقاو .ءاملا نم ءاملا :راصنلأا تلاقف ؟لزني لاو اهطلاخيف هلهأ يتيأ لجرلا يف :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لاقف ؟نسحلا باأ يا لوقت ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل :رمع لاقف ،لسغلا هيلع بجو دقف لاقف لسغلا هيلع بجو دقف ننااتخلا ىقتلا اذإ ؟ءاملا نم اعاص هيلع نوبجوت لاو مجرلاو دحلا هيلع نوبجوتأ .راصنلأا تلقا ام اوعدو نورجاهملا لقا ام لوقلا رمع
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Umar bin Al-Khattab gathered the companions of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: What do you say about a man who comes to his wife and has relations with her but does not ejaculate? The Ansar said: Water is from water. The Muhajiroon said: When the two circumcised parts meet, ghusl becomes obligatory upon him. Umar said to Ali (peace be upon him): What do you say, O Abu Al-Hasan? Ali (peace be upon him) said: Do you make the legal punishment and stoning obligatory upon him but not make a sa' of water obligatory? When the two circumcised parts meet, ghusl becomes obligatory upon him. Then Umar said: The correct opinion is what the Muhajiroon said, and leave what the Ansar said.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Man And Woman After Sexual Intercourse In The Private Part Until The Glans Disappears, Whether Ejaculation Occurs Or Not
arabicText: مل هنلأ ،لسغلا هيلع بجي ملف جرفلا نود اهعماج امنإ رخلآاو (ثيدح يف) :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .نمت مل وأ تنمأ لسغلا اهيلع بجو ةظقيلا يف هلخدأ ناك ولو ،هلخدي
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: (in a hadith) And the other one only had relations outside the private part, so ghusl was not obligatory upon him because he did not insert it, and if he had inserted it while awake, ghusl would have been obligatory upon her whether she discharged or not. Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Man And Woman After Sexual Intercourse In ...

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Man And Woman After Sexual Intercourse In The Private Part Until The Glans Disappears, Whether Ejaculation Occurs Or Not
arabicText: نم اهباصأ نإ :لاقف ؟لسغ اهيلع ينميف ةأرملا جرف لىع هركذ عضي لجرلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .هلخدي نأ لاإ ئش اهيلع سيلو هلسغتلف ئش ءاملا
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A man places his organ on the woman's private part and ejaculates on her, is ghusl required? He said: If any fluid touches her, she should wash it, but nothing is obligatory upon her unless he inserts it.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Man And Woman After Sexual Intercourse In The Private Part Until The Glans Disappears, Whether Ejaculation Occurs Or Not
arabicText: لسغلا بجو هجلوأ اذإ :لاقف ؟ةأرملاو لجرلا لىع لسغلا بجوي ام هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا بحاص .مجرلاو رهملاو
englishText: The companion of Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: I asked him what makes ghusl obligatory upon man and woman? He said: When he penetrates, ghusl, mahr (mahr), and stoning become obligatory.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Man And Woman After Sexual Intercourse In The Private Part Until The Glans Disappears, Whether Ejaculation Occurs Or Not
arabicText: نيح لسغلا امهيلع بجي :لاقف ؟لسغلا ةأرملاو لجرلا لىع بجي ىتم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .امهجرف نلاسغيف ننااتخلا ىقتلا اذإو ،هلخدي لىع هيف ةللاد لا اذه نأ لىع حيرصتلا نم مدقت امل ،ةفشحلا ةبوبيغ نود ام انه نيناتخلا ءاقتلبا دارملا :لوقأ لسغلا امنإ :(ملاسلا مهيلع) مهلوق يف يتلآا رصحلاو ،يتيأو قبس ام يفاني لاف احيرص لسغلا بوجو يفن لسغلا بوجو نإ مث .هريغو خيشلا هلقا ننااتخلا قتلي مل اذإ امب صوصخم يفاضإ رصح ،ربكلأا ءاملا نم ءاش نإ يتيأ امل اهتقو لوخدو اهوحنو فاوطو موصو ةلاص نم هتياغ بوجو لىع فوقوم ةفشحلا ةبوبيغب .ملعأ اللهو ةريثك طورش لىع نفاوقوم مجرلاو رهملا بوجو نأ لىع ،الله
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when does ghusl become obligatory upon the man and woman? He said: Ghusl becomes obligatory upon them when it enters, and when the two circumcised parts meet, they should wash their private parts. I (Hurr Amili) say: The meaning of "meeting of the two circumcised parts" here refers to what is less than the disappearance of the glans, based on what was previously stated explicitly that this does not clearly indicate the negation of the obligation of ghusl, so it does not contradict what came before and what will come after. And the restriction in their saying (peace be upon them): "Indeed ghusl is only from the greater fluid" is a relative restriction specific to when the two circumcised parts do not meet. Then, the obligation of ghusl upon the disappearance of the glans depends on the obligation of its purpose such as prayer, fasting, tawaf and similar acts, and the entry of their prescribed times. Also, the obligation of mahr and stoning depends on many conditions, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: .لزنأ اذإ معن :لقا ؟لسغ هيلع ذخفملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about thighing (*)- is ghusl (ritual washing) required for it? He replied: Yes, if ejaculation occurs. Translator: * Intercrural intercourse, where the male places his penis between the partner's thighs (without actual penetration of the vagina) to achieve sexual gratification.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: هديب اهب ثبعي رشابي نأ ريغ نم ءاملا لزنت ىتح هتيراج جرف سملي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تلأس .لسغلا اهيلعف ةوهش نم تلزنأ اذإ :لقا ؟لزنت ىتح
englishText: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about a man who touches the private part of his slave girl until she discharges fluid without direct contact, playing with her by his hand until she discharges? He said: If she discharges due to desire, then she must perform ghusl (ritual bath).

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: .معن :لقا ؟لسغ اهيلع له ةأرملا لزنتو جرفلا نود اميف ةأرملا عماجي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا تلأس
englishText: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about a man who has intimate relations with his wife without penetration and she experiences discharge, is she required to perform ghusl (ritual bath)? He said: Yes.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: لزنتف ةوهشلا اهيتأتف هرهظ لىع كرحتف هفلخ نم اهجوز قناعت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس .لسغلا اهيلع بجو ءاملا تلزنفأ ةوهشلا اهتءاج ذإ :لقا ؟لسغلا اهيلع بجي لا وأ لسغلا اهيلع ،ءاملا
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a woman who embraces her husband from behind and moves against his back, then she feels desire and releases f luid- is ghusl (ritual bath) obligatory upon her or not? He said: If she experiences desire and releases fluid, then ghusl becomes obligatory upon her. Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Wh...

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: اهيلعف تلزنأ نإ :لقا ؟لجرلا ىري ام مانملا يف ىرت ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لسغلا اهيلع سيلف لزنت مل نإو ،لسغلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a woman who sees in her sleep what a man sees? He replied: If she experiences a discharge then ghusl is obligatory upon her, and if she does not experience a discharge then ghusl is not obligatory upon her.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: لاإ هنم بوثلا باصأ ام لاسغ لاو اءوضو يذملا يف يري لا ليع ناك :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .ربكلأا ءاملا يف
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) say: Ali used to consider that pre-seminal f luid (madhi) does not require ablution or washing, whether it touches the garment, except in the case of the greater discharge (semen).

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: :لقا ،لزنت ىتح اهجرف يف مانملا يف اهعماجي لجرلا نأ ىرت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لستغت
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who dreams that a man is having intercourse with her in her private part until she climaxes, he said: She must perform ghusl (ritual bath).

englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And in another narration: He said: She must perform ghusl (ritual bath), but do not tell them (women) about this, as they might use it as an excuse.

arabicText: نفإ ،تلزنأ اذإ لسغلا اهيلعف تملتحا اذإ ةأرملا نأ يور :لقا (عنقملا) باتك يف نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .ئش اهيلع سيلف لزنت مل
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn narrated in the book (Al-Muqni') that: It has been reported that when a woman has a wet dream, she must perform ghusl (ritual bath) if she ejaculates, but if she does not ejaculate, then nothing is required of her.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: .لسغلا هيفو ينملا نهو ليلحلإا نم نجرخي ثلاث :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Three things come out from the urethra and among them is semen which requires ghusl (ritual bath).

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: .ربكلأا ءاملا يف لاإ لسغلا ئش يف ىري لا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ali (peace be upon him) would not mandate washing except for major ritual impurity.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: لاو ،معن :لقا ؟لسغ اهيلع لجرلا ىري ام اهمانم يف ىرت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ةلع هنذختيف نهوثدحت
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who sees in her sleep what a mansees, is ghusl obligatory upon her? He said: Yes, but do not tell them about it lest they use it as an excuse.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: كرحتف بنج لىع كيتم ناأو ،يفلخ نم ةيراجلا وأ ةأرملا ينمزلت هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع بجو ءاملا تلزنأو ةوهشلا تءاج اذإ معن :لقا ؟لا مأ لسغ اهيلعفأ ،ءاملا لزنتو ةوهشلا اهيتأتف يرهظ لىع .لسغلا اهيلع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman or a young girl who clings to me from behind while I am lying on my side, then she moves on my back until she feels desire and discharges fluid, is she required to perform ghusl (ritual bath) or not? He said: Yes, when she experiences desire and discharges fluid, ghusl becomes obligatory upon her.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation

englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) say: When a woman or a female slave experiences sexual arousal whether the man has intercourse with her or not, whether this occurs during sleep or while awake, she must perform ghusl (ritual bath). chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: هب ثبعي هتيراج وأ هتأرما جرف سم لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) احلاص ادبع لأس هنأ هحلط يبأ نب ىيحي نع .لسغ اهيلع لقا ،لىب :تلق ؟ةوهش نم تلزنأ دق سيلأ :لقا ؟لا مأ لسغ اهيلع ،تلزنأ ىتح
englishText: From Yahya bin Abi Talha that he asked a righteous servant (peace be upon him) about a man who touched the private part of his wife or his slave girl, playing with it until she reached climax, does she have to perform ghusl (full ablution) or not? He said: Did she not reach climax from desire? I said: Yes. He said: She must perform ghusl.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: .معن :لقا ؟لسغ اهيلع ،لزنتف اهمانم يف ىرت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a woman who has a wet dream and experiences discharge, is ghusl (ritual bath) obligatory upon her? He said: Yes.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: يذلا وهف ينملا امفأ ،يذولاو يدولاو يذملاو ينملا ليلحلإا نم جرخي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لسغلا هيفو ،دسجلا هنم رتفيو ،ماظعلا هل خيرتسي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: From the urethra comes out semen (maniy), pre-seminal fluid (madhiy), post-urinal discharge (wadiy), and post-seminal discharge (wadhiy). As for semen, it is that which causes the bones to relax, and makes the body languid, and it necessitates ghusl (ritual bath).

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: اهباصأ نإ :لاقف ؟لسغ اهيلع ،ينميف ةأرملا جرف لىع هركذ عضي لجرلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق اهيلع سيل :لقا ؟هلخدي ملو يه تنمأ نفإ :تلق ،هلخدي نأ لاإ ئش اهيلع سيلف هلسغتلف ئش ءاملا نم .لسغلا
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): If a man places his organ on a woman's private part and ejaculates, must she perform ghusl (ritual bath)? He said: If any fluid touches her, she should wash it, but she is not obligated to do anything unless penetration occurs. I said: What if she reaches climax but there was no penetration? He said: She is not obligated to perform ghusl.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: ؟لسغلا اهجرف يف اهعماجي لجرلا نأ مونلا يف تأر اذإ ةأرملا لىع لعج فيك :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق ؟تنمفأ ةظقيلا يف جرفلا نود اهعماج اذإ لسغلا اهيلع لعجي ملو ملف جرفلا نود اهعماج امنإ رخلآاو لسغلا اهيلع بجوف اهجرف يف اهعماجي لجرلا نأ اهمانم يف تأر اهنلأ :لقا .نمت مل وأ تنمأ ،لسغلا اهيلع بجو ةظقيلا يف هلخدأ ناك ولو ،هلخدي مل هنلأ ،لسغلا اهيلع بجي
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): How is it that ghusl is obligatory upon a woman when she sees in her dream that a man is having intercourse with her in her private part? But ghusl is not obligatory upon her when she has intercourse without penetration while awake and reaches climax? He said: Because she saw in her dream that the man had intercourse with her in her private part, so ghusl became obligatory upon her, while the other one had intercourse with her but not in the private part, so ghusl was not obligatory upon her because he did not penetrate. Had he penetrated while awake, ghusl would have been obligatory upon her, whether she discharged or not.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: .لسغ اهيلع لاو ءوضو كيلع سيل :لاقف ؟كلذ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأسف
englishText: So I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about that? He said: Neither do you need to perform ablution nor does she need to perform ritual bath.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: .لسغ اهيلع سيل :لقا ؟مظعلأا ءاملا قيرهتف مانملا يف ملتحت ةأرملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): About a woman who has a wet dream during sleep and experiences a major discharge (wet dream)? He said: She does not have to perform ghusl (ritual bath).

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: كلذ لىع ربصي وأ ىري نأ ىضري مكيأو لا :لقا ؟لجرلا اهتيأ مل اذإ اهتبانج نم لسغ ةأرملا لىع له :هل تلق تملتحا :لوقتف ؟كلام :لوقيف ،لستغت ةمئقا هتبارق نم ادحأ وأ ،هتجوز وأ ،همأ وأ ،هتخأ وأ هتنبا ىري نأ ملو ،اورهطفا ابنج متنك نإو " :لقا ،مكيلع كلذ الله عضو دقو كلذ نهيلع سيل لا :لقا مث .لعب اهل سيلو .نهل كلذ لقي وأ ،يتيأ امك اينم جراخلا نوك ققحت مدع وأ ،هابتشلاا لىع لمحلا امإ ةسمخلا ثيداحلأا هذه يف هجولا :لوقأ لاقتنبا تسحأ اهنأ لىع وأ ،اضيأ يتيأ امك ائيش دجت مل تهبتنا املف تلزنأ اهنأ مونلا يف تأر اهنأ لىع لمحلا يف رقتسي هنلأ اهجرف نم جرخي املق ةأرملا ينم نفإ ،ئش هنم جرخي ملو رخآ عضوم ىلإ هلحم نع ينملا .ةماعلا ضعبل اهتقفاومل ةيقتلا لىع وأ ،اضيأ يتيأ امل اهمحر يف ةماعلا نم فلاخلا ققحت دقو ،لجرلبا صاخ كلذ نفإ ،نيملسملا عامجإ ربتعملا يف ققحملا ىعدا نإو يرهاظلا للادتسلااو ،ملسم نب دمحم ثيدح يف يزاجملا ليلعتلا نم تيأر ام ةيقتلا ةنيرقو ،ةأرملا مكحلا اذه ءافخإ ةدارإ انه ةلوؤملا ظافللأا قلاطإ يف ةمكحلاو ،كلذ ريغو ةرارز نب ديبع ثيدح يف يعانقلاا لسغلا ليهستل اقيرطو ،جورخلل ةلع هنذختي لائل هيلإ نهجايتحا ملعي ملو ،هنع نلأسي مل اذإ ءاسنلا نع ةبيرلا عقت وأ ،داسفلا ىلإ ايعاد نوكيو اريثك مونلا يف كلذ نيريف ساوسولاو ركفلا يف نعقي وأ ،هوحنو ناز نم ،ةقباسلا تاحيرصتلا نم مهفي امك لاجرلا نم نهل ةمهتلاو ضعب ىلإ هريغو خيشلا راشأ دقو .ملعأ اللهو رابخلاا نود راكنلاا لىع لمحلا لمتحي ثيداحلأا هذه ضعبو .الله ءاش نإ هسفنل لا هريغل لسغلا بوجو لىع لدي ام يتيأو .ةروكذملا هوجولا
englishText: I said to him: Does a woman have to perform ghusl from her janabah if a man has not come to her? He said: No, and which of you would be pleased to see or bear seeing his daughter, sister, mother, wife, or any of his female relatives standing performing ghusl, and he asks her: What is wrong with you? And she replies: I had a wet dream and I have no husband. Then he said: No, this is not required of them and Allah has placed this obligation upon you men, as He says "And if you are in a state of janabah, then purify yourselves" [Quran, 5:6], and He did not say this to women. Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Wh... I (Hurr Amili) say: The explanation for these five hadiths is either: attributing it to confusion, uncertainty about whether the discharge was actual semen, or that she saw in her dream that she discharged but found nothing upon waking, or that she felt the movement of fluid internally but nothing was discharged, as women's fluid rarely exits due to its settling in the womb, or this was said out of taqiyyah (precautionary dissimulation) as it agrees with some opinions of the Aammah (general non-Shia muslims). Although Muhaqqiq claimed consensus of Muslims in Al-Mu'tabar, that consensus specifically pertains to men, and there is known disagreement regarding women. Evidence of taqiyyah appears in the metaphorical reasoning in Muhammad bin Muslim's hadith and the apparent persuasive argument in Ubayd bin Zurarah's hadith. The wisdom in using interpretable terms here is to conceal this ruling from women unless they specifically ask about it or need it, to prevent it being used as an excuse for going out, or as a way to facilitate ghusl after illicit relations, or to prevent them from becoming preoccupied with such thoughts leading to frequent dreams that could invite corruption, or to prevent suspicion from men as understood from previous explicit statements. Some of these hadiths might be interpreted as denial rather than information. And Allah knows best. The Shaykh and others have pointed to some of these aspects, and evidence will come regarding the obligation of ghusl for other reasons, not for this specific reason, insha'Allah.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: ام لثم مانملا يف ىرت ةأرملا نع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تلأس ةأرما نأ (ربتعملا) يف ققحملا ىورو .لجرلا لىع ام اهيلع :لاقف ،معن :تلاقف ؟ةذل دجتأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لاقف ؟لجرلا ىري
englishText: Al-Muhaqqiq reported in (Al-Mu'tabar) that a woman asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) about a woman who sees in her sleep what a man sees? He (peace be upon him and his family) said: Does she find pleasure? She said: Yes. He said: She must do what is required of a man.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl From The Emission Of Semen, Awake Or Asleep, Whether A Man Or A Woman, Through Intercourse Or Otherwise, And The Non-obligation Of Ghusl For Impurity Without Intercourse And Ejaculation
arabicText: لخدو ضخضخ ةنيدملا برق راص املف ةنيدملا ىلإ يبارعأ لبقأ :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نيدباعلا نيز نع متنأ ،بنج تنأو كمامإ يلإ لخدت ييحتست امأ يبارعأ يا :هل لاقف .بنج وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا لىع هدنع نم جرخف ،هل تئج اميف يتجاح تغلب دق :يبارعلاا لاقف ،متضخضخ متولخ اذإ برعلا رشاعم .هبلق يف ناك امع هلأسف هيلإ عجرو لستغفا
englishText: From Zain Al-Abidin (peace be upon him) who said: A Bedouin approached Medina, and when he came near the city, he had sexual intercourse, then he entered upon Al Husayn (peace be upon him) while being in a state of janabah. So he (Al-Husayn) said to him: O Bedouin, are you not ashamed to enter upon your Imam while you are in a state of janabah? You, the community of Arabs, whenever you are alone, you engage in intercourse. The Bedouin said: I have achieved what I came for. So he left his presence, performed the ghusl (of janabah), and returned to him to ask about what was in his heart.

chapter: Considering Semen By Its Ejaculation And The Body's Weakness In Case Of Doubt. If So, Then Ghusl Is Obligatory, Otherwise Not, Unless The Person Is Sick, In Which Case Desire Without Ejaculation Suffices
arabicText: جرخيف اهلبقيو ةأرملا عم بعلي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نع نسحلا نب دمحم مل ئش وه امنإ ناك نإو ،لسغلا هيلعف هجورخل رتفو عفدو ةوهشلا تءاج اذإ :لقا ؟هيلع امف ينملا هنم .سبأ لاف ةوهش لاو ةرتف هل دجي ناسنلاا لىع هتبشا اذإ ينعي :خيشلا لقا .ئشلا هنم جرخيف :لقا هنأ لاإ هوحن هباتك يف رفعج نب ليع هاورو هنلأ ،ةيقتلا لىع هلمح نيعتل هرهاظ هب دارملا ناك ولو :لوقأ .ةوهشلا دوجوب هربتعي هنفإ ينم هنأ دقتعفا نظلا لىع لئاسلا هانب اينم جراخلا نوكب حيرصتلا نإ :ىقتنملا بحاص لقاو .ةماعلا بهاذم رهشلأ قفاوم .مهولل اعفاد ،مكحلل لاصفم باوجلا ءاجف
englishText: Muhammad bin Al-Hasan from Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: I asked him about a man who plays with a woman and kisses her, then semen comes out from him, what is required of him? He said: If desire comes with release and subsides after discharge, then he must perform ghusl (ritual bath). But if it is something where he f inds neither subsiding nor desire, then there is no issue. Ali bin Ja'far narrated similarly in his book except he said: "something comes out from him." The Shaykh said: Meaning if it is unclear to a person and he believes it is semen, then he should consider the presence of desire as the criterion. I (Hurr Amili) say: If the apparent meaning was intended, it would have to be interpreted as taqiyyah (precautionary dissimulation), because it agrees with the most famous schools of the Aammah (general non-Shia muslims). The author of Al-Muntaqa said: The questioner's explicit mention of the discharge being semen was based on assumption, so the answer came detailed in ruling, removing any doubt.

chapter: Considering Semen By Its Ejaculation And The Body's Weakness In Case Of Doubt. If So, Then Ghusl Is Obligatory, Otherwise Not, Unless The Person Is Sick, In Which Case Desire Without Ejaculation Suffices
arabicText: :لقا .لايلق لالب دجو هبتنا املف ملتحا لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا رامع نب ةيواعم نع .لسغلا هيلعف فعضي هنفإ اضيرم نوكي نأ لاإ ئشب سيل
englishText: From Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who had a wet dream, and when he woke up he found a small amount of wetness. He said: It is nothing unless he is sick, for in that case he is weak, then he must perform ghusl (ritual bath).

chapter: Considering Semen By Its Ejaculation And The Body's Weakness In Case Of Doubt. If So, Then Ghusl Is Obligatory, Otherwise Not, Unless The Person Is Sick, In Which Case Desire Without Ejaculation Suffices
arabicText: دجي لاف رظنيف ظقيتسيف ةوهشلا دجيو مانملا يف ىري لجرلا هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ئش لاف اضيرم نكي مل نإو ،لستغيلف اضيرم ناك نإ :لقا ،جرخيف دعب نيوهلا ثكمي مث ،ائيش مل اضيرم ناك نإو ،ةيوق ةقفدب ءاملا ءاج احيحص ناك اذإ لجرلا نلا :لقا ؟(امهنيب قرف امف :تلق) ،هيلع .دعب لاإ جئي ،ميهاربإ نب ليع نع ،هيبأ نع للعلا يف قودصلا هاورو .ةوقب هقفدي :لقا هنأ لاإ .هلثم زيرح نع ينيلكلا هاورو .فعضب لاإ جئي مل هرخآ يف لقاو .ةوهشلا دجيو عماجي هنأ مانملا يف ىري لقا هنأ لاإ .هلثم هيبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who sees a dream and feels desire, then wakes up and looks but finds nothing, then after a while something comes out. He replied: If he is sick, he should perform ghusl (ritual bath), and if he is not sick, then nothing is required of him. I asked: What is the difference between the two cases? He said: Because when a man is healthy, the fluid comes with a strong gush, and when he is sick, it only comes later. Al-Kulayni narrated it from Hareez similarly, except that he said: "it gushes with force." Al-Saduq narrated it in Al-Ilal from his father, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father similarly, except that he said "sees in his dream that he is having intercourse and feels desire." And at the end he said "it only comes with weakness."

chapter: Considering Semen By Its Ejaculation And The Body's Weakness In Case Of Doubt. If So, Then Ghusl Is Obligatory, Otherwise Not, Unless The Person Is Sick, In Which Case Desire Without Ejaculation Suffices
arabicText: :لقا ،ائيش هبوث يف ري ملف :مقا مث ،ةوهشلاو ةذللا دجوف همانم يف ىأر لجر :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق .هيلع ئش لاف احيحص ناك نإو ،لسغلا هيلعف اضيرم ناك نإ :لاقف
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): A man experienced pleasure and desire in his dream, then he woke up and did not find anything on his garment. He [Abu Ja'far] said: If he was ill, then he must perform ghusl (ritual bath), and if he was healthy, then nothing is required of him.

chapter: Considering Semen By Its Ejaculation And The Body's Weakness In Case Of Doubt. If So, Then Ghusl Is Obligatory, Otherwise Not, Unless The Person Is Sick, In Which Case Desire Without Ejaculation Suffices
arabicText: هل سيل افيعض ائيجم ئيجي هنكل قفادلا وه ناك امبر هنفإ ةوهش كتباصفأ اضيرم تنك اذإ :لقا ةرارز نع .هنم لستغفا لايلق لايلق ةعاس دعب ةعاس كضرم ناكمل ،ةوق
englishText: Zurarah narrated: If you are ill and you feel sexual desire, then perhaps it is ejaculation but it comes weakly without force, due to your illness, hour after hour, little by little, so perform ghusl (ritual bath) for it.

chapter: No Obligation For Ghusl Merely Due To A Wet Dream Without Finding Semen Upon Waking Up
arabicText: اذفإ ،ملتحا دق هنأ ىري وهو ،ةوهشلا دجي ىتح مانملا يف ىري لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ناك :لقا .لسغلا هيلع سيل :لقا ،هدسج يف لاو ءاملا هبوث يف ري مل ظقيتسا .لسغ هيلع سيلف ربكلأا ءاملا ىري ملو همانم يف ىأر اذفإ ،ربكلأا ءاملا نم لسغلا امنإ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who experiences pleasure in his dream and believes he had a wet dream, but when he wakes up, he finds no wetness on his clothes or body. He said: He does not have to perform ghusl. He said: Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: Ghusl is only required for the greater discharge (semen), so if he sees something in his dream but does not find the greater discharge, then ghusl is not required of him.

chapter: No Obligation For Ghusl Merely Due To A Wet Dream Without Finding Semen Upon Waking Up
arabicText: ،هيف لىصي :لقا ،ائيش هبري ملف هبوث ىلإ رظن حبصأ املف ملتحا لجر :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق نإ ،لسغ هيلع سيل :لقا ؟هركذ فرط لىع لايلق لالب دجو مقا املف ملتحا هنأ مانملا يف ىأر لجرف :تلق .ربكلأا ءاملا نم لسغلا امنإ :لوقي ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A man had a wet dream, and when he woke up in the morning, he looked at his clothes but did not see anything? He said: He can pray in it. I asked: What about a man who saw in his dream that he had a wet dream, and when he got up he found a little moisture on the tip of his private part? He said: He does not have to perform ghusl. Indeed, Ali (peace be upon him) used to say: Ghusl is only required for the greater discharge.

chapter: No Obligation For Ghusl Merely Due To A Wet Dream Without Finding Semen Upon Waking Up
arabicText: .ربكلأا ءاملا يف لاإ لسغلا ئش يف ىري لا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ali (peace be upon him) did not consider ghusl necessary for anything except for the greater discharge.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Finding Semen On One's Body Or Exclusive Clothing
arabicText: ،ءاملا هذخف لىعو هبوث يف دجوف ملتحا هنأ همون يف ري ملو ماني لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .معن :لقا ؟لسغ هيلع له
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who sleeps and doesn't see in his sleep that he had a wet dream, then finds water on his clothes and thigh, is ghusl obligatory upon him? He said: Yes.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Finding Semen On One's Body Or Exclusive Clothing
arabicText: يف ىأر نكي ملو حبصي ام دعب ينملا هبوث يف ىري لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هتلاص ديعيو هبوث لسغيلو لستغيلف :لقا ؟ملتحا دق هنأ همانم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who sees semen on his clothes after waking up in the morning, but didn't see in his sleep that he had a wet dream? He said: He should perform ghusl, wash his clothes, and repeat his prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Finding Semen On One's Body Or Exclusive Clothing
arabicText: :لقا ؟ملتحا هنأ ملعي ملو اينم هبوثب بيصي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع .أضوتيلو هبوثب دجو ام لسغيل ،ملاتحلاا نقيتي نأ لاإ لسغلا هيلع بجي لا هنفإ هريغ هيف هكراشي يذلا بوثلا لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ هبتناو منا مث لستغا مث لزنأ اذإ امك ،اهنم لستغا دق ةقباس ةبانج نم ينملا نوك زيوجت لىع هلمح نكميو انه دوصقملا لىع لدي ام ضقاونلا يف مدقت دقو ملاتحلاا نقيتي ملو هدجوف
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who finds semen on his clothes but doesn't know that he had a wet dream? He said: He should wash what he found on his clothes and perform wudu. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as referring to clothing shared with others, where ghusl is not obligatory unless one is certain of having a wet dream. It can also be interpreted as allowing for the possibility that the semen is from a previous state of janabah from which he has already performed ghusl, such as if he ejaculated, performed ghusl, then slept and woke to find it without being certain of Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Finding Semen On One's Body Or Exclusive C... having had a wet dream, and what indicates the intended meaning here has already been mentioned in the invalidators.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl Upon Finding Semen On One's Body Or Exclusive Clothing
arabicText: .لسغ هيلع سيل :لقا ،للب وه اذفإ ظقيتسفا ائيش همانم يف ري مل لجر نع هتلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم .اينم هنوك مولعم ريغ للبلا اذه :لوقأ
englishText: Muhammad bin Muslim said: I asked him about a man who didn't see anything in his sleep but woke up to find wetness. He said: Ghusl is not obligatory upon him. Shaykh Hurr Amili:  It is not known if this wetness is semen.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl For Intimacy Without Penetration And Without Ejaculation
arabicText: لزنت ملو لزنأ وه نإ لسغ اهيلعأ جرفلا نود اميف ةأرملا بيصي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس .لسغ هيلع سيلف وه لزني مل نإو ،لسغ اهيلع سيل :لقا ؟يه
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who is intimate with a woman without penetration, is ghusl mandatory upon her if he ejaculates but she does not? He said: Ghusl is not mandatory upon her, and if he does not ejaculate then ghusl is not mandatory upon him.

chapter: Ruling Of Anal Intercourse Without Ejaculation
arabicText: .لسغلا هيف نييتأملا دحأ وه :لقا اهفلخ نم هلهأ يتيأ لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who approaches his wife from behind. He said: It is one of the two approaches that requires ghusl (ritual bath).

chapter: Ruling Of Anal Intercourse Without Ejaculation
arabicText: لسغ لاف لازني ملف اهربد يف ةأرملا لجرلا ىتأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هعفر يقربلا نع .اهيلع لسغ لاو ،لسغلا هيلعف لزنأ نإو ،امهيلع
englishText: Al-Barqi reported, raising it to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said: If a man approaches a woman in her rear (anal intercourse) and neither of them ejaculates, then no obligatory bath is required for either of them. However, if he ejaculates, then he must perform the obligatory bath, but she does not have to.

chapter: Ruling Of Anal Intercourse Without Ejaculation
arabicText: لا :لقا .ةمئاص يهو اهربد يف ةأرملا يتيأ لجرلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ هعفري نييفوكلا ضعب نع .لسغ اهيلع سيلو اهموص ضقني
englishText: From some Kufans, raising it to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding a man who approaches a woman in her rear (anal intercourse) while she is fasting. He said: It does not invalidate her fast, and she is not required to perform ghusl (ritual bath). Shaykh Hurr Amili: Ibn Idris narrated this in "Akhir al-Sarair," citing from the book of Muhammad bin Ali bin Mahbub, similarly. I say: The first scholar interpreted it as taqiyyah (precautionary dissimulation), as far as I know.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl On Women Upon Mere Entry Of Man's Semen In Her Private Part, Or Its Exit, Or Exit Of Semen That Could Be From Him
arabicText: :لقا ،؟ئش هنم جرخف لوبي نأ لبق لستغفا بنجأ لجر نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ام نلا :لقا ؟امهنيب قرفلا امف :تلق .ديعت لا :لقا .لسغلا دعب ئش اهنم جرخي ةأرملفا :تلق .لسغلا ديعي .لجرلا ءام نم وه امنإ ةأرملا نم جرخي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who becomes junub and performs ghusl before urinating, then something comes out of him? He said: He must repeat the ghusl. I said: What about a woman from whom something comes out after ghusl? He said: She does not repeat. I said: What is the difference between them? He said: Because what comes out of the woman is from the man's water.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl On Women Upon Mere Entry Of Man's Semen In Her Private Part, Or Its Exit, Or Exit Of Semen That Could Be From Him
arabicText: .لجرلا ءام ةأرملا نم جرخي ام نلا :لقاو كلذ لثم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،روصنم نع املقو :ابلاغ محرلا يف رقتسي ةأرملا ينم نأ وأ ،لجرلا ينم نم هنوكب مكحي امنإ هابتشلاا عم هنأ دارملا :لوقأ .بلغلأا لىع ءانب لجرلا ءام نم جراخلا نوكب مكحيف جرفلا نم جرخي
englishText: From Mansur, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) similar to that, and he said: Because what comes out of the woman is the man's water. I (Hurr Amili) say: The meaning is that when in doubt, it is ruled to be from the man's semen, or that the woman's semen usually settles in the womb and rarely exits from the private part, so what comes out is ruled to be from the man's water based on what is more common.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl On Women Upon Mere Entry Of Man's Semen In Her Private Part, Or Its Exit, Or Exit Of Semen That Could Be From Him
arabicText: مث ،ةبانجلا نم لستغت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا الله دبع يبأ نب نامحرلا دبع نع .لا :لاقف ؟لسغ اهيلع له كلذ دعب لجرلا ةفطن ىرت
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Abdullah, he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who performs ghusl from janabah, then she sees the man's nutfah after that, is ghusl obligatory upon her? He said: No. Non-Obligation Of Ghusl On Women Upon Mere Entry Of Man's Semen In ...

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Ghusl On Women Upon Mere Entry Of Man's Semen In Her Private Part, Or Its Exit, Or Exit Of Semen That Could Be From Him
arabicText: ةأرملا جرف لىع هركذ عضي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ديزي نب رمع ثيدح مدقت دقو .هلخدي نأ لاإ ،لسغ اهيلع سيلو هلسغتلف ئش ءاملا نم اهباصأ نإ :لقا ؟لسغ اهيلع ينميف
englishText: The previous hadith of Umar bin Yazid has been mentioned where he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who places his organ on a woman's private part and ejaculates, is ghusl obligatory upon her? He said: If any water touches her, she should wash it, and ghusl is not obligatory upon her unless it enters.

chapter: Ghusl For Janabah Being Obligatory Only For Prayer And Similar Acts, Not For Itself
arabicText: لقا ؟لا مأ لستغتف ،لستغملا يف يهو ضيحتف لجرلا اهعماجي ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لستغت لاف ةلاصلا دسفي ام اهءاج دق
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman whom a man has intercourse with, then she menstruates while still in the washing place, should she perform ghusl or not? He said: Something that invalidates prayer has come to her, so she should not perform ghusl.

chapter: Ghusl For Janabah Being Obligatory Only For Prayer And Similar Acts, Not For Itself
arabicText: .روهطب لاإ ةلاص لاو ،ةلاصلاو روهطلا بجو تقولا لخد اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When the time (for prayer) enters, purification and prayer become obligatory, and there is no prayer except with purification.

chapter: Ghusl For Janabah Being Obligatory Only For Prayer And Similar Acts, Not For Itself
arabicText: ام ىلإ امهب شطبي لا نأ نيديلا لىع ضرف الله نإ :لقا - ليوط ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع يف داهجلاو ،محرلا ةلصو ةقدصلا نم امهيلع ضرفو ،لجو زع الله رمأ ام ىلإ امهب شطبي نأو ،الله مرح .تاولصلل روهطلاو ،الله ليبس ،بنجلا مون ثيداحأو ةددعتملا بابسلأا نع دحاولا لسغلا ءازجإ ثيداحأ يف كلذ لىع لدي ام يتيأو :لوقأ هبوجو لىع ةلادلا ثيداحلأا نم رم ام امأو .كلذ ريغو موصلا باتك يفو ،لسغلا يف ةلااوملا ثيداحأو ةلبقا ةماع امإ يه لب ،تقولا لوخد لبق بجاو وأ ،هسفنل بجاو هنبأ حيرصت اهيف سيلف لازنلاا وأ ،عامجلبا ضقاون ثيداحبأ ةضراعملا عم نايبلا ىلإ جاتحت ةلمجم وأ ،دييقتلا لىع ةلومحم ةقلطم وأ ،صيصختلل ةلازإو ءاجنتسلاا بوجو ثيداحأ اذكو ،اهسفنل اهبوجوب نولوقي لا مهو ،لاسغلأا ةيقب ثيداحأو ،ءوضولا ناك امل نكل فاوطلاو ةلاصلاك ،اهب لاإ متي لا امدنع بجت ةراهطلا :ربتعملا يف ققحملا لقا دقو ،تاساجنلا .ىهتنإ طرشلا لىع فاوقوم ببسملا بوجو ناك نإو ،هلوصح دنع بوجولا قلطأ بوجولا ببس ثدحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a long hadith- he said: Indeed Allah has ordained upon the hands that they should not be used for what Allah has forbidden, and that they should be used for what Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has commanded, and He has ordained upon them sadaqah, maintaining family ties, jihad in the way of Allah, and purification for prayers. Ghusl For Janabah Being Obligatory Only For Prayer And Similar Acts... I (Hurr Amili) say: Evidence for this comes in hadiths about one ghusl being sufficient for multiple causes, hadiths about the sleep of one in major impurity, hadiths about continuity in ghusl, and in the Book of Fasting and others. As for the previous hadiths indicating its obligation due to intercourse or ejaculation, they do not explicitly state that it is obligatory for itself, or obligatory before the time enters. Rather, they are either general and subject to specification, or absolute and carried on restriction, or ambiguous requiring clarification, along with contradiction with hadiths about nullifiers of ablution and hadiths about other ritual baths, which they do not consider obligatory for themselves, as well as hadiths about the obligation of istinja and removal of impurities. Al-Muhaqqiq said in Al-Mu'tabar: Purification becomes obligatory when something cannot be complete without it, like prayer and tawaf, but since impurity is the cause of obligation, the obligation is stated upon its occurrence, even though the obligation of the caused is dependent on the condition. End.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). If One Experiences A Wet Dream Or Menstruation In Either Of These Mosques, They Should Perform Tayammum To Exit. It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: دجسملا نم جرخأو ،كدجسم رهط نأ هيبن ىلإ حىوأ الله نإ ليوط ثيدح يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع نكسمو (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ببا لاإ ،ببا كدجسم يف هل ناك نم باوبأ دسب رمو ليللبا هيف دقري نم .بنج هيف نرمي لاو (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) in a long hadith: Allah revealed to His Prophet to purify his mosque, and to remove from the mosque those who sleep in it at night, and to order the closing of all doors of those who had a door to his mosque, except for the door of Ali (peace be upon him) and the dwelling of Fatima (peace be upon her), and that no one in a state of janabah should pass through it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). If One Experiences A Wet Dream Or Menstruation In Either Of These Mosques, They Should Perform Tayammum To Exit. It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: دجسملا لاإ اهلك اهيف رمي نكلو .لا :لقا ؟دجاسملا يف سلجي بنجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لوسرلا دجسمو ،مارحلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a junub sitting in mosques? He said: No. However, he may pass through all of them except the Masjid al-Haram (Sacred Mosque) and the Mosque of the Messenger (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). If One Experiences A Wet Dream Or Menstruation In Either Of These Mosques, They Should Perform Tayammum To Exit. It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: الله لىص) لوسرلا دجسم وأ ،مارحلا دجسم وأ دجسملا يف امئنا لجرلا ناك اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا ،لستغي مث ،هنم جرخي ىتح امميتم لاا دجسملا يف رمي لاو ،مميتيلف ةبانج هتباصفأ ملتحفا (هلآو هيلع .اهيف ناسلجي لاو دجاسملا رئاس يف ارمي نأ سبأ لاو ،كلذك ضيحلا اهباصأ اذإ ضئاحلا كلذكو
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: If a man is sleeping in a mosque, the Sacred Mosque, or the Prophet's Mosque (peace be upon him and his family) and has a wet dream becoming ritually impure, he should perform tayammum (dry ablution) and Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And ... not pass through the mosque except with tayammum until he exits from it, then he should perform ghusl. Similarly for a menstruating woman when menstruation begins. However, there is no harm in them passing through other mosques, though they should not sit in them.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). arabicText: مارحلا دجسملا لاإ اهيف سلجي لاو اهلك دجاسملا يف يشمي نأ بنجلل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لوسرلا دجسمو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A person in a state of janabah may walk through all mosques but may not sit in them, except for the Sacred Mosque (in Makkah) and the Mosque of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) where they cannot even walk through.

arabicText: لاإ هيف رمي نكلو لا :لقا دجسملا يف سلجي بنجلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةنيدملا دجسمو مارحلا دجسملا
englishText: Narrated from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a junub sitting in a mosque. He replied: No, but he may pass through it, except for the Sacred Mosque (in Makkah) and the Prophet's Mosque (in Medina).

arabicText: دجسملا يف امئنا لجرلا ناك اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا ةزمح يبأ نع ،نانس نب الله دبع نع لاإ دجسملا يف رمي لاو ،مميتيلف ةبانج هتباصفأ ملتحفأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لوسرلا دجسم وأ ،مارحلا .دجاسملا نم ئش يف سلجي لاو ،دجاسملا رئاس يف رمي نأ سبأ لاو ،امميتم
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan, from Abu Hamza who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: If a man is sleeping in the Sacred Mosque (Masjid al-Haram) or the Prophet's Mosque and he has a wet dream resulting in janabah (sexual impurity), he should perform tayammum (dry ablution). He should not pass through the mosque except after performing tayammum. However, there is no harm in passing through other mosques, but he should not sit in any mosque.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him): Indeed Allah disliked for my nation (fidgeting) movement during prayer- until he said: - and entering mosques in a state of janabah.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the hadith of prohibitions- he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prohibited that a man sit in the mosque while he is in a state of janabah.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). arabicText: نم مهعابتأو يدلو نم ءايصولأل نهتهركو لاصخ تس يل هرك الله نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقاو .ابنج دجاسملا نايتإ اهنم دعو ،يدعب
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed, Allah has made six traits detestable for me, and I have made them detestable for the trustees from my children and their followers after me, and he counted among them entering mosques while in a state janabah.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). arabicText: لا بنجلاو ضئاحلا :لقا ؟لا مأ دجسملا نلاخدي بنجلاو ضئاحلا :هل انلق :لاقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .اولستغت ىتح ليبس يرباع لاإ ابنج لاو :لوقي ىلاعتو كرابت الله نإ نيزاتجم لاإ دجسملا نلاخدي
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), they said: We asked him: Can the menstruating woman and the junub enter the mosque or not? He said: The menstruating woman and the junub cannot enter the mosque except as passers-by, for indeed Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, says: 'nor when you are in a state of janabah, except those passing through, until you have bathed.' [Quran 4:43]

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). arabicText: لا دجسملا اذه نإ :لاأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .هلآو دمحمل لاإ بنجل لحي
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who narrated that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed, this mosque is not permissible for the junub except for Muhammad and his family. Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And ...

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،هيبأ نع نسحلاو ةمطفاو ليعو ناأ لاإ دجسملا اذه يف بنجي نأ دحلا لحي لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .ينم هنفإ ليهأ نم ناك نمو نيسحلاو
englishText: From his father, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: It is not permissible for anyone to be in a state of janabah in this mosque except for me, Ali, Fatima, Al-Hasan, Al-Husayn, and whoever is from my family, for they are from me.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). If One Experiences A Wet Dream Or Menstruation In Either Of These Mosques, They Should Perform Tayammum To Exit. It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: امهموقل اينبي نأ نوراهو ىسوم رمأ الله نإ سانلا اهيأ :لاقف سانلا بطخ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ ينم ايلع نإو ،هتيرذو نوراه لاإ ءاسنلا هيف برقي لاو ،بنج امه دجسم يف تيبي لا نأ امهرمأو ،تاويب رصمب هتيرذو ليع لاإ بنج هيف تيبي لاو ،يدجسم يف ءاسنلا برقي نأ دحلا لحي لاف ىسوم نم نوراه ةلزنمب .- ماشلا وحن هديب برضو - انهاهف كلذ هءاس نمف
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) delivered a sermon to the people saying: O people! Allah commanded Moses and Aaron to build houses in Egypt for their people, and ordered them that no one in the state of janabah should spend the night in their mosque, and no women should enter it except Aaron and his progeny. And indeed, Ali's position to me is like Aaron's position to Moses, so it is not permissible for anyone to bring women into my mosque or spend the night there in the state of janabah except Ali and his progeny. Whoever is displeased with this, then (go) there - and he pointed with his hand towards Syria. Shaykh Hurr Amili: 'His descendants' here specifically refers to the eleven Imams (peace be upon them), his Ahlul Bayt, and his progeny, as previously mentioned and forthcoming.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). If One Experiences A Wet Dream Or Menstruation In Either Of These Mosques, They Should Perform Tayammum To Exit. It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: هدجسم نكسي لا نأ ىسوم رمأ الله نإ - ثيدح يف - (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع ديسأ نب ةفيذح نع لاو ليهأو خيأ وهو ىسوم نم نوراه ةلزنمب ينم ايلع نإو ،هتيرذو نوراه لاإ بنج هلخدي لاو هيف حكني لاو .- ماشلا وحن ىلإ هديب راشأو - ،انهاهف هءاس نمف هتيرذو ليع لاإ ءاسنلا هيف حكني نأ دحلا لحي
englishText: Hudhaifa bin Asid narrated that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said in a hadith- "Indeed Allah commanded Moses not to dwell in his mosque, nor to marry in it, nor should anyone in state of janabah enter it except Aaron and his descendants. And indeed Ali is to me of the same status as Aaron was to Moses, and he is my brother and my family, and it is not permissible for anyone to marry women in it except Ali and his descendants. So whoever is displeased with this, then (let them go) there" - and he pointed with his hand towards Syria.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). arabicText: نهتهركو لاصخ تس يل هرك الله نإ :لقا هنأ (مهيلع الله تاولص) الله لوسر نع هئباآ نع قداصلا نع .ابنج دجاسملا نايتإ اهنم دعو يدعب نم ءايصولأل
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers, from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon them all) that he said: Indeed Allah has made six characteristics disliked for me, and I have made them disliked for the successors after me, and he counted among them entering mosques while in a state of janabah.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). If One Experiences A Wet Dream Or Menstruation In Either Of These Mosques, They Should Perform Tayammum To Exit. It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: ةمئلأل اهتهركف يل الله اههرك ةتس :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نيب كحضلاو ،موصلا يف ثفرلاو ،ةقدصلا دعب نملاو ،ةلاصلا يف ثبعلا :مهعابتلا ةمئلأا اههركتلو يتيرذ نم نايتإ يف ميرحتلا ىنعمب مهعابتأ ىلإ ةبسنلبا ةهاركلا :لوقأ .ابنج دجاسملا نايتإو ،رودلا يف علطتلاو ،روبقلا .يتيأو ىضم امل ثبللا مدعب ةصوصخم وأ ،ابنج دجاسملا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There are six things that Allah made disliked for me, so I made them disliked for the Imams from my progeny, and the Imams should make them disliked for their followers: Fidgeting during prayer, reminding others of sadaqah after giving it, obscene speech while fasting, laughing among graves, peeping into houses, and entering mosques while in a state of janabah. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The dislike in relation to their followers means prohibition regarding entering mosques while in a state of janabah, or it is specific to not staying, based on what has passed and what will come.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). arabicText: ،هيف نادعقي لاو نيزاتجم دجسملا نلاخديو - ضئاحلاو بنجلا ثيدح يف - :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا .نيمرحلا نيدجسملا نبارقي لاو
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said- in a hadith about the junub and menstruating person- they may pass through the mosque but may not sit in it, and they may not approach the two sacred mosques (in Makkah and Medina).

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). If One Experiences A Wet Dream Or Menstruation In Either Of These Mosques, They Should Perform Tayammum To Exit. It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: لاو ،أضوتي :لاقف ؟دجسملا يف ماني بنجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا مساقلا نب دمحم نع .هيف رميو دجسملا يف ماني نأ سبأ ،ءوضولبا بنجلل دجاسملا ناطيتسا نوحيبتسي ةماعلا نم ةعامج نفإ ةيقتلا لىع لومحم امإ اذه :لوقأ لاإ ائيش الله مرح ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لوق نم .يتيأ امل ةرورضلا لىع وأ ،ءوضو ريغب هزوجي مهضعبو نم يتيأ امك ،رادلا يف ةلاصلل دعملا تيبلا دجسملا نم دارملا نأ لىع وأ هيلإ رطضا نمل هلحأ دقو .ملعأ اللهو ىنعملا اذه يف هلامعتسا
englishText: From Muhammad bin al-Qasim who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a junub sleeping in the mosque? He said: He should perform wudu, and there is no harm in him sleeping in the mosque and passing through it. Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And ... I (Hurr Amili) say: This is either interpreted as taqiyyah (precautionary dissimulation) because a group of the general public permit staying in mosques for the junub person with ablution, and some permit it without ablution; or it applies to cases of necessity, as comes in the saying of Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him): "Allah has not forbidden anything except that He has permitted it for whoever is compelled to it"; or that what is meant by 'mosque' here is a room designated for prayer within a house, as this usage of the term will be explained later, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). If One Experiences A Wet Dream Or Menstruation In Either Of These Mosques, They Should Perform Tayammum To Exit. It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: لاإ ابنج لاو " :ىلاعت هلوق يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع (نايبلا عمجم) يف يسربطلا نسحلا نب لضفلا .نيزاتجم لاإ بنج متنأو دجاسملا نم ةلاصلا عضاوم اوبرقت لا هانعم نأ " ليبس يرباع
englishText: Al-Fadhl bin Al-Hasan Al-Tabarsi in (Majma' Al-Bayan) from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding the words of the Almighty: "nor when you are in a state of ritual impurity, except those passing through a way" [Quran, 4:43], that its meaning is do not approach places of prayer in mosques while you are in a state of janabah except when passing through.

chapter: Permissibility Of Passing Through Mosques For Those In Janabah And Menstruation Except Al-Masjid Al-Haram And The Prophet's Mosque (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family). If One Experiences A Wet Dream Or Menstruation In Either Of These Mosques, They Should Perform Tayammum To Exit. It Is Not Permissible For Them To Stay In Any Mosque, And Ejaculation And Intercourse Are Forbidden In All Mosques
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع هريسفت يف (ملاسلا هيلع) يركسعلا ليع نب نسحلا دجسملا اذه يف تيبي نأ رخلآا مويلاو للهبا نمؤي دحلا يغبني لا :لقا هنأ - باوبلأا دس ثيدح يف - (هلآو .مهدلاوأ نم نوبيطلا ،مهلآ نم نوبجتنملاو ،نيسحلاو نسحلاو ةمطفاو ليعو دمحم لاإ ابنج
englishText: Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari (peace be upon him) in his exegesis, narrating from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from the Prophet (peace be upon him)- in the hadith of closing the doors- said: It is not befitting for anyone who believes in Allah and the Last Day to spend the night in this mosque in a state of janabah except Muhammad, Ali, Fatima, Al-Hasan, Al-Husain, and the chosen ones from their progeny, the pure ones from their children.

chapter: Dislike Of A Junub Entering The Houses Of The Prophet (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them)
arabicText: لا نحنو بنج وهو ققاز نم اجراخ ريصب وبأ انقحلف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لزنم ديرن ةنيدملا نم انجرخ ملعت امأ دمحم باأ يا :لاقف ، ريصب يبأ يلإ هسأر عفرف لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لىع انلخد ىتح ملعن .انلخدو ريصب وبأ عجرف :لقا !؟ءايبنلأا تويب لخدي نأ بنجل يغبني لا هنأ
englishText: We left Medina intending to go to Abu Abdullah's (peace be upon him) house. Abu Basir joined us coming from an alley while he was in a state of janabah, and we didn't know until we entered upon Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him). He raised his head towards Abu Basir and said: "O Abu Muhammad, don't you know that it's not appropriate for a junub to enter the houses of the Prophets?" So Abu Basir left and we entered.

chapter: Dislike Of A Junub Entering The Houses Of The Prophet (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them)
arabicText: انباحصأ تيقلف مامحلا ىلإ تجرخ مث اهنم تبصفأ يل ةيريوج يعم تناكو ةنيدملا تلخد :لقا ريصب يبأ نع تيشمف هيلإ لوخدلا ينتوفيو ينوقبسي نأ تفخف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ نوهجوتم مهو ةعيشلا امأ ريصب باأ يا :لقا مث يلإ رظن (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ يدي نيب تلثم املف ،رادلا تلخد ىتح مهعم تيقل ينإ الله لوسر نب يا :هل تلقف تييحتسفا !؟بنجلا اهلخدي لا ءايبنلأا دلاوأو ءايبنلأا تويب نأ تملع .تجرخو ،اهلثم ىلإ دوعأ نلو ،مهعم لوخدلا ينتوفي نأ تيشخف انباحصأ
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I entered Medina and I had a young female servant with me. I had relations with her, then went to the public bath. I met our Shia companions who were heading to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him). I feared they would go ahead of me and I would miss entering upon him, so I walked with them until I entered the house. When I stood before Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he looked at me and said: O Abu Basir, don't you know that the houses of prophets and children of prophets should not be entered by one who is in janabah? I became embarrassed and said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah, I met our companions and feared I would miss entering with them. I will never do this again, and I left. chapter: Dislike Of A Junub Entering The Houses Of The Prophet (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them)
arabicText: يناطعأ لثم ةماملإا ةللاد نم ينيطعي نأ ديرأ ناأو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لىع تلخد :لقا ريصب يبأ نع لخدت ،لغش هيف تنك اميف كلذ ناك ام دمحم با يا :لاقف ابنج تنكو تلخد املف ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ با يا :لقاو .يبلق نئمطيل نكلو لىب :تلق ؟نمؤت مل وأ :لقا ،ادمع لاإ هتلمع ام :تلقف ،بنج تنأو لىع .مامإ هنإ :كلذ دنع تلقو يسلجم ىلإ ترصو تلستغاو تمقف ،لستغفا مق دمحم
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I entered upon Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) wanting him to give me from the evidence of Imamate like Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) had given me. When I entered, I was in a state of janabah, so he said: O Abu Muhammad, what preoccupied you to enter upon me while you are a junub? I said: I did it deliberately. He said: Do you not believe? I said: Yes, but so that my heart may be at ease. He said: O Abu Muhammad, get up and perform ghusl. So I got up, performed ghusl, and returned to my sitting place, and at that point I said: Indeed he is an Imam.

chapter: Dislike Of A Junub Entering The Houses Of The Prophet (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them)
arabicText: امأ :هل لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا لىع لخد ايبارعأ نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع نع ،رباج نعو !؟بنج تنأو كمامإ لىع لخدت يبارعأ يا ييحتست
englishText: From Jabir, from Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) that a Bedouin entered upon Al-Husayn (peace be upon him), so he said to him: Are you not ashamed O Bedouin that you enter upon your Imam while you are in a state of janabah?!

chapter: Dislike Of A Junub Entering The Houses Of The Prophet (Peace Be Upon Him And His Family) And The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them)
arabicText: هيلع انلخدف ىضمف كعبتأ ناأ :لقا .كلاوم ديرأ :تلق ؟ديرت نيأ :لاقف يدارملا ريصب باأ تيقل :لقا ريكب نع :لقاو ،كبضغو الله بضغ نم للهبا ذوعأ :لاقف !؟بنج تنأو ءايبنلأا تويب لخدت اذكه :لقاو هيلإ رظنلا دحأو .دوعأ لاو الله رفغتسا
englishText: From Bukayr who said: I met Abu Basir Al-Muradi and he said: Where are you going? I said: I want to see your master. He said: I will follow you. So we went and entered upon him, and he sharpened his gaze at him and said: Is this how you enter the houses of the prophets while you are in a state of janabah? He said: I seek refuge in Allah from the anger of Allah and your anger, and he said: I seek forgiveness from Allah and I will not do it again.

chapter: Prohibition Of Junub And Menstruating Women Placing Items In The Mosque And The Permissibility Of Taking Items From It
arabicText: معن :لقا ؟هيف نوكي عاتملا دجسملا نم نلاوانتي ضئاحلاو بنجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ائيش دجسملا يف ناعضي لا نكلو
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the junub and menstruating woman taking items from the mosque that are in it? He said: Yes, but they should not place anything in the mosque.

chapter: Prohibition Of Junub And Menstruating Women Placing Items In The Mosque And The Permissibility Of Taking Items From It
arabicText: ناذخيأو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - نيزاتجم لاإ دجسملا نلاخدي لا بنجلاو ضئاحلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع لا امهنلأ :لقا ؟هيف ناعضي لاو هنم ناذخيأ امهلبا امف هل تلق :ةرارز لقا ،ائيش هيف ناعضي لاو دجسملا نم .هريغ يف امهديب ام عضو لىع ناردقيو ،هنم لاإ هيف ام ذخأ لىع ناردقي
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The menstruating woman and the junub should not enter the mosque except passing through- until he said:- and they may take (*) from the mosque but not place anything in it. Zurarah said: I asked him, why can they take from it but not place anything in it? He said: Because they cannot take what is in it except from inside it, while they can place what is in their hands elsewhere. Translator: * A mosque can be used for safekeeping of personal items so it is allowed to take them anytime.

chapter: Prohibition Of Junub And Menstruating Women Placing Items In The Mosque And The Permissibility Of Taking Items From It
arabicText: ؟هنم ناذخيأ لاو هيف ناعضي امهلبا ام :تلقف .هنم ناذخيأ لاو ئشلا هيف ناعضي :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع .لاخدي ىتح هيف ام ذخأ لىع ناردقي لاو ،لوخد ريغ نم هيف ئشلا عضو لىع ناردقي امهنلأ :لاقف
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him): They may place things in it but not take from it. So I asked: Why can they place in it but not take from it? He said: Because they can place things in it without entering, but they cannot take what is inside until they enter. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Some of the companions have acted according to this content and interpreted what preceded as disliked, but the first opinion is more famous and reliable. It is possible to specify it with placing without entering, and what indicates this will come in the hadiths about menstruation, God willing

chapter: Ruling On A Junub Touching Something Bearing Allah's Name, White Dirhams (Silver Coins), And Touching Quranic Writing And Other Parts Of The Mushaf
arabicText: .الله مسا هيلع ارانيد لاو امهرد بنجلا سمي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A person in the state of janabah should not touch a dirham or dinar that has Allah's name on it.

chapter: Ruling On A Junub Touching Something Bearing Allah's Name, White Dirhams (Silver Coins), And Touching Quranic Writing And Other Parts Of The Mushaf
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لقا ؟ضيبلا مهاردلا امهيديأ ناسمي ثماطلاو بنجلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a person in the state of janabah and a menstruating woman touching white dirhams (silver coins) with their hands? He said: There is no problem. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The sheikh meant that if the dirhams do not have the name of Allah on them, as previously mentioned."

chapter: Ruling On A Junub Touching Something Bearing Allah's Name, White Dirhams (Silver Coins), And Touching Quranic Writing And Other Parts Of The Mushaf
arabicText: اللهو ينإ يإ :لاقف ؟بنج وهو ضيبلأا مهاردلا لجرلا سمي له هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .بنجل ينإو هذخفا مهردلبا يتولا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him whether a man can touch white dirhams (silver coins) while he is in a state of janabah? He said: Yes, by Allah, I am brought a dirham and I take it while I am in a junub.

chapter: Ruling On A Junub Touching Something Bearing Allah's Name, White Dirhams (Silver Coins), And Touching Quranic Writing And Other Parts Of The Mushaf
arabicText: بنجلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع عيبرلا يبأ نع ،دلاخ نع ،بوبحم نسحلا باتكو :ققحملا لقا .كلذ تلعف امبر هب سبأ لا :لقا ؟هلوسر مساو الله مسا اهيفو مهاردلا سمي دقو ،ةرورضلا لىع لمحلا لمتحيو ،هلوسر مساو الله مسا هدي بيصت لا ثيحب سملا نوك لمتحي :لوقأ باوبأ يف مدقت دقو .طوحأ لولأاو ،ةيهاركلا لىع رامع ثيدح لمحو ،زاوجلا لىع باحصلأا ضعب هلمح .بابلا نومضم ةيقب لىع لدي ام ءوضولا
englishText: Al Muhaqqiq said: And the book of Al-Hasan Mahboub, from Khalid, from Abu Al Rabee', from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a person in the state of janabah touching dirhams that have Allah's name and His Messenger's name on them? He said: There is no problem with it, I sometimes do that. I (Hurr Amili) say: It is possible that the touching is in a way that the hand does not touch Allah's name and His Messenger's name, and it is possible to interpret it as necessity, and some companions have interpreted it as permissible, and interpreted Ammar's hadith as disliked, and the first interpretation is more precautionary. And what has preceded in the chapters of ablution indicates the remaining content of the

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: .اضيأ بنجلاو ءاسفنلاو نآرقلا ضئاحلا أرقت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The menstruating woman, the post-partum bleeding woman, and the junub can recite the Quran.

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: ركذيو ،أرقيو برشيو لكيأ معن :لقا نآرقلا أرقيو برشيو لكيأ بنجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ءاش ام لجو زع الله
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the junub eating, drinking, and reciting the Quran. He said: Yes, he can eat, drink, recite, and remember Allah the Mighty and Majestic as he wishes.

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: عم شارفلا يف ابنج ناك نم ليع يا :لقا هنأ - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف .امهقرحتف ءامسلا نم رنا امهيلع لزنت نأ ىشخأ ينفا نآرقلا أرقي لاف هتأرما
englishText: In the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: O Ali, whoever is in a state of janabah while in bed with his wife should not recite the Quran, for I fear that fire from the sky might descend upon them and burn them. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Narrated in "Al-Amali and Al-Ilal." Al-Saduq said: This refers to reading the invocations, not others. I say: It is also possible that this was abrogated.

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: :لقا ؟ائيش نارقلا نم نآءرقي له بنجلاو ضئاحلا :هل تلق :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .لاح لك لىع الله نا ركذيو ةدجسلا لاا الله ءاش ام معن
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- I said to him: Can the menstruating woman and the junub recite anything from the Quran? He said: Yes, whatever Allah wills except the prostration verses, and they can remember Allah in all conditions.

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: .نآرقلا بنجلاو ضئاحلا ولتت نأ سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: There is no problem for the menstruating woman and the junub to recite the Quran.

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: :لاقف ؟نآرقلا طوغتي لجرلاو بنجلاو ضئاحلاو ءاسفنلا أرقتأ هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اوؤاش ام نؤرقي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I asked him: Can the post-partum bleeding woman, the menstruating woman, the junub, and the man defecating recite the Quran? He said: They can recite whatever they wish.

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: بوثلا ءارو نم فحصملا ناحتفي ضئاحلاو بنجلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .ةدجسلا لاإ اءاش ام نآرقلا نم نآرقيو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The junub and the menstruating woman can open the Quran from behind a cloth and recite whatever they wish from it except the prostration verses.

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: .نآرقلا نم تءاش ام أرقت ضئاحلا لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The menstruating woman can recite whatever she wishes from the Quran.

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: ؟نآرقلا أرقي له بنجلا نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع ،ىسيع نب نامثع نع ،ديعس نب نيسحلا نع هدانسباو .تياآ عبس نيبو هنيب ام :لقا
englishText: And by his chain from Al-Husayn bin Sa'eed, from Uthman bin Isa, from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about the junub, can he recite the Quran? He said: Up to seven verses. Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post-partum B...

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: .ةيآ نيعبس :لقا ةعامس نع ،ةعرز ةياور يفو :لقا
englishText: He said: And in the narration of Zur'a, from Sama'ah he said: Seventy verses. Shaykh Hurr Amili: A group of companions have interpreted this as dislike in what exceeds, and what preceded as negating prohibition, and it is susceptible to taqiyya due to the strictness of the Al A'amah (Ahl al Sunna) in this matter, hence there is doubt in the dislike."

chapter: chapter.  Permissibility For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Post partum Bleeding Woman To Recite The Quran Except For The Four Obligatory Prostration Verses, And The Dislike Of Reciting More Than Seven Verses For The Junub, And Its Emphasis On More Than Seventy Verses
arabicText: لاإ نآرقلا نم اءاش ام اءرقي نأ ضئاحلاو بنجلل زوجي :لقا (ربتعملا) يف ققحملا ديعس نب نسحلا نب رفعج .ةدجسلا محو ،ةدجسلا ليزنتو ،مجنلاو ،كبر مسبا ءرقأ :يهو عبرلأا مئازعلا روس
englishText: Ja'far bin Al-Hasan bin Sa'eed Al-Muhaqqiq said in (Al-Mu'tabar): It is permissible for the junub and the menstruating woman to recite whatever they wish from the Quran except the Suwar Al Azaaim Al Arba'a (four chapters of obligatory prostration), which are: Iqra' bismi rabbik (96), Al-Najm (53), Tanzil Al-Sajda (32), and Ha Mim Al-Sajda Shaykh Hurr Amili: Narrated by al-Bazanti in his compilation, from al-Muthanna, from Hasan al-Sayqal, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him). I say: And it comes in the reading of the Quran outside of prayer the command to read the Quran in every state."

chapter: Dislike Of Eating And Drinking For The Junub Except After Ablution Or Rinsing The Mouth And Washing The Face And Hands
arabicText: لكأو ههجو لسغو ضمضمتو هدي لسغ برشيو لكيأ نأ دارأ اذإ بنجلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .برشو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: When the junub wants to eat and drink, he should wash his hands, rinse his mouth, wash his face, and then eat and drink.

chapter: Dislike Of Eating And Drinking For The Junub Except After Ablution Or Rinsing The Mouth And Washing The Face And Hands
arabicText: هنفإ ضمضمتيو هيدي لسغي ىتح ائيش بنجلا قوذي لا :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .حضولا هنم فاخي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: The junub should not taste anything until he washes his hands and rinses his mouth, for vitiligo is feared from it.

chapter: Dislike Of Eating And Drinking For The Junub Except After Ablution Or Rinsing The Mouth And Washing The Face And Hands
arabicText: .برشيو لكيأ بنجلا نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ريكب نبا ثيدح يف قبس دقو
englishText: And it has preceded in the hadith of Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that the junub may eat and drink.

chapter: Dislike Of Eating And Drinking For The Junub Except After Ablution Or Rinsing The Mouth And Washing The Face And Hands
arabicText: .أضوتي ىتح برشي ملو لكيأ مل ابنج لجرلا ناك اذإ :لقا ،(ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah from his father (peace be upon them both), he said: When a man is junub, he should not eat or drink until he performs ablution.

chapter: Dislike Of Eating And Drinking For The Junub Except After Ablution Or Rinsing The Mouth And Washing The Face And Hands
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىهن :لقا - يهانملا ثيدح يف (ملاسلا هيلع) بلاط يبأ نب ليع نينمؤملا ريمأ نع .رقفلا ثروي هنإ :لقاو ةبانجلا لىع لكلاا نع (هلآو
englishText: From Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) in the hadith of prohibitions- he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) Dislike Of Eating And Drinking For The Junub Except After Ablution ... forbade eating while in the state of janabah and said: It causes poverty.

chapter: Dislike Of Eating And Drinking For The Junub Except After Ablution Or Rinsing The Mouth And Washing The Face And Hands
arabicText: .رقفلا ثروي ةبانجلا لىع لكلاا نأ يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that eating while in the state of janabah causes poverty.

chapter: Dislike Of Eating And Drinking For The Junub Except After Ablution Or Rinsing The Mouth And Washing The Face And Hands
