arabicText: نأ لبق بنجلا لكيأأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا - ثيدح يف - الله دبع يبأ نب نامحرلا دبع نع .لضفأ ءوضولفا هدي لسغيل نكلو ،لسكنل ناإ :لقا ؟أضوتي
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman ibn Abu Abdullah- in a hadith- he said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Should the junub eat before performing ablution? He said: We sometimes feel lazy, but he should wash his hands, though ablution is better.

chapter: Dislike Of Applying Oil For The Junub Before Ghusl
arabicText: .لا :لقا ؟لستغي مث نهدي بنجلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Can one in the state of janabah apply oil then perform ghusl? He said: No.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: .ةرونلبا ليطيو ،بضتخملا بنجيو ،بنجلا بضتخي نبأ سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) who said: There is no problem with a junub applying dye, or becoming ritually impure while having dye on, or applying depilatory paste.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: .لاف باضخلا لوأ يف امفأ ،باضخلا ذخيأ ىتح بنجي لا بضتخملا نأ اضيأ يورو :ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: It is also narrated that one who has dyed their hair should not become in a state of janabah until the dye takes effect, but this does not apply at the beginning of dyeing.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: .بضتخم وهو بنجيو لجرلا بضتخي نأ سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no harm if a man dyes his hair and becomes in a state of janabah while having the dye on.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: وهو بنجيف :تلق ،لا :لقا ؟بنج وهو لجرلا بضتخيأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ يبلأ تلق :لقا ديعس يبأ نع تبضتخا اذإ :لقا لىب :تلق ؟هلعفت ئش لىع كلدأ لاأ ديعس با يا :لقا مث لايلق ثكم مث ،لا :لقا ؟بضتخم .عماجف ذئنيحف غلبو هذخأم ءانحلا ذخأو ءانحلبا
englishText: From Abu Sa'id who said: I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him): Can a man apply hair dye while in a state of janabah? He said: No. I asked: Can he become a junub while having dye on? He said: No. Then he waited a little and said: O Abu Sa'id, shall I guide you to what you should do? I said: Yes. He said: When you apply henna dye and the henna has taken effect and reached its full color, then at that time you may have intimate relations.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: .بضتخم وهو لستغي لاو ،بنج وهو لجرلا بضتخي لا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: A man should not apply hair dye while he is in a state of janabah, nor should he perform ghusl while he has hair dye applied.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لقا ؟نابضتخيأ ضئاحلاو بنجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا تلأس
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): I asked the righteous servant (peace be upon him) about whether one who is in a state of janabah or a menstruating woman can apply henna? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: ؟بنج وهو بضتخي لجرلا :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا نع ،ارغملا يبأ نع ،ةلاضف نع ،هنعو .سبأ هب سيل :لقا ؟ضئاح يهو بضتخت ةأرملا نعو .سبأ لا :لقا
englishText: From him, from Fadalah, from Abi Al-Maghra, from Al-Abd Al-Salih (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a man applying dye while in a state of janabah? He said: There is no harm in it. And about a woman applying dye while menstruating? He said: There is no harm in it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: وأ بضتخي بنجلا نع هلأسي (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ ىلإ بتك هباأ نأ سنوي نب دمحم نب رفعج نع .كلذ هل بحأ لا بتكف ؟بضتخم وهو بنجي
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad bin Yunus that his father wrote to Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) asking him about one who is in a state of janabah applying henna, or one who becomes in a state of janabah while having henna applied? He wrote: I do not like that for him.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: اهيلعو بنجت لاو ،بنجلا لاو ،ضئاحلا بضتخت لا :لوقي هتعمس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .بنج وهو بضتخي لاو باضخ هيلعو وه بنجي لاو ،باضخ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I heard him say: A menstruating woman should not apply henna, nor should one in a state of janabah, and a woman should not enter a state of janabah while having henna on her, and a man should not enter a state of janabah while having henna on him, nor should he apply henna while in a state of janabah. Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating W...

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: وأ بنج وهو بضتخا نم :لقاو ،بنج وهو لجرلا بضتخي نأ هركي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نب ليع نع .ءوسب ناطيشلا هبيصي نأ هيلع نمؤي مل هباضخ يف بنجأ
englishText: From Ali bin Musa (peace be upon him) who said: It is disliked for a man to dye his hair while in a state of janabah, and he said: Whoever dyes his hair while in a state of janabah or becomes a junub while his hair is dyed, it is not guaranteed that Satan will not afflict him with harm.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: نفإ ،ثماطلا لاو ،بضتخم تنأو بنجت لاو ،بنج تنأو بضتخت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نعو .ءاسفنلل هب سبأ لاو ،كلذ دنع اهرضحي ناطيشلا
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said: Do not apply henna while you are in a state of janabah, and do not enter a state of janabah while having henna applied, and the menstruating woman should not apply it, for the devil is present at that time, and there is no harm in it for the post-partum woman.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: .ضئاحلا بضتخت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نعو
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) who said: A menstruating woman should not apply dye.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For The Junub, Menstruating Woman, And Postpartum Woman, And Becoming Ritually Impure While Having Dye, With Dislike Except For Postpartum Women Unless The Dye Has Set And Reached Its Full Effect
arabicText: .ءاسفنلا بضتخت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نعو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A postpartum woman may apply dye.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Junub Person Using Depilatory, Getting Cupped, Slaughtering, And Mentioning Allah The Mighty And Majestic
arabicText: .بنج وهو لجرلا مجتحي نأ سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no harm in a man getting cupping done while he is in a state of janabah.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Junub Person Using Depilatory, Getting Cupped, Slaughtering, And Mentioning Allah The Mighty And Majestic
arabicText: .حبذيو ،مجتحيو ،بنجلا رونتي نأ سبأ لاو :لقا - ثيدح - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no harm if a person in the state of janabah uses the depilatory paste, gets cupping (hijamah) done, and slaughters animals.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Junub Person Using Depilatory, Getting Cupped, Slaughtering, And Mentioning Allah The Mighty And Majestic
arabicText: ةرونلا ،اءادتبا يلإ بتكف :لقا ؟بنج وهو لجرلا رونتي هلأسأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ ىلإ بتكأ نأ تدرأ .ةبضتخم ةأرما عماجت لاو ،ابضتخم لجرلا عماجي لا نكلو ،ةفاظن بنجلا ديزت
englishText: Ali bin Mahziyar from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): I wanted to write to Abu al Hasan (peace be upon him) asking him if a man in a state of janabah can use depilatory paste? He wrote to me first: Using depilatory paste increases cleanliness for the one in janabah, but a man should not have intercourse while using henna dye, nor should he have intercourse with a woman who is using henna dye. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And what precedes proves the permissibility of using noorah and mentioning Allah by one who is junub in the hadiths about reading the Quran, in the rulings of seclusion, and what will come proves the ruling on slaughtering also in its place, God willing."

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth And Nose Before Ghusl, And That They Are Not Obligatory, And That Washing Internal Parts Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: لىع كنيميب غرفت مث ،كيفك لسغتف أدبت :لاقف .ةبانجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .كدسج لسغت مث ،قشنتساو ضمضمت مث ،كجرف لسغتف كلامش
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the ghusl al-janabah. He said: You begin by washing your palms, then pour water with your right hand over your left and wash your private parts, then rinse your mouth and nose, then wash your body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth And Nose Before Ghusl, And That They Are Not Obligatory, And That Washing Internal Parts Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: لخدت مث ،كيفك لسغتف ءاملا كيدي لىع بصت :لاقف ،ةبانجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس ضيفتو كهجو لسغتو تارم ثلاث كسأر لىع ءاملا بصتو قشنتستو ضمضمت مث ،كجرف لسغتف كدي .ءاملا كدسج لىع
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about ghusl al-janabah. He said: Pour water on your hands and wash your palms, then insert your hand and wash your private parts, then rinse your mouth and nose, and pour water on your head three times and wash your face and pour water over your body.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth And Nose Before Ghusl, And That They Are Not Obligatory, And That Washing Internal Parts Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: لوسر نس امم قاشنتسلااو ةضمضملا :لقا ،ملاسلا هيلع الله دبع يبأ نع ،نانس نب الله دبع نع .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said: Rinsing the mouth and nose (during ghusl al-janabah) are from what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) established as sunnah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth And Nose Before Ghusl, And That They Are Not Obligatory, And That Washing Internal Parts Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: .ةداعإ كيلع نكي مل امهتيسن نفإ ةنسلا نم امه :لاقف .امهنع هتلأس
englishText: I asked him about these two (rinsing mouth and nose). He said: They are from the Sunnah, so if you forget them, you don't need to repeat (the ghusl).

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth And Nose Before Ghusl, And That They Are Not Obligatory, And That Washing Internal Parts Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: .نلائاس امهنلأ مفلاو فنلاا بنجي لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا لقا نانس نب الله دبع نع
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan who said Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The nose and mouth do not become ritually impure because they are flowing (parts).

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth And Nose Before Ghusl, And That They Are Not Obligatory, And That Washing Internal Parts Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: بنجي امنإ لا :لقا ؟قشنتسيو ضمضمتي بنجلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا هباحصأ ضعب نع .رهاظلا
englishText: From some of his companions who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Should the junub rinse his mouth and nose? He said: No, only the external parts become impure.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth And Nose Before Ghusl, And That They Are Not Obligatory, And That Washing Internal Parts Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: مفلاو ،نطابلا بنجي لاو ،رهاظلا بنجي امنإ .لا :لاقف ؟ضمضمتي بنجلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .نطابلا نم
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Should the junub rinse his mouth? He said: No. Only the external parts become impure, and the internal parts do not become impure, and the mouth is from the internal parts.

chapter: Recommendation Of Rinsing The Mouth And Nose Before Ghusl, And That They Are Not Obligatory, And That Washing Internal Parts Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: ضمضمتت نأ تئش نإ :ةبانجلا لسغ يف لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نأ رخآ ثيدح يف يورو :لقا .نطب ام لىع لا رهظ ام لىع لسغلا نلا بجاوب سيلو ،لعففا قشنتستو
englishText: It is narrated in another hadith that Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said regarding ghusl al-janabah: If you wish to rinse your mouth and nose, then do so, but it is not obligatory because the washing is required for what is external, not what is internal.

chapter: Dislike Of Sleeping In The State Of Janabah Except After Performing Ablution, Bath, Dry Ablution, Or Intending To Return To Intimacy, And The Non-Prohibition Of Sleep For The Junub, Whether Man Or Woman, Without Bath, Ablution, Or Dry Ablution
arabicText: .أضوتي ىتح كلذ هركي :لاقف ؟بنج وهو ماني نأ هل يغبنيأ لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about whether it is appropriate for a man to sleep while in a state of janabah. He said: That is disliked until he performs ablution.

chapter: Dislike Of Sleeping In The State Of Janabah Except After Performing Ablution, Bath, Dry Ablution, Or Intending To Return To Intimacy, And The Non-Prohibition Of Sleep For The Junub, Whether Man Or Woman, Without Bath, Ablution, Or Dry Ablution
arabicText: .دوعأ نأ ديرأ ينأ كلذو ،حبصأ ىتح كلذ لىع مناأ ناأ :رخآ ثيدح يفو :لقا
englishText: He said in another hadith: I sleep in that state until morning, and that is because I intend to return (to intimacy).

chapter: Dislike Of Sleeping In The State Of Janabah Except After Performing Ablution, Bath, Dry Ablution, Or Intending To Return To Intimacy, And The Non-Prohibition Of Sleep For The Junub, Whether Man Or Woman, Without Bath, Ablution, Or Dry Ablution
arabicText: لاو بنج وهو ملسملا ماني لا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع ،هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع .ديعصلبا مميتيلف ءاملا دجي مل نفإ ،روهط لىع لاإ ماني
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his father, from his forefathers, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon them), he said: A Muslim should not sleep while in a state of janabah, and should not sleep except in a state of ritual purity. If he cannot find water, then he should perform tayammum with clean earth.

chapter: Dislike Of Sleeping In The State Of Janabah Except After Performing Ablution, Bath, Dry Ablution, Or Intending To Return To Intimacy, And The Non-Prohibition Of Sleep For The Junub, Whether Man Or Woman, Without Bath, Ablution, Or Dry Ablution
arabicText: يف سفن لاا ىفوتي الله نإ :لقا ؟كلذ لىع مانيأ ،هلهأ عقاوي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لستغيلف غرف اذإ ،ةيلبلا نم هقرطي ام يردي لاو ،اهمانم
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who has intercourse with his wife, can he sleep in that state? He said: Indeed Allah takes the souls at the time of their death [Quran, 39:42], and one does not know what affliction might befall him, so when he finishes he should perform ghusl.

chapter: Dislike Of Sleeping In The State Of Janabah Except After Performing Ablution, Bath, Dry Ablution, Or Intending To Return To Intimacy, And The Non-Prohibition Of Sleep For The Junub, Whether Man Or Woman, Without Bath, Ablution, Or Dry Ablution
arabicText: .بنج يهو ةأرملا مانتو ،بنج وهو لجرلا ماني :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: A man can sleep while in a state of janabah, and a woman can sleep while in a state of janabah.

chapter: Dislike Of Sleeping In The State Of Janabah Except After Performing Ablution, Bath, Dry Ablution, Or Intending To Return To Intimacy, And The Non-Prohibition Of Sleep For The Junub, Whether Man Or Woman, Without Bath, Ablution, Or Dry Ablution
arabicText: نم لضفأو ،(يلإ بحأ) لسغلاو ،لعفيلف أضوتي نأ بحأ نإ :لقا ؟مونلا ديري مث بنجي بنجلا نع هتلأس .الله ءاش نإ ئش هيلع سيلف لستغي ملو أضوتي ملو منا وه نإو ،كلذ
englishText: I asked him about one who is in a state of janabah and wants to sleep? He said: If he wishes to perform ablution then he may do so, and bathing is (more beloved to me) and better than that. And if he sleeps without performing ablution or bathing, then there is no blame upon him if Allah wills.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: لسغت مث ،امهلسغتف كيفكب أدبت :لاقف ؟ةبانجلا لسغ نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع .رهط دقف ءاملا هيلع ىرج امف ،نيترم كدسج رئاس لىع بصت مث ،ثالاث كسأر لىع بصت مث ،كجرف
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them) who said: I asked him about ghusl al janabah? He said: Start with your palms and wash them, then wash your private parts, then pour water on your head thrice, then pour water on the rest of your body twice, and whatever the water flows over has been purified.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: هجرفب ءدب مث ،ءاملا يف اهسمغ ئش هفك باصأ نكي مل نإ :لاقف ؟بنجلا لستغي فيك :تلق :لقا ةرارز نع رسيلأا هبكنم لىعو ،نيترم نميلأا هبكنم لىع بص مث ،فكأ ثلاث هسأر لىع بص مث ،فرغ ثلاثب هاقنفأ .هأزجأ دقف ءاملا هيلع ىرج امف نيترم
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I asked: How does the one in state of janabah perform ghusl? He said: If nothing has touched his palms, he immerses them in water, then starts with his private parts and cleans it with three handfuls, then pours three palms-full on his head, then pours twice on his right shoulder, and twice on his left shoulder, and whatever the water flows over is sufficient.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: .فرغ ثلاثب :هلوق طقسأ هنأ لاإ بوقعي نب دمحم نع ،هدانسإب خيشلا هاورو
englishText: And Al-Shaykh narrated it through his chain from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub except that he omitted the phrase "with three handfuls."

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: .كلذ نم لقأ هيزجي لا ثالاث ءاملا هسأر لىع بنجلا ضيفي لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The one in state of janabah pours water on his head three times, less than that is not sufficient.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: كلامش لىع كنيميب غرفت مث ،كيفك لسغتف أدبت :لاقف ،ةبانجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس هلبق سيل ،كيمدق ىلإ كنرق ندل نم كدسج لسغت مث ،قشنتساو ضمضمت مث ،كقفارمو كجرف لسغتف ةدحاو ةسامترا ءاملا يف سمترا ابنج لاجر نأ ولو ،هتيقنأ دقف ءاملا هتسسمأ ئش لكو ،ءوضو هدعب لاو .هدسج كلدي مل نإو كلذ هأزجأ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about ghusl al-janabah, so he said: Begin by washing your palms, then pour with your right hand over your left and wash your private parts and elbows, then rinse your mouth and nose, then wash your body from the top of your head to your feet, there is no wudu before it or after it, and everything the water touches has been cleaned, and if a person in state of janabah immerses himself in water once, that suffices even if he doesn't rub his body.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: نم ىنميلا كدي لسغت :لاقف ؟ةبانجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا باأ تلأس كباصأ ام لسغا مث ،ءنالاا يف كدي لخدت مث لوبلا لىع تردق نإ لوبتو ،كعباصأ ىلإ (قفرملا) نيقفرملا .هيف ءوضو لاو كدسجو كسأر لىع ضفأ مث ،هنم
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about ghusl al-janabah? He said: Wash your right hand from the elbow to your fingers, and urinate if you can, then put your hand in the vessel, then wash what was affected by it, then pour over your head and body and there is no wudu in it.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: مث ،اهلسغفا ءاملا نم ينميلا كفك لىع ضفأ :لاقف ؟ةبانجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لستغفا كدسجو كسأر لىع ضفأو كجرف لسغا مث ،ىذأ نم كدسج باصأ ام لسغا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about ghusl al-janabah? He said: Pour water on your right palm and wash it, then wash whatever impurity affected your body, then wash your private parts and pour over your head and body and perform ghusl.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: نود امهلسغيلو هيفك لىع غرفيلف لسغلا دارفأ ةبانج لجرلا باصأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع برضي مث ،هيفك ءلم تارم ثلاث هسأر لىع بصيل مث ،هجرف لسغي مث ،هئناإ يف هدي لخدي مث ،قفرملا دعب هئناإ يف هئام نم حضتنا امف ،هلك هدسج لىع ءاملا ضيفي مث ،هيفتك نيب فكو ،هردص لىع ءام نم فكب .سبأ لاف تفصو ام عنص ام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a man becomes junub and wants to perform ghusl, let him pour water on his palms and wash them below the Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion... elbows, then put his hand in his vessel, then wash his private parts, then pour on his head three times palm-full, then strike with a palm of water on his chest, and a palm between his shoulders, then pour water over his entire body, and whatever water splashes back into his vessel after doing what I described, there is no problem.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: لخدت مث ،كيفك لسغتف ءاملا كيدي لىع بصت :لاقف ؟ةبانجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس ضيفتو كهجو لسغتو ،تارم ثلاث كسأر لىع ءاملا بصتو قشنتستو ضمضمتت مث ،كجرف لسغتف كدي .ءاملا كدسج لىع
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about ghusl al-janabah? He said: Pour water on your hands and wash your palms, then insert your hand and wash your private parts, then rinse your mouth and nose and pour water on your head three times, and wash your face and pour water over your body.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: رطملا يف موقي نأ ةبانجلا لسغ نم هيزجي له بنجي لجرلا نع هلأس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم هيخأ نع .كلذ هأزجأ ءاملبا هلاستغا هلسغي ناك نإ :لاقف ؟كلذ ىوس ام لىع ردقي وهو ،هدسجو هسأر لسغي ىتح
englishText: From his brother Musa (peace be upon him) that he asked him about a man who becomes junub- is it sufficient for ghusl al-janabah to stand in the rain until it washes his head and body, while he has access to other means? He said: If it washes him like his normal washing with water, it suffices.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: نم تلنا ام لىع هدي رميو قشنتسيو ضمضمتي نأ هل يغبني هنأ لاإ دازو ،هلثم هباتك يف رفعج نب ليع هاورو هيلع وأ كلذ هيزجيأ رطملا هبيصيف ءاملا ليع ردقي لاو ةبانجلا هبيصت لجرلا نع هتلأسو :لقا ،هدسج .مميت لاإو هأزجأ هلسغ نإ :لاقف ؟مميتلا
englishText: And Ali ibn Ja'far narrated similarly in his book, and added: except that he should rinse his mouth and nose and pass his hand over what the water reaches of his body. He said: And I asked him about a man who becomes junub and cannot find water, then rain falls on him- does this suffice or must he perform tayammum? He said: If it washes him it suffices, otherwise he should perform tayammum.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: .هلسغ نم كلذ هأزجأ ةدحاو ةسامترا ءاملا يف بنجلا سمترا اذإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When the one in state of janabah immerses himself in water once, that suffices for his ghusl.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: هيزجي جرخيو ةدحاو ةسامترا ءاملا يف سمتريف بنجي لجرلا :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .معن :لقا ؟هلسغ نم كلذ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said to him: A man becomes junub then immerses himself in water once and comes out- does that suffice for his ghusl? He said: Yes.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: نم كلذ هيزجيأ ،هدسج لىع لاس ىتح رطملا يف ماقف ةبانج هتباصأ لجر يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .معن :لقا ؟لسغلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who became junub then stood in the rain until it flowed over his body, does that suffice for ghusl? He said: Yes.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: هأزجأ ةدحاو ةسامتغا ءاملا يف بنجلا سمتغا اذإ لوقي هعمس نم ينثدح :لقا يبلحلا ليع نب الله ديبع نع .هلسغ نم كلذ
englishText: From Ubaydullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi who said: Someone who heard him told me that when the one in state of janabah submerges in water once, that suffices for his ghusl.

chapter: Method Of Performing Ghusl Of Janabah Sequentially And By Immersion, And Some Of Its Rulings
arabicText: اهلخدت مث ،كعباصأ ىلإ قفرملا نم ىنميلا كدي لسغت :ةبانجلا لسغ يف لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .كدسج رئاسو كسأر لىع ضفأ مث ،كنم باصأ ام لسغا مث ،ءنالاا يف
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said regarding ghusl al-janabah: Wash your right hand from the elbow to your fingers, then insert it in the vessel, then wash what was affected of you, then pour water over your head and the rest of your body.

chapter: Ruling On Washing The Feet After Ghusl
arabicText: يف تنك نفإ :لقا - ةبانجلا لسغ ةيفيك ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ميكح نب مكح نع .كيلجر لسغفا فيظنب سيل ناكم يف تنك نإو ،كيلجر لسغت لا نأ كرضي لاف فيظن ناكم
englishText: From Hakam bin Hakeem, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith about how to perform ghusl for janabah- he said: If you are in a clean place, it does not harm you if you do not wash your feet, and if you are in a place that is not clean, then wash your feet.

chapter: Ruling On Washing The Feet After Ghusl
arabicText: لعن لىعو هيف لابي يذلا فينكلا يف كلذ ريغو ةبانجلا نم لستغأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ تلأس كيمدق لفسأ بيصي كدسج نم ليسي يذلا ءاملا ناك نإ :لاقف ؟(يه امك لعنلا ليعو لستغفأ) ةيدنس .كيمدق لسغت لاف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Can I perform ghusl for janabah and other purposes in a lavatory where urination takes place while wearing Sindhi sandals (performing ghusl while keeping the sandals on)? He said: If the water flowing from your body reaches the bottom of your feet, then do not wash your feet.

chapter: Ruling On Washing The Feet After Ghusl
arabicText: ناك نإ :لاقف ؟لسغلا دعب هيلجر لسغيأ ةبانجلا نم لستغي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس هلاجر عقنتسي ناكم يف لستغي ناك نإو امهلسغي لا نأ هيلع لاف هيلجر لىع ءاملا ليسي ناكم يف لستغي .امهلسغيلف ءاملا يف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man performing ghusl for janabah, should he wash his feet after the ghusl? He said: If he performs ghusl in a place where water flows over his feet, then there is no need to wash them, but if he performs ghusl in a place where his feet are immersed in water, then he should wash them.

chapter: Obligation Of Sequence In Ghusl Without Immersion, And The Obligation Of Repeating When Done Incorrectly
arabicText: مل هسأر لسغي نأ هلادب مث ،هسأر لسغي ملف ةبانج نم لستغا نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لسغلا ةداعإ نم ادب دجي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever performs ghusl from janabah and does not wash his head, then later decides to wash his head, must repeat the entire ghusl.

chapter: Obligation Of Sequence In Ghusl Without Immersion, And The Obligation Of Repeating When Done Incorrectly
arabicText: ثلاث هسأر لىع بص مث ،فرغ ثلاثب هاقنفأ هجرفب أدب مث :لقا - ةبانجلا لسغ ةيفيك ثيدح يف - ةرارز نع .نيترم رسيلأا هبكنم لىعو ،نيترم نميلأا هبكنم لىع بص مث ،فكأ
englishText: From Zurarah- in a hadith about how to perform ghusl janabah- he said: Then he began with his private parts and cleaned it with three handfuls of water, then poured three palms of water over his head, then poured twice over his right shoulder, and twice over his left shoulder.

chapter: Obligation Of Sequence In Ghusl Without Immersion, And The Obligation Of Repeating When Done Incorrectly
arabicText: مل هسأر لسغي نأ هلادب مث ،هسأر لسغي ملو ةبانج نم لستغا نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لسغلا ةداعإ نم ادب دجي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever performs ghusl from janabah and does not wash his head, then later decides to wash his head, must repeat the entire ghusl. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What precedes this indicates it in the hadiths about the method of bathing and some hadiths about the sequence of ablution, and what will come will indicate this, and in the washing of the deceased, hadiths indicate that it is similar, and other explicit hadiths about the obligation of sequence in washing the deceased and prioritizing the right side over the left, and precaution dictates it, and the companions acted upon it. Obligation Of Sequence In Ghusl Without Immersion, And The Obligati...

chapter: Obligation Of Sequence In Ghusl Without Immersion, And The Obligation Of Repeating When Done Incorrectly
arabicText: اهرمفأ هل ةيراج نم باصفأ ليعامسإ مأ هعمو ةنيدملاو ةكم نيب اميف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ناك مأ كلذب تملعف كلذ تلعفف ،كسأر ليسغفا يبكرت نأ تدرأ اذإ :اهل لقاو ،اهسأر تكرتو اهدسج تلسغف مأ هل تلاقف ناكملا كلذ ىلإ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ىهتنا لبقا نم ناك املف ،اهسأر تقلحف ليعامسإ .لوأ ماع كجح هيف الله طبحأ يذلا عضوملا اذه :اهل لقا ؟اذه عضوم يأ :ليعامسإ اذه يوار ملاس نب ماشه نلا ،سكعلبا هاورف هيلع هبتشاو هيف يوارلا مهو دق ثيدحلا اذه :خيشلا لقا مهولا نم تملس ول ةيقتلا لىع ةياورلا هذه لمح نكميو ،هتياور يتأتس :لوقأ .هنيعب هانلق ام ىور ثيدحلا نم فاوخ اهندب لىع بصت لا نأ اهرمفأ ندبلا لسغ يف فاك سأرلا نع لصفنملا ءاملا نأ لىع وأ ،روكذملا ةلازإو فيظنتلل ندبلا لسغب رملآاو ،نيتعقاو يف كلذ نوكيو ،دسجلا لىع ديلا رارمبا يفتكتو ،اهيلع اهتلاوم .اهوحنو تاساجنلا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was between Makkah and Madinah and with him was UmmIsma'il. He had relations with one of his slave girls and ordered her to wash her body but leave her head, telling her: "When you want to ride, wash your head." She did that, and Umm Isma'il learned of this and shaved her head. The following year, when Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) reached that place, Umm Isma'il asked him: "What place is this?" He said to her: "This is the place where Allah nullified your hajj last year." The Shaykh said: The narrator erred in this hadith and confused it, narrating it in reverse, because Hisham ibn Salim, the narrator of this hadith, narrated what we mentioned exactly. I (Hurr Amili) say: His narration will come later, and this narration can be interpreted as taqiyyah if it is free from the mentioned error, or that the water separated from the head is sufficient for washing the body, so he ordered her not to pour water on her body fearing her mistress, and to suffice with passing the hand over the body, and this could be in two instances, and the order to wash the body was for cleaning and removing impurities and the like.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Immediate Succession Between Body Parts During Ghusl, Permissibility Of Delays Between Them, Obligation Of Repeating It If Minor Or Major Impurity Occurs During It, Permissibility Of Asking Others To Bring Water For Ghusl, And Permissibility Of Performing Ghusl Or Part Of It Before Prayer Time
arabicText: ليعامسإ مأ هذه هندأ :لاقف ،هيلع تأطبفأ ةأرما ملكي وهو هطاطسف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لىع تلخد ءاملا يلإ اوعض :تلقف مارحلاا تدرأ تنك ،لوأ ماع اهجح هيف الله طبحأ يذلا ناكملا اذه نأ معزأ ناأو تءاج ،اهنم تبصفأ اهتففختسفا هتعضوف ءاملبا ةيراجلا تبهذف ،ابخلا يف لاو كدسج ليسغفا مارحلاا تدرأ اذفإ ،كتلاوم هب ملعت لا اديدش احسم هيحسماو كسأر ليسغا :تلقف اذفإ اهسأر اهتلاوم تسمف ائيش لوانتت تبهذف اهتلاوم طاطسف تلخدف ،كتلاوم بيرتستف كسأر ليسغت .كجح هيف الله طبحأ يذلا ناكملا اذه :اهل تلقف .اهتبرضو اهسأر تقلحف ءاملا ةجوزل
englishText: I entered Abu Abdullah's (peace be upon him) tent while he was talking to a woman, and I waited for him. He said: Come closer, this is Umm Isma'il who came while I claim this is the place where Allah nullified her Hajj last year. I wanted to enter ihram and said: Put the water for me in the tent. The maid went with the water and put it, then I took advantage of her and had relations with her. I told her: Wash your head and wipe it firmly without your mistress knowing, and when you want to enter ihram, wash your body but don't wash your head so your mistress won't be suspicious. Then she entered her mistress's tent and went to reach for something, and her mistress touched her head and felt the wetness of water, so she shaved her head and beat her. I told her: This is the place where Allah nullified your Hajj.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Immediate Succession Between Body Parts During Ghusl, Permissibility Of Delays Between Them, Obligation Of Repeating It If Minor Or Major Impurity Occurs During It, Permissibility Of Asking Others To Bring Water For Ghusl, And Permissibility Of Performing Ghusl Or Part Of It Before Prayer Time
arabicText: ؟هيلي يذلا لسغأ نأ لبق لولأا فج نفا :تلق :لقا .فجي ءوضولا يف زيرح نع ،ةريغملا نب الله دبع نع مث ،سأرلبا أدباو ةلزنملا كلتب وه :لقا ؟ةبانجلا لسغ كلذكو :تلق ،يقب ام لسغا ،فجي ملوأ فج :لقا .معن :لقا ؟موي ضعب ناك نإو :تلق .كدسج رئاس لىع ضفأ
englishText: From Abdullah bin Al-Mughirah, from Hareez regarding drying of wudu. He said: I asked: What if the first part dries before I wash the next part? He said: Whether it Non-Obligation Of Immediate Succession Between Body Parts During Gh... dries or not, wash what remains. I asked: Is it the same for ghusl janabah? He said: It is of the same status, and start with the head, then pour water over the rest of your body. I asked: Even if it's part of a day? He said: Yes.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Immediate Succession Between Body Parts During Ghusl, Permissibility Of Delays Between Them, Obligation Of Repeating It If Minor Or Major Impurity Occurs During It, Permissibility Of Asking Others To Bring Water For Ghusl, And Permissibility Of Performing Ghusl Or Part Of It Before Prayer Time
arabicText: لسغيو ةودغ هسأر بنجلا لسغي نأ اسبأ ري مل (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةلاصلا دنع هدسج رئاس
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ali (peace be upon him) saw no problem in the person in state of janabah washing his head in the morning and washing the rest of his body at prayer time.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Immediate Succession Between Body Parts During Ghusl, Permissibility Of Delays Between Them, Obligation Of Repeating It If Minor Or Major Impurity Occurs During It, Permissibility Of Asking Others To Bring Water For Ghusl, And Permissibility Of Performing Ghusl Or Part Of It Before Prayer Time
arabicText: كدسج لسغ رخؤتو ،كسأرو كجرفو كدي لسغت لسغلا ضيعبتب سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع امدعب ينم وأ ،حير وأ ،طئاغ وأ ،لوب نم ثادح تثدحأ نفا ،كلذ تدرأ اذإ كدسج لسغت مث ةلاصلا تقو ىلإ .هلوأ نم لسغلا دعفأ كدسج لسغت نأ لبق نم كسأر تلسغ
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: There is no problem in dividing the ghusl: wash your hand, private parts, and head, and delay washing your body until prayer time, then wash your body when you want. But if you experience a minor impurity from urine, feces, wind, or semen after washing your head but before washing your body, then repeat the ghusl from the beginning. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What was previously mentioned about performing wudu before the prayer time indicates the permissibility of performing ghusl early as well, as do the hadiths about the sleep of the junub and others.

chapter: Permissibility Of Remaining Traces Of Perfume, Khaloq, Saffron, Gum, And Similar Substances On The Body At The Time Of Ghusl
arabicText: كلع لثم دكللا ئشلاو بيطلاو قولخلا هسأرو هدسج بيصيف بنجي لجرلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلل تلق :لقا ؟هريغو بيطلاو قولخلا رثأ نم هدسج يف يقب دق ائيش دجو غرف اذفإ لستغيف ههبشأ امو برظلاو مورلا .سبأ لا
englishText: I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him): A man becomes junub while his body and head have khaloq, perfume, and sticky substances like Roman gum, dharab, and similar things, then he performs ghusl, but after finishing he finds some traces of khaloq, perfume, and other things remaining on his body? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Permissibility Of Remaining Traces Of Perfume, Khaloq, Saffron, Gum, And Similar Substances On The Body At The Time Of Ghusl
arabicText: نلستغا اذإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ءاسن نك :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،دمحمنب رفعج نع ءاملا نببصي نأ نهرمأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ كلذو ،نهداسجأ لىع بيطلا ةرفص نيقبي ةبانجلا نم .نهداسجأ لىع ابص
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), he said: The wives of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) would leave the yellow traces of perfume on their bodies when they performed ghusl from janabah, and that was because the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) ordered them to pour water over their bodies.

chapter: Permissibility Of Remaining Traces Of Perfume, Khaloq, Saffron, Gum, And Similar Substances On The Body At The Time Of Ghusl
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لقا ،ءاملا هب بهذي مل نارفعزلا اهدسج لىعو لستغت ضئاحلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a menstruating woman who performs ghusl while having saffron on her body that the water did not remove, he said: There is no problem.

chapter: Sufficiency Of The Basic Amount In Ghusl Even If Like Oil, And The Recommendation Of Ghusl With A Sa'a
arabicText: .عاص نم هل دبلاف هدحو لسغلبا درفنا نمو (ثيدح يف) :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: (in a hadith) And whoever performs ghusl alone must use a sa'a (*) Translator: * A sa' is a unit of measurement equal to approximately four handfuls of water.

chapter: Sufficiency Of The Basic Amount In Ghusl Even If Like Oil, And The Recommendation Of Ghusl With A Sa'a
arabicText: .ءام نم لاطرأ ةعستب لستغت ثماطلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The menstruating woman performs ghusl with nine ratls of water.

chapter: Sufficiency Of The Basic Amount In Ghusl Even If Like Oil, And The Recommendation Of Ghusl With A Sa'a
arabicText: .هأزجأ دقف هريثكو هليلق هدسج نم ءاملا هيلع ىرج ام بنجلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: For the one in the state of janabah, whatever water runs over their body, be it little or much, it suffices them.

chapter: Sufficiency Of The Basic Amount In Ghusl Even If Like Oil, And The Recommendation Of Ghusl With A Sa'a
arabicText: .اهأزجأ اهرعش نم ءاملا للب غلب ام ضئاحلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: For the menstruating woman, whatever water reaches and wets her hair suffices her.

chapter: Sufficiency Of The Basic Amount In Ghusl Even If Like Oil, And The Recommendation Of Ghusl With A Sa'a
arabicText: .كنيمي تلب ام ءاجنتسلااو لسغلا نم كيزجي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: For ghusl and istinja, what your right hand gets wet with suffices you.

chapter: Sufficiency Of The Basic Amount In Ghusl Even If Like Oil, And The Recommendation Of Ghusl With A Sa'a
arabicText: كنيمي نعو فكأ ثلاث كسأر لىع ضفأ :لقا ،ةبانجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس :لقا ةرارز نع .نهدلا لثم كيفكي امنإ ،كراسي نعو
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the ghusl of janabah. He said: Pour three handfuls over your head, and over your right and your left. Indeed, an amount like oil suffices you. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What precedes this is indicated in the chapters on ablution, in cleansing after relieving oneself, in the chapters on added and used water, and in the hadiths about the obligation of bathing when the glans is covered and other matters, and what will come will indicate this."

chapter: Permissibility Of Man And Woman Performing Ghusl From One Container, And The Recommendation For The Man To Begin First, And The Water Being Two Sa's Or One Sa' And One Mudd
arabicText: لوسر ناك :لاقف ؟ءاملا نم يزجي مك ةبانجلا لسغ تقو نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع .دحاو ءناإ نم اعيمج نلاستغيو ،هتبحاص نيبو هنيب دادمأ ةسمخب لستغي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them) who said: I asked him about the amount of water sufficient for ghusl al-janabah? He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would perform ghusl with five mudds between him and his companion, and they would both perform ghusl together from one container.

chapter: Permissibility Of Man And Woman Performing Ghusl From One Container, And The Recommendation For The Man To Begin First, And The Water Being Two Sa's Or One Sa' And One Mudd
arabicText: لبق امهيديأ لىع ناغرفي معن :لقا ؟دحاو ءناإ نم ةأرملاو لجرلا لستغي له (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ءنالاا يف امهيديأ اعضي نأ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) whether a man and woman can perform ghusl from one container? He said: Yes, they should pour water on their hands before placing their hands in the container.

chapter: Permissibility Of Man And Woman Performing Ghusl From One Container, And The Recommendation For The Man To Begin First, And The Water Being Two Sa's Or One Sa' And One Mudd
arabicText: هعم ناك اذإو ،عاصب لستغي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناك :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .دمو عاصب لستغي هئاسن ضعب
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would perform ghusl with one sa', and when one of his wives was with him, he would perform ghusl with one sa' and one mudd.

chapter: Permissibility Of Man And Woman Performing Ghusl From One Container, And The Recommendation For The Man To Begin First, And The Water Being Two Sa's Or One Sa' And One Mudd
arabicText: ةسمخ نم هتجوزو وه (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لستغا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لقا ةرارز نع تبرض مث ،هجرف ىقنفأ اهلبق ءاملا هديب برضف وه أدب :لاقف ؟عنص فيك :ةرارز هل لاقف ،دحاو ءناإ نم دادمأ هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا هب لستغا يذلا ناكو ،اغرف ىتح اهسفن لىع يه تضفاأو وه ضفاأ مث .اهجرف تقنفأ يه لسغلبا درفنا نمو ،اعيمج هيف اكرتشا امهنلأ امهنع أزجأ امنإو ،نيدم هب تلستغا يذلاو دادمأ ةثلاث (هلآو .عاص نم هل دبلاف هدحو
englishText: From Zurarah who said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and his wife performed ghusl from five mudds from one container. Zurarah asked him: How did they do it? He said: He began by putting his hand in the water before her and cleaned his private parts, then she put her hand and cleaned her private parts. Then he poured water over himself and she poured water over herself until they finished. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) used three mudds and she used two mudds, and this was sufficient for them because they shared it together, but whoever performs ghusl alone must use one sa'.

chapter: Permissibility Of Man And Woman Performing Ghusl From One Container, And The Recommendation For The Man To Begin First, And The Water Being Two Sa's Or One Sa' And One Mudd
arabicText: لستغاو دمب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر أضوت :لاقا امهنأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) الله دبع يبأو ،رفعج يبأ نع .ثيدحلا ركذو .دادمأ ةسمخب هتجوزو وه لستغا :لقا مث ،عاصب
englishText: From Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon them) who both said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed wudu with one mudd and ghusl with one sa', then he said: He and his wife performed ghusl with five mudds. And he mentioned the hadith.

chapter: Permissibility Of Man And Woman Performing Ghusl From One Container, And The Recommendation For The Man To Begin First, And The Water Being Two Sa's Or One Sa' And One Mudd
arabicText: ءاجف ةلضف اهيف تلضفو ةنفج نم تلستغفا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرو ناأ تبنجأ :تلقا ةنوميم نع ،تلستغا :تلقا وأ ،ينم ةلضف اهنإ الله لوسر يا :تلقف ،اهنم لستغفا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .ةبانج ءاملا سيل :لاقف
englishText: From Maymunah who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and I became junub, so I performed ghusl from a bowl and left some water in it. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) came and performed ghusl from it. I said: O Messenger of Allah, this is leftover from me, or she said: I performed ghusl from it. He said: Water does not become junub.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: .لسغلا نم رهطأ ءوضو يأو ءوضولا نع يزجي لسغلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl suffices instead of wudu, and what wudu could be purer than ghusl.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: لسغ يف ةلاصلل ءوضولا نع هلأسي ثلاثلا نسحلا يبأ ىلإ بتك ينادمهلا نامحرلا دبع نب دمحم نأ .هريغ لاو ةعمجلا موي لسغ يف ةلاصلل ءوضو لا بتكف ،ةعمجلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Abd al-Rahman Al-Hamdani wrote to Abu Al-Hasan the Third asking about wudu for prayer with Friday ghusl, and he wrote back: No wudu is needed for prayer with Friday ghusl or any other ghusl.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: وأ ،ةعمج موي وأ ،هتبانج نم لستغا اذإ لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس :لقا يطبااسلا رامع نع ةأرملاو ،لسغلا هأزجأ دق دعب لاو لبق هيلع سيل لا :لاقف ؟هدعب وأ كلذ لبق ءوضولا هيلع له ،ديع موي .لسغلا اهأزجأ دق دعب لاو لبق لا ءوضولا اهيلع سيلف كلذ ريغ وأ ،ضيح نم تلستغا اذإ كلذ لثم
englishText: From Ammar al-Sabati who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man when he performs ghusl from janabah, or for Friday, or for Eid, does he need to perform wudu before or after it? He said: No, he does not need to do it before or after, the ghusl suffices him. And the woman is the same when she performs ghusl from menstruation or other than that, she does not need to perform wudu neither before nor after, the ghusl suffices her.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: دبع وبأ لاقف ؟ءوضولا نم هيزجيأ كلذ ريغ وأ ،ةعمجلل لستغي لجرلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لسغلا نم رهطأ ءوضو يأو :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who performs ghusl for Friday or other occasions, does it suffice instead of wudu? Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: And what wudu could be purer than ghusl.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: .ةعدب هدعبو لسغلا لبق ءوضولا نأ لاسرم ىيحي نب دمحأ نب دمحم نع هدانسإبو
englishText: And by his chain from Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya in a mursal tradition that wudu before and after ghusl is an innovation.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: .ةعدب لسغلا دعب ءوضولا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا ناميلس نب الله دبع نع
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sulayman who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Wudu after ghusl is an innovation.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: .ءوضو هلبق نفإ ، ةعمجلا موي لسغ لاإ ءوضو هيف لسغلا نم ءيش سيل هنأ يورو : ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: It has been narrated that none of ghusls require wudu except the ghusl of Friday, for it requires wudu before it.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: .لسغلا نم رهطأ ءوضو يأ يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it is narrated: What wudu could be purer than ghusl.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: .ةعدب لسغلا دعب ءوضولا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Wudu after ghusl is an innovation.

chapter: That Every Ghusl Suffices Instead Of Wudu
arabicText: .ةعدب لسغلا دعب ءوضولا لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع قرط ةدع نم يور :(ربتعملا) يف ققحملا :لقاو
englishText: And Al-Muhaqqiq said in (Al-Mu'tabar): It is narrated through several chains from Al Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Wudu after ghusl is an innovation. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What supports this will come in hadiths regarding menstruation, irregular bleeding, postpartum period, and others, and what appears contradictory will be clarified later.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Performing Wudu Either Before Or After Ghusl Of Janabah
arabicText: :لقا ؟ليئربج هب لزن اميف لا مأ ءوضو هيف ةبانجلا لسغ نع هتلأس :لقا ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع مث ،ىذأ نم هباصأ ام لسغي مث ،ءاملا يف امهسمغي نأ لبق نيقفرملا ىلإ هيدي لسغيف أدبي لستغي بنجلا .هيلع ءوضو لاو لسغلا ىضق دق مث ،هلك هدسج لىعو ههجو لىعو هسأر لىع بصي
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about the ghusl al janabah, is there wudu in it or not according to what Gabriel brought down? He said: The person in state of janabah performs the ghusl by first washing his hands up to the elbows before immersing them in water, then washes what was affected by impurity, then pours water over his head, face, and his entire body, then he has completed the ghusl and no wudu is required of him.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Performing Wudu Either Before Or After Ghusl Of Janabah
arabicText: .ءوضو دعب لاو هلبق سيل :لاقف ةبانجلا لسغ ةيفيك ركذو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), and he mentioned how to perform the ghusl al-janabah, and he said: There is no wudu required before or after it.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Performing Wudu Either Before Or After Ghusl Of Janabah
arabicText: ىلإ نيقفرملا نم ىنميلا كدي لسغت :لاقف ،ةبانجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا باأ تلأس كسأر لىع ضفأ مث ،هنم كباصأ ام لسغا مث ،ءنالاا يف كدي لخدت مث ،لوبلا لىع تردق نإ لوبتو ،كعباصأ .هيف ءوضو لاو كدسجو
englishText: Abu Al-Qasim said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about the ghusl al-janabah. He said: Wash your right hand from the elbows to your fingers, and urinate if you are able to urinate, then put your hand in the vessel, then wash what was affected by it, then pour water over your head and body, and there is no wudu required in it.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Performing Wudu Either Before Or After Ghusl Of Janabah
arabicText: ءوضو أضوتي :نولوقي سانلا نإ :تلق - :لقا نأ ىلإ - ةبانجلا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .غلبأو لسغلا نم ىقنأ ءوضو يأو :لقاو كحضف ،لسغلا لبق ةلاصلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the ghusl of janabah- until he said- I said: People say one should perform wudu for prayer before the ghusl. He laughed and said: Which wudu is purer and more thorough than the ghusl?

chapter: Impermissibility Of Performing Wudu Either Before Or After Ghusl Of Janabah
arabicText: لبق ءوضولبا رميأ ناك هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع نووري ةفوكلا لهأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق لقا ،(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع باتك يف كلذ اودجو ام (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لىع اوبذك :لقا ،؟ةبانجلا نم لسغلا .اورهطفا ابنج متنك نإو ىلاعت الله
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): The people of Kufa narrate from Ali (peace be upon him) that he used to order performing wudu before the ghusl al-janabah? He said: They have lied against Ali (peace be upon him), they did not find that in the book of Ali (peace be upon him). Allah the Exalted said: And if you are in a state of janabah, then purify yourselves [Quran, 5:6].

chapter: Impermissibility Of Performing Wudu Either Before Or After Ghusl Of Janabah
arabicText: أضوتو كجرفو كيفك لسغا :لقا ؟تبنجأ اذإ عنصأ فيك :تلق هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .لستغا مث ةلاصلا ءوضو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him saying: What should I do when I am in a state of janabah? He said: Wash your palms and private parts, perform wudu like you do for prayer, then perform the ghusl.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Performing Wudu Either Before Or After Ghusl Of Janabah
arabicText: .ةعدب هدعب لسغلا لبق ءوضولا نبأ لاسرم ىيحي نب دمحأ نب دمحم نع هدانسإبو
englishText: And by his chain from Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya in a mursal tradition that wudu before or after the ghusl is an innovation.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu Before Ghusl In Cases Other Than Janabah
arabicText: .ةبانجلا لسغ لاإ ءوضو هلبق لسغ لك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Every ghusl is preceded by ablution except for the ghusl of janabah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu Before Ghusl In Cases Other Than Janabah
arabicText: .ةبانجلا لاإ ءوضو لسغ لك يف :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: In every ghusl there is ablution except in (the ghusl of) janabah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu Before Ghusl In Cases Other Than Janabah
arabicText: .لستغا و أضوتف ةعمجلل لستغت نأ تدرأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع ادج بيرق بابحتسلاا لىع امهلمح لب ،بوجولبا امهيف حيرصت لا ةيقتلل امهتقاوم عم ناثيدحلا ناذه :لوقأ ةبانجلا لسغ ريغ يف سيل هنأ داريو يراكنلاا ماهفتسلاا لولأا لمتحيو ،ةيقتلا لىع لمحلا لمتحيو ،رم امل امهيف حيرصت لا مث ،هيف مهبهذم نم ملع امل صن ىلإ جاتحي لا هنلأ ،ةبانجلا لسغ ريغ لىع اصن ءوضو اضيأ ام امأو ،هكرت وأ ،ءوضولا ميدقت نيعتيف ةعدب لسغلا دعب ءوضولا نأ مدقت دقو ،ءوضولا ريختأ زاوجب اضيأ لمتحيو ،بوجولا دصقب وأ ،ةبانجلا لسغب صوصخم وهف ةعدب هدعبو لسغلا لبق ءوضولا نأ نم مدقت .ملعأ اللهو ،أدتبملا ربخ لسغلا لبق نوكي نبأ هدعب هيفنو لسغلا لبق ءوضولا تابثإ ةدارإ لىع لمحلا
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) who said: When you want to perform the ghusl for Friday, perform wudu and then perform the ghusl. I (Hurr Amili) say: These two hadiths, while conforming to taqiyyah (religious dissimulation), do not explicitly indicate obligation. Rather, interpreting them as recommendation is very probable based on what has preceded. They could also be interpreted as taqiyyah. The first one could be interpreted as rhetorical questioning, meaning that even in baths other than janabah there is no ablution, specifically mentioning other than janabah bath because it doesn't need explicit text as their position on it is known. Then there is also no explicit mention in them about permissibility of delaying ablution, and it has preceded that ablution after bath is an innovation, so ablution must either be performed before or abandoned. As for what preceded about ablution being an innovation before and after bath, this is specific to the bath of janabah, or when intended as obligatory. It could also be interpreted as establishing ablution before bath and negating it after, with "before bath" being the predicate of the subject, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: ،لالب كلذ دعب دجي مث لستغي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس :لقا يبلحلا ليع نب الله ديبع نع .لسغلا دعيلف لسغلا لبق لبا نكي مل نإو أضوتيل :لقا لستغي نأ لبق لبا ناك دقو
englishText: From Ubaydullah bin Ali Al-Halabi who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who performs ghusl then finds moisture afterward, and he had urinated before performing ghusl. He said: He should perform wudu, and if he had not urinated before ghusl, he should repeat the ghusl.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: .لئابحلا نم كلذ امنإ لستغي لاو أضوتيلف لبا نكي ملو لالب ىأر دق ناك نإ :رخآ ثيدح يف يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it was narrated in another hadith: If he saw moisture and had not urinated, he should perform wudu and not ghusl, for that is from the urethral discharge. Translator: To resolve this apparent contradiction with Hadith 2075, please see Shaykh's comment on Hadith 2088.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: ؟لستغيأ ائيش همانم يف ري ملو ،لالب ىريف هركذ سميف ظقيتسي مث ماني لجرلا نع لئسو :يبلحلا لقا .ربكلأا ءاملا نم لسغلا امنإ لا :لقا
englishText: Al-Halabi said: He was asked about a man who sleeps then wakes up and touches his private part and sees moisture, but didn't see anything in his sleep, should he perform ghusl? He said: No, ghusl is only required from the greater discharge.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: .لئابحلا نم كلذ امنإو ،لستغت لاو أضوتف تلب نكت مل نإ رخآ ثيدح يف يورو :لقا (عنقملا) باتك يفو
englishText: And in the book (Al-Muqni) it said: And it was narrated in another hadith if you had not urinated then perform wudu and do not perform ghusl, for that is from the urethral discharge. Translator: See comment by Shaykh Hurr Amili in Hadith 2088.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: نأ ليق لبا ناك دقو لالب كلذ دعب دجي مث لستغي لجرلا نع لئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لسغلا ديعي لاف لستغي نأ لبق لبا ناك نإ :لقا ؟لستغي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: He was asked about a man who performs ghusl then finds moisture afterward and he had urinated before performing ghusl? He said: If he had urinated before performing ghusl, he does not repeat the ghusl.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: ديعيو لستغي :لقا ئش لستغا ام دعب هليلحإ نم جرخي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .هلسغ ديعي لا هنفإ لستغي نأ لبق لبا نوكي نأ لاإ ،ةلاصلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who finds something coming out of his urethra after performing ghusl. He said: He should perform ghusl and repeat the prayer, unless he had urinated before performing ghusl, then he does not repeat his ghusl.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: ناك نإو ،هلسغ ضقتنا دقف لالب دجو مث لوبي نأ لبق بنج وهو لستغا نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقاو .ائيش عدي مل لوبلا نلا ،ءوضولا هيلع نكلو ،هلسغ ضقني سيل لالب دجو مث ،لستغا مث لبا
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Whoever performs ghusl while in a state of janabah before urinating then finds moisture, his ghusl is nullified. But if he had urinated then performed ghusl, then found moisture, his ghusl is not nullified, but he must perform wudu, because urination leaves nothing behind. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Repeating the prayer is based on the assumption that he prayed after the semen was discharged, not before."

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: لبا ناك نفإ ،لسغلا ديعي :لقا ،لستغي ام دعب لالب دجيف لوبي نأ لبق لستغي مث بنجي لجرلا نع هتلأس .جينتسيو أضوتي نكلو هلسغ ديعي لاف لستغي نأ لبق
englishText: I asked him about a man who becomes junub then performs ghusl before urinating and finds moisture after performing ghusl. He said: He should repeat the ghusl, but if he had urinated before performing ghusl, he does not repeat his ghusl but should perform wudu and clean himself. Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: لبق هعامج دعب لبا ناك نإ :لقا ،ائيش لسغلا دعب ىأر لجر يف :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .لسغلا دعيلف للبلا دجو مث لستغا ىتح لبي مل نإو ،أضوتيلف لسغلا
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Regarding a man who saw something after ghusl, he said: If he had urinated after intercourse before ghusl, he should perform wudu, and if he had not urinated until he performed ghusl then found moisture, he should repeat the ghusl.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: ديعي :لقا ،ئش هنم جرخف لوبي نأ لبق لستغفا بنجأ لجر نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ام نلا :لقا ؟امهنيب اميف قرفلا امف :تلق ،ديعت لا :لقا ،؟لسغلا دعب ئش اهنم جرخي ةأرملفا :تلق ،لسغلا .لجرلا ءام نم وه امنإ ةأرملا نم جرخي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who became junub and performed ghusl before urinating and something came out of him. He said: He should repeat the ghusl. I said: What about a woman if something comes out of her after ghusl? He said: She does not repeat. I said: What is the difference between them? He said: Because what comes out of the woman is from the man's fluid.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: دعب ىري مث لستغي ىتح لوبي نأ ىسنيف ةبانجلا هبيصي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لئابحلا نم لزنو ترصعت دق ،لا :لقا ؟اضيأ لستغيأ ،ائيش لسغلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who becomes junub and forgets to urinate until he performs ghusl then sees something after ghusl, should he perform ghusl again? He said: No, it has been squeezed out and descended from the urethral discharge. Translator: See comment by Shaykh Hurr Amili in Hadith 2088.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: .لسغلا هنم ديعي لاف ايسنا نوكي نأ لاإ لوبلا دعب لسغلا نأ :بتكف ،لوبي نأ لبق لستغا لجر نع هتلأس
englishText: I asked him about a man who performed ghusl before urinating, and he wrote: Ghusl should be after urination unless he was forgetful, then he does not repeat the ghusl.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: دعب ئش هنم جرخي مث لوبي نأ لبق لستغي مث هلهأ عماجي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .هنع الله هعضو امم كلذ نإ هيلع ئش لا :لقا ،لسغلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who has intercourse with his wife then performs ghusl before urinating then something comes out of him after ghusl. He said: Nothing is required of him as that is what Allah has relieved him from. Translator: See comment by Shaykh Hurr Amili in Hadith 2088.

chapter: Ruling On Suspicious Moisture After Ghusl
arabicText: لا :لقا ،؟ائيش ىأر مث لوبي نأ لبق لستغا مث بنجأ لجر نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ائيش ىأر يذلا كلذ سيل ،لسغلا ديعي وأ ،اينم جراخلا نوك ققحت لىع وأ ،بابحتسلاا لىع لمحلا امإ ءوضولا وأ لسغلا ةداعإ نمضت ام هجو :لوقأ ةيقب ترم دقو ،بوجولا مدع لىع ةلادلا ثيداحلأا نم مدقت امل خيشلاو قودصلا ملاك نم مهفي امك لاوب لاإ ةراهطلا ضاقتنا مدع لىع لدي ام مدقتو ،كلذ ريغو ةولخلا يفو ،ءوضولا ضقاون يف هبتشملا للبلا ثيداحأ .كشلاو نظلا نود ثدحلا لوصحب نيقيلبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a man who became junub then performed ghusl before urinating then saw something? He said: He does not repeat the ghusl, what he saw is nothing. I (Hurr Amili) say: The aspect of what includes repeating ghusl or wudu is either carried on recommendation, or on confirming that what came out was semen or urine as understood from the words of Al-Saduq and Al-Shaykh, due to the previous hadiths indicating non-obligation, and the rest of the hadiths about suspicious moisture have passed in the nullifiers of wudu, in seclusion and otherwise, and what has preceded indicates that purification is not nullified except with certainty of occurrence of hadath, not with doubt or suspicion.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Traditional Supplications During Ghusl
arabicText: " ليمع لطبتو ينيد قحمت ةفاع لك نم يبلق رهط مهللا " :ةعمجلا لسغ يف لوقت :لقا انباحصأ ضعب نع " يل اريخ كدنع ام لعجاو ،ييعس لبقتو ،ليمع كزو ،يبلق رهط مهللا " :ةبانجلا لسغ يف لوقتو
englishText: From some of our companions who said: For the Friday ghusl, say: "O Allah, purify my heart from every affliction that destroys my religion and invalidates my deeds." And for the ghusl of janabah (sexual impurity), say: "O Allah, purify my heart, increase my deeds in virtue, accept my efforts, and make what is with You better for me."

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Traditional Supplications During Ghusl
arabicText: " نيرهطتملا نم ينلعجاو نيباوتلا نم ينلعجا مهللا " رخآ ثيدح يفو :خيشلا لقا
englishText: The Shaykh said: And in another hadith: "O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves."

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Traditional Supplications During Ghusl
arabicText: ام لعجاو ،ييعس لبقتو ،يبلق رهط مهللا ":لقف ةبانج نم تلستغا اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا " نيرهطتملا نم ينلعجاو ،نيباوتلا نم ينلعجا مهللا ،يل اريخ كدنع نم ينلعجا مهللا ليمع هب لطبتو ،ينيد قحمت ةفآ لك نم يبلق رهط مهللا " :لقف ةعمجلل تلستغا اذإو " نيرهطتملا نم ينلعجاو نيباوتلا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When you perform ghusl from janabah, say: "O Allah, purify my heart, accept my efforts, and make what is with You better for me. O Allah, make me among those who repent, and make me among those who purify themselves." And when you perform ghusl for Friday, say: "O Allah, purify my heart from every affliction that destroys my religion and invalidates my deeds with it. O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves."

chapter: Obligation Of Making Water Reach The Roots Of Hair And The Entire Body In Ghusl, And The Non-Obligation Of Washing Or Undoing The Hair
arabicText: راعشأ تناك :تلقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر مداخ ىملس ينتثدح لقا ( ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ءاسنلا امفأ ،ليلق ئش ءاملا نم نهيفكي ناكف ،نهسؤر مدقم نهسؤر نورق (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ءاسن ءاملا يف نغلابي نأ نهل يغبني دقف نلآا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said: Salma, the servant of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) told me: The hair of the Prophet's wives (peace be upon him and his family) was in braids at the front of their heads, and a small amount of water was sufficient for them. As for women nowadays, they should use more water.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Water Reach The Roots Of Hair And The Entire Body In Ghusl, And The Non-Obligation Of Washing Or Undoing The Hair
arabicText: نك امنإ ةطشملا هذه نكت مل :لقا ،نورقلاو رعشلا يف ءاسنلا عنصت امع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لسغلا يف نغلابي :لقا مث ،ةنكمأ ةعبرأ فصو مث ،هنعمجي
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about what women should do with their hair and braids. He said: This hairstyling didn't exist then, they used to gather it, then he described four places, then said: They should be thorough in washing.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Water Reach The Roots Of Hair And The Entire Body In Ghusl, And The Non-Obligation Of Washing Or Undoing The Hair
arabicText: .ةبانجلا نم تلستغا اذإ اهرعش ةأرملا ضقنت لا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هيبأ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon them) who said: A woman should not undo her hair when performing ghusl from janabah.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Water Reach The Roots Of Hair And The Entire Body In Ghusl, And The Non-Obligation Of Washing Or Undoing The Hair
arabicText: .ةبانجلا نم تلستغا ذإ اهرعش ةأرملا ضقنت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A woman should not undo her hair when performing ghusl from janabah. Obligation Of Making Water Reach The Roots Of Hair And The Entire B...

chapter: Obligation Of Making Water Reach The Roots Of Hair And The Entire Body In Ghusl, And The Non-Obligation Of Washing Or Undoing The Hair
arabicText: ،فوصلا نم لمارقلا ىلإ نهادحإ دمعت ،اطشم نثدحأ مويلا ءاسنلا نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق ،ةلسمب هطيخت مث ،ةقيقر ةقرخ هيلع لعجت مث ،نيحيارلبا هوشحت مث ،رعشلا نم هعنصت ،ةطشاملا هلعفت ؟ةبانجلا اهبيصت مث ،اهسأر يف اهلعجت مث ءاملا نم اهسأر يورت نأ اهرم ،ردغت لسغلا نهباصأ اذفإ ميداقملا نطشمتي امنإ لولأا ءاسنلا ناك :لاقف .اضقن ةطشملا ضقنت :لقا ؟ضئاحلفا :تلق .اهيلع سبأ لاف ىور اذفإ يوري ىتح هرصعتو
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Women nowadays have innovated a new way of styling, where one of them takes wool padding that the hairdresser makes from hair, then fills it with aromatic plants, puts a thin cloth over it, sews it with a needle, places it on her head, then becomes junub? He said: The women of old would only style the front of their hair, and when they needed to perform ghusl they would leave it. Tell her to saturate her head with water and squeeze it until it's saturated, and once saturated there's no problem. I asked: What about menstruation? He said: The styling should be completely undone. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The author of al-Muntaqa said: His saying 'they would just wet it' means they leave the hair as it is without untangling it, and as stated in al-Qamus: 'To leave it is to neglect and preserve it as it was left.'

chapter: Obligation Of Making Water Reach The Roots Of Hair And The Entire Body In Ghusl, And The Non-Obligation Of Washing Or Undoing The Hair
arabicText: لمارقب تطشتما دقو لستغي ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ ،يطبااسلا ىسوم نب رامع نع ،اهسأر لىع نانفح ثلاث وهو ،اهرعش برشي يذلا لثم :لقا ؟ءاملا نم اهيزجي مك اهرعش ضقنت ملو .هلك اهدسج لىع اهدي رمت مث ،راسيلا لىع ناتنفحو نيميلا لىع ناتنفحو
englishText: From Ammar bin Musa Al-Sabati, that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman performing ghusl who has styled her hair with padding and hasn't undone her hair, how much water suffices her? He said: As much as her hair drinks, which is three handfuls on her head, two handfuls on the right, two handfuls on the left, then she passes her hand over her entire body.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Water Reach The Roots Of Hair And The Entire Body In Ghusl, And The Non-Obligation Of Washing Or Undoing The Hair
arabicText: .رانلا يف وهف ادمعت ةبانجلا نم ةرعش كرت نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever intentionally leaves a single hair unwashed from janabah is in the Fire. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The intent is that water must reach the roots of the hair, not just the ends, as indicated by this and other narrations on ablution and in the hadiths describing how to properly bathe, which also emphasize the obligation to cover the body with water.

chapter: Ruling For One Who Forgets The Ghusl For Janabah Or Doesn't Know About It Until After Praying And Fasting
arabicText: ناضمر رهش جرخ ىتح لستغي نأ يسنف ناضمر رهشف بنجأ لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس .مايصلاو ةلاصلا يضقي و لستغي نأ هيلع :لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who became in a state of janabah during the month of Ramadan and forgot to perform the ghusl until the month of Ramadan had passed. He said: He must perform the ghusl and make up the prayers and fasts.

chapter: Ruling For One Who Forgets The Ghusl For Janabah Or Doesn't Know About It Until After Praying And Fasting
arabicText: وأ ابنج ناك اذإو ،تقو يف ناك ام لاإ ةلاصلا دعي مل اسجن هبوث ناك اذإ لجرلا نأ ثيدح يف ريازهم نب ليع نع كلذ لىع لمعفا دسجلا فلاخ بوثلا نلا ،هتتفا يتاوللا تباوتكملا تاولصلا ةداعإ هيلعف ءوضو ريغ لىع لىص .الله ءاش نإ
englishText: From Ali bin Mahziyar in a hadith that if a man's clothes were impure, he need not repeat the prayer except what was still within its time, but if he was in a state of janabah or prayed without wudu, he must repeat the obligatory prayers that he missed, because clothes are different from the body, so act upon this if Allah wills.

chapter: Ruling For One Who Forgets The Ghusl For Janabah Or Doesn't Know About It Until After Praying And Fasting
arabicText: :لقا ملتحا دق هنأ همانم يف ىأر نكي ملو حبصي ام دعب ينملا هبايث يف ىري لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) هتلأس .هتلاص دعيو هبوث لسغيلو لستغيلف
englishText: I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man who sees semen on his clothes after morning time, and he had not seen in his dream that he had a wet dream. He said: He should perform the ghusl, wash his clothes, and repeat his prayer. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And there will come what supports this in the hadith concerning someone who forgets part of a limb, and in the book on fasting, God willing.

chapter: Recommendation Of Pouring Water Three Times On The Head And Twice On Each Side
arabicText: .كلذ نم لقأ هيزجي لا ثالاث ءاملا هسأر لىع بنجلا ضيفي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: A person in the state of janabah must pour water over their head three times, and anything less than that is not sufficient. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What precedes this has been indicated in the method of bathing, and also what has been indicated concerning the sufficiency of the named amount in bathing, even as little as oil, and that less than a sa' suffices. It appears that the intention behind the three and two pours is recommendatory.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Informing Others About Defects In Ghusl, And The Ruling For One Who Forgets Or Doubts About A Body Part
arabicText: اهبصي مل كرهظ يف ةعمل تيقبأ دق :هل ليقف ةبانجلا نم يبأ لستغا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هديب ةعمللا كلت حسم مث !؟تكس ول كيلع ناك ام :هل لاقف ءاملا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: My father performed ghusl from janabah, and he was told: "You have left a spot on your back that the water did not reach." He replied to him: "What harm would it have done you if you had remained silent?!" Then he wiped that spot with his hand.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Informing Others About Defects In Ghusl, And The Ruling For One Who Forgets Or Doubts About A Body Part
arabicText: لسغ نم هدسج ضعب وأ ،هعارذ ضعب كرت لجر :هل تلق :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع مل ام امهيلع داعفأ عجر نقيتسا ناك نإو ،هيلع اهب حسم هتلاص يف وهو ةلب هب تناكو كش اذإ :لاقف ةبانجلا داعفأ عجر نيقتسا نإو ،هيلع ئش لاو هتلاص يف ضميلف هتلاص يف لخد دقو كشلا هلخد نفإ ،ةلب بصي ئش هكش يف هيلع سيلف اكاش ناك نإو ،ناقيتسبا ةلاصلا داعأو هيلع حسم ةلب هبو هآر نإو ،ءاملا هيلع .هتلاص يف ضميلف
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: I asked him about a man who left part of his forearm or part of his body unwashed in ghusl from janabah. He said: If he doubts while there is still wetness and he is in his prayer, he should wipe over it with that wetness. If he is certain, he should go back and repeat washing those parts as long as there is no wetness. If doubt enters while he has started his prayer, he should continue his prayer and nothing is upon him. If he becomes certain, he should go back and pour water over it. If he sees it while there is wetness, he should wipe over it and repeat the prayer with certainty. If he is in doubt, nothing is upon him regarding his doubt, so he should continue his prayer.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Informing Others About Defects In Ghusl, And The Ruling For One Who Forgets Or Doubts About A Body Part
arabicText: لسغا ،فجي مل وأ فج :لقا ؟هيلي يذلا لسغأ نأ لبق لولأا فج نفإ :تلق :لقا فجي ءوضولا يف زيرح نع .ةلزنملا كلتب وه :لقا ةبانجلا لسغ كلذكو :تلق ،يقب ام
englishText: From Hareez regarding wudu drying up, he said: I asked: What if the first part dries Non-Obligation Of Informing Others About Defects In Ghusl, And The ... before I wash the next part? He replied: Whether it dries or not, wash what remains. I asked: And is it the same for ghusl from janabah? He said: It is of the same status.

chapter: Ruling On Ring, Bracelet, Armlet, Splints, Wounds And Similar Items During Ghusl
arabicText: نإ هلسغي لاف :لقا ،هباصأ نإ ءاملا فوختيف حرجلا هب بنجلا نع هتلأس ،لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هسفن لىع يشخ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a person in the state of janabah who has a wound and fears water touching it. He said: He should not wash it if he fears harm to himself.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concerning The Meeting Of The Junub, The Deceased, And The One With Minor Impurity When There Is Only Enough Water For One
arabicText: قلحلاو رحنلاو ةفرعو ةماجحلاو ةبانجلل كلذ كلسغ كأزجأ رجفلا عولط دعب تلستغا اذإ :لقا ةرارز نع اهيزجي ةأرملا كلذكو :لقا مث :لقا .دحاو لسغ كنع اهأزجأ (الله) قوقح كيلع تعمتجا اذفإ ،ةريازلاو حبذلاو .اهديعو اهضيح نم اهلسغو اهتعمجو اهمارحإو اهتبانجل دحاو لسغ
englishText: From Zurarah who said: If you perform ghusl after dawn, that ghusl suffices for janabah, cupping, Arafah, sacrifice day, shaving, slaughtering, and ziyarah. When multiple rights of Allah combine upon you, one ghusl suffices for all of them. Then he said: Similarly, for a woman, one ghusl suffices for her janabah, ihram, Friday, menstruation, and Eid.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concerning The Meeting Of The Junub, The Deceased, And The One With Minor Impurity When There Is Only Enough Water For One
arabicText: لسغ لك نم لسغلا كلذ هنع هأزجأ رجفلا عولط دعب بنجلا لستغا اذإ :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) امهدحأ نع .مويلا كلذ يف همزلي
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon him) who said: When a person in the state of janabah performs ghusl after dawn, that ghusl suffices for all obligatory ghusls required of them that day.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concerning The Meeting Of The Junub, The Deceased, And The One With Minor Impurity When There Is Only Enough Water For One
arabicText: ؟لستغي مث هلهأ يتيأ نأ هل اتيم لسغ نم وأ تيملا لسغي بنجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس مث أضوت اتيم لسغ نإو ،بنج وهو تيملا لسغو ،أضوتو هدي لسغ ابنج ناك اذإ كلذب سبأ لا ءاوس :لاقف .امهل دحاو لسغ هيزجي و ،هلهأ ىتأ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a person in janabah washing a deceased person, or one who washes a deceased person then has relations with his wife, then performs ghusl? He said: It's the same, there's no problem with that. If he's in janabah, he washes his hands and performs wudu, and washes the deceased while in janabah. And if he washes a deceased person, he performs wudu then has relations with his wife, and one ghusl suffices for both.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concerning The Meeting Of The Junub, The Deceased, And The One With Minor Impurity When There Is Only Enough Water For One
arabicText: .دحاو لسغ اهأزجأ بنج يهو ةأرملا تضاح اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: If a woman menstruates while in the state of janabah, one ghusl suffices for her.
