chapter: Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concerning The Meeting Of The Junub, The Deceased, And The One With Minor Impurity When There Is Only Enough Water For One
arabicText: هلعجت :لقا ،لستغت نأ لبق تضاح مث ةأرما نم باصأ لجر نع لئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ادحاو لاسغ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He was asked about a man who had relations with a woman then she menstruated before performing ghusl. He said: She makes it one ghusl.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concerning The Meeting Of The Junub, The Deceased, And The One With Minor Impurity When There Is Only Enough Water For One
arabicText: وأ ترهط اذإ ادحاو لاسغ هلعجتأ ،غرف ام دعب تثمطف هتأرما لىع عقو لجر (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .اهرهط دنع ادحاو لاسغ هلعجت :لقا ؟نيترم لستغت
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who had relations with his wife, then she menstruated after he finished, should she make it one ghusl when she becomes pure or perform ghusl twice? He said: She makes it one ghusl when she becomes pure.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concerning The Meeting Of The Junub, The Deceased, And The One With Minor Impurity When There Is Only Enough Water For One
arabicText: نإ :لقا ،لستغت نأ لبق ضيحت مث اهجوز اهعقاوي ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةبانجلاو ضيحلل ادحاو لاسغ تلستغا ترهط اذفإ ،ئش اهيلع سيلف لعفت مل نإو ،تلعف لستغت نأ تءاش
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I asked him about a woman whose husband has relations with her then she menstruates before performing ghusl. He said: If she wishes to perform ghusl she may do so, and if she doesn't, nothing is required of her. When she becomes pure, she performs one ghusl for both menstruation and janabah.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concerning The Meeting Of The Junub, The Deceased, And The One With Minor Impurity When There Is Only Enough Water For One
arabicText: نم لستغت نأ لبق ضيحتف ةأرملا عماجي لجرلا يف :لاقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) نسحلا يبأو الله دبع يبأ نع .بجاو اهيلع ةبانجلا لسغ :لقا ،ةبانجلا دحاو لسغ ىزجي رهطلا دعب نكلو ضيحلا درجمب ةيلكلبا هرثا طقسي لا ةبانجلا لسغ نأ مولعم :لوقأ ةبانجلا لسغ لثم نأ هانعم نوكي نأ نكميو ،لسغلا ددعت بوجو يف حيرصب اذه سيلو ،ضيحلاو ةبانجلل تقو لسغلا نع اهيهن نم مدقت املو ،ةبانجلا لسغك ضيحلا لسغ نأ لىع لد امل ترهط اذإ اهيلع بجي .ملعأ اللهو راكنلاا لىع لمحلا لمتحيو ،ةلاصلا دسفي ام اهءاج دق هنلأ ،ضيحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah and Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon them) who said regarding a man who has relations with a woman then she menstruates before performing ghusl from janabah: The ghusl of janabah is obligatory upon her. Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concern... I (Hurr Amili) say: It is known that the effect of janabah ghusl is not completely nullified merely by menstruation, but after purification one ghusl suffices for both janabah and menstruation. This is not explicit in requiring multiple ghusls, and it could mean that a ghusl like the janabah ghusl is required when she becomes pure, as evidenced by menstruation ghusl being like janabah ghusl, and by the previous prohibition of ghusl during menstruation because something that invalidates prayer has occurred. It could also be interpreted as a denial, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Ghusl For Multiple Causes And The Ruling Concerning The Meeting Of The Junub, The Deceased, And The One With Minor Impurity When There Is Only Enough Water For One
arabicText: اهيلع له ،بنج يهو ضيحت ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،نانس نبا الله دبع نع .دحاو ضيحلاو ةبانجلا لسغ :لقا ؟ةبانجلا لسغ
englishText: From Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a woman who menstruates while in the state of janabah, is ghusl for janabah required of her? He said: The ghusl for janabah and menstruation is one. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What indicates the latter ruling will come in the sections on tayammum and the overlap of the bath of janaba and death, indeed all baths in the bath of the dead.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing Hands Three Times Before Putting Them In The Vessel In The State Of Janabah
arabicText: امك تارم ثلاث هيدي لسغا مث ( :لقا نأ ىلإ) تيملا لسغ تدرأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) مهنع ،سنوي نع .عارذلا فصن ىلإ ةبانجلا نم ناسنلاا لسغي
englishText: From Yunus, from them (peace be upon them), he said: When you want to perform ghusl for the deceased (until he said:) then wash his hands three times as one washes from janabah up to half of the forearm.

chapter: Recommendation Of Washing Hands Three Times Before Putting Them In The Vessel In The State Of Janabah
arabicText: دارأ اذإ :لقا ةئامعبرلأا ثيدح يف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع هدانسإب (لاصخلا) يف نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .امهلسغيلف هيعارذب ءدبيلف لسغلا مكدحأ
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn in (Al-Khisal), with his chain of narrators from Ali (peace be upon him) in the hadith of the four hundred, said: When one of you wants to perform ghusl, he should start with his forearms and wash them.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Junub To Put Their Hand In Water Before The Recommended Washing
arabicText: رظنف ةلأسملا تيسنأ هدنع ترص املف ،بنجلا نع هلأسأ نأ ديرأ ناأو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لىع تلخد .بحلا نم بنجلا فرغي نبأ سبأ لا باهش يا :لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ىلإ
englishText: From Shihab: I entered upon Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) wanting to ask him about the person in state of janabah. When I was with him, I forgot the question. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) looked at me and said: O Shihab, there is no harm if a person in state of janabah scoops from a water container.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Junub To Put Their Hand In Water Before The Recommended Washing
arabicText: تئج امب كناربخأ تئش نإو !باهش يا لئسفا تئش نإ :لاقف ينأدتبفا هلأسأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تيتأ نأ لبق ءاملا يف هدي رمغيف وهسي بنجلا نع ينلأست تئج :لقا ،كادف تلعج ينربخأ :هل تلق :لقا ،هل ،معن :تلق ؟امهلسغي :لقا كادف تلعج ينربخأ :تلق ،كناربخأ تئش نإو لس تئش نإو ،سبأ لاف ئش هدي باصأ نكي مل اذإ :لقا .سبأ لا :لقا معن :تلق ؟ءاملا بيصيف بحلا نم ءاملا فرغي بنجلا نع ينلأست تئج
englishText: I came to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), to ask him, but he initiated by saying: O Shihab! If you wish, you may ask, and if you wish, we will tell you what you came for. I said to him: Tell me, may I be sacrificed for you. He said: You came to ask me about one who is in a state of janabah and forgetfully immerses his hand in water before washing them? I said: Yes. He said: If nothing touched his hand then there is no harm, and if you wish you may ask and if you wish we will inform you. I said: Inform me, may I be sacrificed for you. He said: You came to ask me about one who is in a state of janabah scooping water from a vessel and touching the water? I said: Yes. He said: There is no harm.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Junub To Put Their Hand In Water Before The Recommended Washing
arabicText: هدي سمي ملو لوبي لجرلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ملسم نب دمحم ثيدح ءوضولا يف مدقت دقو .ابنج ناك نإو معن :لقا ؟ءاملا يف اهسمغيأ ائيش ىنميلا
englishText: The hadith of Muhammad bin Muslim has preceded in (the chapter of) ablution, from one of them (peace be upon him), regarding a man who urinates and his right hand has not touched anything- can he immerse it in water? He said: Yes, even if he is in a state of janabah.

chapter: Not Having To Perform Ghusl Due To Wearing A Garment With Janabah Even If One Sweats In It Or If Rain Wets It, And The Purity Of Sweat Of The Person In State Of Janabah And Menstruation
arabicText: ضئاح يهو اهعجاضي وأ هتأرما قناعيف لستغي وأ ،هبوث يف قرعي بنجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ئشب سيل هلك اذه :لقا ،اهقرع نم دسج بيصيف بنج وأ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a person in the state of janabah who sweats in his clothes, or performs ghusl then embraces his wife or lies with her while she is menstruating or in janabah, and his body is touched by her sweat. He said: All of this is nothing [no issue].

chapter: Not Having To Perform Ghusl Due To Wearing A Garment With Janabah Even If One Sweats In It Or If Rain Wets It, And The Purity Of Sweat Of The Person In State Of Janabah And Menstruation
arabicText: .بوثلا لجرلا بنجي لاو ،لجرلا بوثلا بنجي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The garment does not make a person junub, and a person does not make a garment junub.

chapter: Not Having To Perform Ghusl Due To Wearing A Garment With Janabah Even If One Sweats In It Or If Rain Wets It, And The Purity Of Sweat Of The Person In State Of Janabah And Menstruation
arabicText: سبأ لا :لقا ،لىع لتبي نأ ءامسلا ينبيصتف ةبانجلا هيف نوكت بوثلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a garment that has janabah on it and rain falls on me causing it to get wet. He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Not Having To Perform Ghusl Due To Wearing A Garment With Janabah Even If One Sweats In It Or If Rain Wets It, And The Purity Of Sweat Of The Person In State Of Janabah And Menstruation
arabicText: بنجي لا بوثلا نإ :لاقف :لقا ،هيف قرعيف ةبانج هيفو باوث سبلي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لجرلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who wears a garment that has janabah on it and then sweats in it. He said: The garment does not make a person junub.

chapter: Permission To Perform Ghusl Without A Waist Wrap Where No One Can See, Though Disliked, And Permission For A Man To Perform Ghusl Naked In The Presence Of His Wife
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لقا ،دحأ هاري لا ثيح رازإ ريغب لستغي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man performing ghusl without a waist wrap where no one can see him. He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Permission To Perform Ghusl Without A Waist Wrap Where No One Can See, Though Disliked, And Permission For A Man To Perform Ghusl Naked In The Presence Of His Wife
arabicText: يدي نيب لجرلا لستغيأ :هل تلق (:لقا نأ ىلإ) اهجوز جرف لسغت ةأرملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .مظعأ هب يضفي ام معن :لاقف ؟هلهأ
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Can a woman wash her husband's private parts? (Until he said:) I asked him: Can a man perform ghusl in front of his wife? He said: Yes, what he reveals to her is even greater. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And there will come what indicates this in the chapter on marriage, God willing. Section 4 Haydh (Menstruation)

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl After Menstruation Ends For Prayer, Fasting, And Similar Acts
arabicText: تحبصأ ىتح (لستغت نأ يف) تناوت مث اهضيح نم ليلب ترهط نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مويلا كلذ ءاضق اهيلع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If she becomes pure from her menstruation at night and then delays (performing ghusl) until morning, she must make up for that day (*). Translator: * Make up for the Maghrib and Isha prayer of that day. See Hadith 2377.

chapter: Obligation Of Ghusl After Menstruation Ends For Prayer, Fasting, And Similar Acts
arabicText: .بجاو ضيحلا لسغو :لقا (ثيدح يف) (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع مدقتو ،ةريثك ثيداحأ يف كلذ لىع لدي ام يتيأو ،ضيحلا لسغ بوجو لىع ةلاد ثيداحأ ةدع مدقت دقو :لوقأ هبوجو نفإ ةبانجلا لسغ فلاخب ،نآرقلا نم لا ،ةنسلا نم دافتسم هبوجوأ هانعم نأو ةنس هنأ لىع لدي ام .ملعأ اللهو امهنم دافتسم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) (in a hadith) who said: And the ghusl for menstruation is obligatory. I (Hurr Amili) say: Several hadiths have previously been mentioned indicating the obligation of ghusl for menstruation, and many hadiths will come indicating this, and what has preceded indicates that it is a sunnah and that its obligation is derived from the sunnah, not from the Quran, unlike the ghusl for janabah where its obligation is derived from both, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Distinguishing Menstrual Blood From Virginity Blood And The Ruling For Each
arabicText: ىنمب (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا يبأ لىع تلخد :لقا " ثيدح يف " يفوكلا دامح نبا فلخ نع لا لائاس ثكمف ،مدلا لاس اهضتفا املف ،ثمطت مل ،ارصعم ،ةيراج جوزت كيلاوم نم لاجر نإ :هل تلقف ،مياأ ةرشع نم اوحن عطقني ؟عنصت نأ اهل يغبني امف ،ةرذعلا مد :نهضعب لقاو ،ضيحلا مد :نهضعب لاقف كلذ يف نفلتخا لباوقلا نأو ناك نإو ،اهلعب اهنع كسميلو ،رهطلا ىرت ىتح ةلاصلا نع كسمتلف ضيحلا مد نم ناك نفإ ،الله قتتلف :لقا .كلذ بحأ نإ اهلعب اهيتيأو لصتلو أضوتتلو الله قتتلف ةرذعلا نم ةفاخم طاطسفلا يف لاامشو انيمي تفتلفا :لقا ؟يغبني ام اولعفي ىتح وه ام اوملعي نأ مهل فيكو :هل تلقف نيد لوصأ قلخلا اذه اوملعت لاو ،هوعيذت لاف الله رس ؟فلخ يا :لاقف يلإ دهن مث :لقا ،دحأ ملاك عمسي نأ ،للاض نم مهل الله يضر ام مهل اوضرا لب ،الله نفإ ،اقيقر اجارخإ اهجرخت مث ،ايلم اهعدت مث ةنطقلا لخدتست :لقا مث ،نيعست ىرسيلا هديب دقع مث :لقا ،ضيحلا نم وهف ةنطقلا يف اعقنتسم ناك نإو ،ةرذعلا نم وهف ةنطقلا يف قاوطم مدلا ناك اذه نسحي ناك نم ،كادف تلعج :تلق ؟كاكبأ ام :لقا يئاكب نكس املف ،تيكبف حرفلا ينفختسفا :فلخ لقا نع ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع لاإ كربخأ ام اللهو ينإ :لقاو ءامسلا ىلإ هدي عفرف :لقا ؟كريغ .لجو زع الله نع ،ليئربج
englishText: Through Khalaf ibn Hammad al-Kufi (in a hadith) who said: I entered upon Abu al Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) in Mina and said to him: One of your followers married a young maiden (virgin) who had not yet menstruated. When he deflowered her, blood flowed and continued flowing without stopping for about ten days. And the midwives differed regarding that matter, as some of them said: It is menstrual blood, while others said: It is virginal blood. So what should she do? He replied: She should fear Allah. If it is menstrual blood, she should refrain from prayer until she sees purity, and her husband should keep away from her. And if it is virginal blood, she should fear Allah, perform ablution, pray, and her husband may approach her if he wishes to do so. I said to him: "How would they know what it is so they can do what is needed?" He then looked right and left in the tent, fearing that someone might hear the conversation. Then he rose towards me and said: "O Khalaf! (This is) Allah's secret, so do not spread it, and do not teach these people the fundamentals of Allah's religion. Rather, be content with what Allah has been content for them of misguidance." Distinguishing Menstrual Blood From Virginity Blood And The Ruling ... He said: Then he made ninety with his left hand, then said: Insert the cotton, then leave it for a while, then remove it gently. If the blood forms a ring around the cotton, then it is from defloration, and if the blood is pooled in the cotton, then it is from menstruation. Khalaf said: Joy overwhelmed me and I wept. When my crying subsided, he asked: "What made you cry?" I said: "May I be sacrificed for you, who else but you could master this?" He then raised his hand to the sky and said: "By Allah, I only tell you what comes from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), from Gabriel, from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic."

chapter: Distinguishing Menstrual Blood From Virginity Blood And The Ruling For Each
arabicText: عنصت فيك ،اموي اهنع عطقني لا اريثك ءامد تأرف هتمأ وأ هتأرما ضتفا لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لئس اهعم كسمتو لستغت ،ةرذعلا نم هنفإ مدلبا ةقوطم ةنطقلا تجرخ نفإ فسركلا كسمت :لقا ؟ةلاصلبا .ضيحلا مياأ ةلاصلا نع دعقت ثمطلا نم وهف مدلبا اسمغنم فسركلا جرخ نفإ ،ليصتو ةنطق
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who deflowered his wife or slave-girl, and she saw abundant blood that did not stop from her for a day, how should she deal with prayer? He said: She should insert cotton; if the cotton comes out with blood around its edges, then it is from defloration- she should perform ghusl, keep cotton with her, and pray. But if the cotton comes out soaked in blood, then it is from menstruation - she should refrain from prayer during the days of menstruation. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The intended bathing here is from major impurity and it is obvious, for virginity blood does not necessitate bathing as previously discussed and forthcoming.

chapter: Distinguishing Menstrual Blood From Virginity Blood And The Ruling For Each
arabicText: مل وأ تثمط ةيراج ىرتشا وأ ةيراج جوزت لجر كادف تلعج :(ملاسلا هيلع) يضاملا نسحلا يبلأ تلق .يلايلو امياأ ثكمف مدلا بلغ اهعرتفا املف ،تثمط ام لوأ يف وأ ثمطت ضيحلا نم ناك نإ :لاقف مسبتف :لقا ،ةرذعلا نم :لقا ضعبو ،ةضيحلا نم :لقا ضعبف لباوقلا تيرفأ ،بحأ نإ اهلعب اهيتيأو لصتلو أضوتلف ةرذعلا نم ناك نإو ،ةلاصلا نع كسمتلو اهلعب اهنع كسميلف ،هوعيذت لاف الله رس فلخ يا :لاقف ؟ةرذعلا نم مأ ،وه ضيحلا نم ملعت نأ اهل فيكو كادف تلعج :تلق وهف مدلبا ةعقنتسم تجرخ نإو ،ةرذعلا نم وهف مدلبا ةقوطم ةنطقلا تجرخ نفإ اهجرخت مث ةنطق لخدتست .ثمطلا نم
englishText: I said to Abul-Hasan Al-Madhi (peace be upon him): May I be sacrificed for you, a man married a girl or bought a slave girl who had menstruated or had not menstruated, or was in her first menstruation. When he deflowered her, blood persisted for days and nights. The midwives were consulted, and some said it was from menstruation, while others said it was from virginity. He smiled and said: If it is from menstruation, then her husband should abstain from her and she should abstain from prayer. If it is from virginity, then she should perform ablution, pray, and her husband may approach her if he wishes. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, how can she know if it is from menstruation or from virginity? He said: O Khalaf, this is God's secret so do not spread it. She should insert cotton and then remove it. If the cotton comes out with blood around its edges, it is from virginity, and if it comes out soaked in blood, it is from menstruation.

chapter: Differentiating Menstrual Blood From Irregular Bleeding, And The Requirement For Women With Irregular Cycles To Use Discrimination Or Refer To Narrations
arabicText: مد نإ ،دحاو ناكم نم ناجرخي سيل ضيحلاو ةضاحتسلاا مد نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .راح ضيحلا مد نإو دربا ةضاحتسلاا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, the blood of istihadha and menstruation do not come from the same place. The blood of istihadha is cold, while the blood of menstruation is warm.

chapter: Differentiating Menstrual Blood From Irregular Bleeding, And The Requirement For Women With Irregular Cycles To Use Discrimination Or Refer To Narrations
arabicText: وأ وه ضيح (أ) يردت لاف مدلا اهب رمتسي ةأرملا نع هتلأسف ةأرما (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لىع تلخد ناك اذفإ ،دربا ،رفصأ ةضاحتسلاا مدو ،ةرارحو عفد هل ،دوسأ ،طيبع ،راح ضيحلا مد نإ :اهل لاقف :لقا ؟هريغ .اذه لىع داز ام ةأرما ناك ول نأ اللهو :لوقت يهو تجرخف :لقا ،ةلاصلا عدتلف داوسو عفدو ةرارح مدلل
englishText: I came to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), and a woman asked him about a woman who experiences continuous bleeding and does not know whether it is menstrual blood or something else. He said to her: Indeed menstrual blood is hot, fresh, black, has force and heat, while irregular bleeding (istihadha) is yellow and cold. So when the blood has heat, force, and blackness, she should leave the prayer. [The narrator] said: She left saying: By Allah, even if it was a woman [answering], she wouldn't have explained it better than this.

chapter: Differentiating Menstrual Blood From Irregular Bleeding, And The Requirement For Women With Irregular Cycles To Use Discrimination Or Refer To Narrations
arabicText: :" لقا نأ ىلإ " تلخدف اهل نذفأ اهل تنذأتسفا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ لىع اهلخدا نأ انم ةأرما ينتلأس يه مث دحاو مويب ترهظتسا ةرشع ناك نإ :لقا ؟اهضيح مياأ زوجتف ضيحت ةأرملا يف لوقت ام :هل تلاقف ،ةضاحتسم مث اهضيح مياأ سلجت :لقا ؟ةلاصلبا عنصت فيك ةثلاثلاو نيرهشلاو رهشلا اهب رمتسي مدلا نفإ :تلقا ،نيتلاص لكل لستغت امف كلذ لثم رخأتيو ،ةثلاثلاو نيمويلاو مويلا ضيحلا مدقتي ناكو ،اهيلع فلتخت اهضيح مياأ نإ هل :تلقا :لقا ،دربا دسفا مد ةضاحتسلاا مدو ،ةقرح هل دجت راح مد وه ،ءافخ هب سيل ضيحلا مد :لقا ؟هب اهملع :!؟ةرم ةأرما ناك هارتأ :تلاقف اهتلاوم ىلإ تتفتلفا
englishText: A woman from among us asked me to let her meet Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him). I sought permission for her, and he granted it. She entered... [until he said]: She asked him, "What do you say about a woman whose menstruation extends beyond her usual period?" He said, "If it was ten days, she should wait one additional day, then she is considered in a state of istihadha." She asked, "What if the bleeding continues for a month, two months, or three months? How should she perform her prayers?" He replied, "She should refrain from prayer during her usual menstrual days, then perform ghusl for every two prayers." She then asked him, "What if her menstrual days vary, sometimes coming earlier by one, two, or three days, and sometimes later by the same amount? How should she distinguish it?" He answered, "Menstrual blood is unmistakable; it is warm blood that causes a burning sensation, while istihadha blood is abnormal (*) and cold." She then turned to her female companion and said, "Do you think he was once a woman?!" Translator: * The word used is "fasid" which literally means corrupt, spoiled, defective, or abnormal. In this context it refers to blood that is abnormal or irregular compared to normal menstrual blood.

chapter: Differentiating Menstrual Blood From Irregular Bleeding, And The Requirement For Women With Irregular Cycles To Use Discrimination Or Refer To Narrations
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لاقف ،هتقو يف ةنسلاو ضئاحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ اولأس دحاو ريغ نع طلتخا مث ةمدقتم مياأ اهل تناك دق يتلا ةنس امأو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - ننس ثلاث ضئاحلا يف نس (هلآو هيلع ،كلذ ريغ اهتنس نفإ رهشلا نم اضومو اهددع تلفغأ ىتح تصقنو تدازف مدلا لوط نم اهيلع اهل لاقف ،رهطأ لاو ضاحتسأ ينإ :تلاقف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا تتأ شيبح يبأ تنب ةمطفا نأ كلذو تبدأ اذإو .ةلاصلا يعدف ةضيحلا تلبقأ اذفإ قرع وه امنإ ،ضيحب كلذ سيل :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةرفص تناكف اهتخلأ نكرم يف سلجت تناكو ،ةلاص لك تقو يف لستغت تناكو ،ليصو مدلا كنع ليسغفا ،ءاملا ولعت مدلا لاأ ؟كلت هب رمأ ام ريغب هذه رمأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر عمست امأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا ليستغفا تربدأ اذإو ،ةلاصلا يعدف ةضيحلا تلبقأ اذإ :اهل لقا نكلو ؟كءارقأ مياأ ةلاصلا يعد اهلقي مل هارت ،!؟ليصو لاو ضاحتسأ ينإ :لوقت اهعمست لاأ ،اهتقو لاو اهددع فرعت مل ،اهمياأ اهيلع طلتخا دق ةأرما هذه نأ نيب اذهف تجاتحا اذهلف طلاتخلااو ةبيرلا نوكت اذه نم لقأ يفف نينس عبس تضيحتسا اهنإ :لوقي يبأ ناكو ؟رهطأ ،فرعي دوسأ ضيحلا مد نأ كلذوهريغ ىلإ داوسلا نم هنول ريغتو هربادإ نم مدلا لابقإ فرعت نأ ىلإ امف ةردكلاو ةرفصلا نوكت نأ ضيحلا يف ةنسلا نلا ،مدلا نول ةفرعم ىلإ تجاتحا ام اهمياأ فرعت تناك ولو ،كلذ ريغو ادوسأ مدلا ناك نإ هلك اضيح تفرع اذإ ضيحلا مياأ يف اهقوف اهددعو ميالأا تلهج اذفإ ،ةمولعم ميالأا تناك اذإ هلك ضيح ضيحلا مياأ ةريثكو مدلا ليلق نأ كل نيبي اذهف ،كلذ ردق لىع ةلاصلا عدت مث ،هنول ريغتو هربادإو مدلا لابقإ ىلإ ذئنيح رظنلا ىلإ تجاتحا رميأ مل امك ،ةضاحتسم تنفأ تداز امف اموي اذكو اذك يسلجا :اهل لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ىرأ لاو تلاسف تضاحتسا انلهأ نم ةأرما نأ كلذو ،اذه لثم يف ىتفأ (ملاسلا هيلع) يبأ كلذكو ،كلذب ىلولأا راهن نم ةعاس ولو رهطلا تيأر اذإو ،ةلاصلا يعدف ينارحبلا مدلا تيأر اذإ :لاقف كلذ نع (ملاسا هيلع) يبأ ،ليصو ليستغفا ىرت لاأ ىلولأا ةضاحتسملا يف هباوج ريغ انهه (ملاسلا هيلع) يبأ باوج ىرأو :(ملاسا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا اهرمفأ ،ةلاصلا عدتلف ينارحبلا مدلا تيأر اذإ :انهه لقاو ،ميالأا ددع ىلإ رظن هنلأ ؟اهئارقأ مياأ ةلاصلا عدت لقا هنأ نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لوق ىنعم هبش ،ينارحبلا :هلوقو ،ريغتو ربدأو لبقأ اذإ مدلا ىلإ رظنت نأ انه ،هنولو هترثكل اينارحب يبأ هامس امنإو فرعي دوسأ ضيحلا مد ناك ام مدلبا اهفرعت امنإو ،اهفرعت لا ىتح اهمياأ اهيلع طلتخا يتلا يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةنس هذهف اهتنسف نااولأ مدلا اهيلع ريغتو ترختأو تمدقتو اهيلع ميالأا تطلتخا نإ " :لقا نأ ىلإ " هريثكو ميالأا ليلق نم .هتلااح ريغتو هربادإو مدلا لابقإ
englishText: From several people who asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about menstruation and its established practice regarding timing, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) established three practices for menstruation- until he said: As for the practice of one who had previous regular days but then became confused due to prolonged bleeding, increasing and decreasing until she forgot her count and its time in the month, her practice is different. This is because Fatima bint Abi Hubaish came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: "I have persistent bleeding and do not become pure." The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to her: "This is not menstruation. It is rather a vein. When menstruation approaches, leave prayer. When it retreats, wash off the blood and pray." She used to perform ritual bath at every prayer time and would sit in Differentiating Menstrual Blood From Irregular Bleeding, And The Re... her sister's washing tub where the yellowness of blood would rise to the water's surface. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Don't you hear that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered her differently than the other? Don't you see he didn't tell her to leave prayer during her menstrual days? Rather he said to her: "When menstruation approaches, leave prayer, and when it retreats, perform ritual bath and pray"? This clearly shows that this woman had become confused about her days, not knowing their number or timing. Don't you hear her saying: "I have persistent bleeding and do not become pure"? My father used to say she had persistent bleeding for seven years, so confusion and uncertainty can occur in less time than this. This is why she needed to recognize the approaching and retreating of blood and its color change from black to other colors, as menstrual blood is distinctively black. Had she known her days, she wouldn't have needed to recognize the blood color, because the established practice regarding menstruation is that yellowness and turbidity and above during known menstrual days are all considered menstruation, whether the blood is black or otherwise. This clarifies for you that little or much blood during menstrual days is all considered menstruation when the days are known. When days and their count are unknown, one needs to observe the blood's approach, retreat, and color change, then leave prayer accordingly. I don't see that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) told her to sit for so many days and consider anything beyond that as persistent bleeding, just as he didn't order the first woman to do so. Similarly, my father (peace be upon him) gave fatwa in similar cases. A woman from our family had persistent bleeding and asked my father (peace be upon him) about it. He said: "When you see the dark blood, leave prayer, and when you see purity even for an hour of the day, perform ritual bath and pray." Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: I see my father's answer here differs from his answer about the first case of persistent bleeding. Don't you see he said there to leave prayer during her menstrual days? Because he considered the number of days. And here he said: "When you see the dark blood, leave prayer." Here he ordered her to observe the blood when it approaches, retreats, and changes. His saying "dark" (*) is similar to the Prophet's saying that menstrual blood is distinctively black. My father called it dark due to its abundance and color. This is the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) practice regarding one who becomes confused about her days until she doesn't recognize them, and she only recognizes them through blood whether the days are few or many- until he said- If the days become confused for her, advancing and retreating, and blood changes colors, her practice depends on the blood's approach, retreat, and changing conditions. Translator: * "Dam al-Bahraani" refers to the heavy, dark-colored blood that is typically seen during the main days of menstruation. It is a definitive indication of menstruation as opposed to other types of bleeding that may occur outside of the menstrual period.

chapter: That Yellowish And Brownish Discharge During Menstruation Days Is Menstruation, And During Pure Days Is Pure, And Preference Of Habit Over Distinction
arabicText: تأر نإو ،اهمياأ يضقنت ىتح ليصت لا :لاقف اهمياأ يف ةرفصلا ىرت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .تلصو تأضوت اهمياأ ريغ يف ةرفصلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who sees yellowish discharge during her days, he said: She should not pray until her days end, and if she sees yellowish discharge outside her days, she should perform ablution and pray.

chapter: That Yellowish And Brownish Discharge During Menstruation Days Is Menstruation, And During Pure Days Is Pure, And Preference Of Habit Over Distinction
arabicText: نإو ،ضيحلا نم وهف نيمويب ضيحلا لبق ناك نإ :لاقف ةرفصلا ىرت ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ضيحلا نم سيلف نيمويب ضيحلا دعب ناك ليصفت لىع ةضاحتسا وهف راهظتسلااو ةداعلا دعب ام امأو ،نيموي وأ مويب مدقتت دق ةداعلا نأ ههجو :لوقأ .ىلاعت الله ءاش نإ يتيأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who sees yellowish discharge, he said: If it occurs two days before menstruation then it is from menstruation, and if it occurs two days after menstruation then it is not from menstruation. I (Hurr Amili) say: The reasoning is that the regular cycle may advance by a day or two, and as for what comes after the regular cycle and precautionary period, it is irregular bleeding according to details that will come, insha'Allah.

chapter: That Yellowish And Brownish Discharge During Menstruation Days Is Menstruation, And During Pure Days Is Pure, And Preference Of Habit Over Distinction
arabicText: نم وهف ةرمح وأ ةرفص نم اهضيح مياأ يف ةأرملا تأر ام (ثيدح يف) :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ضيحلا نم سيلف اهضيح مياأ دعب هتأر ام لكو ،ضيحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: (in a hadith) Whatever yellowish or reddish discharge a woman sees during her menstruation days is from menstruation, and whatever she sees after her menstruation days is not from menstruation.

chapter: That Yellowish And Brownish Discharge During Menstruation Days Is Menstruation, And During Pure Days Is Pure, And Preference Of Habit Over Distinction
arabicText: ةرفص تناك نإو لصت مل اهتداع مياأ ءاضقنا لبق ةرفصلا ةأرملا تأر اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .تلص اهئرق مياأ ءاضقنا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a woman sees yellowish discharge before the end of her regular days, she should not pray, and if the yellowish discharge is at the end of her menstrual days, she should pray.

chapter: That Yellowish And Brownish Discharge During Menstruation Days Is Menstruation, And During Pure Days Is Pure, And Preference Of Habit Over Distinction
arabicText: ناك ام :لاقف ؟ةرفصلا ىرت ةأرملا نع رضاح ناأو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس لقا ةزمح يبأ نب ليع نع .هنم سيلف ضيحلا دعب ناك امو ،ضيحلا نم وهف ضيحلا لبق
englishText: From Ali bin Abi Hamza who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked while I was present about a woman who sees yellowish discharge? He said: What comes before menstruation is from menstruation, and what comes after menstruation is not from it.

chapter: That Yellowish And Brownish Discharge During Menstruation Days Is Menstruation, And During Pure Days Is Pure, And Preference Of Habit Over Distinction
arabicText: نم سيلف ضيحلا مياأ دعبو ،ضيحلا نم وهف نيمويب ضيحلا لبق ةرفصلا لقا :لقا ميكح نب ةيواعم نع .ضيحلا ضيحلا مياأ يف يهو ،ضيحلا
englishText: From Muawiya bin Hakim who said: Yellowish discharge two days before menstruation is from menstruation, and after menstruation days is not from menstruation, and during menstruation days is menstruation.

chapter: That Yellowish And Brownish Discharge During Menstruation Days Is Menstruation, And During Pure Days Is Pure, And Preference Of Habit Over Distinction
arabicText: :لقا ؟عنصت فيك اهثمط مياأ ةرفصلا ىرت ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع لاف اهلسغ دعب ةرفص تأر نفإ ،ليصتو لستغت مث اهثمط يف دعقت تناك يتلا اهمياأ دعب ةلاصلا كلذل كرتت .ليصتو ةلاص لك دنع ءوضولا اهيزجي ،اهيلع لسغ
englishText: From his brother Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a woman who sees yellowish discharge during her menstruation days, what should she do? He said: She should leave prayer for that after her days which she used to sit in her menstruation, then perform ghusl and pray. If she sees yellowish discharge after her ghusl, no ghusl is required of her, ablution is sufficient for her before each prayer and she should pray. chapter: That Yellowish And Brownish Discharge During Menstruation Days Is Menstruation, And During Pure Days Is Pure, And Preference Of Habit Over Distinction
arabicText: كلذ لثم بهذيو نيتعاسلاو ةعاسلاو نيمويلاو مويلا اهارتف اهثمط مياأ ريغ يف مدلا ىرت ةأرملا نع هتلأس اهنع عطقنا املك لستغتو مدلا ماد ام اهلاح كلت تناك اذإ ةلاصلا كرتت :لقا ،عنصت فيك اهارت ةرفص نم) اهيلع لسغ لاو ليصتو ةرفصلا نم أضوتتلف ةرفصلا ىرت تماد ام :لقا ؟عنصت فيك :تلق .مدلل اهكرتك ةلاصلا تكرت اهثمط مياأ يف ةرفص تأر نفإ ،اهثمط مياأ يف (لاإ
englishText: I asked him about a woman who sees blood outside her menstruation days, seeing it for a day or two, or an hour or two, and it goes away like that, what should she do? He said: She should leave prayer when that is her condition as long as there is blood, and perform ghusl whenever it stops. I said: What should she do? He said: As long as she sees yellowish discharge, she should perform ablution from the yellowish discharge and pray, and no ghusl is required of her (from yellowish discharge she sees except) during her menstruation days. If she sees yellowish discharge during her menstruation days, she should leave prayer as she leaves it for blood.

chapter: That Yellowish And Brownish Discharge During Menstruation Days Is Menstruation, And During Pure Days Is Pure, And Preference Of Habit Over Distinction
arabicText: مياأ يفو ضيح ضيحلا مياأ يف ةرفصلا نأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) مهنع يور :لقا (طوسبملا) يف نسحلا نب دمحم .رهط رهطلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Al-Hasan in (Al-Mabsut) said: It is narrated from them (peace be upon them) that yellowish discharge during menstruation days is menstruation and during pure days is pure.

chapter: Obligation Of A Woman With Regular Menstrual Cycles To Return To Her Regular Days Even If Exceeding Ten Days Without Considering The Distinction
arabicText: لوسر نإ :لاقف ،؟هتقو يف ةنسلاو ضيحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ اولأس دحاو ريغ نع ،سنوي نع عدي لا ىتح ،اهمهفو اهعمس نمل لكشم لك اهيف نيب ،ننس ثلاث ضيحلا يف نس (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله مث اهيلع طلاتخا لاب اهتضحا دق ةمولعم مياأ اهل يتلا ضياحلفا ننسلا ىدحإ امأ ،يأرلبا هيف لااقم دح لا ،اهتدع غلبمو اهمياأ فرعت كلذف يهو مدلا اهب رمتسفا تضاحتسا هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تلأسف ةملس مأ تتفا تضاحتسا شيبح يبأ تنب ةمطفا :اهل لاقي ةأرما نفإ رفثتستو لستغت نأ اهرمفأ قرع وه امنإ :لقا ،اهضيح ردق وأ اهئارقأ ردق ةلاصلا عدت :لاقف كلذ نع (هلآو ،ليصتو بوثب طلتخت مل ،اهئارقأ مياأ فرعت يتلا يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةنس هذه :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا اهل نس امنإو ،!؟ةضاحتسم تنفأ اموي اذك لىع تداز اذإ لقي ملو ؟يه موي مك اهلأسي مل هنأ ىرت لاأ ،اهيلع ،اهفرعت نأ دعب ريثك وأ ليلق نم تناك ام ةمولعم امياأ ناطيشلا نم ةضكر وأ رباع قرع كلذ امنإ :لاقف ةضاحتسملا نع لئسو ،(ملاسلا هيلع) يبأ ىتفأ كلذكو ،بعثملا لثم لاس نإو :لقا ؟لاس نإو :ليق ،ةلاص لكل أضوتتو لستغت مث ،اهئارقأ مياأ ةلاصلا عدتلف هذهف ،هل قفاوم وهو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ثيدح ريسفت اذه :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا ةضاحتسملا تلااح عيمجف - :لقا نأ ىلإ - ترثك وأ ،تلق ،اهمياأ لاإ اهل تقو لاو اهئارقأ مياأ فرعن يتلا ةنس يهف ريثك وأ ليلق نم ةمولعم مياأ اهل تناك نإ نهنم ةدحاو نم ولخت ادبأ داكت لا ثلاثلا ننسلا هذه لىع رودت .اهمياأ ريغ تقوم مولعم ددع هيف سيل ،اهيلع ترج يتلا اهتقلخو اهمياأ لىع
englishText: From Yunus, from several people who asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about menstruation and its timing according to the Sunnah. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) established three practices regarding menstruation, clarifying every difficulty for those who hear and understand them, leaving no room for personal opinion. As for one of the practices, it concerns the menstruating woman who has known days without confusion, then experiences continuous bleeding. In this case, she knows her days and their number. A woman named Fatima bint Abi Hubaish experienced prolonged bleeding, so she went to Umm Salamah who asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) about it. He said: She should leave prayer for the duration of her regular period or menstruation. He said: It is merely a vein, so he ordered her to perform ghusl, wrap herself with cloth, and pray. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: This is the Prophet's practice regarding she who knows her regular days without confusion. Don't you see that he didn't ask her how many days it was? And didn't say if it exceeds so many days then you are in istihadha?! Rather, he established for her known days, whether few or many, as long as she knows them. Obligation Of A Woman With Regular Menstrual Cycles To Return To He... Similarly, my father (peace be upon him) gave fatwa and was asked about the woman with istihadha, so he said: This is merely a passing vein or a kick from Satan, so she should leave prayer during her regular days, then perform ghusl and make wudu for each prayer. It was asked: Even if it flows? He said: Even if it flows like a spout. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: This is the explanation of the Prophet's hadith and it agrees with it. This is the practice for she who knows her regular days and has no timing except her days, whether few or many- until he said: So all cases of istihadha revolve around these three practices, never being void of one of them. If she has known days, whether few or many, she follows her days and her natural cycle, with no specific numbered limit other than her days.

chapter: Obligation Of A Woman With Regular Menstrual Cycles To Return To Her Regular Days Even If Exceeding Ten Days Without Considering The Distinction
arabicText: اهمياأ تزاج اذإو ،اهلعب اهبرقي لاو اهيف ليصت لاف اهمياأ رظنت ةضاحتسملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رصعلاو رهظلل تلستغا فسركلا بقثي مدلا تأرو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The woman with istihadha should observe her days and not pray during them nor should her husband approach her, and when her days pass and she sees blood penetrating the cotton, she should perform ghusl for Dhuhr and Asr.

chapter: Obligation Of A Woman With Regular Menstrual Cycles To Return To Her Regular Days Even If Exceeding Ten Days Without Considering The Distinction
arabicText: لئس :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لاقف ؟ضاحتست ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لستغت مث اهيف ليصت لا اهضيح مياأ ثكمت نأ اهرمفأ ضاحتست ةأرملا نع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman with istihadha? He said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about a woman with istihadha, so he ordered her to wait during her menstrual days without praying, then perform ghusl.

chapter: Obligation Of A Woman With Regular Menstrual Cycles To Return To Her Regular Days Even If Exceeding Ten Days Without Considering The Distinction
arabicText: :لقا ،؟مدلا ىرت يهو اهرهط تقو يضمي مث ضيح ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع " ةضاحتسم يهف مدلا رمتسا نفا ،مياأ ةرشعلا نود اهضيح ناك نإ مويب رهظتست :لاقف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman who menstruates then her time of purity passes while she still sees blood? He said: She should wait one extra day if her menstruation is less than ten days, and if the blood continues then she has istihadha.

chapter: Obligation Of A Woman With Regular Menstrual Cycles To Return To Her Regular Days Even If Exceeding Ten Days Without Considering The Distinction
arabicText: .ضيحلا نم سيلف اهضيح مياأ دعب هتأر ام لكو - ثيدح يف - لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said- in a hadith- whatever she sees after her menstrual days is not from menstruation.

chapter: Obligation Of A Woman With Regular Menstrual Cycles To Return To Her Regular Days Even If Exceeding Ten Days Without Considering The Distinction
arabicText: يتلا اهمياأ ددع ةلاصلا نع كسمتلف :لقا - لماحلا نميح ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ام دعب لاإ اهنع مدلا عطقني مل نإو ،لصتلو لستغتلف كلذ لبق اهنع مدلا عطقنا نفإ ،اهضيح يف دعقت تناك .ةضاحتسملا ماكحأ ركذ مث ،لستغتلف نيموي وأ مويب اهيف مدلا ىرت تناك يتلا ميالأا يضمت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith about a pregnant woman- he said: She should refrain from prayer for the number of days she used to observe during her menstruation. If the blood stops before that, she should perform ghusl and pray. If the blood doesn't stop except after the days she used to see blood by a day or two, she should perform ghusl, then he mentioned the rulings for istihadha.

chapter: Obligation Of A Woman With Regular Menstrual Cycles To Return To Her Regular Days Even If Exceeding Ten Days Without Considering The Distinction
arabicText: وأ مويب رهظتست :لقا ؟عنصت فيك اهمياأ ددعب دعقت ثماطلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةضاحتسم يه مث نيموي
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a menstruating woman who observes her regular days, what should she do? He said: She should wait one or two extra days, then she has istihadha.

chapter: Rulings On Blood Discontinuation During Menstruation, Its Return, And Rulings On Confusion Of Menstruation Days
arabicText: ،مياأ ةينامث وأ مياأ ةعبس اهضيح نوكي ةأرملفا :هل تلق :لقا " ثيدح يف " (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لستغت :لقا ؟امد لاو ةرفص لا ضايبلا ىرتو مدلا اهنع عطقني مث مياأ ةثلاث ضيحت مث ،ميقتسم مئاد اهضيح .ليصتو ىرت اهنفإ :تلق ،مايصلاو ةلاصلا نع تكسمأ مدلا تأر اذإ :لقا ،مدلا دوعي مث موصتو ليصتو لستغت تلق رمتساو اهضيح مياأ تضم اذفإ ،تلص رهطلا تأر اذإو ،تكسمأ مدلا تأر اذإ :لاقف :لقا ،اموي رهطتو اموي مدلا .هلك اهرمأ كل تمظتنا دق ،ةضاحتسم يهف مدلا تأر اذفإ ،تلص رهطلا اهب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) "in a hadith" he said: I asked him: What about a woman whose menstruation is seven or eight days, her menstruation being regular and consistent, then she menstruates for three days then the blood stops and she sees white discharge with no yellowness or blood? He said: She should perform ghusl and pray. I said: She performs ghusl, prays and fasts, then the blood returns. He said: When she sees blood, she should stop praying and fasting. I said: What if she sees blood one day and is pure one day? He said: When she sees blood she should stop, and when she sees purity she should pray. When her menstruation days pass and purity continues, she should pray. If she sees blood after that, she is in istihadha. I have explained her entire situation to you.

chapter: Rulings On Blood Discontinuation During Menstruation, Its Return, And Rulings On Confusion Of Menstruation Days
arabicText: رهطلا ىرت اهنفإ :تلق ،ةلاصلا عدت :لقا ،ةعبرأ وأ مياأ ةثلاث مدلا ىرت ةأرملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يب لا تلق رهطلا ىرت اهنفإ :تلق ،ةلاصلا عدت :لقا ؟ةعبرأ وأ مياأ ةثلاث مدلا ىرت اهنفإ تلق ،ليصت :لقا ،ةعبرأ وأ مياأ ةثلاث نيبو امهنيب ام عنصت ةلاصلا عدت :لقا ،ةعبرأ وأ مياأ ةثلاث مدلا ىرت اهنفإ تلق ،ليصت :لقا ،ةعبرأ وأ مياأ ةثلاث .ةضاحتسملا ةلزنمب يهف لاإو مدلا اهنع عطقنا نفإ ،رهش
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A woman sees blood for three or four days. He said: She should leave prayer. I said: Then she sees purity for three or four days. He said: She should pray. I said: Then she sees blood for three or four days? He said: She should leave prayer. I said: Then she sees purity for three or four days. He said: She should pray. I said: Then she sees blood for three or four days. He said: She should leave prayer and continue this pattern until a month; if the blood stops, fine, otherwise she is considered in the state of istihadha.

chapter: Rulings On Blood Discontinuation During Menstruation, Its Return, And Rulings On Confusion Of Menstruation Days
arabicText: ،مياأ ةسمخ رهطلاو مياأ ةسمخ مدلا ىرت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ريصب يبأ نع نيبو اهنيب ام تلص رهطلا تأر نإو ،لصت مل مدلا تأر نإ :لاقف ،؟مياأ ةتس رهطلا ىرتو مياأ ةعبرأ مدلا ىرتو لك تقو يف فسركلبا تشتحاو ترفثتساو تلستغا ابيبص امد تأرف اموي نوثلاث تمت اذفإ ،اموي نيثلاث .تأضوت ةرفص تأر اذفإ ةلاص اهتقاوأ نع تريغتو ضيحلا يف اهتداع تطلتخا ةأرما لىع امهلمحن نأ نيربخلا نيذه يف هجولا :خيشلا لقا لثم ةضاحتسلاا مد هبشي ام ىرتو مياأ ةعبرأ ضيحلا مد هبشي ام ىرت وأ ،هريغ نم ضيحلا مد اهل زيمتي ملو ةضاحتسلاا مد هبشي ام تأر املك ليصتو ،ضيحلا مد هبشي ام تأر املك ةلاصلا كرتت نأ اهضرفف :لقا ،كلذ .رهش ىلإ اذه :لوقن نا لا مياأ ةرشع نم لقأ نوكي لا رهطلا :لاقي لاو ،هب سبأ لا ليوتأ اذه :)ربتعملا( يف ققحملا لقاو .ىهتنا طايتحلابا هيف لمعف هبتشم مد وه لب ،اضيح لاو نيقيلا لىع رهطب سيل اذه نكلو ،قح
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who sees blood for five days and purity for five days, and sees blood for four days and sees purity for six days? He said: If she sees blood, she should not pray, and if she sees purity, she should pray for the duration between that and thirty days. When thirty days are complete and she sees flowing blood, she should perform ghusl, use a sanitary pad, and stuff cotton at the time of each prayer. If she sees yellowish discharge, she should perform wudu. The Shaykh said: The proper understanding of these two reports is that we interpret them regarding a woman whose menstrual habit has become irregular and changed from its usual times, and she cannot distinguish menstrual blood from other blood, or she sees what resembles menstrual blood for four days and sees what resembles istihadha blood for the same period. He said: Her obligation is to leave prayer whenever she sees what resembles menstrual blood, and pray whenever she sees what resembles istihadha blood up to a month. Al-Muhaqqiq said in (Al-Mu'tabar): This interpretation is acceptable, and if it is said that the period of purity cannot be less than ten days, we say: this is true, but this is neither definitive purity nor menstruation, rather it is questionable blood, so precaution was exercised in dealing with it.

chapter: Establishing The Menstrual Period By The Consistency Of Two Months, The Necessity Of Referring To It In The Third Month, And Its Non-establishment By One Month Only
arabicText: .اهمياأ كلتف ءاوس مياأ ةدع نارهش قفتا اذفإ - :لقا نأ ىلإ - ضيحت ام لوأ ركبلا ةيراجلا نع هتلأس
englishText: I asked him about the virgin girl when she first menstruates- until he said:- If two months match in the same number of days, then those are her days.

chapter: Establishing The Menstrual Period By The Consistency Of Two Months, The Necessity Of Referring To It In The Third Month, And Its Non-establishment By One Month Only
arabicText: ملو ةمدقتم مياأ اهل تسيل يتلا يفف ةثلاثلا ةنسلا امأو :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع اهنفإ عبس نم رثكأو عبس نم لقأ يف مدلا عطقنا نفإ - :لقا نأ ىلإ - تكردأ ام لوأ تأرو طق مدلا ىرت ،ليصتو رهطلا ىرت ةعاس لستغت يلاوت ىتح ءاوس لولأا رهشلا يف هتقول مدلا عطقنا نفإ يناثلا رهشلا يف نوكي ام رظنت ىتح كلذك لازت لاف ،هاوس ام عدتو ،هيلع لمعت ،فاورعم اقلخو اتقو اهل راص دق كلذ نأ نلاا ملع دقف ثلاث وأ ناتضيح هيلع يلاوت نأ تقولا لعج امنإو ،اهئارقأ سلجت نأ ىلإ ةنس تراص دق تضاحتسا نإ لبقتست اميف اهتنس نوكتو ،كئارقأ مياأ ةلاصلا يعد :اهمياأ فرعت يتلل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لوقل ثلاث وأ ناتضيح اهيلع هنادأو ،ءارقلأا اهل نس نكلو ،كئرق مياأ ةلاصلا يعد :اهل لوقيف اهل ةنس دحاولا ءرقلا لعجي مل هنأ انملعف .ادعاصف ناتضيح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: As for the third year, it is for the one who has no previous days and has never seen blood before and saw it for the first time when she reached maturity- until he said:- If the blood stops in less than seven or more than seven days, she should perform ghusl as soon as she sees purity and pray. She continues like this until she observes what happens in the second month. If the blood stops at the same time as in the first month, until two or three menstrual cycles follow the same pattern, then it is now known that this has become her regular time and known nature, which she should follow and leave anything else. Her practice for future reference if she experiences irregular bleeding has become established until she observes her menstrual periods. The time was set to be established by two or three consecutive menstrual cycles because of the saying of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) to the woman who knows her days: "Leave prayer during the days of your menstrual periods." Thus, we learned that he did not make a single menstrual cycle a practice for her by saying "Leave prayer during your menstrual period," but rather he established for her the menstrual periods, with a minimum of two cycles and above.

chapter: Obligation For The Beginner To Distinguish (Between Menstrual And Non-Menstrual Bleeding) If The Duration Exceeds Ten Days
arabicText: لىع رهظتست مث اهئارقبأ يدتقتف اهئاسن ضعب رظنت نأ ةضاحتسملل بجي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .مويب كلذ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: A woman experiencing irregular bleeding (istihadha) must observe the menstrual cycles of her female relatives and follow their pattern, then add one extra day for precaution.

chapter: Obligation For The Beginner To Distinguish (Between Menstrual And Non-Menstrual Bleeding) If The Duration Exceeds Ten Days
arabicText: ءارقأ لثم اهئارقأ لاقف ؟اهئارقأ مياأ فرعت لا يهو رهشأ ةثلاث اهمد مادف اهضيح لوأ تضاح ةيراج نع هتلأس .مياأ ةثلاث هلقأو ،مياأ ةرشع اهسولج رثكفأ تافلتخم اهئاسن تناك نفإ ،اهئاسن
englishText: I asked him about a girl who had her first menstruation and her bleeding continued for three months, and she does not know her menstrual periods? He said: Her periods are like the periods of her female relatives, and if her female relatives have different durations, then her maximum sitting (menstrual period) is ten days, and minimum is three days.

chapter: Obligation For The Beginner To Distinguish (Between Menstrual And Non-Menstrual Bleeding) If The Duration Exceeds Ten Days
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لاقف ،هتقو يف ةنسلاو ضيحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ اولأس دحاو ريغ نع مياأ اهل سيل يتلا يفف ةثلاثلا ةنسلا امأو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - ننس ثلاث ضيحلا يف نس (ملسو هلآو هيلع ،ةيناثلاو ىلولأا ةنس ريغ هذه ةنس نفإ هب رمتسفا تكردأ ام لوأ تأرو ،طق مدلا ىرت ملو ةمدقتم لاقف ،؟ةديدش ةضيح تضحتسا ينإ تلاقف الله لوسر تتأ شحج تنب ةنمح :اهل لاقي ةأرما نأ كلذو الله ملع يف رهش لك يف يضيحتو يمجلت ،لاقف ،اجث هجثأ ينإ ،كلذ نم دشأ هنإ تلاقف ،افسرك يشتحا رجفلل ليستغاو نيرشعو ةعبرأ وأ اموي نيرشعو ةثلاث يموصو ،لاسغ ليستغا مث مياأ ةعبس وأ مياأ ةتس ،لاسغ ليستغاو ءاشعلا ليجعو برغملا يرخأو ،لاسغ ليستغاو رصعلا ليجعو رهظلا يرخأو ،لاسغ فلاخم اهرمأ نأ كلذو ،ةيناثلاو ىلولأا يف نس ام ريغ هذه يف نس دق هارفأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا ،؟اعبس يضيحت :اهل لقا ام كلذ نم لقأ وأ اسمخ تناكو عبس نم لقأ تناك ول اهمياأ نأ ىرت لاأ ،كنيترملا ،ضئاح ريغ ةضاحتسم يهو امياأ ةلاصلا كرتب اهرمأ دق نوكيف ديزي امم مث ،ضئاح يهو ةلاصلبا اهرميأ مل رثكأ وأ ارشع اهمياأ تناكو عبس نم رثكأ اهضيح ناك ول كلذكو ،ضئاحلا لمعت ام فلكت نأ ديرت يتلا ةأرملل لاإ ضيحتلا نوكي سيلو ،يضيحت :اهل هلوق ناايب اذه اهل ناك دق هنلأ ،الله ملع يف :اهل هلوق اذه نيبي اممو ،كضيح مياأ يضيحت ةمولعم امياأ اهل لقي مل هارت لاأ ةنس هذهو ،طق كلذ لبق مياأ اهل نكي مل هذه نأ حضاو نيب اذهف ،ىلاعت الله ملع يف اهلك ءايشلأا تناك نإو مياأ اهل ريصي ىتح نورشعو ثلاث هرهط ىصقأو ،عبس اهتقو ىصقأ ،هارت ام لوأ مدلا (اهب) هب رمتسا يتلا ،اهيلإ لقتنتف ةمولعم مياأ اهل تناك نإ نهنم ةدحاو نم ولخت ادبأ داكت لا ثلاثلا ننسلا هذه لىع رودت ةضاحتسملا تلااح عيمجف ريغ تقوم مولعم ددع اهيف سيل ،اهيلع ترج يتلا اهتقلخو (اهم) مياأ لىع يهف ريثك وأ ليلق نم ةمولعم ريغتو هربادإو مدلا لابقإ اهتنسف نااولأ مدلا اهيلع ريغتو ترختأو تمدقتو اهيلع ميالأا تطلتخا نفإ ،اهمياأ ،هتلااح مدلا رمتسا نفإ ،نورشعو ثلاث اهرهطو عبس اهتقوف تأر ام لوأ تضاحتساو كلذ لبق مياأ اهل نكي مل نإو يف لستغت اهنفإ عبس نم رثكأ وأ عبس نم لقأ يف مدلا عطقنا نإو ،اهل لقا امك رهش لك يف تلعف ارهشأ- :لقا نأ يلإ - يناثلا رهشلا يف نوكي ام رظنت ىتح كلذك لازت لاف ليصتو رهطلا ىرت ةعاس مدلا لابقإب تلمع نول لىع مدلا نم لاو دح لىع اهنم فقت لا ىتح تصقنو تدازو اهمياأ اهيلع طلتخا نإو يعدف ةضيحلا تلبقأ اذإ :(ملسو هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لوقل ،اذه ريغ ةنس اهل سيلو هربادإو مدلا تيأر اذإ " :يبأ لوقك " فرعي دوسأ ضيحلا مد نإ " :(ملاسلا هيلع) هلوقلو ليستغفا تربدأ اذإو ةلاصلا " ينارحبلا ةلاحو دحاو نول لىع مدلا ناكو ةراد ةضاحتسلاا لزت ملف اهيلع قبطأ مدلا نكلو كلذك رملاا نكي مل نفإ .اجث هجثأ ينإ :تلقا نيح ةنمح ةصقك اهتصق نلا نورشعلاو ثلاثلاو عبسلا اهتنسف ةدحاو
englishText: From several individuals who asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about menstruation and its established timing, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) established three rulings regarding menstruation- until he said: As for the third ruling, it concerns the woman who has no previous menstrual pattern and has never seen blood before, but when she first experiences it, it continues. Her ruling differs from the first and second cases. This is because a woman called Hamna bint Jahsh came to the Messenger of Allah and said: I am experiencing severe menstrual bleeding. He said: Use cotton. She said: It's more severe than that, it flows heavily. He said: Wear protection and consider yourself menstruating for six or seven days each month in Allah's knowledge, then perform ghusl. Fast for twenty-three or twenty-four days, perform ghusl for Fajr, delay Dhuhr and hasten Asr with ghusl, delay Maghrib and hasten Isha with ghusl. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: I see that he established different rules for her than the first two cases, because her situation differs from the other two women. Don't you see that if her days were less than seven, say five or less, he wouldn't have told her to consider seven days? For then he would have ordered her to leave prayer while she was in istihadha, not menstruation. Similarly, if her menstruation was more than seven days, say ten or more, he wouldn't have ordered her to pray while menstruating. What further clarifies this is his saying to her "consider yourself menstruating," as this instruction is only given to a woman who needs to know what actions of a menstruating woman to follow. Notice he didn't specify exact days or say "menstruate during your menstrual days." What also clarifies this is his saying "in Allah's knowledge," because although everything is in Allah's knowledge, this clearly shows she had no previous pattern at all. This is the ruling for one who experiences continuous bleeding when first seeing it: maximum of seven days, and maximum of twenty-three days of purity, until she establishes a regular pattern to follow. Obligation For The Beginner To Distinguish (Between Menstrual And N... All cases of istihadha revolve around these three rulings, never deviating from one of them. If she has known days, whether few or many, she follows her regular pattern and nature, with no specific count other than her days. If her days become confused, moving earlier or later, and blood changes colors, her ruling follows the blood's appearance and disappearance and its changing states. If she had no previous pattern and experienced istihadha from first sight, her period is seven days and purity twenty-three days. If bleeding continues for months, she follows these instructions monthly. If bleeding stops before or after seven days, she performs ghusl when seeing purity and prays, continuing thus until seeing what happens the next month - until he said: If her days become confused, increasing and decreasing until she can't determine a limit or blood color, she acts according to the blood's appearance and disappearance, having no other ruling, as the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "When menstruation comes, leave prayer, and when it goes, perform ghusl" and his saying: "Menstrual blood is black and recognizable" like Abu's saying: "When you see the dark blood." If not thus, but bleeding continues constantly with one color and state, her ruling is seven and twenty-three days because her case is like Hamna's when she said: "It flows heavily."

chapter: Obligation For The Beginner To Distinguish (Between Menstrual And Non-Menstrual Bleeding) If The Duration Exceeds Ten Days
arabicText: مكو ةرفصلا تأر اذإو ،مدلا تأر اذإ عنصت فيك ةضاحتسملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .نيتلاصلا نيب عمجتو ةرشع هرثكأو ةثلاث ضيحلا لقأ :لاقف ؟ةلاصلا عدت
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman experiencing irregular menstrual bleeding (Istihadha), what should she do when she sees blood, and when she sees yellowish discharge, and for how long should she leave prayer? He said: The minimum duration of menstruation is three days and its maximum is ten days, and she should combine between the two prayers.

chapter: Obligation For The Beginner To Distinguish (Between Menstrual And Non-Menstrual Bleeding) If The Duration Exceeds Ten Days
arabicText: ةلاصلبا رظتنت اهنأ ةضاحتسم نوكتف مدلا اهيلع عفدي ضيحت ام لوأ ةيراجلا يف :لقا ،ريكب نب الله دبع نع ةضاحتسملا هلعفت ام تلعف مياأ ةرشع وهو كلذ ىضم اذفإ ضيحلا نم نوكي ام رثكأ ىضمت ىتح ليصتف ،اهرهش ةيقب ليصت تثكمف تلص مث ،مياأ ةثلاث وهو ،ثمطلا نم نوكي ام لقأ سلجتو ةلاصلا ةأرما كرتت ام لقأ ةيناثلا ةرملا يف ةلاصلا كرتت مث اهكرتو ،رهطلا نم نوكي ام رثكأ اهرهط تقو تلعجو .تلص يتلا ةلاصلا تقو يف تلص ضيحلا اهيلع ماد نفإ .ضيحلا نم نوكي ام لقأ ةلاصلل
englishText: From Abdullah bin Bakeir, he said: For a virgin girl experiencing her first period, if the blood flows continuously, making her a mustahada (woman with istihadha), she should wait and pray until the maximum duration of the period has passed. When that is over, which is ten days, she should act as a mustahada and then pray. She should continue praying for the rest of her month. Then, in the second instance, she should abandon prayer for the minimum that a woman abandons prayer, which is three days, being the minimum duration of menstruation. If the period continues beyond that, she should pray at the time she had prayed previously. She should make her purity period the maximum duration of purity, and her abandonment of prayer the minimum duration of menstruation.

chapter: Obligation For The Beginner To Distinguish (Between Menstrual And Non-Menstrual Bleeding) If The Duration Exceeds Ten Days
arabicText: ةرشع ةلاصلا تكرت مدلا اهب رمتسفا اهضيح لوأ يف مدلا تأر اذإ ةأرملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نيرشعو ةعبس تلصو مياأ ةثلاث ةلاصلا تكرت كلذ دعب مدلا اهب رمتسا نفإ ،اموي نيرشع ليصت مث ،مياأ .اموي ناقباطم سنوي ثيدحو ثيدحلا اذه نأ ركذ مث ،تافلتخم نك وأ ءاسن اهل سيل نم لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ اهلك لوصلأل
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a woman sees blood at the beginning of her menstruation and the blood continues with her, she leaves prayer for ten days, then prays for twenty days. If the blood continues with her after that, she leaves prayer for three days and prays for twenty-seven days. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this to be about a woman who has no female relatives [to consult] or they differ [in their cycles], then he mentioned that this hadith and the hadith of Yunus are in accordance with all principles.

chapter: Establishing Doubt When Purity Exceeds a Month and that Menstruation Occurs Once Every Month
arabicText: .ةبير وهف رهشلا زاجأ ام :لاقف (متبترا نإ) لجو زع الله لوق نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about the words of Allah the Mighty and Majestic "if you are in doubt" and he said: Whatever exceeds a month is doubt.

chapter: Establishing Doubt When Purity Exceeds a Month and that Menstruation Occurs Once Every Month
arabicText: .ةرم رهش لك يف ءاسنلل دح الله نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Indeed Allah set for women once every month.

chapter: Establishing Doubt When Purity Exceeds a Month and that Menstruation Occurs Once Every Month
arabicText: يف ءاسنلا نك دقو ،اهب لجو زع الله نهامر ةساجن ءاسنلل ضيحلا نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رقابلا رفعج وبأ لقا نقلطنفا ةأرما ةأمعبس نكو ،نهبيراحم نم ةوسن جرخ ىتح ةضيح ةنسلا يف ةأرملا ضيحت امنإ حون نمز ندهشو ،لاجرلا عم نسلجف دلابلا يف نقرفتف نجرخ مث ،نرطعتو نيلحتو ،بايثلا نم تارفصعملا نسبلف ،مهفوفص يف نسلجو مهعم دايعلأا نيب نم نجرخفأ نهئامد تلاسف ،نهنايعبأ ةوسنلا كئلوأ ينعي ،رهش لك يف كلذ دنع ضيحلبا الله نهامرف نلعف ام لثم نلعفي مل يتاوللا ءاسنلا نم نهريغ ناكو (:لقا نأ ىلإ) ةضيح رهش لك يف نضحي نكف لاجرلا لك يف ،نضحي يتاوللا تانب ةضيح رهش لك يف نضحي يتاوللا ونب جوزتف لقا ،ةضيح ةنس لك يف نضحي .موقلا جزتمفا ةضيح ةنس ةماقتسلا ةضيح رهش لك يف نضحي يتاوللا دلاوأ رثكو ةضيح رهش لك يف ءلاؤهو ءلاؤه تانب نضحف .كئلوأ لسن لقو ءلاؤه لسن رثكف :لقا ،مدلا داسفل ةضيح ةنس لك يف نضحي يتاوللا دلاوأ لقو ضيحلا
englishText: Abu Ja'far Al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said: Menstruation for women is an impurity that Allah the Mighty and Majestic afflicted them with. Women in the time of Noah used to menstruate only once a year until some women left their prayer niches, and they were seven hundred women. They went and wore saffron-dyed clothes, adorned themselves, and perfumed themselves. Then they went out and dispersed in the lands, sat with men, attended festivals with them, and sat in their rows. So Allah afflicted them with menstruation at that time every month, meaning those specific women. Their blood flowed and they were removed from among the men, and they would menstruate every month (until he said): And other women who did not do what they did would menstruate once a year. He said: Then the sons of those who menstruated monthly married the daughters of those who menstruated yearly, so the people mixed. The daughters of both groups menstruated monthly, and the children of those who menstruated monthly increased due to the regularity of menstruation, while the children of those who menstruated yearly decreased due to blood irregularity. He said: So the offspring of these increased and the offspring of those decreased. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The hadiths indicating that menstruation occurs once every month are numerous and scattered, as previously mentioned and will be mentioned later. So the beginner (mubtadi'ah) and the woman with irregular cycles (mudtaribah) should act upon that when the blood continues if there is no distinction, as previously stated.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: .مياأ ةرشع نوكي ام هرثكأو ،مياأ ةثلاث ضيحلا نوكي ام لقأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The minimum menstruation period is three days, and its maximum is ten days.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: .ةرشع هدعبأو ،ةثلاث هنادأ :لاقف ،؟ضيحلا نم نوكي ام ىندأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about the minimum duration of menstruation, and he said: Its minimum is three, and its maximum is ten.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: .ةرشع هرثكأو مياأ ةثلاث :لاقف ضيحلا نم نوكي ام ىندأ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the minimum duration of menstruation, and he said: Three days and its maximum is ten.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: ةريثك تناك امبر ضيحت ام لوأ ةأرملا نأ كلذو ،مياأ ةرشع رهطلا ىندأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع مياأ ةثلاث ىلإ تعجر اذفإ ،مياأ ةثلاث ىلإ عجرت ىتح تصقن تربك املك لازت لاف مياأ ةرشع اهضيح نوكيف مدلا ،مياأ ةثلاث نم لقأ نوكي لاو اهضيح عفترا وهو ضيحلا نم وهف مياأ ةثلاث اهل مت نإو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - ةلاصلا تكرت اهضيح مياأ يف مدلا ةأرملا تأر اذفإ .ءاضقلا اهيلع بجي ملو ضيحلا ىندأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The minimum period of purity is ten days, and that's because when a woman first menstruates, she might have heavy bleeding for ten days, and as she grows older it decreases until it returns to three days. When it returns to three days her menstruation rises and it's never less than three days. When awomansees blood in her menstruation days she leaves prayer- until he said and if she completes three days then it is from menstruation and it is the minimum of menstruation and she doesn't have to make up for it.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: .ترهظتسا لقأ تناك اذفإ ،رهظتست مل مياأ ةرشع ةأرملا مياأ تناك اذإ لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a woman's days are ten days she doesn't need to wait extra days, but if it's less she should wait extra days. Translator: If a woman's usual period is the maximum of ten days, she doesn't need to add any extra days. However, if her usual period is less than ten days, she should add extra days to ensure that her bleeding has completely stopped before considering herself pure.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: .ةسمخ اهطسوأو ةرشع اهرثكأو مياأ ةثلاث ضيحلا لقأ نأ يور :لقا (ثيدح) يف نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn in a hadith said: It is narrated that the minimum menstruation is three days and its maximum is ten and its middle is five.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: ةسمخ هطسوأو ،مياأ ةثلاث هلقأ ضيحلا نإ - :لقا نأ ىلإ ثيدحلا ركذو - هل تلق :لقا ريدس نب نانح نع .مياأ ةرشع هرثكأو مياأ
englishText: From Hanan bin Sudayr who said: I said to him- and he mentioned the hadith until he said: The minimum menstruation is three days, its middle is five days and its maximum is ten days.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: .مياأ ةثلاث هلقأو ،مياأ ةرشع ضيحلا رثكأ :لقا - ليوط ثيدح - يف (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) in a long hadith, he said: The maximum menstruation is ten days, and its minimum is three days.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: ،مياأ ةرشع ةأرملا ضيح مياأ رثكأو :لقا - نيدلا عيارش ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع موصلا كرتتو ،اهيضقت لاو ةلاصلا كرتت ضئاحلاو ،ليصتو يشتحتو لستغت ةضاحتسملاو ،مياأ ةثلاث اهلقأو .هيضقتو
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him)- in a hadith about religious laws he said: The maximum days of woman's menstruation is ten days, and its minimum is three days, and the woman with irregular bleeding should perform ghusl and use cotton and pray, while the menstruating woman leaves prayer and doesn't make up for it, and leaves fasting but makes up for it. Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: .ةرشع هاصقأو ،ةثلاث ضيحلا ىندأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said: The minimum menstruation is three, and its maximum is ten.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: لبق مدلا تأر اذإو ،ةثلاث ضيحلا نوكي ام لقأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ملسم نب دمحم نع .ةلبقتسم ىرخأ ةضيح نم وهف مياأ ةرشع دعب هتأر اذإو .ىلولأا ةضيحلا نم وهف مياأ ةرشع
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The minimum menstruation is three, and if she sees blood before ten days then it's from the first menstruation. And if she sees it after ten days then it's from another new menstruation.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: .ةرشع هرثكأو ،ةثلاث ضيحلا لقأ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: The minimum menstruation is three, and its maximum is ten.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: لاف اطيبع مدلا ناك نإ :لقا ،؟نيمويلاو مويلا مدلل ىرت لىبحلا ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس ةثلاثلا ىأر اذإ ام لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .نيتلاص لك دنع لستغتلف ةرفص ناك نإو ،نيمويلا كنيذ لصت .ةرشع ةلمج يف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a pregnant woman who sees blood for one or two days? He said: If the blood is fresh then she shouldn't pray those two days, and if it's yellowish then she should perform ghusl for every two prayers. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as when she sees three days within ten days. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh interpreted it as when she sees three days within a total of ten days.

chapter: Minimum Menstruation Being Three Days And Maximum Being Ten Days
arabicText: .ةثلاث هنم نوكي ام ىندأو ،نامث ضيحلا نم نوكي ام رثكأ نإ لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع كلذ نأو ،نامث ضيحلا رثكأ نأ نم ثيدحلا اذه هنمضت ام فلاخ لىع تعمجأ ةفئاطلا نأ خيشلا ركذ :لوقأ هجتملا :ىقتنملا بحاص لقاو .مياأ ةينامث اهتداع نوكت ةأرما لىع هلمح مث ،انباحصأ نم دحأ هربتعي مل ليبس لىع ةرشعلا غولب نفإ كلذك رملااو عرشلا يف لا ،بلاغلاو ةداعلا بسحب ةيرثكلأا ةدارإ لىع هلمح .هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقت دقو .ىهتنا دوهعم ريغ دايتعلاا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The maximum menstruation is eight, and its minimum is three. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh mentioned that the sect unanimously disagreed with what this hadith contained about the maximum being eight, and that none of our companions considered this, then he interpreted it as referring to a woman whose habit is eight days. The author of Al-Muntaqa said: The appropriate interpretation is to consider it as referring to the majority in terms of habit and what's common, not in terms of religious law, and that's correct because reaching ten days habitually is not known. End quote. What indicates this has preceded, and what indicates it will come.

chapter: Minimum Period Of Purity Between Two Menstruations Is Ten Days
arabicText: نيح نم ةرشع نوكي ام لقأ داز امف مياأ ةرشع نم لقأ يف ءرقلا نوكي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .مدلا ىرت نأ ىلإ رهطت
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: The period between menstruations cannot be less than ten days. The minimum is ten days from when she becomes pure until she sees blood.

chapter: Minimum Period Of Purity Between Two Menstruations Is Ten Days
arabicText: لقأ رهطلا نوكي لاو - :لقا نأ ىلإ ثيدحلا ركذو - مياأ ةرشع رهطلا ىندأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .مياأ ةرشع نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The minimum period of purity is ten days- and he mentioned the hadith until he said:- and the period of purity cannot be less than ten days.

chapter: Minimum Period Of Purity Between Two Menstruations Is Ten Days
arabicText: دعب ناك نإو ،ىلولأا ةضيحلا نم وهف مياأ ةرشع لبق مدلا ةأرملا تأر اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةلبقتسملا ةضيحلا نم وهف ةرشعلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: If a woman sees blood before ten days, it is from the first menstruation, and if it is after ten days, it is from the next menstruation.

chapter: Minimum Period Of Purity Between Two Menstruations Is Ten Days
arabicText: مدلا تيأر اذإ :لاقف كلذ نع يبأ تلأسف تضاحتسا انلهأ نم ةأرما نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ليصت اهنأ لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ .ليصو ليستغفا راهن نم ةعاس ولو رهطلا تيأر اذإو ،ةلاصلا يعدف ينارحبلا .رهاظ وهو رهطلا عومجم ةعاسلا نأ لىع لا ،ائيش رظتنت لاو ،رهطلا نم ةعاس لوأ يف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: A woman from our family experienced irregular bleeding, so she asked my father about it. He said: When you see the dark blood, leave the prayer, and when you see purity even for an hour of the day, perform ghusl and pray. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted to mean that she prays in the first hour of purity without waiting for anything, not that the hour is the total period of purity, which is apparent.

chapter: Minimum Period Of Purity Between Two Menstruations Is Ten Days
arabicText: .ةلبقتسم ىرخأ ةضيح نم وهف مياأ ةرشع دعب مدلا تأر اذإو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: And if she sees blood after ten days, it is from another, upcoming menstruation.

chapter: Whether Consecutiveness Is Required In The Minimum Period Of Menstruation Or If Three Days Within Ten Days Is Permissible
arabicText: دعب ناك نإو ،ىلولأا ةضيحلا نم وهف ةرشع لبق مدلا ةأرملا تأر اذإو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةلبقتسملا ةضيحلا نم وهف ةرشعلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: If a woman sees blood before ten days, it is from the first menstruation, and if it is after ten days, it is from the next menstruation.

chapter: Whether Consecutiveness Is Required In The Minimum Period Of Menstruation Or If Three Days Within Ten Days Is Permissible
arabicText: رمتسا نفإ ،ةلاصلا تكرت اهضيحأ يف مدلا ةأرملا تأر اذفإ :- ثيدح يف - لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع موي نم ترظتناو تلصو تلستغا نيموي وأ اموي هتأر ام دعب مدلا عطقنا نإو ،ضئاح يهف مياأ ةثلاث مدلا اهب ،مياأ ةرشع ىلإ مدلا تأر يف هتأر يذلا مدلا كلذف مياأ ةثلاث اهل متي ىتح نيموي وأ اموي مدلا تأر موي نم مياأ ةرشعلا كلت يف تأر نفإ ،ضيحلا نم وه ةرشعلا يف كلذ دعب هتأر يذلا اذه عم رملأا لوأ امنإ ،ضيحلا نم نكي مل هتأر يذلا نامويلاو مويلا كلذف مدلا رت ملو مياأ ةرشع - مدلا تأر موي نم اهب رم نإو مل اهنلأ ،اهتكرت يتلا نيمويلا كلت ةلاصلا ديعت نا اهيلعف ،فوجلا نم امإو اهفوج يف ةحرق امإ :ةلع نم ناك ،نيمويلاو مويلا يف ةلاصلا نم تكرت ام يضقت نأ بجيف اضئاح نكت ةرشع نم لقأ رهطلا نوكي لاو ،ءاضقلا اهيلع بجي ملو ،ضيحلا ىندأ وهو ضيحلا نم وهف مياأ ةثلاث اهل مت نإو ،تلصو تلستغا مدلا عطقنا مث مياأ ةسمخ اهضيح ناكو ةأرملا تضاح اذفإ ،مياأ نم مدلا تأر نفإ ،ةلاصلا عدت ،ضيحلا نم كلذف مياأ ةرشع ترهط موي نم اهل متي ملو مدلا كلذ دعب تأر نفإ مث ،مياأ ةرشع يناثلاو لولأا مدلا تأر ام لوأ نم تدع اهيلع مادو مياأ ةرشعلا مامت هتأر يذلا يناثلا هتأر ام لوأ .ةضاحتسملا هلمعت ام لمعت ةضاحتسم يه
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said- in a hadith: When a woman sees blood during her menstrual days, she leaves prayer. If the blood continues for three days, she is menstruating. If the blood stops after she sees it for a day or two, she performs ghusl, prays, and waits from the day she saw blood until ten days. If during those ten days from when she first saw blood, she sees blood for a day or two until it completes three days, then that blood she saw at first along with what she saw later within the ten days is from menstruation. If ten days pass from when she first saw blood and she doesn't see blood, then that day or two days in which she saw blood was not from menstruation, rather it was from an ailment: either an internal wound or from the internal organs, so she must make up those two days of prayers she left, because she wasn't menstruating so she must make up the prayers she left during that day or two days. If three days complete for her then it is from menstruation and that is the minimum for menstruation, and she doesn't have to make up [the prayers], and the period of purity cannot be less than ten days. When a woman menstruates and her menstruation is five days then the blood stops, she performs ghusl and prays. If she sees blood after that and ten days haven't completed from the day she became pure, then that is from menstruation, she leaves prayer. If she sees blood from the first time she saw it the second time she saw it completing ten days and it continues, she counts ten days from when she first saw blood the first and second time, then she is in istihadha and does what a woman in istihadha does.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: تقو لبق مدلا تأر اذإ :لاقف ،؟اهضيح تقو لبق مدلا ىرت ةأرملا نع هتلأس لقا ةعامس نع ،ةعرز نع صبرتلف نهيف ضيحت تناك يتلا اهمياأ نم رثكأ ناك نفإ ،تقولا اهب لجعت امبر هنفإ ،ةلاصلا عدتلف اهضيح .ةضاحتسملا عنصت امك عنصتلف اهنع مدلا عطقني ملو مياأ ةثلاث تصبرت اذفإ ،اهمياأ ىضمت ام دعب مياأ ةثلاث
englishText: From Zur'ah, from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about a woman who sees blood before her menstrual time? He said: When she sees blood before her menstrual time, she should leave prayer, as the time might have come early. If it exceeds her usual days of menstruation, she should wait three days after her usual days pass. If after waiting three days the blood doesn't stop, she should do as a woman with irregular bleeding does.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: .ترهظتسا لقأ تناك اذفإ ،رهظتست مل ةرشع ةأرملا مياأ تناك اذإ لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a woman's days are ten, she shouldn't take precautionary days, but if they are less, she should take precautionary days.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: اهضيح مياأ ناك نإ لقا ،اهضيح مياأ زوجتف ضيحت ةأرملا يف - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةضاحتسم يه مث دحاو مويب ترهظتسا مياأ ةرشع نود
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- regarding a woman whose menstruation exceeds her usual days, he said: If her menstrual days are less than ten days, she should take one precautionary day, then she is considered as having irregular bleeding.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: :لقا ،؟مدلا ىرت يهو اهرهط تقو ىضمي مث ضيحت ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع مدلا عطقنا نإو ،ةضاحتسم يهف مدلا رمتسا نفإ ،مياأ ةرشعلا نود اهضيح ناك نإ مويب رهظتست :لاقف .تلصو تلستغا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I asked him about a woman who menstruates then her time of purity passes while she still sees blood? He said: She should take one precautionary day if her menstruation is less than ten days. If the blood continues, she has irregular bleeding, and if it stops, she should perform ghusl and pray.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: لىع رهظتست مث اهئارقبأ يدتقتف اهئاسن ضعب رظنت نأ ةضاحتسملل بجي :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .لولأا مكحلبا صوصخم انه بوجولا :لوقأ .مويب كلذ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A woman with irregular bleeding should look to some of her female relatives and follow their menstrual pattern, then take one precautionary day after that. I (Hurr Amili) say: The obligation here is specific to the first ruling.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: تناك يتلا ميالأا لىع مدلا داز اذفإ ،ضيحت تناك يتلا اهمياأ دعقت :لقا ؟لبحلا يف مدلا تأر ةأرما نع هتلأس .ةضاحتسم يه مث مياأ ةثلاثب ترهظتسا دعقت
englishText: I asked him about a woman who sees blood during pregnancy? He said: She should wait her usual menstrual days, and if the blood exceeds her usual days, she should take three precautionary days, then she has irregular bleeding.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: ارهط تأر يه نفإ ،نيموي وأ مويب طاتحت مث ،اهئرق مياأ دعقت ةضاحتسملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .تلستغا
