englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A woman with irregular bleeding should wait her menstrual days, then take precaution for one or two days, and if she sees purity, she should perform ghusl.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: دعب قيقرلا مدلا نم ئشلا كلذ دعب تأر امبرو رهطت مث ضيحت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ليصت مث ةثلاث وأ نيمويب اهمياأ دعب رهظتست :لاقف ؟اهرهط نم لاستغا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who menstruates then Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular P... becomes pure, but sometimes sees light blood after performing ghusl for her purity? He said: She should take two or three precautionary days after her days, then pray.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: وأ نيموي وأ مويب رهظتست :لاقف ؟رهظتست مك ضياحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع .ةثلاث
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him): I asked him how many precautionary days should a menstruating woman take? He said: She should take one, two, or three precautionary days.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: تناك ام ةدع رظتنت :لاقف ،؟اهسولج دحو ثماطلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا يبأ نع .ةضاحتسم يه مث مياأ ةثلاثب رهظتست مث ضيحت
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him): I asked him about menstruation and the limit of its duration? He said: She should wait her usual menstrual days then take three precautionary days, then she has irregular bleeding.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: ناك نإ :لاقف ،؟مدلا ىرت يتلا ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،لجر نع ،ةريغملا نب الله دبع نع .رهظتست مل ةرشع اهمياأ تناك نإو ،ةرشعلا ترظتنا ةرشعلا نود اهئرق
englishText: From Abdullah bin Al-Mughirah, from a man, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who sees blood? He said: If her period is less than ten days, she should wait until ten, and if her days are ten, she shouldn't take precautionary days.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: :لقا ؟ليصت نأ اهل يغبني ىتم اهتقو زواجت ىتح اهضيح يف مدلا تأر ةأرما :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق لك تقو يف لستغتلف ابيبص امد مدلا تأر نفإ ،مياأ ةرشعب رهظتست مث ،سلجت تناك يتلا اهتدع رظتنت .ةلاص ءابلا لعجف مياأ ةرشع ىلإ هانعم :خيشلا لقاو ،ضيحلا رثكأ اهنلأ مياأ ةرشع مامتب رهظتست اهنأ دارملا :لوقأ .ىلإ ىنعمب
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A woman saw blood during her menstruation until it exceeded her time, when should she pray? He said: She should wait her usual duration, then take precaution up to ten days, and if she sees flowing blood, she should perform ghusl at the time of each prayer. I (Hurr Amili) say: What's meant is that she takes precaution up to completing ten days because it's the maximum for menstruation, and Al-Shaykh said: Its meaning is up to ten days, interpreting "bi" (with) to mean "ila" (until).

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: مويب رهظتست :لقا ؟عنصت فيك اهمياأ ددعب دعقت ثماطلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ ،ةرارز نع .ةضاحتسم يه مث نيموي وأ
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a menstruating woman who waits her usual days, what should she do? He said: She should take one or two precautionary days, then she has irregular bleeding.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: .نيموي وأ مويب رهظتست ةضاحتسملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A woman with irregular bleeding should take one or two precautionary days.

chapter: Recommendation Of Extra Precautionary Days For Women With Regular Periods When Bleeding Continues For One Or More Days Up To Ten Days
arabicText: ةلاصلا نع دعقتلف اهيف مدلا ىرت تناك يتلا اهمياأ دعب امد تأر اذإ ضئاحلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .راهظتسلاا بوجو مدع لىعو ،هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .نيموي وأ اموي
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding a menstruating woman who sees blood after her usual days: she should abstain from prayer for one or two days. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What indicates this has preceded, and what indicates this and the non obligation of taking precautionary days will follow.

chapter: Obligation Of Menstruating Women To Leave Prayer From The First Sight Of Blood, And That Beginners And Those With Irregular Cycles Should Leave Prayer With Conditions Until The Situation Becomes Clear
arabicText: ةثلاث رهشلا يفو نيموي رهشلا يف دعقتف ضيحت ام لوأ ركبلا ةيراجلا نع هتلأس :لقا نارهم نب ةعامس نع ىرت تماد ام ةلاصلا عدتو سلجت نأ اهلف :لقا ،؟ءاوس مياأ ةدع رهشلا يف اهثمط نوكي لا اهيلع فلتخي مياأ .اهمياأ كلتف ءاوس مياأ ةدع نارهشلا قفتا اذفإ ،ةرشعلا زجي مل ام مدلا
englishText: From Sama'ah bin Mihran who said: I asked him about a virgin girl who first menstruates, and she sits for two days in one month and three days in another month, it varies for her and her menstruation isn't the same number of days each month? He said: She should sit and leave prayer as long as she sees blood, as long as it doesn't exceed ten days. When two months align with the same number of days, those become her days.

chapter: Obligation Of Menstruating Women To Leave Prayer From The First Sight Of Blood, And That Beginners And Those With Irregular Cycles Should Leave Prayer With Conditions Until The Situation Becomes Clear
arabicText: هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا بوقعي نب سنوي نع ،ريمع يبأ نبا نع ،هيبأ نع ،ميهاربإ نب ليع نعو .ةلاصلا عدت :لقا ،؟ةعبرأ وأ مياأ ةثلاث مدلا ىرت ةأرملا :(ملاسلا
englishText: From Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Yunus bin Yaqub who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A woman sees blood for three or four days? He said: She should leave prayer.

chapter: Obligation Of Menstruating Women To Leave Prayer From The First Sight Of Blood, And That Beginners And Those With Irregular Cycles Should Leave Prayer With Conditions Until The Situation Becomes Clear
arabicText: رمتسا نفإ ةلاصلا تكرت اهضيح مياأ يف مدلا ةأرملا تأر اذفإ (ثيدح يف) :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نأ اهيلعف :لقا مث ،تلصو تلستغا نيموي وأ اموي هتأر ام دعب مدلا عطقنا ناو ،ضئاح يهف مياأ ةثلاث مدلا اهب .اضئاح نكي مل اهنلأ اهتكرت يتلا نيمويلا كلت ةلاصلا ديعت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: (in a hadith) When a woman sees blood during her menstruation days, she leaves prayer. If the blood continues for three days, she is menstruating. If the blood stops after she sees it for a day or two, she should perform ghusl and pray. Then he said: She must make up the prayers of those two days that she left because she was not menstruating.

chapter: Permissibility Of Slightly Early Menstrual Habits
arabicText: مدلا هيف ىرت تناك يذلا تقولا لبق مدلا لماحلا تأر اذإو :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ةضيحلا نم هنفإ رهشلا كلذ نم تقولا يفوأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When a pregnant woman sees blood before the time she used to see blood or during that time of the month, it is from menstruation.

chapter: Permissibility Of Slightly Early Menstrual Habits
arabicText: امبر هنفإ ةلاصلا عدتلف :لقا ؟اهضيح تقو لبق مدلا ىرت ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس ثيدح يف مدقت دقو .تقولا اهب لجعت
englishText: And it was previously mentioned in the hadith of Sama'ah who said: I asked him about a woman who sees blood before her menstrual time? He said: She should leave prayer because sometimes the time comes early for her.

chapter: Permissibility Of Slightly Early Menstrual Habits
arabicText: وهف ضيحلا لبق ناك ام :لاقف ؟ةرفصلا ىرت ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ريصب يبأ ثيدح يفو .ضيحلا نم
englishText: And in the hadith of Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who sees yellowish discharge? He said: Whatever comes before menstruation is from menstruation.

chapter: Permissibility Of Slightly Early Menstrual Habits
arabicText: دعب ناك امو ،ضيحلا نم وهف ضيحلا لبق ناك ام :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) هنع ةزمح يبأ نب ليع ثيدح يفو .هنم سيلف ضيحلا
englishText: And in the hadith of Ali ibn Abi Hamza from him (peace be upon him), he said: Whatever comes before menstruation is from menstruation, and whatever comes after menstruation is not from it.

chapter: How To Distinguish Between Menstrual Blood And Wound Blood, And The Ruling On Wound Blood
arabicText: مد نم وأ ضيحلا مد نم يردت لئاس مدلاو اهفوج يف ةحرق اهبانم ةاتف :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق نم مدلا جرخ نفإ ،ىطسولا اهعبصإ لخدتستو اهيلجر عفرت مث اهرهظ لىع قلتستلف اهرم :لاقف ؟ةحرقلا .ةحرقلا نم وهف رسيلأا بناجلا نم جرخ نإو ،ضيحلا نم وهف نميلأا بناجلا
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A girl has a wound in her body and blood is flowing, and she doesn't know if it's menstrual blood or wound blood? He said: Tell her to lie on her back, then raise her legs and insert her middle finger. If the blood comes from the right side, it is menstrual blood, and if it comes from the left side, it is from the wound. Translator: Compare with Hadith 2210 and refer to the comment there by Shaykh Hurr Amili.

chapter: How To Distinguish Between Menstrual Blood And Wound Blood, And The Ruling On Wound Blood
arabicText: رسيلأا بناجلا نم مدلا جرخ نفإ لقا هنأ لاإ ،ثيدحلا ركذو هعفر ىيحي نب دمحم نع هدانسإب خيشلا هاورو .ةحرقلا نم وهف نميلأا بناجلا نم جرخ نإو ،ضيحلا نم وهف لعل :ققحملا لقاو ،مهريغو ةملاعلاو ققحملاو قودصلاو ديفملا هركذ امل اهتقفاومل تبثأ خيشلا ةياور :لوقأ ةقفاوم .ةميدقلا خسنلا ضعب يف تدجو خيشلا ةياور نأ لقن دقو ،ىهتنا خسانلا نم وهس ينيلكلا ةياور خيشلا ةياورو ،رخآ ليوتأ اهلوأ ،ةيقت امهيدحإ نوكتو امهددعتو نيتياورلا ةحص دعبي لاو ،ينيلكلا ةياورل .ملعأ اللهو ةحجرم يهف رهشأ
englishText: And the Shaykh narrated it with his chain from Muhammad bin Yahya, raising it and mentioned the hadith, except that he said if the blood comes from the left side it is menstrual blood, and if it comes from the right side it is from the wound. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh's narration is more established as it agrees with what was mentioned by Al-Mufid, Al-Saduq, Al-Muhaqqiq, Al-Allama and others. Al Muhaqqiq said: Perhaps Al-Kulayni's narration was a mistake by the copyist. It has been reported that the Shaykh's narration was found in some old copies matching Al Kulayni's narration. It is not far-fetched that both narrations are correct and multiple, with one being taqiyyah, or having another interpretation. The Shaykh's narration is more famous, so it is preferred, and Allah knows best.

chapter: How To Distinguish Between Menstrual Blood And Wound Blood, And The Ruling On Wound Blood
arabicText: نإو ،ةلاصلا تكرت اهضيح مياأ يف مدلا ةأرملا تأر اذفإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع- :لقا نأ ىلإ - ترظتناو تلصو تلستغا نيموي وأ اموي هتأر ام دعب مدلا عطقنا امنإ ،ضيحلا نم نكي مل هتأر يذلا نامويلاو مويلا كلذف مدلا رت ملو مياأ ةرشع مدلا تأر موي نم اهب رم نإو مل اهنلأ ،اهتكرت يتلا نيمويلا كلت ةلاصلا ديعت نأ اهيلعف ،فوجلا نم امإو ،اهفوج يف ةحرق امإ ةلع نم ناك .نيمويلاو مويلا يف ةلاصلا نم تكرت ام يضقت نأ بجيف اضئاح نكت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When a woman sees blood during her menstrual days, she leaves prayer, and if the blood stops after she sees it for a day or two, she performs ghusl and prays and waits - until he said: And if ten days pass from the day she saw blood and she doesn't see blood, then that day or two days in which she saw it was not from menstruation, it was rather from an ailment, either a wound in her body or from the inside, so she must make up the prayers of those two days that she left, because she was not menstruating, so she must make up the prayers she left during that day or two days.

chapter: Obligation And Method Of Istibra' (Checking) For The Menstruating Woman When Bleeding Stops Before Ten Days
arabicText: مدلا نم ئش اهيف جرخ نفإ ةنطق لخدتستلف لستغت نأ ضئاحلا تدارأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .لصتلو ضوتلف ةرفص كلذ دعب تأر نإو ،لستغتلف ائيش رت مل نإو ،لستغت لاف
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When a menstruating woman wants to perform ghusl, she should insert cotton. If any blood appears on it, she should not perform ghusl. If she sees nothing, she should perform ghusl. If she sees yellowish discharge after that, she should perform wudu and pray.

chapter: Obligation And Method Of Istibra' (Checking) For The Menstruating Woman When Bleeding Stops Before Ten Days
arabicText: امئقا موقت :لقا ،؟لا مأ ترهطأ ىردت لاف مدلا اهنع عطقنا ةأرما نع لئس لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع بباذلا سأر لثم ةنطقلا سأر لىع جرخ نفا ىنميلا اهلجر عفرتو ءاضيب ةنطق لخدتستو طئاحب اهنطب قزلتو .ليصتو لستغت ترهط دقف جرخي مل نإو ،رهطت مل طيبع مد
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who was asked about a woman whose blood has stopped but she doesn't know if she has become pure or not. He said: She should stand upright and press her stomach against a wall, insert white cotton while raising her right leg. If fresh blood appears on the tip of the cotton like the head of a fly, she has not become pure. If nothing appears, she has become pure and should perform ghusl and pray.

chapter: Obligation And Method Of Istibra' (Checking) For The Menstruating Woman When Bleeding Stops Before Ten Days
arabicText: لىع ىرسيلا اهلجرب دمعت :لقا ؟اهرهط ثماطلا فرعت فيك :تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .فسركلا لىع جرخ بباذلا سأر لثم مث ناك نفإ ىنميلا اهديب فسركلا لخدتستو ،طئاحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I asked: How does a menstruating woman know her purity? He said: She should place her left foot against the wall and insert cotton with her right hand. If there is blood like the head of a fly, it will appear on the cotton.

chapter: Obligation And Method Of Istibra' (Checking) For The Menstruating Woman When Bleeding Stops Before Ten Days
arabicText: ؟لا مأ ترهطأ يردت لاف ئشلا وأ ةرفصلا ىرتو رهطلا ىرت ةأرملا :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نأ دارأ اذإ عنصي بلكلا تيأر امك طئاح لىع اهلجر عفرتو طئاح ىلإ اهنطب قصلتلف مقتلف كلذك ناك اذفإ :لقا مل نإو ،رهطت ملف مد جرخ نفإ ،جرخ بباذلا سأر لثم مدلا نم ةمث ناك اذفإ ،فسركلا لخدتست مث ،لوبي .ترهط دقف جرخي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said to him: A woman sees signs of purity but sees yellowish discharge or something and doesn't know if she has become pure or not? He said: When that happens, she should stand and press her stomach against a wall and raise her leg against the wall like you see a dog do when it wants to urinate, then insert cotton. If there is blood there like the head of a fly it will come out. If blood comes out she is not pure, and if nothing comes out then she has become pure.

chapter: What Is Recommended For A Woman Who Sees Drops After Performing Ghusl From Menstruation
arabicText: ةرطقلا تأر تلستغا يه اذفإ اهئارقأ مياأ دعقت باهش ةنبا نإ :هل تلقو (ملاسلا هيلع) ريخلأا نسحلا باأ تلأس ازمغ اهيكرو نيب زمغتلف ةأرما رمتأ مث ،بلكلا موقي امك طئاحلا لصبأ مقتلف اهرم :لاقف :لقا ،؟ةرطقلا دعب ،هلك جرخيس هنفإ ةقارلإا :هل لاقي محرلا يف ىقبي ئش وه امنإ هنفإ اديدش داع امف اهنع عطقنفا لقا يذلا ةأرملبا انلعفف :لقا ،ةرذقلا نهتلعو نهورذو ههبشو اذهب نهوربخت لا :لقا مث .تتام ىتح مدلا اهيلإ
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Akheer (peace be upon him) and said to him: The daughter of Shihab sits during her menstrual days, and when she performs ghusl, she sees drops after drops? He said: Tell her to stand at the base of a wall like a dog stands, then have a woman press firmly between her hips with strong pressure, for it is something that remains in the womb called: Al-Iraaqah (residual fluid), and it will all come out. Then he said: Do not inform them of this and similar matters, and leave them with their unclean ailment. The narrator said: We did with the woman what he said, and it stopped, and blood did not return to her until she died.

chapter: Dislike Of A Woman Looking At Herself At Night During Menstruation
arabicText: رهطلا ىلإ رظنت ليللا فوج يف حابصملبا وعدت نهادحإ تناك ءاسن نأ هغلب هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .اذه نعضي ءاسنلا ناك ىتم :لوقيو كلذ بيعي ناكف
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that it reached him that women, one of them would call for a lamp in the middle of the night to look for signs of purity, and he would criticize that and say: "Since when did women do this?"

chapter: Dislike Of A Woman Looking At Herself At Night During Menstruation
arabicText: اهنإ :لوقيو ،ليللبا ضيحملا يف نهسفنأ ىلإ نرظني نأ ءاسنلا ىهني ناك هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةردكلاو ةرفصلا نوكت دق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he used to forbid women from looking at themselves during menstruation at night, and he would say: "There might be yellowness and turbidity."

chapter: Recommendation For A Menstruating Woman To Perform Ghusl With A Sa' Of Water Or More, And That The Basic Performance Of Ghusl Is Sufficient
arabicText: .ءام نم لاطرأ ةعستب لستغت ثماطلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The menstruating woman performs ghusl with nine ratls of water. Translator: A Ratl is a unit of weight that varies by region, typically ranging from 300 to 900 grams.

chapter: Recommendation For A Menstruating Woman To Perform Ghusl With A Sa' Of Water Or More, And That The Basic Performance Of Ghusl Is Sufficient
arabicText: .اهأزجأ اهرعش نم ءاملا للب غلب ام ضئاحلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: For the menstruating woman, whatever amount of water reaches and wets her hair is sufficient.

chapter: Recommendation For A Menstruating Woman To Perform Ghusl With A Sa' Of Water Or More, And That The Basic Performance Of Ghusl Is Sufficient
arabicText: .قرف :لقا ؟ءاملا نم اهيفكي مك ضئاحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس جاتحي ثيحب خسولاو تاساجنلاو رعشلا ةرثك لىع هلمح نكميو ،لضفلاو غابسلاا لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .ملعأ اللهو كلذ ريغو ةبانجلاو ءوضولا يفو انه رم امل ردقلا كلذ ىلإ
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about how much water is sufficient for a menstruating woman? He said: A faraq (*). I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as referring to thorough washing and excess, and it can be interpreted based on the abundance of hair, impurities, and dirt where that amount might be needed, as has been discussed here and in matters of wudu, janabah, and other cases, and Allah knows best. Translator: * A "faraq" is a unit of volume equal to about 10 liters.

chapter: Permissibility Of Intimacy With The Menstruating Woman After Cessation When Bathing Is Not Possible, After Tayammum
arabicText: اهيفكي ام ءاملا نم اهعم سيلو رفسلا يف يهو رهطلا ىرت ضئاحلا ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :تلق ،ليصتو مميتي مث ،هلسغتف اهجرف هب لسغت ام ردقب اهعم ناك اذإ :؟لقا ةلاصلا ترضح دقو اهلسغل .سبأ لاف تمميتو اهجرف تلسغ اذإ معن :لقا ؟لاحلا كلت يف اهجوز اهيتأيف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a menstruating woman who sees signs of purity while traveling and doesn't have enough water for her ritual bath, and the prayer time has come. He said: If she has enough water to wash her private parts, she should wash them, then perform tayammum and pray. I asked: Can her husband be intimate with her in that state? He said: Yes, if she has washed her private parts and performed tayammum, there is no problem.

chapter: Permissibility Of Intimacy With The Menstruating Woman After Cessation When Bathing Is Not Possible, After Tayammum
arabicText: .معن :لقا ؟اهجوزل لحت له ضيحلا نم تمميت اذإ ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I asked him about a woman who performed tayammum due to menstruation, is she permissible for her husband? He said: Yes.

chapter: Permissibility Of Intimacy With The Menstruating Woman After Cessation When Bathing Is Not Possible, After Tayammum
arabicText: له ،ثالاث وأ نيموي ءاملا دجت ملف رفس يف ترهط مث تضاح ةأرما نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لستغت ىتح اهيلع عقي نأ اهجوزل حلصي لا :لقا ؟اهيلع عقي نأ اهجوزل نم ريثكل هتقفاومل ةيقتلا لىع وأ ميرحتلا لا ةهاركلا لىع وأ ،رابخلاا نود راكنلاا لىع امإ لومحم اذه :لوقأ .الله ءاش نإ يتيأو ىضم املو ةماعلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who menstruated then became pure while traveling but couldn't find water for two or three days, can her husband be intimate with her? He said: It is not appropriate for her husband to be intimate with her until she performs the ritual bath. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted either as a denial rather than information, or as dislike rather than prohibition, or as taqiyyah due to its agreement with the Aammah.

chapter: Menstruating Women Not Having Their Ritual Impurity Lifted
arabicText: وأ لستغت لستغملا يف يهو ضيحتف اهجوز اهعماجي ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لستغت لاف ةلاصلا دسفي ام اهئاج دق :لقا ؟لستغت لا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman whose husband has intercourse with her and then she menstruates while she is in the place of washing, should she perform ghusl or not? He said: Something has come to her that invalidates prayer, so she should not perform ghusl.

chapter: Menstruating Women Not Having Their Ritual Impurity Lifted
arabicText: ةبانجلا لسغ وأ ؟ةبانجلا نع لستغتأ بنج يهو مدلا ىرت ةأرملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .كلذ نم مظعأ وه ام اهتاأ دق :لاقف ؟دحاو ضيحلاو
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A woman sees blood while she is in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah), should she perform ghusl for janabah? Or is the ghusl for janabah and menstruation the same? He said: Something greater than that has come to her.

chapter: Menstruating Women Not Having Their Ritual Impurity Lifted
arabicText: أضوت اهنكلو ،لاف رهطلا امأ لقا ؟الله ركذتو ةعمجلا موي رهطت ضئاحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .الله ركذتو ةلبقلا لبقتست مث ةلاصلا تقو يف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a menstruating woman, can she purify herself on Friday and remember Allah? He said: As for purification, no, but she can perform wudu at prayer time, then face the qibla and remember Allah.

chapter: Menstruating Women Not Having Their Ritual Impurity Lifted
arabicText: نإ :لقا ،؟لستغت نأ لبق ضيحت مث اهجوز اهعقاوي ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ضيحلل ادحاو لاسغ تلستغا ترهط اذفإ ،ئش اهيلع سيلف لعفت مل نإو ،تلعف لستغت نأ تءاش .ثدحلا عافترا يف حيرص ريغ اذه :لوقأ .ةبانجلاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman whose husband has intercourse with her then she menstruates before performing ghusl? He said: If she wishes to perform ghusl she may do so, and if she doesn't there is nothing upon her, and when she becomes pure she performs one ghusl for both menstruation and janabah. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is not explicit regarding the lifting of ritual impurity.

chapter: Ghusl For Menstruation Is Like Ghusl For Janabah And They Overlap
arabicText: .دحاو ضيحلاو ةبانجلا لسغ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،يبلحلا ليع نب الله ديبع نع
englishText: From Ubaydullah bin Ali Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The ghusl for janabah and menstruation is the same.

chapter: Ghusl For Menstruation Is Like Ghusl For Janabah And They Overlap
arabicText: ؟ءاوس ءاسنلل ضيحلا نمو ةبانجلا نمو ءوضولا نع مميتلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .معن لاقف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about tayammum for wudu, janabah, and menstruation for women - are they the same? He said: Yes.

chapter: Ghusl For Menstruation Is Like Ghusl For Janabah And They Overlap
arabicText: .دحاو ضيحلاو ةبانجلا لسغ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The ghusl for janabah and menstruation is the same.

chapter: Ghusl For Menstruation Is Like Ghusl For Janabah And They Overlap
arabicText: .هلثم ضيحلا لسغو ةضيرف ةبانجلا لسغو :لقا (ثيدح يف) (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) (in a hadith) who said: The ghusl for janabah is obligatory and the ghusl for menstruation is like it.

chapter: Ghusl For Menstruation Is Like Ghusl For Janabah And They Overlap
arabicText: لثم لسغ اهيلع ضئاحلا نع هتلأسو لقا ،دحاو ضيحلاو ةبانجلا لسغ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .معن :لقا ؟بنجلا لسغ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The ghusl for janabah and menstruation is the same. He said: And I asked him whether a menstruating woman should perform ghusl like the ghusl for janabah? He said: Yes.

chapter: Ghusl For Menstruation Is Like Ghusl For Janabah And They Overlap
arabicText: .ضئاحلا ينعي معن :لقا ؟بنجلا لسغ لثم لسغ اهيلعأ هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) هنع ،ريصب يبأ ثيدحو
englishText: And the hadith of Abu Basir, from him (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him whether she should perform ghusl like the ghusl for janabah? He said: Yes, meaning the menstruating woman.

chapter: Ghusl For Menstruation Is Like Ghusl For Janabah And They Overlap
arabicText: لسغ اهيلع له بنج يهو ضيحت ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) هنع ،نانس نب الله دبع ثدحو .دحاو ضيحلاو ةبانجلا لسغ لقا ؟ةبانجلا
englishText: And Abdullah bin Sinan narrated, from him (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a woman who menstruates while she is in a state of janabah, does she need to perform ghusl for janabah? He said: The ghusl for janabah and menstruation is the same.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: اهمياأ تزاج اذفإ ،اهلعب اهبرقي لاو اهيف ليصت لاف اهمياأ رظنت ةضاحتسملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهضيح مياأ يف لاإ اهلعب اهيتيأ هذهو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - رصعلاو رهظلل تلستغا فسركلا بقثي مدلا تأرو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A woman with irregular bleeding should observe her regular days, during which she should not pray and her husband should not approach her. When her days pass and she sees blood penetrating the cotton, she should perform ghusl for Dhuhr and Asr- until he said- and her husband can approach her except during her menstrual days.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: مياأ لاإ ءاش اذإ اهلعب اهيتيأ نأ سبأ لاو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - ةضاحتسملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) لله ا دبع يبأ نع .اهجوز اهلزتعيف اهضيح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman with irregular bleeding until he said- and there is no harm in her husband approaching her whenever he wishes except during her menstrual days when her husband should avoid her.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: مهؤباآ نيذلا ءلاؤه :لقا ،معن :تلق :لقا ؟مهقلخ يف نيهوشملا ءلاؤه ىرت :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .ثمطلا يف مهءاسن نوتيأ
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Do you see these people who are deformed in their creation? I said: Yes. He said: These are those whose fathers approached their mothers during menstruation.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: لاإ نمولي لاف صربأ وأ اموذجم دلولا جرخف ضئاح يهو هتأرما عماج نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا .هسفن
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating and the child is born with leprosy or vitiligo, he should blame none but himself.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: .اهضيح يف همأ هب تلمح وأ ،هتدلاو ثبخ نم لاإ انضغبي لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقاو :لقا
englishText: He said: And Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: None hates us except one whose birth was impure, or whose mother conceived him during her menstruation.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: - (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (ملسو هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف - (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،قداصلا نع :لوقأ .هسفن لاإ نمولي صربأ وأ اموذجم دلولا جرخف لعف نفإ ،ضياح يهو هتأرما لجرلا ىشغي نأ هركو :لقا .يتيأو ىضم امل ميرحتلا ةهاركلبا دارملا
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers (peace be upon them)- in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him)- he said: He discouraged a man from approaching his wife while she is menstruating, for if he does and the child is born with leprosy or vitiligo, he should blame none but himself. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The intended meaning of dislike (karahah) is prohibition, based on what has been mentioned before and what will be mentioned later.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: لوقي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تعمس تلاقف ةملس مأ دنع انك :لقا ،يشرقلا ميهاربإ نع .ضئاح يهو همأ هب تلمح نمو ،قفانمو ،ناز دلو ةثلاث لاإ مكضغبي لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل
englishText: From Ibrahim Al-Qurashi, who said: We were with Umm Salamah and she said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) saying to Ali (peace be upon him): None hates you except three: an illegitimate child, a hypocrite, and one whose mother conceived him while menstruating.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: لاو ،نمؤم لاإ كبحي لا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل :لقا هنإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع ،بويأ يبأ نع .ثماط يهو همأ هتلمح وأ ،ةينز دلو وأ ،قفانم لاإ كضغبي
englishText: From Abu Ayyub, from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that he said to Ali (peace be upon him): None loves you except a believer, and none hates you except a hypocrite, or an illegitimate child, or one whose mother conceived him while menstruating. Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before ...

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: قفانم امإ :ثلاث ىدحلإ وهف يترتع بحي مل نم ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) لوسر لقا لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع .رهط ريغ يف همأ هب تلمح ؤرما امإو ،ةينزل امإو
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever does not love my family is one of three: either a hypocrite, or conceived illegitimately, or one whose mother conceived him while not pure.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: دلولا جرخف اهيشغ نفإ ضئاح يهو هتأرما ىشغي نأ لجرلل هرك هنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع .هسفن لاإ نمولي لاف صربأ وأ اموذجم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) that he discouraged a man from approaching his wife while she is menstruating, for if he does and the child is born with leprosy or vitiligo, he should blame none but himself.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: ضيحت تناك يتلا ميالأا رظني :لقا ؟اهجوز اهاشغي فيك ةضاحتسملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس .كلذ ىوس اميف اهاشغيو ،رهشلا كلذ نم ميالأا كلت ةدع يف اهبرقي لاف ةميقتسم اهضيحو اهيف
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about how a husband can approach his wife who has irregular bleeding? He said: He should look at the days she used to menstruate when her menstruation was regular and not approach her during those numbered days of that month, and he can approach her other than that.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Menstruating Woman Before She Becomes Pure, And The Permissibility Of Intercourse With A Woman Having Irregular Bleeding
arabicText: ؟ثماطلا نم هل لحي ام لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا الله دبع يبأ نب نامحرلا دبع نع .رهطت ىتح ئش لا :لقا ،بابحتسلاا لىع لمحي نأ نكميو :لقا ،كلذ نود ام هل ناك نإو جرفلا يف يطولا نم ئش لا ينعي خيشلا لقا .ةماعلا نم ريثك بهاذمل هتقفاومل ةيقتلا لىع وأ
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Abdullah who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about what is permissible for a man from a menstruating woman? He said: Nothing until she becomes pure. The Shaykh said this means nothing of intercourse in the private parts although he can do other than that, he said: And it's possible to interpret it as recommendation, or as taqiyyah because it agrees with many of the Aammah (general non-Shia muslims) schools of thought.

chapter: Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Except In The Private Part And Enjoying What Is Less Than That
arabicText: .هنيعب اهنم لبقلا ادع ام ئش لك :لاقف ؟اهنم ضياحلا ةأرملا بحاصل ام (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) what is permissible for a man from his menstruating wife? He said: Everything except her private part specifically.

chapter: Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Except In The Private Part And Enjoying What Is Less Than That
arabicText: .جرفلا نود ام :لقا ؟اهنم اهجوزل لحي ام ضئاحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about what is permissible for a husband from his menstruating wife? He said: What is other than the private part.

chapter: Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Except In The Private Part And Enjoying What Is Less Than That
arabicText: ام :لاقف ؟ضئاح يهو هتأرما نم لجرلل لحي ام (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا نانس نب الله دبع نع .جرفلا نود
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), what is permissible for a man from his wife while she is menstruating? He said: What is other than the private part.

chapter: Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Except In The Private Part And Enjoying What Is Less Than That
arabicText: مث :لقا ،جرفلا ريغ ئش لك :لقا ،ضئاح يهو ةأرملا نم لجرلل لحي ام (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .لجرلا ةبعل ةأرملا امنإ :لقا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) what is permissible for a man from a woman while she is menstruating? He said: Everything except the private part. Then he said: Indeed, a woman is a man's plaything. Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Exc...

chapter: Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Except In The Private Part And Enjoying What Is Less Than That
arabicText: ىقتا ام ءاش ثيح اهجوز اهتأيلف ةأرملا تضاح اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ريكب نب الله دبع نع .مدلا عضوم
englishText: From Abdullah bin Bukair, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a woman menstruates, her husband may come to her wherever he wishes as long as he avoids the place of blood.

chapter: Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Except In The Private Part And Enjoying What Is Less Than That
arabicText: كلذ بنتجا اذإ سبأ لا :لقا ،ضئاح يهو جرفلا نود اميف ةأرملا يتيأ لجرلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .عضوملا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who comes to his wife in places other than the private part while she is menstruating, he said: There is no problem if he avoids that place.

chapter: Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Except In The Private Part And Enjoying What Is Less Than That
arabicText: .نيذخفلا نيب ام :لقا ؟ضئاحلا نم لجرلل ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What is permissible for a man from a menstruating woman? He said: What is between the thighs.

chapter: Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Except In The Private Part And Enjoying What Is Less Than That
arabicText: .بقوي لاو اهيتيلأ نيب ام :لقا ؟ضئاحلا نم لجرلل ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What is permissible for a man from a menstruating woman? He said: What is between her buttocks but not penetration.

chapter: Permission To Have Intimate Relations With A Menstruating Woman Except In The Private Part And Enjoying What Is Less Than That
arabicText: ىتح نهوبرقت لاو) :ىلاعت الله لوقل اهيتيأ نأ اهجوز لىع مرحي ضيحت ةأرملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .جرفلا نود اميف ضئاح يهو هتأرما يتيأ نأ لجرلل ميقتسيف (نرهطي
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When a woman menstruates, it is forbidden for her husband to have intercourse with her because of Allah's statement: And do not approach them until they are pure [Quran, 2:222]. However, it is permissible for a man to be intimate with his wife while she is menstruating in ways other than intercourse in the vagina.

chapter: Recommendation To Avoid The Area Between The Navel And Knee Of A Menstruating Woman And Post-partum Woman
arabicText: جرختو نيتبكرلا ىلإ رازإب رزتت :لقا ،اهنم اهجوزل لحي امو ضئاحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأس هنأ الله لىص) يبنلا نإ :لوقت تناك ةنوميم نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) هيبأ نع ركذو :لقا رازلإا قوف ام هل مث ،اهترس .شارفلا يف هعم عجطضا مث بوثب رزتأ نأ اضئاح تنك اذإ ينرميأ ناك (ملسو هلآو هيلع
englishText: He asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the menstruating woman and what is permissible for her husband from her. He said: She should wear a waist wrapper up to the knees and keep her navel uncovered, then he can have access to what is above the wrapper. He mentioned that his father (peace be upon him) said that Maymunah used to say: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would order me when I was menstruating to wear a garment and then lie with him in bed.

chapter: Recommendation To Avoid The Area Between The Navel And Knee Of A Menstruating Woman And Post-partum Woman
arabicText: نيتبكرلا ىلإ رازإب رزتت :لقا ؟اهنم اهجوزل لحي ام ضئاحلا نع لئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رازلإا قوف ام هلو ،اهيقاس جرختو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he was asked about what is permissible for a husband from his menstruating wife. He said: She should wear a waist wrapper up to the knees and keep her legs uncovered, and he can have access to what is above the wrapper.

chapter: Recommendation To Avoid The Area Between The Navel And Knee Of A Menstruating Woman And Post-partum Woman
arabicText: عجطضت مث اعرد سبلت :لقا ؟اهنم اهجوزل لحي ام ءاسفنلاو ضئاحلا نع ملاسلا هيلع الله دبع باأ تلأس .هعم ةيقتلا لىع وأ ،رظحلا عفرو زاوجلا لىع ةلولأاو ،بابحتسلاا لىع امإ رابخلأا هذه لمحن نأ هجولا :خيشلا لقا .ةماعلا نم ريثك بهذمل ةقفاوم اهنلأ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about what is permissible for a husband from his menstruating and post-partum wife. He said: She should wear a shirt then lie with him. The Shaykh said: The proper understanding is to interpret these reports either as recommendations, with the first being permissible and removing prohibition, or as Recommendation To Avoid The Area Between The Navel And Knee Of A Me... taqiyyah because it agrees with the doctrine of many of the Aammah (general non Shia muslims).

chapter: Permissibility Of Intercourse After Menstruation Stops Before Bathing, Though It Is Disliked And Preferably Done After Washing The Private Parts
arabicText: قبش اهجوز باصأ اذإ :لقا ،اهمياأ رخآ يف ضيحلا مد مدلا اهنع عطقني ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .لستغت نأ لبق ءاش نإ اهسمي مث اهجرف لسغتلف اهرمأيلف
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding a woman whose menstrual blood stops on her last days, he said: If her husband experiences desire, he should ask her to wash her private parts, then he may be intimate with her if he wishes before she performs the ritual bath.

chapter: Permissibility Of Intercourse After Menstruation Stops Before Bathing, Though It Is Disliked And Preferably Done After Washing The Private Parts
arabicText: بحأ ام :لاقف ؟هلهأ يتيأ ءاملا دجي لاف رفسلا يف هلهأ هعم نوكي لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ باأ تلأس .هسفن لىع فاخي وأ اقبش نوكي نأ لاإ كلذ لعفي نأ
englishText: I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about a man who is with his wife during travel and cannot find water, can he be intimate with his wife? He said: I do not like him to do that unless he is experiencing strong desire or fears for himself.

chapter: Permissibility Of Intercourse After Menstruation Stops Before Bathing, Though It Is Disliked And Preferably Done After Washing The Private Parts
arabicText: .ءاش نإ اهجوز اهتأيلف لستغت ملو مدلا عطقنا اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: When the blood stops and she has not performed the ritual bath, her husband may be intimate with her if he wishes.

chapter: Permissibility Of Intercourse After Menstruation Stops Before Bathing, Though It Is Disliked And Preferably Done After Washing The Private Parts
arabicText: ىتح اهجوز اهيلع عقي لاف ءاملا سمت ملو ضيحلا نم ترهط اذإ ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا نع .يلإ بحأ ءاملا سمت :لقاو هب سبأ لاف لعف نإو ،لستغت
englishText: From Al-Abd Al-Salih (peace be upon him) regarding a woman when she becomes pure from menstruation but has not touched water, her husband should not be intimate with her until she performs the ritual bath, but if he does so there is no harm. And he said: Touching water is more beloved to me. Permissibility Of Intercourse After Menstruation Stops Before Bathi...

chapter: Permissibility Of Intercourse After Menstruation Stops Before Bathing, Though It Is Disliked And Preferably Done After Washing The Private Parts
arabicText: نأ لبق اهجوز اهيف عقيأ ،رهطلا ىرت ضئاحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا يبأ نع .يلإ بحأ لسغلا دعبو سبأ لا :لقا ؟لستغت
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a menstruating woman who sees purity, can her husband be intimate with her before she performs the ritual bath? He said: There is no harm, though after bathing is more beloved to me.

chapter: Permissibility Of Intercourse After Menstruation Stops Before Bathing, Though It Is Disliked And Preferably Done After Washing The Private Parts
arabicText: نأ لبق اهجوز اهيلع عقيأ رهطلا تأرف اثماط تناك ةأرما نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،نينثاو اموي ءام دجت ملف ترهط مث رفسلا يف تضاح ةأرما نع هتلأسو :لقا ،لستغت ىتح لا :لقا ؟لستغت .لستغت ىتح حلصي لا :لقا ؟لستغت نأ لبق اهعماجي نأ اهجوزل لحيأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman who was menstruating then saw purity, can her husband be intimate with her before she performs the ritual bath? He said: No, not until she performs the ritual bath. He said: And I asked him about a woman who menstruated while traveling then became pure but could not find water for one or two days, is it permissible for her husband to be intimate with her before she performs the ritual bath? He said: It is not proper until she performs the ritual bath.

chapter: Permissibility Of Intercourse After Menstruation Stops Before Bathing, Though It Is Disliked And Preferably Done After Washing The Private Parts
arabicText: ،لستغت نأ ريغ نم أضوتف رهطت مث ةلاصلا اهيلع مرحت ةأرملا :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لستغت ىتح لا لقا ؟لستغت نأ لبق اهيتيأ نأ اهجوزلفأ لمح نكميو :لوقأ .زاوجلا لىع ةلولأاو ،ةهاركلا نم برض لىع اهلمحن نأ رابخلأا هذه يف هجولا :خيشلا لقا .ةماعلا رثكلأ ةقفاوم اهنلأ ةيقتلا لىع عنملا ثيداحأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I said to him: A woman who is prohibited from prayer then becomes pure and performs ablution without performing the ritual bath, can her husband be intimate with her before she performs the ritual bath? He said: No, not until she performs the ritual bath. The Shaykh said: The proper understanding of these reports is to interpret them as expressing dislike, while the first ones indicate permissibility. I (Hurr Amili) say: It's possible to interpret the prohibiting traditions as being based on taqiyyah because they agree with most of the A'ammah (general muslims).

chapter: Recommendation Of Expiation For One Who Has Intercourse During Menstruation: One Dinar At Its Beginning, Half In Its Middle, Quarter At Its End, Or Half
arabicText: ،رانيد فصن هطسو يفو ،رانيدب هلوأ يف ناك اذإ قدصتي هنأ ثمطلا ةرافك يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع الله رفغتسا لاإو ،دحاو نيكسم لىع قدصتيلف :لقا ؟رفكي ام هدنع نكي مل نفإ :تلق ،رانيد عبر هرخآ يفو .ةرافكلا نم ئش ىلإ ليبسلا دجي مل نم لكل ةرافكو ةبوت رافغتسلاا نفإ ،دوعي لاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding the expiation for menstruation that one gives sadaqah when it's at the beginning with one dinar, in its middle half a dinar, and at its end quarter dinar. I asked: What if one doesn't have means for expiation? He said: Then let him give sadaqah to one poor person, and if not then seek Allah's forgiveness and not repeat it, for seeking forgiveness is repentance and expiation for anyone who cannot find means for any expiation.

chapter: Recommendation Of Expiation For One Who Has Intercourse During Menstruation: One Dinar At Its Beginning, Half In Its Middle, Quarter At Its End, Or Half
arabicText: نفإ :كلملا دبع لقا هبر الله رفغتسي :لقا ،ثماط يهو هتيراج ىتأ لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .نيكاسم ةرشع لىع قدصتيلف :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لاقف ،رانيد وأ ،رانيد فصن هيلع :نولوقي سانلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who had relations with his slave girl while she was menstruating. He said: He should seek forgiveness from Allah his Lord. Abdul Malik said: People say he must pay half a dinar or a dinar. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Then let him give sadaqah to ten poor people.

chapter: Recommendation Of Expiation For One Who Has Intercourse During Menstruation: One Dinar At Its Beginning, Half In Its Middle, Quarter At Its End, Or Half
arabicText: .ىلاعت الله رفغتسيو رانيدب قدصتي :لقا ؟ثماط يهو هتأرما ىتأ نمع هتلأس
englishText: I asked him about one who had relations with his wife while she was menstruating? He said: He gives sadaqah of one dinar and seeks forgiveness from Allah the Most High. Recommendation Of Expiation For One Who Has Intercourse During Mens...

chapter: Recommendation Of Expiation For One Who Has Intercourse During Menstruation: One Dinar At Its Beginning, Half In Its Middle, Quarter At Its End, Or Half
arabicText: .هب قدصتي رانيد فصن هيلعف اضئاح ىتأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever has relations with a menstruating woman must give half a dinar in sadaqah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Expiation For One Who Has Intercourse During Menstruation: One Dinar At Its Beginning, Half In Its Middle, Quarter At Its End, Or Half
arabicText: نيكسم لىع قدصتي :لقا ؟هيلع ام ضئاح يهو هتأرما لىع عقي لجرلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هعبش ردقب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who has relations with his wife while she is menstruating, what is upon him? He said: He gives sadaqah to a poor person enough to satisfy their hunger.

chapter: Recommendation Of Expiation For One Who Has Intercourse During Menstruation: One Dinar At Its Beginning, Half In Its Middle, Quarter At Its End, Or Half
arabicText: عبر هيلعو رانيدب قدصتي نأ هيلعف اهضيح مياأ لوأ يف جرفلا يف هتأرما ىتأ نم (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا يتنثا برضيو رانيد فصنب قدصتي نأ هيلعف اهضيح مياأ رخآ يف اهتاأ نإو ،ةدلج نورشعو ةسمخ ينازلا دح .افصنو ةدلج ةرشع
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Whoever has relations with his wife in the private parts during her first days of menstruation must give sadaqah of one dinar and receive quarter of the adulterer's punishment which is twenty-five lashes, and if he does it in her last days of menstruation he must give sadaqah of half a dinar and receive twelve and a half lashes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Expiation For One Who Has Intercourse During Menstruation: One Dinar At Its Beginning, Half In Its Middle, Quarter At Its End, Or Half
arabicText: يف ناك نإو ،رانيد فصنف هفصن يف ناك نإو ،رانيدب قدصتي نأ هيلعف ضيحلا لوأ يف اهعماج نإ هنأ يور .رانيد عبرف هرخآ لا ثيداحلأا نأ عم ،لولأا ثيدحلا يف قباسلا ليصفتلا لىع ثيداحلأا هذه ةعامجو خيشلا لمح :لوقأ بوجولبا لوقلا نأ لىع ،ملعأ اللهو ،بابحتسلاا ةنيرق اهلامجإو اهفلاتخاو ىرت امك ةرافكلا بوجوب اهيف حيرصت .لولأا ثيدحلا نومضم يف حيرص وه ام مهثيداحأ يفو ،ةماعلا نم ةعامجل قفاوم
englishText: It is narrated that if he has relations with her at the beginning of menstruation he must give sadaqah of one dinar, if in its middle then half a dinar, and if at its end then quarter dinar. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh carried these hadiths on the previous detail in the first hadith while the hadiths have no explicit mention of obligatory expiation as you see and their differences and brevity are indicators of recommendation, and Allah knows best, although saying it's obligatory agrees with a group of the Aammah (sunnis), and in their hadiths is what explicitly supports the content of the first hadith.

chapter: Non-obligation Of Expiation For Intercourse During Menstruation
arabicText: نأ الله ىهن دقو كلذ لعف سمتلي لا :لقا ،ثماط يهو هتأرما عقاو لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .رفغتسي ،ائيش هيف ملعأ لا :لقا ؟ةرافك هيلعأ لعف نفإ :تلق ،اهبرقي
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who had intercourse with his wife while she was menstruating. He said: He should not seek to do that act, and Allah has forbidden approaching her. I said: If he does it, is there any expiation due upon him? He said: I do not know of anything regarding this, he should seek forgiveness.

chapter: Non-obligation Of Expiation For Intercourse During Menstruation
arabicText: رفغتسي ،ئش هيلع سيل :لقا ،اهجوز اهيتيأ ضئاحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ةرارز نع .دوعي لاو الله
englishText: From Zurarah, from one of the two (peace be upon them), he said: I asked him about a menstruating woman whose husband approaches her. He said: There is nothing due upon him, he should seek Allah's forgiveness and not repeat it.

chapter: Non-obligation Of Expiation For Intercourse During Menstruation
arabicText: دقو ئش هيلع سيل :لقا ؟أطخ ثماط يهو هتأرما لىع لجرلا عوقو نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .هبر ىصع
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man having intercourse with his wife while she was menstruating by mistake. He said: There is nothing due upon him though he has disobeyed his Lord.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: معن :لاقف ؟ةلاصلا كرتتأ مدلا ىرت يبلحلا نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نانس نب الله دبع نع .مدلبا تفذق امبر لىبحلا نإ
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he was asked about a pregnant woman who sees blood, should she leave the prayer? He said: Yes, sometimes a pregnant woman may discharge blood.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: له ،رهش لك يف كلذ لبق ىرت تناك امك لماح يهو مدلا ىرت لىبحلا نع (ملاسل ا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس .ماد اذإ ةلاصلا كرتت :لقا ؟ةلاصلا كرتت
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a pregnant woman who sees blood while she is pregnant, just as she used to see it before that every month, should she leave the prayer? He said: She should leave the prayer if it continues.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: اذإ ،يل لاقف :لقا ؟ةلاصلبا عنصت فيك ،لماح يهو مدلا ىرت يدلو مأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق دعقت تناك يذلا رهشلا نم مدلا هيف ىرت تناك يذلا تقولا نم اموي نورشع يضمي ام دعب مدلا لماحلا تأر لبق مدلا لماحلا تأر اذإو ،ليصتو فسركب يشتحتو أضوتتلف ،ثمطلا نم لاو محرلا نم سيل كلذ نفإ هيف ةلاصلا نع كسمتلف ،ةضيحلا نم هنفإ رهشلا كلذ نم تقولا يف وأ ليلقب مدلا هيف ىرت تناك يذلا تقولا .لصتلو لستغتلف كلذ لبق مدلا اهنع عطقنا نفإ ،اهضيح يف دعقت تناك يتلا اهمياأ ددع
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): My umm walad [slave woman who has borne a child to her master] sees blood while she is pregnant. How should she deal with prayer? He said to me: When a pregnant woman sees blood after twenty days have passed from the time she used to see blood in the month she used to stay [in menstruation], then this is neither from the womb nor from menstruation. So she should perform ablution, use cotton padding, and pray. And when a pregnant woman sees blood shortly before her usual time of seeing blood or during that time of the month, then it is from menstruation. So she should refrain from prayer for the number of days she used to stay in her menstruation. If the blood stops before that, she should perform ritual bath and pray.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: نع كسمت :لقا ؟ليصت مياأ ةعبرأ وأ مياأ ةثلاث مدلا ىرت لىبحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا باأ تلأس .ةلاصلا
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about a pregnant woman who sees blood for three or four days, should she pray? He said: She should refrain from prayer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: .نيتلاص لك دنع لستغتلف لايلق ناك نإو ،نيلصت لاف اريثك امد ناك نإ ،ةقارهلا كلت :لقا
englishText: He said: That is irregular bleeding. If it is heavy bleeding then do not pray, and if it is light bleeding then perform ghusl for every two prayers.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: لاف اطيبع امد ناك نإ :لقا ،؟نيمويلاو مويلا مدلا ىرت لىبحلا ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .نيتلاص لك دنع لستغتلف ةرفص ناك نإو نيمويلا كنيذ ليصت
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a pregnant woman who sees blood for a day or two? He said: If it is fresh blood then she should not pray during those two days, and if it is yellowish discharge then she should perform ghusl for every two prayers.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: لك يف اميقتسم اهضيح مياأ ىرت تناك امك مدلا ىرت لىبحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع .تلص ترهط اذفإ ،اهضيح يف عنصت تناك امك ةلاصلا كسمت :لقا ،؟رهش
englishText: From one of the two (peace be upon them), he said: I asked him about a pregnant woman who sees blood as she used to see during her menstrual days, regularly every month. He said: She should refrain from prayer as she used to do during her menstruation. When she becomes pure, she should pray.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: رهشلا يفو ميالأا يف مدلا نم نيتقفدلاو قفدلا ىرت لىبحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا باأ تلأس .ةلاصلا نع هذه كسمت سيل ،ةقارهلا كلت :لاقف ،؟نيرهشلاو ،اعطق اضيح نوكت لا طقف ،نيتقفدلاو ةقفدلا نلا ةقباسلا رابخلال ةفاانم اذه يف سيل ىقتنملا بحاص لقا ىنثملا نب ديمح ارغملا يبأ ةياور ينعي ،ىهتنا رم اميف هنيعب اذه يوار ريثكلاو ليلقلا نيب قرفلا ىور دقو .ةقباسلا
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) about a pregnant woman who sees one or two gushes of blood in some days during one or two months? He said: That is hemorrhage, this does not prevent her from prayer. Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy The author of Al-Muntaqa said: There is no contradiction with the previous narrations because one or two gushes only cannot definitively be considered menstruation, and the distinction between small and large amounts has been narrated by this same narrator as mentioned before, meaning the previous narration of Abu Al Maghra Humaid bin Al-Muthanna.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: مدلا محرلا يف يقب امبر هنفإ ةلاصلا عدت :لقا مدلا ىرت لىبحلا يف (ملاسلا امهيلع) الله دبع يبأو رفعج يبأ نع .ةقارهلا كلتو ،جرخي ملو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon them both) regarding a pregnant woman who sees blood, they said: She should leave prayer for sometimes blood remains in the womb and does not come out, and that is the discharge (al-haraqah).

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: يهو مدلا ةأرملا تفذق امبر هنإ ،معن :لقا ؟مدلا ىرت يبلحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لىبح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a pregnant woman who sees blood. He said: Yes, sometimes a woman may discharge blood while pregnant.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: تناك يتلا ميالأا لىع مدلا داز اذفإ ،ضيحت تناك يتلا اهمياأ دعقت :لقا ،؟لبحلا يف مدلا تأر ةأرما نع هتلأس .ةضاحتسم يه مث مياأ ةثلاثب ترهظتسا دعقت
englishText: I asked him about a woman who sees blood during pregnancy? He said: She should observe her usual days of menstruation, and if the blood exceeds the days she used to observe, she should wait an additional three days, then she is considered in a state of istihadha (one who experiences irregular bleeding).

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: ىنعي ،لبح عم اضيح لعجيل الله ناك ام :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع .ةلاصلا تكرت مدلا تأرو قلطلا اهبرض اذإ دلولا سأر لىع ىرت نأ لاإ ،ةلاصلا عدت لا لماح يهو مدلا تأر اذإ هنوك لىع وأ ،هطئارش ضعب للاتخا وأ ،ضيحلا لقأ نع مدلا روصق لىع وأ ،بلاغلا لىع لومحم امإ اذه :لوقأ رهشأو مهئاهقف رثكأ لوقل قفاوم هنومضمو ةماعلا نم هتاور نلا ،ةياورلا يف ةيقتلا لىع وأ ،اخوسنم امكح .ملعأ اللهو ،مهبهاذم
englishText: From his father (peace be upon them), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah would not make menstruation coincide with pregnancy. Meaning, if she sees blood while pregnant, she should not leave the prayer, unless she sees it on the head of the child when labor pains strike her and she sees blood, then she should leave the prayer. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is either interpreted based on the predominant case, or the deficiency of the blood from the minimum duration of menstruation, or the absence of some of its conditions, or it being an abrogated ruling, or dissimulation (Taqiyyah) in the narration, because its narrators are from the common people and its content agrees with the opinion of most of their jurists and their well-known schools of thought. And Allah knows best.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: :لاقف ،همأ نطب يف دلولا قزر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع (هر) ناملس لأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .همأ نطب يف هقزر اهلعجف ةضيحلا هيلع سبح ىلاعتو كرابت الله نإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Salman (may Allah be pleased with him) asked Ali (peace be upon him) about the sustenance of the child in the womb of its mother. He said: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, withholds menstruation from her and makes it the sustenance of the child in the womb of its mother.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: همأ نطب يف دلولا نأ كلذو ،معن لقا ؟تثمط امبر لىبحلا كادف تلعج :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .ةلاصلا اهيلع تمرح هتقفد اذفإ ،هتقفد لضف اذفإ ،هنع لضفف رثك امبرف ،مدلا هؤاذغ
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): May I be sacrificed for you, sometimes a pregnant woman menstruates? He said: Yes, and that is because the child in its mother's belly is nourished by blood, and sometimes it becomes abundant and exceeds what is needed, so when it exceeds she discharges it, and when she discharges it prayer becomes forbidden for her.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: .ةدلاولا رختأ كلذك ناك اذإ ىرخأ ةياور يفو :ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And in another narration, when it is like this, the birth is delayed.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: :لقا ،؟مدلا نم ضئاحلا ىرت ام ىرت اهلبح نابتسا دق لىبحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع .ءوضولا لاإ اهيلع سيلف رفصأ لايلق ناك نإو ،ليصت لاف اريثك رمحأ امد ناك نإ ،مدلا نم ةقارهلا كلت
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them), he said: I asked him about a pregnant woman whose pregnancy has become apparent and she sees what a menstruating Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy woman sees of blood? He said: That is an outpouring of blood. If it is abundant red blood then she should not pray, and if it is little yellow blood then she only needs to perform ablution.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruation Coinciding With Pregnancy
arabicText: مدلا تأر اهنفإ :تلق ،ةلاصلا عدت لقا ؟مدلا تأر ةلماح ةأرما نع هلأس لاجر نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ةلاصلا اهيلع بجت مل هسأر جرخ اذفإ ،يبصلا جرخي ىتح ليصت :لقا ،؟ضخمت يهو هتأرف قلطلا اهباصأ دقو ،اهسافن نم تجرخأ ذإ هتضق دهجلاو ةدشلا نم هيف يه امل وأ ،عجول لاحلا كلت يف ةلاصلا نم هتكرت ام لكو تفذق هذهو ،ضيحلا مدب تفذق لماحلا نإ :لقا ؟ضاخملا مدو لماحلا مد نيب قرفلا ام كادف تلعج :تلق امفأ ،ضيحلاو سافنلا يف عدت نأ بجيف سافنلا مد ريصي كلذ دنعف دلولا ضعب جرخي نأ ىلإ ،ضاخملا مدب .محرلا يف قتف نم كلذ امنفإ اسافن وأ اضيح نكي مل ام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that a man asked him about a pregnant woman who saw blood? He said: She should leave prayer. I said: What if she saw blood when labor pains came to her and she saw it while in labor? He said: She should pray until the child comes out. When the head emerges, prayer is no longer obligatory upon her. And all prayers she left during that condition due to pain or what she is experiencing of hardship and strain, she should make them up after her postpartum period. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, what is the difference between the blood of pregnancy and the blood of labor? He said: The pregnant woman discharged menstrual blood, while this one discharged labor blood, until part of the child emerges, at that point it becomes postpartum blood, so she must leave prayer during postpartum and menstruation. As for what is neither menstruation nor postpartum bleeding, that is from a tear in the womb.

chapter: Age Limit Of Menopause
arabicText: .ةنس نوسمخ ضيحملا نم تسئي دق يتلا دح :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The age limit for a woman who has reached menopause is fifty years.

chapter: Age Limit Of Menopause
arabicText: .شيرق نم ةأرما نوكت نأ لاإ ةرمح رت مل ةنس نيسمخ ةأرملا تغلب اذإ لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: When a woman reaches fifty years, she will not see red unless she is a woman from Quraysh.

chapter: Age Limit Of Menopause
arabicText: نوسمخ اهدح ضيحملا نم تسئي دق يتلا ةأرملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا :لقا انباحصأ ضعب نع .ةنس
englishText: From some of our companions who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The woman who has reached menopause, her limit is fifty years.

chapter: Age Limit Of Menopause
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: It is also narrated as sixty years.

chapter: Age Limit Of Menopause
arabicText: .اضيأ ةنس نوتس يورو :ينيلكلا لقا اهنأ يور هنفإ شيرق نم ةأرما نوكت نأ لاإ ةنس نيسمخ تغلب اذإ ةأرملا سأيت :(طوسبملا) يف خيشلا لقاو .ةنس نيتس ىلإ ضيحلا مد ىرت
englishText: And Al-Shaykh said in (Al-Mabsut): A woman reaches menopause when she reaches f ifty years unless she is from Quraysh, for it is narrated that she sees menstrual blood until sixty years. Age Limit Of Menopause

chapter: Age Limit Of Menopause
arabicText: ضيحملا نم تسئي دق يتلاو (:لقا نأ ىلإ) لاح لك لىع نجوزتي ثلاث :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .ةنس نوسمخ اهل ناك اذإ :لقا ؟اهدح امو :تلق ضيحت لا اهلثمو
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Three types can marry in any condition (until he said:) and the one who has reached menopause and whose like does not menstruate. I asked: What is her limit? He said: When she is fifty years old.

chapter: Age Limit Of Menopause
arabicText: دح وهو ،شيرق نم ةأرما نوكت نأ لاإ ةرمح رت مل ةنس نيسمخ تغلب اذإ ةأرملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا .ضيحلا نم سأيت يتلا ةأرملا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: When a woman reaches fifty years, she will not see red unless she is a woman from Quraysh, and this is the limit for a woman who reaches menopause.

chapter: Age Limit Of Menopause
arabicText: ؟ضيحت لا اهلثمو ضيحملا نم تسئي دق يتلا :تلق :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع امل ةيشرقلا لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ .ضيحت لا اهلثمو ضيحملا نم تسئي دقف ةنس نيتس تغلب اذإ :لقا .ربتعم ريغ اهريغ يف طرشلا موهفمو ،رم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- I said: The one who has reached menopause and whose like does not menstruate? He said: When she reaches sixty years, she has reached menopause and her like does not menstruate. I (Hurr Amili) say: This applies to the Qurashi woman as mentioned before, and the implied condition for others is not considered.

chapter: Age Limit Of Menopause
arabicText: مدلا نيارت ةيطبنلاو ءاسنلا نم ةيشرقلا نأ يور دق :لقا (ةعنقملا) يف ديفملا نامعنلا نب دمحم نب دمحم .ةنس نيتس ىلإ
englishText: Muhammad bin Muhammad bin Al-Nu'man Al-Mufid said in (Al-Muqni'ah): It has been narrated that Qurashi and Nabataean (*) women see blood until sixty years. Translator: * An ancient Arab people who established a powerful kingdom in what is now Jordan, portions of Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Syria.

chapter: Ruling On The Disappearance Of A Woman's Menstruation For Years, Its Return, Its Cessation, And That It Is A Defect For Which A Girl Can Be Returned Before Menopause When There Is No Pregnancy
arabicText: ىتح ةلاصلا كرتت :لقا ؟ئش اهيلإ داع مث نينس اهثمط بهذ ةأرما نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .رهطت
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman whose menstruation disappeared for years and then something returned to her? He said: She should leave prayer until she becomes pure.

chapter: Ruling On The Disappearance Of A Woman's Menstruation For Years, Its Return, Its Cessation, And That It Is A Defect For Which A Girl Can Be Returned Before Menopause When There Is No Pregnancy
arabicText: ةتس كلذل ىضم ىتح هدنع ضحت ملو ةكردم ةيراج ىرتشا لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .هنم درت بيع اذهف ربك نم كلذ نكي ملو ضيحت اهلثم ناك نإ :لقا ،؟لبح اهب سيلو رهشأ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who bought a mature girl slave and she did not menstruate while with him until six months passed, and she was not pregnant? He said: If someone like her typically menstruates and this was not due to old age, then this is a defect for which she can be returned. Shaykh Hurr Amili: There will be mentioned, God willing, in the chapter on trade what indicates some of the intended meanings.

chapter: Prohibition Of Giving Medicine To A Woman Whose Menstruation Has Stopped For A Month With The Possibility Of Pregnancy
arabicText: يقستف محر يف حير وأ مد داسف نم اهثمط سبتحا امبرف ةيراجلا يرتشأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق ،كلذ لعفت لا :يل لاقف ؟هريغ وأ وه لبح نم يردأ لا ناأو كلذ يل زوجيفأ ،اهموي نم ثمطتف كلذل ءاود ،لزعي يذلا لجرلا ةفطنك ةفطن ناك امنإ لبح نم كلذ ناك ولو ارهش اهنم اهثمط عفترا امنإ هنإ :هل تلقف تعقو اذإ ةفطنلا نإو ،الله ام ىلإ مث ،ةغضم ىلإ مث ،ةقلع ىلإ ريصت محرلا يف تعقو اذإ ةفطنلا نإ :يل لاقف .هيف ثمطت تناك يذلا اهتقو زاجو ارهش اهثمط عفترا اذإ ءاود اهقست لاف ئش اهنم قلخي مل محرلا ريغ يف
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I buy a slave girl and sometimes her menstruation is retained due to blood corruption or wind in the womb, so she is given medicine for that and she menstruates from that day. Is this permissible for me when I don't know if it's due to pregnancy or something else? He said to me: Don't do that. I said to him: Her menstruation has only been delayed for a month, and if it were due to pregnancy, it would just be a sperm like the sperm of a man who practices withdrawal. He said to me: When the sperm settles in the womb, it transforms into a clot, then into a lump of flesh, then into what Allah wills, but if the sperm falls outside the womb, nothing is created from it. So do not give her medicine when her menstruation stops for a month and passes her usual time of menstruation. Shaykh Hurr Amili: There will be mentioned what generally indicates that in the chapters on retaliation (qisas), blood money (diyat), and other topics.

chapter: Ruling On Sexual Intercourse With A Purchased Female Slave Whose Menstruation Stops Before Menopause Due To Pregnancy Or Other Reasons
arabicText: ثمطت لا رهشلأا يدنع ثكمتف ةيراجلا يرتشأ :تلق (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا باأ تلأس دق ثمطلا نإ :لاقف ؟اهجرف يف اهحكنا نأ ليف ،لبح اهب سيل يل نلقيف ءاسنلا اهيراو ،ربك نم كلذ سيلو نإ :لاقف ؟اهنم يلامف لبح اهب ناك نفإ :تلق ،جرفلا يف اهسمت نبأ سبأ لاف ،لبح ريغ نم حيرلا هسبحت .جرفلا نود اميف تدرأ
englishText: I asked Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him): I buy a slave girl and she stays with me for months without menstruating, and this is not due to old age. I show her to women and they tell me she is not pregnant. Is it permissible for me to have intercourse with her? He said: Wind can sometimes hold back menstruation without pregnancy, so there is no harm in having intercourse with her. I asked: If she is pregnant, what is permissible for me with her? He said: If you wish, you may enjoy her in ways other than intercourse.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Menstruating Woman Taking From The Mosque And The Impermissibility Of Placing In It
arabicText: ؟هيف عضت لاو دجسملا يف ام ذختأ ضئاحلا تراص فيك هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ،ةرارز نع .هنم لاإ هيف ام ذختأ نأ عيطتست لاو ،هريغ اهدي يف ام عضت نأ عيطتست ضئاحلا نلا :لقا
englishText: From Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him why a menstruating woman can take what is in the mosque but cannot place anything in it? He said: Because a menstruating woman can place what is in her hand elsewhere, but she cannot take what is in it except from it. Translator: A mosque was used for short-term safekeeping of personal items. And so it is allowed to take items from the mosque. As for placing them, it is possible to find an alternate location.

chapter: Obligation Of Prostration For A Menstruating Woman When She Hears The Recitation Of Obligatory Prostration Verses
arabicText: اذإ دجستلف مئازعلا نم تناك نإ :لاقف ،ةدجسلا عمست ثماطلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس .اهتعمس
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a menstruating woman who hears a prostration verse. He said: If it is from the obligatory ones, she should prostrate when she hears it.

chapter: Obligation Of Prostration For A Menstruating Woman When She Hears The Recitation Of Obligatory Prostration Verses
arabicText: تنك نإو ءوضو ريغ لىع تنك نإو ،دجسفا اهتعمسو عبرلأا مئازعلا نم ئش أرق ذإ :لقا :لقا ريصب يبأ نع .دجست مل تئش نإو ،تدجس تئش نإ ،رايخلبا هيف تنأ نآرقلا رئاسو ،ليصت لا ةأرملا تناك نإو ،ابنج
englishText: Abu Basir said: He said: When something from the four obligatory prostration verses is recited and you hear it, then prostrate, even if you don't have ablution, even if you are in a state of major impurity, and even if the woman is not praying. As for the rest of the Quran, you have the choice: if you wish, prostrate, and if you wish, don't prostrate.

chapter: Obligation Of Prostration For A Menstruating Woman When She Hears The Recitation Of Obligatory Prostration Verses
arabicText: .ةدجسلا تعمس اذإ دجست ضئاحلاو (ثيدح يف) :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: (in a hadith) And the menstruating woman prostrates when she hears the prostration verse.

chapter: Obligation Of Prostration For A Menstruating Woman When She Hears The Recitation Of Obligatory Prostration Verses
arabicText: ؟ةدجسلا تعمس اذإ ةدجس دجستو نآرقلا أرقت له ضئاحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .دجست لاو أرقت :لقا بحاص لقاو ،كرتلا زاوج لىع لومحم هنع اهيهنو ،بابحتسلاا لىع لومحم دوجسلبا رمأ :خيشلا لقا .اضيأ راكنلاا لمتحيو :لوقأ .اهريغب صخيف ماع ىهنلاو ،مئازعلبا صوصخم رملاا :ىقتنملا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I asked him about whether a menstruating woman can recite the Quran and prostrate when she hears a prostration verse? He said: She can recite but not prostrate. Obligation Of Prostration For A Menstruating Woman When She Hears T... The Shaykh said: The command to prostrate is interpreted as recommended, and the prohibition from it is interpreted as permissibility to leave it. The author of Al Muntaqa said: The command is specific to obligatory prostrations, and the prohibition is general so it applies to other than them. I (Hurr Amili) say: Denial is also possible.

chapter: Obligation Of Prostration For A Menstruating Woman When She Hears The Recitation Of Obligatory Prostration Verses
arabicText: .ةدجسلا تعمس اذإ دجست لاو ةلاصلا ضئاحلا يضقت لا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع .عنملا ىلإ اوبهذ ةماعلا رثكأ نلا ةيقتلا لىع لمحلا هلبق امو اذه لمتحيو ،ههجو تفرع دق :لوقأ
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: A menstruating woman does not make up prayers nor does she prostrate when she hears a prostration verse. I (Hurr Amili) say: You have known its explanation, and this and what preceded it might be interpreted as taqiyyah because most of the Aammah (general non-Shia muslims) believe in prohibition.

chapter: Permissibility Of Hanging Amulets On The Menstruating Woman, Her Reading Of It, And Her Writing Of It With Dislike And Impermissibility Of Touching It
arabicText: هأرقت لقاو :لقا ،سبأ لا معن :لقا ؟ضئاحلا لىع قلعي ذيوعتلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهدي هبيصت لاو هبتكتو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about hanging an amulet on a menstruating woman? He said: Yes, there is no problem. He said: She may read it and write it but her hand should not touch it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Hanging Amulets On The Menstruating Woman, Her Reading Of It, And Her Writing Of It With Dislike And Impermissibility Of Touching It
arabicText: .نآرقلا بتكت لا اهنأ يورو :ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And it is narrated that she should not write the Quran.

chapter: Permissibility Of Hanging Amulets On The Menstruating Woman, Her Reading Of It, And Her Writing Of It With Dislike And Impermissibility Of Touching It
arabicText: وأ دلج يف ناك اذإ معن :لاقف ؟ضئاحلا لىع قلعي ذيوعتلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ديدح ةبصق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about hanging an amulet on a menstruating woman? He said: Yes, if it is in leather or an iron reed.

chapter: Permissibility Of Hanging Amulets On The Menstruating Woman, Her Reading Of It, And Her Writing Of It With Dislike And Impermissibility Of Touching It
arabicText: هبتكتو هأرقت :لقاو ،سبأ لا :لقا ؟ضئاحلا لىع قلعي ذيوعتلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هسمت لاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about hanging an amulet on a menstruating woman? He said: There is no problem, and he said: She may read it and write it but should not touch it.

chapter: Ruling On Menstruating Women Regarding Reading The Quran, Touching It, Entering Mosques, And Remembering Allah
arabicText: .الله دمحتو نآرقلا أرقت ضئاحلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The menstruating woman can recite the Quran and praise Allah. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What was previously mentioned indicates the rulings mentioned here and in the state of ritual impurity, and what follows will indicate them.

chapter: Prohibition Of Prayer, Fasting, And Similar Acts For The Menstruating Woman
arabicText: .ةلاصلا اهل لحت لاف اثماط ةأرملا تناك اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: When a woman is menstruating, prayer is not permissible for her.

chapter: Prohibition Of Prayer, Fasting, And Similar Acts For The Menstruating Woman
arabicText: دبعي لا نأ الله بحفأ ةساجن دح يف اهنلأ ،ليصت لاو موصت لاف ةأرملا تضاح اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .هل ةلاص لا نمل موص لا هنلأو ،ارهاط لاإ
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him), he said: When a woman menstruates, she should neither fast nor pray, because she is in a state of impurity and Allah loves to be worshipped only in a state of purity, and because there is no fasting for one who has no prayer.

chapter: Prohibition Of Prayer, Fasting, And Similar Acts For The Menstruating Woman
arabicText: تناك يتلا ميالأا لاإ ناضمر رهش موصت :لاقفو :لقا ،؟ةضاحتسملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .دعب اهيضقت مث اهيف ضيحت
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the woman with irregular bleeding (istihadha)? He said: She should fast during Ramadan except for the days in which she usually menstruates, then she should make up for those days later.

chapter: Prohibition Of Prayer, Fasting, And Similar Acts For The Menstruating Woman
arabicText: رشاعم :لقا هنإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع (ةغلابلا جهن) يف يوسوملا يضرلا نيسحلا نب دمحم ةلاصلا نع نهدوعقف نهناميإ ناصقن امفأ ظوظحلا صقاونو ،لوقعلا صقاون ،ناميلاا صقاون ءاسنلا نإ !سانلا ناصقن امأو ،دحاولا لجرلا ةداهشك نهنم نيتأرملاا ةداهشف نهلوقع ناصقن امأو ،نهضيح مياأ يف مايصلاو .لاجرلا ثيراوم نم فاصنلاا لىع نهثيراومف نهظوظح
englishText: Muhammad bin Al-Husayn Al-Radhi Al-Musawi in (Nahj Al-Balagha) from Amir al Mu'minin (peace be upon him) that he said: O people! Indeed women are deficient in faith, deficient in intellect, and deficient in fortune. As for their deficiency in faith, it is their abstention from prayer and fasting during their menstruation days. As for Prohibition Of Prayer, Fasting, And Similar Acts For The Menstruati... their deficiency in intellect, it is that the testimony of two women equals the testimony of one man. And as for their deficiency in fortune, their inheritance is half of men's inheritance.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Ablution For Menstruating Women At Every Prayer Time, Facing The Qibla, And Remembering Allah For The Duration Of Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Ablution When Intending To Eat
arabicText: نكلو ،نضح اذإ ةلاصلا نيضقي لا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ءاسن نكو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لجو زع الله نركذيف دجسملا نم ابيرق نسلجي مث نيضوتيو ةلاصلا تقو لخدي نيح نيشحتي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The wives of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) would not make up the prayers when menstruating, but they would clean themselves when prayer time entered and perform ablution, then sit close to the mosque remembering Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.
