chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Ablution For Menstruating Women At Every Prayer Time, Facing The Qibla, And Remembering Allah For The Duration Of Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Ablution When Intending To Eat
arabicText: ءوضو أضوتت نأ اهيلعو ،ةلاصلا اهل لحت لاف اثماط ةأرملا تناك اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع رفعج يبأ نع رادقمك هدمحتو هللهتو هحبستو لجو زع الله ركذتف رهاط عضوم يف دعقت مث ،ةلاص لك تقو دنع ةلاصلا .اهتجاحل غرفت مث اهتلاص
englishText: From Abu Ja'far Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a woman is menstruating, prayer is not permissible for her, but she should perform ablution like the prayer ablution at every prayer time, then sit in a clean place to remember Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, glorify Him, declare His oneness, and praise Him for the duration of her prayer, then attend to her needs.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Ablution For Menstruating Women At Every Prayer Time, Facing The Qibla, And Remembering Allah For The Duration Of Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Ablution When Intending To Eat
arabicText: ةلبقلا لبقتست مث ،ةلاص لك تقو دنع أضوتت نأ ضئاحلل يغبني :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .ليصت ام رادقم الله ركذتو
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: A menstruating woman should perform ablution at every prayer time, then face the qibla and remember Allah for the duration she would pray. Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Ablution For Menstruating Women A...

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Ablution For Menstruating Women At Every Prayer Time, Facing The Qibla, And Remembering Allah For The Duration Of Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Ablution When Intending To Eat
arabicText: يف أضوت اهنكلو ،لاف رهطلا امأ :لقا ؟الله ركذتو ةعمجلا موي رهطت ضئاحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله باأ تلأس .ىلاعت الله ركذتو ةلبقلا لبقتست مث ،ةلاصلا تقو
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a menstruating woman purifying herself on Friday and remembering Allah? He said: As for purification, no, but she should perform ablution at prayer time, then face the qibla and remember Allah the Most High.

chapter: Emphasis On The Recommendation Of Ablution For Menstruating Women At Every Prayer Time, Facing The Qibla, And Remembering Allah For The Duration Of Prayer, And The Recommendation Of Ablution When Intending To Eat
arabicText: تأضوت ةلاصلا تقو ناك اذإو ،لكتأ نأ تدارأ اذإ ضئاحلا ةأرملا أضوتت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لجو زع الله تركذو رقلا تلتو تربكو تللهو ةلبقلا تلبقتساو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A menstruating woman performs ablution when she wants to eat, and when it's prayer time she performs ablution, faces the qibla, declares Allah's oneness, proclaims His greatness, recites the Quran, and remembers Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: ؟اهتلاص يضقت لاو اهموص يضقت ةأرملا نأ ىرت لاأ ،ساقت لا ةنسلا نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, the Sunnah (religious rulings) cannot be based on analogical reasoning (qiyas). Do you not see that a woman makes up her missed fasts but does not make up her missed prayers?

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: نأ اهيلع سيل :لقا ،؟مايصلا يضقت مث ،ةلاصلا ضئاحلا ءاضق نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ :لقا ةرارز نع هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لاقف لىع لبقأ مث ،ناضمر رهش موص يضقت نأ اهيلعو ،ةلاصلا يضقت .تانمؤملا كلذب رميأ ناكو ،(ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا كلذب رميأ ناك (هلآو
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about making up prayers for a menstruating woman, then making up fasts? He said: She doesn't have to make up the prayers, but she must make up the fasts of Ramadan month. Then he turned to me and said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to order Fatima (peace be upon her) with this, and he used to order the believing women with this.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: نم :تلق ،معن :لقا ؟موصلا يضقت :تلق ،لا :لقا ؟ةلاصلا يضقت ضئاحلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .سيلبإ سقا نم لوأ نإ :لقا ؟اذه ءاج نيأ
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Does a menstruating woman make up prayers? He said: No. I said: Does she make up fasts? He said: Yes. I said: Where did this come from? He said: Indeed, the first one to use analogy (qiyas) was Iblis.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: .ةلاصلا يضقت لاو مايصلا يضقت ضئاحلا ،لاقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأو رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon them), they said: The menstruating woman makes up fasts but not prayers. Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Wome...

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: ،ةلاصلا يضقت ضياحلا نإ :هل تلق كنأ كنع ىور ديعس نب ةريغملا نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق هنم جرخي لا مث هلخدي دجسملل ررحملاو ،اررحم اهنطب يف ام ترذن نارمع ةأرما نإ .الله هقفو لا هلام :لاقف ،ىثنلأاك ركذلا سيلو ىثنأ اهتعضو ينإ بر :تلقا اهتعضو املف ،ادبأ دجسملا نم جرخت ملف ،اهلفكف ياركز ةعرقلا تباصفأ ءايبنلأا اهيلع تمهاسف دجسملا اهتلخدأ اهتعضو املف يهو تجرخ يتلا ميالأا كلت ىضقت نأ لىع ردقت تناك لهف ،تجرخ ءاسنلا غلبت ام تغلب املف تغلب ىتح .دجسملا يف رهدلا نوكت نأ اهيلع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): I said to him: Al-Mughira bin Sa'id narrated from you that you told him that a menstruating woman should make up her prayers. He said: What is wrong with him, may Allah not grant him success. Indeed, the wife of Imran vowed what was in her womb to be dedicated, and one dedicated to the mosque enters it and never leaves it. When she gave birth to her, she said: My Lord, I have delivered a female, and the male is not like the female [Quran, 3:36] When she gave birth to her, she brought her to the mosque, and the prophets drew lots over her guardianship. The lot fell to Zakariya, so he took care of her. She did not leave the mosque until she reached maturity. When she reached the age of womanhood, she left. So could she make up for those days she left despite being obligated to stay in the mosque forever.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: .نضح اذإ ةلاصلا نيضقي لا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ءاسن نك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The wives of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) would not make up prayer when they menstruated.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: ناضمر رهش نم موي لوأ يف اهسافن مد وأ اهضيح نم ترهط ةأرما :هيلإ تبتك :ريازهم نب ليع نع هدانسإبو لكل لسغلا نم ةضاحتسملا هلمعت ام لمعت نأ ريغ نم هلك ناضمر رهش تماصو تلصف تضاحتسا مث ؟لا مأ اهتلاصو اهموص زوجي له ،نيتلاص رميأ ناك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نلا ،اهتلاص يضقت لاو اهموص يضقت ،(ملاسلا هيلع) بتكف .كلذب هءاسن نم تانمؤملا
englishText: Through his chain from Ali ibn Mahziyar who wrote to him: A woman became pure from her menstruation or postpartum bleeding on the first day of the month of Ramadan, then she experienced istihadha. She prayed and fasted the entire month of Ramadan without performing what a woman with istihadha should do, which is performing ghusl for every two prayers. Is her fasting and prayer valid or not? He (peace be upon him) wrote back: She must make up her fasts but not her prayers, because the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to order the believing women among his wives to do so. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The author of Al-Muntaqa and others mentioned that the answer here is about the ruling of the days of menstruation and postpartum bleeding, not Istihadha. They mentioned indications that show it is about the ruling of previous menstruation or menstruation occurring in the month of Ramadan. In it, ten days or less are considered as menstruation. Or perhaps the question is about the first day, and refraining from mentioning the ruling of Istihadha is due to taqiyyah, as it is considered a minor ritual impurity according to some common people. And Allah knows best.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: ضئاحلا تراص امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ،ناذاش نب لضفلا نع يتلآا دانسلابا (رابخلأا نويع) يفو :ىتش للعل ةلاصلا يضقت لاو مايصلا يضقت ةمرمب لاغتشلااو ،اهرومبأ مايقلاو ،اهتيب حلاصإو ،اهجوز ةمدخو اهسفن ةمدخ نم اهعنمي لا مايصلا نأ اهنم موصلاو ،كلذ لىع ىوقت لاف ،ارارم ةليللاو مويلا يف نوكت ةلاصلا نلا ،هلك كلذ نم اهعنمت ةلاصلاو ،اهتشيعم ،كلذك وه سيل نع كاسملاا وه امنإو ،كلذ نم ئش موصلا يف سيلو ،ناكرلأا لاغتشاو بعتو ءانع اهيف ةلاصلا نأ اهنمو ،ناكرلأا لاغتشا هيف سيلف بارشلاو ماعطلا هنلأ كلذك موصلا سيلو ،اهتليلو اهموي يف ةديدج ةلاص هيف اهيلع بجت لاإ ئيجي تقو نم سيل هنأ اهنمو .ةلاصلا اهيلع تبجو ةلاصلا تقو ثدح املكو ،موصلا بجو موي اهيلع ثدح املك سيل
englishText: In ('Uyun al-Akhbar) with the following chain of narration from Al-Fadhl ibn Shadhan, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: A menstruating woman must make up for her fasting but not her prayers for several reasons: Among them is that fasting does not prevent her from serving herself, serving her husband, maintaining her house, managing her affairs, and attending to her livelihood, while prayer prevents her from all of that, because prayers occur multiple times during day and night, so she cannot manage that, whereas fasting is not like that. And among them is that prayer involves hardship, fatigue, and engagement of the body parts, while fasting has none of that, as it is merely abstaining from food and drink and does not involve bodily engagement. And among them is that there is no time that comes except that a new prayer becomes obligatory upon her in her day and night, while fasting is not like that because not every new day necessitates fasting, whereas every time for prayer necessitates a new prayer upon her. Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Wome...

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: كرتت ضئاحلاو ،ليصتو يشتحتو لستغت ةضاحتسملاو :نومأملا ىلإ هباتك يف (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .يضقتو موصلا كرتتو ،يضقت لاو ةلاصلا
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) in his letter to Al-Ma'mun: The woman with irregular bleeding (mustahada) should perform ghusl, use cotton padding, and pray, while the menstruating woman (ha'id) should leave prayer and not make it up, and leave fasting but make it up.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: ةلاصلا :لقا ؟موصلا مأ ةلاصلا ،مظعأ امهيأ :ةفينح يبلأ لقا هنأ (ثيدح يف) (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .سقت لاو الله قتفا !؟ةلاصلا يضقت لاو مايصلا يضقت ضئاحلا لبا امف :لقا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) (in a hadith) that he said to Abu Hanifah: Which is greater, prayer or fasting? He said: Prayer. He said: Then why does a menstruating woman make up for her fasts but not her prayers?! So fear Allah and do not make analogies.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: ،ةلاصلا :لقا ؟موصلا مأ ةلاصلا لضفأ اميأ ةفينح يبلأ لقا هنأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .تكسف !؟اهتلاص يضقت لاو اهموص يضقت ضئاحلا لبا امف لقا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a narration- that he said to Abu Hanifah: Which is more virtuous, prayer or fasting? He said: Prayer. He said: Then why does a menstruating woman make up her fasts but not her prayers?! And he remained silent.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: يف وه امنإ موصلا نلأ :لقا ؟ةلاصلا يضقت لاو موصلا يضقت ضئاحلا لبا ام (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .كلذل ةلاصلا ءاضق اهيلع بجوي ملو موصلا ءاضق اهيلع الله بجوفأ ،ةليلو موي لك يف ةلاصلاو ،رهش ةنسلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Why does a menstruating woman make up for missed fasts but not make up for missed prayers? He said: Because fasting is only one month in the year, while prayer occurs every day and night, so Allah made it obligatory upon her to make up for fasting but did not make it obligatory upon her to make up for prayers for that reason.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: لبا امف :لقا ،ةلاصلا :لقا ؟موصلا مأ ةلاصلا مظعأ اميأ :ةفينح يبلأ لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .سقت لاو الله قتفا !؟ةلاصلا يضقت لاو موصلا يضقت ضئاحلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said to Abu Hanifah: Which is greater, prayer or fasting? He said: Prayer. He said: Then why does the menstruating woman make up fasting and not make up prayer? Fear Allah and do not make analogies.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: ثماطلا يف :لوقت ام - مرحمل ليلظت ثيدح يف :فسوي يبلأ لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نع هيلع) نسحلا وبأ لاقف ،ءاج اذكه :لقا ؟ملو :لقا معن :لقا ؟موصلا يضقتف :لقا ،لا :لقا ؟ةلاصلا يضقتف .اذه ءاج اذكهو :(ملاسلا
englishText: From Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said to Abu Yusuf- in a hadith about shade for a pilgrim in ihram- What do you say about a menstruating woman: does she make up the prayer? He said: No. He said: Does she make up the fast? He said: Yes. He said: Why? He said: This is how it has come. So Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: And this too has come like this.

chapter: Obligation of Making up Fasts but not Prayers for Menstruating Women and Those in Post-partum Period When They Become Pure
arabicText: ناك هنإ :لاقف ةريغملا ركذ مث باذك مهيف لزي مل ةفوكلا لهأ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ نأ ةرارز نع نم ئش ناك ام :الله ةنعل هيلع اللهو بذكو ةلاصلا نيضقف نضح دمحم لآ ءاسن نإ :اثيدح يبأ لىع بذكي .هثدح لاو كلذ
englishText: Zurarah narrated that Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The people of Kufa have always had a liar among them. Then he mentioned al-Mughira and said: He used to fabricate lies against my father, claiming: The women of the family of Muhammad menstruated and made up their prayers. He lied, by Allah may Allah curse him nothing of this sort ever happened, nor did my father narrate it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For Menstruating Women, Though Disliked
arabicText: .هب سبأ لا :لقا ،؟ضئاح يهو بضتخت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a woman applying dye while she is menstruating? He said: There is no problem with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For Menstruating Women, Though Disliked
arabicText: .معن :لاقف ؟ثماط يهو ةأرملا بضتخت (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ يبلأ تلق
englishText: I said to Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him), can a woman apply dye while she is menstruating? He said: Yes.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For Menstruating Women, Though Disliked
arabicText: .ناطيشلا اهيلع فاخي هنلأ لا :لقا ؟بضتخت له ضئاحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about whether a menstruating woman can apply dye? He said: No, because Satan is feared for her.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For Menstruating Women, Though Disliked
arabicText: .كلذ دنع ناطيشلا اهيلع فاخي لا :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) similar to the previous, except that he said: Satan is not feared for her at that time.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For Menstruating Women, Though Disliked
arabicText: هب سيل ،لا :لقا ؟ضئاح يهو بضتخت ةأرملا :تلق :لقا - ثيدح - يف (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا نع .سبأ
englishText: From Al-Abd Al-Salih (peace be upon him) in a hadith, he said: I said: Can a woman apply dye while she is menstruating? He said: No, there is no problem with it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For Menstruating Women, Though Disliked
arabicText: .سبأ لا :لقا ؟نابضتخيأ ضئاحلاو بنجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا تلأس :لقا
englishText: He said: I asked Al-Abd Al-Salih (peace be upon him) about the person in the state of janabah and the menstruating woman, can they apply dye? He said: There is no problem.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For Menstruating Women, Though Disliked
arabicText: .بنجلا لاو ضئاحلا بضتخت لا :لوقي هتعمس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I heard him saying: Neither the menstruating woman nor the person in state of major ritual impurity should apply dye.

chapter: Permissibility Of Dyeing (With Henna) For Menstruating Women, Though Disliked
arabicText: .ضئاحلا بضتخت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: A menstruating woman should not apply dye.

chapter: Recommendation Of Women Dyeing Their Hair With Henna After Menstruation Stops
arabicText: ضيحلا نفإ ءانحلبا اهسأر بضخا :لاقف ؟اهتلع تعفترا دق ةاتف يل نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبلأ تلق .ضيحلا اهيلإ داعف كلذ تلعفف :لقا ،اهيلإ دوعيس
englishText: I said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): I have a young girl whose condition (menstruation) has stopped? He said: Dye her head with henna for menstruation will return to her. He said: So I did that and her menstruation returned.

chapter: There Is No Ruling Based On Suspicion Or Doubt Of Menstruation, Even During Prayer, Until There Is Certainty About It, And It Is Recommended To Verify The Situation
arabicText: سمتف اهدي لخدت لقا ،تضاح دق اهنأ نظتف ةلاصلا يف نوكت ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهتلاص تمتأ ائيش رتنا ائيش تأر نفإ عضوملا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who is in prayer and suspects that she has started menstruating, he said: She should insert her hand and touch the area, and if she sees something that has scattered, she should complete her prayer.

chapter: There Is No Ruling Based On Suspicion Or Doubt Of Menstruation, Even During Prayer, Until There Is Certainty About It, And It Is Recommended To Verify The Situation
arabicText: دق هنأ نقيتسي ىتح لا :لقا ؟هب ملعي ملو ئش هبناج ىلإ كرح نفإ :تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع هضقنت امنإو كشلبا ادبأ نيقيلا ضقنت لاو ،هئوضو نم نيقي لىع هنفإ لاإو ،نيب رمأ كلذ نم ئيجي ىتح ،منا .رخآ نيقيب
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), I said: What if something moves to his side and he doesn't know about it? He said: No [it doesn't affect anything] until he is certain that he has slept, until there comes clear evidence of that. Otherwise, he maintains certainty in his ablution, and certainty is never invalidated by doubt, rather it is only invalidated by another certainty.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Menstruating Woman Handing Water And Prayer Mat To A Man
arabicText: ءاسن ضعب ناك دق :لاقف ؟ءاملا لجرلا لوانت ضئاحلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةرمخلا هلوانتو ،ضئاح يهو ءاملا هيلع بكست (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a menstruating woman handing water to a man? He said: Some of the Prophet's wives (peace be upon him and his family) would pour water for him while menstruating, and would hand him the prayer mat.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Menstruating Woman Handing Water And Prayer Mat To A Man
arabicText: يف كضيحأ :اهل لاقف ،ضئاح ناأ :تلاقف ،ةرمخلا ينيلونا هئاسن ضعبلو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا !؟كدي
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to one of his wives: Hand me the prayer mat. She said: I am menstruating. He said to her: Is your menstruation in your hand?!

chapter: Permissibility Of A Menstruating Woman Handing Water And Prayer Mat To A Man
arabicText: ينيلونا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) هل ةيراجل وأ ،هئاسن ضعبل :لقا هنأ لاإ هلثم (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .اهيلع دجسأ ةرمخلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) similar to it except that he said: To one of his wives, or to his maid servant (peace be upon him): Hand me the prayer mat so I may prostrate on it.

chapter: Permissibility Of Menstruating Women Nursing The Sick And The Dislike Of Their Presence At The Time Of Death
arabicText: سبأ لا :لاقف ؟توملا دح يف ضئاح يهو ضيرملا سأر دنع دعقت ةأرملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبلأ تلق .كلذب ىذأتت ةكئلاملا نفإ ،هبرق نعو هنع حنتلف كلذ برقو هيلع اوفاخ اذفإ ،هضرمت نأ
englishText: I said to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): Can a menstruating woman sit at the head of a sick person who is near death? He said: There is no problem with her nursing him, but when they fear for him and death approaches, she should move away from him and his proximity, for the angels are disturbed by that.

chapter: Obligation To Refer To Women And Believe Them Regarding Waiting Period And Menstruation Unless They Claim Something Contrary To Women's Normal Habits
arabicText: .تقدص تعدا اذإ ءاسنلل ضيحلاو ةدعلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: The waiting period and menstruation are matters for women, when they claim something about them, they are to be believed.

chapter: Obligation To Refer To Women And Believe Them Regarding Waiting Period And Menstruation Unless They Claim Something Contrary To Women's Normal Habits
arabicText: .يتيأ امل ةمهتلا مدعب خيشلا هديق :لوقأ .ءاسنلا ىلإ ضيحلاو ةدعلا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس
englishText: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: The waiting period and menstruation are matters for women. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh restricted this to cases where there is no suspicion, as will be mentioned later. Shaykh Hurr Amili: The Sheikh restricted it to cases where there is no suspicion, based on what will be mentioned.

chapter: Obligation To Refer To Women And Believe Them Regarding Waiting Period And Menstruation Unless They Claim Something Contrary To Women's Normal Habits
arabicText: دحاو رهش يف تضاح اهنأ تعدا ةأرما يف لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع لاإو تقدص ندهش نفإ ؟تعدا ام لىع ىضم اميف ناك اهضيح نا اهتناطب نم ةوسن اوفلك لاقف ،ضيح ثلاث .ةبذاك يهف
englishText: From his father (peace be upon them both) that Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said regarding a woman who claimed she had three menstrual periods in one month: He said ask the women close to her if her menstruation in the past was as she claimed? If they testify to that, she is truthful, and if not, she is lying.

chapter: Ruling On Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman During The Prayer Time And The Ruling On Menstruation Occurring During Prayer
arabicText: سمشلا لاوز نم يضمي ام دعب مدلا ةأرملا تأر اذإو لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع يهو اهيلع لخد رهظلا تقو نلا ،رهظلا ةلاص ضقتلف مدلا نم ترهط اذفإ ،ةلاصلا نع كسمتلف مادقأ ةعبرأ .اهؤاضق اهيلع بجوف رهظلا ةلاص تعيضف ،رهاط يهو رهظلا تقو اهنع جرخو ،رهاط
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: If a woman sees blood after four feet have passed from the sun's zenith, she should refrain from prayer. When she becomes pure from blood, she should make up the Dhuhr prayer, because the time of Dhuhr entered while she was pure, and the time of Dhuhr ended while she was pure, so she neglected the Dhuhr prayer and must make it up.

chapter: Ruling On Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman During The Prayer Time And The Ruling On Menstruation Occurring During Prayer
arabicText: تقو لخدي ىتح ةلاصلا ترخفأ تقو يف ترهط اذإو :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهيف تطرف يتلا ةلاصلا كلت ءاضق اهيلع ناك امد تأر مث ىرخأ ةلاص
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: If she becomes pure during a prayer time but delays the prayer until another prayer time enters, then sees blood, she must make up that prayer which she neglected.

chapter: Ruling On Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman During The Prayer Time And The Ruling On Menstruation Occurring During Prayer
arabicText: :لقا ،مدلا ىرت مث نيتعكر تلص دقو رهظلا ةلاص يف نوكت يتلا ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس مقتلف نيتعكر تلص دقو برغملا ةلاص يف يهو مدلا تأر تناك نإو ،نيتعكرلا يضقت لاو اهدجسم نم موقت .برغملا نم اهتتفا يتلا ةعكرلا ضقتلف ترهطت اذفإ اهدجسم نم ةعكرلا ءاضق متي امنإو لقا ،رهظلا نود برغملا يف تطرف اهنوك لىع (فلتخملا) يف ةملاعلا هلمح :لوقأ .ازاجم ةلاصلا لىع ةعكرلا قلاطإ نوكيو يقابلا ءاضقب
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a woman who is in Dhuhr prayer and has prayed two rak'ahs then sees blood. He said: She should rise from her prayer place and not make up the two rak'ahs. If she saw blood while in Maghrib prayer and had prayed two rak'ahs, she should rise from her prayer place, and when she becomes pure, she should make up the missed rak'ah of Maghrib. Ruling On Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman During The Pra... I (Hurr Amili) say: Al-Allama interpreted it in (Al-Mukhtalif) as being about her neglecting Maghrib but not Dhuhr, saying that making up the rak'ah is only complete by making up the remainder, and using the term rak'ah for the prayer is metaphorical.

chapter: Ruling On Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman During The Prayer Time And The Ruling On Menstruation Occurring During Prayer
arabicText: تضاح ىتح ةلاصلا ترخفأ رهاط يهو ةلاصلا تقو اهيلع لخد ةأرما يف لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ترهط اذإ يضقت لقا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said regarding a woman who enters prayer time while pure but delays the prayer until she menstruates: She should make it up when she becomes pure.

chapter: Ruling On Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman During The Prayer Time And The Ruling On Menstruation Occurring During Prayer
arabicText: اهيلع له رهظلا لصت ملو سمشلا لوزت ام دعب ثمطت ةأرملا نع هتلأس لقا جاجحلا نب نامحرلا دبع نع .معن لقا ؟ةلاصلا كلت ءاضق
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Al-Hajjaj, he said: I asked him about a woman who menstruates after the sun's zenith and hasn't prayed Dhuhr, does she have to make up that prayer? He said: Yes.

chapter: Ruling On Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman During The Prayer Time And The Ruling On Menstruation Occurring During Prayer
arabicText: يهو تثمط اهنإ مث نيتعكر رهظلا نم تلص ةأرما نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ةعامس نع .نيتعكرلا يضقت لاف اهناكم نم موقت :لاقف ،؟ةسلاج
englishText: From Sama'ah, he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who prayed two rak'ahs of Dhuhr then menstruated while sitting? He said: She should rise from her place and not make up the two rak'ahs.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: ةلاص تقو يف لستغت نأ لىع ةردقا يهو رهطلا تأر ةأرما اميأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع يف رهطلا تأر نإو اهيف تطرف يتلا ةلاصلا كلت ءاضق اهيلع ناك ىرخأ ةلاص تقو لخدي ىتح اهيف تطرفف ليصتو ،ءاضق اهيلع سيلف ىرخأ ةلاص تقو لخدو ةلاص تقو زاجف كلذ ةيهت يف تماقف ةلاص تقو .اهتقو لخد يتلا ةلاصلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Any woman who sees purity and is able to perform ghusl during prayer time but neglects it until another prayer time enters, she must make up that prayer she neglected. If she sees purity during prayer time and begins preparing but the time passes and another prayer time enters, she does not need to make it up, and she prays the prayer whose time has entered.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: ؟ةلاصلبا عنصت فيك سمشلا بورغ لبق رهطلا ىرت ةأرملا :تلق (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا باأ تلأس لخد رهظلا تقو نلا ،رصعلا لاإ ليصت لاف مادقأ ةعبرأ سمشلا لاوز نم ىضمي ام دعب رهطلا تأر اذإ :لقا نم اهنع الله حرط امو رهظلا ليصت نأ اهيلع بجي ملف ،مدلا يف يهو تقولا اهنع جرخو مدلا يف يهو اهيلع .رثكأ مدلا يف يهو ةلاصلا .ةقداص ةيدعبلا نفإ اهئادأ رادقم ىقبي نبأ رصعلا تقو قيض لىع وأ ،ةيقتلا لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan I (peace be upon him): What should a woman do about prayer if she becomes pure before sunset? He said: If she sees purity after the sun has declined by four feet, she only prays Asr, because the time of Dhuhr entered while she was menstruating and left while she was menstruating, so she is not obligated to pray Dhuhr, and what Allah has removed from her of prayer while she was menstruating is more. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as taqiyyah, or when Asr time is tight with just enough time to perform it, as the latter interpretation is valid. Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Become...

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: يتلا ةلاصلا ليصت امنإ ،لا :لقا ؟ىلولأا ليصت رصعلا دنع رهطت ضئاحلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس .اهدنع رهطت
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a menstruating woman who becomes pure at Asr time, should she pray the first prayer? He said: No, she only prays the prayer at whose time she became pure.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: ىتح لسغلا ترخأ مث ةلاصلا تقو اهيلع لخد دقو رهطلا ةأرملا تأر اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهيف تطرف يتلا ةلاصلا كلت ءاضق اهيلع ناك ىرخأ ةلاص تقو لخدي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a woman sees purity when prayer time has entered but delays ghusl until another prayer time enters, she must make up that prayer she neglected.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: تقو لخدي ىتح اهنأش يف لغتشتف رهظلا دنع رهطلا ىرت ةأرملا :تلق :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع .نتالاص اهيلعف تقيض نفإ اهدحو رصعلا ليصت :لقا ،؟رصعلا .رابخلاا نيب اعمج ،بورغلا لبق اهئادأ رادقم وهو اهب صتخملا تقولا رصعلا تقوب داري نأ دعبي لا :لوقأ
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them) when I asked: A woman sees purity at Dhuhr time but becomes occupied with her affairs until Asr time enters? He said: She prays Asr alone, but if she made it tight then she must pray both prayers. I (Hurr Amili) say: It's not far-fetched that what's meant by Asr time is the time specific to it, which is enough time to perform it before sunset, combining between the reports.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: رخآ يف ترهط نفإ ،رصعلاو رهظلا تلص رصعلا لبق ضئاحلا ترهط اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رصعلا تلص رصعلا تقو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a menstruating woman becomes pure before Asr, she prays Dhuhr and Asr, and if she becomes pure at the end of Asr time, she prays Asr.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: ترهط نإو ،ءاشعلاو برغملا تلص رجفلا عولط لبق ةأرملا ترهط اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رصعلاو رهظلا تلص سمشلا بيغت نأ لبق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a woman becomes pure before dawn breaks, she prays Maghrib and Isha, and if she becomes pure before sunset, she prays Dhuhr and Asr.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: جرخيو ةلاصلا اهتوفت ىتح اهرهظ يضقت لاف ةلاصلا تقو يف موقت ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .يضقت لاف اهلسغ يف ةبئاد تناك نإو ،اهتضق تناوت تناك نإ :لقا ؟اهتتفا يتلا ةلاصلا يضقتأ ،تقولا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who starts at prayer time but doesn't complete her Dhuhr until she misses the prayer and the time exits, should she make up the missed prayer? He said: If she delayed it, she makes it up, but if she was continuously engaged in her ghusl, she doesn't make it up.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: ،رفصت سمشلا تداك دق :لئاقلا لوقي ىتح لستغتف اهضيح نم رهطت ليهأ نم ةأرملا تناك :لقا هيبأ نعو .رصعلا ليصت نأ اهرميأ ناكف ،طرفأ دق :تلق ةعاسلا كلت رصعلا ليصي نااسنإ تيأر ول ام كنأ ردقب
englishText: And from his father who said: A woman from my family would become pure from her menstruation and perform ghusl until someone would say the sun has almost yellowed, to the extent that if you saw someone praying Asr at that time you would say they were late, and he would order her to pray Asr.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: ترهط نإو ،رصعلاو رهظلا لصتلف سمشلا بورغ لبق ةأرملا ترهط اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اشعلاو برغملا لصتلف ليللا رخآ نم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a woman becomes pure before sunset, she should pray Dhuhr and Asr, and if she becomes pure at the end of the night, she should pray Maghrib and Isha.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: ،رصعلاو رهظلا تلص سمشلا بورغ لبق ترهطف اضئاح ةأرملا تناك اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ةرخلآا ءاشعلا برغملا تلص ليللا رخآ نم ترهط نإو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: If a woman is menstruating and becomes pure before sunset, she prays Dhuhr and Asr, and if she becomes pure at the end of the night, she prays Maghrib and the last Isha. Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Become...

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: نأ لبق ترهط نإو ،ءاشعلاو برغملا تلص رجفلا عولط لبق ةأرملا ترهط اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) خيشلا نع .رصعلاو رهظلا تلص سمشلا بيغت امل ،ىرخلأا نم ةعكرو ةلاص رادقم وأ ،تقولا رخآ نم نيتلاصلا رادقم كاردإ لىع لومحم هلاثمأو اذه :لوقأ ،بابحتسلاا لىع ليللا فصن دعب ترهط اذإ ءاشعلاو برغملا ءاضق خيشلا لمح دقو ،تيقاوملا يف يتيأ .الله ءاشنإ يتيأ امل ةيقتلا لىع هلمح نكميو
englishText: From the Shaykh (peace be upon him) who said: If a woman becomes pure before dawn breaks, she prays Maghrib and Isha, and if she becomes pure before sunset, she prays Dhuhr and Asr. I (Hurr Amili) say: This and its like are interpreted as catching enough time for both prayers at the end of the time, or enough time for one prayer and one rak'ah of the other, as will come in the prayer times section, and the Shaykh interpreted making up Maghrib and Isha when becoming pure after midnight as recommended, and it can be interpreted as taqiyyah as will come if Allah wills.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: مويلا ةلاصلا تضق راهنلا نم ةعاس يف رهطلا تأر اذإو - ثيدح يف - لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كلذ لثم ليللاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said- in a hadith- and if she sees purity at any hour of the day, she makes up the prayer of the day and night similarly.

chapter: Obligation Of Making Up Prayers For A Menstruating Woman Who Becomes Pure Before The Time Ends With Enough Time For Purification And One Rak'ah
arabicText: .رهظلا ليصت مث رصعلا ليصت رصعلا تقو يف تلستغا اذإ ضئاحلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع بحاص هنسحتساو ،رصعلا تقو قيضت ىتح لسغلا ترخأو رهظلا تقو ترهط اهنأ لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .تيقاوملا يف يتيأ امل ةيقتلا لىع هلمح نكميو :لقا مث ،ىقتنملا
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) regarding a menstruating woman who performs ghusl at Asr time, she prays Asr then prays Dhuhr. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as her becoming pure at Dhuhr time but delaying ghusl until Asr time becomes tight, and the author of Al-Muntaqa approved it, then said: It can be interpreted as taqiyyah as will come in the prayer times section.

chapter: Prohibition Of Fasting For Menstruating Women, Its Invalidation When Occurring During Any Part Of The Day, The Recommendation To Abstain When Purified During The Day, And The Obligation To Make Up For It
arabicText: لقا ،؟سمشلا بيغت نأ لبق ناضمر رهش يف تثمط ةأرما نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ثمطت نيح رطفت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman who menstruates in Ramadan before sunset? He said: She breaks her fast when she menstruates.

chapter: Prohibition Of Fasting For Menstruating Women, Its Invalidation When Occurring During Any Part Of The Day, The Recommendation To Abstain When Purified During The Day, And The Obligation To Make Up For It
arabicText: دقو ترهط تحبصأ اذفإ ناضمر رهش يف ضياح يهو رجفلا علطي ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هب دتعت لاو موصت :لقا ؟هيف ترهط يذلا مويلا كلذ يف عنصت فيك ،رصعلاو رهظلا تلص مث ،تلكأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who experiences dawn while menstruating in Ramadan, then becomes pure in the morning after having eaten, then prays Dhuhr and Asr, what should she do on that day in which she became pure? He said: She should fast but it won't count.

chapter: Prohibition Of Fasting For Menstruating Women, Its Invalidation When Occurring During Any Part Of The Day, The Recommendation To Abstain When Purified During The Day, And The Obligation To Make Up For It
arabicText: رهطلا تأر اذإو ،تثمط اذإ ةمئاصلا رطفت يهف مدلا ةأرملا تأر ةعاس يأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كلذ لثم ليللاو ،مويلا ةلاص تضق راهنلا نم ةعاس يف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: At whatever hour a woman sees blood, the fasting woman breaks her fast when she menstruates, and if she sees purity at any hour of the day, she makes up the prayer of that day, and the night is similar to that.

chapter: Prohibition Of Fasting For Menstruating Women, Its Invalidation When Occurring During Any Part Of The Day, The Recommendation To Abstain When Purified During The Day, And The Obligation To Make Up For It
arabicText: ناك اذإو ،رطفت :لقا ؟لاوزلا دنع وأ ،راهنلا عافترا وأ ،ةودغ مدلا ىرت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس .مويلا كلذ ضقتلو اهموص ضمتلف لاوزلا دعب وأ رصعلا دعب
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a woman who sees blood in the Prohibition Of Fasting For Menstruating Women, Its Invalidation Whe... morning, or when the day rises, or at noon? He said: She breaks her fast, and if it's after Asr or after noon, she should continue her fast and make up that day.

chapter: Prohibition Of Fasting For Menstruating Women, Its Invalidation When Occurring During Any Part Of The Day, The Recommendation To Abstain When Purified During The Day, And The Obligation To Make Up For It
arabicText: نأ ةعس يف يهف لاوزلا لبق ناضمر رهش يف ثمطلا ةأرملل ضرع نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .برشتو لكتأ مل ام مويلا كلذ موصب دتعتلو لستغتلف سمشلا لاوز دعب اهل ضرع نإو ،برشتو لكتأ مكح هيف سيل ذإ ،هئاضق بجو نإو ،ةدابع هدعتو ،باوثلا لوصح يف هب دتعت اهنأ لىع لمحلا نكمي :لوقأ .ءاضقلا طوقسب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: If menstruation occurs for a woman in Ramadan before noon, she is free to eat and drink, and if it occurs after noon, she should perform ghusl and count that day's fast if she hasn't eaten or drunk. I (Hurr Amili) say: It's possible to interpret that she counts it for receiving reward and considers it worship, even if making it up is obligatory, as there's no ruling about dropping the make-up fast.

chapter: Prohibition Of Fasting For Menstruating Women, Its Invalidation When Occurring During Any Part Of The Day, The Recommendation To Abstain When Purified During The Day, And The Obligation To Make Up For It
arabicText: مويلا كلذ رطفت :لقا ،ترهط راهنلا عفترا اذإ ىتح ناضمر يف تضاح ةأرما يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع :لقا ،؟ضيحلا تأر راهنلا عفترا اذإ ىتح ارهاط ناضمر يف تحبصأ ةأرما نعو ،هيضقت مث ،برشتو لكتأ ،هلك .هلك مويلا كلذ رطفت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who menstruated in Ramadan until the day rose and then became pure, he said: She should break her fast for that entire day, eat and drink, then make it up, and regarding a woman who begins Ramadan pure until the day rises and then sees menstruation? He said: She breaks her fast for that entire day.

chapter: Prohibition Of Fasting For Menstruating Women, Its Invalidation When Occurring During Any Part Of The Day, The Recommendation To Abstain When Purified During The Day, And The Obligation To Make Up For It
arabicText: ةأرملا يفو ،رطفت :لقا ؟موصت وأ رطفت ،ناضمر يف راهنلا لوأ يف رهطت ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .مدلا نم اهرطف امنإ رطفت :لقا ؟موصت مأ رطفتأ ناضمر رهش يف راهنلا لوأ نم مدلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who becomes pure at the beginning of the day in Ramadan, should she break her fast or fast? He said: She breaks her fast, and regarding a woman who sees blood from the beginning of the day in Ramadan, should she break her fast or fast? He said: She breaks her fast as her breaking is due to blood.

chapter: Ruling On Menstruation During I'tikaf (Spiritual Retreat) And The Ruling On Divorce During Menstruation
arabicText: .فاكتعا اهل سيل عجرت :لقا ،تثمط اهنإ مث تفكتعا ةأرما يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who performed i'tikaf then menstruated, he said: She should return home as her i'tikaf is nullified.

chapter: Ruling On Menstruation During I'tikaf (Spiritual Retreat) And The Ruling On Divorce During Menstruation
arabicText: دجسملا نم تجرخف ةلاصلا اهيلع تمرح مث ةفكتعم تناك ةأرما يأو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهفاكتعا يضقتو دجسملا ىلإ دوعت ىتح اهعماجي نأ اهجوزل يغبني سيلف ترهطف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Any woman who was in i'tikaf then prayer became forbidden for her (due to menstruation) and she left the mosque, then became pure, it is not appropriate for her husband to have intimate relations with her until she returns to the mosque and completes her i'tikaf.

chapter: Recommendation For Menstruating Women To Dye Their Clothes With Red Clay If Blood Traces Remain
arabicText: بهذي ملف هتلسغف ضيحلا مد يبوث باصأ :تلاقف هيبلأ دلو مأ هتلئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا نع .بهذيو طلتخي ىتح قشمب هيغبصا :لاقف ،؟هرثأ
englishText: From Al-Abd Al-Salih (peace be upon him), he said: A slave woman of his father asked him saying: Menstrual blood got on my clothes and I washed it but its trace did not go away? He said: Dye it with red clay (ocher) until it blends and disappears. Section 5 Istihadha (Irregular Vaginal Bleeding)

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ،اهلعب اهبرقي لاو ،اهيف ليصت لاف اهمياأ رظنت ةضاحتسملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ءاشعلاو برغمللو هذه لجعتو هذه رخؤت ،رصعلاو رهظلل تلستغا فسركلا بقثي مدلا تأرو اهمياأ تزاج اذفإ دجسملا يف اهيذخف مضتو ىنحت لاو رفثتستو يشتحتو حبصلل لستغتو ،هذه ل لجعتو هذه رخؤت لاسغ ،جراخ اهدسج رئاسو ،ءوضوب ةلاص لك تلصو دجسملا تلخدو تأضوت فسركلا بقثي لا مدلا ناك نإو اهءرق مياأ اهلعب اهيتيأ لاو .اهضيح مياأ يف لاإ اهلعب اهيتيأ هذهو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: A woman experiencing istihadha (irregular bleeding) should observe her usual menstrual days, during which she does not pray, and her husband should not approach her. When her usual days have passed and she sees blood penetrating the cotton pad, she should perform ghusl (ritual bath) for Dhuhr and Asr prayers- delaying the former and hastening the latter- and one ghusl for Maghrib and Isha prayers- delaying the former and hastening the latter- and perform ghusl for Fajr prayer. She should insert cotton, tie a cloth tightly, avoid applying henna, and place her thighs inside the mosque while keeping the rest of her body outside. Her husband should not approach her during her menstrual days. If the blood does not penetrate the cotton pad, she should perform wudu (ablution), enter the mosque, and pray each prayer with a fresh wudu. This woman can be approached by her husband except during her menstrual days.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: لئس :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا :لاقف ،؟ضاحتست ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لستغت مث ،اهيف ليصت لا اهضيح مياأ ثكمت نأ اهرمفأ ضاحتست ةأرملا نع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ،بوثلا ءارو نم مدلا جرخي ىتح ليصت مث ،بوثب رفثتستو ةنطق لخدتستو كلذ ريغ وأ ةنخدلبا رمجتستو بيطتت نأ رفاذتسلااو ،نيتلاص لك نيب ةيمدلا ةأرملا لستغت :لقاو .ةبادلا رفث لثم لعجي نأ رافثتسلااو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a woman Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings experiencing istihadha (irregular bleeding)? He said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about a woman experiencing istihadha, so he commanded her to remain during her menstrual days without praying during them, then perform ghusl (ritual bath), insert cotton, and wear a cloth protection. Then she should pray until blood appears from behind the cloth. And he said: The bleeding woman should perform ghusl between every two prayers, and istithfar means to use perfume and fumigation with incense or similar things, and istidfar means to wear protection similar to an animal's harness.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: مياأ ةثلاث تثكمف ترهط مث مدلا ىرت مياأ ةرشع ةأرملا ثكم اذإ :هل تلق ،لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع دعب ةنطق لخدتستو لستغت ،ةضاحتسم هذه لا :لقا ؟ةلاصلا نع كسمتأ كلذ دعب مدلا تأر مث ارهاط .دارأ نإ اهجوز اهيتيأو لسغب نيتلاص نيب عمجتو ةنطق
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him: If a woman experiences bleeding for ten days, then becomes pure for three days, then sees blood after that, should she abstain from prayer? He said: No, she is in a state of istihadha (irregular bleeding). She should perform ghusl (ritual bath), insert cotton after cotton, combine two prayers with one ghusl, and her husband may approach her if he wishes.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: لستغت مث ،رصعلاو رهظلا ليصتو رهظلا ةلاص دنع لستغت ةضاحتسملا لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ءاش اذإ اهلعب اهيتيأ نبأ سبأ لاو ،رجفلا ليصتف حبصلا دنع لستغت مث ،ءاشعلاو برغملا ليصتف برغملا دنع .كلذ نم تيفوع لاإ بااستحا طق ةأرما هلعفت مل :لقاو :لقا ،اهجوز اهلزتعيف اهضيح مياأ لاإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A woman experiencing istihadha (irregular bleeding) should perform ghusl before Dhuhr prayer and pray Dhuhr and Asr, then perform ghusl before Maghrib and pray Maghrib and Isha, then perform ghusl before dawn and pray Fajr. There is no harm if her husband approaches her whenever he wishes except during her menstrual days when her husband should avoid her. He said: And he said: No woman has ever done this seeking reward except that she was cured from it.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: لاإو مدلا عطقنا نفا ،نيمويب رهظتستو اهضيح ردقب دعقت :لاقف ؟ليصت ىتم ءاسفنلا :هل تلق :لقا ةرارز نع .تلصو ترفثتساو تشتحاو تلستغا ءاشعلاو برغملاو لسغب رصعلاو رهظلاو لسغب ةادغلا تلص مث ،تلستغاو تبصعت فسركلا مدلا زاج نفإ ؟ضئاحلاو :تلق ،دحاو لسغب تلص فسركلا مدلا زجي مل نإو ،لسغب عدت لاو ليصت مث ءاوس ءاسفنلا لثم عنصت ةضاحتسم يهف لاإو مدلا اهنع عطقنا نفإ ءاوس كلذ لثم :لقا .مكنيد دامع ةلاصلا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نفإ ،لاح لىع ةلاصلا
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I asked him: When does a postpartum woman pray? He said: She waits for the duration of her menstrual period and adds two precautionary days. If the bleeding stops, that is fine, otherwise she performs ghusl, uses padding, ties it securely, and prays. If the blood seeps through the padding, she should bandage herself and perform ghusl, then pray Fajr with one ghusl, Dhuhr and Asr with another ghusl, and Maghrib and Isha with another ghusl. If the blood does not seep through the padding, she prays with a single ghusl. I asked: And what about the menstruating woman? He said: The same applies equally. If the bleeding stops from her then that is that, otherwise she is considered to be in a state of istihadha (irregular bleeding) and should do the same as what a woman in post-partum bleeding does, then she should pray and not leave prayer in any circumstance, for the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Prayer is the pillar of your religion.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: زجي مل نإو ،لاسغ رجفللو نيتلاص لكل تلستغا فسركلا مدلا بقث اذإ ةضاحتسملا :لقا :لقا ،ةعامس نع نإ اذه ،لستغت نيحف اهيتيأ نأ اهجوز دارأ نإو ةلاص لكل ءوضولاو ةرم موي لكل لسغلا اهيلعف فسركلا مدلا .ءوضولا اهيلعف ةرفص ناك نإو ،اطيبع اهمد ناك
englishText: From Sama'ah who said: He said: For a woman with irregular menstrual bleeding (Istihadha), if the blood penetrates through the cotton, she should perform ghusl (ritual bath) for every two prayers and one ghusl for Fajr prayer. If the blood does not penetrate through the cotton, then she must perform ghusl once every day and perform wudu (ablution) for each prayer. If her husband wants to have intercourse with her, it should be after she performs ghusl. This applies if her blood is fresh. If the blood is yellowish, then she only needs to perform wudu. Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: يذلا تقولا لبق مدلا لماحلا تأر اذإو :لقا - لماحلا ضيح ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع يتلا اهمياأ ددع ةلاصلا نع كسمتلف ةضيحلا نم هنفإ رهشلا كلذ نم تقولا يف وأ ليلقب مدلا هيف ىرت تناك ،لصتلو لستغتلف كلذ لبق مدلا اهنع عطقنا نفإ ،اهتضيح يف دعقت تناك يشتحت مث لستغتلف نيموي وأ مويب اهيف مدلا ىرت تناك يتلا ميالأا يضمت ام دعب لاإ اهنع مدلا عطقني مل نإو فسركلا فلخ نم ليسي لا برغملا نيبو اهنيب اميف مدلا ناك نفإ رظنتل مث رصعلاو رهظلا ليصتو رفذتستو اهيلع بجو مدلا لاسف اهنع فسركلا تحرط نفإ ،فسركلا حرطت مل ام ةلاص لك تقو دنع لصتلو أضوتلف ،اهيلع لسغ لاو لصتلو أضوتلف مدلا لسي ملو اهنع فسركلا تحرط نإو ،لسغلا لك يف لستغت نأ اهيلع نفإ ىقري لا ابيبص فسركلا فلخ نم ليسي فسركلا تكسمأ اذإ مدلا ناك نإو :لقا ءاشعلاو برغملل لستغتو ،رصعلاو رهظلل لستغتو ،رجفلل لستغتو ليصتو يشتحتو تارم ثلاث ةليلو موي .اهنع مدلبا الله بهذأ كلذ تلعف ذإ لعفت كلذكو :لقا ،ةرخلآا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith about menstruation during pregnancy- he said: When a pregnant woman sees blood shortly before or during her usual time of the month, it is from menstruation. She should refrain from prayer for the number of days she used to observe during her menstruation. If the bleeding stops before that, she should perform ghusl and pray. If the bleeding does not stop until one or two days after her usual period, she should perform ghusl, use cotton padding, secure it, and pray Dhuhr and Asr. Then she should observe: if between that time and Maghrib the blood does not seep through the padding, she should perform wudu and pray at each prayer time as long as she keeps the padding. If she removes the padding and blood flows, ghusl becomes obligatory. If she removes the padding and blood doesn't flow, she should perform wudu and pray, with no ghusl required. He said: If when using the padding the blood flows heavily and continuously through it, she must perform ghusl three times every day and night: use padding, pray, perform ghusl for Fajr, perform ghusl for Dhuhr and Asr, and perform ghusl for Maghrib and Isha. He said: When she does this, Allah will remove the bleeding from her.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: يذلا اهؤرق دعقت :لقا ؟تيبلبا فوطت لهو ؟اهجوز اهأطيأ ةضاحتسملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس ،هب ذخأتلف اميقتسم اهؤرق ناك نفإ ،هيف ضيحت تناك لستغتلف فسركلا نع رهظ نفإ افسرك لخدتستلو لستغتلو ،نيموي وأ مويب طتحتلف فلاخ هيف ناك نإو لسغب نيتلاص ليصت مث ،ةلاصلا ىلإ ةلاصلا رخؤتلف لائاس امد ناك اذفإ ليصت مث ،رخآ افسرك عضت مث .تيبلبا فطتلو اهجوز اهتأيلف ةلاصلا هب تلحتسا ئش لكو ،دحاو
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Mustahadhah, can her husband have intercourse with her? And can she perform tawaf of the House (Ka'bah)? He said: She should sit out her menstrual cycle in which she used to menstruate. If her cycle is regular, she should adhere to it. If there is a discrepancy in it, she should take precaution for a day or two, perform Ghusl, insert cotton, and if it appears on the cotton, she should perform Ghusl and place another cotton. Then she should pray. If it is flowing blood, she should delay the prayer until the next prayer, then pray two prayers with one Ghusl. With whatever she becomes permissible for prayer, her husband can approach her and she can perform tawaf of the House.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: وأ مويب رهظتست :لقا ؟عنصت فيك اهمياأ دعب دعقت ثماطلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع دفن اذفإ ،مدلا دفني مل ام ءوضوب ةلاص لك ليصتو ،اهسفن نم قثوتستو لستغتلف ةضاحتسم يه مث ،نيموي .تلصو تلستغا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a menstruating woman who continues beyond her usual days, what should she do? He said: She should wait for one or two additional days for precaution, then she is considered in a state of istihadha (irregular bleeding). She should perform ghusl (ritual bath), take precautions for herself, and pray every prayer with a fresh wudu (ablution) as long as the bleeding does not stop. When it stops, she should perform ghusl and pray.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ارهط تأر يه نفإ ،نيموي وأ مويب طاتحت مث اهئرق مياأ دعقت ةضاحتسملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع فسركلا لىع مدلا رهظي ىتح لسغلا كلذب ليصت لازت لاو تشتحاو تلستغا ارهط رت مل يه نإو ،تلستغا .فسركلا تداعأو لسغلا تداعأ رهظ اذفإ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A woman experiencing irregular menstrual bleeding should wait for her usual menstruation days, then take precaution for one or two additional days. If she sees signs of purity, she should perform ghusl (ritual bath). If she does not see signs of purity, she should perform ghusl and use cotton padding, and she continues to pray with that ghusl until blood appears on the cotton. When blood appears, she should repeat the ghusl and replace the cotton padding. Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: :لقا ؟ليصت نأ اهل يغبني ىتم اهتقو زواج ىتح اهضيح يف مدلا تأر ةأرما (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .ةلاص لك تقو يف لستغتلف ابيبص امد مدلا تأر نفإ مياأ ةرشعب رهظتست مث ،سلجت تناك يتلا اهتدع رظنت .رم امك مياأ ةرشع ىلإ رهظتست اهنأ لىع خيشلا هلمح لوقأ
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): "When should a woman pray if she sees blood during her menstruation period that extends beyond her usual time?" He said: "She should consider her usual period duration, then take precaution for ten more days. If she sees flowing blood, she should perform ghusl (ritual bath) at the time of each prayer." I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this to mean that she should take precaution up to ten days, as previously mentioned.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: لستغت مث نينثا وأ مويب طاتحتو اهئارقأ مياأ ةلاصلا نع فكت ةضاحتسملا :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع نيب عمجتو ،لسغب رصعلاو رهظلا نيب عمجتو لستغتو ،ةادغلا ةلاصل يشتحتو تارم ثلاث ةليلو موي لك .اهاشغي نأ اهجوزل لح ةلاصلا اهل تلح اذفإ ،لسغب ءاشعلاو برغملا
englishText: From one of them (peace be upon them both) who said: A woman experiencing irregular menstrual bleeding should refrain from prayer during her usual menstrual days and take precaution by adding one or two days, then she should perform ghusl (ritual bath) three times every day and night, and insert cotton for the morning prayer, and perform ghusl and combine the noon and afternoon prayers with one ghusl, and combine the sunset and night prayers with one ghusl. When prayer becomes permissible for her, it becomes permissible for her husband to have intercourse with her.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: نفإ رظنتو اهفسرك تشتحاو تلستغا اهئارقأ مياأ تضم اذإ ةضاحتسملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .تلصو تأضوتو اهفسرك تداز فسركلا لىع رهظ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A woman experiencing irregular bleeding (Istihadha), when her usual menstrual days have passed, should perform ghusl (ritual bath), insert cotton, and observe. If blood appears on the cotton, she should add more cotton, perform wudu (ablution), and pray.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ةلاصلا نع دعقتلف اهيف مدلا ىرت تناك يتلا اهمياأ دعب امد تأر اذإ ضئاحلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع اهنم بيصيو لسغب نيتلاص لك نيب عمجتلف عطقني لا مد ةنطقلا غبص نفإ ةنطق كسمت مث ،نيموي وأ اموي .ةلاصلا اهل تلحو بحأ نإ اهجوز
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding a menstruating woman: If she sees blood after her usual days of menstruation, she should refrain from prayer for a day or two, then insert a cotton. If the cotton is stained with blood that does not stop, she should combine every two prayers with one ghusl (ritual bath), and her husband may have intimate relations with her if he wishes, and prayer becomes permissible for her.

chapter: Types Of Istihadha And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: :لقا ؟عنصت فيك ةضاحتسملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس ،رصعلاو رهظلا ليصت مث ،لستغت مث ،اهتقو رخآ ىلإ رهظلا رخؤتلف هيف رهطت تناك يذلا اهرهط تقو ىضم اذإ رجفلا ةلاص ناك اذفإ ،ءاشعلاو برغملا ليصت مث ،لستغت مث اهتقو رخآ ىلإ اهرخؤتلف برغملا ناك نفإ ،ةادغلا ليصت مث ،ةادغلا لبق نيتعكر ليصت مث رجفلا عولط دعب لسغتلف .دارأ نإ اهعقاوي مث أضوتتلو لسغتلف كلذ اهب لاط اذإ :لقا ؟لجرلا اهعقاوي تلق
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about what a woman with irregular bleeding (Mustahadha) should do? He replied: Whenher normal period of purity has passed, she should delay the Dhuhr prayer until its last time, then perform ghusl (ritual bath), then pray Dhuhr and Asr. And if it's Maghrib time, she should delay it until its last time, then perform ghusl, then pray Maghrib and Isha. When it's time for Fajr prayer, she should perform ghusl after dawn breaks, then pray two rak'ahs before the morning prayer, then pray the morning prayer. I asked: Can her husband have intercourse with her? He replied: If this condition persists with her, she should perform ghusl and make wudu, then he can have intercourse with her if he wishes.

chapter: Non-prohibition Of Prayer, Fasting, Tawaf, Entering Mosques And Staying In Them For Women With Irregular Bleeding (Istihadha)
arabicText: ضيحت تناك يتلا ميالأا لاإ ناضمر رهش موصت لاقف :لقا ،ةضاحتسملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .دعب نم اهيضقت مث ،اهيف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the woman with irregular bleeding (mustahadha), so he said: She fasts during Ramadan except for the days in which she used to menstruate, then she makes up for them afterward.

chapter: Non-prohibition Of Prayer, Fasting, Tawaf, Entering Mosques And Staying In Them For Women With Irregular Bleeding (Istihadha)
arabicText: ،ليصتو يشتحتو لستغت ةضاحتسملاو :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع (رابخلأا نويع) يفو .ةلاصلا كرتت ضئاحلاو
englishText: And in (Uyun al-Akhbar) from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: And the woman with irregular bleeding performs ghusl, uses padding, and prays, while the menstruating woman leaves prayer.

chapter: Ruling On Having Intimate Relations With A Woman Experiencing Irregular Bleeding (Istihadha) Before Ghusl
arabicText: ضيحت تناك يتلا ميالأا رظني :لقا ؟اهجوز اهاشغي فيك ةضاحتسملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس لاو ميالأا نم كلذ ىوس اميف اهاشغيو رهشلا كلذ نم ميالأا كلت ةدع يف اهبرقي لاف ةميقتسم اهتضيحو اهيف .دارأ نإ اهاشغي مث لستغتف اهرميأ ىتح اهاشغي انئاهقف نم نيققحملا ضعب مكح دقو ،هيلع لدي ام يتيأو هريغو ضيحلا يف كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .همدع لىع اهضعبو لسغلا رابتعا لىع اهضعب لادلا ثيداحلأا نيب عمجلل لسغلا لبق ةهاركلبا
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about how a husband can be intimate with his wife who is experiencing irregular bleeding (istihadha)? He said: He should consider the days during which she used to menstruate when her menstruation was regular, and he should not approach her during those same days of that month, but he can be intimate with her during the other days. However, he should not be intimate with her until he instructs her to perform ghusl, then he may be intimate with her if he wishes. I (Hurr Amili) say: What indicates this has been mentioned previously in the chapter on menstruation and elsewhere, and what indicates it will also come later. Some of our scholarly jurists have ruled that it is disliked (makruh) to have relations before ghusl, as a way to reconcile between the various hadiths, some of which indicate the requirement of ghusl and others which do not. Section 6 Nifas (Postpartum Bleeding)

chapter: Obligation Of Postpartum Purification Ghusl For Prayer And Similar Acts After Bleeding Stops
arabicText: رهظتست مث ،ضيحت تناك يتلا اهضيح مياأ ءاسفنلا سلجت :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .ليصتو لستغتو
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: A woman in postpartum state should wait for the days of her regular menstruation period, then she should wait for extra precaution, then perform ghusl (ritual bath) and pray.

chapter: Obligation Of Postpartum Purification Ghusl For Prayer And Similar Acts After Bleeding Stops
arabicText: .بجاو ءاسفنلا لسغو :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ةعامس ثيدح ةبانجلا يف قبس دقو
englishText: In the section about janabah, according to Sama'ah who narrated from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: And the ghusl for the postpartum woman is obligatory.

chapter: Obligation Of Postpartum Purification Ghusl For Prayer And Similar Acts After Bleeding Stops
arabicText: .رفسلا يف لسغ ءاسفنلا لىع سيل :لوقي هتعمس لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هريغو خيشلا هلقا ،ةرهاظ هيلع ةنيرقلاو مميتلا بجيف لسغلا رذعت لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ
englishText: Narrated from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I heard him saying: A woman in postpartum bleeding is not required to perform ghusl (ritual bath) during travel. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted to mean when ghusl is not possible, then tayammum (dry ablution) becomes obligatory, and the evidence for this is apparent, as stated by the Shaykh and others.

chapter: There Being No Minimum Duration For Postpartum Bleeding
arabicText: فيكو ؟ةلاصلا اهيلع بجي ىتح اهسافن دح مك ءاسفنلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .دح اهل سيل :لقا ؟عنصت دارملا نأ برقلأاو ،اهتداع ىلإ عجرت لب ،صقني لاو ديزي لا يعرش دح اهل سيل هنأ لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .ضيحلا يف درو امك هلقلأ ديدحت دري ملو هرثكأ ديدحت تنمضت ثيداحلأا نفإ ةلقلا يف دح اهل سيل
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about the woman experiencing postpartum bleeding, what is the minimum duration of her bleeding before prayer becomes obligatory upon her? And what should she do? He said: There is no minimum duration for it. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this to mean that there is no legally prescribed duration that neither increases nor decreases, rather she should refer to her usual pattern. The closest interpretation is that there is no minimum duration, for the hadiths have specified its maximum duration but have not specified its minimum, as was specified for menstruation.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: مث اهيف ثكمت تناك يتلا اهمياأ ةلاصلا نع فكت ءاسفنلا :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ةرارز نع .ةضاحتسملا لمعت امك لمعتو لستغت
englishText: From Zurarah, from one of them (peace be upon them) who said: A postpartum woman refrains from prayer for the days she used to wait, then she performs ghusl and does as a woman with irregular bleeding does.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: ،نيمويب رهظتستو اهضيح ردق دعقت :لقا ؟ليصت ىتم ءاسفنلا :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .تلصو ترفثتساو تشتحاو تلستغا لاإو مدلا عطقنا نفإ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), I said to him: When does a postpartum woman pray? He said: She waits the duration of her menstruation and waits two extra days, if the bleeding stops [that's good], otherwise she performs ghusl, uses cotton padding, ties it securely, and prays.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: يتلا اهئرق مياأ دعقتلف لقا ،؟ىرت تناك امم رثكأ مدلا تأرف تدلو ةأرما نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس ةرفص تأر نفإ ،ةلاص لك تقو دنع لستغتلف ابيبص امد تأر نفإ ،مياأ ةرشعب رهظتست مث سلجت تناك .مياأ ةرشع ىلإ رهظتست ينعي :خيشلا لقا لصتل مث أضوتتلف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who gave birth and saw more blood than she used to see? He said: She should wait the days of her regular period that she used to wait, then wait up to ten extra days. If she sees flowing blood, she should perform ghusl at the time of each prayer. If she sees yellowish discharge, she should perform wudu then pray. The Shaykh said: meaning she waits extra up to ten days.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: اهل ىضم اذإ معن :لقا ؟مدلا نم اهسافن يف يهو اهجوز اهاشغي ءاسفنلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس لستغتلف اهرميأ ،اهجوز اهاشغي نأ دعب سبأ لاف مويب رهظتست مث ،اهضيح ةدع مياأ ردقب تعضو موي ذنم .بحأ نإ اهاشغي مث
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a postpartum woman whose husband approaches her while she is in her postpartum bleeding? He said: Yes, when the number of days equal to her menstrual period have passed since she gave birth, then she waits one extra day, there is no harm if her husband approaches her after that. He orders her to perform ghusl then he may approach her if he wishes.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: .نيمويب رهظتستو ضيحلا يف دعقت تناك يتلا اهمياأ ءاسفنلا دعقت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A postpartum woman waits the days she used to wait during menstruation and waits two extra days.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر هرمفأ ركب يبأ نب دمحمب تسفن سيمع تنب ءامسأ نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ةكم اومدق املف ،جحلبا لهتو قرخلاو فسركلبا يشتحت نأ ةفيلحلا يذ نم مارحلاا تدارأ نيح (هلآو هيلع تيبلبا فوطت نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر اهرمفأ اموي رشع ةينامث اهل ىتأ دقو كسانملا اوكسن دقو .كلذ تلعفف مدلا اهنع عطقني ملو ،ليصتو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that Asma bint Umays had postpartum bleeding after giving birth to Muhammad bin Abi Bakr, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered her when she wanted to enter ihram from Dhul Hulaifa to use cotton padding and cloths and to declare intention for Hajj. When they arrived in Makkah and had performed the rituals, eighteen days had passed for her, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered her to perform tawaf around the House and pray, while her bleeding had not stopped, and she did that.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: نيرشع يسافن يف دعقأ تنك ينإ :تلاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ ةأرما تلأس :لقا هعفر هيبأ نع ،هنعو لاقف ؟اموي رشع ةينامثب كوتفأ ملو (ملاسلا هيلع) :الله دبع وبأ لاقف ،اموي رشع ةينامثب ينوتفأ ىتح اموي تسفن ثيح سيمع تنب ءامسلأ لقا هنأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع يور يذلا ثيدحلل :!؟لجر ،ركب يبأ نب دمحمب رشع ةينامث اهل ىتأ دقو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تلأس ءامسأ نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لاقف .ةضاحتسملا لعفت ام لعفتو لستغت نأ اهرملأ كلذ لبق هتلأس ولو ،اموي
englishText: And from him, from his father, raising it, he said: A woman asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: I used to wait twenty days in my postpartum period until they gave me a fatwa of eighteen days. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: And That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A... why did they give you a fatwa of eighteen days? A man said: Because of the hadith narrated from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that he said to Asma bint Umais when she had postpartum bleeding after giving birth to Muhammad bin Abi Bakr. Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Asma asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) when eighteen days had passed for her, and if she had asked him before that, he would have ordered her to perform ghusl and do as a woman with irregular bleeding does.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: تناك يتلا اهضيح مياأ سلجت ءاسفنلا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا بوقعي نب سنوي نع .ليصتو لستغتو رهظتست مث ،ضيحت
englishText: From Yunus bin Ya'qub who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Apostpartum woman sits for the days of her menstruation that she used to have, then she takes precaution, performs ghusl and prays.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: تلستغفا اهرمأ مث ،اهضيح مياأ اهلدعف تدلو كلملا دبع ةأرما نإ :هل تلق :لقا نيعأ نب نامحرلا دبع نع دجسملا لخدأ نأ يسفن بيطت لا :هل تلاقف ةلاصلبا اهرمأو ،نيفيظن نيبوث سبلت نأ اهرمأو ،تشتحاو ،هيف دجسأو هنم اجراخ موقأ ينعدف هيلع) ليع رمأو ،رهطلا تأرو ةأرملا نع مدلا عطقنفا :لقا ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر اذب رمأ دق :لاقف .يردأ ام تلق ؟مكتبحاص تلعف امف ،رهطلا تأرو ةأرملا نع مدلا عطقنفا ،مكلبق اذهب (ملاسلا
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin A'yan who said: I said to him: Abdul Malik's wife gave birth, so he counted her menstruation days, then ordered her to perform ghusl and use cotton padding, and ordered her to wear two clean garments, and ordered her to pray. She said to him: I don't feel comfortable entering the mosque, so let me stand outside it and prostrate in it. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered this. He said: The bleeding stopped from the woman and she saw purity, and Ali (peace be upon him) ordered this before you, and the bleeding stopped from the woman and she saw purity, so what did your companion do? I said: I don't know. Translator: The main dialogue in this hadith is between Abdul Rahman bin A'yan and an unnamed person, possibly a scholar or a companion of the Prophet. Abdul Rahman bin A'yan is narrating an incident about Abdul Malik's wife and her post-partum bleeding. The unnamed person mentions that the Prophet Muhammad and Imam Ali had given similar orders regarding women's prayer after childbirth. Finally, the unnamed person asks Abdul Rahman bin A'yan about what his companion did in a similar situation, to which he replies, "I do not know."

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: ةدم سافنلا ةدم ءاضقنا نبأ ةدمتعم رابخأ تءاج :لقا (ةعنقملا) يف ديفملا نامعنلا نب دمحم نب دمحم .مياأ ةرشع يهو ضيحلا
englishText: Muhammad bin Muhammad bin Al-Nu'man Al-Mufid said in (Al-Muqni'ah): Reliable reports have come that the end of postpartum period is the menstruation period, which is ten days.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: لقو ملاسلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ أرقا :ادولو تناكو ملسم نب دمحم ةأرما تلقا :لقا نيعأ نب نارمح نع ،اموي رشع ةينامث اهولعجف لىع اوقيض انباحصأ نإو ،اموي نيعبرأ يسافن يف دعقأ تنك ينإ :هل تنب ءامسأ يف اهوور يتلا ةياورلا :تلق :لقا ؟اموي رشع ةينامثب اهاتفأ نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لاقف ؟عنصأ فيك الله لوسر يا :تلاقف ةفيلحلا يذب ركب يبأ نب دمحمب تسفن اهنأ سيمع ىضقت ىتح عست ملو فطت ملو ةكم تلخدو تشتحاو تلستغفا ،جحلبا ليهأو يشتحاو ليستغا اهل :لاقف ملو فطأ ملو تمرحأ الله لوسر يا :تلاقف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تتفأ ةكم ىلإ تعجرف جحلا لاقف ،اموي رشع ةينامث تلاقف ؟مويلا كل مكو :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر اهل لاقف ،عسأ ،تلحأو تعسو تفاطو تلستغفا ،يعساو يفوطو يشتحاو ليستغفا ةعاسلا جيرخفأ (نلآا) لااما امب اهرملأ هتربخأو كلذ لبق (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تلأس ول اهنأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لاقف ؟ءاسفنلا دح امف :تلق ،هب اهرمأ مث مياأ ةثلاث وأ نيمويب ترهظتسا لاإو ترهط يه نفإ ،اهئرق مياأ نهيف ثمطت تناك يتلا اهمياأ دعقت لقا لستغت ةضاحتسملا ةلزنمب يهف مدلا عطقني مل نإو ،ترهط دقف مدلا عطقنا ناك نفإ ،تشتحاو تلستغا .ليصتو نيتلاص لكل
englishText: From Hamran bin A'yan who said: Muhammad bin Muslim's wife, who was fertile, said: Convey my greetings to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and tell him: I used to sit in my postpartum period for forty days, and our companions have restricted me and made it eighteen days. Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Who gave her the fatwa of eighteen days? I said: The narration they narrated about Asma bint Umais that she gave birth to Muhammad bin Abu Bakr at Dhul-Hulaifa and said: O Messenger of Allah, what should I do? He said to her: Perform ghusl, use cotton padding, and declare intention for Hajj. So she performed ghusl, used padding, and entered Makkah but did not perform tawaf or Sa'i until Hajj was completed. She returned to Makkah and came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: O Messenger of Allah, I entered ihram but did not perform tawaf or Sa'i. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to her: How many days has it been for you? She said: Eighteen days. He said: Now go out immediately, perform ghusl, use padding, perform tawaf and Sa'i. So she performed ghusl, tawaf, Sa'i and completed her ihram. That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A... Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: If she had asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) before that and informed him, he would have ordered her with what he ordered her. I said: So what is the limit for postpartum women? He said: She sits for her days that she used to menstruate during her periods, then if she becomes pure (fine), otherwise she takes precaution for two or three days then performs ghusl and uses padding. If the bleeding stops then she is pure, and if it doesn't stop then she is like a woman with irregular bleeding- she performs ghusl for every two prayers and prays.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: نامث :لقا ؟ليصت ىتح ءاسفنلا دعقت مك :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .ةيقتلا لىع لومحم هدعب امو اذه :لوقأ .ليصتو يشتحتو لستغت مث ،ةرشع عبس ،ةرشع
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): How long does a postpartum woman sit until she prays? He said: Eighteen, seventeen, then she performs ghusl, uses padding and prays. I (Hurr Amili) say: This and what follows is interpreted as taqiyyah.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: ىلإ اموي نيعبرأ وأ نيثلاث مدلا اهنع عطقني مل اذإ ءاسفنلا دعقت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نيسمخلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A postpartum woman sits when the bleeding doesn't stop for thirty or forty days up to fifty.
