chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: امد تأر نفإ ةليل ةرشع عبس ءاسفنلا دعقت :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا نانس نبا نع .ةضاحتسملا عنصت امك تعنص
englishText: From Ibn Sinan who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: A postpartum woman sits for seventeen nights, and if she sees blood she does what a woman with irregular bleeding does.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: لىص) الله لوسر اهرمأ سيمع تنب ءامسأ نإ :لاقف ؟دعقت مك ءاسفنلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس نسحلا نب ليع نع هدانسإبو .نيموي وأ مويب رهظتست نبأ سبأ لاو ةرشع نامثل لستغت نأ (هلآو هيلع الله .هوحن لاعلا نع طابسأ نب ليع نع
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about how long a postpartum woman sits? He said: Asma bint Umais was ordered by the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) to perform ghusl after eighteen days and there's no harm in taking precaution for a day or two. And with his chain from Ali bin Al-Hasan from Ali bin Asbat from Al-Ala similar to it.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: ام ةلاصلا عدت :لقا ؟ةلاصلا كرت اهيلع بجي مكو ءاسفنلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) يضاملا نسحلا باأ تلأس .الله ءاش نإ تلصو تلستغا ةرفص تناكو قر اذفإ اموي نيثلاث ىلإ طيبعلا مدلا ىرت تماد
englishText: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madhi (peace be upon him) about postpartum bleeding and how long should she abstain from prayer? He said: She should leave prayer as long as she sees fresh blood up to thirty days, and when it becomes thin and yellow, she should perform ghusl and pray, insha'Allah.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: تناكو اهجوز اهيتيأو ،تلصو تلستغا لاإو ترهط نفإ اموي نيعبرأ دعقت ءاسفنلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع .ليصتو موصت ةضاحتسملا ةلزنمب
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: A woman with postpartum bleeding should wait for forty days, if she becomes pure before that, otherwise she should perform ghusl and pray, and her husband may approach her, and she would be like a woman with irregular bleeding who fasts and prays.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: ،تبرج امو اهدلاوأ نم ىضم ام عم نوكت تناك امك :لاقف ؟ءاسفنلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس سافنلا رثكأ نأ هدارم نوكي نأ لمتحي :لوقأ .نيسمخلا ىلإ نيعبرلأا نيب :لقا ،ىضم اميف دلت ملف :تلق .ةيقتلا لجلأ ةرابعلا قلاطإ نوكيو نيسمخلا ىلإ نيعبرلأا نيب ام اهنلأ مياأ ةرشع
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about postpartum bleeding? He said: It is like what she experienced with her previous children and what she has experienced. I said: What if she hasn't given birth before? He said: Between forty to fifty days. I (Hurr Amili) say: It's possible that he meant the maximum postpartum period is ten days because it's between forty to fifty, and the broad expression was for the sake of taqiyyah. englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that Asma bint Umays had postpartum bleeding after giving birth to Muhammad bin Abi Bakr, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered her when she wanted to enter ihram from Dhul Hulaifa to perform ghusl, use cotton padding, and declare intention for Hajj. When they arrived and performed the rituals, she asked the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) about circumambulating the House and prayer? He asked her: How long has it been since you gave birth? She said: Eighteen days. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered her to perform ghusl, perform tawaf of the House and pray, even though her bleeding hadn't stopped, and she did that.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: كلذ لبق سلجت تناك يلإ اهمياأ لثم تثكم ةريثك ميابأ تيلتبا اذإ ءاسفنلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع أ نع ،ةضاحتسملا عنصت امك عنصتو يشتحتو لستغت مث ،اهمياأ يثلث لثمب ترهظتساو مث ،كلذ يثلثب ترهظتساو اهتلاخ وأ اهتخأ وأ اهمأ مياأ لثمب تسلج تيلتبفا اهسافن مياأ فرعت لا تناك نإو .لستغتو يشتحت ةضاحتسملا عنصت امك تعنص .مدقت امل ةرشعلا لىع راهظتسلااو ةداعلا مياأ ديزت لائل لقأ وأ مياأ ةتس اهتداع نوك لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If a woman with postpartum bleeding experiences many days, she should wait for the same number of days she used to wait before, and add two-thirds of her days as precaution, then perform ghusl, use padding, and do as a woman with irregular bleeding does. If she doesn't know her postpartum period days and is afflicted, she should wait the same as her mother's or sister's or aunt's days and add two-thirds of that as precaution, then do as a woman with irregular bleeding does by using padding and performing ghusl. I (Hurr Amili) say: This applies when her normal period is six days or less so that the normal days and precautionary days don't exceed ten days as previously mentioned.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: اهرمفأ عادولا ةجح يف ركب يبأ نب دمحمب تسفن سيمع تنب ءامسأ نإ :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم اموي نيعبرأ اهدوعق يف تيور يتلا رابخلااو :لقا .اموي رشع ةينامث دعقت نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .فلاخلا لهأ لاإ اهب يتفي لا ةيقتلل تدرو اهلك ةمولعم رهطت نأ ىلإ داز امو
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Asma bint Umays had postpartum bleeding with Muhammad bin Abi Bakr during the Farewell Pilgrimage, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered her to wait for eighteen days. He said: And the narrations about waiting forty days or more until purification are all known to be for taqiyyah, only those (*) who differ follow them. Translator: * The Aamm'ah (general non-Shia muslims) - ahl al sunnah.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: اهرثكأو ،مياأ ةثلاث ضيحلا مياأ لقأ نلا اموي رشع ةينامث ةلاصلا نع ءاسفنلا دوعق دح راص هنأ يور دقو :لقا .هرثكأو هطسوأو ضيحلا لقأ ءاسفنلل لجو زع الله لعجف ،مياأ ةسمخ اهطسوأو ،مياأ ةرشع
englishText: He said: It has been narrated that the limit of postpartum bleeding abstention from prayer became eighteen days because the minimum menstruation days are three, the maximum is ten days, and the middle is five days, so Allah the Mighty and Majestic gave the postpartum woman the minimum, middle, and maximum of menstruation.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: .هوحن ركذو اموي رشع ةينامث ءاسفنلا تيطعأ ةلع يلأ تلق :لقا ريدس نب نانح نع
englishText: From Hanan bin Sudayr who said: I asked about the reason why postpartum women were given eighteen days, and he mentioned similar to the above.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: اموي رشع ةينامث نم رثكأ ةلاصلا نع دعقت لا ءاسفنلاو :لقا نومأملا ىلإ هباتك يف (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع لمعت امب تلمعو تلصو تلستغا اموي رشع ةينامث زواجت ىتح رهطت مل نإو ،تلص كلذ لبق ترهط نفإ .رشع ةينامثلا مكحب هيف حيرصت لا اذه :لوقأ .ةضاحتسملا
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) in his letter to Al-Ma'mun, he said: A postpartum woman should not abstain from prayer for more than eighteen days. If she becomes pure before that, she should pray, and if she does not become pure until after eighteen days, she should perform ghusl, pray, and do what a woman with irregular bleeding does. I (Hurr Amili) say: This does not explicitly state the ruling of eighteen days. That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A...

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: لاإ اموي نيرشع نم رثكأ دعقت لا ءاسفنلاو :لقا (نيدلا عئارش) ثيدح يف (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع .ةضاحتسملا لمع تلمعو تشتحاو تلستغا نيرشعلا لبق رهطت مل نفإ كلذ لبق رهطت نأ
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) in the hadith of (Religious Laws) he said: A postpartum woman should not abstain for more than twenty days unless she becomes pure before that. If she does not become pure before twenty days, she should perform ghusl, use cotton padding, and do what a woman with irregular bleeding does.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: .اموي رشع ةينامث دعقت اهنأ يور :لقا (عنقملا) يفو
englishText: In (Al-Muqni') it is said: It is narrated that she should abstain for eighteen days.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: رثكأ مكئاسن نإ ،لولأا ءاسنلاك نسل مكئاسن نإ :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا الله دبع يبأ نع يورو :لقا .رهطت ىتح دعقتلف ،امد رثكأو امحل
englishText: He said: It is narrated from Abu Abdullah Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he said: Your women are not like the women of the past; your women have more flesh and more blood, so let them abstain until they become pure.

chapter: That The Maximum Postpartum Bleeding Period Is Ten Days, And That A Postpartum Woman Must Return To Her Regular Habit In Menstruation Or Postpartum, Otherwise To The Habit Of Her Female Relatives, And It Is Recommended For Her To Wait Extra Days Like A Menstruating Woman, Then Do As A Woman With Irregular Bleeding Does
arabicText: .اموي نيسمخ ىلإ اموي نيعبرأ نيب ام دعقت اهنأ يور دقو :لقا يف ةداعلا ىلإ عوجرلا لىع لد ام رابخلأا هذه نم دمتعملا :ىقتنملا بحاص لقاو ،ههجو مدقت دق :لوقأ يتلا هوجولا برقأ وهو ،ةيقتلا لىع لمحلل ةيحلاصلا يف رابخلأا رئاس كارتشاو ليوأتلا نع هدعبل ضيحلا ،خيشلا اهركذ رختأ لىع ةلومحم اهنأ ءامسأ ةيضق يف ركذو ،مهبهاذم يف ةماعلا فلاتخاك ظافللأا تفلتخا كلذلو :لقا ،ةيقتلل هريرقتو هلقن نوكيو ،همدقتل اخوسنم مكحلا نوك لىع وأ اهلاؤس .ىهتنا ةرشعلا نع ديزي لا ةداعلا ىصقأو سافنلبا ضيحلا طابترا لىع لدي ةداعلا ىلإ عوجرلبا مكحلاو :لقا .ءاوس ءاسفنلا لثم ضئاحلا نأ لىع لدي ام مدقتو
englishText: He said: It has been narrated that she should abstain between forty to fifty days. I (Hurr Amili) say: The reasoning for this has been mentioned before, and the author of Al-Muntaqa said: The reliable narration among these reports is what indicates returning to the usual menstrual habit, as it is far from interpretation and all other reports share the possibility of being based on taqiyyah (dissimulation), and this is the closest of the perspectives mentioned by the Shaykh, He said: That is why the wordings varied like the variation in the general public's schools of thought, and he mentioned regarding Asma's case that it is interpreted as either her delayed inquiry or that the ruling was abrogated due to its earliness, and its transmission and confirmation was for taqiyyah, He said: The ruling of returning to habit indicates the connection between menstruation and postpartum bleeding, and the maximum habit does not exceed ten days. End quote. And what has preceded indicates that a menstruating woman is exactly like a postpartum woman.

chapter: That The Blood Seen Before Childbirth Is Not Postpartum Bleeding, Rather Prayer Is Obligatory With It And Making Up Missed Prayers Is Required Even If Unable To Pray Due To Pain
arabicText: ليصت :لقا ،امد وأ ةرفصلا ىرتف نيموي وأ اموي وأ امياأ قلطلا اهبيصي ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رهطت ام دعب ةلاصلا كلت ءاضق اهيلعف عجولا نم اهيلصت نأ ردقت مل ةلاص اهتتافف عجولا اهبلغ نفإ دلت مل ام .هلثم ىيحي نب دمحأ نبا دمحم نع هدانسإب نسحلا نب دمحم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who experiences labor pains for days, a day, or two days and sees yellow discharge or blood. He said: She should pray as long as she hasn't given birth. If pain overcomes her and she misses a prayer that she couldn't perform due to the pain, she must make up that prayer after she becomes pure.

chapter: That The Blood Seen Before Childbirth Is Not Postpartum Bleeding, Rather Prayer Is Obligatory With It And Making Up Missed Prayers Is Required Even If Unable To Pray Due To Pain
arabicText: ينعي لبح نم اضيح لعجيل الله ناك ام :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع تكرت مدلا تأرو قلطلا اهبرض اذإ دلولا سأر لىع ىرت نأ لاإ ةلاصلا عدت لا لماح يهو مدلا ةأرملا تأر اذإ .ةلاصلا عم ،ةجحب سيلف ماملاا نم ريسفتلا نوك ملعي لا هنأ لىع ةياورلا يف ةيقتلاو خسنلا لمتحي اذه :لوقأ .دلولا سأر لىع :هلوق ةنيرقب اهدعب وأ ،ةدلاولا عم ىري ام مدلبا داري نأ لامتحا
englishText: From his father (peace be upon them both) who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah would not make menstruation from pregnancy, meaning when a woman sees blood while pregnant she should not leave prayer unless she sees it on the head of the child when labor pains strike her and she sees blood, then she leaves prayer. I (Hurr Amili) say: This could be subject to abrogation and taqiyyah in the narration, as it is not known if the interpretation is from the Imam so it is not authoritative, with the possibility that what is meant by blood is what is seen during childbirth or after it, based on the context of his saying: "on the head of the child."

chapter: That The Blood Seen Before Childbirth Is Not Postpartum Bleeding, Rather Prayer Is Obligatory With It And Making Up Missed Prayers Is Required Even If Unable To Pray Due To Pain
arabicText: ةرفص ىرت ،كلذ نم رثكأو نيمويلاو مويلا قلطلا اهباصأ ةأرما نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .تأرب اذإ تلص عجولا اهبلغ نفإ ،دلت مل ام ليصت :لقا ؟ةلاصلبا عنصت فيك امد وأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman who experiences labor pains for a day, two days or more than that, and sees yellow discharge or blood- what should she do about prayer? He said: She should pray as long as she hasn't given birth. If pain overcomes her, she should pray when she recovers.

chapter: Considering The Minimum Of Two Purification Periods At The End Of Postpartum Bleeding And The Beginning Of Menstruation
arabicText: دعب مدلا تأر مث ترهط مث اموي نيثلاث ةلاصلا تكرتف تسفن ةأرما يف (ملاسلا هيلع) لولأا نسحلا يبأ نع .سافنلا مياأ عم تزاج دق و رهطلا مياأ اهمياأ نلا ،ةلاصلا عدت :لقا ،كلذ
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan the First (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who experienced postpartum bleeding and left prayer for thirty days, then became pure, then saw blood after that. He said: She should leave prayer, because her days are days of purity and they have passed along with the days of postpartum bleeding.

chapter: Considering The Minimum Of Two Purification Periods At The End Of Postpartum Bleeding And The Beginning Of Menstruation
arabicText: امد تأر مث ،تلصو ترهط مث رثكأ وأ اموي نيثلاث تثكمف تسفن ةأرما نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ باأ تلأس .ةلاصلا نع كسمت لاو لصتلو لسغتلف ةرفص تناك نإ :لقا ،ةرفص وأ
englishText: I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about a woman who experienced postpartum bleeding and remained for thirty days or more, then became pure and prayed, then saw blood or yellowish discharge. He said: If it was yellowish discharge, she should perform ghusl and pray, and should not abstain from prayer.

chapter: Considering The Minimum Of Two Purification Periods At The End Of Postpartum Bleeding And The Beginning Of Menstruation
arabicText: ةرفصب سيل امد ناك نفإ :هرخآ يف داز مث رثكأ وأ هليل نيثلاث ثكمف :لقا هنأ لاإ ،هلثم ىيحي نب ناوفص نع .لصتلو لستغتل مث ،اهئرق مياأ ةلاصلا نع كسمتلف
englishText: From Safwan bin Yahya similar to it, except that he said: She remained for thirty nights or more, then he added at the end: If it was blood, not yellowish discharge, she should abstain from prayer during her menstrual days, then perform ghusl and pray.

chapter: Rulings Regarding Postpartum Women In Fasting, Prayer, Prohibitions, And Disliked Matters
arabicText: كلذ متتأ رصعلا ةلاص دعب ناضمر رهش يف عضت ءاسفنلا نع هتلئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع ثيداحلأا يف ةروكذملا ماكحلأا لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .مويلا كلذ ضقتل مث رطفت :لاقف ؟رطفت وأ مويلا الله ءاش نإ جحلاو موصلا يف اهضعب لىع لدي ام يتيأو ةبانجلا يفو ضيحلا يفو ةضاحتسلاا يفو انه ةقباسلا .ىلاعت
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a postpartum woman who gives birth in Ramadan after Asr prayer, should she complete that day or break her fast? He said: She should break her fast, then make up that day. Shaykh Hurr Amili: What has been mentioned previously indicates the rulings mentioned in the previous hadiths here, in the chapters on Istihadha, menstruation, and Janabah. What indicates some of them will be mentioned in the chapters on fasting and Hajj, God willing.

chapter: Rulings Regarding Postpartum Women In Fasting, Prayer, Prohibitions, And Disliked Matters
arabicText: ءاوس ءاسفنلا لثم ضئاحلا نأ ثيدح يف مدقت دقو
englishText: It has preceded in a hadith that a menstruating woman is exactly like a postpartum woman.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Woman In Postpartum Bleeding Before It Stops And Its Permissibility After It Stops Though Disliked Before Bathing
arabicText: اهل ىضم اذإ معن :لقا ؟مدلا نم اهسافن يف يهو اهجوز اهاشغي ءاسفنلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس مث لستغتف اهرميأ اهجوز اهاشغي نأ دعب سبأ لاف مويب رهظتست مث اهضيح ةدع مياأ ردقب عضو موي ذنم .بحأ نإ اهاشغي
englishText: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a woman in postpartum bleeding, can her husband have intercourse with her while she is in her bleeding? He said: Yes, when the number of days equal to her regular menstruation period have passed since she gave birth, and she waits an additional day, then there is no problem if her husband wants to have intercourse with her after he orders her to perform ghusl (ritual bath), then he may have intercourse if he wishes.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Woman In Postpartum Bleeding Before It Stops And Its Permissibility After It Stops Though Disliked Before Bathing
arabicText: الله دبع نع دانسلاباو .ءاش نإ اهجوز اهتأيلف لستغت ملو مدلا عطقنا اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلثم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،نيطقي نب ليع نع ،انباحصأ ضعب نع ،ريكب نب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When the bleeding stops and she hasn't performed ghusl, her husband may have intercourse with her if he wishes. And with the chain of narration from Abdullah bin Bukair, from some of our companions, from Ali bin Yaqtin, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) similar to it.

chapter: Prohibition Of Sexual Intercourse With A Woman In Postpartum Bleeding Before It Stops And Its Permissibility After It Stops Though Disliked Before Bathing
arabicText: لستغت نأ ريغ نم أضوتتف رهطت مث ةلاصلا اهيلع مرحت ةأرملا :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لستغت ىتح لا :لقا ؟لستغت نأ لبق اهيتيأ نأ اهجوزلف مكح لىع نلااد امهنأ ىفخي لاو ،ضيحلا يف كلذ ركذ زاوجلا لىع لولأاو ،ةهاركلا لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ .ةيقتلا لىع عنملا لمح نكميو ،مدقت ام ةنوعمب ولو اضيأ سافنلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I said to him: For a woman who is prohibited from prayer then becomes pure and performs ablution without performing ghusl, can her husband have intercourse with her before she performs ghusl? He said: No, not until she performs ghusl. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted this as disliked, and the first as permissible as mentioned in menstruation, and it's clear that both indicate the ruling for postpartum bleeding as well, even with the help of what preceded, and the prohibition can possibly be interpreted as taqiyyah. Section 7 Throes of Death And What is Related To It

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: مسبتف ءامسلا ىلإ هسأر عفر (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ :لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع يف انمؤم احلاص ادبع ناسمتلي ضرلأا ىلإ ءامسلا نم اطبه نيكلمل تبجع معن :لقا ،؟كلذ نع لئسف .هلاصم يف هادجي ملف هتليلو هموي يف هلمع هل ابتكيل هيف ليصي ناك لىصم ملف هتليلو همويل هلمع هل بتكنل هلاصم يف هانسمتلا نمؤملا نلاف كدبع !انبر :لااقف ءامسلا ىلإ اجرعف ،كلابح يف هنادجوف هبصن نفإ ،يلابح يف ماد ام هتليلو هموي يف ريخلا نم هتحص يف لمعي ناك ام لثم يدبعل ابتكا لجو زع الله لاقف .هنع هتسبح ذإ ،لمعي ناك ام رجأ هل بتكأ نأ لىع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) raised his head to the sky and smiled, so he was asked about that? He said: Yes, I was amazed by two angels who descended from heaven to earth seeking a righteous believing servant in his prayer place where he used to pray, to record his deeds for his day and night, but they did not find him in his prayer place. They ascended to heaven and said: Our Lord! Your believing servant so-and-so, we sought him in his prayer place to record his deeds for his day and night but we did not f ind him as he was in Your bonds/restraints. So Allah the Mighty and Majestic said: Write for My servant the same as what he used to do in good deeds when he was healthy in his day and night as long as he is in My bonds/restraints, for it is upon Me to record for him the reward of what he used to do when I have restricted him from it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: لكوملا كلملل لجو زع الله لوقي :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .يلابح يف هتريص يذلا ناأ ينفإ ،هتحص يف هل بتكت تنك ام هل بتكا :ضرم اذإ نمؤملبا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah the Mighty and Majestic says to the angel appointed over the believer when he falls ill: Write for him what you used to write for him when he was healthy, for I am the One who has put him in My bonds/restraints.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: .هنس ةدابع نم لضفأ ضرم نم ةليل رهس :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: One night of sleeplessness due to illness is better than worship for a year.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: ظح يهو ،ضرلأا يف الله نجس يهو ،توملا دئار ىمحلا :لوقي هتعمس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رانلا نم نمؤملا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), I heard him say: Fever is the pioneer of death, and it is Allah's prison on earth, and it is the believer's portion of the Fire.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: الله نجسو ،توملا دئار ىمحلا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رانلا نم نمؤم لك ظح يهو ،منهج نم اهروفو ،ضرلأا يف ىلاعت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Fever is the pioneer of death, and Allah's prison on earth, and its heat is from Hell, and it is every believer's portion of the Fire.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: .ةنس ةدابع نم ارجأ مظعأو لضفأ عجو وأ ضرم نم ةليل رهس :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah, from one of them (peace be upon them) who said: One night of sleeplessness due to illness or pain is better and greater in reward than worship for a year.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: لىع بتكت لا لامشلا بحاص ىلإ ىلاعت الله حىوأ نمؤملا ضرم اذإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ باأ تعمس هتحص يف هل بتكت تنك ام يدبعل بتكا نأ نيميلا بحاص ىلإ حيويو ،ابنذ يقثاوو يسبح يف ماد ام يدبع ،ليع نب نسحلا نع ،فلخ نب دمحم نع (ةمئلأا بط) يف هوخأو ماطسب نب نيسحلا هاورو .تانسحلا نم .هوحن (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،رمع نب لضفم نع ،هيخأ نع ،نانس نب الله دبع نع
englishText: I heard Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) saying: When the believer falls ill, Allah the Exalted reveals to the angel of the left: Do not write any sin against My servant as long as he is in My confinement and My bonds, and He reveals to the angel of the right: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient ... Write for My servant what you used to write for him of good deeds when he was healthy.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: هب الله لكو نمؤملا ضرم اذإ (ثيدح يف) لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هضبقيو الله هعفري ىتح هتحص يف ريخلا نم هل لمعي ناك ام همقس يف هل بتكي اكلم
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said (in a hadith) that when a believer becomes ill, Allah assigns an angel to record for him during his illness the good deeds he used to do when healthy, until Allah raises him up or takes his soul.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: .اهدعب املو اهلبق امل ةرافك ةليل ىمح :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: One night of fever is an expiation for what came before it and what comes after it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: ىمحو ،نيتنس ةدابع لدعت نيتليل ىمحو ،ةنس ةدابع لدعت ةليل ىمح :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع :تلق :لقا ،هملاو هيبلأف :لقا ؟ةنس نيعبس غلبي مل نفإ :تلق :لقا ،ةنس نيعبس ةدابع لدعت لايل ثلاث .هناريجف :لقا ؟هتبارق غلبي مل نفإ :تلق :لقا ،هتبارقلف :لقا ؟اغلبي مل نفإ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: One night of fever equals the worship of a year, two nights of fever equals the worship of two years, and three nights of fever equals the worship of seventy years. I asked: What if one doesn't reach seventy years? He said: Then it goes to his father and mother. I asked: What if they don't reach it? He said: Then to his relatives. I asked: What if his relatives don't reach it? He said: Then to his neighbors.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا ةيصو يف (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع ىلإ بنج نم هبلقتو ،ةدابع شارفلا لىع همونو ،ليلهت هحايصو ،حيبست نمؤملا نينأ ليع يا :لقا (ملاسلا .بنذ نم هيلع امو سانلا يف ىشم يفوع نفإ ،الله ليبس يف داهج بنج
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) in the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) advice to Ali (peace be upon him), he said: O Ali, the moaning of a believer is glorification (of Allah), his crying is declaration of Allah's oneness, his sleep on the bed is worship, and his turning from side to side is jihad in the way of Allah. If he recovers, he walks among people without any sins upon him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: امإ :ثلاث نم ةدحاوب هفحتأ هيلإ رظن اذفإ ،هيلإ رظن ادبع الله بحأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .دمر امإو ،ىمح امإو ،عادص
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When Allah loves a servant, He looks at him, and when He looks at him, He bestows upon him one of three things: either a headache, or fever, or eye pain.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: نفإ رجشلا قروك هنم بونذلا ترثانت ةدحاو ةامح مح اذإ نمؤملا نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا نفإ ،الله ليبس يف هفيسب برضي نمك هشارف لىع هبلقتو ،ليلهت هحايصو ،حيبست هنينفأ هشارف لىع راص .انيلإ بحأ ةيفاعلاو ،داع نإ هل ليوو ،بتا نإ هل ىبوطف ،هل اروفغم ناك هباحصأو هناوخإ نيب الله دبعي لبقأ
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When a believer gets one fever, his sins fall off like leaves from a tree. When he lies on his bed, his moaning is glorification, his crying is declaration of Allah's oneness, and his turning on his bed is like one who strikes with his sword in the way of Allah. When he returns to worship Allah among his brothers and companions, he is forgiven. So blessed is he if he repents, and woe to him if he returns (to sin), though well-being is more beloved to us.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: .ةنس دسجلا يف ىقبي اهملأ نأ كلذو ةنس ةرافك ةليل ىمح :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع تعمس
englishText: I heard Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) saying: One night of fever is expiation for a year, because its pain remains in the body for a year.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: لازي لا ضرملا نإو ،ةنعلو بيذعت رفاكللو ،ةمحرو ريهطت نمؤملل ضرملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .بنذ هيلع نوكي لا ىتح نمؤملبا
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) who said: Illness for a believer is purification and mercy, and for a disbeliever is punishment and curse, and illness continues with the believer until no sin remains upon him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: .رئابكلا لاإ ةئيطخ لك طحي ةليل عادص :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A night of headache removes all sins except the major ones. Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient ...

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: هنع عفري :لاصخ عبرأ ضيرملل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ يبأ نع هدسج يف وضع لك هضرم عبتيو ،هتحص يف لمعي ناك لضف لك هل بتكيف كلملا الله رميأو ،ملقلا .هل اروفغم شاع شاع نإو ،هل اروفغم تام تام نفإ ،هنم هبونذ جرختسيف
englishText: From Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: For the sick there are four characteristics: The pen is lifted from him, Allah commands the angel to write for him every virtue he used to do in his health, his illness follows every organ in his body and removes his sins from it, if he dies he dies forgiven, and if he lives he lives forgiven.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: ،هتحص يف لمعي ناك ام نسحبأ هل بتك ملسملا ضرم اذإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .رجشلا قرو طقاست امك هبونذ تطقاستو
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When a Muslim falls ill, he is credited with the best of what he used to do in his health, and his sins fall off just as leaves fall from a tree.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: نم تبجع لاقف ؟تمسبت الله لوسر يا كلام هل :تلقف مسبت هنا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع زع هبر ىقلي ىتح اميقس لازي لا نأ بحلأ باوثلا نم مقسلا يف هل ام ملعي ولو ،مقسلا نم هعزجو نمؤملا .لجو
englishText: From the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that he smiled, so I said to him: Why are you smiling, O Messenger of Allah? He said: I am amazed at the believer and his anxiety from illness, if he knew what reward he has in illness, he would love to remain ill until he meets his Lord, the Mighty and Majestic.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: لاقف يسرافلا ناملس داع هنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع ،هئباآ نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا دمحم نب رفعج نع :ناملس لقا ،هل ريهطت عجولا كلذو هنم قبس دق بنذب لاإ عجو هبيصي انتعيش نم دحأ نم ام ناملس يا :هل هيلع ربصلبا رجلاا مكل !ناملس يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع لقا ؟ريهطتلا لاخ رجأ كلذ نم ئش يف انل سيلف ريهطت وهف ةصاخ عجولا امفأ ،تاجردلا مكل عفرتو تانسحلا مكل بتكت امهب ،هل ءاعدلاو الله ىلإ عرضتلاو .ةرافكو
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them) that he visited Salman Al-Farsi and said to him: O Salman, none of our followers is afflicted with pain except due to a sin that preceded from him, and that pain is purification for him. Salman said: Is there no reward for us in any of that except purification? Ali (peace be upon him) said: O Salman! You have reward for patience upon it and supplication to Allah and prayer for it, by these two good deeds are written for you and ranks are raised for you. As for the pain specifically, it is purification and expiation.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: .ةنس ةدابع نمؤملا بيصت يتلا ةلعلا يف ةليل رهس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع دانسلاا اذهبو
englishText: And with this chain from Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said: A night of sleeplessness due to illness that afflicts the believer is equivalent to a year of worship.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: .ةنس ةرافك ةليل ىمح :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا دانسلاا اذهبو
englishText: And with this chain he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: A night of fever is expiation for a year.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: رجلاا نم هل الله بتك بستحاو ربصف كىتشا لجر اميأ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ديهش فلأ رجأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: Any man who suffers and remains patient and anticipates reward, Allah writes for him the reward of a thousand martyrs.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering Illness As A Trial And Being Patient With It
arabicText: اوبتكا :هتكئلامل لجو زع الله لقا لاإ هدسج يف ليتبي ملسم نمام :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .هتحص يف لمعي ناك ام لضفأ يدبعل
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There is no Muslim who is afflicted with an illness in his body except that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, says to His angels: "Write down for My servant the best of what he used to do when he was healthy."

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering The Sickness Of A Child, Blindness, And Similar Afflictions
arabicText: .هيدلاول ةرافك :لقا ،؟يبصلا بيصي ضرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) regarding sickness that afflicts a child, he said: It is an expiation for the parents.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering The Sickness Of A Child, Blindness, And Similar Afflictions
arabicText: .هيلع باسح لاو الله ىقل دمحم للآ ايلاوم ابستحم فاوفكم الله ىقل نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever meets Allah blind while being patient (seeking reward) and loyal to the family of Muhammad will meet Allah with no reckoning against him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Considering The Sickness Of A Child, Blindness, And Similar Afflictions
arabicText: .بنذ نع هلأسي مث امهادحإ وأ هيتميرك انمؤم ادبع الله بلسي لا يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it was narrated: Allah does not take away both or one of a believing servant's eyes and then question him about his sins.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: هتلدبأ ثالاث هداوع كلذ متكف ةيليب هتيلتبا دبع اميأ :لجو زع الله لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع تام تام نإو ،هل بنذ لاو هتيقبأ هتيقبأ نفإ ،هرشب نم اريخ ارشبو ،همد نم اريخ امدو ،همحل نم اريخ امحل .يتمحر ىلإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: "Any servant whom I afflict with a trial and he conceals it from his visitors for three days, I will replace his flesh with better flesh, his blood with better blood, and his skin with better skin. If I let him live, he will live without sins, and if he dies, he will die into My mercy."

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: نيتس ةدابعك تناك اهركش الله ىلإ ىدأو اهلوبقب اهلبقف ةليل كىتشا نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ناك ام لىع الله دمح حبصأ اذفإ ،اهيف ناك امب ربخي لاو اهيلع ربصي :لقا ؟اهلوبق ام :هل تلقف :يبأ لقا ،ةنس
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever experiences pain for one night and accepts it with acceptance and shows gratitude to Allah for it, it will be equivalent to sixty years of worship. My father said: I asked him: What is its acceptance? He said: To be patient with it and not inform anyone about what happened during it, and when morning comes, praise Allah for what occurred.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: نم اريخ امحل هل الله لدبأ ادحأ هب ربخي ملو همتكف مياأ ةثلاث ضرم نم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا فيكو كادف تلعج :تلق لقا هرعش نم اريخ ارعشو ،هترشب نم اريخ ةرشبو ،همد نم اريخ امدو همحل .اهيف بنذي مل ارشبو امدو ارعشو امحل هلدبي :لقا ؟هلدبي
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is ill for three days and conceals it without informing anyone, Allah will replace his flesh with better flesh, his blood with better blood, his skin with better skin, and his hair with better hair. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, how does He replace it? He said: He replaces it with flesh, hair, blood, and skin that have not sinned. Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complainin...

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: لاإ هداوع ىلإ كشي ملف ءلابب هتيلتبا دبع نم ام :ىلاعتو كرابت الله لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع هل سيلو شاع شاع نإو يتمحر ىلإ ةضبق هتضبق نفإ ،همد نم اريخ امدو ،همحل نم اريخ امحل هتلدبأ .بنذ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: "No servant whom I afflict with a trial and does not complain to his visitors except that I replace his flesh with better flesh, and his blood with better blood. If I take his soul, I take it to My mercy, and if he lives, he lives without sins."

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: ،ةنس نيتس ةدابع هل لجو زع الله بتك اهلوبقب اهلبقف ةليل ضرم نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .دحأ ىلإ اهيف هباصأ ام اوكشي لا :لقا ؟اهلوبقب اهلبق ىنعم امو :تلق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever is ill for one night and accepts it with acceptance, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will record for him worship of sixty years. I said: What is the meaning of accepting it with acceptance? He said: Not complaining about what afflicted him during it to anyone.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: ملف ثالاث ضرم نم :لج وزع الله لقا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع نإو ،هل بنذ لاو هتيفاع هتيفاع نفإ ،همد نم اريخ امدو همحل نم اريخ امحل هتلدبأ هداوع نم دحأ ىلإ كشي .يتمحر ىلإ هتضبق هتضبق
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: "Whoever is ill for three days and does not complain to any of his visitors, I will replace his flesh with better flesh and his blood with better blood. If I grant him health, he will be healthy without sins, and if I take him, I will take him to My mercy."

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: .سانلا ىلإ ىوكش هيف سيل ربص كلذ :لقا ؟ليمجلا ربصلا ام الله كمحري (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق
englishText: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): May Allah have mercy on you, what is beautiful patience? He said: That is patience in which there is no complaint to people.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: لوسر لقا :لقا (يهانملا ثيدح يف) (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج قداصلا نع ميهاربإ هليلخ عم ةمايقلا موي الله هثعب هداوع ىلإ كشي ملف ةليلو اموي ضرم نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله .عملالا قربلاك طارصلا زوجي ىتح نامحرلا ليلخ
englishText: From Al-Sadiq Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) (in hadith of prohibitions) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever is sick for a day and night and does not complain to his visitors, Allah will resurrect him on the Day of Judgment with His friend Ibrahim, the friend of the Most Merciful, until he crosses the Sirat like bright lightning.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: مياأ ةثلاث هباصأ اعجو متك نم :لقا - ةأمعبرلأا ثيدح - يف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع هدانسإب (لاصخلا) يفو .هنم هيفاعي نأ الله لىع اقح ناك لجو زع الله ىلإ كىشو سانلا نم
englishText: In (Al-Khisal) through his chain from Ali (peace be upon him)- in the hadith of the four hundred- he said: Whoever conceals his pain from people for three days and complains only to Allah the Mighty and Majestic, it becomes Allah's duty to cure him from it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: ،لىب :تلق ؟ةنجلا ىلإ وعدي ربلاو ربلا نم يه لاصخ سمخب مكربخأ لاأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .اهنامتكو ةبيصملا ءافخإ :لقا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Shall I inform you of five characteristics that are from righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise? I said: Yes. He said: Concealing and hiding calamities.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: .هل ةدسفم مكحتسي نأ لبق ئشلا راهظإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Revealing something before it is established leads to its corruption.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing Illness And Refraining From Complaining About It
arabicText: .كب ىشم ام كئادب شمأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع (ةغلابلا جهن) يف يضرلا نيسحلا نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad bin Al-Husayn Al-Radhi in (Nahj Al-Balagha) from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) who said: Walk with your illness as long as it walks with you.

chapter: Recommendation Of Avoiding Medication While Being Able To Be Patient And There Is No Danger, Especially For Cold, Boils, Eye Inflammation And Cough, And What Should Be Treated With Medication, And Its Obligation When There Is Danger In Avoiding It
arabicText: لاإ ديلا كاسمإ نم ندبلا يف عفنأ ئش سيلو ءاد جيهيو لاإ ءاود نم سيل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .هيلإ جاتحي امع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said: There is no medicine except that it stirs up an illness, and nothing is more beneficial for the body than restraining the hand except from what it needs.

chapter: Recommendation Of Avoiding Medication While Being Able To Be Patient And There Is No Danger, Especially For Cold, Boils, Eye Inflammation And Cough, And What Should Be Treated With Medication, And Its Obligation When There Is Danger In Avoiding It
arabicText: هحرج نم حورجملا ءافش كرتا نإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) حيسملا ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةلاحم لا هحراج كيرش
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messiah (peace be upon him) used to say: Indeed, one who leaves treating the wounded from his wound is inevitably a partner of the one who wounded him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Avoiding Medication While Being Able To Be Patient And There Is No Danger, Especially For Cold, Boils, Eye Inflammation And Cough, And What Should Be Treated With Medication, And Its Obligation When There Is Danger In Avoiding It
arabicText: هنم الله ىلإ نافأ تامف ئشب هسفن جلاعيف همقس لىع هتحص ترهظ نم لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ئرب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever's health appears to overcome his illness, then treats himself with something and dies, I am innocent of him before Allah. Translator: When the body shows signs of healing naturally without any treatment.

chapter: Recommendation Of Avoiding Medication While Being Able To Be Patient And There Is No Danger, Especially For Cold, Boils, Eye Inflammation And Cough, And What Should Be Treated With Medication, And Its Obligation When There Is Danger In Avoiding It
arabicText: ،مكنع ءادلا عفدنا ام ءابطلأا ةجلاعم اوعفدا :لوقي وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا باأ تعمس .هريثك ىلإ رجي هليلق ءانبلا ةلزنمب هنفإ
englishText: I heard Abu Al-Hasan Musa bin Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Avoid doctors' treatment as long as the illness can be pushed away from you, for it is like construction - a little of it leads to a lot of it. Translator: See Hadith 2490.

chapter: Recommendation Of Avoiding Medication While Being Able To Be Patient And There Is No Danger, Especially For Cold, Boils, Eye Inflammation And Cough, And What Should Be Treated With Medication, And Its Obligation When There Is Danger In Avoiding It
arabicText: ءادلا كندب لمتحا ام ءاودلا بنجت :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا :لقا (قلاخلأا مراكم) يف يسربطلا لضف نب نسحلا .ءاودلفا ءادلا لمتحي مل اذفإ
englishText: Al-Hasan bin Fadl Al-Tabarsi in (Makarim Al-Akhlaq) said: He (peace be upon him) said: Avoid medication as long as your body can bear the illness, and when it cannot bear the illness, then use medication.

chapter: Recommendation Of Avoiding Medication While Being Able To Be Patient And There Is No Danger, Especially For Cold, Boils, Eye Inflammation And Cough, And What Should Be Treated With Medication, And Its Obligation When There Is Danger In Avoiding It
arabicText: .طلخم ليلعو ،متحم حيحص :نلايلع نانثا :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: Two are sick: a person who is genuinely (or destined to fall) sick, and a sick person who is delirious (*) Translator: * The root word means to be mixed up or confused.

chapter: Recommendation Of Avoiding Medication While Being Able To Be Patient And There Is No Danger, Especially For Cold, Boils, Eye Inflammation And Cough, And What Should Be Treated With Medication, And Its Obligation When There Is Danger In Avoiding It
arabicText: وه ينضرمأ يذلا نوكي ىتح ىوادتأ لا :لاقف ضرم ءايبنلأا نم ايبن نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نعو .ينم ءافشلا نفإ ىوادتت ىتح كيفشأ لا :هيلإ الله حىوفأ ،ينيفشي يذلا
englishText: And from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A prophet among the prophets became ill and said: I will not seek treatment until the One who made me ill is the One who cures me. So Allah revealed to him: I will not cure you until you seek treatment, for healing is from Me.

chapter: Recommendation Of Avoiding Medication While Being Able To Be Patient And There Is No Danger, Especially For Cold, Boils, Eye Inflammation And Cough, And What Should Be Treated With Medication, And Its Obligation When There Is Danger In Avoiding It
arabicText: .كب ىشم ام كئادب شما :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لوق مدقت دقو
englishText: And it has already preceded, the saying of Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him): "Walk with your illness as long as it walks with you."

chapter: Limit Of Complaining That Is Disliked For The Sick Person And Its Non-prohibition
arabicText: مويلا تممح :لوقي لجرلا نإ :لاقف ،ضيرملل ةياكشلا دح نع لئس لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لوقيو ،دحأ هب لتبي مل امب تيلتبا دقل :لوقي نأ ىوكشلا امنإو ،ةاكش اذه سيلو ،قدص دقو ةحرابلا ترهسو .اذه وحنو مويلا تممحو ةحرابلا ترهس :لوقي نأ ىوكشلا سيلو ،ادحأ بصي مل ام ينباصأ دقل
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said when asked about the limit of complaining for a sick person: Indeed, if a person says "I had fever today" and "I stayed up last night" and he is truthful, this is not complaining. Rather, complaining is when one says "I have been afflicted with what no one has been afflicted with" and says "I have been struck with what has not struck anyone." It is not complaining to say "I stayed up last night" and "I had fever today" and similar statements.

chapter: Limit Of Complaining That Is Disliked For The Sick Person And Its Non-prohibition
arabicText: كرابت برلا لوقي ءاسم لك دنع ءامسلا ىلإ ضيرملا دبعلا اكلم دعص اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع نم سبح يف هتسبحإ يدبع تفصنأ ام :لوقيف ،ةياكشلا :نلاوقيف ؟هضرم يف يدبعل امتبتك اذام :ىلاعتو ةئيس هيلع ابتكت لاو ،هتحص يف ريخلا نم هل نابتكت امتنك ام لثم يدبعل ابتكا ،ةياكشلا هعنمأ مث يسبح .يسبح نم سبح يف هنفإ يسبح نم هقلطأ ىتح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When the two angels of the sick servant ascend to heaven every evening, the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, says: What have you written for My servant in his illness? They say: Complaints. He says: I have not done justice to My servant- I confined him in one of My confinements then prevent him from complaining. Write for My servant the same good deeds you used to write for him when he was healthy, and do not write any bad deeds against him until I release him from My confinement, for he is in one of My confinements.

chapter: Limit Of Complaining That Is Disliked For The Sick Person And Its Non-prohibition
arabicText: نكلو ،ةحرابلا تكعو وأ ،ةحرابلا تضرم :لجرلا لوقي نأ ةياكشلا تسيل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .دحأ هب لبي مل امب تيلب :لوقي نأ ةياكشلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: It is not complaining when a man says "I was sick last night" or "I had a fever last night," but complaining is when he says "I have been afflicted with what no one has been afflicted with."

chapter: Permissibility Of Complaining To A Believer And Not To Others
arabicText: هنيد لىع هفلاخي نم ىلإ وأ رفاك ىلإ هرضو هتجاح اكش نمؤم اميأ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس هلثم نمؤم ىلإ هرضو هتجاح اكش نمؤم لجر اميأو لقا ،الله ءادعأ نم ودع ىلإ لجو زع الله كىش امنفإ .لجو زع الله ىلإ هاوكش تناك
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Any believer who complains of his need and hardship to a disbeliever or to someone who differs from his religion, it is as if he has complained about Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, to an enemy among Allah's enemies. He said: And any believing man who complains of his need and hardship to a believer like himself, his complaint is to Allah (*), the Mighty and Majestic. Translator: * Complaint towards a disbeliever reflects weakness of faith and is ultimately directed towards Allah in a negative sense. Whereas complaint to a believer is seen as an act of reliance on the community that Allah has established for mutual assistance- and it ultimately reaches Allah in a positive way.

chapter: Permissibility Of Complaining To A Believer And Not To Others
arabicText: ،كناوخإ ضعبل اهركذا نكلو ،فلاخلا لهأ نم دحأ ىلإ اهكشت لاف ةلزنا كب تلزن اذإ !نسح يا :الله دبع وبأ لقا .يأرب ةروشم وأ باجتست ةوعد وأ ،هاجب ةنوعم امإو لامب ةيافك امإ :عبرأ لاصخ نم ةلصخ مدعت نل كنفإ
englishText: Abu Abdullah said: O Hasan! When a calamity befalls you, do not complain about it to anyone from the people of opposition, but mention it to some of your brothers, for you will not miss out on one of four qualities: either sufficiency with wealth, or assistance through influence, or an answered supplication, or consultation with an opinion.

chapter: Permissibility Of Complaining To A Believer And Not To Others
arabicText: ىلإ كىش نمو ،لجو زع الله ىلإ كىش دقف نمؤم ىلإ كىش نم :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .لجو زع الله اكش دقف فلاخم
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever complains to a believer has complained to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and whoever complains to an opponent has complained about Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. Permissibility Of Complaining To A Believer And Not To Others

chapter: Permissibility Of Complaining To A Believer And Not To Others
arabicText: .الله اكش دقف هيخأ ريغ ىلإ اكش نمو .الله ىلإ كىش دقف هيخأ ىلإ اكش نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .هنيد يف هوخأ كلذ ىنعمو لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever complains to his brother has complained to Allah, and whoever complains to other than his brother has complained about Allah. He said: And the meaning of this is his brother in religion.

chapter: Dislike Of A Sick Person Walking, Rather They Should Be Carried For Their Needs
arabicText: يف لعج لتعا اذإ ناك (ملاسلا هيلع) يبأ نإ ،سكن ضيرملل يشملا نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .سكن ضيرملل يشملا نإ :لوقي ناك هنأ كاذو ،ءوضولا ىنعي هتجاحل لمحف بوث
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Walking for a sick person is a relapse. When my father (peace be upon him) was ill, he would be wrapped in a cloth and carried for his needs, meaning for ablution, and that was because he used to say: Walking for a sick person is a relapse.

chapter: Recommendation For A Sick Person To Inform His Brothers About His Illness
arabicText: رجويف هنودوعيف هضرمب هناوخإ نذؤي نأ مكنم ضيرملل يغبني لوقي :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا ؟مهيف وه رجوي فيكف ،هيلإ مهاشممب هيف نورجوي مهف معن :هل ليقف :لقا ،هيف نورجويو مهيف حىميو .تاجرد رشع هل عفريو ،تانسح رشع كلذب هل بتكيف مهيف رجويف تانسحلا مهل هباستكبا :لاقف .تائيس رشع هنع اهب
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: It is appropriate for any sick person among you to inform his brothers about his illness so they visit him, then he will be rewarded regarding them and they will be rewarded regarding him. It was said to him: Yes, they are rewarded regarding him for their walking to him, but how is he rewarded regarding them? He said: By earning good deeds for them, so he is rewarded regarding them, and ten good deeds are written for him, and he is raised ten degrees, and ten bad deeds are erased from him because of it.

chapter: Recommendation Of The Sick Person's Permission For Visitors
arabicText: ةوعد هلو لاإ دحأ نم سيل هنفإ هيلع نولخدي سانلل نذأيلف مكدحأ ضرم اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا وبأ لقا .ةباجتسم
englishText: Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: When one of you becomes ill, let him permit people to visit him, for there is no one except that they have an answered supplication.

chapter: Recommendation Of The Sick Person's Permission For Visitors
arabicText: نم سيل هنفإ ،هيلع نولخدي سانلل نذأيلف مكدحأ ضرم اذإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع سانلا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم ةمأ :تلق ؟سانلا نم يردتأ :لقا مث ،ةباجتسم ةوعد هلو لاإ دحأ .ةعيشلا مه
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: When one of you becomes ill, let him permit people to visit him, for there is no one except that they have an answered supplication. Then he said: Do you know who the people are? I said: The nation of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). He said: The people are the Shia.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: ةكئلاملا نم افلأ نيعبس ادبأ هب الله لكو نيملسملا نم اضيرم داع نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ضيرملا دئاعل مهتلاص فصن ةمايقلا موي ىلإ نوربكيو نوللهيو نوسدقيو هيف نوحبسيو هلحر نوشغي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever visits a sick Muslim, Allah assigns seventy thousand angels to him forever, who cover his journey, glorify, sanctify, and proclaim Allah's oneness and greatness until the Day of Judgment, with half of their prayers being for the visitor of the sick.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: ىلإ عجري ىتح هل نورفغتسي كلم فلأ نوعبس هعيش اضيرم داع نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلزنم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever visits a sick person, seventy thousand angels accompany him, seeking forgiveness for him until he returns to his home.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: اذفإ ،ةمحرلا هترمغ سلج اذفإ ،اضوخ ةمحرلا ضاخ انمؤم داع نمؤم اميأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ىلإ ةنجلا كل تباطو تبط :نولوقيو هيلع نومحرتسيو هل نورفغتسي كلم فلأ نيعبس هب الله لكو فرصنا يف :ةيواز لقا ؟كادف تلعج فيرخلا ام :تلق ،ةنجلا يف فيرخ !ةزمح با يا هل ناكو ،دغ نم ةعاسلا كلت .اماع نيعبرأ اهيف بكارلا ريسي ةنجلا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Any believer who visits another believer is immersed in mercy; when he sits, mercy envelops him; and when he leaves, Allah assigns seventy thousand angels to him who seek forgiveness and mercy for him, saying: "You are blessed and Paradise is blessed for you" until the same hour the next day, and he will have, O Abu Hamza, a Khareef in Paradise. I asked: What is Khareef, may I be sacrificed for you? He said: A corner in Paradise that a rider would travel through for forty years.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: نم اكلم هب الله لكو هضرم يف لجو زع الله يف انمؤم داع نمؤم يأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةمايقلا موي ىلإ هل رفغتسيو ربق يف هدوعي داوعلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Any believer who visits another believer for the sake of Allah during his illness, Allah assigns an angel from the visitors to visit him in his grave and seek forgiveness for him until the Day of Judgment.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: .هربق يف هدوعي اكلم هب لجو زع الله لكو اضيرم داع نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever visits a sick person, Allah the Mighty and Majestic assigns an angel to visit him in his grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: ءامسلا نم دانم ىدنا اضيرم داع نم :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع ىبأ نب نوراه نع (دانسلإا برق) يف يريمحلا هاورو .ةنجلا نم باوثب كاشمم باطو تبط !نلاف يا :همسبا .لازنم ةنجلا نم تأوبت :لقا هنأ لاإ هلثم ملسم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever visits a sick person, a caller from heaven calls out his name: "O so-and-so! You are blessed and your walk is blessed with a reward from Paradise." And Al-Himyari reported in (Qurb Al-Isnad) from Harun bin Muslim similarly except he said: "You have secured a dwelling in Paradise."

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: نم ضيرملا ةدايع نم غلب ام !بر يا :لقا نأ :هبر ىسوم هب جىنا اميف ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هرشحم ىلإ هربق يف هدوعي اكلم هب لكوأ :لجو زع الله لاقف ؟رجلاا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Among what Moses conversed with his Lord about was that he said: "O Lord! What reward does visiting the sick earn?" So Allah the Mighty and Majestic said: "I will assign an angel to visit him in his grave until his resurrection."

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: جرخ لجر مهنم ،ةنجلا ةتسل تنمض (ملاسلا : هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم .هلف تامف اضيرم دوعي
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: I guarantee Paradise for six people, among them is a man who went out to visit a sick Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoni... person and died while doing so.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: لكب هلف اضيرم داع نمو :اهيف لوقي (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرل ةليوط ةبطخ يف سابع نب الله دبع هل عفريو ،ةئيس فلأ فلأ نوعبس هنع حىميو ،ةنسح فلأ فلأ نوعبس هلزنم ىلإ عجري ىتح اهاطخ ةوطخ .ةمايقلا موي ىلإ هل نورفغتسيو ،هربق يف هنودوعي كلم فلأ فلأ نوعبس هب لكوو ،ةجرد فلأ فلأ نوعبس
englishText: Abdullah bin Abbas, in a long sermon of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), says in it: And whoever visits a sick person, for every step they take until they return to their home, they get seventy million good deeds, seventy million sins are erased from them, seventy million ranks are raised for them, and seventy million angels are assigned to visit them in their grave and seek forgiveness for them until the Day of Judgment.

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: لجو زع الله ريعي :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،رفعج نب ىسوم هيخأ نع تنأ كناحبس كناحبس :لوقيف ؟يندوعت نأ تضرم اذإ كعنم ام !يدبع :لوقيف ةمايقلا موي هدابع نم ادبع هدنع ينتدجول هتدع ولو يللاجو يتزعو ،هدعت ملف نمؤملا كوخأ ضرم :لوقيف ،ضرمت لاو ملتأ لا ،دابعلا بر .ميحرلا نامحرلا ناأو نمؤملا يدبع ةمارك نم كلذو ،كل اهتيضقف كجئاوحب تلفكتل مث
englishText: From his brother Musa bin Ja'far, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said: Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will reproach one of His servants on the Day of Judgment saying: "My servant! What prevented you from visiting Me when I was sick?" The servant will say: "Glory be to You, Glory be to You, You are the Lord of the servants, You neither feel pain nor fall ill." Allah will say: "Your believing brother was sick and you did not visit him. By My Might and Majesty, had you visited him, you would have found Me with him, then I would have taken care of your needs and fulfilled them for you. This is from the honor of My believing servant, and I am the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate."

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: كدوعأ فيك بر يا :لقا ،يندعت ملف تضرم مدآ نبا لوق لجو زع الله نإ :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع فيك :لاقف ،ينقست ملف كتيقستساو ،هدنع ينتدجول هتدع ولو يدبع نلاف ضرم :لقا ؟نيملاعلا بر تنأو :ينمعطت ملف كتمعطتساو ،يدنع كلذ تدجول هتيقس ولو نلاف يدبع كاقستسا :لقا ؟نيملاعلا بر تنأو .يدنع كلذ ت دجول هتمعطأ (ولو) ولف ،همعطت ملف يدبع كمعطتسا لقا ،؟نيملاعلا بر تنأو فيك :لقا
englishText: From the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said: Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, says: "O son of Adam, I was sick and you did not visit Me." He said: "O Lord, how can I visit You when You are the Lord of the worlds?" He said: "My servant so and-so was sick, and had you visited him, you would have found Me with him. And I asked you for water but you did not give Me to drink." He said: "How, when You are the Lord of the worlds?" He said: "My servant so-and-so asked you for water, and had you given him to drink, you would have found that with Me. And I asked you for food but you did not feed Me." He said: "How, when You are the Lord of the worlds?" He said: "My servant asked you for food but you did not feed him, and had you fed him, you would have found that with Me."

chapter: Recommendation Of Visiting Sick Muslims And The Dislike Of Abandoning Such Visits
arabicText: نع مهاهنو عبسب مهرمأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .ثيدحلا ركذو .ضيرملا ةدايعب مهرمأ :عبس
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon them both) that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) commanded them with seven things and forbade them from seven things: He commanded them to visit the sick. And he mentioned the hadith.

chapter: Emphasis Of Visiting The Sick In The Morning And Evening
arabicText: دعق اذفإ ،كلم فلأ نوعبس هعيش حبصي نيح اضيرم انمؤم داع نمؤم اميأ لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ .حبصي ىتح كلذ لثم هل ناك اءاسم هداع نإو ،يسمي ىتح هل اورفغتساو ةمحرلا هترمغ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Whichever believer visits a sick believer in the morning, seventy thousand angels accompany him, and when he sits, mercy encompasses him and they seek forgiveness for him until evening. And if he visits him in the evening, he will have the same until morning.

chapter: Emphasis Of Visiting The Sick In The Morning And Evening
arabicText: كلم فلأ نوعبس ذئموي هيلع لىص هضرم يف املسم اءرما داع نم :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تعمس .ةنجلا يف افيرخ هل نأ عم اوحبصي ىتح ءاسم ناك نإو ،اوسمي ىتح احابص ناك نإ
englishText: I heard Aba Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Whoever visits a sick Muslim during his illness, seventy thousand angels will pray for him that day if it was in the morning until evening, and if it was in the evening until morning, and he will have an orchard in Paradise.

chapter: Emphasis Of Visiting The Sick In The Morning And Evening
arabicText: :(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نسحلا داع ىسوم باأ نأ عفنا نب الله دبع نب مكحلا نع كلم فلأ نوعبس هعم جرخ لاإ ايسمم اضيرم دوعي لجر نم ام :لاقف ،ادئاع :لاقف ؟ارئاز وأ تئج ادئاعأ .ةنجلا يف فيرخ هل ناكو حبصي ىتح هل نورفغتسي
englishText: From Al-Hakam bin Abdullah bin Nafi that Abu Musa visited Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon him). Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: Have you come to visit me as a sick person or as a regular visitor? He said: As one visiting the sick. He said: No man visits a sick person in the evening except that seventy thousand angels go out with him seeking forgiveness for him until morning, and he will have an orchard in Paradise.

chapter: Recommendation Of Seeking The Patient's Prayer By The Visitor And Avoiding The Patient's Prayer Against Him By Not Causing Anger Or Annoyance
arabicText: ءاعد لثم هئاعد نفإ هل وعدي هلأسيلف هل ادئاع هيخأ لىع مكدحأ لخد اذإ ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .ةكئلاملا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When one of you visits his sick brother, he should ask him to pray for him, for his prayer is like the prayer of angels.

chapter: Recommendation Of Seeking The Patient's Prayer By The Visitor And Avoiding The Patient's Prayer Against Him By Not Causing Anger Or Annoyance
arabicText: لاو هوظيغت لاف ،ضيرملاو يزاغلاو جاحلا :ةباجتسم مهتوعد ةثلاث :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .هورجضت
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Three people's prayers are answered: the pilgrim, the warrior, and the sick person, so do not anger them or annoy them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Seeking The Patient's Prayer By The Visitor And Avoiding The Patient's Prayer Against Him By Not Causing Anger Or Annoyance
arabicText: .هل الله باجتسا لاإ ائيش دئاعلل ضيرملا لأسي مل الله يف اضيرم داع نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever visits a sick person for the sake of Allah, the sick person will not ask anything for the visitor except that Allah will answer it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Seeking The Patient's Prayer By The Visitor And Avoiding The Patient's Prayer Against Him By Not Causing Anger Or Annoyance
arabicText: :لاقف هتلع يف ناملس (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر :داع لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج قداصلا نع ةلعلا عدت لاو ،باجتسم هيف كئاعدو ،ركذب لجو زع الله نم تنأ :لاصخ ثلاث كتلع يف كل نإ !ناملس يا .كلجأ ءاضقنا ىلإ ةيفاعلبا الله كعتم ،هتطح لاإ ابنذ كيلع
englishText: From Al-Sadiq Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) visited Salman during his illness and said: O Salman! In your illness, there are three qualities: You are remembered by Allah the Mighty and Majestic, your prayer during it is answered, and the illness does not leave any sin upon you except that it removes it. May Allah grant you well-being until the Recommendation Of Seeking The Patient's Prayer By The Visitor And A... end of your appointed time.

chapter: Recommendation Of Seeking The Patient's Prayer By The Visitor And Avoiding The Patient's Prayer Against Him By Not Causing Anger Or Annoyance
arabicText: مهولسو مكاضرم اودوع :لقا الله دبع يبأ نع هدانسإب ديزي نب بوقعي نع (ىهتنملا) يف ةملاعلا ىورو .ةكئلاملا ءاعد لدعي هنفإ ءاعدلا
englishText: And Al-Allama reported in (Al-Muntaha) from Ya'qub bin Yazid with his chain from Abu Abdullah who said: Visit your sick ones and ask them to pray, for their prayer equals the prayer of angels.

chapter: Non-emphasis Of Recommended Visitation For Eye Pain, And For Less Than Three Days After Visitation, Or Two Days, And During Extended Illness
arabicText: اذفإ ،مياأ ةثلاث نم لقأ يف ةدايع نوكت لاو ،نيعلا عجو يف ةدايع لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلايعو ضيرملا كرت ةلعلا تلاط اذفإ ،لا مويو مويف تبجو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no visitation for eye pain, and there should not be visitation in less than three days. When it becomes necessary, then visit every other day, and if the illness is prolonged, leave the sick person and his family.

chapter: Non-emphasis Of Recommended Visitation For Eye Pain, And For Less Than Three Days After Visitation, Or Two Days, And During Extended Illness
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا هداعف هنيع كىتشا (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نإ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع تعجو ام الله لوسر يا لاقف ؟اعجو مأ اعزجأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا هل لاقف ،حيصي وه اذفإ ملسو (هلآو .هنم دشأ طق اعجو .ناركذ امك بابحتسلاا دكتأ ىفن لىع لولأاو ،نيعلا عجو يف ةدايعلا بابحتسا لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Indeed, Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) complained of his eye, and the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) visited him and found him crying out. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: "Is it anxiety or pain?" He replied: "O Messenger of Allah, I have never experienced pain more severe than this." I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as recommending visitation for eye pain, and the first one on negating the emphasis of recommendation as we mentioned.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: هسفن ذوعيلف هدسج يف ملأ هباصأ نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رقابلا نع مس همسا عم رضي لا نمب يسفن ذيعأ ،ءامسلا رابجب يسفن ذيعأ ،ءايشلأا لىع هتردقو الله ةزعب ذوعأ :لقيلو .ءاد لاو ملأ هرضي مل كلذ :لقا اذإ هنفإ ،ءافشو ةكرب همسا يذلبا يسفن ذيعأ ،ءاد لاو
englishText: From Al-Baqir (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever experiences pain in their body should seek protection and say: I seek protection in Allah's might and His power over all things, I seek protection with the Compeller of the heavens, I seek protection with the One with whose name no poison or disease can harm, I seek protection with the One whose name is blessing and healing. If one says this, no pain or disease will harm them.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: كىتشا اذإ :لاقف ،؟يدسج يف اعجوو املأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ىلإ توكش :لقا روعلأا ثراحلا نع رش نم ءاشي ام لىع هتردقو الله ةزعب ذوعأو ،هلآو الله لوسر لىع الله لىصو للهباو الله مسب :لقيلف مكدحأ .الله ءاش نإ ءادلا هنع الله فرص كلذ :لقا اذإ هنفإ دجأ ام
englishText: From Al-Harith Al-A'war who said: I complained to Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) of pain and ache in my body. He said: When one of you has pain, they should say: In the name of Allah and by Allah, and may Allah's blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah and his family, and I seek protection in Allah's might and His power over whatever He wills from the evil of what I find. If one says this, Allah will remove the ailment from them, if Allah wills.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: ربلا يف ام هل نكس يذلا للهبا ذوعأ :لقيلو هديب هحسميلف هسأر كىتشا نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رقابلا نع .عجولا هنع عفري هنفإ تارم عبس ،ميلعلا عيمسلا وهو ضرلأاو تاوامسلا يف امو رحبلاو
englishText: From Al-Baqir (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever has a headache should wipe it with their hand and say seven times: I seek protection with Allah, to whom submits whatever is in the land and sea, and whatever is in the heavens and earth, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing. The pain will be lifted from them.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: كدي عض :لاقف ،اراهنو لايل هنم دجأ امو يسأر عجو هيلإ توكش لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع ينإ مهللا ،ميلعلا عيمسلا وهو ءامسلا يف لاو ضرلأا يف ئش همسا عم رضي لا يذلا الله مسب :لقو هيلع الله نذإب هنع كلذ نكسي هنفإ تارم عبس ،هسفنل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) دمحم هب راجتسا امب كب ريجتسأ .هقيفوت نسحو ىلاعت
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him), I complained to him about my headache and what I experience from it day and night. He said: Place your hand on it and say seven times: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or heaven can harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing. O Allah, I seek protection with You with what Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) sought protection for himself. This will calm it by Allah's permission and His good accordance.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لىع لزن (ملاسلا هيلع) ليئربج نأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع هذهب ذوع نم !دمحم يا :لقاو ،كنع الله ففخي ةذوعلا هذهب كعادص ذوع دمحم يا :لاقف عدصم يبنلاو (هلآو :لوقتو عضوملا لىع كديب حسمت ،هنذإب الله هافش هبيصي عجو يأ لىع تارم عبس ةذوعلا يف هرمأ نأ امك ،ضام ذفنا هرمأ ضرلأاو ءامسلا يف يذلا انبر ركذ سدقت ،ءامسلا يف يذلا انبر الله مسب كئافش نم ءافش لزنا ،نيرهاطلا نيبيطلا بر يا نايااطخو انبونذ انل رفغاو ضرلأا يف كتمحر لعجا ،ءامسلا .همسا ىمستو ،ةنلاف نب نلاف لىع كتمحر نم ةمحرو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) that Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) while the Prophet had a headache and said: O Muhammad, seek protection from your headache with this ta'widh and Allah will ease it for you. And he said: O Muhammad! Whoever seeks protection with this ta'widh seven times for any pain that afflicts them, Allah will heal them by His permission. Wipe your hand over the location and say: In the name of Allah our Lord who is in heaven, sanctified is the remembrance of our Lord whose command is effective and executed in heaven and earth, as His command is in heaven. Place Your mercy on earth and forgive us our sins and mistakes, O Lord of the good and pure ones, send down healing from Your healing and mercy from Your mercy upon so-and-so son of so-and-so, and name them.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: كدي عضف بهذا :هل لاقف ةرسلا عجو (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا الله دبع يبأ ىلإ لجر كىش :لقا ريصب يبأ نع نم ليزنت هفلخ نم لاو هيدي نيب نم لطابلا هيتيأ لا زيزع باتكل هنإو) :لقو كيتشت يذلا عضوملا لىع .الله نذإب يفاعت كنفإ ثالاث (ديمح ميكح
englishText: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Disea... From Abu Basir who said: A man complained to Abu Abdullah Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about pain in his navel. He said to him: Go and place your hand on the place that hurts and say: And indeed, it is a mighty Book. Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; a revelation from a Wise and Praiseworthy One [Quran, 41:41-42] three times, and you will be cured by Allah's permission.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: حسمو ةين صلاخإب لاقف طق ةياكش نينمؤملا نم دحأ كىتشا ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقاو :لقا يفوع لاإ (اراسخ لاإ نيملاظلا ديزي لاو نينمؤملل ةمحرو ءافش وه ام نآرقلا نم لزننو) لوقيو ةلعلا عضوم .نينمؤملل ةمحرو ءافش لوقي ثيح ةيلآا يف كلذ قادصمو ،تناك ةلع ةيأ ةلعلا كلت نم
englishText: He said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: No believer has ever complained of any ailment and then sincerely wiped the affected area while saying "And We send down of the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss" [Quran, 17:82], except that he was cured of that ailment, whatever ailment it was. And the confirmation of this is in the verse where it says healing and mercy for the believers.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: كدي عض :لاقف ليللا رهسي هنأو رهظلا عجو (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع ىلإ لجر كىش :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رقابلا نع باوث دري نمو لاجؤم بااتك الله نذإب لاإ تومت نأ سفنل ناك امو) :ثالاث أرقاو هنم كيتشت يذلا عضوملا لىع ةليل يف هانلزنأ ناإ) :تارم عبس أرقاو (نيركاشلا يزجنسو اهنم هتؤن ةرخلآا باوث دري نمو اهنم هتؤن ايندلا .الله ءاش نإ للعلا نم يفاعت كنفإ اهرخآ ىلإ (ردقلا
englishText: From Al-Baqir (peace be upon him) who said: A man complained to Ali (peace be upon him) of back pain and that he could not sleep at night. He said: Place your hand on the spot that hurts and recite three times: "And it is not for a soul to die except by permission of Allah at a decree determined. And whoever desires the reward of this world- We will give him thereof; and whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter We will give him thereof. And we will reward the grateful" [Quran, 3:145] and recite seven times: "Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Decree" [Quran, 97:1] until its end, and you will be cured of ailments, insha'Allah.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: اهرخآ ىلإ (لبج لىع نآرقلا اذه انلزنأ ول) :رشحلا ةروس رخآ مرو لك لىع أرقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .الله نذإب نكسي هنفإ ثالاث اهيلع لفتاو
