englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Recite over any swelling the end of Surah Al-Hashr: "Had We sent down this Quran upon a mountain" [Quran, 59:21] until its end, and spit lightly upon it three times, and it will subside by Allah's permission.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: ءافشلا لزنم يا) :للعلا عيمج لىع لق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع مدآ ،نب ياركز نع ،قاحسإ نب ليع نعو .الله ءاش نإ يفاعت كنفإ (ءافشلا يعجو لىع ءادلا بهذمو
englishText: And from Ali bin Ishaq, from Zakariya bin Adam, from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: Say for all illnesses: "O Sender of healing and Remover of disease, send healing upon my pain," and you will be cured, insha'Allah.

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: :يهو ملأ لكل اهنفإ نينمؤملا نم كناوخإ اهملع :لقاو ةذوعلا هذه ينملع :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ُ ه ُم ْ سا يِذَّ لا ِ للهِبا ي ِسْفَن ُ ذيِع ُ أ ، ٌ ءا َ د ِ هِم ْ سا َ عَ م ُّ ر ُضَ ي َ لا يِذَّ ل ِبا ي ِسْفَن ُ ذيِع ُ أ ،ِءا َم َّسلا ِّ بَ ر َ و ِ ضْ ر َ ْلأا ِّ بَ رِ ب ي ِسْفَن ُ ذيِع ُ أ " " . ٌ ءاَف ِشَ و ٌ ةَ ك َ رَ ب
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) said: He taught me this protection and said: Teach it to your believing brothers for it is for every pain, and it is: "I seek protection for myself with the Lord of the earth and the Lord of the sky, I seek protection for myself with the One with whose name no disease can harm, I seek protection for myself with Allah whose name is blessing and healing."

chapter: A Selection Of Ruqyah, Ta'widh, And Concise Supplications For Diseases And Pains
arabicText: اردق درت له ،اهب يفشتسن يقر (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرل ليق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .الله ردق نم اهنإ لاقف ؟الله نم
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about incantations we seek healing with, do they repel any of Allah's decree? He said: They are from Allah's decree.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sitting With The Sick Person Without Prolonging Unless The Sick Person Desires That Or Requests It
arabicText: .ةقنا بلح وأ ةقنا قاوف ردق ةدايعلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Visiting the sick should be for the duration of milking a camel or the interval between two milkings of a camel.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sitting With The Sick Person Without Prolonging Unless The Sick Person Desires That Or Requests It
arabicText: الله دنع ارجأ دئاوعلا مظعأ نم نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ةدايعلا مامت نم :لقاو ،كلذ هلأسيو هديريو كلذ بحي ضيرملا نوكي نأ لاإ سولجلا ففخ هاخأ داع اذإ نمل .هتهبج لىع وأ ،ىرخلأا لىع هيدي ىدحإ دئاعلا عضي نأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Among those who receive the greatest reward from Allah for visiting the sick are those who keep their visit short, unless the sick person loves that, wants it, and asks for it. And he said: Among the completeness of visiting is that the visitor places one of his hands over the other, or on his forehead.

chapter: Recommendation Of Sitting With The Sick Person Without Prolonging Unless The Sick Person Desires That Or Requests It
arabicText: ،هدنع نم مايقلا لجعتو هعارذ لىع كدي عضت نأ ضيرملل ةدايعلا مامت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هعجو نم ضيرملا لىع دشأ كىونلا ةدايع نفإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The completeness of visiting the sick is that you place your hand on their arm and hasten to leave, for the visit of foolish people is harder on the sick person than their illness.

chapter: Recommendation Of The Visitor Placing His Hand On The Sick Person, And Placing One Of His Hands On The Other Or On His Forehead
arabicText: .هيلع تلخد اذإ ضيرملا لىع كدي عضت نأ ةدايعلا مامت (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The completion of visiting the sick is to place your hand on the sick person when you enter upon him.

chapter: Recommendation Of The Visitor Bringing A Gift To The Sick Person Such As Fruit, Perfume, Incense Or Similar Items
arabicText: يلاوم نم ةدع نحنو هدوعن هيلإ انجرخف هيلاوم ضعب ضرم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعجل ىلوم نع ،انفقوف اوفق :انل :لاقف ،هدوعن نالاف ديرن انلقف ؟نوديرت نيأ :انل لاقف قيرطلا ضعب يف رفعج انلبقتسفا رفعج ئش انعم ام انلقف ؟روخب دوع نم ةعطق وأ ،بيط نم ةقعل وأ ةجرتأ وأ ،ةلجرفس وأ ةحافت مكدحأ عم لاقف !؟هيلع هب لخدا ام لك ىلإ حيرتسي ضيرملا نأ نوملعت امأ لاقف ،اذه نم
englishText: From a client (*) of Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said: One of his clients became ill, so we went out to visit him and we were a group of Ja'far's clients. Ja'far met us on the way and said to us: "Where are you going?" We said we want to visit so-and-so who is sick. He said to us: "Stop," so we stopped. He said: "Does any of you have an apple, or a quince, or a citron, or some perfume, or a piece of incense wood?" We said we don't have any of these things with us. He said: "Don't you know that the sick person finds comfort in everything that is brought to him?!" Translator: * The term "mawla" in this context refers to a person who has been freed from slavery and has become a servant or a client of their former master, continuing to maintain a loyal relationship with the master and his family.

chapter: Recommendation Of Striving To Fulfill The Needs Of The Blind And Sick Until They Are Met, Especially For Relatives
arabicText: اريرض ىفك نمو لقا (يهانملا ثيدح) يفلسو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع رانلا نم ةءاربو قافنلا نم ةءارب الله هاطعأ هتجاح هل الله يضقي ىتح اهيف هل ىشمو ايندلا جئاوح نم هتجاح ،عجري ىتح الله ةمحر يف ضوخي لازي لاو ايندلا جئاوح نم ةجاح نيعبس هل ىضقو يببأ راصنلأا نم لجر لاقف ،همأ هتدلو مويك هبونذ نم جرخ اهضقي مل وأ اهاضق ةجاح يف ضيرمل ىعس نمو لقا ؟هتيب لهأ ةجاح يف ىعس اذإ ارجأ مظعأ سيلوأ هتيب لهأ نم ضيرملا ناك نفإ الله لوسر يا يمأو تنأ .معن
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them), from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), in (the hadith of prohibitions) he said: Whoever suffices a blind person in their worldly needs and walks with them until Allah fulfills their need, Allah will grant them immunity from hypocrisy and immunity from the Fire, and will fulfill seventy of their worldly needs, and they will continue to wade through Allah's mercy until they return. And whoever strives for a sick person in their need, whether it is fulfilled or not, will emerge from their sins as the day their mother gave birth to them. Then a man from the Ansar said: May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Messenger of Allah, if the sick person is from his household, wouldn't there be greater reward when striving for the needs of his household? He said: Yes.

chapter: Not Prohibiting The Dislike Of Death
arabicText: يا لقا ؟كدنع نمؤملا لاح ام !بر يا لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلبا يرسأ امل (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع هلعفا ناأ ئش يف تددرت امو ،يئايلوأ ةرصن ىلإ ئش عرسأ ناأو ،ةبراحملبا ينزربا دقف ايلو يل ناهأ نم !دمحم .ريخأتلا نع ةيانك زاجم ددرتلا لوقأ .هتئاسم هركأو توملا هركي نمؤملا ةفاو يف يددرتك
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): When the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was taken on the night journey, he said: O Lord! What is the status of the believer with You? He said: O Muhammad! Whoever humiliates a friend of Mine has indeed openly challenged Me to war, and I am the quickest to come to the aid of My friends. I have not hesitated in anything I do as I hesitate in taking the soul of a believer- he dislikes death and I dislike causing him distress. I (Hurr Amili) say: The (word) hesitation (used in the hadith) is metaphorical, referring to delay. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Hesitation here is used metaphorically to indicate postponement.

chapter: Not Prohibiting The Dislike Of Death
arabicText: الله ءاقل ضغبأ نمو ؟هئاقل الله بحأ الله ءاقل بحأ نم الله كحلصأ :تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع دنع كلذ امنإ ،بهذت ثيح كلذ سيل :لقا ،!توملا هركنل ناإ اللهوف :تلق ،معن :لقا ؟هئاقل الله ضغبأ ىأر اذإو ،ذئنيح الله ءاقل بحي وهو هئاقل بحي ىلاعت اللهو ،مدقتي بحأ ئش سيلف بحي ام ىأر اذإ ،ةنياعملا .هئاقل ضغبي اللهو ،الله ءاقل نم هيلإ ضغبأ ئش سيلف هركي ام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I said: May Allah preserve you, does whoever loves to meet Allah, Allah loves to meet him? And whoever hates to meet Allah, Allah hates to meet him? He said: Yes. I said: By Allah, we dislike death! He said: It is not as you think. This only occurs at the time of witnessing, when one sees what they love, then nothing is more beloved to them than going forward, and Allah the Exalted loves to meet them and they love to meet Allah at that time. And when they see what they dislike, nothing is more hateful to them than meeting Allah, and Allah hates to meet them.

chapter: Not Prohibiting The Dislike Of Death
arabicText: ةحار توملاو توملا ،مدآ نبا امههركي نائيش :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ ديبل نبا دومحم نع .باسحلل لقأ لاملا ةلقو لاملا ةلق هركيو ،ةنتفلا نم نمؤملا
englishText: From Mahmud ibn Labid that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Two things the son of Adam dislikes: death, yet death is relief for the believer from trials, and he dislikes scarcity of wealth, yet scarcity of wealth means less accountability.

chapter: Permissibility Of Fleeing From A Place Of Epidemic And Plague Except When Staying Is Obligatory, Like For The Fighter And The Guard
arabicText: لوحتيف رصملا ةيحاني باولا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ نع تلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىهن امنإ سبأ لا :لاقف ،؟هرغ ىلإ هنم جرخيف رصم يف نوكي وأ ،ىرخأ ةيحنا ىلإ لجرلا الله لىص) الله لوسر لاقف هنم اوبرهف باولا مهيف عقوف ودعلا لايحب تناك ةيبر ناكمل كلذ نع (هلآو هيلع .مهزكارم ولخت نأ ةيهارك فحزلا نم رافلاك هنم رافلا ،(هلآو هيلع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about an epidemic in a part of a city, can a man move to another area, or if he is in a city can he leave it for another? He said: There is no problem. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) only prohibited this regarding a garrison that was facing the enemy when plague struck them and they fled from it. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The one who flees from it is like one who flees from battle, disliking that their positions would be emptied.

chapter: Permissibility Of Fleeing From A Place Of Epidemic And Plague Except When Staying Is Obligatory, Like For The Fighter And The Guard
arabicText: ؟اهريغ ىلإ اهنع اولوحتي نأ مهلأ ،توملا اهيف عقيف دلبلا يف نونوكي موقلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق ودعلا ءازإب ةبئر اوناك كئلوأ لاقف ،؟كلذب اموق باع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ انغلب :تلق ،معن :لقا مهيف عقو املف ،هريغ ىلإ هنع اولوحتي لاو مهعضوم يف اوتبثي نأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر مهرمفأ .فحزلا نم رارفلاك هريغ ىلإ ناكملا كلذ نع مهليوحت ناكف هريغ ىلإ ناكملا كلذ نم اولوحت توملا
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): People are in a town and death occurs in it, can they move from it to another? He said: Yes. I said: We have been told that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) criticized people for this? He said: Those were a garrison facing the enemy, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered them to stay in their position and not move from it to another. When death occurred among them, they moved from that place to another, so their moving from that place to another was like fleeing from battle.

chapter: Permissibility Of Fleeing From A Place Of Epidemic And Plague Except When Staying Is Obligatory, Like For The Fighter And The Guard
arabicText: لوحتأ ،اهيف ناأو ةدلب يف عقي نوعاطلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ انباحصأ ضعب لأس لقا ،رمحلأا نباأ نع :لقا ؟اهنع لوحتأ اهيف ناأو رادلا يفف :لقا ،معن :لقا ؟اهنع لوحتأ اهيف ناأو ةيرقلا يفف :لقا معن :لقا ؟اهنع نإ :لقا فحزلا نم رارفلاك نوعاطلا نم رارفلا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ ثدحتن نافإ :تلق .معن نوعاطلا عقيف ودعلا وحن يف روغثلا يف نونوكي اوناك موق يف اذه :لقا امنإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر .مهيف كلذ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لاقف ،اهنم نورفي مهنكامأ نولخيف
englishText: From Aban Al-Ahmar, he said: Some of our companions asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about plague occurring in a town while I am in it, should I move from it? He said: Yes. He said: What about in a village while I am in it, should I move from it? He said: Yes. He said: What about in a house while I am in it, should I move from it? He said: Yes. I said: We narrate that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Fleeing from plague (*) is like fleeing from battle. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) only said this about people who were in frontier posts facing the enemy when plague struck and they abandoned their positions fleeing from it, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said this about them. Translator: * Ta'un (translated as plague) is metaphorically employed to convey the idea of a sudden, severe, and widespread problem that causes great harm or distress to people, such as a severe drought/famine or an economic crisis or a political/social upheaval or a moral/spiritual corruption.

chapter: Permissibility Of Fleeing From A Place Of Epidemic And Plague Except When Staying Is Obligatory, Like For The Fighter And The Guard
arabicText: لىع لومحم اذه لوقأ .هريغ ىلإ هنم اورفي نأ مهل سيلف دجسم لهأ يف نوعاطلا عقو اذإ هنأ يورو :لقا .دجسملبا صوصخم هنأ عم ةهاركلا
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that if plague occurs among the people of a mosque, they should not flee from it to another. I (Hurr Amili) say this is interpreted as disliked while being specific to the mosque.

chapter: Permissibility Of Fleeing From A Place Of Epidemic And Plague Except When Staying Is Obligatory, Like For The Fighter And The Guard
arabicText: حلصي له ضرلأا يف عقي ءباولا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم هيخأ نع ،هباتك يف رفعج نب ليع يذلا هدجسم لهأ يف عقو اذفإ ،هيف ليصي يذلا هدجسم يف عقي مل ام هنم برهي :لقا ؟هنم برهي نأ لجرلل .هنم برهلا هل حلصي لاف هيف ليصي
englishText: Ali bin Ja'far in his book, from his brother Musa (peace be upon him) said: I asked him about an epidemic occurring in a land, is it proper for a man to flee from it? He said: He may flee from it as long as it has not occurred among the people of his mosque where he prays. If it occurs among the people of his mosque where he prays, then it is not proper for him to flee from it.

chapter: Dislike Of Covering Up For The Feverish Person, Protecting Him From Cold, And The Recommendation Of Treating Fever With Supplication, Sugar, And Cold Water
arabicText: بوثو درابلا ءاملا يف بوث نباوث هل نوكيف درابلا ءاملبا ناعتسا كعو اذإ :ناك هنإ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .امهنيب حواري هدسج لىع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): When he had fever, he would seek help with cold water, having two garments- one in cold water and one on his body- alternating between them.

chapter: Dislike Of Covering Up For The Feverish Person, Protecting Him From Cold, And The Recommendation Of Treating Fever With Supplication, Sugar, And Cold Water
arabicText: :لقا ؟ءاود ىمحلل مكدنع متدجو ام كادف انلعج :هل تلق :لقا (ثيدح) يف (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ يبأ نع .درابلا ءاملاو ءاعدلا لاإ ءاود نادنع اهل نادجو ام
englishText: From Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) in a hadith, he said: I said to him: May we be sacrificed for you, have you found any medicine for fever? He said: We have not found any medicine for it except supplication and cold water.

chapter: Dislike Of Covering Up For The Feverish Person, Protecting Him From Cold, And The Recommendation Of Treating Fever With Supplication, Sugar, And Cold Water
arabicText: :تلقاو هل ةلاوم هيلع تلخدف مومحم وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ دنع تنك :لقا ريكب نب الله دبع نع .هيذخف لىع هحرط دق قلخ بوث هيلعو ؟هلاح نع هتلأسو ؟ةيسفن كتيدف كدجت فيك لوسر لقا !كيبن فلاخب مهتعلوأ مهللا :لاقف ،حيرلل كدسج تزربأ دقف قرعت ىتح ترثدت ول :هل تلاقف .درابلا ءاملبا اهؤفطفا منهج روف نم :لقا امبرو منهج حيف نم ىمحلا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: From Abdullah bin Bukair who said: I was with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) while he was feverish, and a female servant of his entered and said: How do you feel, may I be sacrificed for you? And she asked about his condition while he had an old garment thrown over his thighs. She said to him: If only you would cover up until you sweat, for you have exposed your body to the wind. He said: O Allah, they are obsessed with opposing Your Prophet! The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Fever is from the heat of Hell- or perhaps he said: from the boiling of Hell- so cool it with cold water.

chapter: Dislike Of Covering Up For The Feverish Person, Protecting Him From Cold, And The Recommendation Of Treating Fever With Supplication, Sugar, And Cold Water
arabicText: .درابلا ءاملبا اهؤفطفا منهج حيف نم ىمحلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Fever is from the heat of Hell, so cool it with cold water.

chapter: Dislike Of Covering Up For The Feverish Person, Protecting Him From Cold, And The Recommendation Of Treating Fever With Supplication, Sugar, And Cold Water
arabicText: .رخلآا هيلع حرط فج اذفإ امهدحأ هيلع حرطي نيبوث لب مح اذإ ناك هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): When he had fever, he would wet two garments and put one of them on himself, and when it dried, he would put on the other one.

chapter: Dislike Of Covering Up For The Feverish Person, Protecting Him From Cold, And The Recommendation Of Treating Fever With Supplication, Sugar, And Cold Water
arabicText: .ءاعدلاو درابلا ءاملا لثم ىمحلل نادجو ام :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :ملسم نب دمحم لقاو
englishText: And Muhammad bin Muslim said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: We have not found anything for fever like cold water and supplication.

chapter: Dislike Of Covering Up For The Feverish Person, Protecting Him From Cold, And The Recommendation Of Treating Fever With Supplication, Sugar, And Cold Water
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر نادج راتخا ام :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس :لقا ماحشلا ةماسأ يبأ نع .قيرلا لىع دربا ءامب ركس مهارد ةرشع نزو لاإ ىمحلل (هلآو هيلع
englishText: From Abu Usama Al-Shahham who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: Our grandfather, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), did not choose for fever except ten dirhams' weight of sugar with cold water on an empty stomach.

chapter: Recommendation Of Giving Charity For The Sick, Giving Charity On Their Behalf, And Raising The Voice With Adhan In The House
arabicText: .ةقدصلبا مكاضرم اوواد :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far from his forefathers (peace be upon them), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Treat your sick with sadaqah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Giving Charity For The Sick, Giving Charity On Their Behalf, And Raising The Voice With Adhan In The House
arabicText: .ةقدصلبا مكاضرم اووادف مربملا ءلابلا عفدت ةقدصلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) هنعو
englishText: From him (peace be upon him) who said: Sadaqah repels destined calamity, so treat your sick ones with sadaqah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Giving Charity For The Sick, Giving Charity On Their Behalf, And Raising The Voice With Adhan In The House
arabicText: .اهبحاص نع ءوسلا ةتيم عفدت ةقدصلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) هنعو
englishText: And from him (peace be upon him), he said: Sadaqah repels an evil death from its giver.

chapter: Recommendation Of Giving Charity For The Sick, Giving Charity On Their Behalf, And Raising The Voice With Adhan In The House
arabicText: هل لاقف ،ضيرم مهلك لايعلا نم رفن ةرشع يف يننا ،هيلإ كىش لاجر نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نعو نم ضيرملل ةعفنم ىدجأ لاو ،ةقدصلا نم ةباجإ عرسأ ئش سيلف ةقدصلبا مهواد :(ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم .ةقدصلا
englishText: And from Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) that a man complained to him saying: I have ten family members and all of them are sick. So Musa (peace be upon him) said to him: Treat them with sadaqah (Sadqah), for nothing is quicker in response than sadaqah, and nothing is more beneficial for the sick than sadaqah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes After It, And Preparing For It
arabicText: ناسنإ رثكي مل هنفإ توملا ركذ رثكأ !ةديبع باأ يا :لاقف ،هب عفتنأ امب ينثدح (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق .ايندلا يف دهز لاإ توملا ركذ
englishText: Abu Ubaydah said: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Tell me something that I can benefit from. He said: O Abu Ubaydah! Remember death frequently, for no person increases in remembering death except that they become disinterested in this worldly life.

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes After It, And Preparing For It
arabicText: توملا ركذ رثكأ نم :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ - ثيدح - يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .الله هبحأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever frequently remembers death, Allah will love him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes After It, And Preparing For It
arabicText: كلاصوأ عطقت ركذا !دمحم باأ يا لاقف ،ساوسولا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ ىلإ توكش :لقا ريصب يبأ نع نفإ كمحل دودلا لكأو كيرخنم نم ءاملا تانب جورخو كترفح يف كونفد اذإ كنع كئابحأ عوجرو كربق يف .ايندلا مه نم هيف ناأ ام ينع لىس لاإ هتركذ ام اللهوف :ريصب وبأ لقا ،هيف تنأ ام كنع ليسي كلذ
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: I complained to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about waswaas (obsessive thoughts), so he said: O Abu Muhammad! Remember your joints being separated in your grave, your loved ones leaving you when they bury you in your pit, water worms coming out of your nostrils, and worms eating your flesh, for that will console you from what you are experiencing. Abu Basir said: By Allah, I did not remember it except that it consoled me from whatever worldly concerns I was experiencing. Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes Afte...

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes After It, And Preparing For It
arabicText: - توملا نم دبلاو لاأ !توملا توملا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع اذإو ،رهظلا ءارو لملاا بهذو نينيعلا نيب لجلأا ءاج ةداعسلاو الله ةيلاو تقحتسا اذإ :لقاو - :لقا نأ ىلإ لوسر لئسو :لقا ،رهظلا ءارو لجلأا بهذو نينيعلا نيب لملاا ءاج ةواقشلاو ناطيشلا ةيلاو تقحتسا .ادادعتسا هل مهدشأو توملل اركذ مهرثكأ لاقف ؟سيكأ نينمؤملا يأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Death, death! Indeed there is no escape from death then he said: When one deserves the Wilayah (guardianship) of Allah and happiness, death comes before one's eyes and hope goes behind one's back, and when one deserves the Wilayah of Satan and misery, hope comes before one's eyes and death goes behind one's back. He said: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was asked: Which of the believers is the most intelligent? He said: The one who remembers death the most and prepares for it the most.

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes After It, And Preparing For It
arabicText: .تاذللا مداه ركذ نم اورثكأ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،اضرلا نع
englishText: From Al-Ridha, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Increase in remembering the destroyer of pleasures.

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes After It, And Preparing For It
arabicText: هدلو لىع هعزج دتشا دق لاجر ىأر هنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) قداصلا نع ،هئباآ نع ،يركسعلا ليع نب نسحلا نع امل ادعتسم كدلو هيلإ راص امل تنك ول ،ىربكلا ةبيصملا نم تلفغو ىرغصلا ةبيصملل تعزج اذه يا :لاقف .كدلوب كباصم نم مظعأ دادعتسلاا ككرتب كباصمف ،كعزج هيلع دتشا
englishText: From Al-Hasan bin Ali Al-Askari, from his fathers, from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon them) that he saw a man who was intensely grieving over his son, so he said: O you, you grieve over the minor calamity while being heedless of the major calamity. If you had been prepared for what your son has gone to, your grief would not have been so intense. Thus your calamity due to your lack of preparation is greater than your calamity regarding your son.

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes After It, And Preparing For It
arabicText: اذفإ :لقا ،اللهو لىب :تلق ؟ملتأ امأ ؟متهت امأ ؟نزحت امأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا يل لقا :لقا ريصب يبأ نع نم دودلا لكأو ،كلاصوأ عطقتو ،كيدخ لىع كينيع نلايسو ،كربق يف كتدحوو ،توملا ركذفا كنم كلذ ناك .ايندلا لىع صرحلا نم ريثك نع كعدريو لمعلا لىع كثحي كلذ نفإ ،ايندلا نع كعاطقناو كلابو ،كمحل
englishText: From Abu Basir who said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said to me: Do you not feel sadness? Do you not worry? Do you not feel pain? I said: Yes, by Allah. He said: When you experience that, then remember death, and your solitude in your grave, and your eyes flowing over your cheeks, and your joints decomposing, and the worms eating your flesh, and your decay, and your separation from the world, for that will motivate you towards good deeds and deter you from excessive worldly greed.

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes After It, And Preparing For It
arabicText: اركذ دشأ ناك نم سانلا سيكأ :لقا هنأ نيعمجأ مهيلع الله تاولص الله لوسر نع هئباآ نع ،قداصلا نع .توملل
englishText: From Al-Sadiq, from his forefathers, from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon them all, that he said: The most intelligent among people is the one who remembers death the most.

chapter: Recommendation Of Frequent Remembrance Of Death And What Comes After It, And Preparing For It
arabicText: هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ باتك) يف ءوضولا ةيفيك يف مدقت دانسإب (هسلاجم) يف يسوطلا دمحم نب نسحلا نم مكسفنأ (هيلإ) مكعزانت امدنع توملا ركذ اورثكأو :لقا رصم لهأو ركب يبأ نب دمحم ىلإ (ملاسلا توملا ركذب هباحصأ يصوي ام اريثك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ناكو ،اظعاو توملبا ىفكو ،تاوهشلا .تاوهشلا نيبو مكنيب لئاح ،تاذللا مداه هنفإ توملا ركذ اورثكأ :لوقيف
englishText: Al-Hasan bin Muhammad Al-Tusi in (his Majalis) with a chain of narration that preceded in the description of ablution in (the book of Amir Al-Mu'mineen (peace be upon him) to Muhammad bin Abi Bakr and the people of Egypt) said: And increase the remembrance of death when your souls are drawn to desires, and death is sufficient as a preacher, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would often advise his companions to remember death, saying: Increase the remembrance of death for it is the destroyer of pleasures and a barrier between you and desires.

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: ادغ دع نم هتلزنم قح توملا لزنأ ام (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ىأر ول :لوقي ناكو :لقا ،لمعلا ءاسأ لاإ لملاا دبع لاطأ ام (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقاو :لقا ،هلجأ نم .ايندلا بلط نم لمعلا ضغبلأ هيلإ هتعرسو هلجأ دبعلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: One who counts tomorrow as part of his life has not given death its proper due. He said: And Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: No servant extends his hopes except that his deeds worsen. He said: And he used to say: If a servant were to see his death and how quickly it approaches him, he would hate seeking worldly pursuits.

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: .توملا ةبحص ءاسأ دقف هلجأ نم ادغ دع نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn reported that he (peace be upon him) said: Whoever counts tomorrow as part of their lifespan has misunderstood (*) their companionship with death. Translator: * We should live with awareness of death's inevitability and being overconfident about having more time is a form of heedlessness.

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اهيبأ نع ،نيسحلا تنب ةمطفا همأ نع ليع نب .لملأاو حشلبا اهرخآ كلاهو ،نيقيلاو دهزلبا ةملأا هذه لوأ حلاص
englishText: From Fatima bint Al-Husayn, from her father (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed, the righteousness of the early members of this ummah (nation/community) was through asceticism (zuhd) and certainty (yaqeen), and the destruction of its later members will be through greed (stinginess) and false hopes/desires.

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: .هلمع ءاسأ هلمأ لاطأ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع ،(ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from Ali (peace be upon him) who said: Whoever extends his hopes will worsen his deeds.

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: نع دصي هنفإ ىوهلا امأ ،لملاا لوطو ىوهلا يتمأ لىع فاخأ ام فوخأ نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .ةرخلآا ىسنيف لملاا لوط امأو ،قحلا
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed what I fear most for my nation is desire and lengthy hope. As for desire, it prevents from the truth, and as for lengthy hope, it causes one to forget the Hereafter.

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: ىوهلا عابتا :ناتلصخ مكيلع فاخي ام فوخأ نإ لاأ :لقا - ثيدح - يف (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع .ةرخلآا يسني لملاا لوطو ،قحلا نع دصيف ىوهلا عابتا امأ لملاا لوطو
englishText: From Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) in a hadith, he said: Indeed, the most fearful things I fear for you are two traits: following desires and having long hopes. As for following desires, it prevents from the truth, and having long hopes makes one forget the Hereafter.

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: نانع يف ىرج نم :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع (ةغلابلا جهن) يف يضرلا نيسحلا نب دمحم .هلجبأ رثع هلمأ
englishText: Muhammad bin Al-Husayn Al-Radi in (Nahj Al-Balagha) from Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) that he said: Whoever runs in pursuit of his hopes will stumble upon his death.

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: !؟ىقتلملا عرسأ امف لابقإ يف توملاو ربادإ يف تنك اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو
englishText: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) said: When you are in retreat while death is advancing, how swift is the meeting!

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: .لمعلا ءاسأ لملاا لاطأ نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: Whoever extends his hopes will do evil deeds. Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life

chapter: Dislike Of Long Hopes And Counting Tomorrow As Part Of One's Life
arabicText: .هرورغو لملاا ضغبلأ هريصمو لجلأا دبعلا ىأر ول :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: If the servant were to see their appointed time and destiny, they would hate hope and its deception.

chapter: Dislike Of Saying "Allah Has Taken So-and-So For Himself" And The Permissibility Of Saying "So-and-So Is Giving Up His Soul"
arabicText: دوجي نلاف :ليقف ،هوركم اذ :لاقف ،!نلافبللا رثأتسا :لوقي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس الله باوث نم ىري امل اهب دوجي نيح كاذف ؟ثالاث وأ نيترم هتوم دنع هفا حتفي هارت امأ ،سبأ لا :لاقف ،هسفنب .انينض اهب ناك دقو لجو زع
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about a person saying "Allah has taken so-and-so for Himself!" He said: This is disliked. Then he was asked about saying "So and-so is giving up his soul," to which he replied: There is no problem with that. Do you not see how he opens his mouth two or three times at death? That is when he is giving it (the soul) up when he sees the reward from Allah the Mighty and Majestic, though he had been attached to it.

chapter: Impermissibility Of One Saying To Another "May My Father And Mother Be Sacrificed For You" While They Are Living Believers, Except After Their Death
arabicText: وأ هنبلا لوقي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج نب ىسوم نسحلا وبأ لئس لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم نإو قاوقع كلذ ىرفأ نييح نينمؤم هاوبأ ناك نإ :لاقف ؟اسبا كلذب ىرتأ ،تنأ يوببأ وأ ،يمأو تنأ يببأ :هتنبلا .سبأ لاف تاام دق ناك
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: Abu Al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) was asked about a man saying to his son or daughter: "May my father and mother be sacrificed for you" or "May my parents be sacrificed for you"- would that be problematic? He said: If his parents are living believers, I consider that to be disobedience, but if they have died then there is no problem.

chapter: Impermissibility Of One Saying To Another "May My Father And Mother Be Sacrificed For You" While They Are Living Believers, Except After Their Death
arabicText: .هدعب نم هفلخ ىري ىتح تمي مل ءرما دعس :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج لقاو دازو
englishText: He added that Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Fortunate is the person who does not die until he sees his successor after him.

chapter: Recommendation For The Bereaved To Remove His Shoes And Cloak, And To Be In A Shirt, And The Disapproval Of Removing The Cloak For Someone Else's Misfortune
arabicText: .فرعي ىتح صيمق يف نوكي نأو اءادر سبلي لا نأ ةزانجلا بحاصل يغبني :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: The person (*) accompanying the funeral procession should not wear a cloak, and should be in a shirt so that he can be recognized. Translator: * The bereaved person - the one who has experienced the death of his relative.

chapter: Recommendation For The Bereaved To Remove His Shoes And Cloak, And To Be In A Shirt, And The Disapproval Of Removing The Cloak For Someone Else's Misfortune
arabicText: .هريغ ةبيصم يف هئادر عضو نم نوعلم نوعلم :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو :لقا
englishText: He said: And he (peace be upon him) said: Cursed, cursed is the one who removes his cloak for someone else's misfortune.

chapter: Recommendation For The Bereaved To Remove His Shoes And Cloak, And To Be In A Shirt, And The Disapproval Of Removing The Cloak For Someone Else's Misfortune
arabicText: .ءادر لاو ءاذح لاب ريرسلا مدقتف (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا جرخ ليعامسإ تام املو :لقا
englishText: He said: And when Isma'il died, Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) went out and walked in front of the bier without shoes or cloak.

chapter: Recommendation For The Bereaved To Remove His Shoes And Cloak, And To Be In A Shirt, And The Disapproval Of Removing The Cloak For Someone Else's Misfortune
arabicText: ؟كلذ نع لئسف الله همحر ذاعم نب دعس ةزانج يف هئادر (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر عضوو :لقا .يئادر تعضوف اهتيدرأ تعضو دق ةكئلاملا تيأر ينإ :لاقف
englishText: He said: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) removed his cloak at the funeral of Sa'd bin Mu'adh, may Allah have mercy on him, and he was asked about that? He said: I saw the angels had removed their cloaks, so I removed my cloak. Recommendation For The Bereaved To Remove His Shoes And Cloak, And ...

chapter: Recommendation For The Bereaved To Remove His Shoes And Cloak, And To Be In A Shirt, And The Disapproval Of Removing The Cloak For Someone Else's Misfortune
arabicText: ذاعم نب دعس لسغب رمأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهب تيسأتف ءاذح لاو ءادر لاب تناك ةكئلاملا نإ :لاقف كلذ نع لئسف ءادر لاو ءاذح لاب هعبت مث تام نيح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ordered the washing of Sa'd bin Mu'adh when he died, then followed him without shoes or cloak, and was asked about that. He said: The angels were without cloak or shoes, so I followed their example.

chapter: Recommendation For The Bereaved To Remove His Shoes And Cloak, And To Be In A Shirt, And The Disapproval Of Removing The Cloak For Someone Else's Misfortune
arabicText: مهيأ يردأ ام ةثلاث :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع .ءادر ريغب ةزانجلا عم ىشمي يذلا :مهنم (امرج) ارجأ مظعأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There are three things, I don't know which of them has greater reward (crime): the one who walks with the funeral without a cloak.

chapter: Recommendation For The Bereaved To Remove His Shoes And Cloak, And To Be In A Shirt, And The Disapproval Of Removing The Cloak For Someone Else's Misfortune
arabicText: لاو ءاذح لاب ريرسلا مدقتف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ جرخ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نب ليعامسإ تام امل .ءادر
englishText: When Isma'il bin Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) died, Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) went out and walked in front of the bier without shoes or cloak.

chapter: Recommendation For The Bereaved To Remove His Shoes And Cloak, And To Be In A Shirt, And The Disapproval Of Removing The Cloak For Someone Else's Misfortune
arabicText: بحاص هنأ سانلا ملعي ىتح هئادر عضي نأ ةبيصملا بحاصل يغبني :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةبيصملا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The person who has been afflicted with a calamity should place his cloak [differently] so that people know he is the one afflicted with the calamity.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity, Doing Good Deeds, Freeing Slaves On Behalf Of The Deceased, And Making Supplication And Seeking Mercy For Them, And The Permissibility Of Partnering Between Two People In Two Rak'ahs And In Hajj
arabicText: هيلع الله عسويف قيض يف نوكيل هنأ ىتح معن :لاقف ؟تيملا نع ليصن (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق نيب كرشفا :تلقف :لقا ،كنع كيخأ نلاف ةلاصب قيضلا اذه كنع ففخ :هل لاقيف ىتؤي مث ،قيضلا كلذ .معن :لقا ؟نيتعكر يف نيلجر
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Can we pray on behalf of the deceased? He said: Yes, to the extent that if the deceased is in hardship, Allah will ease that hardship for them. Then they will be told: This hardship has been lightened from you due to the prayer of your brother on your behalf. I then asked: Can I partner between two people (*) in two rak'ahs? He said: Yes. Translator: * Meaning can I offer a prayer on behalf of two deceased individuals thereby combining the reward for both of them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity, Doing Good Deeds, Freeing Slaves On Behalf Of The Deceased, And Making Supplication And Seeking Mercy For Them, And The Permissibility Of Partnering Between Two People In Two Rak'ahs And In Hajj
arabicText: .هيلإ ىدهت ةيدهلبا حيلا حرفي امك هل رافغتسلااو هيلع محرتلبا حرفيل تيملا نإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو
englishText: And he (peace be upon him) said: Indeed the deceased rejoices when mercy and forgiveness are sought for them just as a living person rejoices when given a gift.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity, Doing Good Deeds, Freeing Slaves On Behalf Of The Deceased, And Making Supplication And Seeking Mercy For Them, And The Permissibility Of Partnering Between Two People In Two Rak'ahs And In Hajj
arabicText: هرجأ بتكيو ءاعدلاو ربلاو ةقدصلاو جحلاو موصلاو ةلاصلا هربق يف تيملا لىع لخدي :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو .تيمللو هلعفي يذلل
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: The deceased receives in their grave the prayers, fasting, hajj, sadaqah, righteousness and supplications, and the reward is written for both the one who performs it and for the deceased. Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity...

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity, Doing Good Deeds, Freeing Slaves On Behalf Of The Deceased, And Making Supplication And Seeking Mercy For Them, And The Permissibility Of Partnering Between Two People In Two Rak'ahs And In Hajj
arabicText: .تيملا هب الله عفنو حرجأ هل الله فعضأ احلاص لامع تيم نع نيملسملا نم لمع نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: Whoever among the Muslims performs a righteous deed on behalf of a deceased person, Allah will multiply their reward and benefit the deceased with it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity, Doing Good Deeds, Freeing Slaves On Behalf Of The Deceased, And Making Supplication And Seeking Mercy For Them, And The Permissibility Of Partnering Between Two People In Two Rak'ahs And In Hajj
arabicText: موصيو امهنع قدصتيو امهنع ليصي ،!؟نيتيمو نييح هيدلاو ربي نأ مكدحأ عنمي ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا .اريثك اريخ هربب الله هديزيف كلذ لثم هلو امهل عنص يذلا نوكيف امهنع .يتيأ امل ةريازلاو فاوطلا ةلاص وحن لىع وأ ،غارفلا دعب موصلاو ةلاصلا باوث ءادهإ لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: What prevents any of you from being dutiful to your parents while they are alive and after death?! One can pray for them, give sadaqah on their behalf, and fast for them. What they have done for them will be rewarded equally, and Allah will increase them abundantly in goodness for their dutifulness. I (Hurr Amili) say: This is interpreted as gifting the reward of prayer and fasting after completing them, or like the prayer of tawaf and ziyarah as will be explained later.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity, Doing Good Deeds, Freeing Slaves On Behalf Of The Deceased, And Making Supplication And Seeking Mercy For Them, And The Permissibility Of Partnering Between Two People In Two Rak'ahs And In Hajj
arabicText: هل نوكيف هتوم دعب اهب لمعي اهنس ةنس :لاقف ؟هتوم دعب لجرلا قحلي ام (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق بيطلا دلولاو ،هدعب نم يرجت ةيراجلا ةقدصلاو ،ئش مهروجأ نم صقتني نأ ريغ نم ،اهب لمعي نم رجأ لثم ؟يتجح يف امهكرشا :تلقف ،امهنع موصيو ليصيو امهنع قتعيو قدصتيو جحيو امهتوم دعب هيدلاول وعدي .معن :لقا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What reaches a man after his death? He said: A practice he established that is followed after his death, so he gets reward equal to those who practice it without diminishing anything from their rewards, and ongoing sadaqah that continues after him, and a righteous child who supplicates for his parents after their death, performs hajj, gives sadaqah, frees slaves, prays and fasts on their behalf. I said: Should I include them in my hajj? He said: Yes.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity, Doing Good Deeds, Freeing Slaves On Behalf Of The Deceased, And Making Supplication And Seeking Mercy For Them, And The Permissibility Of Partnering Between Two People In Two Rak'ahs And In Hajj
arabicText: تلق ،نيتعكر موي لك يف هيدلاو نعو ،نيتعكر ةليل لك يف هدلو نع ليصي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ناك ةليل يف هانلزنأ ناإ :امهيف ءرقي ناكو :لقا ،دلولل شارفلا نلا :لقا ؟ليللا دلولل راص فيك كادف تلعج :هل .رثوكلا كانيطعأ ناإو ،ردقلا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) used to pray two rak'ahs every night for his child, and two rak'ahs every day for his parents. I said to him: May I be sacrificed for you, how did the night become for the child? He said: Because the bed is for the child. He said: And he would recite in them: Verily We have revealed it (the Quran) in the Night of Power [Quran, 97:1] and Verily We have given you Al-Kawthar [Quran,

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity, Doing Good Deeds, Freeing Slaves On Behalf Of The Deceased, And Making Supplication And Seeking Mercy For Them, And The Permissibility Of Partnering Between Two People In Two Rak'ahs And In Hajj
arabicText: هنع ةقدصلاو هنع جحلا هقحلي :لقا ؟هتوم دعب لجرلا قحلي ئش يأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .هنع موصلاو
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): What things reach a man after his death? He said: Hajj performed on his behalf, sadaqah given on his behalf, and fasting done on his behalf reach him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Praying, Fasting, Performing Hajj, Giving Charity, Doing Good Deeds, Freeing Slaves On Behalf Of The Deceased, And Making Supplication And Seeking Mercy For Them, And The Permissibility Of Partnering Between Two People In Two Rak'ahs And In Hajj
arabicText: لمحي نأ ليئربج الله رمأ تيملا ةينب لجرلا قدصت اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا :لقا هباتك يف سارف يبأ نب مارو هذه ،الله يلو يا كيلع ملاسلا :نولوقيو ،هربق ىلإ نولمحيف قبط كلم لك دي يف ،كلم فلأ نيعبس هربق ىلإ ،ةلح فلأ هسبلأو ،ءاروح فلأ هجوزو ،ةنجلا يف ةنيدم فلأ الله هاطعأو هربق لألأتيف كيلإ نلاف نب نلاف ةيده .ةجاح فلأ هل ىضقو
englishText: Warram ibn Abi Firas reported in his book that he (peace be upon him) said: When a person gives sadaqah with the intention of a deceased person, Allah commands Gabriel to carry seventy thousand angels to his grave, with each angel carrying a plate. They carry these to his grave and say: Peace be upon you, O friend of Allah, this is a gift from so-and-so to you. Then his grave illuminates, and Allah grants him a thousand cities in Paradise, marries him to a thousand houris, clothes him with a thousand garments, and fulfills a thousand of his needs. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And there will be mentioned later what indicates that regarding making up missed prayers, Hajj, endowments, and other things.

chapter: Obligation Of Will Upon Those Who Have Rights Or Debts, And Its Recommendation For Others
arabicText: ،ةيصولل هلقعو هعمسو هرصب نم هيلع الله در لاإ ةفاولا هرضحت تيم نم ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .ملسم لك لىع قح يهف ،توملا ةحار :اهل لاقي يتلا ةحارلا يهو ،كرت وأ ةيصولا ذخأ
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: There is no dying person who is approached by death except that Allah returns to him his sight, hearing, and intellect for making a will, whether he makes the will or not, and this is the comfort that is called: the comfort of death, and it is a right upon every Muslim.

chapter: Obligation Of Will Upon Those Who Have Rights Or Debts, And Its Recommendation For Others
arabicText: نأ نمؤملل يغبنيف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىصوأ دقو قح ةيصولا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا .يصوي
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Making a will is a right, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) made a will, so it is befitting for a believer to make a will.

chapter: Obligation Of Will Upon Those Who Have Rights Or Debts, And Its Recommendation For Others
arabicText: .ملسم لك لىع قح يه :لاقف ؟ةيصولا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع حابصلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Sabbah from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about making a will? He said: It is a right upon every Muslim.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making A Will With Some Wealth For Acts Of Righteousness, Goodness, Endowment, And Charity, And The Recommendation Of Doing Good After Recovery
arabicText: كيلع ترتس ةثلاثب كيلع تلوطت !مدآ نبا :لوقي ىلاعتو كرابت الله نإ :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ةمئلأا ضعب نع كتوم دنع ةرظن كل تلعجو ،اريخ مدقت ملف كنم تضرقتسفا كيلع تعسوأو ،كوراو ام كلهأ هب ملعي ول ام .اريخ مدقت ملف كثلث يف
englishText: From some Imams (peace be upon them) who said: Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, says: O son of Adam! I have bestowed upon you three favors- I concealed what if your family knew, they would not have buried you; I gave you abundance and sought a loan from you but you did not send forth any good; and I gave you consideration at your death regarding your third but you did not send forth any good.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making A Will With Some Wealth For Acts Of Righteousness, Goodness, Endowment, And Charity, And The Recommendation Of Doing Good After Recovery
arabicText: يف هب قدصت نمك ناك راضي ملو فحي ملف ىصوأ نم (ملاسلا هيلع) لىع لقا :لقا ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .هتايح
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, who said: Ali (peace be upon him) said: Whoever makes a will without being unfair or causing harm is like one who gave sadaqah during his lifetime.

chapter: Recommendation Of Making A Will With Some Wealth For Acts Of Righteousness, Goodness, Endowment, And Charity, And The Recommendation Of Doing Good After Recovery
arabicText: ،هسرغي سرغو ،هفلخي فحصمو ،هل رفغتسي دلو :هتفاو دعب نمؤملا نقحلي ةتس :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو :لقا .هدعب نم اهب ذخؤي ةنسو ،اهيرجي ةقدصو ،اهرفحي رئبو
englishText: He said: And he (peace be upon him) said: Six things continue to benefit the believer after his death: a child who seeks forgiveness for him, a Quran he leaves behind, trees he plants, a well he digs, ongoing sadaqah he establishes, and a tradition that is followed after him. Recommendation Of Making A Will With Some Wealth For Acts Of Righte...

chapter: Recommendation Of Making A Will With Some Wealth For Acts Of Righteousness, Goodness, Endowment, And Charity, And The Recommendation Of Doing Good After Recovery
arabicText: تيقل ءوس نع فكي ملو اريخ ثدحي ملف يفوع مث دبعلا كىتشا اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم نب رفعج نع .ءاودلا هعفني ملف هانيواد نالاف نإ :تلاقف - هتظفح ىنعي - اضعب اهضعب ةكئلاملا
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said: When a servant falls ill then recovers but does not do any good or refrain from evil, the angels- meaning his guardians- meet each other and say: Indeed we treated so-and-so but the treatment did not benefit him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having Good Thoughts About Allah At Death
arabicText: هدصقف ،ليلع :ليقف ؟هسلجم لهأ ضعب نع (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لأس :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع .نسحف للهبا ينظ امأ :لاقف ،للهبا كنظ نسحأ :هل لاقف ،افند هدجوف هسأر دنع سلجو ادئاع
englishText: From his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) asked about some people in his gathering? It was said: He is sick, so he went to visit him and sat by his head and found him severely ill, so he said to him: Have good thoughts about Allah. He replied: As for my thoughts about Allah, they are good.

chapter: Recommendation Of Having Good Thoughts About Allah At Death
arabicText: للهبا نظلا نسح نفإ لجو زع للهبا هنظ نسحي ىتح مكدحأ نتومي لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .ةنجلا نمث
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: None of you should die except while having good thoughts about Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, for having good thoughts about Allah is the price of Paradise.

chapter: Dislike Of A Person Wishing For Death For Themselves Even If Harm Befalls Them, And The Impermissibility Of Wishing Death For A Muslim Or A Child, Even Daughters
arabicText: وهو هدوعي لجر لىع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لخد :تلقا لضفلا مأ نع يشرقلا ثراحلا تنب دنه نع ،نااسحإ دادزت انسحم كت نإ كنفإ توملا نمتت لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لاقف توملا ىنمتف كاش .توملا اونمتت لاف بتعتست رخؤتف ائيسم كت نإو
englishText: From Hind bint Al-Harith Al-Qurashi from Umm Al-Fadhl who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) visited a sick man who was wishing for death. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Do not wish for death, for if you are doing good, you will increase in goodness, and if you are doing wrong, you will have time to make amends, so do not wish for death.

chapter: Dislike Of A Person Wishing For Death For Themselves Even If Harm Befalls Them, And The Impermissibility Of Wishing Death For A Muslim Or A Child, Even Daughters
arabicText: ،هب لزن رضل توملا مكدحأ ىنمتي لا :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نع (ىهتنملا) يف ةملاعلا ىورو .يل اريخ ةفاولا تناك اذإ ينفوتو ،يل اريخ ةايحلا تناك ام ينيحأ مهللا :لقيلو
englishText: Al-Allama narrated in (Al-Muntaha) from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said: None of you should wish for death due to harm that has befallen him, but should say: O Allah, keep me alive as long as life is better for me, and take my soul when death is better for me.

chapter: Dislike Of A Person Wishing For Death For Themselves Even If Harm Befalls Them, And The Impermissibility Of Wishing Death For A Muslim Or A Child, Even Daughters
arabicText: :لقاو هيدي عفر رابغلاو قرعلا هباصأ دقو عماجلا نم ةعمجلا موي عجر اذإ ناك هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع .ضبق نأ ىلإ باوركم امومغم لزي ملو ،ةعاسلا يل هلجعف توملبا هيفنأ امم جيرف ناك نإ مهللا
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) that when he would return on Friday from the mosque, having been affected by sweat and dust, he would raise his hands and say: O Allah, if my relief is in death, then hasten it for me this hour. And he remained sorrowful and distressed until he passed away.

chapter: Dislike Of Pretending To Be Sick Without Illness And Being Unkempt Without Calamity
arabicText: !؟سانلا نم مهلك قلخلا اذه ىرتأ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ ليق هنأ هركذ نمع يطساولا نسحلا يبأ نع ملع لا اميف يرامملاو ،هينعي لا اميف لخادلاو ،قيضلا عضوملا يف عبرتملاو ،كاوسلل كراتلا مهنم قلأ :لاقف .ةبيصم ريغ نم ثعشتملاو ،ةلع ريغ نم ضرمتملاو ،هب هل
englishText: From Abu al-Hasan al-Wasiti from whoever mentioned it that it was said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Do you see all these creatures as people?! He said: Exclude from them the one who abandons using the siwak (toothstick), the one who sits cross-legged in a tight space, the one who interferes in what does not concern him, the one who argues about what he has no knowledge of, the one who pretends to be sick without having an illness, and the one who appears unkempt (or disheveled) without having faced a calamity.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To The Funeral And Delaying For Wedding And Banquet, And Preferring The Funeral When There Is A Conflict
arabicText: لئس (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع ةطساوب ،دياز يبأ نب ليعامسإ نع ،ةرخلآا ركذت اهنفإ ةزانجلا بيجي :لقا ؟بيجي امهيأو ؟لضفأ امهيفأ ةزانج ىلإو ةميلو ىلإ ىعدي لجر نع .ايندلا ركذت اهنفإ ةميلولا عديلو
englishText: From Isma'il bin Abi Ziyad, through a chain from Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both) that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about a man who is invited to a banquet and to a funeral, which is better? And which should he respond to? He said: He should respond to the funeral for it reminds of the hereafter, and leave the banquet for it reminds of the worldly life.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To The Funeral And Delaying For Wedding And Banquet, And Preferring The Funeral When There Is A Conflict
arabicText: .اؤطبفا سئارعلا ىلإ متيعد اذإو ،اوعرسفا ةزانجلا ىلإ متيعد اذإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: When you are invited to a funeral, hasten to it, and when you are invited to weddings, delay.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening To The Funeral And Delaying For Wedding And Banquet, And Preferring The Funeral When There Is A Conflict
arabicText: اهنفإ اؤطبفا تاسرعلا ىلإ متيعد اذإ :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا نأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع رفعج نع .ةرخلآا ركذت اهنفإ اوعرسفا زئانجلا ىلإ متيعد اذإو ،ايندلا ركذت
englishText: From Ja'far from his father (peace be upon them both) that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: When you are invited to weddings, delay for they remind of the worldly life, and when you are invited to funerals, hasten for they remind of the hereafter.

chapter: Obligation Of Directing The Dying Person Towards The Qibla By Positioning Their Face And The Soles Of Their Feet Towards It
arabicText: هلعجت لا ،ةلبقلا ههجوب لبقتسفا ةلبقلل تيملا تهجو اذإو :لقا (ثيدح) يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع كلذب ينربخأ ،ضارتعلابا رميأ ريصب وبأ ناك دقو ،كلذ نولعفي انباحصأ تيأر ينفإ ،سانلا لعجي امك اضرتعم .هلجعو هزاهج يف ذخف تيملا تام اذفإ ،ةزمح يبأ نب ليع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith, he said: When you direct the deceased towards the qibla, face them towards the qibla, do not place them crosswise as people do, for I saw our companions doing that, and Abu Basir used to order placing crosswise, Ali bin Abi Hamza informed me of that. When the person dies, proceed with their preparation and hasten it.

chapter: Obligation Of Directing The Dying Person Towards The Qibla By Positioning Their Face And The Soles Of Their Feet Towards It
arabicText: رفحي لسغ اذإ كلذكو ،ةلبقلا هاجت هوجسف تيم مكدحلأ تام اذإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .ةلبقلا ىلإ ههجوو هيمدق نطبا لبقتسم نوكيف ةلبقلا هاجت لستغملا عضوم هل
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When someone among you has a deceased, lay them facing the qibla, and likewise when washing them, dig the washing place facing the qibla so that the soles of their feet and face are towards the qibla.

chapter: Obligation Of Directing The Dying Person Towards The Qibla By Positioning Their Face And The Soles Of Their Feet Towards It
arabicText: .ةلبقلا ليي امم هيمدق لعجتو ةلبقلا ههجوب لبقتست :لقا تيملا هيجوت يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding directing the deceased, he said: Face them towards the qibla and place their feet towards the qibla.

chapter: Obligation Of Directing The Dying Person Towards The Qibla By Positioning Their Face And The Soles Of Their Feet Towards It
arabicText: .ةلبقلا هيمدق نطابب لبقتسا :لاقف تيملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the deceased, and he said: Face the soles of their feet towards the qibla. Obligation Of Directing The Dying Person Towards The Qibla By Posit...

chapter: Obligation Of Directing The Dying Person Towards The Qibla By Positioning Their Face And The Soles Of Their Feet Towards It
arabicText: .ةلبقلا هيمدق نطابب لبقتسا لاقف تيملا هيجوت نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he was asked about directing the deceased, and he said: Face the soles of their feet towards the qibla.

chapter: Obligation Of Directing The Dying Person Towards The Qibla By Positioning Their Face And The Soles Of Their Feet Towards It
arabicText: وهو بلطملا دبع دلو نم لجر لىع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لخد :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا لبقأو ،ةكئلاملا هيلع تلبقأ كلذ متلعف اذإ مكنفإ ةلبقلا ىلإ هوهجو لاقف ،ةلبقلا ريغب هجو دقو قوسلا يف .ضبقي ىتح كلذك لزي ملف ،ههجوب هيلع لجو زع الله
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered upon a man from the children of Abdul Muttalib who was in the market and had been directed away from the qibla, so he said: Direct him towards the qibla, for when you do that, the angels face him, and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, faces him with His face, and he remains like that until he passes away.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: لا هدحو الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ ةداهش هنقلف تومي نأ لبق تيملا ترضح اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هلوسرو هدبع ادمحم نأو هل كيرش
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When you are present with a dying person before their death, instruct them to testify that there is no god but Allah, alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: مكتاوم نونقلت مكنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،يرتخبلا نب صفحو ،(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر دمحم ناتاوم نقلن نحنو ،الله لاإ هلإ لا توملا دنع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), and Hafs bin Al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: You instruct your dying ones at death to say "La ilaha illa Allah", and we instruct our dying ones to say "Muhammadun rasul Allah" (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: يف هككشيو رفكلبا هرميأ نم هنيطايش نم سيلبإ هب لكو لاإ توملا هرضحي دحأ نم ام :لقا الله دبع يبأ نع ،الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ ةداهش مهونقلف مكتاوم مترضح اذفإ ،هيلع ردقي مل انمؤم ناك نمف ،هسفن جرخي ىتح هنيد .اوتومي ىتح (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ادمحم نأو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah who said: There is no one at the time of death except that Iblis assigns one of his devils to command them to disbelief and make them doubt their religion until they die. But if they are believers, he has no power over them. So when you are present with your dying ones, instruct them to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) until they die. Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimo...

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: دنع تارم سمخ موي لك يف سانلا حفصتي توملا كلم نأ - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لوسر ادمحم نأو ،الله لاإ هلإ لا نأ ةداهش هنقل اهتيقاوم دنع اهيلع بظاوي نمم ناك نفإ ،ةلاصلا تيقاوم .سيلبإ توملا كلم هنع حىنو ،(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- that the angel of death examines people five times every day at prayer times. If someone regularly maintains their prayers at their proper times, he instructs them to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and the angel of death drives Iblis away from them.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: هلإ لا نأ ةداهش توم دنع نمؤملا نقلمل ينإ :لوقي توملا كلم نإ (ثيدح) يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .الله لوسر ادمحم نأو ،الله لاإ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) in a hadith: The angel of death says: I indeed instruct the believer at death to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: لخد الله لاإ هلإ لا هملاك رخآ ناك نم نفإ ،الله لاإ هلإ لا مكتاوم اونقل :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .ةنجلا
englishText: The messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Instruct your dying ones to say "La ilaha illa Allah", for whoever's last words are "La ilaha illa Allah" will enter Paradise.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: .هتوم دنع نمؤملا نوكي ام لقعأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: The believer is most conscious at the time of death.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: - هقلح ىلإ هديب ىوهأو - هذه هسفن تغلب دقو بتا نم :- ثيدح يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .هيلع الله بتا
englishText: From the chain of narrators, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said in a hadith: Whoever repents when his soul reaches here- and he pointed with his hand to his throat - Allah accepts his repentance.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: اونقل :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .ةنجلا لخد الله لاإ هلإ لا هملاك رخآ ناك نم نفإ ،الله لاإ هلإ لا مكتاوم
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Instruct your dying ones to say "La ilaha illa Allah," for whoever's last words are "La ilaha illa Allah" will enter Paradise.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: ،الله لاإ هلإ لا مكتاوم اونقل :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع رباج نع ،بونذلا مدهت اهنفإ هتايح يف نمؤملل سنا الله لاإ هلإ لا نإ ،مدهأو مدهأ كلذ :لاقف ؟هتحص يف لقا نمف الله لوسر يا :اولاقف ،ثعبي نيحو هتوم دنعو :يداني ههجو ضيبم اذه نوثعبي نيح مهارت ول دمحم يا :ليئربج لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقاو .هاروبث يا ،هلايو يا :يداني ههجو دوسم اذهو ،ربكأ اللهو الله لاإ هلإ لا
englishText: From Jabir from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Instruct your dying ones to say "La ilaha illa Allah," for it demolishes sins. They said: O Messenger of Allah, what about one who says it in his health? He said: That is more destructive (on sins) and more destructive. Indeed "La ilaha illa Allah" is companionship for the believer in his life, at his death, and when he is resurrected. And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gabriel said: O Muhammad, if you could see them when they are resurrected- this one with a brightened face calling out "La ilaha illa Allah wa Allahu Akbar," and this one with a darkened face calling out "Ya waylah, Ya Suburah" (O woe to me, O destruction to me).

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هعفر نامثع نب ليضف نع (نساحملا) يف يقربلا الله دبع يبأ نب دمحأ هتوم دنع الله لاإ هلإ لا دهش نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقاو :دازو ،مدهأو مدهأ :هلوق ىلإ هلثم (ملاسلا .ةنجلا لخد
englishText: Ahmad bin Abu Abdullah al-Barqi in (Al-Mahasin) from Fudhayl bin Uthman raising it to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) similar to it up to his saying "more destructive (on sins) and destructive," and added: And Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Whoever testifies "La ilaha illa Allah" at his death will enter Paradise. Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimo...

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person With The Two Testimonies
arabicText: سنا اهنفإ ،الله لاإ هلإ لا مكتاوم اونقل :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هربق يف قرمي نيح نمؤملل
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Instruct your dying ones to say "La ilaha illa Allah," for it is companionship for the believer when he passes through his grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person To Acknowledge The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them) And Naming Them By Their Names
arabicText: دبع يبلأ ليقف ،هتعفنل توملا دنع ةمركع تكردأ ول ،لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هيلع متنأ ام هنقلي لقا هعفني ناك اذامب :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: If I had been present with Ikrimah (*) at his death, I would have benefited him. It was said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): How would you have benefited him? He said: I would have instructed him in what you follow. Translator: * Someone who was known to be a khawarij. See Hadith 2642.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person To Acknowledge The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them) And Naming Them By Their Names
arabicText: انل لاقف ،جراوخلا ىأر ىري ناكو ،توملا يف ةمركع اذه :هل ليقف هدنع انك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع تكردأ ول ينإ امأ :لاقف ،عجر نأ ثبل امف،معن :انلقف ،مكيلإ عجرأ ىتح ينورظنا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ ،اهعقوم تعقو دقو هتكردأ ينكلو ،اهب عفتني تاملك هتملعل اهعقوم سفنلا عقت نأ لبق ةمركع هلإ لا نأ ةداهش توملا دنع مكتاوم اونقلف ،هيلع متنأ ام اللهو وه :لقا ؟ملاكلا كاذ امو كادف تلعج :تلقف .ةيلاولاو الله لاإ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: We were with him when it was said to him: This is Ikrimah dying, and he held the beliefs of the Khawarij. Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said to us: Wait for me until I return to you. We said: Yes. He soon returned and said: If I had reached Ikrimah before his soul reached its place, I would have taught him words that would have benefited him, but I reached him after it had reached its place. I said: May I be sacrificed for you, what were those words? He said: By Allah, it is what you believe in. So instruct your dying ones at death with the testimony that there is no god but Allah and the Wilayah (allegiance/guardianship of Ahl al-Bayt). Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person To Acknowledge The I...

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person To Acknowledge The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them) And Naming Them By Their Names
arabicText: مهيلع) ةمئلأبا رارقلاا هل ىمستو نيتداهشلاو جرفلا تاملك هنقلف ىرخأ ةياور يفو :ينيلكلا لقا .ملاكلا هنع عطقني ىتح دحاو دعب ادحاو (ملاسلا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And in another narration: So instruct him with words of relief and the two testimonies, and name for him the acknowledgment of the Imams (peace be upon them) one after another until speech ceases from him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Instructing The Dying Person To Acknowledge The Imams (Peace Be Upon Them) And Naming Them By Their Names
arabicText: نم رانلا تمعط ام هسفن جورخ دنع نوفصت ام فصو نثو دباع نأ ول اللهو :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .ادبأ ائيش هدسج
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: By Allah, if even an idol worshipper described what you describe at the time of his death, the fire would never taste anything from his body, ever.

chapter: Recommendation Of Teaching The Words Of Relief To The Dying
arabicText: ميلحلا الله لاإ هلإ لا :جرفلا تاملك هنقلف عزنلا دنع لجرلا تكردأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع امو نهيف امو ،عبسلا نيضرلأا برو عبسلا تاوامسلا بر الله ناحبس ،ميظعلا ليعلا الله لاإ هلإ لا ،ميركلا .نيملاعلا بر لله دمحلاو ،ميظعلا شرعلا برو نهنيب
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: When you reach a man at the time of death, teach him the words of relief: "There is no god but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous; there is no god but Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent; Glory be to Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the seven earths, and what is in them and what is between them, and Lord of the Magnificent Throne, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds."

chapter: Recommendation Of Teaching The Words Of Relief To The Dying
arabicText: يضقي وهو مشاه ينب نم لجر لىع لخد (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،ميركلا ميلحلا الله لاإ هلإ لا ،ميظعلا ليعلا الله لاإ هلإ لا :لق (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر هل لاقف دمحلاو ،ميظعلا شرعلا برو نهتحت امو نهنيب امو ،عبسلا نيضرلأا برو عبسلا تاوامسلا بر الله ناحبس .رانلا نم هذقنتسا يذلا لله دمحلا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لاقف :اهلاقف .نيملاعلا بر لله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered upon a man from Bani Hashim who was dying, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: Say: "There is no god but Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent; there is no god but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous; Glory be to Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the seven earths, and what is between them and what is beneath them, and Lord of the Magnificent Throne, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds." He said it, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Praise be to Allah who saved him from the Fire."

chapter: Recommendation Of Teaching The Words Of Relief To The Dying
arabicText: توملا هتيب لهأ نم ادحأ رضح اذإ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع برو عبسلا تاوامسلا بر الله ناحبس ،ميظعلا ليعلا الله لاإ هلإ لا ،ميركلا ميلحلا الله لاإ هلإ لا ،لق :هل لقا بهذا :لقا ضيرملا اهلقا اذفإ .نيملاعلا بر لله دمحلاو ،ميظعلا شرعلا برو امهنيب امو ،عبسلا نيضرلأا .سبأ كيلع سيلف
englishText: Recommendation Of Teaching The Words Of Relief To The Dying From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Whenever Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was present with any of his family members at death, he would say to them: Say: "There is no god but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous; there is no god but Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent; Glory be to Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the seven earths, and what is between them, and Lord of the Magnificent Throne, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds." When the sick person would say it, he would say: "Go, for there is no harm upon you."

chapter: Recommendation Of Teaching The Words Of Relief To The Dying
arabicText: رظني ىتح اطغلا هل فشكي الله نأ كلذو (هنم) اضرب لاإ ايندلا نم نمؤم جرخي ام :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا الله دنع ام راتخيف ريخي مث ،هل تناك ام نسحأك ايندلا هل بصنتو ،اهيف هل الله دعأ امو ةنجلا نم هناكم ىلإ .جرفلا تاملك مكتاوم اونقلف ،اهءلابو ايندلبا عنصأ ام :لوقيو
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: No believer leaves this world except with contentment (from him), and that is because Allah removes the veil for him until he sees his place in Paradise and what Allah has prepared for him in it, and this world is presented to him in the best form it ever was for him, then he is given the choice and he chooses what is with Allah and says: "What should I do with the world and its trials," so teach your dying ones the words of relief.

chapter: Recommendation Of Teaching The Dying Person Repentance, Seeking Forgiveness, And The Transmitted Supplications
arabicText: ،توملا هرضح دق نالاف نإ !الله لوسر يا :ليقف توملا لاجر رضح :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع كلم يا :لاقف ،هيلع ىمغم وهو هتاأ ىتح هباحصأ نم سنا هعمو (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ضهنف ،هلأسأ ىتح لجرلا نع فك توملا امهيفأ :لقا ،اريثك اداوسو اريثك اضايب تيأر ،لقا ؟تيأر ام :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا هل لاقف لجرلا قفافأ دبع وبأ لاقف :لقا ،مكبحاصل الله رفغ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لاقف ،ضايبلا :لاقف ؟كيلإ برقأ ناك .هلوقيل ملاكلا اذه :هل اولوقف اتيم مترضح اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: A man was approaching death, and it was said: "O Messenger of Allah! Such person is approaching death." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) got up along with some of his companions until he came to him while he was unconscious. He said: "O Angel of Death, hold back from the man until I ask him." The man regained consciousness, and the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) asked him: "What did you see?" He said: "I saw much whiteness and much blackness." He asked: "Which was closer to you?" He replied: "The whiteness." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Allah has forgiven your companion." Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: "When you attend a dying person, tell him to say these words."

chapter: Recommendation Of Teaching The Dying Person Repentance, Seeking Forgiveness, And The Transmitted Supplications
arabicText: :لقا مث ،هيلع الله بتا ةنسب هتوم لبق بتا نم :اهبطخ ةبطخ رخآ يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا مويب هتوم لبق بتا نم ،ريثكل رهشلا نإو :لقا مث ،هيلع الله بتا رهشب هتوم لبق بتا نم ،ةريثكل ةنسلا نإو ،ةريثكل ةعاسلا نإو :لقا مث ،هيلع الله بتا ةعاسب هتوم لبق بتا نم ،ريثكل اموي نإو :لقا مث ،هيلع الله بتا .هيلع الله بتا - هقلح ىلإ هديب ىوهأو - هذه هسفن تغلب دقو بتا نم
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said in his last sermon: Whoever repents a year before his death, Allah accepts his repentance. Then he said: And indeed a year is long. Whoever repents a month before his death, Allah accepts his repentance. Then he said: And indeed a month is long. Whoever repents a day before his death, Allah accepts his repentance. Then he said: And indeed a day is long. Recommendation Of Teaching The Dying Person Repentance, Seeking For... Whoever repents an hour before his death, Allah accepts his repentance. Then he said: And indeed an hour is long. Whoever repents when his soul reaches here- and he gestured with his hand to his throat - Allah accepts his repentance.

chapter: Recommendation Of Teaching The Dying Person Repentance, Seeking Forgiveness, And The Transmitted Supplications
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر هيلع لخدف ةنيدملا لهأ نم لجر ناسل لقتعا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا ،هيلع ردقي ملف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر هيلع داعفأ ،هيلع ردقي ملف ،الله لاإ هلإ لا لق :هل لاقف (هلآو تنأ ةيضارفأ :اهل لاقف ،همأ ناأ الله لوسر يا معن :تلقا ؟مأ لجرلا اذهل له :اهل لاقف ةأرما لجرلا سأر دنعو :تلاقف ،هنع ىضرت نأ بحأ ينفإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر اهل لاقف ،ةطخاس لب لا :تلاقف ؟لا مأ هنع ،الله لوسر يا كاضرل هنع تيضر دق ينم لبقا ريثكلا نع وفعيو ،ريسيلا لبقي نم يا لق :هل :لاقف ،الله لاإ هلإ لا :لاقف ،الله لاإ هلإ لا لق :هل لاقف ،اهلاقف .روفغلا وفعلا تنأ كنإ ريثكلا ينع فعاو ،ريسيلا ادعابت دق :لاقف !ىرت ام :لاقف ،اهداعفأ اهدعأ :لاقف ،لىع لاخد دق نيدوسأ ىرأ :لاقف ؟ىرت اذام :هل لاقف .هتعاس نم تامف ،يسفنب ناذخيأ نلآا ينم ناضيبلأا نادو ،امهارأ امف نادوسلأا جرخو ،ناضيبأ لخدو ،ينع
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: A man from Medina's tongue became tied, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) entered upon him and said to him: "Say: There is no god but Allah," but he couldn't say it. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) repeated it to him, but he couldn't say it. There was a woman at the man's head, so he asked her: "Does this man have a mother?" She said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah, I am his mother." He asked her: "Are you pleased with him or not?" She said: "No, rather I am angry with him." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to her: "I would like you to be pleased with him." She said: "I am now pleased with him for your pleasure, O Messenger of Allah." He said to him: "Say: There is no god but Allah," and he said it. Then he told him: "Say: O He who accepts the little and pardons the much, accept from me the little and pardon me the much, surely You are the Pardoning, the Forgiving." He said it. Then he asked him: "What do you see?" He said: "I see two black figures have entered upon me." He said: "Repeat it," and he repeated it. He asked: "What do you see?" He said: "They have moved away from me, and two white figures have entered while the black ones left, and I don't see them anymore. The white ones are now approaching me to take my soul." Then he died that very hour.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moving Those Experiencing Difficult Death Throes To Their Prayer Place Where They Used To Pray
arabicText: .هيف ليصي ناك يذلا هلاصم ىلإ برق هعزنو هتوم تيملا لىع رسع اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If death and its throes become difficult for the dying person, move them to their prayer place where they used to pray.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moving Those Experiencing Difficult Death Throes To Their Prayer Place Where They Used To Pray
arabicText: .هيلع وأ هيف ليصي ناك يذلا هلاصم يف هعضف عزنلا هيلع دتشا اذإ لقا ةرارز نع
englishText: From Zurarah who said: If the death throes become severe for them, place them in their prayer place where they used to pray or on it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moving Those Experiencing Difficult Death Throes To Their Prayer Place Where They Used To Pray
arabicText: نم ناك يردخلا ديعس باأ نإ نيسحلا نب ليع لقا لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس لقا حيرذ نع هلاصم ىلإ لمح مث هلهأ هلسغف مياأ ةثلاث عزنف اميقتسم ناكو ( هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر باحصأ .هيف تامف
englishText: From Dharih who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying that Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri was among the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and he was steadfast. He experienced death throes for three days, then his family washed him and carried him to his prayer place where he died.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moving Those Experiencing Difficult Death Throes To Their Prayer Place Where They Used To Pray
arabicText: :لاقف هعزن دتشا هنإو ،يأرلا اذه الله هقزر دق يردخلا ديعس باأ نإ :لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كله نأ ثبلي ملف هولمحف يلاصم ىلإ ينولمحا
