englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri was granted this opinion by Allah, and when his death throes became severe, he said: "Carry me to my prayer place." They carried him and shortly after he passed away. Recommendation Of Moving Those Experiencing Difficult Death Throes ...

chapter: Recommendation Of Moving Those Experiencing Difficult Death Throes To Their Prayer Place Where They Used To Pray
arabicText: الله لىص) الله لوسر باحصأ نم ناك :لاقف يردخلا ديعس وبأ ركذ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هيف تامف هلاصم ىلإ هولمح مث هلهأ هلسغف مياأ ةثلاث عزنف لقا ،اميقتسم ناكو (هلآو هيلع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri was mentioned and he said: He was among the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and he was steadfast. He experienced death throes for three days, then his family washed him and carried him to his prayer place where he died.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moving Those Experiencing Difficult Death Throes To Their Prayer Place Where They Used To Pray
arabicText: سابعلا نع ،دمحم نب رضخلا نع (ملاسلا مهيلع ةمئلأا بط) باتك يف الله دبع هوخأو ماطسب نب نيسحلا خيأ نإ :لجر هل لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ دنع انك :لقا زيرح نع ،ىسيع نب دامح نع ،دمحم نب :لقاو هرمأ مث .توملا تاركس هيلع لهس مهللا :لاقف ،هل عدفا رملاا هيلع دتشا دقو عزنلا يف مياأ ةثلاث ذنم دق هتينم تناك نإو ،ريختأ هلجأ يف ناك نإ هيلع ففخي هنفإ هيف ليصي ناك يذلا هلاصم ىلإ هشارف اولوح .الله ءاش نإ هيلع لهسي هنفإ ترضح
englishText: Al-Husayn bin Bastam and his brother Abdullah in their book (Medicine of the Imams, peace be upon them) from Al-Khidr bin Muhammad, from Al-Abbas bin Muhammad, from Hammad bin Isa, from Hareez who said: We were with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when a man said to him: My brother has been in death throes for three days and it has become severe for him, so pray for him. He said: "O Allah, ease for him the agonies of death." Then he commanded him saying: Move his bed to his prayer place where he used to pray, for it will ease his condition if there is delay in his appointed time, and if his death has arrived, it will be easier for him, insha'Allah.

chapter: Recommendation Of Moving Those Experiencing Difficult Death Throes To Their Prayer Place Where They Used To Pray
arabicText: ففخي ءاعدلا اذهب عدا :هل لقف ديدشلا عزنلا يف وهو ضيرم لىع تلخد اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع هنقل مث ،تارم عبس .رانلا رح رش نمو رافن قرع لك نم ،ميركلا شرعلا بر ،ميظعلا للهبا ذوعأ :كنع الله .الله نذإب هرمأ لهسيو هنع ففخي هنفإ هيف ليصي ناك يذلا هلاصم ىلإ ههجو لوح مث ،جرفلا تاملك
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: When you visit a sick person who is in severe death throes, tell him to recite this prayer and Allah will ease it for him: "I seek refuge in Allah the Great, Lord of the Noble Throne, from every throbbing vein and from the heat of the Hellfire" seven times, then teach him the words of relief, then turn his face towards his prayer place where he used to pray, and it will ease his condition and simplify his matter by Allah's permission.

chapter: Recommendation Of Reciting Al-Saffat And Ya-Sin For The Dying Person
arabicText: ىتح (افص تفااصلاو) كيخأ سأر دنع أرقفا ىنب يا مق :مساقلا هنبلا لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا باأ تيأر نب بوقعي هيلع لبقأ اوجرخو جيس املف ىتفلا ىضق (انقلخ نم مأ اقلخ دشأ مهأ) غلب املف أرقف ،اهمتتست ،تفااصلبا نارمتأ ترصف (ميكحلا نآرقلاو سي) هدنع أرقي توملا هب لزن اذإ تيملا دهعن انك :هل لاقف رفعج .هتحار الله لجع لاإ طق توم نم بوركم دنع أرقت مل ىنب يا :لاقف
englishText: I saw Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying to his son al-Qasim: Stand up my son and recite at the head of your brother Surah As-Saffat until you complete it. So he recited, and when he reached Are they harder to create, or what We have created [Quran, 37:11], the young man passed away. When he was prepared for burial and they left, Yaqub ibn Ja'far approached him and said: We used to know that when death approaches someone, Ya-Sin and the wise Quran [Quran, 36:1-2] is recited for them, but you commanded us to recite As-Saffat. He replied: O my son, it is never recited for someone in the agony of death except that Allah hastens their relief.

chapter: Undesirability Of Leaving The Deceased Alone
arabicText: .هفوج يف ناطيشلا بعل لاإ هدحو كرتيو تومي تيم نم سيل :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no deceased person who dies and is left alone except that Satan plays in their body.

chapter: Undesirability Of Leaving The Deceased Alone
arabicText: .هفوج يف ثبعي ناطيشلا نفإ هدحو كتيم نعدت لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Do not leave your deceased one alone, for Satan tampers with their body.

chapter: Chapter: The Dislike Of Menstruating Women And Those In State Of Janabah Being Present With The Dying Person At The Time Of Death And During Final Instructions
arabicText: يف ضئاح يهو ضيرملا سأر دنع دعقت ةأرملا :(ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبلأ تلق لقا ةزمح يبأ نب ليع نع يذأتت ةكئلاملا نفإ ،هبرف نعو هنع حنتتلف كلذ برقو هيلع اوفاخ اذفإ ،هضرمت نأ سبأ لا :لاقف ؟توملا دح .كلذب
englishText: From Ali ibn Abi Hamza who said: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): Can a menstruating woman sit by the head of a sick person who is near death? He said: There is no harm in her nursing him, but when they fear for him and death approaches, she should move away from him and his proximity, for the angels are disturbed by that.

chapter: Chapter: The Dislike Of Menstruating Women And Those In State Of Janabah Being Present With The Dying Person At The Time Of Death And During Final Instructions
arabicText: .هلسغ ايلي نأ سبأ لاو ،نيقلتلا دنع بنجلا لاو تيملا ضئاحلا رضحت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Neither a menstruating woman nor one in state of janabah should be present with the dying person during talqeen (prompting of shahada to dying person), but there is no harm in them performing the washing of the deceased.

chapter: Chapter: The Dislike Of Menstruating Women And Those In State Of Janabah Being Present With The Dying Person At The Time Of Death And During Final Instructions
arabicText: .امهب ىذأتت ةكئلاملا نلا ،نيقلتلا دنع بنجلاو ضئاحلا رضحي لا :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he said: A menstruating woman and a person in state of janabah should not be present during talqeen (prompting of shahada to dying person), because the angels are offended by them.

chapter: Dislike Of Touching The Deceased During The Exit Of The Soul, And The Recommendation Of Closing Their Eyes, Tightening Their Jaws, And Covering Them With Cloth Afterwards
arabicText: امنإ هنفإ هسمت لا :لقا ناسنإ هنم ىند اذإ ناكف ،ةيحنا يف سلاج رفعج وبأو رفعجل نبا لقث :لقا ةرارز نع هب رمأ ملاغلا ىضق املف ،هيلع ناعأ لاحلا هذه لىع هسم نمو ،لاحلا هذه يف نوكي ام فعضأو ،افعض دادزي .هايحل دشو هانيع ضمغف
englishText: From Zurarah who said: A son of Ja'far became seriously ill while Abu Ja'far was sitting in a corner. Whenever someone approached him, he would say: Do not touch him for it will only increase his weakness, and he is at his weakest in this state. Whoever touches him in this state assists against him. When the boy passed away, he ordered that his eyes be closed and his jaw be tied.

chapter: Dislike Of Touching The Deceased During The Exit Of The Soul, And The Recommendation Of Closing Their Eyes, Tightening Their Jaws, And Covering Them With Cloth Afterwards
arabicText: فلخ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسرو بوثب رتسف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ضبق :لقا هدج نع هجو لىع بوثلا فرط برضت حيرلاو هتحار لىع هيدخ عضو دقو ،هبوث فرط دنع (ملاسلا هيلع) ليعو بوثلا .نوكبيو نوبحتني دجسملا يف بابلا لىع سانلاو :لقا ،ليع
englishText: From his grandfather who said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) passed away, he was covered with a cloth, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was behind the cloth while Ali (peace be upon him) was at the edge of his cloth, having placed his cheeks on his palm while the wind was blowing the edge of the cloth against Ali's face. He said: And the people were at the door in the mosque, sobbing and crying.

chapter: Dislike Of Touching The Deceased During The Exit Of The Soul, And The Recommendation Of Closing Their Eyes, Tightening Their Jaws, And Covering Them With Cloth Afterwards
arabicText: توملا هرضح املف ،هدنع سلاج (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأو ليعامسإ توم ترضح :لقا شمهك يبأ نع .ةفحلملا هيلع ىطغو هضمغو هييحل دش
englishText: From Abu Kahmas who said: I was present at Isma'il's death while Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was sitting with him. When death approached him, he tied his jaws, closed his eyes, and covered him with a sheet.

chapter: Recommendation Of Lighting (Lamps) Near The Deceased At Night And Maintaining Lighting In That House
arabicText: يف جارسلبا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ رمأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ ضبق امل :لقا انباحصأ نم ةدع نع كلذ لثمب (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا وبأ رمأ مث (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ضبق ىتح هنكسي ناك يذلا تيبلا .ناك امب يردأ لا مث ،قارعلا ىلإ هب جرخا ىتح (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ تيب يف
englishText: From several of our companions who said: When Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) passed away, Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) ordered for lamps to be lit in the house where he used to live, until Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) himself passed away. Then Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) ordered the same thing in Abu Abdullah's (peace be upon him) house until he was taken to Iraq, then I don't know what happened after that.

chapter: Ruling On The Death Of The Fetus Without Its Mother And Vice Versa
arabicText: :لقا ؟دلولا جرخيو اهنطب قشيأ ،اهنطب يف دلولا كرحتيو تومت ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهنطب طاخيو معن :لاقف
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who dies while the child moves in her womb, should her belly be cut open and the child be removed? He said: Yes, and her belly should be stitched.

chapter: Ruling On The Death Of The Fetus Without Its Mother And Vice Versa
arabicText: .اهدلو جرخيو اهنطب قشي لقا ،اهنطب يف اهدلوو تومت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا تلأس
englishText: I asked the righteous servant (peace be upon him) about a woman who dies while her child is in her womb. He said: Her belly should be cut open and her child should be removed.

chapter: Ruling On The Death Of The Fetus Without Its Mother And Vice Versa
arabicText: كرحتي دلو نطب يفو ةأرملا تتام اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لجرلا لخدي نبأ سبأ لا :لقا ،اهيلع فوختيف دلولا اهنطب يف تومي ةأرملا يف :لقاو ،دلولا جرخيو اهنطب قش مل اذإ :هرخآ يف دازو .هيلع فوختيف كرحتي :لقا هنأ لاإ هلثم رخآ عضوم يف هاورو .هجرخيو هعطقيف هدي .ءاسنلا هب قفرت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: If a woman dies while there is a moving child in her womb, her belly should be cut open and the child should be removed. And he said regarding a woman whose child dies in her womb and there is fear for her: There is no harm in a man inserting his hand to cut it and remove it. And he narrated it in another place similarly except that he said: it moves and there is fear for it. And he added at the end: If women cannot handle it gently.

chapter: Ruling On The Death Of The Fetus Without Its Mother And Vice Versa
arabicText: جرختسيو اهنطب قشيأ ،اهنطب يف دلولا كرحتيو تومت ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .معن :لقا ؟اهدلو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a woman who dies while the child moves in her womb, should her belly be cut open and her child extracted? He said: Yes.

chapter: Ruling On The Death Of The Fetus Without Its Mother And Vice Versa
arabicText: .اهنطب طاخيو دلولا جرخي :هيف داز ريمع يبأ نبا ةياور يفو ينيلكلا لقا
englishText: Al-Kulayni said: And in the narration of Ibn Abi Umayr, he added: The child is removed and her belly is stitched.

chapter: Ruling On The Death Of The Fetus Without Its Mother And Vice Versa
arabicText: ،كرحتي اهنطب يف اهدلوو تومت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ىسوم نسحلا باأ تلأس :لقا نيطقي نب ليع نع .دلولا نع قشي لقا
englishText: From Ali bin Yaqtin who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) about a woman who dies while her child moves in her womb. He said: Cut open for the child.

chapter: Ruling On The Death Of The Fetus Without Its Mother And Vice Versa
arabicText: .اهنطب طاخيو دلولا جرخي :لقا ةنيذأ نبا نع ،ريمع يبأ نبا نع هدانسإبو
englishText: And by his chain from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Uthayna who said: The child is removed and her belly is stitched.

chapter: Ruling On The Death Of The Fetus Without Its Mother And Vice Versa
arabicText: دلولاو تتفا ىتح قلطت تلاز امف قلطلا اهبرض سورع تنب يل :تلاقف هتلأس ةأرما نأ ملسم نب دمحم نع هيلع) رقابلا ليع نب دمحم لئس !الله ةمأ يا تلق :لقا ؟عنصأ امف ئيجيو بهذيو اهنطب يف كرحتي .دلولا جرختسيو تيملا نطب قشي :لاقف كلذ لثم نع (ملاسلا
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim that a woman asked him saying: I have a bride daughter who went into labor and continued in labor until she died while the child was moving in her belly, going back and forth, so what should I do? He said: I said O servant of Allah! Muhammad bin Ali Al-Baqir (peace be upon him) was asked about something similar to this and he said: The belly of the deceased should be cut open and the child should be extracted.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening The Preparation And Burial Of The Dead, Whether Death Occurs At Night Or Day, When There Is No Doubt About Death
arabicText: تام لاجر نيقلأ لا !سانلا رشعم يا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع سمشلا عولط مكتاومب اورظتنت لا ،ليللا هب رظتنفا اراهن تيم هل تام لاجر لاو حبصلا هب رظتنفا لايل تيم هل .الله كمحري الله لوسر يا تنأو :سانلا لقا .الله مكمحري مهعجاضم ىلإ مهب اولجع ،اهبورغ لاو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: O people! Let me not find a man whose relative died at night waiting until morning, nor a man whose relative died during the day waiting until night. Do not wait with your dead for sunrise or sunset. Hasten with them to their resting places, may Allah have mercy on you. The people said: And you, O Messenger of Allah, may Allah have mercy on you.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening The Preparation And Burial Of The Dead, Whether Death Occurs At Night Or Day, When There Is No Doubt About Death
arabicText: مهيأ يردأ ام ةثلاث :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) هئباآ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع .مكل الله رفغ هل اورفغتسا :لوقي يذلا وأ ،اوفق :لوقي يذلا وأ ،ءادر ريغب ةزانجلا عم يشمي يذلا :امرج مظعأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: There are three, and I don't know which of them has the greater sin: The one who walks with the funeral without a cloak, or the one who says "stop," or the one who says "seek forgiveness for him, may Allah forgive you."

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening The Preparation And Burial Of The Dead, Whether Death Occurs At Night Or Day, When There Is No Doubt About Death
arabicText: هريغ ةبيصم يف ةزانج فلخ يشمي يذلا امرج مظعأ مهيأ يردأ لا ةثلاث لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .الله مكمحري هيلع اومحرتو اوقفرا لوقي يذلاو ةبيصملا دنع هذخف لىع برضي يذلاو ،ءادر ريغب
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There are three, and I don't know which of them has the greater sin: The one who walks behind a funeral in someone else's tragedy without a cloak, the one who slaps his thigh during tragedy, and the one who says "be gentle and have mercy on him, may Allah have mercy on you."

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening The Preparation And Burial Of The Dead, Whether Death Occurs At Night Or Day, When There Is No Doubt About Death
arabicText: ؟أدبأ امهيأبف ةبوتكم تقو يف ةزانجلا لىع ةلاصلا ترضح اذإ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق لقا رباج نع سمشلا عولط ةزانجلا لىع ةلاصلبا رظتنت لاو ،ةضيرفلا تقو توفي نأ فاخت نأ لاإ هربق ىلإ تيملا لجع لاقف .اهبورغ لاو
englishText: From Jabir who said: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): If the time for prayer over the deceased coincides with the time of an obligatory prayer, which should I begin with? He said: Hasten the deceased to his grave unless you fear missing the time of the obligatory prayer, and do not wait for sunrise or sunset to pray over the deceased.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening The Preparation And Burial Of The Dead, Whether Death Occurs At Night Or Day, When There Is No Doubt About Death
arabicText: ليقي لاف راهنلا لوأ تيملا تام اذإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هربق يف لاإ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: If someone dies at the beginning of the day, they should not take their afternoon rest (qaylula) except in their grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening The Preparation And Burial Of The Dead, Whether Death Occurs At Night Or Day, When There Is No Doubt About Death
arabicText: .هلجعو هزاهج يف ذخف تيملا تام اذإ لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon them both), he said: When someone dies, take to preparing them (for burial) and hasten it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Hastening The Preparation And Burial Of The Dead, Whether Death Occurs At Night Or Day, When There Is No Doubt About Death
arabicText: .هليجعت تيملا ةمارك :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husain said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Honoring the deceased means hastening (his burial).

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying The Preparation Of The Dead Body For Three Days When Death Is Uncertain, Unless Death Is Confirmed Before Or Remains Uncertain After
arabicText: .كلذ لبق ريغتي نأ لاإ مياأ ةثلاث هب رظتني لقا قيرغلاو قوعصملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) regarding the person struck by lightning and the drowned person, he said: Wait with them for three days unless they change before that. Translator: They may still be alive even though they appear dead. See Hadith 2686 and 2688.

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying The Preparation Of The Dead Body For Three Days When Death Is Uncertain, Unless Death Is Confirmed Before Or Remains Uncertain After
arabicText: ودهملاو نوطبملاو قوعصملاو قيرغلا ريغتي نأ لاإ مهب رظتني سمخ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .نخدملاو
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Five types should be waited for unless they change: the drowned, the lightning-struck, the one with stomach illness, the collapsed, and the suffocated.

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying The Preparation Of The Dead Body For Three Days When Death Is Uncertain, Unless Death Is Confirmed Before Or Remains Uncertain After
arabicText: ،ءربتسيو معن :لقا ؟لسغيأ قيرغلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ ينعي هتلأس :لقا رامع نب قاحسإ نع تام هنأ اونظ امبر هنفإ ةقعاصلا بحاص اضيأ كلذكو ،نفدي نأ لبق مياأ ةثلاث كرتي :لقا ؟أربتسي فيكو :تلق .تمي ملو
englishText: From Ishaq bin Ammar who said: I asked him, meaning Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), about the drowned person, should they be washed? He said: Yes, and they should be confirmed dead. I said: How is death confirmed? He said: They are left for three days before burial, and likewise the person struck by lightning, for sometimes people think they have died when they haven't.

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying The Preparation Of The Dead Body For Three Days When Death Is Uncertain, Unless Death Is Confirmed Before Or Remains Uncertain After
arabicText: :لقا .نفكيو لسغي مث تام دق هنأ ملعيو ريغتي ىتح سبحي قيرغلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نفكيو لسغي مث نيموي سبح قعص اذإ :لاقف قوعصملا نع لئسو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The drowned person should be kept until they change and it is known they have died, then they are washed and shrouded. He was asked about the lightning-struck person and he said: When struck, they should be kept for two days then washed and shrouded.

chapter: Obligation Of Delaying The Preparation Of The Dead Body For Three Days When Death Is Uncertain, Unless Death Is Confirmed Before Or Remains Uncertain After
arabicText: ،ريثك قلخ كلذ نم تام ،ةريثك قعاوص نينسلا نم ةنس ةكمب (سانلا) باصأ :لقا ةزمح يبأ نب ليع نع نأ قوعصملاو قيرغلل يغبني - هلأسأ نأ ريغ نم اءدتبم - :لاقف (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ يبأ لىع تلخدف سنا نفد دق هنأ ينربخت كنأك كادف تلعج :تلق ،هتوم لىع لدت حير هنم جئي نأ لاإ نفدي لا ثالاث هب صبرتي .مهروبق يف لاإ اوتام ام اءايحأ ريثك سنا نفد دق !ليع يا معن :لاقف اءايحأ ريثك
englishText: From Ali bin Abi Hamza who said: In Makkah during one year, people were affected by many lightning strikes, and many people died from that. I entered upon Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and he said- beginning without me asking- it is appropriate for the drowned and lightning-struck to be waited with for three days and not buried unless an odor comes from them indicating their death. I said: May I be your ransom, it's as if you're telling me that many people were buried alive! He said: Yes, O Ali! Many people were buried alive and only died in their graves.

chapter: Impermissibility Of Leaving The Crucified Without Burial Preparation For More Than Three Days
arabicText: مياأ ةثلاث دعب بولصملا اورقت لا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نفديو لزني ىتح
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Do not leave the crucified person after three days until he is taken down and buried. Section 8 Ghusl Al-Mayyit (Washing The Deceased)

chapter: Its Obligation
arabicText: .بجاو تيملا لسغو لقا نأ ىلإ بجاو ةبانج لاا لسغ :لقا - ثيدح يف - (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)- in a hadith- he said: The ghusl al-janabah (sexual impurity) is obligatory... until he said: and ghusl al-mayyit (washing the deceased) is obligatory.

chapter: Its Obligation
arabicText: نأ تيبلا يف تاوص انعمس (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ضبق امل لقا - ثيدح - يف مكحلا نب ليع نع ،هولسغت لاو هونفدفا رهطم رهاط مكيبن ،ةنس اذو هنفدو هنفكو هلسغب ينرمأ هنفإ !الله ودع أسخا لاقف اعزف هسأر عفر (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع تيأرف لقا .صيمقلا عزنت لاو كيبن ةروع رتسا !بلاط يبأ نب ليع يا ةمغنلا كلت ريغ رخآ دانم ىدنا مث لقا
englishText: From Ali bin Al-Hakam- in a hadith- he said: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) passed away, we heard a voice in the house saying: "Your Prophet is pure and purified, so bury him and do not wash him." He said: Then I saw Ali (peace be upon him) raise his head in alarm and said: "Be gone, enemy of Allah! For he commanded me to wash him, shroud him, and bury him, and this is the Sunnah." Then another caller called with a different tone: "O Ali bin Abi Talib! Cover the private parts of your Prophet and do not remove the shirt."

chapter: Its Obligation
arabicText: هنلأ لسغي هنأ تيملا لسغ ةلع :هلئاسم باوج يف هيلإ بتك (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نأ نانس نب دمحم نع .ةرخلآا لهأ رشابيو ةكئلاملا ىقلي هنلأ هللع فونص نم هباصأ امو ،هضارمأ سنادأ نم فظنيو رهطي ىلإ هب اهجوم افيظن ارهاط نوكي نأ مهساميو هنوساميو ةراهطلا لهأ ىقلو لجو زع الله لىع درو اذإ بحتسيف نوكيف بنجيف قلخ هنم يذلا ينملا هنم جرخي هنأ ىرخأ ةلعو ،هل (عفشيلو ههجو) بلطيل لجو زع الله .هل هلسغ
englishText: From Muhammad bin Sinan that Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) wrote to him in response to his questions: The reason for ghusl al-mayyit is that he is washed to be purified and cleaned from the filth of his diseases and what afflicted him of various illnesses because he meets the angels and encounters the people of the hereafter. Its Obligation It is recommended when he comes to Allah the Mighty and Majestic and meets the people of purity and touches them and they touch him that he be pure and clean, directed towards Allah the Mighty and Majestic to seek His face and intercession, and another reason is that semen comes out of him from which he was created so he becomes in a state of janabah (sexual impurity), thus washing becomes necessary for him.

chapter: Its Obligation
arabicText: ىذلأاو ةفلآاو ةساجنلا هيلع بلاغلا ناك تام اذإ هنلأ تيملا لسغب رما امنإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نع ىلإ هب اهجوم افيظن مهساميف هنوساميو هنولي نيذلا ةكئلاملا نم ةراهطلا لهأ رشبا اذإ ارهاط نوكي نأ بحفأ .لجو زع الله كلذلف ةبانجلا هنم تجرخ لاإ تومي تيم نم سيل :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) ةمئلأا ضعب نع ىور دقو .لسغلا بجو بنجو تيم عمتجا اذإ اميف ثيداحأ مميتلا يف يتيأو ،كلذ لىع لدت ةيتلآا باوبلأا ثيداحأ رثكأو :لوقأ ،ةبانجلا لسغ لىع هحيجرتل ،اضيأ تيملا لسغ بوجو لىع لدي ام اهنم مهدحأ يفكي ءام كانهو ثدحمو يف هلوقو ،رئاظنو ،نآرقلا نم لا ةنسلا نم ملع هبوجو نأ لىع لومحم وهف ةنس هنأ نم اهضعب نمضت امو امل الله نأو ،عرشلا لصأ يف بوجولل ةلع بابحتسلاا اذه نأ هب داري بحتسيف :نانس نب دمحم ثيدح .ملعأ اللهو هبجوأ كلذ بحأ
englishText: From Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) he said: The washing of the deceased was commanded because when he dies, impurity, affliction, and harm predominantly affect him, so it was beloved that he be pure when he encounters the people of purity from among the angels who attend to him and touch him, so he touches them clean, directed towards Allah the Mighty and Majestic. It has been narrated from some of the Imams (peace be upon them) that they said: There is no deceased who dies except that janabah (major ritual impurity) comes out from him, therefore washing becomes obligatory. I (Hurr Amili) say: Most of the hadiths in the coming chapters indicate this, and there will come in the chapter of tayammum hadiths about when a deceased, someone in major ritual impurity, and someone in minor ritual impurity gather and there is only enough water for one of them, including what indicates the obligation of washing the deceased also, preferring it over the ritual bath for major impurity, and what some of them included about it being Sunnah is interpreted to mean that its obligation was known from the Sunnah not from the Quran, and similar cases, and his saying in the hadith of Muhammad bin Sinan: "it is recommended" means that this recommendation is the reason for the obligation in the original law, and that when Allah loved that He made it obligatory, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: رثأ لىع هلسغا مث ،ردسو ءامب هلسغا :لاقف ؟تيملا لسغ نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ؟هلك هدسجل تلاسغ ثلاث تلق ،حارق ءامب ةثلاثلا لسغاو ،تناك نإ ةريرذو روفاكو ءامب ىرخأ ةلسغ كلذ ،هتحت نم هلسغف صيمق هيلع نوكي نأ تعطتسا نإ لقا ؟لسغ اذإ بوث هيلع نوكي :تلق ،معن :لقا .هلسغي نيح ةقرخلا هدي لىع فلي نأ تيملا لسغ نمل بحأ :لقاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about washing the deceased? He said: Wash him with water and sidr (lote tree leaves), then wash him after that another washing with water and camphor and dhareerah (*) if available, and wash the third time with pure water. I said: Three washings for his entire body? He said: Yes. I said: Should he wear clothes when being washed? He said: If you can have him wear a shirt and wash him underneath it. And he said: I prefer for whoever washes the deceased to wrap a cloth around his hand when washing him. Translator: * A powder made from a mixture of aromatic herbs, dried flowers, or other fragrant materials.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: امإ ،هتروع كنع رتسي باوث هنيبو كنيب لعجفا تيملا لسغ تدرأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نميلأا هقشب أدباو ،هدسج رئاس مث ،ردسلبا تارم ثلاث هسأرو هيفكب ءدبت مث ،هريغ امإو صيمق لىع يذلا بوثلا تحت نم كدي لخدا مث ،ىرسيلا كدي لىع اهفلف ةفيظن ةقرخ ذخف جرف لسغت نأ تدرأ اذفإ .هتروع ىرت نأ ريغ نم هلسغفا تيملا جرف ةلسغ تحب ءامب هلسغا مث ،طونح نم ئشبو روفاكو ءامب ىرخأ ةرم هلسغفا ردسلبا هلسغ نم تغرف اذفإ .هتففج مث فيظن بوث يف هتلعج تلاسغ ثلاث نم تغرف اذإ ىتح ،ىرخأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: When you want to wash the deceased, place between you and him a cloth that covers his private parts, either a shirt or something else. Then begin with his palms and head three times with sidr (lote tree leaves), then the rest of his body, and start with his right side. When you want to wash his private parts, take a clean cloth and wrap it around your left hand, then insert your hand under the cloth that is covering the deceased's private parts and wash them without seeing his private parts. When you finish washing him with sidr, wash him another time with water and camphor and some hanut (* perfume), then wash him with pure water for another washing, until when you finish the three washings, place him in a clean cloth then dry him. Translator: * A mixture of fragrant ingredients such as musk, camphor, sandalwood, rose water, and other aromatic oils or herbs.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ناك نفإ ،ةلبقلا لبقتسم لستغملا لىع هعضف تيملا لسغ تدرأ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) مهنع سنوي نع مل نإو ،ةبكرلا قوف ىلإ هيلجر نم هعفراو ،هتروع لىع هصيمق عمجاو صيمقلا نم هدي جرخفأ صيمق هيلع .ةقرخ هتروع لىع قلفا صيمق هيلع نكي يف ةوغرلا لزعاو ،هتوغر عفترت ىتح كديب هبرضاو ءاملا هيلع بصو تشط يف هريصف ردسلا ىلإ دمعاو ىلإ ةبانجلا نم ناسنلاا لسغي امك تارم ثلاث هيدي لسغا مث ،ءاملا اهيف يتلا ةناجلإا يف رخلآا بصو ،ئش هيرخنم ءاملا لخدي لا نأ دهتجاو كلذ يف غلباو ةوغرلبا هسأر لسغا مث ،هقنو هجرف لسغا مث ،عارذلا فصن ،هعماسمو .اقيفر اكلد هندب كلداو ،تارم ثلاث هيمدق ىلإ هسأر فصن نم ءاملا بصو نميلأا هبناج لىع هعجضا مث ةناجلإا نم ءاملا كلذ بص مث ،كلذ لثم هب لعفاو نميلأا هبناج لىع هعجضا مث ،هنطبو هرهظ كلذكو لعفاو ،روفاك تابح هيف قلأو ةينلآا يف ءاملا بص مث ،نيقفرملا ىلإ كيدي لسغاو ،حارق ءامب ةناجلإا لسغاو ،هقنفا ئش هنم جرخ نفإ ،اقيفر احسم هنطب حسماو هجرفب مث ،هيديب أدبا ،ىلولأا ةرملا يف تلعف امك هب هبنج لىع هعجضا مث ،هنطبو هرهظو نميلأا هبنج لسغاو ،رسيلأا هبنج لىع هعجضا مث ،هسأر لسغا مث ،حارقلا ءام هيف بصو ةينلآاو نيقفرملا ىلإ كيدي لسغا مث ،ةرم لوأ تلعف امك رسيلأا هبنج لسغاو نميلأا ،رهاط بوثب هفشن مث .نيتلولأا نيترملا يف هتلسغ امك حارق ءامب هلسغاو هنم جرخي لائل هربد يف نطقلا شحاو ربدو لبق هجرف لىع هعضفو طونح نم ائيش هيلع رذف نطق ىلإ دمعاو جرخا مث ،هيذخفف اهفلو اديدش امض هيذخف مضو ،هيوقح نم اهدشف ربش اهضرع ةليوط ةقرخ ذخو ئش ةليوط ،ةقرخلا نوكتو ةقرخلا هيف تففل يذلا عضوملا يف اهزرغاو ،نميلأا بناجلا ىلإ هيلجر تحت نم اهسأر .اديدش افل هيتبكر ىلإ هيوقح نم هيذخف فلت
englishText: From Yunus, from them (peace be upon them) who said: When you want to wash the deceased, place them on the washing table facing the qibla. If they are wearing a shirt, remove their hand from it and gather the shirt over their private parts, and raise it from their feet above the knee. If they have no shirt, place a cloth over their private parts. Take sidr (lote tree leaves), put them in a basin, pour water over them, and beat them with your hand until foam rises. Set the foam aside in something, and pour the rest in the tub with water. Then wash their hands three times up to mid-forearm as one washes from janabah. Then wash their private parts and clean thoroughly. Then wash their head with the foam, being thorough and careful not to let water enter their nostrils and ears. Then lay them on their right side and pour water from mid-head to feet three times, gently rubbing their body. Do the same for their back and belly. Then lay them on their right side and do the same. Then pour out that water from the tub and wash the tub with pure water. Wash your hands up to the elbows. Then pour water in the vessel, add some camphor grains, and do as you did the first time: start with their hands, then private parts, and gently wipe their belly. If anything comes out, clean it. Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings Then wash their head, lay them on their left side, wash their right side, back and belly, then lay them on their right side and wash their left side as done the first time. Then wash your hands to the elbows and the vessel, pour pure water in it, and wash them with pure water as done in the first two times. Then dry them with a clean cloth. Take cotton, sprinkle some embalming perfume on it, place it on their front and back private parts, and stuff cotton in the back to prevent anything from coming out. Take a long cloth one span wide, tie it around their waist, press their thighs firmly together and wrap it around their thighs, then bring its end from under their feet to the right side, and insert it where you wrapped the cloth. The cloth should be long enough to wrap their thighs from waist to knees firmly.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ،روفاكلا هيف حرطي ءاملبا ةرمو ،ردسلبا ةرم ،تلاسغ ثلاث تيملا لسغي :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .نفكي مث ،حارقلا ءاملبا ىرخأ ةرمو
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The deceased should be given three ritual baths: once with sidr (lote tree leaves), once with water containing camphor, and once with pure water, then the body is to be shrouded.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: هيمدق نطبب لبقتسا :لاقف تيملا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا ليهاكلا الله دبع نع ءامب هجرفب أدبا مث ،اهعدف كيلع تعنتما نفإ ،هلصافم نيلت مث ،ةلبقلا لبقتسم ههجو نوكي ىتح ةلبقلا .اقيفر احسم هنطب حسمفا ءاملا نم رثكأو ،تلاسغ ثلاث ردسلا ههجوو هتيحلو هسأر نم رسيلأا هقشب نث مث ،هسأرو هتيحل نم نميلأا هقشب أدباو هسأر ىلإ لوحت مث هلسغا مث ،نميلأا كل ودبيل رسيلأا هقش لىع هعجضا مث امعنا لاسغ هلسغاو فنعلاو كياإو ،قفرب هلسغفا رسيلأا كل ودبيل نميلأا هبناج لىع هدر مث ،تلاسغ ثلاث هنطبو هرهظ لىع كدي حسماو ،هيمدق ىلإ هنرق نم حسماو ،ضرحلاو روفاكلا ءامب تلاسغ ثلاث هنطبو هرهظ لىع كدي حسماو هيمدق ىلإ هنرق نم ءامب هلسغفا .اقيفر احسم هنطب لىع كدي ثلاث روفاكلا ءامب ههجوو هسأرو امهيلك هيبناج نم مث ،هتيحلب لاوأ تعنص امك عنصفا هسأر ىلإ لوحت مث مث ،تلاسغ ثلاث هيمدق ىلإ هنرق نم هلسغفا ،نميلأا كل ودبي ىتح رسيلأا بناجلا ىلإ هدر مث ،تلاسغ تحت كدي لخداو ،تلاسغ ثلاث همدق ىلإ هنرق نم هلسغفا رسيلأا كل ودبي ىتح نميلأا هبناج ىلإ هدرت نطبا يفو هيبكنم تحت كدي تلخدأ هنم ائيش تلسغ املك هبنج عم فكلاو عارذلا نوكيو ،هيعارذو هيبكنم .هيعارذ هجولاو ةيحللاو سأرلا ىلإ لوحت مث ،جرفلبا أدبت ،لاوأ تعنص امك حارق ءامب هلسغا مث ،هرهظ لىع هدر مث مث ،اريثك انطق ارفا ذإ هب هرفذت نطقلا هتحت نوكيو ،ةقرخلبا هرزا مث ،حارق ءامب لاوأ تعنص امك عنصت ىتح .ئش رهظي نأ فاخت لا ىتح اديدش ادش ةقرخلبا نطقلا لىع هيذخف دشت لاف ئش نيرخنملا رهظي نأ تفخ نفإ ائيش هعماسم يف وشحت نأ كياإو ،هنطب زمغت وأ هدعقت نأ كياإو .ةأرملا لسغ كلذكو هرافظأ للختو ،ائيش هيف لعجت لاف فخت مل ناو ،انطق مث ريصت نأ كيلع
englishText: From Abdullah Al-Kahili who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about washing the deceased. He said: Face his feet towards the qibla so that his face is facing the qibla, then soften his joints. If they resist, leave them. Then begin with his private parts using water with sidr (lote tree leaves) three times, use plenty of water and gently wipe his stomach. Then move to his head and start with the right side of his beard and head, then second with the left side of his head, beard, and face, washing it gently. Avoid roughness and wash him softly. Then lay him on his left side to expose his right side, then wash him from his crown to his feet, and wipe your hand on his back and stomach three times. Then turn him to his right side to expose his left side and wash him with water from his crown to his feet and wipe your hand on his back and stomach three times with camphor water and cleaning agent, and wipe your hand gently on his stomach. Then move to his head and do as you did first with his beard, then both his sides, head, and face with camphor water three times. Then return him to the left side until the right side is exposed, wash him from his crown to his feet three times, then return him to his right side until the left side is exposed and wash him from his crown to his feet three times. Put your hand under his shoulders and arms, keeping the forearm and palm against his side. Whenever you wash any part of him, put your hand under his shoulders and inside his arms. Then return him to his back, then wash him with pure water as you did first, starting with the private parts, then move to the head, beard, and face until you do as you did f irst with pure water. Then wrap him with the cloth, placing cotton underneath, using plenty of cotton when stuffing. Then bind his thighs over the cotton with the cloth tightly until you're not afraid anything will show. Beware of sitting him up or squeezing his stomach, and beware of stuffing anything in his ears. If you fear something might appear from the nostrils, you may place cotton there, but if you don't fear that, don't put anything in them. Clean his nails, and washing a woman is done the same way. Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: ،هلك هدسج لسغاو ،ردسو ءامب :لقا ؟لسغي فيك تيملا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس نيح هيلع نوكي امف :تلق ،معن :لقا ؟تارم ثلاث :تلق .ءامب ىرخأ هلسغا مث ،روفاكو ءامب ىرخأ هلسغاو .صيمقلا تحت نم لسغيف صيمق هيلع نوكي نأ تعطتسا نا :لقا ؟هلسغي
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about washing the deceased, how should he be washed? He said: With water and sidr (lotr tree leaves), wash his entire body, then wash him again with water and camphor, then wash him again with water. I asked: Three times? He said: Yes. I asked: What should be on him while washing? He said: If you can, let there be a shirt on him and wash beneath the shirt.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: أدبت تيملا لسغ :لاقف ؟لا مأ ةلاصلا ءوضو هيفأ ،تيملا لسغ نع ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا تلأس .تارم ثلاث ءاملا هيلع ضافي مث ،ردسلبا هسأرو ههجو لسغي مث ،ضرحلبا لسغيف هقفارمب نم ئشو ردسلا نم ئش ءاملا يف لعجيو ،هقوف نم هيلع بصيو هدي لجر لخدي صيمق يف لاإ لسغي لاو .رصعي نأ ريغ نم اقيفر احسم حسميف ابيرق ائيش فاخي نأ لاإ هنطب رصعي لاو ،روفاك .لستغا هنفك اذإ مث ،تارم ثلاث نيبكنملا ىلإ هنفكي نأ لبق هدي هلسغ يذلا لسغي مث
englishText: I asked the Al-Abd Al Salih (meaning the Imam) (peace be upon him) about washing the deceased, does it require ablution like prayer or not? He said: The washing of the deceased begins with his elbows using hardh (*), then his face and head are washed with sidr (lote tree leaves), then water is poured over him three times. He should only be washed while wearing a shirt through which a man inserts his hand and pours water from above. Some sidr and some camphor should be added to the water. His stomach should not be squeezed unless something recent is feared, then it should be wiped gently without squeezing. Then the person who washed him should wash his own hands up to the shoulders three times before shrouding him, and after shrouding him, he should perform a full ritual bath (ghusl). Translator: * A type of cleaning agent. Specifically a potash or washing soda derived from leaves and branches of the Cynanchum argel plant.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: مث ،هييحلو ردسلبا هسأر لسغأ مث ،نانشلأبا هيضوأ مث ،هنطب رصعأ نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ ينرمأ ءاملا هيلع ضيفأ مث ،حارقلا ءاملبا هلسغا مث ،ثالاث هيلع ضيفأ مث ،هدسجب كلدأ مث ،هنم هدسج لىع ضيفأ .ردس تقارو عبس هيف حرطاو ،حارقلا ءاملباو روفاكلبا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) ordered me to squeeze his abdomen, then wash it with ashnan (*), then wash his head and beard with sidr (lote tree leaves), then pour it over his body, then rub his body, then pour over him three times, then wash him with pure water, then pour water with camphor and pure water over him, and put in it seven sidr leaves. Translator: * Ashes derived from certain plants commonly known as saltworts or glassworts. Their ashes contain high levels of sodium carbonate or potassium carbonate, which have cleansing and softening properties. The ash is mixed with water to create a cleaning solution for washing the deceased.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: مث ،اقيفر ازمغ هنطب زمغاو هدعقا :لاقف ،تيملا (لسغ) نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع مث ،روفاكو ءامب مث ،ضرحلاو ءاملبا هلسغتو ،هنمايمب أدبت هلسغت مث هعجضت مث ،نطبلا زمغ نم هرهط .هنافكأ يف هلعجاو ،حارق ءامب هلسغت .ةيقتلا هيف هجولاو ،هيلع لمعن انسلو ،ةماعلل قفاوم هدعقا هلوق :خيشلا لقا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about washing the deceased, and he said: Sit him up and press his abdomen gently, then clean him from what comes out from pressing the abdomen, then lay him down and wash him starting with his right side. Wash him with water and sidr (lote tree leaves), then with water and camphor, then wash him with pure water, and place him in his shrouds. The Shaykh said: His saying "sit him up" agrees with the Aammah (Sunnis), but we do not practice it, and the reason for it is taqiyyah (dissimulation).

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: حضني مث ،ةقرخ هتئوس لىع حرطتف أدبت :لقا ،تيملا لسغ نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع مث ،نميلأا ةقشب أدبت مث ،هيقني ىتح ردسب ةيحللاو سأرلا لسغتف أدبت مث ءاملا نم هيتبكرو هردص لىع ،سبأ لاف يمطخلبا هتيحلو هسأر تلسغ نإو ،رسيلأا هقشب روفاكلا نم ةرجلا يف لعجي روفاك نم ةرجب مث ،امهنم غرفت ىتح ءام نم ةرجب هنطبو هرهظ لىع كدي رمتو بصنتو ،هلك هدسج لىع كدي رمتو رسيلأا هقش مث ،نميلأا هقش مث ،هتيحلو هسأر لسغي مث ةبح فصن كيدي لىع نوكيو ،جرخ ام هجرخم نم جرخي ىتح ائيش هرصعتف هنطب لىع كدي رمت مث ،ائيش هتيحلو هسأر ،هربد اهب يقنت ةقرخ رارج ثلاث كلذف حارقلا ءام نم ةرجب هلسغت مث ،جرخ ام هرخنم نم جرخي ىتح هضفنتف ائيش هسأرب ليم مث ىلإ كيدي لسغت مث ،فيظن بوثب هففجت مث لخد ام نطقلا نم هتدعقم يف لخدتو ،سبأ لاف تدز نفإ .هنفكت مث ،نيتبكرلا ىلإ كيلجرو قفارملا يتلا ىلولأا ةرجلا :لقا نأ ىلإ اديدش امض هيذخف مضتو ،ةريرذو نطقلا نم ائيش هتدعقم لىع لعجتو أدبت ءامب ةثلاثلا ةرجلاو ةبح فصن ردق اتف اهيف تفي روفاكلا ءامب ةيناثلا ةرجلاو ردسلا ءامب تيملا اهب لسغي .حارقلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he was asked about washing the deceased. He said: Begin by placing a cloth over his private parts, then sprinkle water on his chest and knees. Then start by washing the head and beard with sidr (lote tree leaves) until they are clean. Then begin with the right side, then the left side. If you wash his head and beard with marshmallow plant it is fine. Pass your hand over his back and belly with a pour of water until you finish with them, then with a pour containing camphor- put half a grain of camphor in the pour. Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings Then wash his head and beard, then his right side, then his left side, and pass your hand over his entire body. Raise his head and beard slightly, then pass your hand over his belly and squeeze it gently until whatever comes out emerges from his exit. Have a cloth on your hands to clean his back passage. Then tilt his head slightly and shake it until whatever comes out emerges from his nostrils. Then wash him with a pour of pure water- so that makes three pours, and if you add more it's fine. Insert cotton into his anus as needed, then dry him with a clean cloth. Then wash your hands up to the elbows and your feet up to the knees, then shroud him. Begin by placing some cotton and dharira (fragrant powder) on his anus, and press his thighs together firmly. Then he said: The first pour used to wash the deceased is with sidr (lote tree leaves) water, the second pour with camphor water containing half a grain of crushed camphor, and the third pour with pure water.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر (ملاسلا هيلع) بلاط يبأ نب ليع لسغ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع سأرلا ةدودشم ةبرقب ةثلاثلبا اعدو ،كسم نم لاقثمو روفاك نم ليقاثم ةثلاث ةيناثلاو ،ردسلبا هأدب (هلآو .(ملاسلا هيلع) هجردأ مث ،هيلع اهضفافأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) washed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) starting with sidr (lote tree leaves), and the second with three mithqals of camphor and one mithqal of musk, and for the third he called for a water skin with its head tied and poured it over him, then wrapped him (peace be upon him).

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: .سبأ لاف يمطخلبا هتيحلو تيملا سأر تلسغ نإ :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said: If you wash the deceased's head and beard with marshmallow plant, there is no problem.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: .هريفاظأ للخت لا :تيملا لسغ هيف فصي ليوط ثيدح يف (ملاسلا هيلع) لقاو
englishText: And he (peace be upon him) said in a long hadith describing the washing of the deceased: Do not clean between his fingernails.

chapter: Manner Of Ghusl Al-Mayyit And A Summary Of Its Rulings
arabicText: نأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) مهنع رابخلاا ترتاوت :لقا هنأ ليقع يبأ نبا نع لاقن (فلتخملا) يف ةملاعلا ىورو .تلاسغ ثلاث هصيمق يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لسغ (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع
englishText: Al-Allamah narrated in (Al-Mukhtalif), quoting from Ibn Abi Aqeel that he said: The reports have been frequently narrated from them (peace be upon them) that Ali (peace be upon him) washed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) in his shirt three times.

chapter: Ghusl Al-Mayyit Is Like Ghusl Al-Janabah
arabicText: ءاملا هيلع درف رعشلا ريثك ناك نإو ،بنجلا لسغ لثم تيملا لسغ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .تارم ثلاث
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Ghusl al-mayyit is like ghusl al janabah, and if they have abundant hair then water should be poured over them three times.

chapter: Ghusl Al-Mayyit Is Like Ghusl Al-Janabah
arabicText: مل تيملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ لأس لاجر نإ :- ثيدح يف - لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ام انئاك ،هنم اهنيعب اهنم قلخ يتلا ةفطنلا تجرخ ندبلا نم حورلا تجرخ اذإ :لقا ؟ةبانجلا لسغ لسغي .ةبانجلا لسغ لسغي كلذلف ،ىثنأ وأ اركذ ،اريبك وأ اريغص ،ناك
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said- in a hadith: A man asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about why the deceased must be washed like ghusl for janabah? He said: When the soul leaves the body, the sperm from which they were created exits from them, regardless of who they are, young or old, male or female, and that is why they are washed like ghusl al-janabah.

chapter: Ghusl Al-Mayyit Is Like Ghusl Al-Janabah
arabicText: .اهب يمري اهنم قلخ يتلا ةفطنلا :لقا ؟ىنمي تيملا لبا ام لئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He was asked why does the deceased discharge? He said: The sperm from which they were created is expelled.

chapter: Ghusl Al-Mayyit Is Like Ghusl Al-Janabah
arabicText: نم اهنم قلخ يتلا ةفطنلا هنم جرخت ىتح تومي لا قولخملا نإ لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نب ليع نع .هريغ نم وأ هيف
englishText: From Ali bin Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) who said: The created being does not die until the sperm from which they were created exits from them, either from their mouth or elsewhere.

chapter: Ghusl Al-Mayyit Is Like Ghusl Al-Janabah
arabicText: ،هينيع نم جرخت اهنم قلخ يتلا ةفطنلا هنم جرخت :لقا ؟تيملا لسغي ةلع يلأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لئس .هيف نم وأ
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) was asked for what reason is the deceased washed? He said: The sperm from which they were created exits from them, it exits from their eyes or their mouth.

chapter: Ghusl Al-Mayyit Is Like Ghusl Al-Janabah
arabicText: ةلع يلأ تيملا لسغ نع (ملاسلا امهيلع) ليع نب دمحم رفعج باأ تلأس :لقا ينيوزقلا الله دبع يبأ نع كلذكو ،رهاط وهو ةكئلاملا هيقلاتلو ،بنج هنلأ تيملا لسغي :لقا ؟لساغلا لستغي ةلع يلأو ؟لسغي .نينمؤملا هيقلايل لساغلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah Al-Qazwini who said: I asked Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali (peace be upon them both) about ghusl al-mayyit- for what reason is it done? And for what reason does the washer perform ghusl? He said: The deceased is washed because they are in a state of janabah (sexual impurity), and so that the angels meet them while they are pure, and likewise the washer does so to meet the believers.

chapter: Ghusl Al-Mayyit Is Like Ghusl Al-Janabah
arabicText: اهنم قلخ يتلا ةفطنلا :لقا ؟لسغي تيملا لبا ام لئس هنأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع .اهب يمري
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon them both) that he was asked why is the deceased washed? He said: The sperm from which they were created is expelled.

chapter: Ghusl Al-Mayyit Is Like Ghusl Al-Janabah
arabicText: تام اذفإ :هيف لوقي اثيدح ركذف ؟ةبانجلا لسغ لسغي مل تيملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ باأ تلأس .ةبانجلا لسغ لسغي تيملا راص مث نمف ،اهنم قلخ يتلا ينعي ،اهنيعب ةفطنلا كلت هنم تلاس
englishText: I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about a deceased person who was not given the ghusl for janabah (sexual impurity)? He mentioned a hadith in which he said: When a person dies, that same sperm from which he was created flows out of him, and that is why the deceased is given the ghusl for janabah.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Those Who Die In Water
arabicText: .نفكيو لسغي مث تام دق هنأ ملعيو ريغتي ىتح سبحي قيرغلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): The drowned person should be kept until their condition changes and it is known that they have died, then they should be washed and shrouded.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Those Who Die In Water
arabicText: .لسغي قيرغلا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) used to say: The drowned person should be washed.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Those Who Die In Water
arabicText: جرخا هجارخإ نكمأ نإ (:لقا نأ ىلإ) تامف لجر هيف عقو جرخم رئب يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .نفدو لسغو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who fell into an exposed well and died (until he said:) if it is possible to retrieve him, he should be retrieved, washed, and buried.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Those Who Die In Water
arabicText: .لسغي قيرغلا :لوقي ناك هنأ (ملاسلا امهيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ نع ،الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah, from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon them both) that he used to say: The drowned person should be washed.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Those Who Die In Water
arabicText: .ءربتسيو معن :لقا ؟لسغيأ قيرعلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the drowned person, should they be washed? He said: Yes, and they should be thoroughly cleaned.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing Those Who Die In Water
arabicText: .نيفصلا نيب لتق ام لاإ ئش لكو عبسلا ليكأو ،قيرغلا ،ىتوملا لك لسغأ لقا
englishText: He said: Wash all the dead: the drowned person, the one eaten by predators, and everything except those killed between the battle lines.

chapter: Recommendation Of Directing The Deceased Towards The Qibla During Washing, Like A Dying Person, And That It Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: هلعجت لاو ةلبقلا ههجوب لبقتسفا ةلبقلل تيملا تهجو اذإو :لقا (ثيدح) يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .سانلا لعجي امك اضرتعم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith, he said: When you direct the deceased towards the qibla, face his face towards the qibla and do not place him crosswise as people do.

chapter: Recommendation Of Directing The Deceased Towards The Qibla During Washing, Like A Dying Person, And That It Is Not Obligatory
arabicText: وأ ،ةلبقلا وحن ههجو اهجوم ،لستغملا لىع عضوي فيك تيملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) اضرلا نسحلا باأ تلأس .هربق يف عضوي امك عضو رهط اذفإ ،رسيت فيك عضوي :لقا ؟ةلبقلا وحن ههجوو هنيمي لىع عضوي
englishText: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him) about how the deceased should be placed on the washing table, should his face be directed towards the qibla, or should he be placed on his right side with his face towards the qibla? He said: Place him however is convenient, and when he is purified, place him as he would be placed in his grave.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu For The Deceased Before Bathing And Its Non-obligation
arabicText: .ركذ مث .ةلاصلا ءوضو أضوي مث هجرفب ءدبي تيملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Start with the deceased's private parts then perform wudu like that for prayer. Then he mentioned.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu For The Deceased Before Bathing And Its Non-obligation
arabicText: ءوضو أضويو هجرف لسغي مث ةقرخ هيلع حرطت :لقا ،؟تيملا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس حاحص تقارو عبس هيف حرطي حارقلا ءاملبا مث ،روفاكلاو ءاملبا مث ،نانشلأاو ردسلبا هسأر لسغي مث ،ةلاصلا .ءاملا يف ردسلا قرو نم
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about washing the deceased? He said: Place a cloth over them, then wash their private parts and perform wudu like that for prayer, then wash their head with sir (lote tree leaves) and ashnan (*), then with water and camphor, then with pure water in which seven whole sidr (lote tree leaves) are placed. Translator: * Ashes derived from certain plants commonly known as saltworts or glassworts. Their ashes contain high levels of sodium carbonate or potassium carbonate, which have cleansing and softening properties. The ash is mixed with water to create a cleaning solution for washing the deceased.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu For The Deceased Before Bathing And Its Non-obligation
arabicText: اؤدبيلف اهولسغي نأ اودارفأ ةأرملا تيفوت اذإ :لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نأ كلام نب سنأ مأ نع .اهيكرحت لاف لىبح تناك نفإ لىبح نكت مل نإ اقيفر احسم حسمتلف اهنطبب مث ،اهلسغ ينسحفأ اهيلسغفا ةفسرك يذخ مث ،اريتس باوث اهتروع لىع يقلفأ اهيلفسب أدبفا اهلسغ تدرأ اذفإ ءامب اهيئضو مث ،اهيضوت نأ لبق اهحسم ينسحأو تارم ثلاث فسركب اهحيسمفا بوثلا تحت نم كدي ليخدا .ردس هيف
englishText: From Umm Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When a woman dies and they want to wash her, they should start with her abdomen and wipe it gently if she is not pregnant, but if she is pregnant do not move her. Recommendation Of Performing Wudu For The Deceased Before Bathing A... When you want to wash her, start with her lower parts and place a concealing cloth over her private parts, then take cotton and wash her thoroughly, then insert your hand under the cloth and wipe her with cotton three times and wipe her well before performing wudu on her, then perform wudu on her with water containing sidr (lote tree leaves).

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu For The Deceased Before Bathing And Its Non-obligation
arabicText: مهنإ :لقا مث !ينب يا بتكا :يل لقاو ،ىفوت اذإ هلسغأ نأ ينرمأ يبأ نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هيضوت مث ،هيدي لسغتف ءدبت :لقا مث ،هلوقو دعأ تسلو يبأ باتك اذه :مهل لقف عنصت ام فلاخب كنورميأ .اردسو و ءام ذختأ مث ،ةلاصلا ءوضو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: My father ordered me to wash him when he dies, and said to me: Write, my son! Then he said: They will order you differently from what you do, so tell them: This is my father's writing and I will not deviate from his words. Then he said: Start by washing his hands, then perform wudu on him like that for prayer, then take water and lotus leaves.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu For The Deceased Before Bathing And Its Non-obligation
arabicText: لاإ ءوضو لسغ لك يف :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع هريغ وأ نامثع نب دامح ثيدح مدقت دقو .ةبانجلا
englishText: The previous hadith of Hammad bin Uthman or others from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) has been mentioned saying: In every ghusl there is wudu except for (the ghusl of) janabah (sexual impurity).

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu For The Deceased Before Bathing And Its Non-obligation
arabicText: هلسغأ مث ،هيضوأ مث هنطب رصعأ نأ ينرمأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،رامع نب ةيواعم ثيدحو .نانشلأبا
englishText: And the hadith of Muawiya bin Ammar, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He ordered me to press his abdomen then perform wudu on him, then wash him with ashnan (*). Translator: * Ashes derived from certain plants commonly known as saltworts or glassworts. Their ashes contain high levels of sodium carbonate or potassium carbonate, which have cleansing and softening properties. The ash is mixed with water to create a cleaning solution for washing the deceased.

chapter: Recommendation Of Performing Wudu For The Deceased Before Bathing And Its Non-obligation
arabicText: ةيفيك ركذف ؟ءوضو هيفأ تيملا لسغ نع (ملاسلا هيلع) حلاصلا دبعلا لأس هنأ نيطقي نب بوقعي ثيدحو .ءوضولا ركذي ملو لسغلا نع لاخ اهرثكأ ةقباسلا لسغلا ةيفيك ثيداحأو ،ءوضولا نع يزجي لسغ لك نأ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ ءوضو بوجو مدع لىع لدي امم كلذ ريغو ،ةبانجلا لسغ لثم تيملا لسغ نأ لىع لد ام اذكو ،ءوضولا ركذ ضعب يف خيشلا ملاك رهاظو ،خسنلاو ةيقتلا تلمتحا نإو اهب لمعلبا سبأ لا هبابحتسا ثيداحأو تيملا .ملعأ اللهو ،هلامعتسا كرتو انه ءوضولا يفن لىع ةيماملإا عامجإ لقن هبتك
englishText: And the hadith of Yaqub bin Yaqtin that he asked Al-Abd Al-Salih (peace be upon him) about washing the deceased, is there ablution in it? He described the washing procedure but did not mention wudu. I (Hurr Amili) say: What has preceded indicates that any ritual bath suffices for wudu, and most of the previous hadiths about washing procedures are devoid of mentioning wudu, as well as what indicates that ghusl al-mayyit is like ghusl al-janabah, and other evidence indicating that wudu for the deceased is not obligatory. The hadiths recommending it are acceptable to act upon even if they might involve taqiyyah or abrogation. The apparent meaning of the Shaykh's words in some of his books conveys the consensus of the Imamiyyah on negating wudu here and not using it, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Recommendation Of Personally Performing The Ghusl Al Mayyit And Supplications For Them From Traditions
arabicText: دق نمؤملا كدبع ندب اذه مهللا :هبلق اذإ لاقف انمؤم لسغ نمؤم اميأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .رئابكلا لاإ ةنس بونذ هل الله رفغ لاإ كوفع كوفعف امهنيب تقرفو هنم هحور تجرخأ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Any believer who washes a believer and says while turning him: "O Allah, this is the body of Your believing servant, You have taken his soul from him and separated between them, so [grant] Your pardon, Your pardon," Allah will forgive him the sins of a year except for the major sins.

chapter: Recommendation Of Personally Performing The Ghusl Al Mayyit And Supplications For Them From Traditions
arabicText: افع لاإ كوفع كوفع بر يا :هلسغي وهو لوقيو انمؤم لسغي نمؤم نم ام :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هنع الله
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: There is no believer who washes a believer and says while washing him: "O Lord, Your pardon, Your pardon," except that Allah pardons him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Personally Performing The Ghusl Al Mayyit And Supplications For Them From Traditions
arabicText: :لاقف ؟ىتوملا لسغ نمل ام بر يا :لقا هبر ىسوم هب جينا اميف ناك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .همأ هتدلو امك هبونذ نم هلسغأ
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: Among what Moses confided with his Lord was that he said: "O Lord, what is [the reward] for one who washes the deceased?" He said: "I will wash him from his sins just as his mother bore him."

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing What The Washer Sees Of The Deceased Until Burial, And The Impermissibility Of Revealing What Disgraces Them
arabicText: ؟ةناملأا هيف يدؤي فيكو :تلق ،هل رفغ ةناملأا هيف ىدفأ اتيم لسغ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ىري امب ربخي لا :لقا
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever washes a deceased person and fulfills the trust in it will be forgiven. I asked: And how does one fulfill the trust in it? He said: He does not tell what he sees.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing What The Washer Sees Of The Deceased Until Burial, And The Impermissibility Of Revealing What Disgraces Them
arabicText: .همأ هتدلو مويك بونذلا نم جرخ متكو رتسف اتيم لسغ نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا
englishText: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Whoever washes a deceased person and conceals and keeps secret [what he sees] will emerge from sins as the day his mother bore him.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing What The Washer Sees Of The Deceased Until Burial, And The Impermissibility Of Revealing What Disgraces Them
arabicText: :لقا ؟ةناملأا هيف يدؤي فيكو :ليق ،هل الله رفغ ةناملأا هيف ىدفأ انمؤم اتيم لسغ نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) لقا .تيملا نفدي نأ ىلإ هدحو ،ىري امب ربخي لا
englishText: He (peace be upon him) said: Whoever washes a deceased believer and fulfills the trust in it, Allah will forgive him. It was asked: And how does one fulfill the trust in it? He said: He does not tell what he sees, until the deceased is buried.

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing What The Washer Sees Of The Deceased Until Burial, And The Impermissibility Of Revealing What Disgraces Them
arabicText: الله رفغ ةناملأا هيف ىدفأ اتيم انمؤم لسغ نم :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،نانس نب الله دبع نع .ىري امب ربخي لا :لقا ؟ةناملأا هيف يدؤي فيكو :ليق ،هل
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Whoever washes a deceased believer and fulfills the trust in it, Allah will forgive him. It was asked: And how does one fulfill the trust in it? He said: He does not tell what he sees. Recommendation Of Concealing What The Washer Sees Of The Deceased U...

chapter: Recommendation Of Concealing What The Washer Sees Of The Deceased Until Burial, And The Impermissibility Of Revealing What Disgraces Them
arabicText: لكب هل ناك ةناملأا هيف ىدفأ اتيم لسغ نم :ةليوط ةبطخ يف لقا هنأ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نع ،ةجرد ةأم هل عفرو ،ةبقر قتع هنم ةرعش هنيشو هتروع رتسي مل نإو هنيش رتسيو هتروع رتسي :لقا ؟ةناملأا هيف ىدؤي فيكو الله لوسر يا :ليق .ةرخلآاو ايندلا يف هتروع تفشكو هرجأ طبح
englishText: From the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that he said in a long sermon: Whoever washes a deceased person and fulfills the trust in it, for every hair on them he will receive the reward of freeing a slave, and will be raised one hundred degrees. It was asked: O Messenger of Allah, how does one fulfill the trust in it? He said: He covers their private parts and conceals their flaws, and if he does not cover their private parts and flaws, his reward will be nullified and his private parts will be exposed in this world and the hereafter.

chapter: Recommendation Of Being Gentle With The Deceased During Washing And The Dislike Of Harshness
arabicText: .لاصفم هل اوزمغت لاو هورصعت لاو هب اوقفرفا مكنم تيملا متلسغ اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When you wash your deceased, be gentle with them and do not squeeze them or press their joints.

chapter: Recommendation Of Being Gentle With The Deceased During Washing And The Dislike Of Harshness
arabicText: اتيم تلسغ اذإ :لقا ،لسغا ينإ :تلق ؟نسحت وأ :لقا ،ىتوملا لسغا ينإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق .روفاكب هعماسم (نم) ائيش نبرقت لاو (هرصعت) لاو هب قفرفا
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): I wash the deceased. He said: Do you do it well? I said: I wash. He said: When you wash a deceased, be gentle with them and do not squeeze them, and do not put any camphor near their ears.

chapter: Recommendation Of Being Gentle With The Deceased During Washing And The Dislike Of Harshness
arabicText: ،هناز لاإ ئش لىع عضوي مل قفرلا نإ :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .هناش لاإ ئش نم عزنو
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gentleness was not placed in anything except that it adorned it, and was not removed from anything except that it marred it.

chapter: Recommendation Of Being Gentle With The Deceased During Washing And The Dislike Of Harshness
arabicText: .موش قرخلاو ،نمي قفرلا :(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Gentleness brings good fortune, and roughness brings misfortune.

chapter: Dislike Of Washing The Deceased With Water Heated By Fire Unless The Washer Fears Cold For Themselves
arabicText: .تيملل ءاملا نخسي لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Water should not be heated for the deceased.

chapter: Dislike Of Washing The Deceased With Water Heated By Fire Unless The Washer Fears Cold For Themselves
arabicText: .اميمح اءام تيملا برقي لا لاقا (ع) الله دبع يبأو رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon them), they both said: Hot water should not be brought near the deceased.

chapter: Dislike Of Washing The Deceased With Water Heated By Fire Unless The Washer Fears Cold For Themselves
arabicText: .كسمب طنحي لاو ،رانلا هل لجعت لا (ءاملا تيملل) نخسي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Water should not be heated for the deceased, do not hasten fire for him, and he should not be embalmed with musk.

chapter: Dislike Of Washing The Deceased With Water Heated By Fire Unless The Washer Fears Cold For Themselves
arabicText: .تيملل ءاملا نخسي لا :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Water should not be heated for the deceased.

chapter: Dislike Of Washing The Deceased With Water Heated By Fire Unless The Washer Fears Cold For Themselves
arabicText: .كسفن هنم ىقوت امم تيملا ىقوتف ادربا اءاتش نوكي نأ لاإ :رخآ (ثيدح) يف ىورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it was narrated in another hadith: Unless it is cold winter, then protect the deceased from what you would protect yourself from.

chapter: Prohibition Of Removing Any Hair Or Nail From The Deceased, And If Done, Placing It With Him In The Shroud, And The Dislike Of Pressing His Joints
arabicText: .هنفك يف هلعجفا ئش هنم طقس نإو رفظ لاو رعش تيملا نم سمي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Nothing of hair or nail should be touched from the deceased, and if anything falls from him, place it in his shroud.

chapter: Prohibition Of Removing Any Hair Or Nail From The Deceased, And If Done, Placing It With Him In The Shroud, And The Dislike Of Pressing His Joints
arabicText: وأ ،لسغ اذإ تيملا ةناع قلحي نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ هرك لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رعش هلزجي وأ رفظ هل ملقي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) disliked shaving the pubic hair of the deceased when washing him, or cutting his nails, or cutting his hair.

chapter: Prohibition Of Removing Any Hair Or Nail From The Deceased, And If Done, Placing It With Him In The Shroud, And The Dislike Of Pressing His Joints
arabicText: قلحيف رعشلا هيلع نوكي تيملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس لقا الله دبع يبأ نب نامحرلا دبع نع .هنفداو هلسغا ئش هنم سمي لا لقا ؟ملقي وأ هنع
englishText: From Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Abdullah, he said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the deceased who has hair, should it be shaved from him or trimmed? He said: Nothing of it should be touched, wash him and bury him.

chapter: Prohibition Of Removing Any Hair Or Nail From The Deceased, And If Done, Placing It With Him In The Shroud, And The Dislike Of Pressing His Joints
arabicText: وأ ،هتناع هل قلحي وأ ،رعش هل صقي وأ ،رفظ تيملا نم صقي نأ هرك :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لصفم هل زمغي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: It is disliked to cut the nail of the deceased, or cut his hair, or shave his pubic hair, or press his joints. Prohibition Of Removing Any Hair Or Nail From The Deceased, And If ...

chapter: Prohibition Of Removing Any Hair Or Nail From The Deceased, And If Done, Placing It With Him In The Shroud, And The Dislike Of Pressing His Joints
arabicText: نإ هتناع قلحتو هاطبإ فتنتو هريفاظأ ملقتأ ىفوتي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ لأس هنأ دوراجلا يبأ نع .لا :لاقف ؟ضرملا نم هب تلاط
englishText: From Abu Al-Jaroud that he asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a man who dies, should his nails be cut, his armpits plucked, and his pubic hair shaved if his illness was prolonged? He said: No.

chapter: Prohibition Of Removing Any Hair Or Nail From The Deceased, And If Done, Placing It With Him In The Shroud, And The Dislike Of Pressing His Joints
arabicText: .لاصفم هل اوزمغت لاو هورصعت لاو هب اوقفرفا مكنم تيملا متلسغ اذإ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When you wash your deceased, be gentle with him, do not squeeze him, and do not press any of his joints.

chapter: On The Miscarried Fetus - If It Has Completed Four Months It Should Be Washed, And If It Has Completed Six Months Or More Then Its Ruling Is Like Other Deceased
arabicText: ؟نفكلاو دحللاو لسغلا نع بجي هتقلخ توتسا اذإ طقسلا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ىوتسا اذإ هيلع بجي كلذ لك معن :لقا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about the miscarried fetus when its creation is complete, is washing, burial in a grave, and shrouding obligatory? He said: Yes, all of that is obligatory when it is complete.

chapter: On The Miscarried Fetus - If It Has Completed Four Months It Should Be Washed, And If It Has Completed Six Months Or More Then Its Ruling Is Like Other Deceased
arabicText: امهيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا نأ كلذو ،متا وهف رهشأ ةتس هل مت اذإ :لقاو لسغ رهشأ ةعبرأ (طقسلا متأ) اذإ .رهشأ ةتس نبا وهو دلو (ملاسلا
englishText: If (the miscarried fetus) completes four months it should be washed, and he said: If it completes six months then it is complete, and that is because Al-Husayn bin Ali (peace be upon them both) was born at six months.

chapter: On The Miscarried Fetus - If It Has Completed Four Months It Should Be Washed, And If It Has Completed Six Months Or More Then Its Ruling Is Like Other Deceased
arabicText: نبا وهو دلو ليع نب نيسحلا نأ كلذو ،متا وهف رهشأ ةتسل طقس اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رهشأ ةتس
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: If it miscarries at six months then it is complete, and that is because Al-Husayn bin Ali was born at six months.

chapter: On The Miscarried Fetus - If It Has Completed Four Months It Should Be Washed, And If It Has Completed Six Months Or More Then Its Ruling Is Like Other Deceased
arabicText: .لسغ رهشأ ةعبرأ هل مت اذإ طقسلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: The miscarried fetus, when it completes four months, should be washed. On The Miscarried Fetus - If It Has Completed Four Months It Should...

chapter: On The Miscarried Fetus - If It Has Completed Four Months It Should Be Washed, And If It Has Completed Six Months Or More Then Its Ruling Is Like Other Deceased
arabicText: يف همدب نفدي طقسلا :ىلإ بتكف ؟هب عنصي فيك طقسلا نع هلأسأ (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ ىلإ تبتك .هعضوم .دوصقملا ضعب لىع لدي ام يتيأو ،رهشأ ةعبرأ نم لقلأ دلو نم لىع خيشلا هلمح :لوقأ
englishText: I wrote to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) asking him about the miscarried fetus, how should it be handled? He wrote back: The miscarried fetus should be buried with its blood in its place. I (Hurr Amili) say: The Shaykh interpreted it as referring to one born less than four months, and what follows will indicate some of what is intended.

chapter: When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A Non-muhrim, Except That He Should Not Be Touched With Camphor Or Any Other Perfume And Should Not Be Embalmed
arabicText: تام نسحلا نبا نامحرلا دبع نإ :لقا ؟هب عنصي فيك تومي مرحملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس نب الله دبعو سابعلا نب الله دبع (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا عمو ،مرحم وهو (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا عم ءاوبلابا هيلع) ليع باتك يف ناك كلذو :لقا ،ابيط هسمي ملو ههجو ىطغو ،تيملبا عنصي امك هب عنصو ،رفعج .(ملاسلا
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about what should be done with a Muhrim who dies? He said: Indeed Abdur Rahman ibn Al-Hasan died at Al-Abwa while with Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) while in state of Ihram, and with Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) were Abdullah ibn Abbas and Abdullah ibn Ja'far, and they treated him as a normal deceased person is treated, and covered his face but did not apply perfume to him. He said: And that was in the book of Ali (peace be upon him).

chapter: When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A Non-muhrim, Except That He Should Not Be Touched With Camphor Or Any Other Perfume And Should Not Be Embalmed
arabicText: :لاقف ؟تومي مرحملا نع هتلأس ،لقا ةعامس نع ،ىسيع نب نامثع نع ،نيسحلا نب دمحم نع ،هنعو .بيطلا سمي لا هنأ ريغ ،لحملبا عنصي امك هب عنصيو ههجو ىطغيو ،اهلك بايثلبا نفكيو لسغي
englishText: From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about a Muhrim who dies? He said: He is washed and shrouded in all the clothes, and his face is covered, and he is treated as a non-Muhrim is treated, except that he is not touched with perfume.

chapter: When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A Non-muhrim, Except That He Should Not Be Touched With Camphor Or Any Other Perfume And Should Not Be Embalmed
arabicText: نب نسحلا نب نامحرلا دبع نأ ينثدحف ؟هب عنصي فيك تومي مرحملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس رفعج نب الله دبع و سابعلا نب الله دبع نيسحلا عمو ،مرحم وهو ليع نب نيسحلا عم ءاوبلابا تام ليع .(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع باتك يف كلذو :لقا ،ابيط هسمي ملو ههجو ىطغو تيملبا عنص امك هب عنصف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about what should be done with a Muhrim who dies? He narrated to me that Abdur Rahman ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali died at Al Abwa while with Al-Husayn ibn Ali while in state of Ihram, and with Al-Husayn were When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A... Abdullah ibn Abbas and Abdullah ibn Ja'far, so they treated him as a deceased person is treated and covered his face but did not apply perfume to him. He said: And that is in the book of Ali (peace be upon him).

chapter: When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A Non-muhrim, Except That He Should Not Be Touched With Camphor Or Any Other Perfume And Should Not Be Embalmed
arabicText: هب عنصيو ههجو ىطغي :لقا ؟هب عنصي فيك تام اذإ مرحملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع .ابيط هبرقي لا هنأ ريغ ،للاحلبا عنصي امك
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about what should be done with a Muhrim when he dies? He said: His face is covered and he is treated as a non Muhrim is treated, except that he is not brought near to perfume.

chapter: When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A Non-muhrim, Except That He Should Not Be Touched With Camphor Or Any Other Perfume And Should Not Be Embalmed
arabicText: و سابعلا انبا الله ديبعو الله دبع و (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نب نيسحلا جرخ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ملو هونفكو هولسغف مرحم وهو ءاوبلابا تامف نامحرلا دبع :هل لاقي نسحلل نبا مهعمو رفعج نب الله دبع .هونفدو هسأرو ههجو اورمخو هوطنحي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him), Abdullah and Ubaydullah the sons of Abbas, and Abdullah ibn Ja'far went out, and with them was a son of Al-Hasan called Abdur Rahman, and he died at Al-Abwa while in state of Ihram, so they washed him and shrouded him but did not embalm him, and they covered his face and head and buried him.

chapter: When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A Non-muhrim, Except That He Should Not Be Touched With Camphor Or Any Other Perfume And Should Not Be Embalmed
arabicText: .ايبلم الله هثعب امرحم تام نم :(ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا لقا :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Al-Husayn said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: Whoever dies while in state of Ihram, Allah will resurrect him saying "Labbayk" (Here I am at Your service).

chapter: When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A Non-muhrim, Except That He Should Not Be Touched With Camphor Or Any Other Perfume And Should Not Be Embalmed
arabicText: سمي لاو ،طنحي لاو ههجو ىطغيو نفكيو لسغي :لقا :تومي مرحملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ نع .بيطلا نم ائيش
englishText: From Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) regarding a Muhrim who dies: He said: He is washed and shrouded and his face is covered but he is not embalmed, and he is not touched with anything from perfume.

chapter: When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A Non-muhrim, Except That He Should Not Be Touched With Camphor Or Any Other Perfume And Should Not Be Embalmed
arabicText: نسحلا هعمو مرحم وهو ءاوبلابا ليع نب نسحلا نب نامحرلا دبع ىفوت :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،هوطنحي ملو هسأرو ههجو اورمخو هونفكف ،سابعلا انبا الله ديبعو الله دبع و رفعج نب الله دبع و نيسحلاو .(ملاسلا هيلع) ليع باتك يف اذكه :لقاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Abd al-Rahman bin Al-Hasan bin Ali died at Al-Abwa while he was in the state of ihram, and with him were Al-Hasan, Al-Husayn, Abdullah bin Ja'far, and Abdullah and Ubaydullah sons of Al-Abbas. They shrouded him and covered his face and head but did not apply perfume to him, and he said: This is how it is in the book of Ali (peace be upon him).

chapter: When A Muhrim (Person In State Of Ihram) Dies, He Is Treated Like A Non-muhrim, Except That He Should Not Be Touched With Camphor Or Any Other Perfume And Should Not Be Embalmed
arabicText: بيطلا سمت لا :لقا ،؟ثماط يهو تومت ةمرحملا ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .للاح ةوسن اهعم نك نإو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a woman in ihram who dies while menstruating? He said: Do not apply perfume to her even if there are non-muhrim women with her.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: هب نكي مل نإو ،هيلع ليصو طنحو نفكو لسغ قمر هب ناك اذإ ديهشلا :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) قداصلا نع .هباوثأ يف نفك قمر
englishText: From Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: When a martyr still has signs of life, they should be washed, shrouded, embalmed and prayed upon. If they have no signs of life, they should be shrouded in their clothes.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: :لقاو ،هلسغب (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا رميأ ملف دحبأ بهارلا رماع يبأ نب ةلظنح دهشتساو :قودصلا لقا ليسغ ىمسي ناكو ،ةضف نم فاحص يف نزملا ءامب ةلظنح لسغت ضرلأاو ءامسلا نيب ةكئلاملا تيأر .ةكئلاملا
englishText: Al-Saduq said: Hanzala bin Abi Amir Al-Rahib was martyred at Uhud, and the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) did not order him to be washed, and said: I saw angels between heaven and earth washing Hanzala with cloud water in silver bowls, and he was called "the one washed by angels."

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: هب ناك نفإ ،نيفصلا نيب لتق ام لاإ ئش لكو ،عبسلا ليكأو ،قيرغلا :ىتوملا لك لسغا :لقا دلاخ يبأ نع .لاف لاإو لسغ قمر
englishText: From Abu Khalid who said: Wash all deceased: the drowned, those eaten by predators, and everything except those killed between battle lines. If they have signs of life, they are washed; if not, then no.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
