arabicText: وهو ةبتع نبا مشاه لاو رسيا نب رامع لسغي مل (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .امهيلع لصي ملو ،(امهبايث) يف امهنفدو ،لقارملا .ةلاص ريغب ةملأا نم دحأ كرتي لا نأ لصلأا نكل يور اذكه :لقا مث ،لاسرم قودصلا هاورو هجولا نوكي نأ زوجيو :لقا ،هنع طقست لا ةلاصلا نلا ،يوارلا نم مهو ،امهيلع لصي مل :هلوق :خيشلا لقاو لىع هلمحب رخآ عضوم يف مزجو ،مهل اقفاوم اذه جرخف (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع كلذ يورت ةماعلا نأ يف .ةيقتلا طقسو كلذ أزجفا ريغ امهيلع لىص ناك دق هنلأ ،هسفنب امهيلع لصي مل هنأ دارملا نوكي نأ زوجيو :لوقأ امهيلع لىص لب ،ةبجاولا ةلاصلا امهيلع لصي مل هلعلف امهيلع لىص هنأ رابخلأا ضعب يف يور نإو ،بوجولا ةلاصلبا رمأ هنأ دارملا نوكي وأ ،يتيأ امك امهل ءاعدلا كانه ةلاصلبا دارملا وأ ،سانلا امهيلع لىص ام دعب بادن .ةقيقح يفنلاو ،ايلقع ازاجم تابثلاا حصيف كلذ وحن وأ ،هريغب هلاغتشلا هسفنب هلعفي ملو امهيلع
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon him) that Ali (peace be upon him) did not wash Ammar bin Yasir nor Hashim ibn Utbah who is Al-Mirqal, and buried them in their clothes, and did not pray over them. Al-Saduq narrated it as mursal, then said: This is how it was narrated, but the principle is that no one from the ummah should be left without prayer. The Shaykh said: The statement "did not pray over them" is an error from the narrator, because the prayer is not waived for him. He said: It's possible that the general public narrates this from Ali (peace be upon him) so this came in agreement with them, and he confirmed in another place interpreting it as taqiyyah. I (Hurr Amili) say: It's possible that what's meant is that he didn't pray over them himself, because others had prayed over them which sufficed and fulfilled the obligation. And if it's narrated in some reports that he prayed over them, perhaps he didn't perform the obligatory prayer, but prayed over them voluntarily after people had prayed over them, or what's meant by prayer there is supplication for them as will come, or what's meant is that he ordered prayer over them but didn't do it himself due to being occupied with other matters, or something similar, so the affirmation is valid as rational metaphor, and the negation is literal.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: هوراوف دغلا نم وأ هموي نم ديهشلا تام اذإ (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع .لسغ هتحارج ريغتت ىتح امياأ يقب نإو ،هبايث يف امياأ يقبو ةكرعملا نم جرخ نم لىع لمحلا لمتحيو :لوقأ .هب لمعن انسلو ةماعلل قفاوم اذه خيشلا لقا .يتيأو مدقت امل تام مث قمر هبو
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When a martyr dies on the same day or the next, bury him in his clothes, and if he remains for days until his wounds change, wash him. The Shaykh said: This agrees with the general public and we don't act upon it. I (Hurr Amili) say: It could possibly be interpreted as referring to one who left the battlefield and remained for days with signs of life then died, based on what preceded and what will come. Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Mu...

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: معن :لقا ؟ديهشلا ةلزنمب يهأ ،تتام ىتح اهب اوباصفأ ودعلا اهرسأ ةأرما نع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لئس .اهسفن لىع تناعأ نوكت نأ لاإ
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about a woman who was captured by the enemy and they violated her until she died, is she considered a martyr? He said: Yes, unless she aided against herself.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: وه امك نفدي :لقا ؟طنحيو نفكيو لسغيأ ،الله ليبس يف لتقي يذلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نا ،هيلع لىصيو طنحيو نفكيو لسغي هنفإ تام مث قمر هب نوكي نأ لاإ هبايث يف .درج دق ناك هنلأ هنفكو ةزمح لىع لىص (هلآو
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about one who is killed in the way of Allah, should they be washed, shrouded and embalmed? He said: They should be buried as they are in their clothes unless they had signs of life then died, then they should be washed, shrouded, embalmed and prayed upon. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed over Hamza and shrouded him because he had been stripped.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: هئامدب هبايث يف معن لقا ؟هئامدب نفدي ديهشلا تيأر فيك :هل تلق :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع ةرارزو ،وه امك نفديو ،لسغي لاو طنحي لاو لىص) يبنلا هادرو ،اهيف بيصأ يتلا هئامدب هبايث يف ةزمح همع (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نفد :لقا مث هيلع ربكو ،ةلاص نيعبس هيلع لىصو ،هيلع هحرطف رخذبأ هل اعدف هيلجر نع رصقف ءادرب (هلآو هيلع الله .ةريبكت نيعبس
englishText: Zurarah narrated from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), saying: I asked him: What do you think about burying the martyr with his blood? He said: Yes, in his clothes with his blood, and he is not embalmed nor washed, and he is buried as he is. Then he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) buried his uncle Hamza in his clothes with the blood he was wounded with, and the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) covered him with a garment which was short for his feet, so he called for aromatic grass and placed it on him, and prayed seventy prayers over him, and made seventy takbirs.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: هكردي نأ لاإ لسغي لاو هبايث يف نفدي الله ليبس يف لتقي يذلا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس نفك (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر نإ ،طنحيو نفكيو لسغي هنفإ ،دعب تومي مث قمر هبو نوملسملا .هيلع لىص هنكلو ،هلسغي ملو هبايث يف ةزمح
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: The one who is killed in the way of Allah is buried in his clothes and is not washed unless Muslims find him while he still has life left and then he dies afterward, then he is washed, shrouded, and embalmed. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) shrouded Hamza in his clothes and did not wash him, but he prayed over him.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: ليوارسلاو ةقطنملاو ةمامعلاو ةوسنلقلاو فخلاو ورفلا ديهشلا نع عزني :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا .لح لاإ دوقعم ئش هيلع كرتي لاو كرت مد هباصأ نفإ ،مد هباصأ نوكي نأ لاإ
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Remove from the martyr the fur, boots, cap, turban, belt, and trousers unless they have blood on them; if they have blood on them, leave them, and do not leave anything tied on him except it should be untied.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: .مهبايثو مهئامدب مهولمز :دحأ ءادهش يف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) يبنلا لقا
englishText: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said regarding the martyrs of Uhud: Wrap them in their blood and clothes.

chapter: Rulings Regarding The Martyr And The Obligation Of Washing Every Muslim Deceased Except Them
arabicText: يف امهنفدو نيفص موي ةبتع نبا لاو رسيا نب رامع لسغي مل (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ هيبأ نع ،رفعج نع .امهيلع لىصو امهبايث
englishText: From Ja'far, from his father that Ali (peace be upon him) did not wash Ammar bin Yasir nor Ibn Utbah on the day of Siffin, and he buried them in their clothes and prayed over them.

chapter: Obligation Of Washing The One Killed In Disobedience And The Ruling On His Wounds And The Cutting Of His Head
arabicText: ةيصعم يف هسأر عطقف لتق لجر نع رضاح ناأو (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس :لقا ةبايس نب لاعلا نع ؟ديهشلبا لعفي ام هب لعفي مأ لسغيأ الله نيديلبا ءدبيو ،هدسج كلدي لاو ،ابص ءاملا هيلع بصي مث مدلا هنم لاوأ لسغي هتيصعم يف لتق اذإ :لاقف ،بصع نطقلا هيلع عضو اذإو ،طويخلاو نطقلبا هتاحارج طبريو ربدلاو قوف نطقلا عضوي مث ،طونحلا هيلع رذيو ريثك ئش نطقلا نم هل لعجيو ةبقرلا ىنعي سأرلا عضوم كلذكو .لعففا هبصعت نأ تعطتسا نإو ةبقرلا نيديلا لسغ اذإ سأرلا لسغي :لاقف ؟لسغي فيك هعم وهو دسجلا نم نبا دق سأرلا ناك نفإ :تلق ،نفكلا يف لعجيو سأرلا هيلإ مضيو ةبقرلا قوف نطقلا عضوي مث ،دسجلبا مث ،سأرلبا ءدب ةلفسلاو .ةلبقلل هتهجوو دحللا هتلخدأو دسجلا عم هتلوانت ربقلا ىلإ ترص اذإ كلذكو
englishText: From Al-'Ala ibn Sayaba who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked while I was present about a man who was killed and his head was cut off in disobedience to Allah- should he be washed or should he be treated as a martyr is treated? He said: When he is killed in his disobedience, first the blood should be washed from him, then water should be poured over him without rubbing his body. Start with the hands and back, and bind his wounds with cotton and threads. When cotton is placed on him, it should be tied. Similarly for the head area, meaning the neck, place a large amount of cotton on it and sprinkle camphor on it, then place cotton above the neck, and if you can bind it, do so. I asked: If the head was separated from the body but is present with it, how should it be washed? He said: Wash the head after washing the hands and lower parts, starting with the head, then the body. Then place cotton above the neck and join the head to it and place it in the shroud. And likewise when you reach the grave, take it with the body and place it in the tomb and direct it towards the qibla.

chapter: If There Is Fear Of The Deceased's Body Disintegrating, Pouring Water Over It Is Sufficient If Possible, Otherwise Tayammum Is Sufficient
arabicText: .ابص ءاملا هيلع بصي حورقلا هب يذلاو ريسكلاو رودجملا :لقا (ملاسلا امهيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon them both), he said: For the one with smallpox, the one with broken bones, and the one with wounds, water is to be poured over them.

chapter: If There Is Fear Of The Deceased's Body Disintegrating, Pouring Water Over It Is Sufficient If Possible, Otherwise Tayammum Is Sufficient
arabicText: .هيلع لىصي نأو ،ابص ءاملا هيلع اوبصي نأ مهرمفأ رانلبا قرتحي لجر نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) that he was asked about a man who was burned by fire, so he ordered them to pour water over him and to pray over him.

chapter: If There Is Fear Of The Deceased's Body Disintegrating, Pouring Water Over It Is Sufficient If Possible, Otherwise Tayammum Is Sufficient
arabicText: انل بحاص تام الله لوسر يا :اولاقف (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر اوتأ اموق نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع .هوممي لاقف خلسنا هانلسغ نفإ رودجم وهو
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him), he said: A group of people came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: O Messenger of Allah, a companion of ours has died and he had smallpox. If we wash him, his skin will peel off. So he said: Perform tayammum on him.

chapter: Whoever Is Sentenced To Stoning Or Execution Through Retribution Should Perform Ghusl, Apply Perfume (Hunut), And Wear Their Shroud, And This Becomes Void After Their Killing
arabicText: مث كلذ لبق نفكلا ناسبليو ناطنحيو نلاسغي ةموجرملاو موجرملا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هيلع لىصيو نفكلا سبليو طنحيو لسغي كلذ ةلزنمب هنم صتقملاو ،امهيلع لىصيو نامجري
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The man and woman to be stoned should perform ghusl, be perfumed, and wear their shrouds before that, then they are stoned and funeral prayers are performed for them, and the one to be executed in retribution is in the same position- they should perform ghusl, be perfumed, wear their shroud, and funeral prayers are performed for them.

chapter: Impermissibility Of A Muslim Washing, Burying, Or Shrouding A Deceased Non-Muslim, Even If They Are From The People Of The Book Or The Muslim's Relatives, Or Father, And Likewise With Rebels
arabicText: لا :لقا ،؟توميف نيملسملا عم وهو رفسلا يف نوكي ينارصنلا نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هباأ ناك نإو هربق لىع موقي لاو هنفدي لاو ،ةمارك لاو ملسم هلسغي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), that he was asked about a Christian who is traveling with Muslims and dies? He said: A Muslim should not wash him, there is no honor in that, nor should he bury him or stand at his grave, even if it was his father.

chapter: Impermissibility Of A Muslim Washing, Burying, Or Shrouding A Deceased Non-Muslim, Even If They Are From The People Of The Book Or The Muslim's Relatives, Or Father, And Likewise With Rebels
arabicText: هيلع لىصيو هنفكي نأو كرشملاو يمذلا هتبارق ملسملا ليسغت نع ىهنلا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هب ذوليو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), the prohibition of a Muslim washing his relative who is from the People of the Book or a polytheist, or shrouding them, praying over them, or associating with them.

chapter: Impermissibility Of A Muslim Washing, Burying, Or Shrouding A Deceased Non-Muslim, Even If They Are From The People Of The Book Or The Muslim's Relatives, Or Father, And Likewise With Rebels
arabicText: ةعيش هباحصأو يدع نب رجحب انعنص ام كغلب له :نيسحلل :لقا ةيواعم نأ نع (جاجتحلاا يف) يسربطلا هيلع) نيسحلا كحضف مهيلع انيلصو مهانفكو مهانلتق :لقا ؟مهب تعنص امو :(ملاسلا هيلع) لاقف ؟كيبأ .مهناربق لاو مهيلع انيلص لاو ،مهانفك ام كتعيش انلتق ول انكل ،ةيواعم يا موقلا كمصخ :لاقف ،(ملاسلا
englishText: Al-Tabarsi (in Al-Ihtijaj) narrated that Mu'awiyah said to Al-Husayn: Have you heard what we did with Hujr ibn Adi and his companions, the Shia of your father? So he (peace be upon him) said: What did you do with them? He said: We killed them, shrouded them, and prayed over them. Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) smiled and said: Those people will be your opponents on the Day of Judgment, O Mu'awiyah. If we had killed your Shia we would not have shrouded them, nor prayed over them, nor buried them.

chapter: Ruling On A Dhimmi (Non-Muslim Under Muslim Protection) Washing A Muslim If No Muslim Or Related Muslim Woman Is Present, And Likewise For A Dhimmiyah (Female Non-muslim) And Muslim Woman
arabicText: لاو ملسم لجر هعم سيلو ملسم لجر تام نفإ :تلق :لقا - ثيدح - يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع لستغي لقا ؟ةبارق نهنيبو هنيب سيل تاملسم ءاسنو ىراصن لاجر هعمو هتبارق يوذ نم ةملسم ةأرما ،رطضا دقف هنولسغي مث ىراصنلا لاجرو ةينارصن اهعمو اهتبارق يوذ نم ملسم لجر لاو ةملسم ةأرما اهعم سيلو تومت ةملسملا ةأرملا نعو .اهلسغت مث ةينارصنلا لستغت :لقا ؟نوملسم
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith, he said: I said: If a Muslim man dies and there is no Muslim man or Muslim woman from his relatives with him, but there are Christian men and Muslim women who are not related to him? He said: The Christians should perform ghusl (purification) and then wash him, as this is a case of necessity. And regarding a Muslim woman who dies and there is no Muslim woman or Muslim man from her relatives with her, but there is a Christian woman and Muslim men? He said: The Christian woman should perform ghusl and then wash her.

chapter: Ruling On A Dhimmi (Non-Muslim Under Muslim Protection) Washing A Muslim If No Muslim Or Related Muslim Woman Is Present, And Likewise For A Dhimmiyah (Female Non-muslim) And Muslim Woman
arabicText: سيلو انعم تيفوت ةأرما نإ :اولاقف رفن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىتأ :لقا (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع باتكلا لهأ نم ةأرما متدجو ام وأ :لاقف ،ابص ءاملا اهيلع انببص :اولاقف ؟متعنص فيك :لاقف ،مرحم وذ اهعم !؟اهوممي لافأ لقا ،لا :اولقا ؟اهلسغت
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him), he said: A group came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: A woman died among us and there was no mahram with her. He said: What did you do? They said: We poured water over her. He said: Could you not find a woman from the People of the Book to wash her? They said: No. He said: Why did you not perform tayammum on her?!

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: هتخأو همأو معن :لقا !اهلسغيأ هتأرما هعمو رفسلا يف جرخي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .ةقرخ اهتروع لىع ىقلي اذه وحنو
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who travels with his wife, can he wash her [after death]? He said: Yes, and [he can wash] his mother and sister and similar to these, placing a cloth over her private parts.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: لىع يقلي امهوحنو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - هتأرما عم رفاسي لجرلا :لقا هنأ لاإ !هلثم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهلسغي ةقرخ روع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) similar to it, except he said: The man travels with his wife- until he said- and similar to them, placing a cloth over the private parts to wash her.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: هلسغت :لقا ءاسنلا لاإ هلسغي نم هدنع سيلو تومي لجرلا نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ابص ءاملا هيلع ءاسنلا بصيو ،هل تناك نإ هتبارق تاذ وأ هتأرما
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he was asked about a man who dies and there are only women to wash him. He said: His wife or his female relative can wash him if he has one, and the women should pour water over him.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: ؟ءاسنلا هلسغت له ،ءاسنلا لاإ هلسغي نم هدنع سيلو تومي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .بايثلا قوف نم ابص ءاملا ءاسنلا هيلع بصتو ،همرحم تاذ وأ هتأرما هلسغت :لاقف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who dies and there are only women to wash him, can women wash him? He said: His wife or his mahram female relative can wash him, and women should pour water over him from above the clothes. Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice...

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: هعمو ملسم لجر هعم سيلو رفسلا يف تومي ملسملا لجرلا نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع يف هتلاخو هتمع هلسغت :لقا ؟هلسغ يف عنصي فيك ،ناتملسم هتلاخو هتمع هعمو ىراصن لاجر .ىراصنلا هبرقت لاو ،هصيمق :لقا ناملسم اهعم اهلاخو اهمعو ىراصن ءاسن اهعمو ةملسم ةأرما اهعم سيلو رفسلا يف تومت ةأرملا نعو .عردلا قوف نم ءاملا بصيف عرد اهيلع نوكي هنأ ريغ ،اهلسغت تناك امك ةينارصنلا اهنبرقت لاو اهنولسغي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he was asked about a Muslim man who dies while traveling and there is no Muslim man with him, but there are Christian men and his Muslim paternal and maternal aunts, how should he be washed? He said: His paternal and maternal aunts should wash him in his shirt, and the Christians should not approach him. And about a woman who dies while traveling and there is no Muslim woman with her, but there are Christian women and her Muslim paternal and maternal uncles with her. He said: They should wash her and the Christian women should not approach her as they would wash her, except that she should be wearing a shield and water should be poured from above the shield.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: هعم هتأرما نكت مل نإو هتأرما هتلسغ ءاسنلا عم لجرلا تام اذإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .ةقرخ اهيدي لىع فلتو هب نهلاوأ هتلسغ
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When a man dies among women, his wife should wash him, and if his wife is not with him, then the closest woman to him should wash him and wrap a cloth around her hands.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: نكي مل نإ :لقا ،اهريغ ةأرما مهعم سيل عضوم يف يهو تتام ةأرما نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس ريغ نم اهلسغيلف اهل محر وذ وأ اهجوز مهعم ناك نإو ،اهنولسغي لاو اهبايثب اهونفد محر وذ لاو جوز اهل مهيف .اهتروع ىلإ رظني نأ يف نفديلف ةأرما نهيف هل نكي مل نإ :لاقف ،لجر نهعم سيل ءاسن عم رفسلا يف تام لجر نع هتلأسو :لقا .هتروع ىلإ رظنت نأ ريغ نم صيمق يف لسغيلف ةأرما نهيف هل ناك نإو ،لسغي لاو هبايث
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who died in a place where there was no other woman with them. He said: If there is no husband or mahram relative with them, they should bury her in her clothes without washing her, and if her husband or mahram relative is with them, they should wash her without looking at her private parts. He said: And I asked him about a man who died while traveling with women and no man was with them. He said: If he doesn't have a wife among them, he should be buried in his clothes without washing, and if he has a wife among them, he should be washed in a shirt without looking at his private parts.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: اذإو - :لقا نأ ىلإ - رفسلا يف لجرلا تام اذإ لقا (ثيدح) يف (ملاسلا هيلع نع ،هئباآ نع ،ليع نب ديز نع .هجرف نسسمي لاو هدسج نسسميو .ابص ءاملا هيلع نببصيو هنرزؤي مرحم تاوذ ءاسن هعم ناك
englishText: From Zayd bin Ali, from his forefathers, from him (peace be upon him) in a hadith he said: If a man dies during travel- until he said:- and if there are women who are his mahrams with him, they should wrap him in a waist wrapper and pour water over him. They may touch his body but not touch his private parts.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: ،هنم مرحم تاذ ةأرما هلسغت :لقا ،ءاسن لاإ هدنع سيلو تام لجر نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس اهل مرحم لاو ةأرما اهعم سيلو لاجر اهعم تتام ةأرما تناك نإو ،هبوث علخت لاو ،ءاملا هيلع ءاسنلا بصتو .اهبايث قوف نم اهلسغ اهل مرحم وذ اهعم ناك نإو ،اهبايث يف يه امك نفدتلف
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who died and there were only women present with him. He said: A woman who is his mahram should wash him, and the women should pour water over him without removing his clothes. And if a woman died with men present and there was no woman or mahram with her, she should be buried as she is in her clothes. And if she had a mahram with her, he should wash her over her clothes.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: .ةأرما دجوت لا نأ لاإ ةأرملا لجرلا لسغي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A man should not wash a woman unless no woman can be found.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Woman Being Washed By Her Male Mahrams And Vice Versa, And The Recommendation Of Washing From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: ىلوأ لجر اهلسغي :لقا ،اهلسغت رما باصت لا ةيبصلا يف - ثيدح - يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهب سانلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in a hadith regarding a young girl when no woman can be found to wash her, he said: A man who is closest to her in relation should wash her.

chapter: Waiving The Washing Of A Deceased Woman When There Are No Women Or Mahram Men Present, And Similarly For Men
arabicText: :لقا ،ءاسن لاو مرحم وذ اهعم سيلو رفسلا يف تومت ةأرملا نع هلأس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .هبايثب وه امك نفدي :لقا ،لاجر نهعم سيل ءاسنلا لاإ هعم سيلو تومي لجرلا نعو ،اهبايثب يه امك نفدت
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he was asked about a woman who dies during travel and has no mahram or women with her. He said: She is buried as she is in her clothes. And about a man who dies and has only women with him, with no men present. He said: He is buried as he is in his clothes.

chapter: Waiving The Washing Of A Deceased Woman When There Are No Women Or Mahram Men Present, And Similarly For Men
arabicText: عم رفسلا يف تومي لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لئس هنأ روفعي يبأ نب الله دبع نع هدانسإبو .هنلسغي لاو هنفديو هبايث يف افل هنففلي :لقا ؟هب نعنصي فيك لجر هعم سيل ءاسنلا
englishText: And by his chain from Abdullah bin Abi Ya'fur that he asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who dies during travel with women when there is no man with him, how should they handle him? He said: They should wrap him in his clothes and bury him without washing him.

chapter: Waiving The Washing Of A Deceased Woman When There Are No Women Or Mahram Men Present, And Similarly For Men
arabicText: .لسغت لاو نفدتو فلت :لقا ،لاجر عم تتام ةأرما نع هتلأس :لقا الله دبع يبأ نب نامحرلا دبع نع
englishText: From Abdulrahman bin Abu Abdullah who said: I asked him about a woman who died among men. He said: She is wrapped and buried without washing.

chapter: Waiving The Washing Of A Deceased Woman When There Are No Women Or Mahram Men Present, And Similarly For Men
arabicText: نفدي :لقا ،ءاسنلا لاإ هعم سيل ضرأ يف رفسلا يف تومي لجرلا يف لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهعم اهجوز نوكي نأ لاإ لسغت لاو نفدت ةلزنملا كلتب لاجرلا عم نوكت ةأرملاو ،لسغي لاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said regarding a man who dies during travel in a land where only women are with him: He is buried without washing, and a woman who is with men is in the same position- she is buried without washing, unless her husband is with her. Shaykh Hurr Amili: And with his chain of narration from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn Sarhan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), similar to it. Al-Kulayni narrated it from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, similar to it, except that he said: On a journey or in the land. And he omitted from its end his saying: She should be buried and not washed.

chapter: Waiving The Washing Of A Deceased Woman When There Are No Women Or Mahram Men Present, And Similarly For Men
arabicText: سمخ نم لقأ تنب تناك اذإ :لاقف لجرلا عم تومت ةيراجلا يف يور :لقا ىيحي نب دمحأ نب دمحم نع ةفاانملا هرهاظ ام يتيأو ،هيلع لدي ام يتيأو ،كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقتو :لوقأ .لسغت ملو تنفد تس وأ نينس .بابحتسلاا لىع لومحم هنأو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya who said: It has been narrated regarding a girl who dies with a man, he said: If she is less than five or six years old, she is buried without washing.

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: اهل مهيف سيل لاجرلا عم رفسلا يف نوكت ةأرملا يف لوقت ام كادف تلعج (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق ،سمت لاو مميتلا هيلع الله بجوأ ام اهنم لسغي :لقا ؟اهب عنصي ام ةأرملا تومتف ةأرما مهعم لاو مرحم وذ مث ،اهيفك نطب لسغي :لقا ؟اهب عنصي فيكف :تلق ،اهرتسب الله رمأ يتلا اهنساحم نم ئش اهل فشكي لاو .اهيفك رهظ لسغي مث ،اههجو لسغي
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): May I be sacrificed for you, what do you say about a woman who is traveling with men, with no mahram among them and no woman with them, and she dies- what should be done with her? He said: Wash from her what Allah has made obligatory for tayammum without touching her, and do not uncover any of her beauties that Allah has ordered to be covered. I asked: How should it be done? He said: Wash the inside of her palms, then wash her face, then wash the back of her palms.

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: سيل لاجر عم تومت ةأرملا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ لأسي انل بحاص ىضم :لقا دقرف نب دواد نع .اهيفك نولسغي نكلو مهيلع كلذ لخدي اذإ :لاقف ؟اهبايث اهيلعو اهنولسغي له مرحم وذ مهيف
englishText: From Dawud bin Farqad who said: A companion of ours went to ask Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who dies among men with no mahram present can they wash her while she's in her clothes? He said: That would be difficult for them, but they should wash her palms.

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: ،هئاسن نم مرحم وذ لاو هتأرما نهيف سيل ءاسنلا عم رفسلا يف لجرلا تام اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع .هنرهطيو نهيديبأ هنسملي لاو .هتروع ىلإ نرظني لاو ،ابص ءاملا هيلع نببصيو ،هيتبكر ىلإ هنرزوي :لقا
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) who said: If a man dies while traveling with women, and neither his wife nor any of his female mahrams are among them, he said: They should cover him up to his knees, and pour water over him without looking at his private parts. They should not touch him with their hands while purifying him.

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: تيفوت ةأرما نإ :اولاقف رفن (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر ىتأ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع نع لولأا دانسلاباو نم ةأرما متدجو امأ لاقف ،ابص ءاملا اهيلع انببص اولاقف ؟اهب متعنص فيك :لاقف ،مرحم وذ اهعم سيلو انعم .!؟اهومتممي لافأ :لاقف ،لا :اولاقف ؟اهلسغت باتكلا لهأ
englishText: Through the first chain from Ali (peace be upon him) who said: Some people came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: A woman died among us with no mahram present. He asked: What did you do with her? They said: We poured water over her. He said: Did you not find a woman from the Ahl al-Kitab (People of the Book) to wash her? They said: No. He said: Why did you not perform tayammum on her?!

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: فلخ نم ءاملا هيلع نببصي :لقا ،لجر نهعم سيل ةوسن هعمو تام لجر يف (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع سيل لاجرلا عم تومت ةأرملاو ،هربق هنلخديو ،افص هيلع نيلصيو ،رتسلا تحت نم هنافكأ يف هنففليو بوثلا .نونفديو نولصيو اهنافكأ يف اهنوفليو بوثلا فلخ نم ءاملا نوبصي :لقا ةأرما مهعم
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding a man who died with women present but no man among them, he said: They should pour water over him from behind a cloth and wrap him in his shrouds from under the cover, and pray over him in a row, and place him in his grave. And for a woman who dies among men with no woman present, he said: They should pour water from behind a cloth and wrap her in her shrouds and pray and bury her.

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: اهنم لسغي :لاقف مرحم وذ لاو ءاسن اهعم سيلو رفس يف تتام ةأرما نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس .نفدتو ،اهيلع لىصيو ،ءوضولا عضوم
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a woman who died while traveling with no women or mahram present, so he said: Wash the parts washed in ablution, pray over her, and bury her.

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: .ةأرما دجوت نأ لاإ ةأرملا لجرلا لسغي لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said: A man should not wash a woman unless a woman is found. Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram ...

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: .اهيفك لسغي :لقا ،مرحم اهعم سيلو تومت ةأرملا نع لئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said when asked about a woman who dies and has no mahram (close male relative) with her, he said: Her palms should be washed.

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: ضعب اهلسغ اهلسغت ةأرما اودجي ملف لاجرلا عم تتام اذإ ةأرملا :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس .ةقرخ هيدي لىع فلي نأ بحتسيو ،بوثلا ءارو نم لاجرلا
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When a woman dies among men and they cannot find a woman to wash her, one of the men should wash her from behind a cloth, and it is recommended to wrap his hands with a rag.

chapter: Recommendation Of A Man Washing A Woman Who Has No Woman Or Mahram Available From Behind A Cloth By Pouring Water On Her, Or Washing Her Face And Palms, Or Performing Tayammum For Her, And Likewise For A Man
arabicText: اهيلع ءاملا نوبصي مرحم مهيف اهل سيل موق عم ةأرملا تتام اذإ :لوقي (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تعمس ،ابص هيلع ءاملا نببصي :ةفينح وبأ لاقف مرحم هل نهيف سيل ةوسن عم تام لجرو ،ابص وهو هيلإ هنم نرظني نأ نهل لحي ناك ام هنم نسسمي نأ نهل لحي لب :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لاقف .ابص هيلع ءاملا نببص حي وهو هسملاو هيلإ رظنلا نهل لحي لا يذلا عضوملا نغلب اذفإ ،حي خيشلا هركذ ،بابحتسلاا لىع ثيداحلأا هذه اولمح كلذلف ،بوجولا ىفن لىعو كلذ لىع لدي ام مدقت دق :لوقأ .ةزانجلا ةلاص يف ةأرملبا ىلوأ جوزلا نأ ثيداحأ يف دوصقملا ضعب لىع لدي ام يتيأو ،هريغو
englishText: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When a woman dies among people and has no mahram among them, they should pour water over her. And about a man who dies among women who are not mahram to him, Abu Hanifah said: They should pour water over him. Then Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: Rather, they are allowed to touch of him what they were allowed to see of him when he was alive, and when they reach the parts that they were not allowed to see or touch when he was alive, they should pour water over him. I (Hurr Amili) say: What has preceded indicates this and indicates the absence of obligation, therefore they interpreted these hadiths as recommended, as mentioned by Al-Shaykh and others, and what follows will indicate some of the intended meaning in the hadiths that the husband has more right to the woman in the funeral prayer.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Washing A Three-year-old Boy Or Younger And Men Washing A Three-year-old Girl Or Younger
arabicText: .نينس ثلاث ىلإ :لاقف ؟ءاسنلا هلسغت مك ىلإ يبصلا نع ينثدح :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق
englishText: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Tell me until what age can women wash a boy? He said: Up to three years.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Washing A Three-year-old Boy Or Younger And Men Washing A Three-year-old Girl Or Younger
arabicText: نعو ،ءاسنلا نايبصلا لسغي امنإ :لقا ةأرما هلسغت يبصلا نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .اهب سانلا ىلوأ لجر ،اهلسغي :لقا ،اهلسغت ةأرما باصت لاو تومت ةيبصلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he was asked about a woman washing a boy, he said: Women only wash young boys. And about a girl who dies and no woman is found to wash her, he said: A man who is closest to her in relation washes her.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Washing A Three-year-old Boy Or Younger And Men Washing A Three-year-old Girl Or Younger
arabicText: ملو تنفد تس وأ نينس سمخ نم لقأ تنب تناك اذإ :لاقف لجرلا عم تومت ةيراجلا يف يور :لقا هنعو .لسغت يتيأو ،رثكأ هلصأو ،مهو انه لقأ ظفل :لقا هنأ سواط نبا نع لقنو ،ثلاثلا لىع ةديازلا لىع لومحم اذه :لوقأ .نقيتملا ردقلا هنلأ ثلاثلا لىع داز اميف دارم ريغ طرشلا موهفمف اذه لىعو ،قودصلا قيرط نم هلثم
englishText: And from him, it was narrated regarding a girl who dies among men, he said: If she is less than five or six years old, she is buried without washing. I (Hurr Amili) say: This applies to more than three years, and it was reported from Ibn Tawus that he said: The word "less" here is a mistake, and its original is "more," and something similar comes from Al-Saduq's way, and based on this, the understood condition is not intended for what exceeds three years because it is the certain amount.

chapter: Permissibility Of Women Washing A Three-year-old Boy Or Younger And Men Washing A Three-year-old Girl Or Younger
arabicText: يف لاجرلا عم تومت ةيراجلا يف (هعماج) يف نسحلا نب دمحم انخيش ركذ :لقا نيسحلا نب ليع نب دمحم سمخ نم لقأ تنب تناك نإو ،لسغت ملو تنفد تس وأ نينس سمخ نم رثكأ ةنبا تناك اذإ لقا رفسلا ،تلسغ نينس
englishText: Muhammad bin Ali bin Al-Husayn said: Our Shaykh Muhammad bin Al-Hasan Permissibility Of Women Washing A Three-year-old Boy Or Younger And... mentioned in his (Jami') regarding a girl who dies among men during travel, he said if she is more than five or six years old, she is buried without washing, and if she is less than five years old, she is washed.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: نيح هتأرما ىلإ رظني نأ هل حلصيأ لجرلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا نانس نب الله دبع نع ؟تومي نيح اهجوز نم كلذ لثم ىلإ رظنت له ةأرملا نعو ؟اهلسغي نم اهدنع نكي مل نإ اهلسغي وأ ،تومت .اهنم هنوهركي ئش ىلإ اهجوز رظني نأ ةيهارك ةأرملا لهأ كلذ لعفي امنإ ،كلذب سبأ لا :لاقف
englishText: From Abdullah bin Sinan who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about whether it is permissible for a man to look at his wife when she dies, or to wash her if there is no one else to wash her? And about the woman, can she look at her husband similarly when he dies? He said: There is no problem with that. The woman's family only does that because they dislike her husband seeing something of her they would dislike.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: .بوثلا ءارو نم معن :لقا ؟هتأرما لسغي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked him about a man washing his wife? He said: Yes, from behind a cloth.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: هلسغت :لقا ؟ءاسنلا لاإ هلسغي نم هدنع سيلو تومي لجرلا نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع تحت هدي اهجوز لخدي تتام اذإ ةأرملا يفو ،ابص ءاملا هيلع ءاسنلا بصتو ،هل ناك نإ هتبارق وذ وأ ،هتأرما .اهلسغيف اهصيمق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he was asked about a man who dies and has no one to wash him except women? He said: His wife should wash him, or his female relative if he has one, and the women should pour water over him, and regarding a woman when she dies, her husband can put his hand under her shirt to wash her. Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing H...

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: .ابصعت اهلهأ اهعنمي امنإ معن :لقا ؟هتأرما لسغي لجرلا نع هتلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked him about a man washing his wife? He said: Yes, her family only prevents it out of tribalism.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: .قفارملا ىلإ اهصيمق تحت هدي اهجوز لخدي :لقا ،تتام اذإ ةأرملا نع هتلأس :لقا ةعامس نع
englishText: From Sama'ah who said: I asked him about when a woman dies, he said: Her husband puts his hand under her shirt up to the elbows.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: امنأكف نينمؤملا ريمأ كاذ لقا ؟(ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا لسغ نم (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق لا :لاقف ،كادف تلعج كلذ ناك دق :تلقف ؟هب كتربخأ امم تقض كنأك :يل لاقف ،هلوق نم كلذ تعظفتسا ؟ىسيع لاإ اهلسغي مل ميرم نأ تملع امأ ،قيدص لاإ اهلسغي نكي مل ةقيدص اهنفإ نقيضت
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): Who washed Fatima (peace be upon her)? He said: That was Amir al-Mu'minin. It was as if I found that statement shocking, so he said to me: It seems you are troubled by what I told you? I said: That did happen, may I be sacrificed for you. He said: Don't be troubled, for she was a truthful one and only a truthful one could wash her. Don't you know that no one washed Maryam except Isa?

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: نفدي :لقا ،ءاسنلا لاإ اهيف هعم سيل ضرلأا يف وأ رفسلا يف تومي لجر يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع اهجوز اهعم ناك نفإ ،اهجوز اهعم نوكي نأ لاإ ةلزنملا كلتب لاجرلا عم نوكت ةأرملا يف :لقاو ،لسغي لاو لجرلا لثم تسيل ةأرملاو ،تام اذإ هتأرما هلسغتلو ،ابكس ءاملا اهيلع بكسيو عردلا قوف نم اهلسغيلف .تومت نيح ارظنم ءوسأ ةأرملاو
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who dies while traveling or in a land where there are only women with him, he said: He should be buried without washing. And he said regarding a woman who is with men in the same situation, unless her husband is with her- if her husband is with her, he should wash her over her dress and pour water over her, and his wife should wash him when he dies. The woman is not like the man, and the woman looks worse when she dies.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: تحت هدي اهجوز لخدي :لقا ،اهلسغت ةأرما اهعم سيلو تتام اذإ ةأرملا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .قفارملا ىلإ اهلسغيف اهصيمق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a woman who dies and there is no woman with her to wash her, he said: Her husband can put his hand under her shirt and wash her up to the elbows.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: .اهربق يف اهعضي ىتح هتأرمبا قحأ جوزلا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The husband has more right to his wife until he places her in her grave.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: اههجو ىلإ رظني نأ اهجوزل حلصيأ ،تيفوت ةأرما نع (ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج باأ تلأس :لقا ملسم نب دمحم نع .معن :لقا ؟اهسأرو
englishText: From Muhammad bin Muslim who said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a woman who died, is it permissible for her husband to look at her face and head? He said: Yes.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: ىلإ رظني لا ،بوثلا ءارو نم معن :لقا ؟هتأرما لسغي لجرلا نع لئس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع تضقنا دقف يه تتام اذإو ،هنم ةدع يف تناك تام اذإ هنلأ اهجوز لسغت ةأرملاو ،اهنم ئش ىلإ لاو ،اهرعش .اهتدع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: He was asked about a man washing his wife? He said: Yes, from behind a cloth, not looking at her hair or anything of her, and the woman can wash her husband because when he dies she is in her waiting period from him, and when she dies her waiting period has ended.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: نفدي :لقا ءاسنلا لاإ هعم سيل ضرأ يف رفسلا يف تومي لجرلا يف :لقا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع ،اهعم اهجوز نوكي نأ لاإ ،لسغت لاو نفدت ةلزنملا كلتب لاجرلا عم نوكت ةأرملاو ،لسغي لاو اذإ هتأرما هلسغتو ،اهتروع ىلإ رظني لاو ،ابكس اهيلع ءاملا بكسيو عردلا قوف نم اهلسغ اهعم اهجوز ناك نفإ .تتام اذإ ارظنم ءوسأ ةأرملا ،لجرلا ةلزنمب تسيل تتام نإ ةأرملاو ،تام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: Regarding a man who dies while traveling in a land where only women are with him, he said: He is buried without washing, and a woman who is with men in the same situation is buried without washing, unless her husband is with her. Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing H... If her husband is with her, he washes her over the shield and pours water over her, without looking at her private parts, and his wife washes him when he dies. And when a woman dies she is not in the same position as a man, a woman's appearance is worse when she dies.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: اذإو ةدع يف هنم اهنلأ هتأرما هلسغت :لقا ،ءاسنلا لاإ سيلو تومي لجرلا يف (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ةدع يف اهنم سيل هنلأ ،اهلسغي مل تتام
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding a man who dies and there are only women present, he said: His wife washes him because she is in waiting period from him, and if she dies he does not wash her because he is not in waiting period from her.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: مهعم نكي مل اذإ رفسلا يف اهجوز ةأرملاو رفسلا يف هتأرما جوزلا لسغي :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لقا .لجر
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: The husband washes his wife while traveling and the wife washes her husband while traveling if there is no man with them.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: اهنلأ ،نينمؤملا ريمأ اهلسغ :لقا ؟اهلسغ نم (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع وبأ لئس .قيدص لاإ اهلسغيل نكي مل ةقيدص تناك
englishText: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was asked about Fatima (peace be upon her), who washed her? He said: Amir al-Mu'minin washed her, because she was truthful and only a truthful one could wash her.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: .(هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر تنب ةمطفا هتأرما لسغ ايلع نأ هيبأ نع ،دمحم نب رفعج نع
englishText: From Ja'far bin Muhammad, from his father, that Ali washed [performed ghusl for] his wife Fatima, daughter of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: نب نسحلا نع ،هيوببا نبلا (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا رابخأ باتك نم لاقن (ةمغلا فشك) يف ىسيع نب ليع .(ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا لسغ (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ليع
englishText: Ali bin Isa in (Kashf al-Ghumma), quoting from the book Akhbar Fatima (peace be upon her) by Ibn Babawayh, from Al-Hasan bin Ali (peace be upon him) that Ali (peace be upon him) washed Fatima (peace be upon her).

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: هيلع) ليعو ناأ لاإ تتام اذإ اهلسغي لا نأ (ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا ينتصوأ :تلقا سيمع تنب ءامسأ نعو .ليعو ناأ اهتلسغف ،(ملاسلا
englishText: And from Asma bint Umays who said: Fatima (peace be upon her) instructed me that no one should wash her when she dies except for me and Ali (peace be upon him), so I and Ali washed her.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: نسحلا رمأو .(ملاسلا اهيلع) ةمطفا تلسغف اهرمأ (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع نأ - ثيدح - يف ءامسأ نعو .اهربق ىوسو لايل اهنفدو ،ءاملا نلاخدي (ع) نيسحلاو
englishText: And from Asma- in a hadith- that Ali (peace be upon him) ordered her to wash Fatima (peace be upon her). And he ordered Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn (peace be upon them) to bring in the water, and he buried her at night and leveled her grave.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Man Washing His Dead Wife And A Woman Washing Her Dead Husband, And The Recommendation Of Doing So From Behind A Cloth
arabicText: .اهلاسغي نأ سيمع تنب ءامسأو (ملاسلا هيلع) ايلع تصوأ اهنأ يورو :لقا
englishText: He said: And it is narrated that she (Fatima- peace be upon her) instructed Ali (peace be upon him) and Asma bint Umays to wash her.

chapter: Permissibility Of A Mother Of Child (Umm Al-walad) Washing Her Master
arabicText: .هتلسغف تام اذإ هل دلو مأ هلسغت نأ ىصوأ (ملاسلا هيلع) نيسحلا نبا ليع نأ لسغلا لىع ةدعاسملا انه ةيصولا ىنعمف ،ماملاا لاإ هلسغي لا ماملاا نأ ةريثك ثيداحأ يف يورملا :لوقأ هيلع) رقابلا وه انطبا هل يلوتملا ناك نإو ،ةيقتلا وأ زاوجلا نايب وأ ،ءامسأ ثيدح يف رم امك هيف ةكراشملاو .ملعأ اللهو رابخلاا يف هب حيرصتلا عقو امك ،(ملاسلا
englishText: That Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) instructed that his umm walad (slave woman who bore him a child) should wash him when he dies, so she washed him. I (Hurr Amili) say: It is narrated in many hadiths that an Imam can only be washed by an Imam, so the meaning of the instruction here is assistance in washing and participation in it, as mentioned in the hadith of Asma, or to demonstrate permissibility, or for taqiyyah (precautionary dissimulation), even though the one who actually carried it out internally was Al-Baqir (peace be upon him), as explicitly stated in the reports, and Allah knows best.

chapter: Deceased Being Washed By Those Closest To Him, Or By Whoever The Guardian Orders
arabicText: .هب سانلا ىلوأ تيملا لسغي :لقا هنأ (ملاسلا مهيلع) ليع نع
englishText: From Ali (peace be upon him) that he said: The deceased should be washed by those closest to him.

chapter: Deceased Being Washed By Those Closest To Him, Or By Whoever The Guardian Orders
arabicText: .كلذب يلولا هرميأ نم وأ ،هب سانلا ىلوأ تيملا لسغي :(ملاسلا هيلع) نينمؤملا ريمأ لقا
englishText: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: The deceased should be washed by those closest to him, or by whoever the guardian orders to do so.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of A Specific Amount Of Water For Washing The Deceased
arabicText: مك تيملا هب لسغي يذلا ءاملا يف :(ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم يبأ ىلإ رافصلا ينعي نسحلا نب دمحم بتك .الله ءاش نإ رهطي ىتح لسغي تيملا لسغ دح :(ملاسلا هيلع) عقوف ؟هدح
englishText: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (meaning al-Saffar) wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him): Regarding the water used to wash the deceased, what is its limit? He (peace be upon him) replied: The limit of washing the deceased is to wash until he becomes pure, insha'Allah.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of A Specific Amount Of Water For Washing The Deceased
arabicText: ،تيملا هب لسغي يذلا ءاملا دح مك (ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم يبأ ىلإ بتك هنأ رافصلا نسحلا نب دمحم نع ؟هب لسغي يذلا ءاملا نم دح تيملل لهف ةعستب ضئاحلاو ءام نم لاطرأ ةتسب لسغي بنجلا نأ هاور امك .ىلاعت الله ءاش نإ رهطي ىتح لسغي تيملا لسغ دح :(ملاسلا هيلع) عقوف .ةفيحص يف ملاسلا هيلع هطخب يدنع (ملاسلا هيلع) هتاعيقوت ةلمج يف عيقوتلا اذهو :قودصلا لقا
englishText: From Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, that he wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him): What is the limit of water used to wash the deceased? As it is narrated that a person in the state of janabah is washed with six ratls of water and a menstruating woman with nine. So is there a limit of water with which the deceased is washed? He (peace be upon him) replied: The limit of washing the deceased is to wash until he becomes pure, insha'Allah, the Exalted. Al-Saduq said: This reply is among his (peace be upon him) replies I have in his handwriting (peace be upon him) in a scroll.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Plenty Of Water In Ghusl Al-Mayyit Up To Seven Water Skins
arabicText: رئب نم برق عبسب ينلسغفا تم ناأ اذإ ليع يا :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله لوسر لقا .سرغ
englishText: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him): O Ali, when I die, wash me with seven water skins from the well of Ghars.

chapter: Recommendation Of Using Plenty Of Water In Ghusl Al-Mayyit Up To Seven Water Skins
arabicText: لوسر نإ :لقا ؟دودحم دح تيملا هب لسغي يذلا ءاملل له كادف تلعج :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق سرغ رئب ءام نم برق تس يل قتسفا تم ناأ اذإ :(ملاسلا هيلع) ليعل لقا (هلآو هيلع الله لىص) الله ،ينطنحو ينفكو ينلسغفا ينلأست لا اللهوف ،تئش امع ينلس مث ،ينسلجأو ينفك عماجمب ذخف يطينحتو ينفكو ليسغ نم تغرف اذفإ .هيف كتبجأ لاإ ئش نع
englishText: I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): May I be sacrificed for you, is there a specific limit for the water used to wash the deceased? He said: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him): When I die, draw six water skins of water from the well of Ghars and wash me, shroud me, and apply perfume to me. When you are done with washing me, shrouding me, and applying perfume to me, take hold of the edges of my shroud and sit me up, then ask me whatever you wish, for by Allah, you will not ask me about anything except that I will answer you about it.

chapter: Dislike Of Pouring The Water Used For Ghusl Al-Mayyit Into The Lavatory, And The Permissibility Of Pouring It Into The Drain
arabicText: هيلع بصي يذلا هؤامو تيملا لسغي نأ زوجي له :(ملاسلا هيلع) دمحم يبأ ىلإ نسحلا نب دمحم بتك :(ملاسلا هيلع) عقوف ؟فينك يف هئوضو ءام بصني نأ ةلاصلا ءوضو أضوتي لجرلا وأ ؟فينك رئب ىلإ لخدي .عيل لاب يف كلذ نوكي
englishText: Muhammad bin Al-Hasan wrote to Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him): Is it permissible to wash the deceased and allow the water poured over them to flow into a lavatory pit? Or for a person performing ablution for prayer to pour their ablution water into a lavatory? He (peace be upon him) wrote: That should be done in drains.

chapter: Permissibility Of Washing The Deceased In The Open And The Recommendation Of Placing A Cover Between The Deceased And The Sky
arabicText: لا :لقا ؟ءاضفلا يف لسغي له تيملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) نسحلا يبأ هيخأ نع ،رفعج نب ليع نع .ىلإ بحأ وهف رتسب رتس نإو سبأ
englishText: From Ali bin Ja'far, from his brother Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about washing the deceased in the open space? He said: There is no problem, and if covered with a cover it is more beloved to me.

chapter: Permissibility Of Washing The Deceased In The Open And The Recommendation Of Placing A Cover Between The Deceased And The Sky
arabicText: .لسغ اذإ ينعي ،ارتس ءامسلا نيبو تيملا نيب لعجي نأ بحتسي ناك هباأ نأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that his father used to prefer placing a cover between the deceased and the sky, meaning when washing them.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Washing For The Deceased If They Were In A State Of Janabah, Menstruation, Or Post-childbirth Bleeding
arabicText: :لقا ؟ءاملا نم هيزجي امو ؟لسغي فيك بنج وهو تام تيم :(ملاسلا هيلع) رفعج يبلأ تلق :لقا ةرارز نع .ةدحاو ةمرح يف اعمتجا ناتمرح امهنلأ ،تيملا لسغلو ةبانجلل كلذ يزجي ادحاو لاسغ لسغي
englishText: From Zurarah who said: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): A deceased person who died and he was a junub (in a state of sexual impurity), how should they be washed? And what amount of water suffices? He said: One ghusl suffices for both the janabah and the ghusl al-mayyit, because they are two sacred obligations combined into one sacred obligation.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Washing For The Deceased If They Were In A State Of Janabah, Menstruation, Or Post-childbirth Bleeding
arabicText: لسغ لثم :لقا ؟لسغت فيك اهسافن يف تتام اذإ ةأرملا نع لئس هنأ (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .طقف ادحاو لاسغ لسغي امنإ ،بنجلا كلذكو ،ضئاحلا كلذكو ،رهاطلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he was asked about a woman who dies during her post-childbirth bleeding, how should she be washed? He said: Like the ghusl of a pure person, and likewise for the menstruating woman, and likewise for the person in the state of janabah, they are only washed once.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Washing For The Deceased If They Were In A State Of Janabah, Menstruation, Or Post-childbirth Bleeding
arabicText: .دحاو لسغ :لقا ،؟بنج وهو تومي تيملا نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) ميهاربإ يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him), he said: I asked him about a deceased person who dies while in a state of janabah? He said: One ghusl.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Washing For The Deceased If They Were In A State Of Janabah, Menstruation, Or Post-childbirth Bleeding
arabicText: .ةدحاو ةلسغ لاإ هيلع سيل :لقا ،تام اذإ بنجلا يف (ملاسلا امهيلع) امهدحأ نع ،ريصب يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Basir, from one of them (peace be upon them both) regarding one who dies while in a state of janabah, he said: They only require one washing.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Washing For The Deceased If They Were In A State Of Janabah, Menstruation, Or Post-childbirth Bleeding
arabicText: .كلذ دعب لستغا مث ادحاو لاسغ لسغ بنج وهو تيملا تام اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .رهاظ وهو ،سملا لستغي لساغلا نأ دارملا :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: When a deceased person dies while in a state of janabah, they are given one washing then washed after that. I (Hurr Amili) say: What is meant is that the washer performs the washing for touching the deceased, and this is apparent.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Washing For The Deceased If They Were In A State Of Janabah, Menstruation, Or Post-childbirth Bleeding
arabicText: مث ءامب ةدحاو ةلسغ لسغي :لقا ،؟بنج وهو تام لجر نع هتلأس :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كلذ دعب لستغي
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: I asked him about a man who died while in a state of janabah? He said: He is given one washing with water then washed after that.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Washing For The Deceased If They Were In A State Of Janabah, Menstruation, Or Post-childbirth Bleeding
arabicText: مث ةبانجلا نم لسغي :لقا ،؟بنج وهو تومي لجرلا :(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبلأ تلق :لقا صيع نع .لاوأ ىنملا نم تيملا ندب لسغي هنأ هب داري نأ لمتحي اذه :لوقأ .تيملا لسغ دعب لسغي
englishText: From 'Ees who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): A man dies while he is in a state of janabah? He said: He should be washed from the janabah then washed again after the ghusl al-mayyit. I (Hurr Amili) say: This could mean that the body of the deceased should first be washed from semen.

chapter: Sufficiency Of One Washing For The Deceased If They Were In A State Of Janabah, Menstruation, Or Post-childbirth Bleeding
arabicText: ،ادحاو لاسغ لسغ بنج وهو تيملا تام اذإ :لقا - ثيدح يف - هيبأ نع ،(ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .كلذ دعب لسغي مث ةعامج دحاوب ضراعي نأ زوجي لاو ،مساقلا نب صيع وهو دحاو اهيف لصلأا ةثلاثلا تيااورلا هذه :خيشلا لقا نوكي نأ نكميو :لقا ،بابحتسلاا لىع ةلومحم اهنإ :لقا مث ،ةقباسلا ثيداحلأا قفاوي وه ام يور دقو ،ةريثك مث تنأ لستغت مث تيملا لسغت :هل لقا هنأكف ،هلساغ ىلإ هجوت امنإ تيملا لسغ دعب لاستغلابا رملاا .مدقت امب دهشتسا تيم لك نأ مدقت دقو .ةماعلا ضعبل هتقفاومل ةيقتلا لىعو ،لاوأ ةساجنلا ةلازإ لىع لمحلا لمتحيو :لوقأ .لاسغلأا لخادت لىع لدي ام مدقتو ،بنج
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), from his father- in a hadith- he said: If a deceased person dies while in a state of janabah, they should be given one ghusl, then washed after that. The Shaykh said: These three narrations originate from one source, who is 'Ees bin Al-Qasim, and it is not permissible for one person to contradict a large group, and what has been narrated agrees with the previous hadiths, then he said: it is interpreted Sufficiency Of One Washing For The Deceased If They Were In A State... as recommended, he said: and it's possible that the command to perform ghusl after washing the deceased was directed to the person washing the deceased, as if saying to him: wash the deceased then perform ghusl yourself, then he cited what was previously mentioned as evidence. I (Hurr Amili) say: It could be interpreted as removing impurity first, and as taqiyyah due to its agreement with some of the aammah (general muslims). It has been previously mentioned that every deceased person is in a state of janabah, and evidence of the overlapping of different types of ritual washing has been presented before.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Repeating The Ghusl Al-Mayyit If Something Comes Out After It, And The Obligation Of Washing Only The Impurity
arabicText: .لسغلا دعت لاو هنم ادب يذلا لسغفا هلسغ دعب ئش تيملا نم ادب نإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If something appears from the deceased after washing him, wash what has appeared from him and do not repeat the washing.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Repeating The Ghusl Al-Mayyit If Something Comes Out After It, And The Obligation Of Washing Only The Impurity
arabicText: لسغي :لقا ،هلسغ نم غرفي ام دعب ئشلا هنم جرخي تيملا نع هانلأس :لاقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .لسغلا هيلع داعيو كلذ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), they said: We asked him about the deceased if something comes out after finishing washing him. He said: That should be washed and the washing should be repeated. Translator: There is apparent contradiction between this and Hadith 2858. We don't know how different the circumstances were in these two hadith. The following questions could be raised: 1. Was the amount of impurity large or small? 2. Whether the impurity appeared during the washing or after the complete wash? 3. Whether the impurity appeared before or after the shrouding? 4. Whether the impurity was seen before or after the deceased was placed in the grave?

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Repeating The Ghusl Al-Mayyit If Something Comes Out After It, And The Obligation Of Washing Only The Impurity
arabicText: .هنم ضرق نفكلا باصفأ نفكي ام دعب ئش تيملا نم جرخ ذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ربقلا يف تيملا عضو ول ام لىع مهضعبو ،لسغلا ناكمإ مدع لىع انئاملع ضعب هلمح :لوقأ
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If something comes out from the deceased after he is shrouded and it hits the shroud, cut that part out. I (Hurr Amili) say: Some of our scholars interpreted this as applying when washing is not possible, and others interpreted it as when the deceased has been placed in the grave. Non-Obligation Of Repeating The Ghusl Al-Mayyit If Something Comes ...

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Repeating The Ghusl Al-Mayyit If Something Comes Out After It, And The Obligation Of Washing Only The Impurity
arabicText: وأ ةمامعلا باصأو لسغلا دعب ئشلا وأ مدلا تيملا رخنم نم جرخ اذإ :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ضارقملبا ضرق نفكلا
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: If blood or something comes out from the deceased's nostril after washing and it hits the turban or shroud, cut it out with scissors.

chapter: Non-Obligation Of Repeating The Ghusl Al-Mayyit If Something Comes Out After It, And The Obligation Of Washing Only The Impurity
arabicText: ثدحلا لسغي هنفإ لسغلا دعب ثدحأ مث تيملا لسغ اذإ :لقا هعفر هباحصأ ضعب نع ،لهس نع ،مهنعو .لسغلا داعي لاو
englishText: And from them, from Sahl, from some of his companions, raising it [to the Imam] who said: If the deceased is washed and then something occurs after washing, the occurring matter should be washed but the washing should not be repeated.

chapter: Permissibility Of Placing The Deceased Between The Washer's Legs If Fearing They May Fall
arabicText: اذإ ،هلسغتف هقوف نم موقت نأو كيلجر نيب تيملا لعجت نأ سبأ لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع .ههجول طقسي لايك كيلجرب هطبضت لاامشو انيمي هتبلق
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), he said: There is no problem in placing the deceased between your legs and standing over them to wash them. When you turn them right and left, you control them with your legs so they do not fall on their face. Shaykh Hurr Amili: Al-Sheikh interpreted it as permissible, and interpreted what contradicts it as disliked. The dislike should be specified as when there is no fear of dropping.

chapter: Permissibility For The Junub And Menstruating Woman To Wash The Deceased, And For One Who Washed The Deceased To Have Intimate Relations Before Washing From Touching, And The Recommendation Of Wudu In Both Cases, And The Sufficiency Of One Ghusl
arabicText: اتيم لسغ نم وأ ؟تيملا لسغيأ بنجلا نع (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع باأ تلأس :لقا هبر دبع نب باهش نع وهو تيملا لسغو أضوتو هيدي لسغ ،ابنج ناك اذإ كلذب سبأ لاو ،ءاوس امه :لقا ؟لستغي مث هلهأ يتيأأ .امهل دحاو لسغ هيزجيو ،هلهأ ىتأ مث أضوت هلهأ ىتأ مث اتيم لسغ نإو ،بنج
englishText: From Shihab bin Abd Rabbih who said: I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the junub washing the deceased? Or can one who washed a deceased have relations with his wife then perform ghusl? He said: They are the same, and there is no problem with that if he is junub; he washes his hands and performs wudu and washes the deceased while he is junub, and if he washes a deceased then has relations with his wife he performs wudu then has relations with his wife, and one ghusl suffices for both.

chapter: Permissibility For The Junub And Menstruating Woman To Wash The Deceased, And For One Who Washed The Deceased To Have Intimate Relations Before Washing From Touching, And The Recommendation Of Wudu In Both Cases, And The Sufficiency Of One Ghusl
arabicText: .هلسغ ايلي نأ سبأ لاو نيقلتلا دنع بنجلا لاو تيملا ضئاحلا رضحت لا :لقا (ملاسلا هيلع) الله دبع يبأ نع
englishText: From Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said: The menstruating woman and the junub should not attend the deceased during talqeen (prompting), but there is no problem with them performing the washing of the deceased.
